Description:
Job Summary
Technical Expert, Organisation YR Gaitonde Medical Educational & Research Foundation (YRGMERF) - Project Disha. Experience required: 5 years.
Responsibilities
The Technical Experts will provide mentoring and supportive supervision to DISHA cluster units, ensuring the effective implementation of the National AIDS Control Program (NACP) V.
Mentoring and Supervision: Based at the cluster level, provide mentoring support to 4 to 5 DISHA cluster units or DISHA single units.
Conduct monthly visits to all assigned DISHA units to provide on-site mentoring and supportive supervision.
Provide evidence-based technical guidance on all components of NACP V to the DISHA units.
Coordination and Collaboration: Strengthen coordination with allied health departments at the district level (NHM, NTEP, NVHCP) for enhanced referral linkages.
Make field visits to NACP facilities along with DISHA staff for supportive supervision and capacity building.
Reporting and Data Quality: Ensure the timely and quality submission of monthly reports for DISHA.
Verify data reported by at least 3 facilities per district each month and provide inputs to ensure data quality.
Guidance and Capacity Building: Guide the DISHA team on advocacy, stakeholder coordination, and coordination with other departments in the district.
Assist DISHA in developing district profiles, integrated action plans, and DISHA-specific IEC materials.
Orient and ensure optimal implementation of all component activities as per NACP V in the district/DISHA cluster.
Implementation of Strategies: Guide DISHA units on implementing new strategies of NACP V, such as CSS, SSS, SOA, use of virtual media, APN, index case, etc.
Provide component-wise inputs and guidance to enhance the overall performance of DISHA units.
Performance Improvement: Responsible for periodical improvement in the 95-95-95 performance targets of the DISHA cluster.
Field Visits: Conduct field visits for a minimum of 20 days per month to provide on-site support and supervision.
Requirements
Desirable Attributes: Master's Degree in Social Work, Sociology, Public Health, Humanities, or a related field.
Minimum of 5 years of experience in public health projects, particularly in HIV/AIDS programs.
Strong understanding of NACP V and public health systems.
Excellent mentoring, supervisory, and capacity-building skills.
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
Proficiency in data analysis and reporting.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
Flexibility to travel extensively within the assigned region.

Job Description
Job description Sales (LAP) Area Sales Manager
Job Type: Full-time
About IIFL Finance: IIFL Finance is a leading financial services provider in India, known for its comprehensive range of solutions including loans, insurance, and investment products. We are expanding our footprint and are excited to offer opportunities in the LAP (Loan Against Property) segment in the LAP region.
Position Overview: We are looking for a dynamic and motivated Sales Representative to join our LAP team at IIFL Finance. This role involves promoting our Loan Against Property products, building relationships with clients, and achieving sales targets in the LAP region. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in financial sales and a deep understanding of the local property market.
Key Responsibilities:
DSA Network for Sales Maximization: Maximize sales through a network of DSA by effectively managing connector and builder relationships to ensure strong business
Disbursement Target Management and Achievement: Drive Disbursement Target vs Achievement for LAP product - as per expected business growth plan.
Collaboration: Work closely with internal teams such as underwriting and customer service to ensure smooth customer service.
Market Research: Stay informed about local real estate trends, property values, and competitive offerings. Use market insights to refine sales strategies and identify new opportunities.
Desired Candidate Profile:
5+ years of experience strong understanding handling LAP Product
Problem Solving ability
Bachelors degree in finance or any other field - Graduation is a must

Description:
About IIFL Finance
IIFL Finance is one of the most preferred Gold Loan financing company inIndia

Having presence in 25 states and a network of 2700+ branches on a PANIndia level, our mission is to cater to the needs of all those who are lookingfor an easy swift, and low-cost financing option

Our customers can avail gold loansthrough submitting an online application or visiting any of our branches intheir vicinity

We also have an option where the customers can avail gold loansat their doorstep so that they are not deprived of financing options to fulfilltheir needs

Our core values serve as a moral compass in all our activities

Fairness, Integrity, andTransparency - FIT is the driving force behind all that we do at IIFL

Weonly work with people who fit into our professional ethos

We are resolute inthe observance of these values and will let go of any growth opportunities thatdeem unfit

Job Title Customer Care Executive (Gold Loans)
Job Description -
Responsible toacquire New Customers for generating Gold Loan business and for other cross sell products

Participate in field- marketing activities toimprove the brand visibility of IIFL Finance Limited branch in the catchment areas and generate leads of prospective customers

Drive ensure continuous customer engagement through various channels

Maintaining quality portfolio by trackingcontrolling ROI

Provide after salesservice to existing customers and obtain references from them to increase thecustomer base

Strong follow up on interest collectionsto keep NPAs (non-performing assets) under control

Desired Candidate Profile (CCE) -
Candidateswith 6 months of sales experience in Banking Financial Services can applyfor the role

Fresherswith flair in Sales can also apply

In summary,the role focuses heavily on sales - acquiring new customers, engaging withexisting ones, ensuring portfolio quality, and collecting payments to minimizedefaults

Brand building through field marketing is also a key component

CTC Upto 2

37 Lacs ( for Non Metro) / 2

8Lacs ( for Metro )
Incentives extra - Best in the industry

Description:
Here is a professional Job Description for an Assistant Restaurant Manager WOW! momo, suitable for recruitment portals, LinkedIn, and internal hiring.
JOB DESCRIPTION
Assistant Restaurant Manager WOW! momo
Department: Operations
Designation: Assistant Restaurant Manager (ARM)
Industry: Quick Service Restaurant (QSR) / Food & Beverage
Reports To: Restaurant Manager / Area Operations Manager
Employment Type: Full-Time
Work Location: As per business requirement
About WOW! momo
WOW! momo is one of India’s leading homegrown QSR brands, known for its innovative food offerings, customer-centric approach, and fast-growing restaurant network. We are looking for energetic, customer-focused, and result-oriented professionals to join our restaurant operations team.
Job Purpose
To support the Restaurant Manager in managing day-to-day restaurant operations, ensuring excellent customer experience, maintaining food quality and safety standards, driving sales and profitability, and developing a motivated team that consistently delivers WOW! service.
Key Responsibilities
1. Restaurant Operations
Manage daily restaurant operations and ensure smooth functioning across all shifts.
Ensure adherence to Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), operational checklists, and company policies.
Monitor opening and closing activities, equipment functionality, cleanliness, and overall restaurant readiness.
Ensure timely order preparation, accurate billing, and efficient order delivery.
2. Sales & Business Performance
Drive daily sales and achieve assigned sales targets.
Monitor key performance indicators such as average order value, customer footfall, order accuracy, and sales growth.
Identify opportunities to improve upselling, cross-selling, and customer conversions.
Support cost control initiatives and improve restaurant profitability.
3. People Management & Development
Lead, coach, and motivate Team Members and Shift Managers.
Ensure adequate manpower availability and effective shift scheduling.
Drive employee engagement, attendance, discipline, and retention.
Train team members on product knowledge, customer service, food preparation, and operational standards.
Identify high-potential employees and support their career growth through on-the-job training and development.
4. Customer Experience
Ensure exceptional customer service and a positive dining experience.
Handle customer complaints and resolve service issues promptly.
Maintain service speed, product consistency, and order accuracy.
Build customer loyalty through friendly, efficient, and professional service.
5. Food Safety & Quality
Ensure compliance with food safety, hygiene, sanitation, and food handling standards.
Monitor product quality, portion control, freshness, and adherence to recipes.
Ensure proper storage, stock rotation, and expiry-date monitoring.
Maintain a clean, safe, and hygienic restaurant environment.
6. Inventory & Cost Management
Monitor inventory levels and ensure timely stock replenishment.
Minimize food wastage, pilferage, and operational losses.
Conduct stock counts and support inventory reconciliation.
Monitor consumption, food cost, packaging cost, and other controllable expenses.
7. Cash Management & Compliance
Ensure accurate cash handling, billing, POS operations, and end-of-day reconciliation.
Maintain operational records, registers, and reports as required.
Follow company policies and applicable statutory requirements.
Ensure proper handling of cash, inventory, and other company assets.
Eligibility Criteria
Education: Graduate preferred; candidates with relevant qualifications and QSR experience may also be considered.
Experience: 2–4 years of experience in restaurant operations, preferably in QSR, food service, or retail operations.
Prior experience in team handling, shift management, customer service, and sales performance is preferred.
Required Skills & Competencies
Strong leadership and team management skills.
Customer-first attitude and problem-solving ability.
Sales orientation and business acumen.
Good communication and interpersonal skills.
Ability to multitask and work in a fast-paced environment.
Knowledge of inventory management, cash handling, and food safety.
Willingness to work in rotational shifts, weekends, and holidays as per business requirements.
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
Achievement of restaurant sales targets.
Customer satisfaction and complaint resolution.
Food cost, wastage, and controllable expense management.
Employee attendance, retention, and manpower availability.
Food safety, hygiene, and audit compliance scores.
Order accuracy and service speed.
Team productivity, training completion, and internal promotions.
Career Growth
At WOW! momo, high-performing Assistant Restaurant Managers can develop their leadership capabilities and progress toward Restaurant Manager and higher operations leadership roles, based on performance and business requirements.
Why Join WOW! momo?
Opportunity to work with a growing Indian QSR brand.
Performance-driven work culture.
Hands-on operational and leadership development.
Career growth opportunities within the organization.
Join WOW! momo and be part of a team that delivers great food, great service, and a WOW! customer experience every day.
AboutCompany:
Wow! Momo's FMCG Business Overview
Wow! Momo, while primarily known for its QSR (Quick Service Restaurant) chain, is also making significant strides in the FMCG (Fast-Moving Consumer Goods) sector. Here's a breakdown of the FMCG business:
Key Aspects:
Product Range:
Frozen Momos: This is a core offering, allowing customers to enjoy Wow! Momo's products at home.
Wow! Noodles: A recent addition, featuring a range of "Desi-Asian" flavored instant noodles.
Other Products: Includes items like Wow! Smiley, with plans to expand into categories like kulfi, Beverages called coco charge
Growth and Strategy:
Aggressive expansion in the FMCG segment is underway.
The company aims to establish the FMCG division as a substantial revenue contributor.
Focus on both online (e-commerce, especially quick commerce) and offline (general trade stores, modern trade outlets) distribution channels.
Financials:
The FMCG segment is currently smaller than the QSR business but exhibits rapid growth.
Ambitious revenue targets have been set for the FMCG division.
Overall: Wow! Momo is leveraging its brand to diversify into the FMCG sector, offering convenient food products to a broader consumer base.

Description:
Position Title: Cluster Visual Merchandising - MP & CG

Reports to: Senior Regional Visual Merchandiser (West and East)

Location: Indore

Position Summary:
To ensure enhancement of visual representation of the store by continuously updating the look and feel of the store.
Maintaining RESEC Campaigns, Zoning and Key initiative roll-out
Elevated shopping experience and customer readiness of stores focus on store visits and audit
Fostering VM creativity at stores - Focus on VM training to guide store team to understand brand guidelines and help create an attractive, engaging store environment. Enhancing brand image, improve customer experience and drive sales
Responsible for sharing monthly beat plan covering all formats of stores
Innovation and creativity for the lighthouse stores.

Key Objectives:
Provide support to store teams to ensure brand and visual merchandising standards are understood and consistently upheld.
Plan, order and coordinate for VM supplies for seasonal / monthly changes for the set of stores.
Train Store Management and Support teams on merchandising standards, proper fixture utilization and techniques.
Organizing and sending weekly/monthly reports to the Head Office and implementing feedback.
Maintaining a vendor base for various branded supply elements for the region.
Fostering VM creativity to front end through VM trainings, Competitions & Store Audits.
Supporting Key initiatives roll outs by covering all store formats.

Key Performance Indicators:
Net Sales
Stock Cover
Budget efficiency
Constant upliftment of look & feel of stores.

Organizational relationships:
Internal: Visual Merchandising Team, Sales Ops Team, Projects team and Merchandising Team
External: Hangers Vendors, Mannequin Vendors and Print media vendors.

Eligibility Criteria And Functional Competencies Required:
5+ years of experience.
Bachelors/Masters degree in Fashion Communication / Fashion /Accessories/ Textile Design.
Work experience as a Visual Merchandiser including design/ execution.
Demonstrable visual design skills with a strong retail merchandising portfolio.
Proficiency in Microsoft presentation & excel, Photoshop, Illustrator and other visual design tools.
Well versed with best practices of VM in Global industry.
Excelling Photography skill.
Creative and innovative thinker.
Acing Number game- analyzing and tracking of the executions done.
A proficient communicator.

Role Overview:
Lead all engineering, technical maintenance, HSE, and AMC operations at The Client's Powai facility, ensuring a safe, compliant, and high-performing facility environment. Oversee critical building systems, statutory compliance, vendor management, and operational excellence as per Master Service Agreement requirements.
Key Responsibilities:
Manage all technical operations, maintenance, and uptime for site systems including MEP, HVAC, fire/life safety, BMS, DG sets, lifts, and water systems
Regularly review asset health, preventive maintenance schedules, system performance, and identify improvement opportunities
Plan and execute all technical preparations for meetings, conferences, client visits, and special events
Perform daily check-ins and inspections around facility to ensure high technical and safety standards
Ensure 100% compliance with all statutory and regulatory requirements including labour, fire, EHS, DG, lifts, FSSAI, and environmental laws
Maintain audit-ready documentation, statutory registers, and ensure timely submissions of compliance reports
Develop and enforce SOPs for technical operations, safety procedures, and emergency response protocols
Lead Business Continuity Planning (BCP) preparedness, conduct drills, and coordinate emergency response procedures
Coordinate and manage AMC vendor partners: validate contract compliance, oversee maintenance delivery, and schedule preventive and corrective work
Review vendor service reports, close technical findings, and ensure quality standards are met
Manage contractors and service providers: qualification checks, safety plan reviews, EHS document control, and ongoing performance monitoring
Conduct regular technical, safety, and risk audits; investigate incidents and drive corrective action closure
Provide staff HSE and safety training; promote safety culture across facility operations
Submit all compliance, audit, incident, and performance reports accurately and on time
Maintain operational and technical records as per contract and regulatory requirements
Drive sustainability initiatives, energy efficiency, technology adoption, and continuous service improvements
Collaborate with Facility Manager, site leadership, vendors, and client stakeholders on priorities, procurement, and budget management
Identify and implement best practices to help facility systems perform at optimal levels
Qualifications:
Bachelor's degree in engineering (Mechanical, Electrical, Civil) or related technical discipline
5-7 years of progressive experience in facilities management, engineering operations, or HSE leadership roles
Strong knowledge of building systems including MEP, HVAC, fire/life safety, BMS, DG sets, and critical infrastructure
Understanding of statutory compliance requirements including fire safety, EHS regulations, and environmental laws
Experience with AMC/vendor management, contract compliance, and service delivery oversight
Proficiency in audit management, documentation, and regulatory reporting
Working knowledge of digital FM tools, CMMS, and technical reporting systems
Strong problem-solving skills with ability to diagnose technical issues and implement effective solutions
Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities
Team leadership skills with capability to coordinate cross-functional teams and vendors
Tertiary qualifications in building management, facility management, or business management preferred
Certifications in safety, fire safety, or facility management are advantageous

Title : SAP Consultant
Skills: SAP BW (BW on HANA / BW4HANA), Native HANA & S/4HANA CDS Views
Location: Hyderabad / Bangalore/ Indore
Total Exp: 03-08 Years
Notice Period: Joining in 1 to 2 months, FTE only
Position Overview
We are seeking a skilled SAP Technical Consultant with strong expertise in SAP BW (BW on HANA / BW4HANA), Native HANA development, and S/4HANA CDS Views to support enterprise-wide analytics, reporting, and data integration initiatives. The ideal candidate will have 3-8 years of progressive SAP experience with hands-on exposure to data modeling, performance optimization, and cross-functional collaboration in modern SAP data landscapes.
Core Responsibilities
Technical Development & Implementation
Collaborate with business stakeholders, functional consultants, and end-users to analyze requirements and translate them into scalable technical solutions
Design, develop, and implement technical solutions across SAP BW, Native HANA, and S/4HANA CDS Views
Support migration and upgrade activities from legacy systems while maintaining data consistency, quality, and integrity
Participate in technical workshops with business users to gather requirements and contribute to SAP solution design
SAP BW Development & Data Modeling
Design and develop SAP BW/BW4HANA data models using InfoObjects, Advanced DSOs, CompositeProviders, and Open ODS Views
Build and maintain transformations, DTPs, and process chains for efficient data loading and delta management
Develop and optimize BEx queries and analytical reports to support operational and management reporting needs
Implement extraction using standard and custom ODP-based data sources, including SAP ERP/S4HANA extractors
Apply LSA++ modeling principles to design layered, scalable, and maintainable BW data architectures
S/4HANA CDS Views Development
Design and develop ABAP CDS (Core Data Services) views and entities with associations, annotations, and calculations
Implement data models using ABAP CDS views for operational reporting, embedded analytics, and real-time insights
Create and enhance customer-specific CDS views and analytical queries to meet business requirements
Optimize existing CDS views for improved performance and data modeling efficiency
Develop solutions using SAP BTP/BAS and S/4HANA Private Cloud/On-premise environments
Integrate CDS views with Fiori applications and other analytics platforms
Native HANA Development & Performance Optimization
Design and develop Native HANA solutions (HANA 1.0 and HANA 2.0 XSA) using Calculation Views, Attribute Views, and Analytic Views
Create SQL script solutions, stored procedures, and mixed modeling scenarios for analytics use cases
Support BWoH and BW4HANA modeling activities, including Advanced DSOs, CompositeProviders, and ODP extractors
Perform optimization and troubleshooting of Calculation Views and SQL queries using standard performance tuning techniques
Assist with ABAP to HANA SQL conversions and AMDP script implementations
Support HANA security models, transport management, and lifecycle management activities
SAP Functional Knowledge
Good understanding of core S/4HANA/ECC modules including SD, MM, FI/CO, HR, WM, PP, and supply chain processes
Basic knowledge of master data management and data governance practices
Education and Experience:
Bachelor's/Master's in Computer Science, IT, or related field, with a University degree (Master/Diploma/PhD) in IT, and strong independent, team-oriented, and accountable work ethic.
3-8 years of SAP development experience, focusing on SAP BW, Native HANA, and S/4HANA CDS Views
Hands-on experience in at least one full-cycle SAP BW/BW4HANA implementation
Working knowledge of ABAP CDS view development and Native HANA modeling
Good analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work independently as well as in a team
This role is ideal for a motivated SAP professional who is passionate about leveraging SAP BW, Native HANA, and S/4HANA CDS technologies to deliver reliable, enterprise-scale data and analytics solutions as part of a collaborative technical team.
Application Process
Qualified candidates should submit:
Detailed resume highlighting project experience
Cover letter describing relevant technical achievements
Portfolio of completed data analytics projects (if available)
Professional references from previous SAP implementations
We are an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace.
Working at HGS
At HGS, our employees get an open and collaborative environment and gain experience working for customers in various industries while solving complex business problems. They get support to learn new technologies as well as to enhance existing skills to further their career growth.

Description:
POSITION SUMMARY
Ensure staff is working together as a team to ensure optimum service and that guest needs are met. Inspect grooming and attire of staff, and rectify any deficiencies. Complete opening and closing duties including setting up necessary supplies and tools, cleaning all equipment and areas, locking doors, etc. Inspect storage areas for organization, use of FIFO, and cleanliness. Complete scheduled inventories and stock and requisition necessary supplies. Monitor dining rooms for seating availability, service, safety, and well being of guests. Complete work orders for maintenance repairs.
Assist management in hiring, training, scheduling, evaluating, counseling, disciplining, and motivating and coaching employees; and serve as a role model and first point of contact of the Guarantee of Fair Treatment/Open Door Policy process. Follow all company and safety and security policies and procedures; report accidents, injuries, and unsafe work conditions to manager; and complete safety training and certifications. Ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional, maintain confidentiality of proprietary information, and protect company assets. Welcome and acknowledge all guests according to company standards, anticipate and address guests service needs, assist individuals with disabilities, and thank guests with genuine appreciation. Speak with others using clear and professional language. Develop and maintain positive working relationships with others, support team to reach common goals, and listen and respond appropriately to the concerns of other employees. Ensure adherence to quality expectations and standards; and identify, recommend, develop, and implement new ways to increase organizational efficiency, productivity, quality, safety, and/or cost-savings. Read and visually verify information in a variety of formats (e.g., small print). Visually inspect tools, equipment, or machines (e.g., to identify defects). Stand, sit, or walk for an extended period of time or for an entire work shift. Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 50 pounds without assistance. Grasp, turn, and manipulate objects of varying size and weight, requiring fine motor skills and hand-eye coordination. Move through narrow, confined, or elevated spaces. Move up and down stairs and/or service ramps. Reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping. Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Education: High school diploma or G.E.D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: At least 2 years of related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: At least 1 year of supervisory experience.
License or Certification: None

Description:
Job Purpose
Responsible for evaluating and underwriting loan applications received via digital channels. Focus on quick, accurate decisioning with policy adherence, KYC verification, fraud checks, and coordination with stakeholders to achieve seamless, paperless disbursements.
Key Responsibilities
Evaluate digital loan applications within defined turnaround time (TAT) using scorecards and policy rules.
Perform digital KYC, bureau checks, income surrogates, and fraud screening; escalate suspicious cases.
Prepare concise credit notes/CAMs for non-STP or exception cases; recommend decisions as per DOA.
Ensure accurate documentation and track postdisbursement document (PDD) closure where applicable.
Coordinate with sales/operations for clarifications, rework, and smooth disbursement.
Monitor early vintage performance/FPD for approved cases and provide feedback to improve filters.
Adhere to underwriting policy, regulatory requirements, and internal audit standards, clear QA observations PDs of specific cases.
Skills Required
Strong analytical and decision-making skills.
Knowledge of retail lending credit policies and scorecards.
Proficiency in digital KYC, fraud control, and MIS tools.
Attention to detail and compliance orientation.
Educational Qualifications and Experience
Graduate / Post-Graduate in Finance, Commerce, or related field.
1-3 years in credit appraisal/underwriting; experience in digital/fintech lending preferred.

Summary:
We are seeking an experienced F5 GTM & LTM Engineer with strong expertise in application delivery, load balancing, DNS traffic management, and security solutions using F5 BIG-IP platforms. Description:
Job Summary
Location: Bhopal
At Alstom, we understand transport networks and what moves people. From high-speed trains, metros, monorails, and trams, to turnkey systems, services, infrastructure, signalling and digital mobility, we offer our diverse customers the broadest portfolio in the industry. Every day, more than 80 000 colleagues lead the way to greener and smarter mobility worldwide, connecting cities as we reduce carbon and replace cars.
Could you be the full-time Helpline Engineer in Bhopal were looking for
Your future role
Take on a new challenge and apply your fault-finding and technical expertise in a dynamic and innovative field. Youll work alongside supportive and collaborative teammates.
You'll play a critical role in ensuring the service delivery, availability, and reliability of our fleets and infrastructure equipment. Day-to-day, youll work closely with teams across the business (such as Production Managers, Test Members, Fleet Control, and Engineering Teams), provide technical support to autonomous teams, and contribute to the continuous improvement of our systems and processes.
Youll specifically take care of troubleshooting and fault diagnosis, but also support training and planning activities to enhance team capabilities.
Well look to you for:
Providing technical support and fault-finding expertise to maintenance and warranty teams
Analyzing system event data to identify failure modes and compiling test/rectification reports
Supporting infrastructure maintenance and intervention at other sites when required
Collaborating with Fleet Control, Engineering, and Reliability Teams to identify and resolve technical issues
Assisting in pre-work planning for shifts and contributing to the development of accurate planning boards
Supporting knowledge transfer and training within autonomous teams
Ensuring adherence to safety regulations and promoting a culture of safety and compliance
All about you
We value passion and attitude over experience. Thats why we dont expect you to have every single skill. Instead, weve listed some that we think will help you succeed and grow in this role:
An Engineering qualification such as a Higher National Certificate (or equivalent) in Electrical/Electronic Engineering
Practical experience and sound knowledge of rolling stock and infrastructure equipment
Technical expertise in fault finding and implementing repairs
Competence in the use of diagnostic tools and software
Proficiency in the local language
Strong verbal and written communication skills
Proficiency with IT tools, including office packages, email, and intranet
A logical, organized approach to problem-solving and a willingness to share suggestions for improvement
A demonstrated team player with a collaborative mindset
Things youll enjoy
Join us on a life-long transformative journey the rail industry is here to stay, so you can grow and develop new skills and experiences throughout your career. Youll also:
Enjoy stability, challenges, and a long-term career free from monotonous routines
Work with cutting-edge diagnostic tools and software to enhance rail performance
Collaborate with diverse teams and supportive colleagues
Contribute to innovative projects that make a tangible impact
Utilize our flexible and inclusive working environment
Steer your career in whatever direction you choose across functions and countries
Benefit from our investment in your development through award-winning learning programs
Progress towards leadership or more specialized technical roles
Enjoy a fair and dynamic reward package that recognizes your performance and potential, plus comprehensive and competitive social coverage (life, medical, pension)
You dont need to be a train enthusiast to thrive with us. We guarantee that when you step onto one of our trains with your friends or family, youll be proud. If youre up for the challenge, wed love to hear from you!
Important to note
As a global business, were an equal-opportunity employer that celebrates diversity across the 63 countries we operate in. Were committed to creating an inclusive workplace for everyone.

Description:
Job Summary
Could you be the full-time Signalling Maintenance Manager in Bhopal were looking for
Your future role
Take on a new challenge and apply your Signalling systems maintenance and project management expertise in a cutting-edge field. Youll work alongside dedicated and collaborative teammates.
You'll play a key role in ensuring the operational efficiency of Signalling systems during the Defect Liability Period (DLP) and maintenance contracts. Day-to-day, youll work closely with teams across the business (Project Managers, Service Engineers, Technicians) and external stakeholders (customers, subcontractors, and suppliers) to deliver high-quality maintenance solutions and much more.
You'll specifically take care of preventive and corrective maintenance activities, but also troubleshooting and resolving technical issues on-site.
Responsibilities
Following pre-defined maintenance schedules and ensuring compliance with safety policies
Preparing failure and intervention reports
Collaborating with the customer OM team to address anomalies during the DLP period
Supervising and inspecting Signalling system maintenance activities
Testing and inspecting systems to ensure peak performance
Supporting contract KPIs and coordinating technical meetings with clients
Providing documentation and reports to assist maintenance teams and project managers
Ensuring compatibility with health and safety standards
Requirements
Engineering Degree or diploma in Electrical / Electronics Engineering
8-10 years of experience in Signalling systems for Railway projects
Experience in testing, commissioning, and troubleshooting Signalling systems
Familiarity with preventive and corrective maintenance of safety-critical systems
Strong problem-solving and team-working skills
Proactive mindset and readiness to acquire new knowledge
Ability to build strong relationships with clients, subcontractors, and OEMs
What you will enjoy
Join us on a life-long transformative journey the rail industry is here to stay, so you can grow and develop new skills and experiences throughout your career. Youll also:
Enjoy stability, challenges, and a long-term career free from boring daily routines
Work with advanced Signalling systems and technologies
Collaborate with transverse teams and helpful colleagues
Contribute to innovative projects
Utilise our dynamic and inclusive working environment
Steer your career in whatever direction you choose across functions and countries
Benefit from our investment in your development, through award-winning learning
Progress towards senior leadership roles in Signalling and maintenance management
Benefit from a fair and dynamic reward package that recognises your performance and potential, plus comprehensive and competitive social coverage
You dont need to be a train enthusiast to thrive with us. We guarantee that when you step onto one of our trains with your friends or family, youll be proud. If youre up for the challenge, wed love to hear from you!
Important to note
As a global business, were an equal-opportunity employer that celebrates diversity across the 63 countries we operate in. Were committed to creating an inclusive workplace for everyone.

Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to handle challenging situations with professionalism and tact.
Flexible availability, including evenings, weekends, and holidays, as needed.

Description:
Job Description: Sales and Marketing Central Regional Office (CRO)
Market: Gujarat, Madhya Pradesh & Rajasthan
Position Name: Sr. Engineer/Assistant Manager
Experience Range: - Minimum 04 years to 08 years of experience in Sales and Marketing - Customer Relationship Management, Techno-Commercial knowledge in T&D products
Qualification: - BE in Electrical /Mechanical Engineering
No. of Positions: 02
Location: Jabalpur(MP)- 01 Person
Jaipur (Rajasthan)- 01 Person
Industry Type: The person should be in the Power Transformer Industry.
A local person would be preferred.
Salary Range: As per industry salary standards
Job Responsibilities:
1. Develop a business plan and Sales strategies to achieve Regional sales targets, Project coordination, Revenues, and collections as per the company's business goals.
2. Lead generation and Acquisition of Orders from Utilities, PSU, and Private customers, especially in the Power, Energy, Industry, and Infra sectors.
3. Pre-tender support.
4. Order Booking: Ensure achievement of the budgeted order booking target.
5. To achieve the Budget Target (Order Intake, Revenue, collection, EBIT)
6. Customer Profiling: Understand the customer requirements from different fields like utilities, Building segment, contract segment, channel partners, industries, etc.
7. Keep regular interaction with existing customers and maintain good relationships. Also, expansion of new clients/business.
8. Searching for new tender information on websites of Utilities, Procurement Portals and Tenders information sites, Consultantsetc.
9. Coordinating with Internal departments and customers to ensure the timely completion of bid submission.
10. Responsible for the prequalification process, vendor registration, and renewal of registration in portals,
11. Prepare MIS reports, weekly/monthly/quarterly reports, in coordination with the internal team and superior.
12. Collect and maintain market information, Competitors data, Bid opening details, Win-loss analysis, and preparation of reports
13. Support and resolve customer issues/complaints in sales and service aspects
14. Any other specific/additional responsibilities as assigned by the Reporting Authority / Head of the Department.
Experience, Knowledge, Skills & Functional Competency:
Graduate in Electrical/ Mechanical Engineering with Experience of 4 to 08 years in Business Development and sales/marketing activities of 400KV/ 765KV class transformers and reactors.
Sound in Sales with a positive attitude, Strong communicator, cross-functional team player, facilitator. Should have excellent negotiation skills & Interpersonal Skills, Self-starter and Good team player, Dynamic, and result-oriented
AboutCompany:
ABOUT TBEA

TBEA is an enterprise group that is accredited by the Chinese government, to be engaged in foreign economic and technical cooperation and to undertake national external assistance projects in four industrial fields Transmission, Transformation, New Energy, and Advanced Materials.

TBEA is the core enterprise of China's major Electrical Equipment manufacturing industry and is the first listed Transformer enterprise in China.
TBEA has twelve industrial gardens in Xinjiang, Sichuan, Hunan, Tianjin, Shandong, Liaoning, Shanxi, and other provinces. TBEA has Twenty-seven marketing offices in overseas and in other regions of the world such as America, Russia, India, Brazil, Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, Sudan etc.

TBEA Group is compliant with ISO9001, ISO9002, ISO14001, OHSAS18000, UKAS of Britain, FMRC of America, IEC quality certification, The international management system certification, Environment sanitation, and safety. The economic development mode of green manufacture, energy saving, and high-efficiency low carbon cycle has been adopted.

Description:
Head Plant Maintenance
Internally, the role is designated as Progressive Maintenance & Utilities Lead, responsible for driving plant maintenance excellence, equipment reliability, preventive and predictive maintenance, utilities management, and the Progressive Maintenance (PM) pillar under our IL6S framework.
Are You Ready to Make It Happen at Mondelz International?
Join our Mission to Lead the Future of Snacking. Make It With Pride.
ROLE PURPOSE
As a member of the Plant Leadership Team (PLT), the Progressive Maintenance & Utilities Lead will lead the Progressive Maintenance (PM) Pillar within the Integrated Lean Six Sigma (IL6S) framework and drive the plant's journey towards a Zero Breakdown Culture.

This role is responsible for building maintenance capability, improving equipment reliability, strengthening utilities performance, driving energy efficiency, and embedding world-class maintenance practices across the plant.
The role is focused on coaching, capability building, and technical leadership rather than day-to-day maintenance execution.
Your goal will be to ensure that the site manufacturing & support activities, without interruption, without any facilities shortages and/or any issues thereof. You will achieve 100% compliance to Local legal regulations, Quality, Health Safety & Environment management systems and standards. You are responsible for the management and maintenance of site facilities, buildings and equipment(s) (hardware & software).
How you will contribute
You will:
Works cross functionally to develop and implement a strategic Facilities road-map and annual operating plan which is a competitive advantage to Mondelz. Partner with internal & external stakeholders and service providers to define and meet Safety, Quality, Cost, Delivery, Sustainability, Engagement goals. Establish a strong governance to review & control Operational performance and continuous Improvement plan to deliver against best in class both internally and externally.
Lead and be accountable that Building Maintenance program, Facilities maintenance program capabilities, including maintenance repairs & overall operations are in place. Accountable to insure adherence to business continuity plan, manufacturing standards government regulations are understood by all employees/services providers at the site, regularly reviewed and monitored for effective implementation.
Provide leadership, coaching to Facilities team towards implementation of IL6S-Integrated Lean 6 sigma ways of working: delivering zero breakdowns via preventive/predictive maintenance strategies and technical mastery of maintenance and operation teams; PM (Progressive Maintenance) Pillar, and CBM (condition based monitoring), Visual controls & tools Mgmt., Lubrication mgmt. & Calibration of equipment(s) etc.
Role model Values and principles through effective coaching, mentoring and builds skills capability across the Plant technical/engineering team to engage with latest modern practices. Have a clear people succession and resource plan, for the asset & technology population , identifying and implementing critical levers to attract, retain and develop critical talent
Interface with key stakeholders internally and externally to develop and maintain effective relationships, align priorities in order to deliver the company objectives, and goals.

What you will bring

A desire to drive your future and accelerate your career and the following experience and knowledge:

Strong operational & manufacturing leadership experience in CPG industry with experience in TPM-Total productive maintenance, 5s, LEAN, 6 sigma tools and concepts, Safety & GMP standards
An Engineer with a strong financial & business acumen, project management skills and Knowledge of industrial maintenance and manufacturing equipment, PM (Progressive Maintenance) expertise, Spare parts management, SAP PM module end user knowledge, Technology & Engineering automation basics.
Excellent communication (verbal & written), coaching, and leadership skills in a team-based environment. Demonstrated abilities in Analytics, problem solving and team building
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Progressive Maintenance Leadership
Lead the Progressive Maintenance Pillar and drive equipment reliability across the plant.
Establish and sustain preventive, predictive, and condition-based maintenance practices.
Drive breakdown elimination and continuous improvement initiatives.
Capability Building
Develop maintenance capability across engineering and operations teams.
Coach technical leaders and strengthen organizational expertise in reliability and maintenance excellence.
Support capability transfer through Autonomous Maintenance initiatives.
Reliability & Operational Excellence
Improve equipment availability, maintenance effectiveness, and operational performance.
Lead root cause analysis and drive sustainable corrective actions.
Improve key reliability metrics including OEE, MTBF, and MTTR.
Plant Leadership
Own maintenance and infrastructure budgets.
Support capital projects, plant expansions, and equipment investments.
Provide technical expertise to improve future plant design and asset reliability
Technical & Utilities Governance
Provide leadership across maintenance, utilities, electrical, instrumentation, and automation functions.
Ensure reliable and efficient operation of critical plant infrastructure and utility systems.
Support modernization, automation, and reliability improvement initiatives.
Safety, Compliance & Sustainability
Ensure compliance with safety, statutory, and environmental requirements.
Drive energy optimization and sustainability initiatives across the site.
Champion safe maintenance practices and technical governance
WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE
Reduced equipment breakdowns and downtime.
Improved reliability, maintenance effectiveness, and plant performance.
Strong PM Pillar maturity within the IL6S framework.
Improved utility reliability and energy efficiency.
Enhanced technical capability across the organization.
Best-in-class safety and compliance performance
IDEAL CANDIDATE PROFILE
Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Instrumentation, Electronics, or Industrial Engineering.
10+ years of experience in Maintenance, Reliability, Engineering, or Plant Technical Operations.
Strong hands-on maintenance foundation with progression into maintenance leadership roles.
Experience working within Total Productive Maintenance (TPM), Integrated Lean Six Sigma (IL6S), or similar operational excellence frameworks.
Proven track record of driving reliability improvements, capability building, and maintenance excellence in highly automated manufacturing environments. Strong leadership, coaching, stakeholder management, and systems-thinking capabilities.

Description:
About the Role
Sales Associate is responsible for providing the best customer experience in the stores by providing high standards of selling services to Lenskart customers. He/she plays a pivotal role in driving the revenue achieved by the store.
Responsibilities Area Activities expected to be performed by a Lenskart Sales Associate
Customer focus
Sales Associate is expected to greet and welcome all walk-in customers and guide them toward the clinic, promoting the free eye check-up
He/she will be involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day tasks to deliver the best shopping experience to the customers
He/she must possess a basic understanding of the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively
He/she must be dedicated to customer satisfaction and must go beyond his means to resolve any concerns that the customer has
Product recommendation
With the information received from the Optometrist and the customer, he/she will present the customer with an optimal selection of products. This opportunity may be used to strike a conversation and convert it into sales
He/she is expected to understand the unstated needs of the customer, ask relevant questions,
and pick the right time to pitch the recommended solutions
Achieving sales targets & SOP adherence
Sales Associate is expected to achieve the assigned target for sales, eye-test conversion, and returns. He/she must follow all assigned SOPs diligently
Post making the sale, he/she is responsible for coordinating with the customer for product pick up, after receiving due communication from the warehouse. He/she will verify the accuracy of the lenses fitted before handing over the product to the customer. In case of returns, he/she is expected to understand the reason and try to resolve the same to control the return percentage
Store upkeep & maintenance
He/she is expected to maintain Lenskart standards of hygiene in the store with respect to the overall display, frames, instruments, and other store equipment by cleaning them regularly
He/she must ensure the security of all Lenskart equipment and ensure there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store
Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification: 12th pass; Graduates preferred
Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions
Clear articulation and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to changing environment and openness to learn
Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation
Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority

Description:
Axis Max Life Insurance is seeking a skilled and motivated Senior Officer for the role of CAT (Customer Analytics and Transformation) - Loyalty. The candidate will be responsible for developing and executing loyalty programs that enhance customer engagement and retention. This role involves analyzing customer data, identifying trends, and implementing strategies that foster long-term relationships with clients.

Key Responsibilities:
- Design and implement loyalty programs that cater to customer needs and enhance overall satisfaction.
- Analyze customer data to identify patterns and preferences, using insights to drive decision-making.
- Collaborate with marketing and product teams to align loyalty initiatives with business objectives.
- Monitor the performance of loyalty programs and suggest improvements based on feedback and analysis.
- Engage with customers to gather insights and refine loyalty strategies, ensuring continuous improvement.
- Prepare reports and presentations for management to provide updates on loyalty program performance and impact.

Skills Required:
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret complex data.
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to interact with various stakeholders.
- Proficiency in customer analytics tools and techniques.
- Ability to work collaboratively in a team-oriented environment.
- Detail-oriented with strong organizational and project management skills.

Tools Required:
- Familiarity with CRM software and customer analytics platforms.
- Proficiency in data analysis tools such as Excel, SQL, or other relevant software.
- Experience with reporting and visualization tools like Power BI or Tableau.
- Knowledge of marketing automation tools will be a plus.

Candidates with a background in data analytics, customer experience, or marketing will be preferred for this position. Join Axis Max Life Insurance and contribute to building lasting customer relationships through innovative loyalty programs.

Description:
Our jobs aren t just about giving guests a smooth check-in and check-out.
Instead, we want to build and experience that is memorable and unique.
Our Guest Experience Experts take the initiative to deliver a wide range of services that guide guests through their entire stay.
They are empowered to move about their space and do what needs to be done.
Whether processing operational needs, addressing guest requests, completing reports, or sharing the highlights of the local area, the Guest Experience Expert makes transactions feel like part of the experience.
No matter what position you are in, there are a few things that are critical to success - creating a safe work place, following company policies and procedures, maintaining confidentiality, protecting company assets, upholding quality standards, and ensuring your uniform, personal appearance, and communications are professional.
Guest Experience Experts will be on their feet and moving around (stand, sit, or walk for an extended time) and taking a hands-on approach to work (move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 10 pounds without assistance).
Doing all these things well (and other reasonable job duties as requested) is critical for Guest Experience Experts - to get it right for our guests and our business each and every time.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Education: High school diploma or G. E. D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: No related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.
License or Certification: None
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Description:
Role Details:
Designation : Associate

Mode: Work from Office (6 Days working)

Job Description: The Client Service Associate at Delhivery will be responsible to provide exceptional service and support to customers, ensuring their satisfaction with Delhivery's products and services. You will handle inquiries, complaints, and requests through various communication channels, including phone, email, and chat. Your role involves understanding customer needs, resolving issues, and delivering accurate and timely information.
Key Responsibilities:
Providing assistance with shipment tracking and delivery inquiries and drive regular engagement/quick response
Resolving issues related to shipments (missing or damaged packages, customs delays, or delivery exceptions)
CS Engagement via Ticketing module, getting timely response; Keep active track of timely closure of tickets
Assisting with billing inquiries such as explaining charges, resolving disputes and/or claims, or providing information on payment options
Providing support for shipping services and delivery options available, regulatory compliance, documentation requirements, claim monitoring
Analyze and support with insights to improve the process and internal operations and service levels
Handling customer escalations-preparing RCA / CAPA and providing the solution
Collaborate with internal stakeholders to maintain and increase performance of client accounts
Designing SOP, mapping and freezing requirements, client NPS management and providing best solutions
to the business
Required Skills and competencies
Excellent communication skills: You should possess strong verbal and written communication abilities to effectively interact with customers and convey information clearly and concisely.
Customer-centric approach: A deep understanding of customer needs and the ability to keep focus on their issue is a fast paced and complex environment
Problem-solving skills: You must be adept at analyzing customer issues, identifying root causes, and providing appropriate solutions or escalating matters as needed.
Time management: The ability to prioritize tasks, manage multiple inquiries simultaneously, and meet deadlines is essential for efficient customer service delivery.
Familiarity with customer-relationship management (CRM) software programs
Problem-solving and critical thinking: You will encounter complex customer issues that require effective problem-solving skills and the ability to think critically. You should be able to analyze situations, evaluate available options, and propose viable solutions to ensure customer satisfaction.
Flexible with the working schedule; may be expected to work weekends, holidays and events where there is increased service demand

Description:
Job Title: Dealer Sales Executive - Commercial Vehicles

Location: [Indore, Ujjain, Dhar]

Experience: 1-5 Years

Industry: Automobile / Commercial Vehicles

Job Description:

We are looking for a motivated and result-driven Sales Executive with 1 to 5 years of experience in commercial vehicle sales. The candidate will be responsible for driving sales, building strong customer relationships, and achieving business targets in the assigned territory.

Key Responsibilities:

Identify and develop new business opportunities in the commercial vehicle segment
Achieve monthly and annual sales targets
Build and maintain strong relationships with customers and fleet owners
Conduct market research and competitor analysis
Handle customer inquiries, negotiations, and deal closures
Coordinate with internal teams for smooth order processing and delivery
Ensure high levels of customer satisfaction and repeat business

Requirements:

1-5 years of experience in commercial vehicle sales (trucks, buses, etc.)
Strong communication and negotiation skills
Good understanding of the local market and customer base
Ability to work independently and meet sales targets
Valid driving license preferred

Salary: As per industry standards + incentives

How to Apply:
Interested candidates can apply through Naukri or share their resume at [ranjeet.panwar@tvs.in].


Perks and benefits
Travel allowance, Performance bonus, Sales incentives, Annual bonus
AboutCompany: TVS Mobility Pvt. Ltd. operates as an authorized dealer for Ashok Leyland commercial vehicles in Indore, Madhya Pradesh, providing comprehensive sales, service, and spare parts. Located near Manglia Village, it serves as a key commercial vehicle partner in the region, offering ICV, HCV, and light commercial vehicles.

Sales Associate is responsible for providing the best customer experience in the stores by providing high standards of selling services to Lenskart customers. He/she plays a pivotal role in driving the revenue achieved by the store.
Responsibilities Area Activities expected to be performed by a Lenskart Sales Associate Customer focus Sales Associate is expected to greet and welcome all walk-in customers and guide them toward the clinic, promoting the free eye check-up He/she will be involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day tasks to deliver the best shopping experience to the customers He/she must possess a basic understanding of the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively He/she must be dedicated to customer satisfaction and must go beyond his means to resolve any concerns that the customer has

Description:
You, as an Area Manager, play a critical role to lead diverse teams at store level who are in turn responsible in providing the best customer experience to Lenskart customers as well as revenue generation. You are the facilitator of growth, responsible to build vision & business strategies to achieve sales, customer experience, and other organisational goals by investing in people through regular coaching.

We are looking for enthusiastic & pragmatic leaders with strong inclination towards customer centricity, sales, digital mind-set, and people leadership. On a typical day, you would be spending your time at the stores in your area, helping the team deliver on the strategy, coaching them and helping remove road-blocks.

Key Responsibilities:

Sales Leadership:

- Developing & driving sales strategy for your area & team with focus on revenue goals.
- Driving the rigor to deliver world-class customer experience at the store, thereby increasing the Net Promoter Score (NPS) for the store and reducing detractors
- Drive high performance culture in your area across the metrics mentioned above
- Assessing business and performance trends regularly & build improvement opportunities.
- Serve as critical strategy planning link between Corporate and the field organization.
- Translate corporate goals including financial returns, sales growth and market share, into
Business plans.
- Assess field capability and establish performance priorities at group level.

People leadership:

- Partnership with Store Managers & HR team to make sure stores are adequately staffed.
- Leading leaders, coaching and developing future talent
- Assess & bridge skill gaps including those related to implementation of business plans, forecasts, financial analysis, associate development and communication
- Formal & Informal performance management for store managers they are responsible for
- Responsible for establishing a culture that embraces diversity and maximizes the learnings from a diverse team.
- Retain talent - Reduce attrition

Organizational leadership:

- Solely responsible for managing and maintaining territory and store budgets to ensure profitability at the area level
- Managing the top and bottom line effectively of the assigned territory and stores
- Responsible for overall operational effectiveness of stores on areas such as shrinkage, capacity, productivity, growth, attrition.
- Build creative & cost effective methods to ensure productivity while managing high standards of retail operations.

Location: Chennai, Pondicherry, Erode
Role Purpose
The Customer Service Officer (Internship Trainee) will be responsible for managing customer service operations for unsecured lending products while undergoing structured rotational training across service desk, complaint management, regulatory grievance handling, and quality functions.
The role is designed to build a strong compliance-oriented, customer-centric operations leader for future managerial responsibilities.

Key Responsibilities
1. Service Desk Operations
Handle inbound customer interactions related to loan applications, disbursement, EMI servicing, foreclosure, and account queries
Ensure high First Call Resolution (FCR) and adherence to defined Turnaround Time (TAT)
Maintain accurate call documentation in CRM/system
Deliver consistent customer experience aligned with company standards
Register and track customer complaints in the system
Maintain proper documentation for audit and inspection purposes
2. Regulatory & Compliance Adherence
Strict adherence to RBI guidelines and internal policies
Ensure zero tolerance toward mis-leading information or incorrect commitments
Maintain audit-ready documentation of customer communication
Escalate sensitive cases to Nodal / Grievance Officer as per defined escalation matrix
3. Customer Experience & Process Improvement
Identify recurring service gaps and suggest corrective actions
Support implementation of process improvement initiatives
Contribute to service quality enhancement programs

Training & Rotational Exposure (1218 Months)
The InternshipTrainee will undergo structured exposure to:
Service Desk Operations
Welcome Calling
Complaint Desk & Escalation Handling
Regulatory Grievance Management
Quality & Training Function
MIS & Process Governance
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
First Call Resolution (FCR)
Average Handling Time (AHT)
Complaint TAT Compliance
Customer Satisfaction Score (CSAT)
Audit & Compliance Score
Zero Regulatory Deviations
Qualification
Graduate (MBA in Finance / Operations / Marketing preferred)
02 years of relevant experience (Fresh MBA candidates may apply)
Skills & Competencies
Strong communication and interpersonal skills
Analytical and problem-solving ability
Customer-centric approach
Compliance-driven mindset
Ability to handle pressure and escalations professionally
Working knowledge of CRM systems

Description:
Change the world. Love your job.
Texas Instruments (TI) is out front and ready for the next big challenge. Our innovations are at the core of nearly every electronics product in use today. And it doesnt stop there. Were developing breakthrough technology to power the worlds future innovations as well. TI is committed to building a better future from the responsible manufacturing of our semiconductors, to caring for our employees, to giving back inside our communities. Put your talent to work with us.

Application specific MCU industrial (ASM-IND) product line offers a broad range of high performance, innovative and cost-effective specialized MCUs for a wide range of applications across Motor control and Digital power. We enable powering next generation AI datacenters, provide motor control solutions for Humanoids, robotics, etc., build AI solutions for predictive diagnostics, improve performance, control and optimize energy efficiency.
We are looking for an application engineer who has the passion and excitement to continuously learn, innovate, take an active role in solving real time control. It is a fast paced, results driven environment requiring Microcontroller knowledge, system level understanding, software development, Motor control algorithms and system hardware skillsets. You will collaborate with worldwide accounts to solve their system challenges, enable them to go to market faster, work with marketing and business leadership to develop strategic technical solutions to enable TI business growth and impact the next generation of products.
Key responsibilities include:
Develop sensored and sensor less motor control algorithms to enable faster response, Smoother speed, less acoustic noise
Own specific IP s write technical reference manual, resolve customer issues through E2E platform and field engagement
Participate in customer calls to understand system requirements and help select the right devices and reference designs
Support customer design-in activities by:
Adapting our system reference solutions to their custom hardware design.
Meet customer across the globe to promote our technical benefits and resolve technical issues / Debug
Schematic and layout review of customer solutions for our device
Help with software porting, optimize software to improve performance.
Resolve production stop issues for customers
Design EVM and internal evaluation boards to support evaluation activities of new products.
Train Field Applications Engineers and customers on ASM Microcontrollers and reference designs
Write application notes and training collateral that explain features, implementation of motor control on ASM Microcontrollers.
Qualifications
Minimum requirements:
Master s degree in Electrical Engineering or related degree
3 years of application/system engineering experience
Motor control algorithm development
Strong knowledge of Microcontrollers
Experience in embedded C software development
Solid hardware and software debugging skills

Preferred qualifications:
PHD in Electrical Engineering, Power Electronics, Electrical Drive Systems
Hands-on experience working in motor control algorithm development
Knowledge on Matlab, Simulink and Plexim for simulation and model-based code generation
Digital control system design
Familiarity with field bus communication
Power electronic system design
Knowledge on functional safety, security and artificial intelligence
Ability to review schematics and PCB layout using CAD tools
Demonstrated strong analytical and problem-solving skills
Strong verbal and written communication skills
Ability to work in teams and collaborate effectively with people in different functions
Demonstrated ability to build strong, influential relationships
Strong time management skills that enable on-time project delivery
Self-driven and ability to take initiative and drive for results
Continuous learning mindset
Ability to produce high quality technical documentation
Good communication skillset to interface with customers and Field Applications Engineers

Description:
This is a 30-day paid, part-time internship suitable for students, freshers, and working professionals. The role involves field visits to verify details at your current location, with flexible working days and timings, and the task can be completed before 30 days also. The stipend is 5,000 to 7,000 for the complete task.

We preferably look for local candidates based in Ooty / Coorg / Puducherry. If you're interested, kindly apply.

Trrip Partner Verification Executive (PVE)

Job Description (JD) & Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

PART A JOB DESCRIPTION

1. Position
Designation: Partner Verification Executive (PVE)
Role Type: Field-Based
Location: Ooty / Coorg / Puducherry

Reporting To: Trrip Operations Team
Role Objective
The PVE is responsible for physically visiting locations assigned by Trrip and collecting fresh, accurate and complete information directly from the partner. The objective is to provide Trrip with reliable, up-to-date partner information, images and customer-useful details.
Visit Target
The PVE will be assigned approximately 55 to 60 restaurants and/or shops to visit as part of the assigned field activity. All assigned locations must be physically visited and properly verified according to this SOP.

2. Key Responsibilities

A. Physical Verification
- Visit restaurants, shops and other locations assigned by Trrip.
- Physically verify that the location is operational.
- Confirm the business name and address.
- Meet the owner, manager or authorized contact person.
- Collect the correct contact person's name and number.
- Capture geo-tagged proof of the visit.
B. Partner Data Collection
- Business name
- Contact person's name and number
- WhatsApp number, if available
- Complete address and landmark
- Operating days and timings
- Services/products offered
- Other relevant partner details
C. Images & Menu Collection
- Capture minimum 5 fresh interior/location images.
- Capture exterior/name-board image.
- Capture relevant product, service and facility images where applicable.
- Collect the latest menu, rate card or brochure where applicable.
- Use Microsoft Lens, Adobe Scan or an equivalent scanning application.
- Ensure all images are clear, relevant and readable.

PART B STANDARD OPERATING PROCEDURE
PHASE 1
Receive Assignment
- Receive the list of restaurants, shops or other locations from Trrip.
- The assigned list will generally contain approximately 50 to 60 locations.
- Review the assigned locations.
- Plan the route and visits.
- Visit locations according to the assigned schedule.
PHASE 2
Physical Visit
Step 1: Reach the Location
- Physically visit the assigned location.
- Online verification does not count as a completed visit.

Step 2: Geo-Tagged Proof
- Keep location/GPS enabled.
- Capture a fresh exterior image showing the name board/entrance wherever possible.

Step 3: Meet the Partner
- Speak with the owner, manager or authorized representative.
- Explain that you are collecting updated information for Trrip.
PHASE 3
Collect & Verify Information
- Confirm directly with the partner: name, address, contact person, contact number, WhatsApp number, operating hours, services/products and other relevant information.
- Do not simply copy information from Google or other online platforms.
PHASE 4
Images & Menu Collection
- Capture 1 exterior/name-board image.
- Capture minimum 5 fresh interior/location images.
- Capture relevant product, service and facility images where applicable.
- Collect the latest menu, rate card or brochure where applicable.
- Use Microsoft Lens, Adobe Scan or an equivalent scanning application.
- Ensure there is no blur, glare or unnecessary shadow and that relevant pages are fully visible and readable.
- Do not submit images downloaded from Google, Instagram, Zomato, Swiggy, Justdial or other websites/platformsas fresh PVE photographs.
PHASE 5
Data Submission
- Submit partner details, contact details, address, services/products offered, fresh photographs, geo-tagged proof, menu/rate card where applicable and additional notes.
- If information is unavailable, write Not Provided.
- Never guess, assume or fabricate information.

PVE Principle
Visit Physically > Collect Directly > Verify Accurately > Submit Completely

Description:
Job Title: US IT Recruiter Fresher to Senior Level
Location: Salem, Tamil Nadu, Pondicherry
Experience: 0–5+ Years
Shift: Night Shift – US Staffing
Employment Type: Full-Time
Job Summary
We are looking for US IT Recruiters at different experience levels — Freshers, Junior, Mid-Level, and Senior Recruiters — to join our recruitment team in Salem and Pondicherry.
The role will be assigned based on the candidate's experience, skills, and knowledge of the US IT Staffing process.
Freshers with good communication skills and a strong willingness to learn are welcome to apply. Experienced candidates should have hands-on experience in US IT Recruitment and candidate sourcing.
Key Responsibilities
Source IT professionals using Dice, LinkedIn Recruiter, Monster, CareerBuilder, job boards, referrals, and other sourcing platforms.
Understand job descriptions and identify suitable candidates based on client requirements.
Search and identify candidates using Boolean search, keyword search, resume databases, and other sourcing techniques.
Review resumes and shortlist qualified candidates based on technical skills and experience.
Conduct initial candidate screening to assess skills, experience, communication, availability, location, work authorization, and interest.
Communicate job opportunities and requirements clearly to candidates.
Maintain regular communication and follow-up with candidates throughout the recruitment process.
Coordinate interviews and follow up on interview feedback.
Negotiate candidate salary/rate expectations within approved guidelines.
Collect required candidate information and documentation.
Submit qualified candidates to clients/account managers within the required timelines.
Maintain accurate candidate records, submissions, interview status, and recruitment activities in the ATS.
Build and maintain a strong pipeline of qualified IT professionals.
Meet daily, weekly, and monthly recruitment targets.
Maintain quality submissions and ensure timely completion of recruitment activities.
Experience-Level Expectations
Fresher / Junior (0–2 Years):
Good communication skills and willingness to learn US IT Recruitment.
Learn and perform candidate sourcing, resume screening, candidate calling, and interview coordination.
Previous recruitment experience or internship is an advantage but not mandatory for freshers.
Mid-Level (2–5 Years):
Independently manage assigned US IT recruitment requirements.
Strong experience in sourcing, screening, candidate engagement, submissions, and interview coordination.
Ability to manage multiple requirements and consistently achieve recruitment targets.
Senior Level (5+ Years):
Handle complex, niche, and high-priority US IT requirements independently.
Strong expertise in advanced sourcing, candidate screening, rate negotiation, and candidate management.
Ability to mentor junior recruiters and contribute to team performance and recruitment strategies.
Required Skills
Good verbal and written communication skills.
Strong interpersonal and candidate engagement skills.
Good analytical and organizational skills.
Ability to work in a target-driven and fast-paced environment.
Basic understanding of IT technologies and technical terminology.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office, especially Excel, Word, and Outlook.
Willingness to work during US business hours / night shift.
Preferred Skills – Experienced Candidates
Hands-on experience in US IT Staffing / US IT Recruitment.
Experience with Dice, LinkedIn Recruiter, Monster, CareerBuilder, or similar sourcing platforms.
Knowledge of Boolean search and candidate sourcing techniques.
Understanding of W2, C2C, and 1099 hiring models.
Knowledge of US work authorization and visa categories such as H-1B, OPT, CPT, GC, and USC.
Experience with ATS platforms.
Knowledge of different IT skill sets and technical job requirements.
Experience working with VMS or client/vendor requirements is an advantage.
Educational Qualification
Bachelor's degree in any discipline.
MBA HR, B.E./B.Tech, B.Sc., BCA, or other relevant qualifications are preferred.
Freshers are welcome to apply.
Candidate Profile
We are looking for candidates who are:
Interested in building or advancing their career in US IT Staffing.
Good at communication and relationship building.
Willing to work in a night-shift environment aligned with US business hours.
Target-oriented and committed to achieving recruitment goals.
Willing to learn and continuously improve recruitment skills.
Candidates will be considered for the appropriate level based on their experience, skills, and demonstrated recruitment capabilities.

Description:
What you ll do:
Manage the research, design, and development of critical components for Medium Voltage (MV) Switchgear. Drive innovation, compliance, and industrialization to strengthen the competitiveness of MV Switchgear portfolio.
"-Supervise VCB, RMU, AIS and GIS design activities for MV Switchgear
-Define and approve type and prototype test plans covering MV Switchgear components
-Coordinate type testing with accredited labs (KEMA, CESI, GCC Lab) and oversee in-house prototype validation.
-Lead root cause analysis of failures and ensure effective corrective measures across both product families.
-Guarantee compliance with IEC / 100 / 102 / 103 / 200 standards as well as customer-specific and utility requirements.
-Maintain technical documentation supporting certifications, approvals, and type testing for both MV Switchgear projects.
-Utilize DFMEA and reliability engineering methods to strengthen robustness and long-term quality of Switchgear components.
-Coordinate with manufacturing, supply chain, electrical, and quality teams to ensure industrialization of components for both MV Switchgear.
-Collaborate with suppliers and RD institutions to localize and qualify components, reducing costs and lead times across both product lines.
-Able to anticipate problems and make the necessary proactive steps to prevent them
-Ability to take necessary and proper timely decisions.
