Description:
To know and develop proficiency in handling internal company software platforms, ie. iCABS, SCP and any other systems that may be introduced.
Must have a good knowledge of the branch territory.
To ensure that the Service Companion usage is maximised for all the service deliveries & should be always above 95%
Organisation of schedule and planning of all service (including contracts, jobbing, call outs, etc.) requirements on a daily, weekly and monthly basis for all technicians within the branch
To ensure that all the service companion devices are active and in use. All the devices should be active 100% at any given point of time
Priority-wise planning of all due for Renewals visits, enquiries, call outs and complaints. Pending visits should be negligible (Service backlogs). Emphasis on "On Time planning
Liaise with the Sales and Service team to best accommodate urgent service visit appointments and communicate changes to affected customers timely.
Ensure customer service-related complaints or termination notifications/STOP Services are attended to effectively and promptly.
Manage service documentation and ensure all customer/technician s feedback are followed up with actions
Enter correct (error free) consumption data and TOS in the SCP to ensure command centre account profitability reflects correct data customer wise.
Ensure all service data from dockets, log cards, service orders and other sources is updated accurately into business systems in timely manner
Coordinate with the IT team for new users, device issues etc.
Supports business transition from paper-based to system and digital-based planning, visit documents, whilst upholding documentation integrity. Follow callout process so as to ensure that the complaints are delivered only after raising the ticket
Review service reports with OM, OE and BM and highlight areas of concern critical backlog and weekly trend to manager.
Reviews and provides service compliance updates daily.
Assist & help AOM / OM / Assistant Branch Manager / Branch Manager in monitoring Technician service productivity and efficiency related KPIs
Maintain positive working relationship and effective communication with Sales & Service Colleagues, Supervisor, Technician, Operations staff for any service related issues. Coordinate with Sales for any available slots, time adjustment for new sales scheduling
Work with branch management to correct service areas distributed across the business based on annual revenue from areas, time on site, travel time & routine requirements
Utilise the Route technicians for jobbing only after the route technicians routine services are delivered
Expected to be knowledgeable about company safety policies and safety (SRA) requirements on the job, be able to read and understand company policies
Any unresolved issues should be quickly elevated to the next level of management for prompt resolution
Any other similar duties as and when specified by the manager
  REPORTING
Daily, weekly & monthly (SOS) State of Service for Branch. Residential GSS SOS should also be the priority
Weekly reporting of pending jobs, ageing profiles to ABM/BM
Monthly reporting of technician wise trends.
Maintain State of Service and productivity data per technician
Maintain visibility on complaints received and report on all call outs / critical incidents received from branch.
Annual Leave planning of technicians
Ensure that each technician service productivity is achieved as per set targets
Key Result Areas:
On time service planning with ZERO pending services every month
Monitoring SCP active devices & Usage on weekly basis
Minimum expectancy on SCP active device(100%) & usage >95%
Achieving progressive improvement in State of Service (SOS) and meet SOS targets assigned by the branch
Minimizing service backlog (meet our contractual obligations)
  Competencies (Skills essential to the role):
Be decisive
Attention to details and accuracy
Planning & organizing
Analytical skills
Customer oriented
Negotiation skills
Ability to work patiently in a dynamic service environment
  Educational Qualification / Other Requirement:
Minimum graduation with 1 to 3 years of relevant experience of managing team
Basic computer skills - for reporting/work management (Advanced computer skills would be an added advantage)
Communication - speaking on phone to external customers & internally with technicians, other Operations colleagues.
Knowledge of territory which is handled for planning
Occasional Travel required within the Division
Liaise with the Operations Manager, Operations Executive, Service Supervisors to establish service requirements and provide information, assurance and advice as required
Communicate all service issues in a timely manner to the ABM/BM, Operations Manager
AboutCompany:
Rentokil Initial, founded in 1925 and headquartered in Crawley, West Sussex, UK, is a global leader in pest control and hygiene services. Operating in over 80 countries, the company provides innovative solutions, including pest prevention, removal, and monitoring, as well as workplace hygiene and specialist disinfection services. Renowned for its sustainability efforts and technological advancements, such as smart pest control systems, Rentokil Initial serves a diverse clientele across industries like healthcare, hospitality, and food production. Its mission is to protect people and enhance lives by delivering essential, high-quality services that promote health and safety.

Designing, developing and supporting frameworks for our test infrastructure and providing automation expertise to our development teams Contributing toward predictable delivery of quality releases 4. Provide clear bug description and useful debugging information, ideally for a complex system containing several moving parts 16. Continually update skills by learning new technologies relevant to the role. 17. Identifying issues, risks and dependencies escalating and managing where appropriate Requirements. Description:
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Overview
Service Managers (SM) or Territory Managers (TM) are the frontline owner of fleet quality, safety compliance and ground-level service execution resulting in top-notch customer experience.
Core Responsibilities
Service Quality –
1. Completing daily in-bus inspections and fill the audit form to improve service delivery
2. Own audit score and bus-quality-complaints-per-trip metric, and zero compromise on safety violations
3. Ensure cleanliness, comfort and onboard amenities meet brand standard on every trip
4. Daily coordination with operator staff to get the work done and highlighting improvement areas
5. Calling unhappy customers daily and gather captain & crew feedback to close the loop; resolve issues at the right quality, not just speed
6. Working on reducing customer complaints related to bus condition, cleanliness and safety concerns
 Team Leadership & Accountability -
1. Recruit, train and manage the team of bus captains ensuring grooming standards and timely reporting
2. Own roster planning, week-offs, attendance and attrition control
3. Drive accountability through audits and performance evaluation; log corrective actions against the SOP checklist; keep behavioral complaints under check
4. Deliver on customer engagement targets of customer ratings and in-bus bookings
 Reporting & Continuous Improvement -
1. Own the reports assigned to this role, flag trends and make corrections
2. Monitor service and captain level performance through performance dashboards
3. Bus punctuality reports to be seen daily and making timely schedule/route corrections
4. Log daily checklist of SOPs and ensure team down the line improve on deliverables
 Required Skills & Availability
 Working knowledge of bus systems, fleet maintenance basics and safety regulations
 Proven people-management and training ability for a frontline team
 Composure and firmness enforcing standards under operational pressure, including the authority to hold a bus back from dispatch
 Strong coordination and stakeholder communication — captains, crew, customers and the operator
 Comfortable working late nights and staying reachable off-hours while services are running

Description:
We are looking to hire an Assistant Finance Manager for our factory who will be responsible for managing the financial operations of a manufacturing site.
Cost Control & Budgeting: Drive factory cost management through detailed analysis of production costs, variance tracking, and adherence to annual budgets.
Finance Business Partner, responsible for forecasting, tracking, and reporting an annual spend of approximately Cr across 20 sites (both own and 2P/3P). The role ensures adherence to compliance and controls, supports statutory audit requirements, manages cost actualization and payments, and partners with the business to deliver targeted savings.
Compliance & Controls: Maintain strong internal controls at the factory in all areas like- inventory, assets, gate movements, segregation of duties, etc and ensure audit readiness.
Performance Management: Partner with operations to identify efficiency opportunities, track KPIs, and deliver savings initiatives without compromising quality or safety.
Technology Enablement: Leverage tools like SAP, Power BI, and advanced analytics to improve process hygiene and reporting accuracy.
Stakeholder Engagement: Collaborate with supply chain, procurement, and central finance teams to align factory performance with business objectives and work closely to identify optimisation opportunities.


Key Skills & Requirements
In HUL Finance, we believe in building careers and recruit not just for a role but for a career in the organisation.
We move people every 2 - 3 years and aim at giving our employees holistic experiences across the verticals of finance.
We are looking for a CA/MBA with 2 - 5 years of experience with strong problem solving and analytical abilities and excellent inter-personal and communication skills.

JOB DESCRIPTION
Job Title: Administrative Officer
Department: Administration
Reporting To: Head of Institution / Head of Administration / Management
Experience: 38 Years
Job Summary
Responsible for managing the institution’s day-to-day administrative and non-teaching operations, including manpower, facilities, infrastructure, maintenance, security, housekeeping, and vendor coordination.
Key Responsibilities
Manage overall administrative and campus operations.
Supervise non-teaching staff, housekeeping, security, maintenance, drivers, and support teams.
Coordinate manpower allocation, attendance, discipline, and staff performance.
Oversee building, civil, electrical, plumbing, and general maintenance activities.
Coordinate with vendors, contractors, and service providers.
Monitor infrastructure, renovation, repair, and facility development works.
Ensure campus safety, security, cleanliness, and operational efficiency.
Maintain administrative, manpower, vendor, and maintenance records.
Prepare periodic reports and provide updates to Management.
Resolve day-to-day operational issues and ensure smooth functioning of the institution.
Qualification & Skills
B.E./B.Tech in Civil Engineering preferred.
Candidates with qualifications in Administration, Facility Management, Infrastructure, Projects, or Operations may also be considered.
Strong leadership, manpower management, coordination, and problem-solving skills.
Experience in vendor/contractor coordination and facility management is preferred.
Experience in educational institutions or large organizations will be an added advantage.
Key Requirements
5–10 years of relevant experience in Administration, Facility Management, Infrastructure, Projects, or Operations.
AboutCompany: ACHARIYA a home away from home aims at the children’s’ holistic education with the back bone of Intelligence based teaching to form the whole structure of creating educated and SUCCESSFUL CITIZENS of future. We believe in inculcating the core values of humanity in your children and bear the name of ACHARIYAN to be on the top of the world. Our school equips the children with the knowledge of commitment, Innovation, Determination, Focus, Integrity, respect and excellence which are conveyed through moral, ethical, spiritual, physical, emotional, psychological and spiritual intelligences that can make them Achievers in life. Our school focuses on mental health to lead a successful life and career by practicing the life sciences Yoga and meditation. Every child is trained to become topper here.

Strong measurement, documentation, and material reconciliation skills.

Build strong relationships within the local construction and engineering community.

3-8 years of experience in civil engineering, construction, building materials, steel or a related industry.

Strong communication, interpersonal and relationship-building skills.

Self-motivated, proactive and capable of working independently from the assigned location.

Basic computer skills and the ability to maintain project and lead reports.

Excellent leadership skills with ability to manage teams effectively towards achieving common goals.
Proficiency in MS Office applications (Word, Excel) for documentation purposes.

We offer a comprehensive range of products across various lines of business, catering to retail, corporate, SME, and rural customers.
Ensuring accessibility through both digital and physical channels, we strive to meet the diverse needs of our customers

Position Description:
Oversee strategic planning, implementation, and optimisation of facility operations, ensuring a seamless, safe, and efficient work environment aligned with organisational objectives. The role also supports basic IT infrastructure coordination to ensure uninterrupted business operations.

Primary Responsibilities:
Strategically oversee and optimise the utilisation of physical spaces, resources, and services to enhance workplace functionality, employee well-being, and overall operational efficiency.
Lead the development and implementation of comprehensive facility management policies, procedures, and sustainability initiatives in alignment with organisational goals and industry best practices.
Manage budgets related to repairs, renovations, remodelling, and new construction projects, ensuring cost efficiency and timely execution.
Plan and schedule work for staff and external vendors; supervise operations including CCTV management, event management, canteen services, DG sets, HVAC (AC), fire safety systems, waste management, security services, and overall vendor management.
Coordinate with internal IT teams and external vendors for basic IT infrastructure support, including network connectivity, hardware setup, system maintenance, and timely resolution of IT-related facility issues.
Ensure compliance with safety, security, and statutory regulations across facilities and support smooth day-to-day operations.

Requirements:
Bachelors degree in Facility Management, Engineering, Operations, Administration, or a related field.
2-5 years of experience in facility management, administration, or infrastructure operations.
Strong knowledge of building maintenance, HVAC, DG sets, CCTV, fire safety systems, security, and vendor management.
Experience in budget management, cost optimisation, renovations, and facility improvement projects.
Knowledge of statutory compliance, workplace safety standards, and sustainability practices.
Basic understanding of IT infrastructure, including network connectivity, hardware installation, system maintenance, and troubleshooting.
Strong leadership, team management, vendor coordination, and problem-solving skills.
Proficiency in MS Office and facility management tools.
Ability to manage multiple tasks, handle emergencies, and ensure smooth day-to-day operations.
AboutCompany: Physics Wallah is an online platform and YouTube channel created by Alakh Pandey, a renowned physics teacher. It offers free educational content, primarily focusing on physics for students preparing for various competitive exams in India.

Graduation from a recognized institute

Description:
Job Description Assistant Professor (English)
Job Title: Assistant Professor – English
Department: Department of English
Key Responsibilities
Deliver effective and engaging lectures in English literature, language, communication skills, and related subjects.
Prepare lesson plans, course materials, presentations, and other teaching resources.
Conduct tutorials, practical sessions, seminars, workshops, and other academic activities.
Evaluate students through assignments, internal assessments, examinations, presentations, and projects.
Provide academic guidance, mentoring, and counselling to students as required.
Maintain accurate records of attendance, internal marks, academic performance, and other departmental documentation.
Participate in curriculum development, course planning, and academic review activities.
Contribute to departmental meetings, committees, events, and institutional activities.
Encourage students to participate in academic, literary, cultural, and co-curricular activities.
Undertake research activities and contribute to research publications, conferences, seminars, and academic forums.
Assist in organizing guest lectures, conferences, workshops, literary events, and other academic programmes.
Use appropriate digital tools and innovative teaching methodologies to enhance student learning.
Maintain professional relationships with students, faculty members, parents, and other stakeholders.
Perform other academic and administrative duties assigned by the Head of the Department or competent authority.
Qualifications
Master’s Degree in English / English Literature or a relevant discipline from a recognized university.
UGC-NET / SLET / SET / Ph.D. as applicable, in accordance with prevailing regulatory requirements.
Strong communication, presentation, teaching, and interpersonal skills.
Good command of written and spoken English.
Prior teaching experience in a higher-education institution will be an added advantage.
AboutCompany:
Sri Manakula Vinayagar Engineering College
Overview
Sri Manakula Vinayagar Engineering College (SMVEC) is one of the premier engineering institutions in Puducherry, established in 1999 under the Sri Manakula Vinayagar Educational Trust. The institution is committed to providing quality technical education, research, innovation, and holistic student development.
Affiliation & Approvals
Affiliated to Pondicherry University.
Approved by All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE), New Delhi.
Accredited by National Assessment and Accreditation Council with a high accreditation grade.
Several undergraduate programs are accredited by National Board of Accreditation.
Academic Programs
Undergraduate Programs (B.Tech/B.E.)
SMVEC offers engineering programs in disciplines such as:
Computer Science and Engineering
Artificial Intelligence & Data Science
Information Technology
Electronics & Communication Engineering
Electrical & Electronics Engineering
Mechanical Engineering
Civil Engineering
Mechatronics Engineering
Biomedical Engineering and other emerging fields.
Postgraduate Programs
M.Tech programs in specialized engineering domains.
MBA (Master of Business Administration).
MCA (Master of Computer Applications).
Research Programmes
The institution promotes doctoral research through Ph.D. programs under various engineering, technology, and management disciplines.
Campus & Infrastructure
SMVEC has a modern, eco-friendly campus with:
Smart classrooms and advanced laboratories.
Central library with extensive digital and printed resources.
Research centres and innovation facilities.
Computer centres with high-speed internet.
Separate hostels for boys and girls.
Sports complexes and recreational facilities.
Auditorium and seminar halls.
Transportation facilities.
Medical and wellness support facilities.
Research, Innovation & Industry Connect
Encourages faculty and student research publications.
Supports innovation, startups, and entrepreneurship activities.
Conducts national and international conferences, workshops, and technical events.
Maintains collaborations with industries and research organizations for internships, projects, and training.
Placements & Career Development
SMVEC has an active placement and training ecosystem that provides:
Aptitude and technical skill training.
Soft skill and personality development programs.
Internship opportunities.
Campus recruitment drives with reputed companies across IT, core engineering, and management sectors.
Vision
To become a globally recognized institution of excellence in engineering, technology, and management education through quality teaching, research, innovation, and societal contribution.
Key Highlights
Established: 1999
Location: Puducherry, India
Type: Self-financing Engineering Institution
Programs: UG, PG, and Ph.D.
Specializations: Engineering, Technology, Management, and Computer Applications
Focus Areas: Academic excellence, research, innovation, entrepreneurship, and employability.

Job Title: Store Manager Supermarket

Experience: 5 to 10 Years in Retail / Supermarket Industry
Qualification: Any Degree / Postgraduate
Job Location: Pondicherry

Salary: 30,000 40,000 per month + Incentives

Job Summary:
We are looking for an experienced and responsible Store Manager to oversee the daily operations of our supermarket/department store. The candidate will ensure smooth functioning, excellent customer service, and achievement of sales targets.

Key Responsibilities:

Manage day-to-day supermarket operations
Supervise and guide store staff
Ensure high levels of customer satisfaction and achieve sales targets
Monitor inventory levels and coordinate stock replenishment
Handle billing, cash management, and store reports
Maintain store cleanliness, safety, and visual standards
Plan promotions and implement sales strategies
Resolve customer complaints effectively
Ensure compliance with company policies and procedures
Requirements:
Proven experience in retail or supermarket management
Strong leadership and team management skills
Good communication and interpersonal skills
Knowledge of inventory and billing systems
Ability to work under pressure and meet targets
Good command of English and Tamil (spoken and written)
Important Note:
Only candidates from the Retail industry are eligible to apply.
AboutCompany:

Whether you are stocking up for the month or picking up daily essentials, you will always find what you need quickly and conveniently.
We take pride in offering competitive prices along with regular deals and special offers, helping you save more on your everyday purchases. Our focus is not just on selling products, but on building lasting relationships with our customers through trust, consistency, and satisfaction.
Driven by a passion for quality and service, we continuously strive to improve and expand our product range to meet the evolving needs of modern households. Your comfort, convenience, and confidence in shopping with us are what inspire us every day.

Description:
Roles & Responsibilities
Conduct daily CFT meetings and coordinate with cross-functional teams.
Review and monitor production schedule adherence.
Review and monitor ILR status.
Monitor plant efficiency and identify areas for improvement.
Periodically review and update Control Plans, SOPs, Work Instructions (WI), and related documents.
Coordinate with supporting departments for facility-related requirements.
Coordinate and support IATF, TPS, PMI, OSHAS, VDA, and other system-related activities.
Carry out SAP BOM corrections and ensure accuracy of material-related data.
Carry out SAP Norms corrections and maintain accurate system data.
Ensure timely closure of Stop Advice Notes.
Monitor and ensure shift-wise NC closure.
Coordinate new product introduction / new product activities with the CFT.
Key Technical Responsibilities
The role also requires strong capability in PCBA manufacturing and final assembly, including single-piece flow and batch production, SOP/CP/PFMEA, quality problem-solving tools, line efficiency improvement, assembly rejection/rework control, defect analysis, FPY improvement, 5S/Kaizen, PCB Gerber data, through-hole and selective soldering, and electronic product manufacturing processes.
As a Senior Engineer in the Manufacturing department, you will play a crucial role in the development, optimization, and implementation of manufacturing processes. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to enhance production efficiency, ensure quality compliance, and drive continuous improvement initiatives. The position requires a deep understanding of manufacturing principles, tools, and technologies, as well as strong leadership capabilities to mentor junior engineers and coordinate team efforts.

Description:
Accounts Assistant
Job Overview
Job Title: Accounts Assistant
Location: Trivandrum, Palakkad, Kollenchery, Iritty, Kanhangad, Kannur, Taliparamba, Mannarkkad, Palarivattom, Chinthalapudi, Honnali, Chennai, Puducherry, Mumbai
Job Type: Full-time (On-site)
Gender Preference: Male / Female (As per location openings)
Experience Level: Freshers
About the Role
We are seeking a detail-oriented and motivated Accounts Assistant to handle day-to-day accounting transactions, maintain accurate financial records, and support routine bookkeeping tasks. The ideal candidate will have strong numerical capabilities, organizational skills, and a fundamental understanding of financial operations.
Key Responsibilities
Bookkeeping & Data Entry: Record daily financial transactions, invoices, vouchers, and payments into accounting software.
Accounts Payable & Receivable: Assist in processing vendor invoices, verifying bills, managing receipts, and keeping track of pending receivables/payments.
Financial Documentation & Reconciliation: Verify customer bills, process vouchers, and assist in basic bank and account reconciliations.
Record Management: Maintain accurate, organized financial files, digital databases, and ledger records with high confidentiality.
Administrative & Audit Support: Provide routine administrative support to the finance department and assist with monthly or year-end financial reporting.
Required Qualifications & Skills
Education: B.Com / BBA / M.Com / MBA (Finance)
Technical Skills: Basic proficiency in accounting software (eg, Tally/ERP tools), MS Excel, and spreadsheets.
Core Competencies: Strong numerical accuracy, keen attention to detail, basic understanding of accounting principles, and good time management.
Language Skills: Proficiency in English and the regional language spoken in the designated work location.
Additional Information
Work Setup: On-site full-time role.
Preferred Experience: Prior background in basic accounting, bookkeeping, or office administration is an advantage (freshers are welcome to apply).

Description:
Position: Floor Manager (Supermarket)

Industry: Supermarket / Hypermarket / Retail
Department: Store Operations
Reporting To: Store Manager
Location: Villianur & Pondicherry
Employment Type: Full-Time

Job Purpose
The Floor Manager is responsible for managing the day-to-day activities of the supermarket sales floor, ensuring excellent customer service, effective staff deployment, proper product availability and display, and smooth store operations to achieve sales target.
The role requires strong leadership, customer-handling, merchandising, inventory-control and problem-solving skills.

Key Responsibilities

1. Floor Operations
Manage daily sales-floor operations and ensure smooth functioning of all departments.
Ensure the store is ready for business before opening and properly managed until closing.
Monitor customer flow and ensure a clean, organized and pleasant shopping environment.
Conduct regular floor walks and identify operational issues.
Coordinate with back-store, warehouse, billing and other departments for smooth operations.
2. Team Management
Supervise and guide sales staff, department staff, promoters and support employees.
Allocate staff to departments based on business requirements and customer traffic.
Monitor attendance, punctuality, grooming and discipline.
Conduct daily briefings and communicate targets, promotions and operational instructions.
Coach employees on customer service, product knowledge and selling techniques.
Monitor individual and team performance and provide regular feedback.
3. Sales & Target Achievement
Drive daily, weekly and monthly sales targets.
Monitor department-wise sales performance and identify gaps.
Encourage upselling and cross-selling opportunities.
Ensure promotional activities and offers are properly communicated to customers.
Monitor fast-moving and slow-moving products and take corrective action with the relevant teams.
4. Stock & Inventory Management
Ensure shelves are adequately stocked and products are replenished on time.
Monitor stock availability and coordinate with inventory/warehouse teams.
Ensure proper FIFO/FEFO practices, particularly for grocery, dairy, fresh and perishable products.
Identify damaged, expired, near-expiry and slow-moving products.
Support stock counts, audits and inventory reconciliation.
Monitor stock discrepancies and assist in shrinkage/loss-prevention control.
5. Merchandising & Display
Ensure products are displayed according to company merchandising standards.
Maintain correct pricing, labels, shelf tags and promotional displays.
Ensure planograms and promotional displays are implemented correctly where applicable.
Maintain attractive, clean and well-organized shelves and aisles.
6. Customer Service
Ensure customers receive prompt and professional service.
Handle customer queries, complaints and escalations effectively.
Resolve routine customer issues and escalate major issues to the Store Manager.
Collect customer feedback and identify opportunities to improve the shopping experience.
7. Billing & Cash Operations
Monitor billing-counter operations during peak hours.
Ensure adequate cashier deployment.
Coordinate with the cashier/team to minimize billing queues.
Support accurate billing and cash-handling procedures.
Report billing or POS-related issues promptly.
8. Hygiene, Safety & Compliance
Ensure cleanliness and hygiene standards are maintained throughout the sales floor.
Ensure employees follow company policies, safety procedures and grooming standards.
Monitor food-safety requirements in applicable departments.
Report safety hazards, equipment issues and other operational risks immediately.
9. Reporting & Administration
Prepare or provide daily operational updates to the Store Manager.
Monitor sales, stock availability, customer complaints, staff attendance and other relevant KPIs.
Maintain records related to floor operations.
Support internal audits, stock audits and management inspections.
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
Achievement of daily/monthly sales targets
Sales growth and conversion
Customer satisfaction
Stock availability / out-of-stock percentage
Shrinkage and stock-loss control
Inventory accuracy
Staff productivity and attendance
Shelf/display compliance
Customer complaint resolution
Store hygiene and operational standards
Qualifications
Graduate in any discipline preferred.
Diploma/12th standard may be considered based on experience.
Experience
3+ years of experience in supermarket, hypermarket, grocery retail or general retail operations.
Previous experience as Floor Manager, Department Supervisor, Senior Sales Executive, Store Supervisor or equivalent is preferred.
Experience managing a team in a high-footfall retail environment is an advantage

Description:
About the Role
The role of Cluster Optometrist at Lenskart revolves around a combination of a perfect blend of optometry and optical retail. He/she plays a pivotal role in upskilling the front end retail staff on the professional optometry grounds. They are responsible to deliver the best customer experience by leading the example in driving the key business metrics with their optometric approach. Their key deliverable in business includes maintenance of eye test quality and dispensing standards throughout as per Lenskart norms.

Responsibilities

Store Visit
Must visit assigned stores in Lenskart uniform and manage the complete Technical and Functional part of Lenskart stores
In Store Duty
Act as a Mentor and Coach to Fresher Optometrists. Help them with Sales Pitch, Technical Dispensing Guidance, Troubleshooting, Customer Query Handling etc.
Must also work as a store optometrist during busy hours, high sale days or to cover shifts of those who are on leave. Check eye test, QC drawers, Wooqer entries, CL expiry, merchandise, Instrument calibration, KMT products etc.
To ensure the Store NPS is achieved by training, troubleshooting, tracking detractor and lead by example

Manpower
To welcome new talent from market, conduct interview and on board. Initiation Prepare and conduct meetings with respective AOMs to discuss reviews, performance or proposals

Training
For new staff - Undertake regular reviews, analyse SOPs such as eye test, quality check, dispensing, contact lens, troubleshoot, deliver to measure the impact of training on store performance. Identify and Train the Store staff to help them achieve their goals

Audit
Periodically audit their eye test and dispensing performance

Team Leader
Wear multiple hats of Team leader, Bench, Senior, Consultant Optometrist to support store team

Revenue
Maximise In-Store Revenue through Optometrists through continuous training, periodic reviews, increasing number of eye tests done at store and reducing returns

Team Work
Work as a member of Business Team to accomplish goals and objectives. Participate in regional, departmental, executive, operational meeting as appropriate

Documentation
Maintain documentation and Report daily to PS regional manager on store visit summary

Working Hours
Same as store shift and as per business needs. Must work on weekends and public holidays to support store business

Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification: Diploma in Optometry with minimum 3 years of retail experience and a good track record
Good Knowledge in Optometry, Refraction, Eye Wear Products, Dispensing and Measurements
Must be ready to travel anywhere in India as per Business requirements
Passionate about Sales, Retail, Customer service and Training
Good understanding of market and product analysis
Must have leadership qualities such as - lead by example, coaching, motivating, great communication and never give up attitude
Energy, influence, 10 x think / entrepreneur mind-set etc.

Interested candidates can mail their CV at preetika.arora@lenskart.in or whatsapp at 9818320725

Description:
Role & responsibilities

Perform preventive and breakdown maintenance of electrical equipment and machinery.
Troubleshoot electrical faults and ensure minimum machine downtime.
Maintain electrical panels, motors, drives, contactors, relays, and industrial wiring systems.
Monitor and maintain PLC-controlled machinery and automation systems.
Troubleshoot PLC, HMI, sensors, VFDs, and control circuits, wherever applicable.
Ensure the smooth functioning of production equipment and utilities.
Carry out root cause analysis for recurring electrical failures and implement corrective actions.
Maintain preventive maintenance schedules, breakdown records, and maintenance reports.
Coordinate with production and other departments to resolve equipment-related issues.
Ensure compliance with electrical safety procedures, LOTO, and plant safety standards.
Support installation, commissioning, and modification of electrical equipment.
Monitor spare parts availability and coordinate with vendors for maintenance requirements.
Support continuous improvement initiatives to improve equipment reliability and productivity.

Qualifications & Experience

Diploma / B.E. / B.Tech in Electrical & Electronics Engineering (EEE) or Electrical Engineering.
Relevant experience in electrical maintenance within a manufacturing environment.
Experience in troubleshooting electrical panels, motors, drives, and industrial machinery.
Knowledge of PLC programming and troubleshooting will be an added advantage.
Experience in preventive maintenance and breakdown maintenance is preferred.

Technical Skills

Electrical panel troubleshooting and maintenance.
PLC, HMI, VFD, and industrial automation.
Motors, contactors, relays, sensors, and control circuits.
Preventive maintenance and breakdown analysis.
Electrical safety, LOTO, and root cause analysis.
Maintenance documentation and reporting.

Namaste
The DAV Group - Chennai , functioning under the aegis of Tamil Nadu Arya Samaj Educational Society was established in 1970 at Gopalapuram in Chennai with just 50 students. The Group today, caters to over 40,000 students across Tamil Nadu and Puducherry. It has a staff of 1500 plus which includes 1,200 teachers. In addition to K-12 schooling, DAV has recently ventured into Higher Education with DAV-SMK Fomra College of Arts & Science at Kelambakkam, Chennai.
In this context, we would be interested in recruiting suitable candidates for the position of TGT Social Science
Job description
We are seeking a skilled Trained Teacher with expertise in teaching Social Science to young students. The Trained Teacher will be responsible for delivering engaging lessons, fostering a positive and inclusive learning environment, and promoting the overall development of the students.
Qualification
Bachelor's degree in Education, Social Science, or related field
Strong content knowledge and passion for social science disciplines.
Excellent communication, interpersonal, and organizational skills.
Ability to create a stimulating and inclusive learning environment conducive to student growth and success.
Salary shall commensurate with experience

Description:
About the Role
Sales Associate is responsible for providing the best customer experience in the stores by providing high standards of selling services to Lenskart customers. He/she plays a pivotal role in driving the revenue achieved by the store.
Responsibilities Area Activities expected to be performed by a Lenskart Sales Associate
Customer focus
Sales Associate is expected to greet and welcome all walk-in customers and guide them toward the clinic, promoting the free eye check-up
He/she will be involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day tasks to deliver the best shopping experience to the customers
He/she must possess a basic understanding of the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively
He/she must be dedicated to customer satisfaction and must go beyond his means to resolve any concerns that the customer has
Product recommendation
With the information received from the Optometrist and the customer, he/she will present the customer with an optimal selection of products. This opportunity may be used to strike a conversation and convert it into sales
He/she is expected to understand the unstated needs of the customer, ask relevant questions,
and pick the right time to pitch the recommended solutions
Achieving sales targets & SOP adherence
Sales Associate is expected to achieve the assigned target for sales, eye-test conversion, and returns. He/she must follow all assigned SOPs diligently
Post making the sale, he/she is responsible for coordinating with the customer for product pick up, after receiving due communication from the warehouse. He/she will verify the accuracy of the lenses fitted before handing over the product to the customer. In case of returns, he/she is expected to understand the reason and try to resolve the same to control the return percentage
Store upkeep & maintenance
He/she is expected to maintain Lenskart standards of hygiene in the store with respect to the overall display, frames, instruments, and other store equipment by cleaning them regularly
He/she must ensure the security of all Lenskart equipment and ensure there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store
Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification: 12th pass; Graduates preferred
Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions
Clear articulation and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to changing environment and openness to learn
Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation
Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority

Description:
About the Role

A Store Manager at Lenskart acts as an important link between strategy and execution. He/she drives the store towards achieving all assigned metrics of Store Sales, Conversions, Customer satisfaction etc. and is responsible for keeping a high level of morale among the store staff, developing them, controlling attrition, and ensuring smooth operations at the store.
Responsibilities:

Customer focus: Driving Net Promoter Score ( NPS )

Greeting customers when they enter store and coaching the team to do the same
Displaying commitment towards providing exceptional Customer Service and ensuring that Lenskart associates also treat Customer Satisfaction as a priority
Dealing with customer service issues such as queries and complaints at store level and ensuring this is consistent with the team
Striving to have long lasting and fruitful relationships with each of our customers

Driving sales vs. plan

Driving the sales of the store to meet the allotted targets by allocating the targets to the staff
Developing a culture of high sales performance expectations, i.e. Sales Leadership
Motivating and inspiring the field team to drive for results
Assessing field capability and establish performance priorities at group level

People development (Attrition Control)

Assisting in recruiting and selecting high potential staff
Providing effective on-the-job training and guidance to team members making use of company training modules
Delivering clear, motivating and constructive feedback in a timely manner to all retail associates
Evaluating the training needs of store associates and working closely with L&D department to execute the developmental plan
Understanding the reasons for attrition and taking measures to control it

Cash & Inventory management

Monitoring cash reconciliation to ensure there is no mismatch of store funds
Ensuring availability of required merchandise and services
Conducting stocktakes regularly
Ensuring the staff at store level has basic understanding of POS System to ensure transactions are properly and effectively processed
Performing the necessary quality checks for the new products
Working very closely with other departments till the product reaches the customer and ensuring the best customer experience to the Lenskart Customer

Supervision

Ensuring that all store employees, including the Optometrist, are taken care of and their issues are resolved
Ensuring that the eye check-ups are conducted as per the SOP and maintain high quality standards

SOP adherence & implementation

Ensuring that all SOPs for retail are implemented successfully and adhered to by store employees
Updating colleagues on business performance, new initiatives and other important issues
Scheduling the teams shift timings to meet the stores business needs and demands
Ensuring staffing levels are adequate to effectively operate the store

Store upkeep & maintenance

Maintaining the store as per Lenskart standards, regularly cleaning the frames and other equipment at the store
Ensuring the security of all Lenskart equipment and that there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store

Description:
About the Role
The role of Cluster Optometrist at Lenskart revolves around a combination of a perfect blend of optometry and optical retail. He/she plays a pivotal role in upskilling the front end retail staff on the professional optometry grounds. They are responsible to deliver the best customer experience by leading the example in driving the key business metrics with their optometric approach. Their key deliverable in business includes maintenance of eye test quality and dispensing standards throughout as per Lenskart norms.
Responsibilities
Store Visit
Must visit assigned stores in Lenskart uniform and manage the complete Technical and Functional part of Lenskart stores

In Store Duty
Act as a Mentor and Coach to Fresher Optometrists. Help them with Sales Pitch, Technical Dispensing Guidance, Troubleshooting, Customer Query Handling etc.
Must also work as a store optometrist during busy hours, high sale days or to cover shifts of those who are on leave. Check eye test, QC drawers, Wooqer entries, CL expiry, merchandise, Instrument calibration, KMT products etc.
To ensure the Store NPS is achieved by training, troubleshooting, tracking detractor and lead by example

Manpower
To welcome new talent from market, conduct interview and on board. Initiation Prepare and conduct meetings with respective AOMs to discuss reviews, performance or proposals

Training
For new staff - Undertake regular reviews, analyse SOPs such as eye test, quality check, dispensing, contact lens, troubleshoot, deliver to measure the impact of training on store performance. Identify and Train the Store staff to help them achieve their goals

Audit
Periodically audit their eye test and dispensing performance

Team Leader
Wear multiple hats of Team leader, Bench, Senior, Consultant Optometrist to support store team

Revenue
Maximise In-Store Revenue through Optometrists through continuous training, periodic reviews, increasing number of eye tests done at store and reducing returns

Team Work
Work as a member of Business Team to accomplish goals and objectives. Participate in regional, departmental, executive, operational meeting as appropriate

Documentation
Maintain documentation and Report daily to PS regional manager on store visit summary
Working Hours

Description:
Profile Summary
Our Area Operations Manager is responsible for developing and expanding the business in the respective area and managing the store operations across the respective area thereby increasing the customer experience.
Key Responsibilities
Driving Sales and Customer Service
a. Driving and ensuring to meet or exceed the sales plan of the respective territory monthly/ quarterly and annually
b. Driving and focusing on providing the customer services thereby increasing the Net Promoter Score (NPS) for the store
c. Drive culture of high sales performance expectations, i.e. SALES Leadership
d. Motivates and inspires field team to drive for results.
e. Review financial performance at regional level to identify improvement opportunities.
f. Serve as critical strategy planning link between Corporate and the field organization.
g. Translate corporate goals including financial returns, sales growth and market share, into business plans.
h. Assess field capability and establish performance priorities at group level.
Manpower Planning & People Development
a. Working with the HR team and the Store Manager in ensuring staffing levels are adequate to effectively operate the store
b. Direct responsibility for professional development of Lenskart Associates
c. Assess and prioritize advanced management skill gaps including those related to design and implementation of business plans, forecasts, financial analysis, associate development and communication.
d. Conduct two-way, formal and informal performance evaluations of Lenskart Associates which review professional development needs and accomplishments as well as overall achievement of management objectives
e. Responsible for establishing a culture that embraces diversity and maximizes the learnings from a diverse team.
f. Overall responsibility for associate development
Managing P&L of the Assigned Stores
a. Responsible for managing and maintaining territory and store budgets to ensure profitability at store as well as territory level
b. Managing the top and bottom line effectively of the assigned territory and stores
c. Responsible for reducing shrinkage
d. Managing the productivity of the staff
e. Using cost effective methods to ensure productivity of the respective territory
Managing and Maintaining High Standards of Retail Operations
a.Regular Store Visits to:
Audit stores
Coaching the Store Managers
Motivate staff through sales discussions
Check VM, stock availability
Check store hygiene, grooming
Assess discipline levels in store opening times, staff attendance, process adherence etc.
b. Analyze data before Store Visits
Monitoring Sales through data.
Assessing the productivity and achievements of the stores
Store Staffing levels.
Product flow, supply, demand and shrinkage.
NPS and MC scores
Reviewing measures to achieve performance targets
a.Bridge communication between Management and floor
Recommending changes to ZM/BH basis visits.
Ensure Timely reporting of Data when needed.
Implementing and enforcing company regulations
Implement process change
Attending conferences, events and meetings at regional as well as corporate level to enhance knowledge and skill sets
Inventory Management
a. Ensures availability of required merchandise and services at each of the assigned stores
b. Ensuring that inventory levels are well balanced and making key decisions about inventory control at each of the assigned stores
c. Ensuring physical verification of inventory on regular intervals is being conducted at each of the assigned stores
d. Ensuring the staff at store level has basic understanding of POS System to ensure transactions are properly and effectively processed
e. Ensuring necessary quality checks for the new products is being conducted in a timely manner
f. Responsible for reducing shrinkage at store level
g. Working very closely with various departments in the organization till the product reaches the customer and ensuring the best customer experience to the Lenskart Customer
Key Personal and Professional Attributes:
a) Collaborative Skills: The role requires the incumbent to work closely and coordinate with the Internal and external teams to create success. S/he should be able to seamlessly navigate these relationship dynamics in a high growth, young, agile business environment.
b) Functional understanding: The role is critical for the business performance and would require the incumbent to create a competitive business advantage. It would be critical to analyze the effectiveness of the processes on a day to day basis and course correct.
c) Data driven/ Analytical: The role is required to drive specific process efficiency metrics and would be accountable to drive data-driven decision making.
d) Results oriented: The role is required to work on deliver on daily numbers, short-term goals and long-term milestones set by business and efficacy. Meeting these milestones would be critical to create success.
e) Extroverted Personality
f) Pleasant & Friendly who can be easily approached
g) Pragmatic Leaders who are self -motivated and resilient
h) Passionate
i) Energetic
j) Positive Attitude
k) Ability to handle stressful situations
l) Problem Solving & Decision Making
m) Assertive
n) Sales Driven & Number Oriented Team player
Candidate Profile:
a) Full Time Post Graduate with 7-9 years of relevant experience into retail industry
b) Post-Graduation is a must
c) Very strong communication skills- both written and verbal and must be a good orator
d) Should have hands on experience working on Microsoft Office- Including Excel, PPT & Word
e) Strong inter-personal skills (friendly, caring & patient)
f) Sales oriented
g) Strong Management/leadership skills.
h) Strong organizational skills.
i) Strong team builder
Required Managerial Competencies
People Management
a) Mentors team members and colleagues; guides them with regard to development and career progression.
b) Clearly communicates work responsibilities and expectations and takes steps to balance the workload among team members.
c) Anticipates the effect of an action on other people and modifies such action accordingly.
d) Resolves conflicts among colleagues in just and fair manner
Proactive Problem Solving Skills
a) Anticipates problems before they develop, and takes steps to avert them.
b) Considers a situation from multiple perspectives before deciding on a course of action.
c) Adept at managing the flow of information in times of crisis.
d) Appeals to reason, facts, and figures and adapts managerial style based on the demands of the situation
Commercial Savviness
a) Protects the commercial interests of the company with the aim of maximizing revenue.
b) Takes appropriate business decisions after performing a cost-benefit analysis and pre-empts problems and resolves them, ensuring minimal business loss.
c) Builds and manages workforce based on organizational goals and budget constraints
Customer Expectation Management
a) Adept at balancing the interests of the company with the needs and expectations of the client/customer
b) Responds deliberately and diplomatically to protect company interests
c) Communicates effectively about sensitive matters and influences the client/customer when required
Planning and Organizing
a) Adept at prioritization and time management to ensure efficient and timely completion of assignments
b) Manages and shifts priorities as required and incorporates new approaches
c) Delegates work effectively among team members
Required Personality Traits
a) Extraversion - The trait is marked by pronounced engagement with the external world. Extraverts enjoy interacting with people, and are often perceived as full of energy. They tend to be enthusiastic, action-oriented individuals. They possess high group visibility, like to talk, and assert themselves
b) Conscientiousness- It is a tendency to display self-discipline, act dutifully, and strive for achievement against measures or outside expectations. It is related to the way in which people control, regulate, and direct their impulses. High scores on conscientiousness indicate a preference for planned rather than spontaneous behavior
c) Openness to Experience- Openness is a general appreciation for art, emotion, adventure, unusual ideas, imagination, curiosity, and variety of experience. People who are open to experience are intellectually curious, open to emotion, sensitive to beauty and willing to try new things. They tend to be, when compared to closed people, more creative and more aware of their feelings
d) Agreeableness- The agreeableness trait reflects individual differences in general concern for social harmony. Agreeable individuals value getting along with others. They are generally considerate, kind, generous, trusting and trustworthy, helpful, and willing to compromise their interests with others.
e) Polychronicity- it is defined as a continuum, and preferences for degrees of engagement. At one extreme is the pattern of focusing on one task at a time, interpreting other potential tasks and events as interruptions and attempting to shield one's chosen task from such interference. The other extreme is actually open-ended, it involves engagement in several tasks simultaneously, sometimes literally simultaneously and sometimes in a frequent back-and-forth engagement pattern
f) Emotional Stability- People high on emotional stability do not tend to have a negative outlook of the future and hence are usually calmer. Persons who score low in emotional stability generally have a fearful and negative disposition, with an ominous foreboding about things.

Process all guest check-ins, verifying guest identity, form of payment, assigning room, and activating/issuing room key.

Balance and drop receipts.
Count and secure bank at beginning and end of shift.

Enter and locate information using computers/POS systems.

Description:
Responsible for the daily shift operations of Housekeeping, Recreation/Health Club and, if applicable, Laundry.
Directs and works with employees to verify property guestrooms, public space and employee areas are clean and well maintained.
Completes inspections and holds people accountable for corrective action.
Position assists in ensuring guest and employee satisfaction while maintaining the operating budget.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
High school diploma or GED; 2 years experience in the housekeeping or related professional area. OR
2-year degree from an accredited university in Hotel and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or related major; no work experience required.
CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Managing Housekeeping Operations and Budgets
Verifies guest room status is communicated to the Front Desk in a timely and efficient manner.
Inspects guestrooms on a daily basis.
Obtains list of rooms to be cleaned immediately and list of prospective check-outs or discharges to prepare work assignments.
Inventories stock to verify adequate supplies.
Supports and supervises an effective inspection program for all guestrooms and public space.
Understands the impact of department s operations on the overall property ficial goals and objectives and manages to achieve or exceed budgeted goals.
Verifies all employees have proper supplies, equipment and uniforms.
Communicates areas that need attention to staff and follows up to verify understanding.
Supervises daily Housekeeping shift operations and verifies compliance with all housekeeping policies, standards and procedures.
Participates in departmental meetings and continually communicates a clear and consistent message regarding the departmental goals to produce desired results.
Conducting Human Resources Activities
Uses all available on the job training tools to train new room attendants and provide follow-up training as necessary.
Establishes and maintains open, collaborative relationships with employees and verifies employees do the same with them.
Schedules employees to business demands and for tracks employee time and attendance.
Verifies employees understand expectations and parameters.
Verifies property policies are administered fairly and consistently, disciplinary procedures and documentation are completed according to Standard and Local Operating Procedures (SOPs and LSOPs) and support the Peer Review Process, where applicable.
Supervises staffing levels to verify that guest service, operational needs, and ficial objectives are met.
Observes service behaviors of employees and provides feedback to individuals.
Verifies employee recognition is taking place on all shifts.
Participates in an on-going employee recognition program.
Solicits employee feedback, utilizes an open door policy, and reviews employee satisfaction results to identify and address employee problems or concerns.
Participates in employee progressive discipline procedures.
Celebrates successes and publicly recognizes the contributions of team members.
Ensuring Exceptional Customer Service
Sets a positive example for guest relations.
Understands the brands service culture.
Participates in the development and implementation of corrective action plans to improve guest satisfaction.
Empowers employees to provide excellent customer service.
Emphasizes guest satisfaction during all departmental meetings and focuses on continuous improvement.
Responds to and handles guest problems and complaints.
Strives to improve service performance.

Description:
As the original house of luxury, St.
Regis continues to redefine modern luxury through service.
At the core is the Butler program, an icon to our heritage and the heart and soul of new luxury.
It is high-touch, personalized, creative and original.
It is brought to life by all talent but serving as the primary face to the program is our Butler team, who are the ultimate luxury ambassadors.
The Senior Butler oversees the functioning and delivery of butler services.
You verify that there is a seamless approach to the pre-arrival, guest stay and at departure through St.
Regis brand standards.
You supervise the work of the Butler team - comprised of Butlers and Butler Valets - and drive strong coordination with other departments.
Responsibilities also include people management tasks including interviewing and hiring Butler team members and creating schedules to ensure optimal staffing levels.
While the St.
Regis brand is steeped in history with roots that can be traced back to the early 1900s, every team member is part of a trailblazing future to redefine modern luxury through service.
The Senior Butler s success is rooted in a deep passion for service, uncompromising standards, the ability to anticipate needs and impeccable interpersonal skills.
You will also be expected to create a safe workplace, follow company policies and procedures, uphold quality standards, and ensure your uniform, personal appearance, and communications are professional.
Butler team members will be on their feet and moving around (stand, sit, or walk for an extended time) and taking a hands-on approach to work (move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 50 pounds without assistance).
Doing all these things well (and other reasonable job duties as requested) is critical for Butler team members - to get it right for our guests and our business each and every time.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Education: High school diploma or G. E. D. equivalent.
Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.
License or Certification: None
REQUIRE QUALIFICATIONS
Related Work Experience: 1 year related work experience required.

Description:
Responsible for preparing all event documentation and coordinates with Sales, property departments and customer to ensure consistent, high level service throughout pre-event, event and post-event phases of property events.
This position primarily handles events of average complexity.
Ensures their property events have a seamless turnover from sales to service back to sales.
Recognizes opportunities to maximize revenue opportunities by up-selling and offering enhancements to create outstanding events.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- High school diploma or GED; experienced (1 - 2 years of experience) in the event management or related professional area. OR
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Hotel and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or related major; at least 1 year experience in the event management or related professional area required.
CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Managing Event Logistics and Operations
- Ensures that events progress seamlessly by following established procedures, collaborating with other employees, and ensuring accuracy.
- Greets customer during the event phase and hands-off to the Event Operations team for the execution of details.
- Adheres to all standards, policies, and procedures.
- Ensures billing accuracy and conducts bill reviews with the clients prior to processing the final bill.
- Manages group room blocks and meeting space for average to large-sized assigned groups.
- Identifies operational challenges associated with his/her group and determines how to best work with the property staff and customer to solve these challenges and/or develop alternative solutions.
- Uses his/her judgment to integrate current trends in event management and event design.
- Acts as liaison between field salesperson and customer throughout the event process (pre-event, event, post-event).
- Participates in customer site inspections and assists with the sales process as necessary.
- Performs other duties as assigned to meet business needs.
- Solicits feedback from the property departments to identify areas for improvement to enhance the Event Planner s experience.
Ensuring and Providing Exceptional Customer Service
- Delivers excellent customer service throughout the customer experience and encourages the same from other employees.
- Empowers employees to provide excellent customer service.
- Sets a positive example for guest relations.
- Coordinates and communicates event details both verbally and in writing to the customer and property operations.
- Makes presence known to customer at all times during this process.
- Oversees his/her customer experiences from file turnover through the post event phase until turnover back to sales.
- Follows up with customer post-event.
- Responds to and handles guest problems and complaints.
- Uses personal judgment and expertise to enhance the customer experience.
- Stays available to solve problems and/or suggest alternatives to previous arrangements.
- Works to continually improve customer service by integrating obtained feedback and personal judgment into action plans.
- Emphasizes guest satisfaction during all departmental meetings and focuses on continuous improvement.
- Interacts with guests to obtain feedback on product quality and service levels.
- Ensures hourly employees understand expectations and parameters for event activities.
Leading Event Management Teams
- Conducts formal pre- and post-event meetings as required to review/communicate group needs and feedback.
- Leads formal pre-event and post-event meetings for average to large-sized assigned groups.
- Facilitates various meetings as he/she perceives necessary (Banquet Event Order meeting, block review, etc).
Supporting and Coordinating with the Sales and Marketing Function
- Assists in the sales process and revenue forecasting for customer groups.
- Up-sells products and services throughout the event process.
- Forecasts group sleeping rooms and event revenue (catering and audio visual) for his/her groups.
Conducting Human Resources Activities
- Reviews comment cards and guest satisfaction results with employees.
- Observes service behaviors of employees and provides feedback to individuals and/or managers.
- Assists in the development and implementation of corrective action plans.
- Take initiative to use his/her experience to improve service performance according to his/her evaluation of the issue and resolution.
- Works with the property staff and customers to address operational challenges associated with his/her group.
- Performs other duties as assigned to meet business needs.

Description:
ATM Field Service Engineering (Manipur)
Home
ATM Field Service Engineering (Manipur)
ATM Field Service Engineering (Manipur)
About the Role
An ATM Field Service Engineer is responsible for the entire lifecycle of ATMs, from pre-installation and setup to ongoing maintenance and repair. This includes training clients on ATM usage, performing preventive maintenance to avoid problems, troubleshooting malfunctions, and completing repairs to get ATMs back up and running quickly. They also interact directly with customers to address any concerns and provide excellent customer service. The role requires a proactive approach, responding immediately to all complaints and scheduling preventive maintenance to minimize downtime. For complex issues, collaboration with the customer support team and R&D department is necessary. A valid 2-wheeler license and motorbike are essential for travel to various ATM locations.
About the Company
Vortex Engineering is a Chennai, India-based Technology company focused on building innovative products for the ATM/self-service market. The company has a family of ATM HW & SW products with around 10K installations and a portfolio of software products for the management of multivendor ATMs and other value-added applications. Our customers include leading banks in India and a growing set of new customers in growth countries in Asia, ME & Africa.
Vortex Engineering is revolutionizing self-service product space with unique firsts in the industry

Lowest carbon footprint with ultra-low power design, making it viable for solar-powered deployments
Most sustainable, and the only commercially successful ATM to run on an open-source Linux platform
Only Indian company (and one of a few globally) to have developed and patented dispenser technology
Developing next-generation secured Hardware & Software products using IoT, AI, ML & 5G

The company has a partnership with IIT-Madras for R&D on the latest cutting-edge technologies and offers exciting career opportunities for dynamic individuals with a passion to innovate, lead, take larger responsibilities and grow with the company.
Job Summery
Location:
Manipur, India
Qualification:
Diploma or BE in EEE/ECE
Experience:
0 to 1 Year or willing to work as service technician.

Description:
The Asian International University is looking for Social Media Executive to join our dynamic team and embark on a rewarding career journey.A Social Media Executive is responsible for planning, executing, and managing social media campaigns to increase brand awareness, engagement, and sales. This role involves developing and maintaining a strong online presence for a company across multiple social media platforms, creating engaging content, and analyzing the success of social media efforts.
Key Responsibilities:
1. Develop and implement social media strategies to increase brand awareness, engagement, and sales.
2. Create and publish engaging and relevant content for multiple social media platforms, including but not limited to, Facebook, Twitter, Instagram, LinkedIn, and YouTube.
3. Manage and grow the company's social media presence, including daily monitoring and responding to comments, messages, and reviews.
4. Analyze and report on the success of social media campaigns, using metrics such as likes, shares, comments, and reach to continually improve and refine strategies.
5. Manage and maintain the company's social media calendar, ensuring that content is planned and scheduled in advance.
Requirements:
1. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to create compelling and engaging content.
2. Excellent organizational and time management skills, with the ability to prioritize tasks and manage multiple projects in a fast-paced environment.
3. A creative and analytical mindset, with the ability to use data and metrics to continuously improve social media strategies.
4. A passion for social media and a deep understanding of how to use it to build brand awareness, engagement, and sales.
5. A strong understanding of brand messaging, tone, and voice, and the ability to consistently maintain a cohesive brand image across all social media channels.

Description:
The Asian International University is looking for Estate Manager to join our dynamic team and embark on a rewarding career journey.An Estate Manager, also known as a Property Manager or Estate Supervisor, is responsible for overseeing and managing various aspects of a property or estate, ensuring its efficient operation and maintenance. Estate Managers can work in residential, commercial, or institutional settings, and their duties may vary based on the size and nature of the estate they are managing.

Key Responsibilities:

Property Maintenance:

Supervise and coordinate maintenance and repair tasks.
Ensure the property is clean, well-maintained, and aesthetically pleasing.
Manage landscaping, gardening, and outdoor maintenance activities.
Regularly inspect the property to identify maintenance needs and address them promptly.
Financial Management:

Prepare and manage budgets for property operations and maintenance.
Monitor expenses, approve invoices, and reconcile financial records.
Negotiate contracts with vendors and service providers to ensure cost-effective services.
Security and Safety:

Implement and oversee security measures to safeguard the property and its occupants.
Coordinate with security personnel and install security systems as necessary.
Develop and enforce safety protocols and emergency procedures.
Tenant and Guest Relations:

Interact with tenants, guests, and residents in a professional and courteous manner.
Address tenant concerns, complaints, and requests promptly and effectively.
Conduct regular tenant meetings and ensure a high level of tenant satisfaction.
Staff Management:

Recruit, train, and supervise estate staff, such as maintenance workers, security personnel, and housekeeping staff.
Delegate tasks and responsibilities to staff members.
Conduct performance evaluations and provide feedback to employees.
Administrative Tasks:

Maintain accurate records of property-related activities, contracts, and expenses.
Prepare regular reports for property owners or management.
Handle administrative tasks such as scheduling, correspondence, and document management.
Compliance and Regulations:

Ensure the property complies with local, state, and federal regulations and codes.
Stay updated on relevant laws and regulations affecting property management.
Obtain necessary licenses and permits for the property's operation.
Project Management:

Oversee renovation, remodeling, and construction projects on the property.
Coordinate with contractors, architects, and designers to ensure projects are completed on time and within budget.
Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in Business, Property Management, Hospitality, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
Previous experience in property management, estate management, or a related field is highly desirable.
Strong organizational, communication, and interpersonal skills.
Knowledge of property management software and basic financial principles.
Ability to multitask, prioritize tasks, and work efficiently in a fast-paced environment.
Leadership skills and the ability to motivate and manage a team effectively.

Description:
Management Level: 05 - Associate Director Performance Marketing
Location : Hyderabad, Delhi, Mumbai, Bangalore
Must have skills:
Performance Marketing Strategy, Digital Campaign Management, Paid Media (Google Ads, Meta Ads, LinkedIn Ads), Marketing Analytics, Lead Generation, Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO), Marketing Automation, CRM Integration (Salesforce, HubSpot, Zoho), Budget Management, Funnel Optimization
Good to have skills:
P&L Management, Marketing Attribution, SEO/SEM, Account-Based Marketing (ABM), A/B Testing, Cross-Functional Collaboration, Data Visualization & Reporting
Experience :
15+ years of experience is required
Educational Qualification:
Master''s degree Preferred
Job Overview
The Associate Director - Performance Marketing will lead the performance marketing strategy and execution for programs, driving learner acquisition, enrollment growth, and marketing ROI across India.
This senior leadership role combines strategic planning, digital marketing expertise, data-driven decision-making, and team leadership to scale demand generation efforts.
The role requires building a high-performing marketing function, optimizing the learner acquisition funnel, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to maximize business impact.
Key Responsibilities
Develop and execute the national performance marketing strategy for programs, aligned with business objectives, enrollment goals, and revenue targets Own end-to-end digital acquisition efforts, including paid media, lead generation, campaign optimization, conversion tracking, and marketing performance management Drive qualified lead generation and maximize enrollment conversions through data-driven marketing initiatives Manage and optimize multi-channel campaigns across Google, Meta, LinkedIn, display networks, affiliates, and other digital platforms Lead, mentor, and guide a high-performing performance marketing team, including campaign managers, analysts, and agency partners Collaborate with Sales, Program, Product, and Content teams to improve lead quality, conversion rates, and learner engagement Analyze campaign performance, market trends, competitor activities, and learner behavior to continuously optimize acquisition strategies Ensure marketing excellence through robust analytics, attribution models, budget optimization, forecasting, and reporting for senior leadership Drive process improvements, marketing automation initiatives, standard operating procedures, and best practices within the performance marketing function Required Experience,
Skills, and Qualifications
Graduate with 15+ years of experience in performance marketing, digital marketing, or demand generation, with at least 5 years in leadership roles within higher education, EdTech, or B2C learning programs (MBA preferred)
Prior experience in the EdTech industry required Proven track record of scaling digital acquisition, optimizing marketing spend, and driving significant enrollment growth Strong expertise in paid media, marketing analytics, attribution, and conversion optimization
Experience managing large marketing budgets and delivering measurable ROI Familiarity with CRM platforms, marketing automation tools, web analytics platforms, and marketing technology ecosystems

Design and develop cloud-native APIs, microservices, and serverless applications on GCP.

Experience collaborating with Data Engineering, Data Science, and MarTech teams.
Preferred
Experience with Terraform (Infrastructure as Code).
Knowledge of React-based application deployments.
GCP Associate Cloud Engineer or Professional Cloud DevOps Engineer certification.

ETL Testing Engineer
Job Title
ETL Testing Engineer / Data Warehouse Tester
Experience
3 -10 Years
Job Summary
We are seeking a skilled ETL Testing Engineer to validate data extraction, transformation, and loading processes in data warehouse and business intelligence environments. The ideal candidate should possess strong SQL skills, hands-on ETL testing experience, and expertise in data validation and quality assurance.
Key Responsibilities
Analyze business and technical requirements related to data migration and ETL processes.
Design and execute ETL test cases, test plans, and test scenarios.
Validate data extraction, transformation, and loading from source systems to target databases.
Perform data integrity, completeness, and reconciliation testing.
Verify data mappings, transformation rules, and business logic.
Execute database testing using complex SQL queries.
Identify, document, and track defects through defect management tools.
Perform regression, integration, system, and UAT support testing.
Validate data quality and consistency across multiple platforms.
Collaborate with developers, data engineers, business analysts, and stakeholders.
Prepare test metrics, reports, and test execution status updates.
Required Skills
Strong knowledge of ETL Testing concepts and methodologies.
