Description:
Data Warehouse Testing Engineer - Job Description

Job Title: Data Warehouse Testing Engineer
Experience: 8-15 Years
Location: Bangalore / Hybrid
Employment Type: Full-Time
Job Summary
We are looking for a skilled Data Warehouse Testing Engineer to validate and ensure the quality, accuracy, and integrity of data across Data Warehouse, ETL, and Reporting systems. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in SQL, Data Warehousing concepts, ETL testing, and source-to-target data validation.
Key Responsibilities
Analyze business requirements, data models, and source-to-target mapping documents.
Develop test strategies, test plans, test cases, and test scenarios for Data Warehouse projects.
Validate data extraction, transformation, and loading (ETL) processes.
Perform data reconciliation and source-to-target validation.
Verify data accuracy, completeness, consistency, and integrity across systems.
Execute functional, integration, regression, and system testing.
Validate reports, dashboards, and business intelligence solutions.
Perform backend testing using complex SQL queries.
Identify, document, and track defects using defect management tools.
Collaborate with Data Engineers, ETL Developers, Business Analysts, and stakeholders.
Prepare test execution reports and quality metrics.
Required Skills
Strong experience in Data Warehouse Testing and ETL Testing.
Advanced SQL skills including joins, subqueries, aggregations, and stored procedures.
Strong understanding of Data Warehousing Concepts:
Fact and Dimension Tables
Star Schema
Snowflake Schema
Slowly Changing Dimensions (SCD)
OLAP Concepts
Experience with ETL tools such as Informatica, SSIS, Talend, DataStage, or Ab Initio.
Expertise in source-to-target data validation and data reconciliation.
Experience with defect tracking tools such as JIRA.
Knowledge of Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC) and Agile methodologies.
Preferred Skills
Experience with Cloud Data Warehouses:
Snowflake
Amazon Redshift
Azure Synapse
Google BigQuery
Knowledge of Big Data technologies such as Hadoop, Hive, and Spark.
Experience with BI tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or Cognos.
Basic automation knowledge using Python or SQL scripting.
Experience with Data Lake and Data Migration Testing.
Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
ISTQB or relevant Data Testing certifications are preferred.
Key Competencies
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Excellent attention to detail.
Ability to understand complex data flows and business rules.
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to work independently and within cross-functional teams.
Keywords for Resume Screening
Data Warehouse Testing, ETL Testing, SQL, Data Validation, Data Reconciliation, Informatica, SSIS, Talend, DataStage, Ab Initio, Star Schema, Snowflake Schema, Fact Tables, Dimension Tables, SCD, Data Migration Testing, Snowflake, Azure Synapse, Redshift, BigQuery, Tableau, Power BI, JIRA, Agile.
Must-Have Skills
Data Warehouse Testing
ETL Testing
Advanced SQL
Source-to-Target Validation
Data Reconciliation
Data Warehousing Concepts (Star/Snowflake Schema, Facts & Dimensions)
Agile & JIRA Experience
Provide your feedback on BizChat

Description:
Position: PLM Support Engineer
Experience: 3 to 8 Years
Location: Bangalore / Pune / Chennai / Hyderabad (or as applicable)
Employment Type: Full-Time

Job Summary
We are seeking a highly skilled PLM Support Engineer with 3 to 8 years of experience in supporting and maintaining Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) applications. The ideal candidate will be responsible for providing L2/L3 production support for PLM platforms such as PLM Support ,Teamcenter, Aras Innovator, and SmarTeam, ensuring stable operations, timely incident resolution, and continuous process improvement. The role involves troubleshooting workflows, CAD integrations, BOM management, release processes, and collaborating with global cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality support.
Key Responsibilities
Production Support & Incident Management
Provide L2/L3 production support for PLM applications including Teamcenter, Aras Innovator, and SmarTeam across production and non-production environments.
Act as the primary point of contact for business users for PLM operational, application, and workflow-related issues.
Manage incidents, service requests, problem tickets, and change requests within agreed SLA timelines.
Perform impact analysis and prioritize tickets based on business criticality.
PLM Functional Support
Support Engineering Change Management (ECM/ECR/ECO) processes and workflows.
Manage and troubleshoot complex BOM (Bill of Material) structures and product data issues.
Support product release processes, document lifecycle management, and workflow execution activities.
Assist users with process adherence, workflow execution, and system functionality.
CAD & Integration Support
Provide support for CAD integrations with Siemens NX, CATIA, and related engineering applications.
Troubleshoot CAD data loading, synchronization issues, and integration failures.
Investigate dataset validation failures, translator issues, and CAD file management problems.
Workflow & System Administration Support
Troubleshoot workflow integration issues, dispatcher failures, workflow processing delays, and PDF generation errors.
Support vault server management, job server monitoring, and scheduled background jobs.
Monitor workflow execution and system performance to ensure application availability and stability.
Analyze system bottlenecks impacting user performance and workflow processing.
Root Cause Analysis & Continuous Improvement
Conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for recurring production incidents.
Implement corrective and preventive actions to reduce ticket volumes and improve system reliability.
Identify opportunities for automation and process improvements within PLM support operations.
Maintain knowledge articles, support documentation, and troubleshooting guides.
Reporting & Stakeholder Management
Generate and publish support metrics, incident reports, ticket trend analysis, and SLA compliance reports.
Provide regular status updates to management and key stakeholders.
Coordinate with development, infrastructure, database, and global support teams for issue resolution and deployments.
Participate in release validation, patch deployment, and post-deployment support activities.
Required Technical Skills
PLM Technologies
Strong experience in at least one or more PLM applications:
Teamcenter
Aras Innovator
SmarTeam
Functional Knowledge
Engineering Change Management (ECR/ECO/ECN)
Product Structure Management
BOM Management
Workflow Management
Release Management
Document Management
CAD Integration
Siemens NX
CATIA
CAD Data Management
Technical Skills
SQL Queries and Database Fundamentals
PLM Data Model Understanding
Workflow Configuration and Troubleshooting
Dispatcher Monitoring
PDF Generation Processes
Job Server and Vault Management
Application Log Analysis
Support Tools
ServiceNow / Jira / Remedy
Incident & Change Management Tools
Monitoring and Reporting Tools
Desired Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
3 to 8 years of experience in PLM application support.
Experience in global production support environments.
Knowledge of ITIL processes and best practices.

Description:
We are currently hiring for Sales Specialist for our Apple Retail Stores in India.


Do you love how it feels to encourage others? As a Part-Time Specialist, you help create the energy and excitement around Apple products, providing the right solutions and getting products into customers hands. You understand that the Apple Store is dedicated to delivering a customer experience thats unlike any other. It starts with you discovering customers needs. And with the support of your store team members, you match those needs with the right products. Every day is an opportunity for you to turn another Apple Store visitor into a loyal Apple customer.


Role & responsibilities

Deliver excellent service to Apple customers by seeking to understand their needs, identifying ownership opportunities, presenting products and services, and educating customers on relevant ways to buy products.
Understand and proactively stay up to date on Apples products, services, purchase options and Product Zone sales processes.
Support your peers throughout the store as needed by sharing knowledge about Apples products, services and purchase options, and assist in offering ownership opportunities. Maintain accuracy and follow guidance.
Perform other tasks as needed, including but not limited to providing customer service and support in other areas of the store.
Contribute to an inclusive environment by respecting each others differences and having the curiosity to learn.
Demonstrate Apples values of inclusion and diversity in daily activities.



Preferred candidate profile

Demonstrate knowledge of Apple products and services.
Personalise solutions based on customer needs, and effectively communicate them.
Work in a fast-paced environment, often supporting multiple customers at the same time.
Work in a team environment, demonstrating shared responsibility and accountability with other team members.
Be curious and open to learning from others and helping each other grow.
Learn about and deepen your understanding of Apple products and services, and third-party products, to enhance the customer experience.
Be trusted with sensitive or confidential information, keeping with Apples core values.
You should have availability to work a schedule based on business needs that may include nights, weekends and public holidays in the retail store, and reliably attend work as scheduled, in line with local laws and subject to any approved accommodations.

This is a Part-Time opportunity, requiring you to work 4 Days in a week for 5 hours each day i.e 20 hours in a week.


Location

Bangalore , Delhi, Noida


Perks and benefits

Description:
The Opportunity
Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. Youll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands-on learning, cutting-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.
As a Data Science Manager, you will play a pivotal role in transforming raw data into actionable insights, enabling informed decision-making and driving business growth. Within our Advisory practice, you will focus on leveraging advanced analytics and statistical techniques to extract insights from large datasets and drive data-driven decision-making. As a Manager, you will lead teams and manage client accounts, focusing on strategic planning and mentoring junior staff. You are accountable for project success and maintaining standards. Enhancing your leadership style, you motivate, develop, and inspire others to deliver quality. You are responsible for coaching, leveraging team members' unique strengths, and managing performance to deliver on client expectations. With your growing knowledge of how business works, you play an important role in identifying opportunities that contribute to the success of our Firm. You are expected to lead with integrity and authenticity, articulating our purpose and values in a meaningful way. You embrace technology and innovation to enhance your delivery and encourage others to do the same.
In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will work on exploratory and descriptive analysis, statistical modeling, and creating data visualizations to help solve complex business problems and inform strategic decisions.
Responsibilities
- Leading data science initiatives to transform raw data into actionable insights for informed decision-making
- Guiding teams in the application of advanced analytics and statistical techniques to solve complex business problems
- Developing and implementing data-driven strategies using machine learning, predictive modeling, and artificial intelligence
- Overseeing the creation and maintenance of data pipelines and data lakes to support large-scale data processing
- Collaborating with stakeholders to identify opportunities for leveraging data science to drive business growth
- Utilizing programming languages such as R and MATLAB to develop and refine data models and algorithms
- Promoting the use of innovative technologies and methodologies within data science teams
- Confirming data quality and integrity through rigorous data validation and troubleshooting processes
- Mentoring junior staff and fostering a culture of continuous learning and development within the team
- Engaging in strategic planning and execution to align data science projects with organizational goals
What You Must Have
- At least a Bachelor's degree
- At least 7 years of experience
- Oral and written proficiency in English required
What Sets You Apart
- Preference for at least one of the following fields of study: Artificial Intelligence and Robotics, Business Analytics, Computer and Information Science, Computer Engineering, Computer Programming, Data Processing/Analytics/Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Machine Learning, Management Information Systems, Mathematics, Statistics, Systems Engineering
- Demonstrating proficiency in data science algorithms and workflows
- Utilizing machine learning and deep learning techniques effectively
- Excelling in data-driven decision making and predictive modeling
- Managing data pipelines and confirming data quality
- Leveraging programming languages such as R and MATLAB
- Applying natural language processing and neural network methodologies

Title: Salesforce Marketing Cloud Intelligence Developer

Description:
Location: Bangalore, Mumbai, or Hyderabad.
Word Mode: 2 Days weekly WFO
Interview: 3 rounds virtual.
Notice: Immediate
Code: 108260-42
Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC) Sr. Developer
We are seeking an experienced Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC) Developer with strong hands-on expertise in AMPscript, CloudPages, SQL, Journey Builder, and Automation Studio.
The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, testing, and supporting personalized marketing communications, landing pages, data-driven campaigns, and automated customer journeys within Salesforce Marketing Cloud. This role requires strong technical development skills as well as the ability to translate business and marketing requirements into scalable SFMC solutions.
Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, test, and deploy solutions within Salesforce Marketing Cloud.
Develop personalized and dynamic email content using AMPscript.
Build and maintain CloudPages, landing pages, microsites, forms, preference centers, and subscription-management pages.
Develop server-side functionality on CloudPages using AMPscript and Server-Side JavaScript (SSJS) where applicable.
Create dynamic forms and landing pages that read from and write data to Data Extensions.
Implement form submission, validation, data capture, confirmation pages, and error-handling logic.
Develop secure and personalized CloudPages using URL parameters, encrypted query strings, subscriber attributes, and Data Extension lookups.
Build reusable AMPscript components for personalization, conditional content, data retrieval, data updates, and campaign logic.
Develop complex SQL queries for audience segmentation, campaign targeting, reporting, and data transformation.
Design and manage Data Extensions, subscriber data, Contact Builder relationships, and SFMC data architecture.
Develop and maintain automated processes using Automation Studio, including SQL Query Activities, imports, extracts, file transfers, and scheduled workflows.
Build and support customer journeys using Journey Builder, including entry events, decision splits, personalization, triggered communications, and journey data.
Develop responsive HTML email templates and landing pages using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
Integrate Salesforce Marketing Cloud with Salesforce CRM and other enterprise platforms using Marketing Cloud Connect, REST APIs, SOAP APIs, SFTP, and other integration mechanisms.
Troubleshoot AMPscript, CloudPages, automations, journeys, email rendering, and data-related issues.
Perform unit testing, code reviews, deployment validation, and production support.
Develop reusable technical components and follow development standards for security, maintainability, performance, and scalability.
Maintain technical documentation for CloudPages, data models, APIs, automations, journeys, and integrations.
Work closely with marketing, business, technology, and data teams to translate requirements into technical solutions.
Required Qualifications
Strong hands-on experience with Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC).
Strong proficiency in AMPscript, including:
Personalization
Conditional logic
Lookup functions
Data Extension reads and updates
Subscriber and contact attributes
String, date, and formatting functions
Redirects and URL handling
Error handling
Dynamic content
Strong hands-on experience developing CloudPages.
Experience developing:
Landing pages
Lead capture forms
Registration forms
Preference centers
Unsubscribe pages
Confirmation and thank-you pages
Dynamic personalized pages
Experience using AMPscript functions such as Lookup, LookupRows, RetrieveSalesforceObjects, UpsertData, InsertData, UpdateData, RequestParameter, Redirect, CloudPagesURL, and related functions.
Strong SQL skills for segmentation, data transformation, and audience management.
Hands-on experience with:
Content Builder
Email Studio
Journey Builder
Automation Studio
Contact Builder
Data Extensions
Experience with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
Understanding of responsive email and web development.
Experience integrating SFMC with external systems using REST and/or SOAP APIs.
Experience with SFTP-based file integrations and automated data processing.
Strong debugging, troubleshooting, and analytical skills.
Understanding of Salesforce Marketing Cloud subscriber, contact, and consent-management concepts.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience with Server-Side JavaScript (SSJS) within Salesforce Marketing Cloud.
Experience with CloudPages security and secure data handling.
Experience implementing encrypted and personalized URLs using CloudPagesURL.
Experience working with Salesforce CRM through Marketing Cloud Connect.
Familiarity with JSON and API-based integrations.
Experience building custom preference centers and consent-management solutions.
Knowledge of email deliverability and subscriber-management best practices.
Understanding of CAN-SPAM, GDPR, CCPA, and related data-privacy requirements.
Experience with enterprise-scale Salesforce Marketing Cloud implementations.
Salesforce Marketing Cloud certifications are preferred.
Experience
8+ years of Salesforce Marketing Cloud development experience preferred.
6+ years of hands-on AMPscript development experience.
Demonstrated experience designing and developing CloudPages and custom landing-page solutions.
Experience supporting production marketing campaigns, automated journeys, and enterprise-scale customer communications.

Description:
We are looking for an experienced Full Stack Ecommerce Developer (Magento 2) to join our platinum team of entrepreneurial, enthusiastic, and caring people.
You will be responsible in developing, maintaining, securing, and optimizing our eCommerce platform based on Magento 2 on hyper scaler cloud environment including underlying components.
You will identify new and exciting functionalities and develop new modules.
If you are the person who can design and develop web / mobile platforms securely at an unbelievable pace, we would like to meet you.
To succeed in this role, you must have a growth mindset and be a self-starter, top-notch communicator and passionate hands-on programmer.
Responsibilities
Optimize existing Magento 2 installation
Provide regular and emergency support for break-fixes
Troubleshoot integration and performance issues
Design interfaces, themes, templates while following best practices and maintain world-class coding styles and standard
Anticipate the performance requirements and communicate with management on remediation plans to CTO/CIO
Develop new Magento modules and functionalities
Manage and upgrade Magento add-ons and conduct code reviews/scans
Establish DevOps pipelines, Release/Change management procedures, etc.
Develop testing scenarios including unit testing, integration testing and automate those
Work with UI/UX and graphic designers to implement front-end changes
Work with content writer to implement new contents
Implement additional components such as Elastic Search, Varnish, Redis, CDN, RabbitMQ, etc.
Manage SSL certificates, software accounts, keys, etc.
Rearchitect environment and provide vertical and horizontal scaling as demand grows
Fine-tune batch jobs (Crons) or Consumers
Migrate databases and data
Develop integrations for files, images, etc.
Manage stack components and upgrade them (Ubuntu, PHP, Percona, Nginx, Composer, Firewall, Redis, etc.)
Create plans for developing mobile experience, mobile apps or PWA front end environment
Maintain confidentiality about IP, methods, processes and data
Participate in conferences, webinars and provide presentations while socializing and partnering with startups
Install security patches and monitor web traffic
brand and perform soft-sell while managing and improving brand reputation
Collaborate with other stakeholders such as content developer (copywriter), graphics and media designer, and management for consistent brand messaging and best customer experience
Qualifications
Strong experience with Magento 2 development and debugging
Strong experience with high-performance technologies such as Nginx, Varnish, Redis, ElasticSearch
JavaScript and AJAX experience for Front-end
Extensive HTML5, LESS and CSS knowledge
Understanding of modern UI/UX trends
Experience or knowledge of React.js, Vue.js and Node.js
Experience with AWS components such as VPC, IAM, EC2, ECS, Lambda, S3, CloudFront, WAF Cloud Formation
Linux or Ubuntu server operations working and know-hows
Experience in working with MySQL databases like MariaDB and Percona
Basic understanding of networking and ports
Experience with Google Tag Manager, SEO, Google Analytics, PPC, Facebook Pixels. A/B Testing
Strong attention to details about design styles to improve look and feel
Very good PHP knowledge and understating of various frameworks
Ability to work in a professional capacity and team environment is must
Ability to manage projects and work in strict deadlines
Education Certifications
Bachelors/Masters in Computer Science, Information Technology or a related field
Magento 2 Certification is required
Cloud Computing Certification (AWS/GCP/Azure) is a plus

Description:
Hi Everyone,
Hope youre doing well!
We have an urgent opening for a SAP Senior SD Functional Consultant of our esteemed clients.

Experience Required: 10 – 15 Years
Location: Hyderabad,Bangalore,Pune,Mumbai,Noida,Chennai
Employment Type: Full-time
Education: B. Tech / M. Tech / M.Sc. / MCA

Position Overview
Job Descripition:

We are seeking an experienced SAP Senior SD Functional Consultant with 9+ years of expertise in SAP Sales & Distribution (SD) and SAP S/4HANA. The ideal candidate will have strong experience in Order-to-Cash (O2C) processes, global template rollouts, business process analysis, and SAP implementations. The role involves collaborating with business stakeholders, conducting workshops, gathering requirements, configuring SAP SD solutions, supporting testing activities, and ensuring successful project delivery.

Key Responsibilities
Gather and analyze business requirements and translate them into SAP SD solutions.
Lead workshops with business users and stakeholders to define functional requirements.
Configure and support SAP SD processes, including Sales, Shipping, Delivery, Billing, Pricing, and O2C.
Participate in SAP S/4HANA implementation and global rollout projects.
Prepare functional specifications and coordinate with technical teams for developments.
Support SIT, UAT, defect resolution, cutover, and post-go-live activities.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including MM, FI, WM/EWM, and Logistics.
Create and maintain functional documentation and provide end-user support.
Ensure solution quality, process compliance, and timely project delivery.

Required Skills
9+ years of SAP SD Functional experience.
Strong knowledge of SAP S/4HANA and Order-to-Cash (O2C) processes.
Experience in SAP implementations, enhancements, and global rollouts.
Expertise in Sales Order Processing, Pricing, Shipping, Delivery, and Billing.
Experience in business process analysis, configuration, testing, and production support.
Strong stakeholder management, communication, and problem-solving skills.
Knowledge of SAP integration with MM and FI modules.

Preferred Candidate
Experience in SAP S/4HANA transformation projects.
Exposure to Agile or SAP Activate methodology.

Description:
Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. Youll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Servicessolving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands-on learning, cutting-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.
As a Workday Finance - Associate, you will play a pivotal role in consulting services for Workday finance applications, analyzing client requirements, implementing software solutions, and providing training and support for seamless integration. Within our Digital Core Modernisation network, you will enable clients to optimize financial processes, improve financial reporting, and achieve their strategic objectives. As an Associate, you will focus on learning and contributing to client engagements, developing your skills and knowledge to deliver quality work. You will be exposed to clients to learn how to build meaningful connections, manage and inspire others, and grow your personal brand by deepening your technical knowledge of firm services and technology resources.
In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will adapt to working with a variety of clients and team members, each presenting unique challenges and scope. You will take ownership and consistently deliver work that drives value for our clients and success as a team. As you navigate through the firm, you will build a brand for yourself, opening doors to more opportunities. Embrace the chance to learn and grow in a fast-paced environment, where every experience is an opportunity to enhance your skills and contribute to the success of our clients.
Responsibilities
- Analyzing client requirements to implement Workday finance solutions effectively
- Supporting seamless integration and utilization of Workday finance applications
- Providing training and guidance to clients on optimizing financial processes
- Collaborating with team members to improve financial reporting capabilities
- Assisting in the development of financial management strategies for clients
- Monitoring and analyzing financial trends to inform strategic decisions
- Applying financial accounting and reporting standards in client engagements
- Engaging in business process improvement initiatives to enhance operational efficiency
- Utilizing financial modeling and forecasting techniques to support client objectives
- Participating in the administration of financial systems to maintain accuracy and compliance
Location: Chennai, Bangalore, Hyderabad, Gurugram, Noida, Pune and Kolkata

Description:
Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. Youll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Servicessolving real client challenges through connected collaboration. Well help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands-on learning, cutting-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.
As a Workday Finance - Senior Associate, you will play a pivotal role in consulting services for Workday finance applications, analyzing client requirements, implementing software solutions, and providing training and support for seamless integration. Within our Digital Core Modernisation network, you will enable clients to optimize financial processes, improve financial reporting, and achieve their strategic objectives. As an Associate, you will focus on learning and contributing to client engagements, developing your skills and knowledge to deliver quality work. You will be exposed to clients to learn how to build meaningful connections, manage and inspire others, and grow your personal brand by deepening your technical knowledge of firm services and technology resources.
In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will adapt to working with a variety of clients and team members, each presenting unique challenges and scope. You will take ownership and consistently deliver work that drives value for our clients and success as a team. As you navigate through the firm, you will build a brand for yourself, opening doors to more opportunities. Embrace the chance to learn and grow in a fast-paced environment, where every experience is an opportunity to enhance your skills and contribute to the success of our clients.
Responsibilities
- Analyzing client requirements to implement Workday finance solutions effectively
- Supporting seamless integration and utilization of Workday finance applications
- Providing training and guidance to clients on optimizing financial processes
- Collaborating with team members to improve financial reporting capabilities
- Assisting in the development of financial management strategies for clients
- Monitoring and analyzing financial trends to inform strategic decisions
- Applying financial accounting and reporting standards in client engagements
- Engaging in business process improvement initiatives to enhance operational efficiency
- Utilizing financial modeling and forecasting techniques to support client objectives
- Participating in the administration of financial systems to maintain accuracy and compliance
Location: Chennai, Bangalore, Hyderabad, Gurugram, Noida, Pune and Kolkata

Insurance Follow-Up:
Contact insurance companies via phone, email, or online portals to follow up on outstanding claims. Identify and resolve issues causing payment delays, such as claim denials or underpayments. Verify claim status, appeal denied claims, and resubmit claims when necessary.

Proven experience (1-3 years) in healthcare revenue cycle management, specifically in accounts receivable follow-up and collections.
Strong understanding of medical billing processes, insurance claims, and reimbursement methodologies.
Excellent communication skills with the ability to effectively interact with insurance companies, patients, and internal stakeholders.
Proficiency in using billing software, electronic health records (EHR), and Microsoft Office applications.
Attention to detail and ability to prioritize tasks to meet deadlines.
Knowledge of medical coding (ICD-10, CPT) is a plus.
Experience Level: 1 to 2 years.
Shift timings: Flexible to work in night shifts (US Time zone)

Role & responsibilities

Work on large-scale technology transformation projects across end-to-end SAP transformations as well as emerging and disruptive technologies
Provide risk advisory services to clients in key technology areas such as SAP S/4 HANA (on-prem, private and public cloud), SuccessFactors, BTP, Ariba, SAP Governance, Risk and Compliance (GRC), primarily focused on
Risk identification and control integration as part of an end-to-end ERP implementation;
IT and business process controls audit/review in context of an ERP implementation;
Implementation support including project management and governance;
Risk management and assurance over large transformation technology initiatives;
Design and implementation of SAP application security and controls; and
Experience with assessment and implementation of SAP GRC (ARA, BRM, ARM, UAR, PC, etc.)
Perform reviews and assessments of IT risks, and design and assessment of controls in support of internal and external audit and advisory engagements, in areas such as:
Cloud security
IT projects and system implementations
IT risk and maturity assessment
Access management
IT governance reviews
Data governance assessments and reviews
Bring strong leadership and project management skills to engagement teams, working in dynamic and cross-functional teams for large-scale and multi-national engagements.


Preferred candidate profile

Experience and knowledge of controls integration, security design/implementation and GRC integration related to one or many large ERP solutions such as SAP S/4 HANA, SuccessFactors, Ariba, BTP, SAP Governance, Risk and Compliance (GRC).
Implementation and/or assurance experience with emerging technologies such as blockchain, robotic process automation (RPA) and artificial intelligence is preferred.
Experience in one or more of the following areas would be preferred, especially aligned in context of cloud-based / large-scale ERP systems - external and internal IT audits and reviews, data conversions, audit of controls under CPA Canada section 5970 (CSAE 3416) and SSAE 16, SOX/NI 52-109 programs; and data quality and analytics.
3-5 years of relevant experience, including key areas such as Consulting (e.g. system implementation, project management, IT consulting, risk consulting, cyber security, etc.), Assurance (internal and/or external audit) or relevant industry roles (e.g. risk management, IT, cyber security, finance and accounting, project management, system implementation)
Bachelors or Master's degree in Business, Information Technology, Finance, Data Science or Computer Science degree required
Completion of relevant certifications (e.g. CISSP, PMP, CRISC, CISM or CISA designation) is an asset
Certifications from large ERP vendors (e.g. SAP S/4 HANA, SuccessFactors, Ariba, SAP Governance, Risk and Compliance (GRC), BTP Administrator, SAP Certified Associate - Security Administrator, etc) is an asset
Fluent in French and English would be an asset
Business development: getting involved with new opportunities, taking a proactive role in raising awareness of the firm's services and level of commitment to the market, developing and maturing relationships with internal staff and clients, developing proposals, identifying and pursuing opportunities to increase the practice's penetration in the public and private sector.
Provide high performance (e.g. clear vision/target/purpose, open communication, promoting flexibility, collaboration and accountability) to deliver high quality to clients and a rewarding experience to staff. A demonstrated commitment to valuing differences and working alongside diverse people and perspectives.
Propose initiatives for the development of in-house tools, accelerators and solutions.
A demonstrated commitment to valuing differences, developing and coaching diverse teams, and ensuring diverse perspectives are heard

Description:
Job description
Key Responsibilities:
As a Learning Design & Development practitioner, you will play a key role in helping clients navigate their transformation challenges by designing and building the learning solutions that carry those transformations, owning the work from curriculum architecture through to release-ready assets. You will provide tailored learning solutions to enhance workforce capabilities, optimize HR functions, and support long-term organizational success. By offering insights into company culture and designing impactful learning programs, you will help clients build a skilled, adaptable workforce that drives performance and growth
As such, the key responsibilities for this position include (but are not limited to):
Engagement Delivery
Delivering learning solutions for technology driven or culture-based client transformation journey, by including (but not limiting to) the below skill sets:
Learning Strategies:
Instructional Design (ID) or Learning Experience Design (LXD) with a strong command of adult learning principles and instructional strategies, and working fluency in recognized frameworks - ADDIE and/or SAM, Blooms taxonomy for objective setting, and Kirkpatrick for evaluation.
Demonstrate a deep understanding of business operations and ERP and HCM solutions like Workday, Oracle, SAP, etc.
Learning Activities:
Collaborate with Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) to deliver Training Needs Analysis, Curriculum design, role-based learning plans and blended training solutions.
Ability to use a variety of collaboration tools available to the client to run workshops and presentations.
Ability to develop engaging scenarios, activities, and assessments for blended learning solutions.
Hands-on proficiency with industry-standard authoring and multimedia tools - Articulate Storyline and Rise 360, Adobe Captivate, Camtasia, Vyond, or equivalent - to build visually engaging learning assets.
Publish and troubleshoot content on an LMS or LXP, including SCORM/xAPI packaging and versioning, and build to accessibility standards (WCAG 2.1 / Section 508).
Work directly with clients to support engagement delivery spanning across phases of analysis, design, development, and implementation of training.
Learning Effectiveness:
Evaluate the effectiveness of learning programs against Kirkpatrick Levels 13 using a range of methods - reaction surveys, knowledge checks, and on-the-job performance measures.
Continuously improve learning programs based on feedback, industry best practices, and emerging trends.
General Requirements:
Excellent storyboarding skills, and able to produce release-ready facilitator guides, participant materials and ILT/vILT decks to a publishable standard.
Communicate complex information effectively through engaging written and verbal formats tailored to the client's needs and audiences.
Ensure regular communication and alignment on project updates with the engagement team
Ability to work through ambiguity, flexibility to adapt to changing priorities and business needs.
Ability to work flexibly across time zones as per project requirements, ensuring seamless coordination and efficient project execution.
Stay up to date with the latest trends and advancements in learning and development.
Contribute learning scope, effort estimates and instructional methodology input to pursuits and proposals as a subject-matter expert.
Provide guidance and support to team members to reinforce learning from engagements.
Believe in the value created by diverse teams and adapt to different working styles.
Continue to develop internal relationships and your PwC brand.

Description:
Role & responsibilities

About the Role The Program Specialist is responsible for serving as the customers primary point of contact providing operational and reimbursement support to complex programs within Neovance , including but not limited to, marketing support, reimbursement hotlines, patient assistance programs, Hubs, foundations, safety surveillance programs, case management, and compliance programs. The focus of the Program Specialist is to own issues and remove obstacles that prevent patients or providers from accessing the therapies requested. The Program Specialist will be a self-starter who is comfortable taking initiative, identifying barriers, and working with the appropriate parties to eliminate these obstructions for the customer. The Program Specialist is proficient and knowledgeable about all the services provided on an assigned program and may support multiple client products or programs.

Key Responsibilities:

As a Pharmacy Patient Care Coordinator, you will be the voice patients, providers, and pharmacies rely on when they call in with questions about their therapy. You will support inbound calls tied to Patient Access Programs, HUB services, benefits verification, prior authorization, and pharmacy support, guiding callers through complex healthcare and reimbursement processes with clarity, patience, and genuine care.
This is a highly regulated, high volume calling environment, and you will be expected to bring both empathy and precision to every conversation, balancing quality and compliance standards while helping people move forward on their treatment journey.

What You'll Do:

Manage high volume inbound calls from patients, providers, and pharmacies regarding therapy status, prescriptions, and program questions.
Support callers across Patient Access Programs, HUB services, benefits verification, prior authorization, and pharmacy support processes.
Build trust and rapport with patients, caregivers, and healthcare providers through clear, confident, and empathetic communication.
Simplify complex healthcare, insurance, and reimbursement information into language patients can easily understand.
Ask probing questions and paraphrase what you hear to confirm understanding and avoid miscommunication.
Research across multiple systems and knowledge bases to identify the correct resolution, owning issues through to completion.
Document every interaction accurately and completely, maintaining the compliance and quality standards required in a regulated healthcare environment.
Manage call flow and back-to-back conversations while meeting Average Handle Time, First Call Resolution, and quality expectations.
Respond to vulnerable, frustrated, or anxious patients with composure, recognizing emotional cues and adapting your approach accordingly.

What You'll Bring:

Education & Experience

Bachelors degree preferred, or equivalent experience.
Minimum two years of experience in an international contact center or inbound voice support environment.
US healthcare experience is mandatory, preferably within Patient Access Programs, HUB, Reimbursement, Pharmacy Support, Benefits Verification, Prior Authorization, or PAP.
Experience handling patient, provider, payer, or pharmacy interactions is strongly preferred.

Skills & Strengths
Strong verbal and written English communication skills, with a neutral or globally understandable accent and minimal first language influence.
Ability to manage high volume inbound call queues while maintaining quality, compliance, and productivity standards in a fast paced environment.
Strong listening skills, with the ability to accurately capture concerns and paraphrase them back to confirm understanding.
Sound investigative and analytical thinking, with the ability to research across multiple tools and synthesize information into an accurate resolution.
Comfortable navigating multiple applications simultaneously while keeping the conversation engaged and professional.
Working understanding of call center metrics such as Average Handle Time, Quality Scores, First Call Resolution, Customer Satisfaction, Service Levels, and Adherence.
Proven experience working in a highly regulated environment requiring accurate documentation and compliance adherence.

Preferred candidate profile

Shift: 06:30 PM - 03:30 AM.
Night Shift Allowance: No additional allowance is provided for night shifts
Contract Duration: 6-month contract (C2H)
Work Model: Work From Office

Round 2- Interview (online Interview with Allegis Bangalore )
Round 3 Interview (online With client)

Must have international voice support experience
Good communication skills
must have supported inbound calls
must have all companies experience letter
we support 15 days or immediate joiners

Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. Your role will involve strategic planning and execution, leveraging your business application consulting skills to drive impactful results for our clients.

You will take ownership of projects, confirming their successful planning, budgeting, execution, and completion. In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will be instrumental in cultivating meaningful client relationships and navigating ambiguity, all while upholding PwC’s quality standards. You will articulate our purpose and values in a meaningful way, contributing to the firm's broader business strategies and success.
Responsibilities
- Leading Workday Human Capital Management (HCM) projects to drive successful client outcomes
- Managing client relationships and expectations through effective communication and strategic planning
- Guiding teams in the implementation of Workday HCM solutions, confirming alignment with client needs
- Utilizing analytical thinking and business process improvement skills to enhance project delivery
- Overseeing project budgeting and resource allocation to optimize efficiency and effectiveness
- Coaching and mentoring team members to foster professional growth and development
- Conducting business analysis to identify opportunities for human resources transformation
- Implementing change management strategies to support organizational development and employee engagement
- Collaborating with stakeholders to develop and execute workforce planning and talent management initiatives

Description:
Job Description
The Finance Solution team works closely with client and project teams in the US to help CFOs and their finance organizations identify, design and implement programs that transform their finance functions to meet todays demanding requirements while continuing to provide valuable insights to the business.
A career within the Finance Solutions team, will provide the opportunity to work alongside CEOs, CFOs and Controllers to optimize their Record to Report process. We work closely with clients to diagnose current-state finance operations, identify improvement opportunities, design future-state processes, and implement digital and process solutions to enhance efficiency, accuracy, and control in financial reporting.
Role & responsibilities
4-9 years Experience R2R Finance Strategy, Process Transformation,Blackline end to end Implementation.
1. Finance Strategy, Process Transformation & Optimization
Assist the finance function to define the finance vision, outline clear-set of value proposition, define sustainable cost reduction model, prepare a roadmap for finance transformation strategy, define and develop a finance target operating model.
Lead assessments and diagnostics of clients Controllership function / R2R processes, identifying pain points, inefficiencies, and control gaps.
Design future-state processes aligned with leading practices and automation opportunities.
Drive simplification, standardization, and centralization initiatives across global finance functions.
Performance / KPI Management - define an effective set of performance measures and KPIs which will focus the business on the delivery of strategy and business plans
2. Technology Enablement & Digital Finance
Lead implementation and optimization of Last mile tools (BlackLine, Trintech, Floqast, ReconNet, Workiva, Alteryx, Power BI).
Collaborate with technology teams to define system requirements, support testing, and ensure smooth deployment.
Leverage analytics, RPA, and AI-based solutions to drive continuous improvement.
3. Financial Close & Reporting Excellence
Improve close cycle timelines, accuracy of financial statements, and reconciliation efficiency.
Implement best-in-class closing calendars, governance models, and reporting frameworks.
4. Stakeholder Management & Communication
Act as a trusted advisor to client CFOs, Controllers, and Shared Services leaders.
Coordinate with cross-functional teams (FP&A, Tax, Treasury, Procurement) to ensure end-to-end process alignment.
Prepare and deliver high-quality deliverables, presentations, and reports for leadership reviews.
5. People Development & Knowledge Sharing
Contribute to firm-wide knowledge creation, methodologies, and accelerators for finance transformation projects.
Mentor junior team members and support their development through on-the-job training and feedback.
Preferred candidate profile
An ideal candidate for the Finance Solutions practice of PwC Advisory Acceleration Center should be proficient in one or more of the below:
Advising global organizations on improving efficiency and effectiveness in Record to Report processes
Have a strong business acumen, with an ability to understand how business processes and decisions impact people and organization
Ability to conduct walkthroughs, workshops and meetings involving various business stakeholders
Strong understanding of Record to Report processes (GL, Intercompany, Fixed Assets, Reconciliations, Financial Close, Inventory Accounting and Reporting).
Exposure to automation and reporting tools like BlackLine, Trintech, Floqast, ReconNet, Workiva.
Working knowledge of any digital tools and accelerators such as Alteryx, PowerBI, Tableau, Power Automate, Power Apps etc. would be an added advantage

Description:
Responsibilities
1. Jira Tool Configuration & Administration
Execute assigned Jira and integrated-tool support tickets (Approvals, Rework, Mobilization, Handover, Urgent requests, Change Requests) within SLA and quality standards while communicating proactively with reporters on requirements and status updates.
Create and configure Jira spaces, projects, workflows, schemes, user roles, permissions, fields, boards, and plugins (Structure, Rich Filters, Xray, ScriptRunner) based on standard procedures and templates, adapting configurations for engagement needs while maintaining governance standards. Troubleshoot complex Jira and Confluence issues, evaluate solutions, document changes, and coordinate resolution with technical and functional stakeholders.
2. Reporting, Analytics & Functional Requirements
Gather and translate business and engagement requirements into Jira configurations, dashboards, reports, and delivery solutions. Create and maintain Rich Filter dashboards, Kanban and Scrum boards, and project reporting standards using AI/automation where appropriate to improve efficiency and accuracy. Validate expectations with reporters and stakeholders before implementation.
Use advanced JQL to investigate and resolve client inquiries, build reporting views, and provide data-driven insights for delivery teams. Support project forecasting, progress tracking, resource/capacity visibility, and
management reporting using Jira and other PMO/collaboration tools as engagement needs require.
3. Agile, Scrum & Project Delivery
Apply knowledge of the complete project lifecycle (initiation, planning, execution, monitoring and control, closure) to support timely, quality delivery. Take on Project Manager or Scrum Master responsibilities on selected engagements, including facilitation of Agile ceremonies, backlog/sprint coordination, dependency tracking, and team alignment.
Digitize schedules and plans using tools such as Structure for Jira, Advanced Roadmaps/Plans, MS Project, ServiceNow, or Smartsheet, adapting to client and practice methodologies.
4. Governance, Risk & Delivery Support
Define clear objectives, scope, deliverables, and milestones for proposed solutions. Track progress to ensure delivery outcomes meet agreed quality standards and create Change Requests based on governance requirements and approvals.
Identify, document, and track risks, issues, dependencies, and mitigation actions through closure. Escalate urgent requests and delivery concerns to leadership as appropriate.
Perform advanced Jira administrative activities including MPP uploads, bulk updates, and project configuration changes. Configure Test Management with Xray to enable functional teams with testing workflows, reports, and traceability. Support PMO governance activities, project tracking, documentation, and quality checks across different engagement processes.
5. Stakeholder Management, Training & Communication
Manage stakeholder expectations and communicate proactively with engagement teams, clients, and ticket reporters on requirements, scope, priorities, progress, risks, and completion. Facilitate working sessions, Agile ceremonies, requirement discussions, and project status conversations to align stakeholders on goals, deliverables, and timelines.
Deliver on-demand Jira/Confluence and process training, maintain training materials and knowledge articles, and support user adoption across technical and functional audiences. Mentor team members, build enduring client relationships, and collaborate across PwC practices and technology platforms as engagement assignments change.
6. Quality, Continuous Improvement & Operations
Identify opportunities to streamline Jira administration and PMO processes through standardization, automation, AI, and reusable tools/templates. Measure improvements in efficiency, quality, and SLA performance. Operate effectively in environments without a single fixed process, quickly ramping up on new domains, platforms, client-specific tools, and ways of working.
Perform peer reviews and quality checks, attend team meetings and mandatory trainings, and maintain consistent documentation and delivery standards. Execute ad hoc tasks and special assignments from senior management, prioritizing appropriately and maintaining proactive communication.
7. Cloud Migration, Integrations & Automation
Conduct complex Jira migrations (Data Center to Cloud, Cloud to Cloud) including discovery, planning, testing, and cutover. Perform post-migration stabilization, assess marketplace apps and integrations for migration or replacement, and re-implement using REST APIs, webhooks, ScriptRunner, and plugins while coordinating functional validation.
Design and build automations and AI-assisted workflows using Automation for Jira, ScriptRunner, and AI capabilities (Atlassian Intelligence/Rovo, generative AI) to reduce manual effort across Jira administration, reporting, forecasting, and project delivery. Define responsible AI guardrails including data handling and output validation. Mentor peers on automation rule-building and safe AI use while staying current on Atlassian Cloud features and emerging technologies.

Description:
Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. Youll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Servicessolving real client challenges through connected collaboration. Well help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands-on learning, cutting-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.
As a SAP - CPI/PIPO - Manager, you will specialize in providing consulting services for data and analytics solutions using SAP technologies. You will analyze client requirements, design and implement data management and analytics solutions, and provide training and support for effective utilization of SAP data and analytics tools. Within our Technology Consulting practice, you will work closely with clients to understand their data needs, develop data models, perform data analysis, and create visualizations and reports to support data-driven decision-making, helping them optimize their data management processes, enhance data quality, and derive valuable insights from their data to achieve their strategic objectives.
As a Manager, you will lead teams and manage client accounts, focusing on strategic planning and mentoring junior staff. You are accountable for confirming project success and maintaining standards. Enhancing your leadership style, you motivate, develop, and inspire others to deliver quality. You are responsible for coaching, leveraging team members' unique strengths, and managing performance to deliver on client expectations. With your growing knowledge of how business works, you play an important role in identifying opportunities that contribute to the success of our Firm. You are expected to lead with integrity and authenticity, articulating our purpose and values in a meaningful way.
Responsibilities
- Leading data migration projects using SAP Data Services and SAP LSMW to facilitate seamless transitions to S/4 HANA
- Designing and implementing data management and analytics solutions tailored to client needs
- Collaborating with SAP functional and technical consultants to analyze data migration requirements and legacy data structures
- Developing data migration frameworks and transformation routines to optimize data quality and integration
- Conducting data source analysis and profiling to identify data quality issues and conformity with target systems
- Managing data cleansing activities and validation exercises using tools like Information Steward and SQL
- Providing advisory services to clients on data management strategies and techniques
- Creating technical specification documents to guide the development of data services jobs
- Overseeing preload and post-load validation of migration results and addressing data dropouts
- Supporting migration dress rehearsals, cutover tasks, and post go-live activities to confirm successful project execution

Description:
As a SAP EWM Senior Associate, you will specialize in providing consulting services for SAP supply chain and operations applications. You will analyze client needs, implement software solutions, and offer training and support for seamless integration and utilization of SAP supply chain and operations applications. Working in this area, you will enable clients to optimize their supply chain processes, improve operational efficiency, and achieve their strategic objectives. As a Senior Associate, you will focus on building meaningful client connections and learning how to manage and inspire others. You will navigate increasingly complex situations, growing your personal brand and deepening your technical skills. You are expected to anticipate the needs of your teams and clients, delivering quality solutions while embracing increased ambiguity.
In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will leverage your skills to respond effectively to diverse perspectives and needs, using a broad range of tools and methodologies to generate new ideas and solve problems. You will develop a deeper understanding of the business context and how it is evolving, interpreting data to inform insights and recommendations. Upholding professional and technical standards, you will contribute to the firm's code of conduct and independence requirements, fostering a culture of continuous improvement and innovation within our Tax practice.
Responsibilities
- Analyzing client needs to implement SAP supply chain and operations solutions effectively
- Providing training and support for seamless integration and utilization of SAP applications
- Optimizing supply chain processes to enhance operational efficiency and achieve strategic objectives
- Utilizing data-driven insights to inform supply chain transformation initiatives
- Managing project resources and budgeting to deliver successful client engagements
- Coordinating supply chain management activities to improve performance and reduce lead times
- Developing procurement strategies and implementing procurement systems to enhance cost efficiency
- Designing warehouse layouts and managing warehouse systems to streamline operations
- Applying analytical thinking to solve complex supply chain challenges and improve processes
- Collaborating with clients to build meaningful relationships and anticipate their needs
What You Must Have
- At least a Bachelor's degree
- At least 5 years of experience
- Oral and written proficiency in English required
What Sets You Apart
- At least one of the following: One or more SAP certifications in SAP Supply Chain and Operations solutions, including SAP S/4HANA Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Extended Warehouse Management (EWM), Transportation Management (TM), or related logistics credentials
- Demonstrating proficiency in SAP Supply Chain Management (SAP SCM)
- Utilizing data-driven insights for supply chain optimization
- Managing complex supply chain transformation projects
- Excelling in demand forecasting and planning operations
- Leveraging analytical thinking for supply chain analysis
- Implementing procurement strategies and system improvements

Description:
Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. Youll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands-on learning, cutting-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.
As a SAP-CO-Senior Associate, you will specialize in providing consulting services for SAP finance applications, analyzing client requirements, implementing software solutions, and offering training and support for seamless integration and utilization of SAP finance applications. Within our Technology Consulting practice, you will enable clients to optimize financial processes, improve financial reporting, and achieve their strategic objectives. As a Senior Associate, you will leverage your skills to analyze complex problems, mentor others, and maintain professional standards. You will focus on building client relationships and developing a deeper understanding of the business context, navigating increasingly complex situations to grow your personal brand and deepen your technical skills.
In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will work as part of a team of problem solvers with extensive consulting and industry experience, helping clients solve their complex business issues from strategy to execution. You will proactively assist the team in various aspects of the project, prepare deliverables, and contribute to the development of your own and the team’s technical acumen. This position offers an opportunity to develop internal relationships and enhance your PwC brand while keeping up to date with local and national business and economic issues.
Responsibilities
- Analyzing client requirements to implement SAP finance solutions effectively
- Providing training and support for seamless integration and utilization of SAP finance applications
- Optimizing financial processes and improving financial reporting for clients
- Collaborating with teams to solve complex business issues from strategy to execution
- Preparing deliverables and contributing to the development of technical acumen
- Keeping up to date with local and national business and economic issues
- Validating compliance matters within financial processes
- Developing internal relationships and enhancing your personal brand
- Configuring and solutioning SAP FI and CO modules, including General Ledger, Taxation, and Asset Accounting
- Managing integration with peripheral tools such as Trintech, RAR, and CFIN
- Leading end-to-end SAP implementation projects, including S/4 Hana
- Utilizing team handling and people management skills to mentor junior team members
- Monitoring and analyzing financial trends to provide strategic insights
- Presenting financial reports and advising on financial planning and budgeting
- Embracing change and fostering a culture of continuous improvement in financial systems and processes

Client Advisor Job Description
About NoBroker
NoBroker is a technology-led real estate platform focused on simplifying the property buying, selling, and renting experience through technology. We operate in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment where ownership, customer experience, and business outcomes are highly valued.
About the Role
We are looking for Client Advisors to join our sales team. In this role, you will be responsible for driving sales, understanding customer requirements, guiding customers through NoBroker’s products and services, and converting leads into successful customers.
The role requires strong communication, relationship-building, follow-up, and negotiation skills, along with a target-oriented mindset.
Key Responsibilities
Drive sales and revenue targets within the assigned territory.
Identify and connect with potential customers to understand their property requirements.
Guide customers on NoBroker’s plans, products, and value-added services.
Build and maintain strong customer relationships throughout the sales journey.
Generate leads through calls, referrals, follow-ups, and local market opportunities.
Conduct product/service demonstrations and clearly explain pricing and benefits.
Handle customer queries, objections, and escalations effectively.
Convert leads into customers and consistently achieve individual sales targets.
Follow up with prospective customers to maximize conversions.
Identify upselling and cross-selling opportunities for premium plans and additional services.
Maintain accurate customer information, follow-ups, and sales activities in the CRM.
Track daily sales performance, pipeline status, and achievement against targets.
Coordinate with internal teams to ensure smooth customer onboarding and service delivery.
Stay updated on local market trends, customer preferences, and competitor activities.
Prepare regular sales reports and share performance updates with the reporting manager.
Candidate Requirements
Experience: Freshers can apply.
Education: Any Graduation.
Age: Up to 30 years.
Strong verbal communication and interpersonal skills.
Good customer-handling and relationship-management abilities.
Strong persuasion, negotiation, objection-handling, and closing skills.
Comfortable working in a target-driven environment.
Self-motivated, persistent, and result-oriented.
Willingness to learn and work in a fast-paced sales environment.

Opportunity to build a career in a fast-paced PropTech environment.
Performance-driven growth opportunities.

Job Overview

The Associate Director - Sales (eDegrees) will lead the sales strategy and execution for eDegrees programs, driving enrollment and revenue growth across India. This senior leadership role combines strategic planning, high-value consultative selling, and team leadership to scale the business. This role requires building strong relationships with prospective learners, corporate partners, and academic stakeholders, while mentoring sales managers and driving national sales performance.

Key Responsibilities:

Develop and execute the national sales strategy for eDegrees programs, aligning with business objectives and revenue targets

Own end-to-end sales operations, including lead generation, pipeline management, negotiation, and deal closure

Achieve and exceed enrollment and revenue targets consistently across all markets and segments

Build and maintain strong relationships with prospective learners, corporate clients, and academic partners

Lead, mentor, and guide a high-performing sales team (sales managers, executives, and regional teams)

Collaborate with Marketing, Program, and Product teams to optimize campaigns, promotions, and lead conversions

Analyze market trends, competitor strategies, and learner preferences to refine sales approaches

Ensure sales process excellence, CRM adoption, accurate forecasting, and reporting for senior leadership

Represent professionally at industry events, webinars, and conferences

Drive process improvements, standard operating procedures, and best practices within the sales function

Required Experience, Skills, and Qualifications:

Graduate with 18+ years of experience in sales, with at least 5 years in leadership roles in higher education or B2C learning programs (MBA preferred)

Prior experience in the EdTech industry required

Proven track record of scaling revenue, managing large sales teams, and achieving aggressive enrollment targets

Experience in consultative, solution-based, and high-value selling

Strong business acumen, stakeholder management, and negotiation skills

Excellent verbal and written communication and presentation skills

Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment

Familiarity with CRM tools, sales analytics, and marketing collaboration

Description:
Project Role : Cloud Technical Architect

Project Role Description : Develop and deliver agile and cost effective hosting solutions. Implement scalable, high performance hosting solutions that meet the need of todays corporate and digital applications using both private and public cloud technologies. Plan and deliver legacy infrastructure transformation and migration to drive next-generation business outcomes.

Must have skills : SAP ABAP Development for HANA

Good to have skills : NA
Minimum 5 year(s) of experience is required

Educational Qualification : 15 years full time education

Summary : As a Business Analyst with strong SAP ABAP on HANA with BRIM SOM exposure, a typical day involves analyzing organizational processes, systems, and subscription-based business models to understand how they function end-to-end. The role focuses on aligning business requirements with SAP BRIM Subscription Order Management (SOM) and HANA-based technical solutions. This includes identifying customer and stakeholder needs, envisioning future-state improvements across the subscription lifecycle, and supporting data-driven decision-making through effective requirement analysis and collaboration with technical teams to enhance overall business performance.

Roles Responsibilities
Expected to perform independently and grow into a Subject Matter Expert (SME) in SAP ABAP on HANA and BRIM SOM.
Actively participate and contribute to team discussions, solution design, and problem-solving activities.
Provide effective solutions to work-related challenges, particularly in subscription order lifecycle, order changes, and integrations.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams (functional, technical, and business stakeholders) to ensure alignment between BRIM SOM processes and technology implementations.
Document and clearly communicate business and functional requirements to technical teams, ensuring accurate ABAP on HANA implementation.
Support and mentor junior team members by sharing knowledge and best practices in SAP ABAP, HANA, and BRIM SOM.
Continuously monitor and evaluate business and subscription processes to identify opportunities for optimization, automation, and innovation.

Professional Technical Skills
Must-Have Skills
Proficiency in SAP ABAP Development on HANA.
Hands-on experience in SAP BRIM Subscription Order Management (SOM) ABAP developments and enhancements.
Experience in developing and customizing SAP applications using ABAP for HANA environments, including performance-optimized coding.
Strong understanding of SAP HANA database concepts, CDS views, Open SQL, and performance tuning techniques.
Ability to analyze and troubleshoot complex technical and functional issues within SAP BRIM and core SAP systems.
Familiarity with integration of BRIM SOM with CI, FI-CA, Convergent Invoicing, and downstream systems.
Skilled in writing efficient, maintainable code while adhering to SAP development best practices.

Additional Information
Minimum 3+ years of experience in SAP ABAP Development on HANA, with exposure to SAP BRIM SOM.
Position based at the Bangalore office.
15 years of full-time education is required.

Qualification 15 years full time education
