Description:
Technology Strategy and Transformation Senior Manager Technology Modernization

Join our team in Technology Strategy Transformation for an exciting career opportunity to help our most strategic clients define and accelerate technology modernization journeys that unlock growth, simplify complexity and create future-ready technology landscapes

Practice: Technology Strategy Transformation, Global Network
Areas of Work: Technology Modernization Strategy, Application Modernization
Level: Senior Manager

Location: Bangalore/Gurugram/Mumbai/Pune/Chennai/Kolkata/Hyderabad

Years of Exp: 15+ years

Explore an Exciting Career at Accenture

Do you believe technology modernization is key to unlocking growthAre you a problem solver who enjoys helping clients simplify complex technology landscapes and make the right modernization choicesDo you enjoy being part of an inclusive, diverse and collaborative culture

If yes, this is the right opportunity for you. Join Accenture Technology Strategy Transformation and work with global clients to shape enterprise-wide technology modernization strategies, target-state architecture, application modernization approaches, executable roadmaps and value cases. You will partner with C-suite stakeholders to convert modernization ambition into practical decisions, business-aligned priorities and measurable outcomes across industries.

The Practice A Brief Sketch

Technology Strategy Transformation Practice is a part of Accenture Strategy and focuses on our clientsmost strategic priorities. We help clients achieve growth and efficiency through innovative transformation initiatives, aimed at redefining business models and delivery approaches using agile methodologies.

We provide you with a strong learning environment, deep-rooted in Technology Strategy, Enterprise Architecture and Technology consulting, where you will get an opportunity to support and work with our key global clients, defining and driving end-to-end technology modernization initiatives and strategic value, business growth and cost optimization. As part of this high-performing team, these are some of the initiatives you will support:

Modernization Strategy Value Agenda: Help clients define the strategic intent for modernization, aligning with core business objectives of growth, agility, resilience, cost and simplification to a clear modernization ambition and measurable value outcomes Technology Estate Application Portfolio Assessment: Assess complex technology landscapes across applications, platforms, integrations, data, AI, engineering and legacy applications, including non-mainframe legacy estates, to identify technical debt, business risk, modernization opportunities and portfolio-level priorities Target Architecture Modernization Pathways: Shape target-state modern architecture, reference technology stacks and modernization pathways across enterprise platforms, applications and legacy estates, helping clients make informed choices across regarding remediation Modernization Roadmap, Business Case Decision Governance: Translate modernization ambition and strategy into sequenced roadmaps, investment cases, decision frameworks and governance mechanisms that help clients prioritize initiatives, manage trade-offs and realize measurable business value

Role Overview

We are looking for a Technology Modernization Strategy Architecture leader with deep expertise in enterprise technology modernization, application modernization and modernization-led architecture strategy across all layers of IT landscape including architecture, application, data, AI, cloud, engineering and IT operations.

The role requires a senior consulting practitioner who can engage confidently with CxO and business leadership, shape the modernization value agenda, assess complex technology and application estates, drive target architecture and modernization pathway discussions, and translate business ambition into executable transformation roadmaps and value cases.

The successful candidate will be expected to evaluate complex technology estates, define modern target state, structure initiatives needed to achieve the target state, identify modernization pathways and guide clients through practical, sequenced transformation choices.

The role requires strong executive presence, structured problem solving, deep modernization expertise across IT landscape and the ability to guide senior clients through practical trade-offs across business value, technology debt, cost, risk, resilience, scalability and long-term architecture fit.

Key Responsibilities


Technology Modernization Strategy and Roadmap


Lead enterprise-wide technology modernization strategy engagements across complex technology landscapes

Define modernization ambition, strategic intent and business-aligned technology modernization priorities

Assess current-state technology estates across applications, platforms, architecture, integration, data, infrastructure and vendor ecosystems

Identify modernization opportunities, technical debt, architecture constraints, platform gaps, business risks and value pools

Shape target-state architecture and reference technology stack aligned to business priorities and enterprise architecture direction

Define modernization guiding principles, decision prioritization frameworks to support consistent technology choices

Advice on vendor, platform and ecosystem strategy, including fitment of cloud platforms, enterprise platforms, integration platforms and modernization partners

Build multi-year modernization roadmaps sequenced by business value, technical dependencies, cost, risk, complexity and readiness

Develop modernization value cases linking technology investments to measurable outcomes such as agility, resilience, scalability, cost efficiency, reduced technology debt and speed-to-market


Application Modernization Strategy, Architecture Planning


Lead application estate assessments covering business criticality, technical health, architecture fit, complexity, dependencies, cost, resilience, scalability and modernization potential

Assess aging and legacy application estates, including non-mainframe legacy applications, to identify technical debt, business risk, modernization constraints and transition priorities

Define application modernization pathways for target applications

Conduct application decomposition and domain analysis to identify modernization boundaries, dependency clusters, migration waves and sequencing options

Shape target application architecture and transition architecture across applications, platforms, integration and data dependencies

Define phased modernization approaches, coexistence models, migration plans and dependency management approaches that protect business continuity

Advice on modernization patterns such as modular architecture, API-led integration, microservices, event-driven architecture, cloud-native enablement, strangler pattern and platform-based modernization

Support data liberation and migration considerations required to reduce dependency on aging systems and enable future-ready application architecture

Develop app modernization roadmaps and value cases aligned to enterprise modernization strategy, architecture direction and business priorities


Executive advisory and Growth


Lead CxO-level conversations on technology modernization priorities, application modernization choices, architecture implications, investment trade-offs and enterprise transformation decisions

Serve as a trusted advisor to CIO, CTO, enterprise architecture and business leadership teams on modernization strategy, sequencing choices and strategic technology decisions

Translate complex modernization and architecture topics into clear executive recommendations, decision options and leadership-ready points of view

Support strategic pursuits, client account development and growth initiatives through differentiated modernization propositions and executive-ready solution narratives

Shape client opportunities by bringing together various capabilities of Accenture to provide a holistic solution to client

Develop thought leadership, market perspectives, offering assets and reusable modernization frameworks

Lead and mentor teams across discovery, modernization assessment, strategy development, roadmap creation and senior stakeholder engagement


Core Skillsets Tools

Technology Modernization Advisory


Strong understanding of how enterprise technology modernization enables business growth, agility, resilience, cost optimization, speed-to-market and technology simplification

Ability to assess complex technology estates across applications, platforms, integrations, data dependencies, AI, engineering, infrastructure touchpoints, cloud footprint, vendor ecosystem and technology debt

Strong capability in legacy application modernization, technology debt assessment, modernization prioritization and investment sequencing across large enterprise landscapes

Experience in developing modernization value cases that connect technology investments to measurable outcomes such as run-cost reduction, risk reduction, improved resilience, faster change velocity and business capability enablement

Familiarity operating model implications of modernization, including product-centric delivery, platform operating models, engineering maturity, governance and change readiness



Ability to define data, platform and architecture enablers required to scale AI responsibly across the enterprise value chain


Application Architecture, Engineering and AI


Strong understanding of application architecture, integration architecture, data AI architecture, cloud architecture and transition architecture in modernization contexts

Deep understanding of modern application architecture patterns such as domain-driven design, modular architecture, microservices, event-driven architecture, API-led integration, cloud-native application design and strangler-based modernization

Strong understanding of application modernization pathways including trade-offs across value, cost, risk, feasibility and business continuity

Experience with aging application estates, including non-mainframe legacy applications, custom applications, packaged applications, end-of-life technologies and fragmented platform landscapes

Practical understanding of modern engineering practices such as AI driven SDLC, DevSecOps, CI/CD, automated testing, observability, infrastructure-as-code, containerization, Kubernetes and platform engineering

Strong understanding of frameworks and methods such as TOGAF, COBIT, IT4IT, business capability modelling, modernization maturity assessment and technology value assessment

Good understanding of cloud, data and AI architecture concepts, including Azure/AWS/GCP, data lake, data fabric, real-time data processing, semantic models, AI/ML integration, GenAI enablement and AI-ready application architecture

Familiarity with platform ecosystems across SAP, Oracle, Salesforce, ServiceNow, hyperscalers, integration platforms, data platforms, observability tools and engineering toolchains


Consulting and Communication Skills


Strong consulting toolkit spanning structured problem solving, assessment design, facilitation, business case development and executive storytelling

Ability to engage senior stakeholders with credibility and clarity, influence client leadership and create alignment across business and technology teams

Experience in independently leading client discussions, develop thought leadership, create compelling modernization narratives and shape opportunities

Experience leading proposals, strategic pursuits and senior client relationship development


Whats in it for you


An opportunity to work on transformative projects with key G2000 clients

Potential to Co-create with leaders in strategy, industry experts, enterprise function practitioners and, business intelligence professionals to shape and recommend innovative solutions that leverage emerging technologies.

Ability to embed responsible business into everythingfrom how you service your clients to how you operate as a responsible professional.

Personalized training modules to develop your strategy consulting acumen to grow your skills, industry knowledge and capabilities

Opportunity to thrive in a culture that is committed to accelerate equality for all. Engage in boundaryless collaboration across the entire organization.


Qualification

Your experience counts!


Bachelors degree required; MBA or equivalent postgraduate qualification is a plus

15+ years of experience in technology consulting, technology strategy, application modernization, architecture-led transformation, cloud modernization or large-scale technology transformation advisory

Experience working with CIO, CTO, enterprise architecture, application, platform, cloud, data and business leadership teams to shape modernization strategies and transformation priorities

Hands on experience in defining and driving minimum 2 technology modernization engagement for a client with large IT landscape with expertise in defining portfolio prioritization according to minimal business continuity risk

Hands-on experience in defining modern application architecture patterns and practices

Experience with aging and legacy application estates, including non-mainframe legacy applications, custom applications, packaged applications, end-of-life technologies and fragmented platform landscapes

Strong understanding of modernization pathways including the ability to evaluate trade-offs across value, cost, risk, feasibility and business continuity

Experience shaping target-state and transition architecture across application, integration, data, cloud and platform layers

Exposure to modern engineering, cloud, data and AI-enabled modernization concepts, including DevSecOps, CI/CD, platform engineering, cloud-native architecture, data modernization, GenAI enablement and AI-ready application architecture

Experience creating executive-ready deliverables such as modernization strategy documents, application portfolio heatmaps, architecture options, roadmap views, business cases, investment options and CxO-level presentations

Experience leading consulting teams, including structuring workplans, guiding analysis, reviewing deliverables, facilitating workshops and managing senior stakeholder discussions

Experience supporting proposal development, solution shaping, strategic pursuits, thought leadership or practice-building activities in technology modernization or adjacent transformation areas.

Understanding of at least one of the industries across Financial Services, Retail, Consumer Goods, Life Sciences, Telecommunications, Resources, Industrial, Automotive, Travel or similar sectors is preferred

Strong facilitation capability with experience in workshops, design thinking sessions, leadership discussions and architecture governance forums

Description:
Enterprise AI Value Strategy- Consultant
Join our team in Technology Strategy & Transformation for an exciting career opportunity to help our most strategic clients realize exceptional value from AI in software delivery, a boardroom priority for organizations globally and be at the forefront of shaping how enterprises adopt AI-native software engineering
Practice: Technology Strategy & Transformation, Global Network
Areas of Work: Enterprise AI Value Strategy
Level: Consultant
Location: Bangalore/Gurugram/Mumbai/Pune/Chennai/Kolkata/Hyderabad
Years of Exp: 5+ years
Explore an Exciting Career at Accenture
Do you believe software engineering is entering a new AI-native era? Are you a problem solver who enjoys helping CIOs, CTOs, CDOs and engineering leaders rethink how software is imagined, designed, built, tested, secured and delivered using AI? Are you passionate about being part of an inclusive, diverse and collaborative culture?
If yes, this is the right opportunity for you. Join Accenture Technology Strategy & Transformation practice and work with global clients to shape the next frontier of enterprise software delivery using AI. Working with C-suite stakeholders, you will help enterprises adopt AI-native software delivery at scale and turn transformation ambition into measurable outcomes. You will help enterprises define AI-powered software delivery transformation strategies and translate them into executable approaches, define target state SDLC, create platform and tooling strategy and architecture, engineering productivity measures, delivery operating model change and measurable value realization.
The Practice - A Brief Sketch
Technology Strategy & Transformation Practice is a part of and focuses on our clients' most strategic priorities. We help clients achieve growth and efficiency through engineering transformation initiatives, aimed at making software delivery powered by AI to bring productivity and quality uplift, resulting in larger enterprise value delivery.
You are:
A workstream owner. You take a defined part of an engagement end-to-end - the agent hierarchy for a process, or use-case and data-product definition for a domain - and are its day-to-day client contact.


Qualification
The work
Basic Requirements
Basic Requirements
* Assist in discovery workshops to identify business opportunities and translate them into AI use cases, business cases, and solution requirements.
* Design end-to-end agent-driven business process flows and define agent hierarchies, help define AI solution blueprints, and high-level reference architectures.
* Develop functional specifications and collaborate with architecture and engineering teams to deliver implementation-ready solution designs.
* Apply foundational knowledge of enterprise data, data management, and analytics to shape AI solution design and business outcomes.
* Evaluate AI platforms, tools, and industry best practices to support solution recommendations and client engagements.
Good to Have
* Experience defining data products, enterprise data models, and AI-ready data foundations.
* Exposure to knowledge graphs, knowledge layers, prompt engineering, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).
* Experience developing AI capability roadmaps, AI platform assessments, and value realization plans.
* Strong consulting, problem-solving, stakeholder communication, and presentation skills with experience working in cross-functional teams
Tech fluency
Hands-on depth in at least one platform (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud), data platforms (Databricks, Snowflake), or foundation models (e.g., Anthropic, OpenAI)., plus conversant across the categories. Can weigh trade-offs (fit, cost, risk) within an engagement.
Industry Lens:
Working knowledge of one priority industry's processes and value drivers; applies it to use-case and roadmap work..
Role Summary
Min. 5 yrs overall, incl. AI & data projects
High-value consulting or relevant industry/functional experience
Engages senior stakeholders
Structured problem-solving; program management
Strong communication

Qualifications & Certifications
Bachelor's degree (relevant discipline); MBA preferred
What's in it for you?
An opportunity to work on with key G2000 clients
Potential to with leaders in strategy, industry experts, enterprise function practitioners and, business intelligence professionals to shape and recommend innovative solutions that leverage emerging technologies.
Ability to embed into everything-from how you service your clients to how you operate as a responsible professional.
Personalized training modules to develop your to grow your skills, industry knowledge and capabilities
Opportunity to thrive in a that is committed to accelerate equality for all. Engage in boundaryless collaboration across the entire organization.

Accenture is a leading global professional services company, providing a broad range of services and solutions in strategy, consulting, digital, technology and operations. Combining unmatched experience and specialized skills across more than 40 industries and all business functions - underpinned by the world's largest delivery network - Accenture works at the intersection of business and technology to help clients improve their performance and create sustainable value for their stakeholders. With 569,000 people serving clients in more than 120 countries, Accenture drives innovation to improve the way the world works and lives. Visit us at
About Accenture Strategy & Consulting:
Accenture Strategy shapes our clients' future, combining deep business insight with the understanding of how technology will impact industry and business models. Our focus on issues such as digital disruption, redefining competitiveness, operating and business models as well as the workforce of the future helps our clients find future value and growth in a digital world. Today, digital is changing the way organizations engage with their employees, business partners, customers and communities. This is our unique differentiator. To bring this global perspective to our clients, Accenture Strategy's services include those provided by our Capability Network - a distributed management consulting organization that provides management consulting and strategy expertise across the client lifecycle. Role & responsibilities
Playwright QA Automation Engineer with experience in designing, developing, and maintaining automated test frameworks for web applications. Skilled in Playwright, end-to-end testing, API validation, regression testing, and CI/CD integration to ensure high-quality software delivery. Prior experience in the Hospitality, Travel & Leisure, or Hotel Booking domain will be an added advantage.
We are seeking a Playwright QA Automation Engineer to drive quality assurance initiatives through test automation. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with Playwright, strong programming skills, and expertise in building scalable automation frameworks. The role involves collaborating with cross-functional teams to ensure application quality, reliability, and performance throughout the software development lifecycle.

Preferred candidate profile
Develop, maintain, and execute automated test scripts using Playwright.
Design and implement scalable test automation frameworks and reusable components.
Perform functional, regression, smoke, integration, and end-to-end testing.
Execute cross-browser testing across Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit.
Validate APIs and backend integrations.
Analyze test results, identify defects, and work with development teams for resolution.
Integrate automated test suites with CI/CD pipelines.
Participate in Agile ceremonies and contribute to test planning and estimation.
Prepare test reports and provide quality metrics to stakeholders.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
5+ years of experience in QA Automation Testing.
Hands-on experience with Playwright and TypeScript/JavaScript (preferred) or Java.
Strong understanding of software testing methodologies and automation best practices.
Experience with REST API testing and tools such as Postman.
Familiarity with Git, Azure DevOps, Jenkins, or similar CI/CD tools.
Knowledge of Agile/Scrum development methodologies.
Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and communication skills.

Description:
#ACN Song GN Reinvention Services Customer Service Retail Service Reinvention Manager
Job Title Retail Service Reinvention Manager
Management Level: L07 Manager
Location: Bangalore, Gurgaon, Mumbai (India; global remit)
Experience: 10+ Years (L07)
Must have skills: Retail Service Reinvention / Customer Service Strategy Transformation; a blend of industry and consulting experience with deep understanding of the end-to-end retail value chain and how it drives service demand, volume and exceptions; experience shaping AI-native / agentic service operating models.
The Practice A Brief Sketch
The practice works with clients across their marketing, commerce, sales and service functions to reinvent how they engage customers. As part of the Reinvention Services Customer Service team, you will help the worlds leading retailers transform service from a reactive, cost-driven function into an intelligence-led, AI-native capability that senses signals in real time, resolves issues before they escalate, and continuously improves from every interaction across the shopper, store, supplier and fulfilment ecosystem driving customer value, growth, margin, operational efficiency and enterprise resilience.
Job summary
As a Retail Service Reinvention Senior Manager / Associate Director, you will advise C-suite executives, shape AI-native service operating models, and lead end-to-end transformation for the worlds leading retailers. Reporting to the Customer Service Managing Director, you will build and lead a team of Managers, Consultants and Analysts and carry accountability for generating business development opportunities upwards of USD 4M. The role requires a strong blend of retail domain expertise, consulting leadership, end-to-end value chain understanding, executive stakeholder management, and business development capability to shape and deliver scalable, future-ready retail service solutions.
Roles and responsibilities
Service Strategy Advisory
Define enterprise and omnichannel service strategy across the shopper, store, supplier and fulfilment ecosystems.
Shape AI-native service vision, target operating models and multi-year transformation roadmaps.
Develop business cases, prioritize investment and establish value-realization frameworks.
Advise boards and C-suite on where to sequence quick wins against enterprise-scale change.
Experience Design
Map end-to-end journeys for shoppers (order, delivery, returns, loyalty, complaints), associates (store, picker, contact centre) and suppliers (onboarding, purchase orders, invoicing, disputes).
Blueprint services across people, process, data and technology layers.
Identify moments of truth and design service recovery for stock-outs, failed deliveries, substitutions and disputed refunds.
Define channel strategy spanning mobile app, web, WhatsApp, voice, social, store desk and associate/picker devices.
Operating Model Process Transformation
Design target operating models spanning shopper services, supplier services, store workforce services, and fulfilment/ecosystem services.
Design the workforce across shoppers, store associates, pickers and inventory teams, contact-centre specialists and leads, supplier account teams, and delivery partners/dispatchers.
Establish governance frameworks policy and business rules, approval/escalation thresholds, SLAs and entitlements, and human-in-the-loop checkpoints.
Build KPI and performance frameworks tied to customer value, growth, margin, operational efficiency and enterprise resilience outcomes.
Technology AI Transformation
Set CRM and CCaaS platform strategy (Genesys, NICE, Salesforce Service Cloud, Five9, Amazon Connect).
Shape knowledge and case management (ServiceNow, Zendesk).
Design conversational and agentic AI (Kore.ai, Dialogflow) intent detection, content enrichment, knowledge graphs and decisioning/policy engines.
Integrate across order, store and supply-chain systems of record (OMS, POS, WMS, TMS, ERP, supplier/EDI portals) and IoT/GPS-enabled field and delivery tracking.
Build service analytics, predictive/prescriptive models and root-cause analysis capability.
Human + Agentic Operations
Design hybrid workforce models blending advisors, associates, AI copilots and autonomous agents across the shopper, supplier, store and fulfilment domains.
Design agents for high-volume service capabilities order status, substitutions, returns, refunds, delivery orchestration, supplier collaboration and dispute resolution.
Lead change management, upskilling and adoption programmes for frontline and support teams.
Establish AI governance, ethics and bias controls, and ongoing model/agent performance oversight.
Enterprise Transformation Delivery
Lead end-to-end programmes from strategy through implementation, adoption and value realisation.
Orchestrate multi-workstream delivery across business, experience, operations, technology and data/AI teams.
Manage executive steering committees and track value against committed business cases.
Practice Building
Develop market-leading thought leadership and intellectual property.
Build reusable methods, accelerators, assets and AI workflows for retail reinvention services.
Coach and mentor consulting teams.
Support business development and strategic pursuits collaborating with Song leadership to identify new opportunities and with Songs Consulting, Technology and Data AI teams for delivery.
Professional Technical Skills
Deep expertise in grocery, apparel or large omnichannel retail, with working knowledge of the end-to-end value chain merchandising and assortment planning, inventory and price management, promotions execution, digital commerce, in-store operations, supplier and partner operations, and last-mile fulfilment and how each stage drives customer demand, service volume and service exceptions.
First-hand practitioner experience inside leading grocery, apparel or omnichannel retailers (not advisory-only) having lived these operations, partnered with frontline teams, and redesigned them at enterprise scale.
Proven track record across service strategy advisory, experience design, operating model transformation, technology AI transformation, and enterprise delivery; consulting background is valuable but strong industry leadership experience counts equally.
Hands-on shopper/customer service experience across the lifecycle: order status and delivery-exception handling; substitutions, out-of-stock and refund/credit resolution; returns and reverse-logistics servicing; loyalty, rewards and membership servicing; complaint, feedback and social/review response; and multi-channel delivery (mobile app, web, WhatsApp, voice, social) with consistent resolution regardless of entry channel.
Supplier and partner service experience: onboarding, compliance and account management; forecast, purchase-order and inventory collaboration; quality issues, disputes and score-carding; invoice, payment and reconciliation servicing; and supplier/partner portals, EDI exchanges and account-management workflows.
Store and workforce service experience: inventory accuracy, price integrity and promotion execution at store level; pick, pack and in-store fulfilment; store-to-contact-centre escalation and case hand-off; associate empowerment tools (store apps, picker/associate devices, knowledge assistants); and workforce scheduling, service standards and frontline performance management.
Fulfilment and ecosystem service experience: delivery orchestration, routing and ETA/live tracking; failed-delivery, missed-slot and delivery-recovery workflows; reverse logistics and returns-to-warehouse operations; driver, dispatcher and 3PL partner management; and last-mile SLAs, on-time performance and partner score-carding.
Working knowledge of core retail service processes order-to-delivery, returns refunds, complaint case management, store-to-contact-centre escalation, substitution/refund workflows and supplier dispute resolution with the SLAs and benchmarks that define operational excellence, and fluency in how cases move end-to-end (detect, triage/categorise, route/assign, investigate/enrich, decide/approve, orchestrate, execute/communicate, confirm/close).
Exposure to the retail service technology and AI stack: CRM CCaaS (Genesys, NICE, Salesforce Service Cloud, Five9, Amazon Connect); knowledge case management (ServiceNow, Zendesk); conversational and agentic AI (Kore.ai, Dialogflow); systems of record (OMS, POS, WMS, TMS, ERP, PIM/MDM, pricing and promotions engines); supplier/EDI portals and IoT/GPS-enabled tracking; and the underlying AI/ML stack (intent detection, content enrichment, knowledge graphs, policy/rules engines, predictive/prescriptive models, decisioning/optimisation and root-cause analytics).
Experience designing target operating models that combine human and AI/agentic capacity reusable service capability design, hybrid workforce design, and governance/guardrail frameworks (policy business rules, approvals escalation, human-in-the-loop controls, SLAs entitlements, privacy consent, security access, compliance audit, model/agent performance governance, ethics bias controls, and data quality traceability).
Demonstrated track record of driving measurable outcomes customer value (NPS/CSAT, trust, advocacy); growth (repeat purchase rate, average order value, attach rate, customer lifetime value); service quality productivity (first-contact and overall resolution, reduced cost-to-serve and contact volume, higher associate productivity); and availability resilience (in-stock rate, on-time delivery/payment, margin protection, and supply/compliance resilience).
Executive stakeholder management, communication and storytelling; ability to build and defend a business case at board level; fluency across business, experience, operations, technology and AI/data teams; and comfort translating complex operating models into a clear enterprise narrative.
Additional information
Experience in retail, customer service or enterprise service transformation, including large-scale programmes delivered end-to-end from strategy through implementation; the ideal candidate blends industry and consulting experience.
Reports to the Customer Service Managing Director; builds and leads a team of Managers, Consultants and Analysts, with accountability for generating business development opportunities upwards of USD 4M.
Employment type: Permanent. Work arrangement: remote / hybrid / onsite, flexed to client and project needs; travel expectation varies by client engagement.
MBA or postgraduate qualification in retail preferred. Relevant certifications a plus CCXP, Six Sigma/Lean, ITIL, PMP, CSCP/APICS, Agile or Design Thinking, or platform certifications (Genesys, NICE, Salesforce).



Qualification
Experience in Retail industry (physical + digital) - Grocery, Apparel or large omnichannel retail sector experience
Good to have skills: relevant certifications (CCXP, Six Sigma/Lean, ITIL, PMP, CSCP/APICS, Agile or Design Thinking) and platform certifications (Genesys, NICE, Salesforce).
Educational Qualification: MBA or postgraduate qualification in retail preferred; MBA or equivalent degree in Business, Strategy, Sales Marketing.

The Strategy & Consulting Global Network Song Practice| Marketing Transformation |


Life Science Marketing Manager






Join our team of Strategy & Consulting Global Network Song who solve customer - facing challenges at clients spanning sales, service and marketing to accelerate business change.







Practice Strategy & Consulting Global Network Song I Areas of Work:Digital Marketing, Creative Strategy, Brand Strategy, Campaign Management, Next Best Action Marketing, Mar-Tech Strategy, Customer Experience & Journey Development | Level

Manager | Location:Delhi, Mumbai, Bangalore , Gurgaon, Hyderabad | Years of Exp8 + years







Explore an Exciting Career at Accenture


Are you passionate about scaling businesses using in-depth frameworks and techniques to solve customer facing challenges? Do you want to design, build and implement strategies to enhance business performance? Does working in an inclusive and collaborative environment spark your interest?


Then, this is the right place for you! Welcome to a host of exciting global opportunities within Accenture's Strategy & Consulting Global Network Song practice.




The Practice A Brief Sketch The Strategy & Consulting Global Network Song practice is aligned to the Global Network Song Practice of Accenture and works with clients across their marketing, sales and services functions. As part of the team, you will provide transformation services driven by key offerings like Living Marketing, Connected Commerce and Next-Generation Customer Care. These services help our clients become living businesses by optimizing their marketing, sales and customer service strategy, thereby driving cost reduction, revenue enhancement, customer satisfaction and impacting front end business metrics in a positive manner.







The Life Sciences Marketing Senior Manager position is within the Marketing Transformation vertical of Accenture GN Song. The individual would work at the heart of the top global Life Sciences (Pharmaceuticals, Biotechnology and Medical Technology) and would collaborate on innovative projects while bringing in deep industry knowledge and Marketing skills.







The key responsibilities will include


Strong project management skills to plan, execute, and deliver content initiatives successfully. This includes managing timelines, budgets, resources, and coordinating cross-functional teams. An analytical & data driven mindset to drive result-oriented decisions


Exposure and experience in roles across the marketing value chain, primarily in the life sciences or allied industries as detailed out below.







Consulting & Advisory S ervice







Market Research


Analysis and assessment of the pharmaceutical market across disease areas and opportunity identification for new launches, indication expansions,identify emerging trends, competitive landscapes, and new opportunities within the life sciences sector.

Competitor benchmarking, patient journey mapping, segmentation & targeting







Digital Marketing



Develop E2E strategy & campaigns:Liaise withkey client stakeholders in the marketing teams to design strategies for omni-channel marketing campaigns.Lead development of content marketing, social media, and web engagement programs for the client, ensuring that they are aligned with the overall content strategy. In-depth knowledge of branding, creative development and execution, digital marketing, and campaign deployment and optimization



Provide expertiseon Content design and campaign execution:Able to provide a perspective on identification and selectionof the right digital channels and content types based on campaign objectives. Able to understand client requirements based on their briefs & ideate to appropriate creativedesigns.Support end to end campaign execution and suggest ways for optimization.










Marketing Technology



Leadplatform assessment and solutiondesign :Understand the

marketing value chain across process, technology & people. Conduct a thorough assessment, propose a solution along with an operating model & define KPIs for different marketing technologies Adobe / SF / Veeva. Have an understanding of the regulatory, compliance and governance landscape in the industry and build frameworks for scale up.



MarTech Consulting Projects:Lead projects focusing on optimizing the MarTech stack and develop use cases to improve utilization of existing MarTech stack. Research, evaluate and recommend new martech systems and suppliers. Keep a holistic understanding of existing and upcoming martech platforms and how they connect into the broader marketing technology landscape.



Tools & Platforms:Hands on experience on Mar-tech tools such as Adobe campaign, Marketo, Adobe, Cloud, Google Marketing platform, Google Ads, Pega decisioning, SFMC etc.



Value realization:Crafting a value tree and developing business casesfor implementation and scale up




Gen AI

Be aware of the latest AI developments in the Life Science industry and be able to co-create customized solutions for the client to meet their objectives.

Job Title -

Instructional Design - Analyst

- T&O- (S&C GN)

Management Level:11 - Analyst

Location:Gurugram, Bangalore, Mumbai, Pune, Hyderabad, Kolkata and Chennai

Must have skills:

Instructional Design OR Storyboarding OR Articulate Storyline


Good to have skills:Whatfix, walk me, ADDIE model

Experience:Minimum 2-3 year(s) of experience is required


Educational Qualification:Any Bachelors Fulltime

Job

Summary:

As a Talent & Organization (T&O) professional in the S&C Global Network, youll help clients across a variety of industries in the areas of Learning Design and Development, Change Management and HR Transformation. Youll use your expertise to develop exciting new learning strategies and solutions. Youll help clients manage organizational change and smooth the transition process. Essentially, youll be part of the team that is creating the workforce of the future!

Roles & Responsibilities:



Although no two days at Accenture are the same, as an Instructional Designer Analyst in our T&O practice, a typical day might include:
Support team/ project through various phases of learning design and development based on the identified business problem, audience profile, and evaluation methodology.
Help develop standards and templates for the proposed learning solution.
Create effective training materials mapping the clients needs using learning modalities such as Instructor-led training, Web-based training, virtual Instructor-led training, simulations, videos, interactive learning nuggets, and performance support materials.
Collaborate with stakeholders such as Subject Matter Experts, team leads, media and technology teams to support iterations to the learning material for improved business outcomes.
Creatively visualize the content and work with the visual design team to convey the course content/key messages impactfully.
Write impactful storyboards by understanding the raw content and repurposing it based on audience, content, modality, and other considerations.
Perform quality checks on the training deliverables to meet the standard quality benchmarks.
Bring your best skills forward to excel in the role:
Proficiency in content development and instructional design, research and information gathering, content analysis, knowledge of latest trends in the learning industry.
Understanding of industry standard design/rapid authoring tools such as Articulate/Captivate/ Lectora/ Camtasia/ SAP Enable Now/WalkMe and be comfortable with client proprietary authoring tools. An ideal candidate should be well-versed with the technical functionalities and limitations of these tools.
Work in a problem-solving global environment with Cross cultural competence.
Possess excellent interpersonal and writing skills with a strong business acumen.


Qualification

Professional & Technical

Skills:

Graduate/Post Graduate in any specialization, preferably Journalism / Mass Communication / English Literature /Advertising / Public Relations
Desired work experience:2-3 years in instructional design and content development with an understanding of training and design strategy
Adept at gathering and understanding source content to create engaging courses based on the target audience
Experience in applying proven learning methodologies and emerging technologies for adult learning



Additional Information:
A transparent career path designed for rapid career progression
A supportive culture that is serious about training, coaching and continuous learning
A global network where only state-of-the-art tools and technologies will do
A bighearted environment with opportunities to give back to our local communities
An opportunity to work on with key G2000 clients
Potential to with leaders in strategy, industry experts, enterprise function practitioners and, business intelligence professionals to shape and recommend innovative solutions that leverage emerging technologies.
Ability to embed into everythingfrom how you service your clients to how you operate as a responsible professional.
Personalized training modules to develop your to grow your skills, industry knowledge and capabilities
Opportunity to thrive in a that is committed to accelerate equality for all. Engage in boundaryless collaboration across the entire organization.

Job Title - GN - SONG - MT - Hyperpersonalization - Analyst

Management Level 11 - Analyst

LocationGurgaon, Mumbai, Bangalore

Must have skills Banking, Fintech Industries

Good to have skills Marketing

ExperienceOverall experience of 2+ years with at least 1 year of experience in the Banking/Fintech domains, delivering insights with a focus on designing & executing customer-centric initiatives.


Educational QualificationPost-Graduation (Preferably MBA)

Job

Summary You will work closely with our clients as consulting professionals who design, build and implement initiatives that can help deliver hyper-personalized experiences for their customers and enhance business performance within Banking and Fintech landscape.

Roles & Responsibilities
Collaboration and Stakeholder Management

o Collaborate with various client teams (including marketing, sales, and product) to align customer value management strategies with the respective teams' and overall organization's business goals.

o Communicate effectively with internal ACN leaders, SMEs and teams to ensure a cohesive and client-centric approach.

o Manage relationships with key partners to ensure compliance and smooth execution of all partner-related initiatives.

Data Analysis

o Monitor trends to identify anomalies, promptly flagging them to stakeholders and ensuring follow-up to resolution.

o Analyze data to uncover growth opportunities and recommend potential improvements.

o Track performance metrics and marketing interventions, highlighting key insights and resolving critical issues to support business objectives .

Project Management

o Plan , execute, and oversee projects, ensuring timely delivery and alignment with business goals.

o Develop and maintain project plans, timelines, and budgets, proactively addressing risks and mitigating issues.

o Monitor project performance, report progress to stakeholders, and implement process improvements for efficiency.

Retention / Churn Reduction Strategies

o Design and implement customer retention programs that are aligned to the unique challenges and opportunities of the Banking/Fintech/Insurance sectors to reduce churn and increase customer lifetime value leveraging data and analytical models.

o Work closely with product and marketing teams to create hyper-personalized campaigns and promotions to engage and retain customers.

Cross-Sell and Upsell Initiatives

o Identify opportunities for cross-selling and upselling based on segment-level behavior and preferences tailored to the banking / e-commerce / retail sectors.

Business Development

o Create business cases, solution deals and develop proposals to bring the best of Accenture's capabilities to clients.

 Qualification 

Professional & Technical

Skills:
Strong analytical skills and data-driven mindset to drive results-oriented decisions.

In-depth knowledge of industry from banking / fintech.

Strategic Thinking - Capability to align projects and processes with long-term business goals.

Crisis / Risk Management - Ability to effectively manage and lead during crises or challenging project situations by implementing contingency plans

Strong understanding of marketing processes & operating models

Good project management skills – The ability to plan, execute, and oversee projects to ensure that projects are completed on time, within budget, and meeting the specified goals.

Additional skills

o Excellent oral and written communication skills

o Proven success in navigating global matrixed environments and / or experience in client facing roles

o Ability to work effectively in a remote, virtual, fast-paced & unstructured global environment


Additional Information


An opportunity to work on transformative projects with key G2000 clients


Potential to Co-create with leaders in strategy, industry experts, enterprise function practitioners and, business intelligence professionals to shape and recommend innovative solutions that leverage emerging technologies.


Ability to embed responsible business into everything"”from how you service your clients to how you operate as a responsible professional.



Personalized training modules to develop your strategy & consulting acumen to grow your skills, industry knowledge and capabilities


Opportunity to thrive in a culture that is committed to accelerate equality for all. Engage in boundaryless collaboration across the entire organization.

Job Title: Python Developer _Data Test Engineer/Backoffice (Associate/Sr Associate/ Delivery Lead/ Manager)
Location: Gurgaon/Bangalore/Pune
Work hours: 10am to 7pm IST
Department: Data Technology Services
Experience Level : 4-10 years
Job Purpose
Were hiring a hands-on engineer to design and build a reusable Pythonframeworks that spans front-end integrations, backend/middle-tier services, andcloud execution. Youll translate complex, post-trade data flows into robustdata models, stored procedures, and regression automation, and ownCI/CDincluding scripts to run AutoSys/batch jobs and stored procs acrossenvironments. The ideal candidate brings pragmatic engineering discipline,capital-markets data intuition, and a builders mindset.
Key Responsibilities
Collaborate with BAs, QEs, and traders/ops to clarify requirements and codesign testable acceptance criteria; maintain living technicaldocumentation and run-books.
Champion reusability: templates, golden pipelines, sample datasets, and coding standards that scale across engagements
Key Competencies
410 years of hands-on softwareengineering with Python (incl. packaging, virtual envs, unit/integrationtesting); strong use of libraries such as pandas, SQL Alchemy/ pyodbc, andasyncio /celery for pipelines and services
Expert SQL skills and stored-proc development (SQL Server/Oracle/Postgres), query tuning, and execution-plan analysis for largedatasets.
Proven experience designing CI/CD pipelines and automating promotion (code + data + DB objects) with Azure DevOps/Jenkins/GitLab; strongGit practices and code-review hygiene.
Comfort with schedulers (AutoSys/Control-M/Airflow) and shell/Python scripting for batch or chestration; familiarity with secretsmanagement and environment configuration.
Domain understanding of post-trade data flows and how to encode the m into repeatable regression checks.

Educational Qualification:Any Fulltime Masters degree/ MBA

Job

Summary:

HR Strategy & Transformation is a team of HR Professionals who specializes in select areas within HR to help our clients target and deliver values for their HR and Talent investments using a distributed delivery model, and can be deployed globally - onsite, near shore and offshore.


Roles & Responsibilities:
HR Operating Model HR Op Model Design, Organization Design, Capability Enhancement
Competency Based Talent Management Competency Modelling, Design, Assessment and Integration with HR & Talent processes
Workforce Management Workforce effectiveness analysis, planning and optimization
HR Shared Services HR Shared service Assessment, Design and Deployment
Process Excellence HR & Talent Processes design, innovation & Implementation
HR SaaS Implementation SaaS Process design, configuration, training & Change Enablement


Qualification

Professional & Technical

Knowledge and application of Business Process Re-engineering
HR and TM Process Design experience
HR system implementation experience
Conduct HR Policy Design and harmonization
Project Management of large HRT engagements
Design and deployment of HR Service Delivery Model across diverse set of organizations
Desired knowledge of Cloud HR Platforms (SuccessFactors/Workday/Oracle/SAP)
Knowledge of outsourcing business model of key HR processes.
Talent Management Processes including Talent Acquisition and Performance Management and Rewards.
Talent Availability and Competency Modeling and Assessment
Sourcing Strategy, Recruitment Process Optimization
Performance Measurement, Rewards Audit and Strategic Role Assessment
Minimum 3 plus years of work experience after masters degree and significant years of experience in Human Resource Transformation and Talent Management related projects is desired.

Role Summary
Support fund accounting, financial reporting, investor reporting, and operational activities across private equity funds, co-investment vehicles, SPVs, GP entities, and management companies.
Perform accounting, reconciliations, capital activity processing, and quarter-end close within a complex alternative investment environment.
Partner with finance, fund administration, audit, tax, compliance, and investor relations teams to ensure accurate reporting and operational excellence.

Prepare and post journal entries independently using supporting schedules, transaction documentation, and bank statements.
Perform bank reconciliations and investigate outstanding reconciling items.

Required Experience
5+ years of experience in Private Equity Fund Accounting, Fund Administration, Fund Operations, or Alternative Investments.
Strong understanding of private equity fund structures, partnership accounting, capital activity, and investor allocations.
Proven experience preparing journal entries independently using supporting documentation and bank statements.
Strong understanding of end-to-end quarter-end close and financial statement preparation.
Experience with reconciliations, expense allocations, accruals, and general ledger accounting.
Exposure to investor reporting, fund reporting, and audit support activities.
Advanced Excel and strong analytical skills.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management capabilities.
Preferred Experience
Experience with Investran.
Exposure to flagship buyout funds, co-investment structures, SPVs, and management company accounting.
Experience supporting investor reporting and regulatory reporting requirements.
Experience working with fund administrators, auditors, tax advisors, and investor relations teams.
Exposure to process improvement and automation initiatives.

Description:
Tech Transformation delivery leader- Associate Director
Join our team in Technology Strategy & Transformation for an exciting career opportunity to drive large-scale complex AI led Technology Transformation programmes for our most strategic clients across the globe. You will lead the execution of enterprise-wide transformation initiatives that drive strategic business outcomes, operational excellence, and sustainable value creation across Technology Modernization, AI Enterprise Transformation, M&A and Enterprise Agility pillars.
Practice: Technology Strategy & Transformation, Global Network
Areas of Work: Tech Transformation delivery leader
Level: Associate Director
Location: Bangalore/Gurugram/Mumbai/Pune/Chennai/Kolkata/Hyderabad
Years of Exp: 17+ years
Explore an Exciting Career at Accenture
Do you thrive on leading complex transformations, improving SDLC using AI, Mainframe Modernisation, Data & AI, building domain driven Architecture and high-stakes transformation programmes? Are you a delivery leader who is passionate about complex Technology Delivery and helping CIOs, CTOs and business executives drive technology change that delivers real commercial outcomes? Are you passionate about being part of an inclusive, diverse and collaborative culture?
If yes, this is the right opportunity for you. Join Accenture Technology Strategy & Transformation practice and lead and deliver complex, high-value transformation portfolios for global clients. Working at C-suite level, you will take Revenue (P&L) accountability for accounts and portfolios, managing budgets from $5M to $30M, scaling delivery organisations, and ensuring transformation investments generate lasting revenue and business value. You will govern multi-programme portfolios, drive commercial growth, and serve as a trusted strategic advisor on delivery and transformation at the highest levels of client organisations.
The Practice - A Brief Sketch
Technology Strategy & Transformation Practice is a part of Digital Core Reinvention Partner and focuses on our clients' most strategic priorities. We help clients achieve growth and efficiency through technology transformation initiatives, aimed at modernising delivery, improving operational performance and generating measurable enterprise value.
We provide you with a strong learning environment, deep-rooted in Technology Strategy, large-scale programme delivery and business transformation, where you will work with key global clients to drive the next evolution of enterprise technology change. As part of this high-performing team, you will lead organisations through complex transformation journeys - from translating transformation vision into measurable business outcomes through disciplined execution across global teams, functions, and delivery partners. This is a delivery leadership role with direct accountability for transformation outcomes These are some of the initiatives you will support:
Enterprise Transformation Portfolio Leadership:Own and lead a portfolio of strategic transformation initiatives aligned to enterprise priorities and growth objectives, ensure transformation programs deliver measurable business outcomes, operational improvements, customer impact, and financial value. End-to-End Delivery Accountability:Assume full accountability for transformation execution from mobilization through implementation, stabilization, and value realization - including complex systems implementation, Mainframe Modernisation, and cloud-native migration programmes, lead multiple concurrent, large-scale transformation programs with significant organizational, operational, and technology complexity.Revenue Management and Financial Governance:Carry P&L accountability for accounts and portfolios with budgets of $5M-$30M; manage actuals, forecasts, margin protection, revenue recognition and commercial change control; identify and drive revenue growth opportunities and account expansions AI & Intelligent Transformation Leadership:Lead and manage scaled deployment of Agentic AI, Generative AI, automation, and digital workforce solutions as part of enterprise transformation programs, establish governance, risk management, and adoption frameworks for responsible deployment of AI-enabled transformation initiatives. Integration and Dependency Management:Govern complex multi-programme integration across internal teams, client stakeholders and third-party vendors; manage interdependencies, interface points, data migration streams and system integration programmes to ensure coherent, risk-managed portfolio delivery; lead cloud-native and API-led architecture transitions within delivery programmes Value Realisation and Benefits Framework:Track measurable transformation outcomes across the portfolio - cost reduction, revenue growth, operational efficiency, risk reduction and speed-to-market; report on value delivered at board level Global Delivery Leadership:Act as a trusted partner to C-suite executives and senior business leaders, lead executive governance forums and transformation steering committees, communicate complex delivery and business challenges clearly, providing actionable recommendations and mitigation strategies. Executive Stakeholder Leadership:Shape CxO narratives, transformation roadmaps and investment choices at portfolio level; advise on vendor strategy and scale-up plans; lead deal-shaping and account growth, representing Accenture externally and contributing to practice development and market offerings


Role Summary
As Delivery Lead Associate Director, you are accountable for the overall delivery performance of an account or portfolio of transformation programmes with budgets of $5M-$30M. You will lead high-impact delivery for programs on a scale, carry P&L accountability, and align outcomes to strategic client objectives. You will engage at C-suite level, govern Senior Manager delivery leads, drive revenue management and commercial growth, embed continuous improvement, and make decisions that carry major, lasting impact across the organisation.



Key Responsibilities

Own delivery accountability across an account or portfolio of programmes;


Define and enforce portfolio-level delivery standards, governance frameworks, and quality controls; lead the introduction and embedment of Agile delivery models, CICD practices and modern ways of working within client organisations.


Lead executive-level governance forums and Steering Committees; act as executive delivery sponsor with the client.


Manage relationships at C-suite and board level; act as a trusted strategic advisor on delivery and transformation.


Drive Agentic AI-powered transformation; articulate and demonstrate prior experience using Agentic AI in transformation contexts to clients and internal stakeholders, building confidence and adoption.


Accountability for the account P&L manage budgets of $5M-$30M, protect margin, drive revenue recognition and pursue revenue growth opportunities.


Shape and negotiate commercial terms; manage material changes to contract scope and commercial structure.


Manage and facilitate the governance of large programs comprising 50-150+ FTEs including mentoring and coaching people in the programs.


Manage risk, escalation decisions, and demand/supply balance across the portfolio.


Lead identification and scaling of continuous improvement and delivery innovation initiatives across the portfolio.


Lead deal-shaping and proposal strategy for significant account expansions and new pursuits.


Represent Accenture externally; contribute to practice development, capability strategy, and market offerings.


Qualification

What We're Looking For

17-20 years' total experience; 3-5 years proven experience managing and delivering complex portfolio of transformation programmes with budgets of $5M-$30M.


Proven ability to govern complex, multi-programme transformation portfolios in a large global services environment, with direct accountability for delivery, revenue and commercial outcomes.


Demonstrated track record of C-suite stakeholder engagement, influence, and relationship management.

Description:
Position Title-Delivery Lead- Salesforce Business Partner
Department-Sales operations
Location-Gurgaon/ Bangalore/ Colombo
Position reports to-Associate Director - Sales Operations / Global Sales Operations
Job Summary
To provide hands-on ownership of Acuity's enterprise Salesforce ecosystem across user support, platform administration, data management, integration, enhancements and user enablement. The role will translate business needs into secure, scalable CRM solutions; strengthen data quality; support responsible AI adoption; and turn Salesforce data into actionable commercial insight.
Another important angle will be to improve forecasting accuracy by developing repeatable, data-led approaches that use opening pipeline position, conversion, win rates, sales cycle dynamics and deal level signals to better anticipate quarterly and year-end sales outcomes.
Responsibilities
Business-facing support and ownership: Act as the primary contact for Salesforce incidents, service requests, enhancements and user queries; manage intake, prioritization, communication, resolution and escalation; provide training, release updates and clear documentation.
Salesforce administration: Manage users, licenses, profiles, permission sets, roles, sharing settings and access reviews; configure Flows, approvals, validation and assignment rules, record types, page layouts, Dynamic Forms and Lightning pages; maintain reports, dashboards, queues and notifications.
Platform development and continuous improvement: Apply configuration-first thinking while using Apex, Lightning Web Components, SOQL/SOSL and APIs where appropriate; troubleshoot defects, address root causes, reduce technical debt and coordinate environments, deployments and post-release validation.
Integrations and data management: Support Salesforce integrations with ERP, billing, CPQ, e-signature, marketing and other enterprise platforms; oversee APIs, authentication, middleware, monitoring and error handling; lead migration, cleansing, deduplication, reconciliation, backup and validation activities.
AI, analytics and forecasting: Build operational and executive dashboards covering pipeline, conversion, sales, forecasting, revenue, customers, adoption and service performance; establish repeatable predictive methods to forecast quarterly and year-end landing positions using opening pipeline, stage conversion, win rates, sales-cycle velocity, slippage and deal-level risk; identify and deliver high-value use cases using Agent force, Einstein and related capabilities.
Governance, risk and documentation: Maintain effective release, change, backup, testing and deployment controls; support audits and ITGC requirements; maintain solution designs, SOPs, configuration inventories, deployment records and user guidance; coordinate vendors while retaining clear internal accountability.
Stakeholder partnership: Work closely with Sales, Finance, Marketing, Billing, Delivery, IT and external partners to support connected Lead-to-Order and Order-to-Cash processes, including merger and acquisition initiatives.
Key Competencies
Customer and support orientation: Approachable and accountable front line for Salesforce users.
Technical depth: Strong knowledge of Sales Cloud, Flow, Apex, Lightning Web Components, SOQL/SOSL, APIs, testing and deployment, balancing configuration-first thinking with development and integration capability.
Commercial forecasting and analytical judgement: Converts CRM data into reliable forecasts, early-warning indicators and practical actions for Sales Leadership; challenges assumptions and explains variance clearly.
AI and automation mindset: Identifies AI and automation opportunities that simplify day to day business processes
Ownership and delivery: Takes responsibility from problem definition through design, delivery, validation, adoption and support.
Communication and stakeholder management: Make complex principles easy to understand and explain technical and analytical topics clearly to users, technical teams and senior leadership.
Continuous improvement: Identifies opportunities for automation, simplification, innovation and improved user experience.
Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in computer science preferred but Information Systems, Engineering, Analytics or a related discipline considered too, Salesforce Administrator or Advanced Administrator certification required, with Sales Cloud Consultant, Platform Developer, Omni studio, CPQ, platform data architect or Agent force certification advantageous.

Description:
Role Purpose
The Software Procurement intern is responsible for overseeing the end-to-end lifecycle of global software assets, software procurement processes, and supplier contracts at Thoughtworks. This role ensures cost efficiency, streamlined workflows, timely supplier payments, regulatory compliance, and seamless cross-functional collaboration across GITS, InfoSec, Finance, Accounts Payable, and Legal departments.
Key Responsibilities
Learn and work closely with Software Procurement Lead on below mention responsibilities:
1. Procurement Operations & Purchase Management
End-to-End Workflow Optimisation: Direct and analyse the efficiency of software procurement processes, from request ingestion to inventory updating
Coupa Platform Management: Initiate supplier onboarding forms, monitor supplier statuses until active, and create/publish Purchase Orders (POs) and Virtual Contracts in Coupa
Requisition Approvals: Act as the designated Global Procurement Approver and authorise high-value requisitions (e.g., JetBrains, LinkedIn Sales Navigator) on behalf of the Global Software Lead.
Manage Credit Card Spend: Manage monthly or annual subscriptions that are on credit card and submit weekly expense reports in Expensify; allocating cost accurately.Manage multiple domain registrars: Register and renew domains, working closely with LegalAWS account provisioning: Work closely with CloudOps team on provisioning / deprovisioning AWS accounts including management of login credentials
2. Vendor Relationship & Renewal Management
Vendor Coordination: Manage direct communication with major global SaaS vendors (e.g., JetBrains, LinkedIn, Snowflake, Sisense, Pearson VUE) regarding quotes, order forms, and payment terms.
Renewal Pipeline Tracking: Partner with external procurement platforms to monitor renewal deadlines, evaluate license needs, coordinate stakeholder feedback, and schedule retirements of legacy software.
3. Financial & Budget Governance
Invoice & Payment Resolution: Partner closely with Accounts Payable (AP) to verify receipts, resolve billing discrepancies, split invoices manually, and escalate critical past-due accounts.
Budgeting & Cost Allocation: Monitor license allocations and manage pay-as-you-go or credit-based models to optimize spend and ensure unused credits do not expire.
Cost Distribution Mapping: Distribute software costs accurately among business units, regions (DEC/POH), and specific accounts or departments by aligning data from Jigsaw and other tools.
4. Software Entitlement & Compliance Management
Software Asset Management (SAM): Track active software assets and license assignments via ServiceNow (SNOW). Requires close coordination with multiple teams.
Risk & Regulatory Compliance: Collaborate with GITS, InfoSec, and regional legal leads to verify software compliance, evaluate export regulations (such as the Remote Access Security Act), and implement geographic usage restrictions.
Required Skills & Qualifications
Learn and build following skills (tools/applications and Soft skills:
Procurement Platforms: High proficiency in Coupa Software, ServiceNow, Expensify and Zendesk.
Negotiation & Financial Acumen: Strong capability in analyzing pricing models (pay-as-you-go, subscription, credit-based, or enterprise commitments) and driving cost splits across departments.
Collaboration & Stakeholder Alignment: Exceptional cross-functional relationship-building skills, specifically with Finance, AP, Legal (contracts/compliance), GITS, and InfoSec.
Compliance Mindset: Understanding of IT software security guidelines, software usage terms, and regional compliance standards.
Must-have criteria
Education: MBA / PGDM graduate, 2026 pass-out
Specialization: Procurement, Supply Chain Management, Operations, Strategic Sourcing, or a closely related specialization
Location: Gurgaon, Bangalore, Pune

Description:
Lead - Business Development

About the Role:
The role will spearhead strategic revenue growth by driving enterprise customer acquisition and expansion across key verticals and geographies. The role demands deep industry insight, strong solutioning capability, and the ability to build executive relationships within large organizations. As a senior leader, you will own the go-to-market strategy, shape high-value logistics solutions for clients, and build a scalable and high-performing BD team.

Key Responsibilities:
Drive Revenue Growth: Lead and deliver aggressive revenue targets on a monthly and quarterly basis through new customer acquisition and strategic account expansion in the logistics and supply chain domain.
Enterprise Sales Ownership: Identify, engage, and convert large B2B clients particularly those with complex freight, warehousing, and distribution needs across industries such as retail, FMCG, manufacturing, and e-commerce.
Market Development: Launch and scale presence in new geographies; perform competitive intelligence, demand mapping, and localization of offerings to suit regional market dynamics.
Team Leadership: Build, mentor, and lead a high-impact BD team; establish scalable processes for lead generation, funnel management, and account growth.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Operations, Product, Pricing, and Finance to develop compelling proposals, pilot programs, and commercial models.
Performance Tracking: Own pipeline forecasting, sales performance metrics, and revenue attribution; regularly report to executive leadership on growth performance and strategic initiatives.
Client Success & Retention: Ensure seamless client onboarding, continuous engagement, and upselling of adjacent logistics services such as reverse logistics, express delivery, or value-added services.

Preferred Background & Skills:
5+ years of experience in B2B sales or business development, with a strong focus on logistics, LTL/PTL, freight forwarding, 3PL/4PL, or supply chain tech platforms.
Strong track record of closing complex enterprise deals, especially in contract logistics, transportation management, and integrated logistics solutions.
Deep understanding of supply chain processes including LTL, FTL, warehousing, distribution networks, and logistics tech platforms.
Data-driven, solution-oriented mindset with strong commercial acumen.
Ability to work in a high-growth, agile environment with rapidly evolving priorities.
Local market knowledge or regional exposure is a strong advantage.
AboutCompany:
Delhivery is India's largest fully integrated logistics services provider.
With its nationwide network covering over 18,400 pin codes, the company provides a full suite of logistics services such as express parcel transportation, PTL freight, TL freight, cross-border, supply chain, and technology services.
Delhivery has successfully fullled over 1.7 billion shipments since inception and today works with over 28,000 customers, including large & small e-commerce participants, SMEs, and other enterprises & brands.
For more information about Delhivery, please visit www.delhivery.com.
Vision - Our vision is to become the operating system for commerce in India, through a combination of world-class infrastructure, high-quality logistics operations, cutting-edge engineering, and technology capabilities.
Team- Delhivery was founded in 2011 by Sahil Barua, Mohit Tandon, Bhavesh Manglani, Suraj Saharan, and Kapil Bharati and is now 56,000+ people strong.

Role: Workday Financials Delivery Manager
Experience: 10 to 15 years
Location: Bengaluru/Hyderabad/Chennai/Pune/Gurugram
Mode of work: Hybrid

The Opportunity

As a Workday Financials Delivery Manager at PwC AC, you will lead delivery across Workday Financial Management engagements with a focus on Record to Report (R2R), Procure to Pay (P2P), and overall delivery coordination.
The role combines strong Workday Financials functional knowledge with delivery leadership. You will coordinate across functional and technical workstreams, manage priorities and dependencies, oversee quality and timelines, and act as a key point of contact for client and internal stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities
Lead and coordinate Workday Financials delivery across R2R and P2P workstreams, ensuring alignment on scope, priorities, timelines and dependencies.
Provide functional oversight across areas such as general accounting, journals, close, supplier accounts, procurement, expenses, payments and settlements.
Work with client stakeholders to understand business priorities, assess requirements and guide solution decisions.
Manage delivery of enhancements, production support, releases and continuous improvement initiatives.
Review solution designs and functional deliverables to ensure quality, scalability and alignment with Workday leading practices.
Coordinate across Financials, Integrations, Reporting, Security and other dependent workstreams to resolve issues and manage end-to-end impacts.
Track delivery risks, issues, dependencies and escalations, and drive them to closure.
Lead planning, prioritization and allocation of work across the team while balancing delivery commitments and capacity.
Provide guidance, coaching and functional oversight to Senior Associates and Associates.
Support stakeholder reporting, governance discussions and overall service delivery performance.
What You Bring
Approximately 810 years of relevant experience, including strong hands-on experience with Workday Financial Management and experience leading delivery or functional workstreams.
Strong functional knowledge of R2R and/or P2P, with good understanding of end-to-end financial business processes.
Experience across key Workday Financials capabilities such as Accounting, Supplier Accounts, Procurement, Expenses, Banking, Settlement and related business processes.
Experience leading or coordinating multiple functional and technical workstreams within Workday implementations, optimization programs or managed-services engagements.
Strong understanding of the Workday delivery lifecycle, including requirements, solution design, configuration, testing, deployment and production support.
Ability to review functional solutions, identify cross-workstream impacts and guide teams toward scalable solutions.
Experience managing client stakeholders, priorities, escalations and competing delivery demands.
Ability to independently manage delivery planning, risks, dependencies and team execution.
Experience mentoring and developing junior team members and providing functional direction.
Experience across both R2R and P2P is preferred; deep expertise in one with good working knowledge of the other is acceptable.
Workday Financial Management certification or relevant accreditation is preferred.
