Description:
S&C GN - Tech Strategy & Advisory - Enterprise Architecture _ Business Transformation -Senior Manager
Explore An Exciting Career at Accenture
Do you believe in creating an impact? Are you a problem solver who enjoys working on transformative strategies for global clients? Are you passionate about being part of an inclusive, diverse and collaborative culture?
Then, this is the right place for you! Welcome to a host of exciting global opportunities in Accenture Technology Strategy & Advisory.
The Practice- A Brief Sketch:
The Practice is a part of and focuses on the clients most strategic priorities. We help clients achieve growth and efficiency through innovative R&D transformation, aimed at redefining business models using agile methodologies.
We provide you with a great learning ground, deep-rooted in , where you will get an opportunity to advice and work with our key global clients, driving end-to-end transformative strategic value and business growth.
As a part of this high performing team, you will proactively and holistically help and guide the enterprise leaders, product managers, product owners and distributed product delivery teams through transformation and optimization initiatives, supporting the formulation of business strategy, outcomes and capabilities. Your scope of activities could include helping the organization achieve targeted business outcomes related to growing revenue, optimizing costs, mitigating risks and improving sustainability. You focus on development of the business and IT strategy and enterprise architecture of the organization as a whole.
You would be expected to:
Facilitate alignment between business and IT, and across the democratized IT landscape
Engage business and IT stakeholders, building and maintaining relationships
Adapt to changing business and operating models
Analyze trends and disruptions, and assess their impact on targeted business outcomes
Tell stories to visualize the future state and trigger long-term planning
Support various operating models such as project-centric and product-centric
Communicate the value of enterprise architecture, and its portfolio of services
Drive the evolution of the EA teams services and operating model
Coach and mentor other architects, product owners/managers and business stakeholders to instill architectural thinking
Scope of Activities:
As an Technology Strategy & Advisory leader, you will demonstrate competencies across four key dimensions:
Support Formulation of Strategy and Guide Execution
Work with business and leadership stakeholders to develop strategy
Lead the analysis of business and operating models, market trends and the technology industry to determine their potential impact on the enterprises business strategy, direction, and architecture.
Provide perspective on the readiness of the organization to change and innovate through scenario planning techniques, and supports formulation of business strategy.
Uses planning-driven, design-driven and learning-driven approaches to construct future- and current-state business models.
Connects Strategy to Execution
Facilitate business and IT alignment, connecting strategy to execution, through a collaborative, supportive and consultative manner, driving the organizations digital business strategies and balancing innovation and growth.
Translate and guide execution of business strategy to achieve the organizations targeted business outcomes.
Construct technology-enabled business and operating models and provides viable options and visibility into execution issues.
Build and Maintain Relationships
Build the Technology value proposition and structure business engagement
Build the Tech value proposition, offering services and skills to support the development and execution of business strategy.
Develop a portfolio of consulting services, designed to meet business and stakeholder needs, and delivers in an agile and time-boxed way.
Determine the relationship between people, processes, information, technology and other components of the enterprise operating model.
Enable value-based messaging and manage cross-functional relationships
Provide consultative advice, adapted to stakeholder context, to business leaders and organizational stakeholders who seek actionable recommendations to make investment decisions about the next business and operating model of their organization, using technology to make that change happen.
Lead interaction with business leaders, product managers and product owners in a business-driven conversation over the risks and implications of the product decision to the line of business, business unit and greater enterprise.
Orchestrate the Delivery of Business Outcomes
Bring alignment across business and IT
Lead analysis of the business future-state capabilities and future (and current) IT environment to detect critical gaps and opportunities and recommend solutions for improvement to drive the business towards its targeted outcomes.
Identify organizational requirements for the resources, structure and cultural changes necessary to support the enterprise architecture.
Work with the CIO and IT leaders to find the right Tech organizational design to drive business-outcomes.
Support Solution Design and Delivery
Support portfolio modernization and develop roadmaps
Maintain the alignment, integration and coordination of architecture activities across different programs, projects and products as they evolve over time.
Present gap analyses and/or IT investment roadmaps that reflect the status of the existing IT landscape, namely, its ability to contribute to future-state business capabilities around ecosystems and digital platforms.
Lead analysis of the IT environment to detect critical deficiencies and recommend solutions for improvement.
Lead the development of an implementation plan for the enterprise architecture based on business requirements and the varying IT strategies for project-driven or product-driven delivery teams.
Support solution design and delivery
Develop and apply minimal viable architectures, which can include a set of standards, reference architecture patterns, principles and guardrails, through the EA governance model, which is informed by the business strategy and corporate governance.
Facilitate a collaborative relationship across architecture community, product management and product delivery teams by providing freedom-in-a-box for decision making, with the minimal viable architecture forming the boundaries of the box.
Collaborate with delivery teams to ensure consistency with the enterprise architecture, as well as to leverage shared technologies, tools and processes that impact speed to value and time to market.
Collaborate with infrastructure teams to ensure consistency with the enterprise architecture, as well as to identify when it is necessary to modify the enterprise architecture.
Read more about us.
Your experience counts!
Masters or bachelors degree in business, computer science, computer engineering, electrical engineering, system analysis or a related field of study, or equivalent experience.
15 or more years of business experience in strategic and operations planning and/or business analysis or experience as an enterprise architecture
10 or more years of experience in at least three disciplines, such as business, information, solution or technical architecture, application development.
Technical Skills:
Knowledge of business ecosystems, SaaS, IaaS, PaaS, SOA, APIs, open data, microservices, event-driven IT, data and predictive analytics.
Understanding of business models, operating models, financial models, cost-benefit analysis, budgeting and risk management.
Insight into information management practices, system development life cycle management, IT services management, agile and lean methodologies, infrastructure and operations, and Enterprise Architecture and ITIL frameworks.
Understanding of various operating models such as project-centric and product-centric and also different types of agile principles, methodologies and frameworks, especially those designed to be scaled at the enterprise level.
Awareness of existing, new and emerging technologies, and processing environments.
Effective leadership skills with exceptional soft and interpersonal skills, including teamwork, facilitation and negotiation.
Strong consulting skills such as targeted communications, engagement management, stakeholder management and business development.
Mastery of all components of enterprise architecture, business & IT principles and processes.
Industry Experience:
Experience of working on Digital transformations within Banking or Insurance industry and related platforms modernization
Experience working across banking segments like retail, corporate, wealth, investment or Life / P&C insurance
Working experience and expertise in core banking systems, digital banking, payment processing, financial transaction platforms and open banking etc.
Knowledge of banking or insurance operations, regulatory requirements, industry best practices and standards specific to the banking or insurance sector
Understanding and working knowledge (preferably) of banking platforms like Temenos, Finastra, FIS, Bancs, Fiserv, Oracle FLEXCUBE, Backbase or in insurance platforms like Guidewire, Duck Creek, Majesco, EIS, and familiarity with the ACORD model
Certifications like BIAN are highly desirable
Competencies:
Excellent analytical, planning and organizational skills. Organizationally savvy, with situational and contextual intelligence of the political climate of the enterprise and how to navigate obstacles and politics.
Balances the long-term (big picture) and short-term implications of individual decisions and organization goals.
Estimates the financial impact of Technology options and applies multiple solutions to business problems.
Rapidly comprehends the functions and capabilities of new technologies.
Ready to think, behave and act in an innovative consulting manner to drive the organizations digital business strategies.
Understands and speaks the language of the business. Excellent written, verbal, communication and presentation skills with the ability to articulate new ideas and concepts to technical and non-technical audiences.
Characteristics:
Trusted and respected as a thought leader who can influence and persuade business and IT leaders.
Comfortable, experienced and accomplished at working with business executives, and able to push back in a professional and diplomatic way.
Highly collaborative and supportive of business and of its ideals and strategies.
Highly innovative with aptitude for foresight, systems thinking and design thinking.
Vendor- and technology-neutral more interested in achieving targeted business outcomes than in personal preferences, or in vested personal preferences of other business and IT leaders.
Composed in the face of opposition to architectural principles, governance and standards.
Practical in approach to problem solving and decision making

Principal Duties & Responsibilities
Overview
Own and lead large-scale Azure cloud architecture advisory programs for enterprise clients ?? setting the overall architecture vision, governance approach, and delivery strategy. Serve as the executive trusted advisor to CTO, CIO, and senior technology leaders, translating complex Azure architecture decisions into clear business outcomes. Define the target-state Azure architecture including Landing Zone (ALZ) designs, Management Group hierarchies, and Azure Policy frameworks that set the standards teams work within.
Shape the cloud security architecture stance for client engagements ?? setting Zero Trust principles, Entra ID governance models, network segmentation strategy using Azure Firewall and Virtual WAN, and policy-as-code frameworks that downstream teams implement. Define the Microsoft Defender for Cloud posture and Sentinel integration approach.
Define the FinOps strategy and financial governance model for client Azure estates ?? setting Reservation and Azure Hybrid Benefit strategies, chargeback and showback models, and multi-year cost optimisation roadmaps using Azure Cost Management. Own the quantification of cost savings and present these to CFO and CIO-level stakeholders.
Set the IaC and platform engineering standards for client engagements ?? defining governance, tooling choices (Bicep, ARM, Terraform), and architectural patterns that ensure consistency and scalability. Own the observability architecture strategy, defining monitoring frameworks across Azure Monitor, Application Insights, Log Analytics, and third-party platforms such as Datadog and Dynatrace.
Beyond core Azure architecture, shape how the practice engages across adjacent areas ?? defining the AI-ready cloud foundation for AI and agentic workloads using Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, and Azure Machine Learning; setting the cloud architecture standards that Tech Modernization and Technology Resiliency colleagues build upon; and leading ecosystem advisory covering Microsoft partner network strategy, ISV/MSP rationalisation, and MACC commercial model evaluation.
Lead business development activities including RFP and RFI responses, solutioning for large cloud architecture and transformation programs, client presentations at CTO/CIO level. Shape and evolve cloud architecture advisory offerings, reference architectures, and methodologies that strengthen the practice.
Build practice capability through asset development, methodologies, and points of view.
Qualification
Qualifications & Certifications
Educational Background
Bachelor''s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a closely related technical discipline. A Master''s degree (MBA, MSc in Cloud Computing, or equivalent) is preferred, particularly when paired with deep experience in cloud architecture advisory and enterprise technology strategy.

Experience

At least 6 years leading cloud architecture strategy and advisory engagements for enterprise clients, with a demonstrated track record of executive-level advisory, program leadership, and practice development.
Proven experience owning the end-to-end Azure architecture vision for large transformation programs ?? setting target-state designs, defining Azure Landing Zone (ALZ) and Management Group standards, and governing architecture quality across delivery teams.
Deep experience shaping cloud security posture for enterprise clients ?? defining Zero Trust frameworks, Entra ID governance models, Microsoft Defender for Cloud strategy, Sentinel integration, and policy-as-code approaches at program level.
Experience defining and owning FinOps strategy for large Azure estates ?? building multi-year cost models, setting Reservation and Azure Hybrid Benefit frameworks, quantifying savings, and presenting financial outcomes to CFO and CIO-level stakeholders.
Experience leading cross-capability cloud architecture programs spanning AI infrastructure, application modernisation, and technology resiliency ?? positioning the Azure platform as the foundational layer across adjacent workstreams.
Demonstrated experience advising clients on AI and agentic AI infrastructure at a strategic level ?? defining AI-ready landing zones, GPU environment strategy, and platform choices across Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, and Azure Machine Learning.
Demonstrated track record leading business development ?? shaping RFPs, building commercial relationships, driving account growth, and developing cloud architecture advisory offerings that differentiate the practice.
Key Competencies & Skills
Competencies
FUNCTIONAL COMPETENCIES
Executive presence, storytelling, and synthesis ?? able to advise CTO, CIO, and CFO-level stakeholders on cloud architecture strategy, platform choices, and investment decisions, translating technical complexity into clear strategic narratives.
Cloud architecture strategy and roadmap development ?? able to assess current-state cloud estates, identify architecture gaps, define target-state designs, and build pragmatic transformation roadmaps aligned to business priorities.
Structured problem-solving under ambiguity ?? able to frame cloud architecture challenges, evaluate trade-offs across cost, performance, security, and resilience dimensions, and produce actionable recommendations.
Financial and commercial acumen ?? able to build cloud business cases, evaluate hyperscaler commercial models, quantify FinOps value levers, and support investment decisions across cloud platform choices.
Business development and solutioning leadership ?? experience shaping RFP responses, leading large solutioning efforts, and building cloud advisory propositions that differentiate the practice in the market.
TECHNICAL COMPETENCIES
Azure cloud architecture ?? expert-level mastery of Azure Landing Zones (ALZ), Management Group hierarchies, Azure Policy, Virtual Network, ExpressRoute, Azure Virtual WAN, compute (Virtual Machines, AKS, Azure Functions), storage (Blob, Files, NetApp), databases (Azure SQL, Cosmos DB, Synapse), Entra ID, Microsoft Defender for Cloud, and Azure Monitor. Able to define architecture standards and govern quality across large programs. Working knowledge of AWS and GCP for cross-cloud advisory.
Cloud security architecture ?? expert ability to define Zero Trust frameworks, Entra ID governance models, Microsoft Defender for Cloud posture, Sentinel integration strategies, policy-as-code approaches, and compliance-aware architecture patterns at program and enterprise level.
Cloud FinOps ?? expert ability to define multi-year FinOps strategies, set Reservation and Azure Hybrid Benefit frameworks, build executive-facing cost models, and quantify value from rightsizing and architectural optimisation using Azure Cost Management.
Infrastructure as code and platform engineering ?? expert advisory fluency across Bicep, ARM Templates, Terraform, and Azure DevOps / GitHub Actions; able to set IaC governance standards and define DevSecOps pipeline design for large programs.
Observability architecture ?? expert ability to define enterprise observability strategies using Azure Monitor, Application Insights, Log Analytics, and third-party platforms such as Datadog and Dynatrace across infrastructure, network, application, and cloud service layers.
Containers and cloud-native patterns ?? deep knowledge of Kubernetes (AKS, Azure Container Apps), microservices architecture, serverless patterns, and cloud-native developer platform design; able to advise on platform engineering strategy.
AI and agentic AI infrastructure ?? expert advisory knowledge of Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Azure Machine Learning, and Copilot Studio; able to define AI-ready landing zone standards, GPU environment strategy, and enterprise-scale AI infrastructure frameworks.
Ecosystem advisory ?? deep knowledge of Microsoft partner network, ISV/MSP landscape, MACC commercial models, and Microsoft alliance strategy; able to advise clients on build-buy-partner decisions at enterprise level.

Description:
Experience Management Supervising Associate
About Global Delivery Services:
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
The Opportunity:
As a part of a team, you will act as a Resource Management Hub Deputy Manager who provides consistent, high quality services to key individual stakeholders.
Your Key Responsibilities:
Service Delivery Leadership:
Manage end-to-end resource fulfilment, ensuring alignment with delivery timelines and business priorities.
Oversee billing and finance operations related to resource deployment, ensuring accuracy and compliance.
Own headcount planning to support growth and efficiency.
Champion and lead Strategic Experience Management initiatives, aligning resource strategy with long-term business objectives.
Monitor and improve service levels, turnaround times, and stakeholder satisfaction.
Planning & Optimization:
Forecast demand and plan capacity across skill sets.
Maximize bench utilization and redeployment efficiency.
Collaborate with Talent Acquisition and HR to align hiring plans with pipeline and delivery needs.
Performance Management:
Establish and track KPIs for resource performance, utilization, and productivity.
Conduct regular reviews with delivery leads to assess individual and team performance.
Stakeholder Management:
Act as a strategic partner to delivery, business leaders.
Facilitate governance forums to review resource allocation, pipeline, and performance metrics.
Resolve escalations related to staffing conflicts, skill mismatches, or delivery risks.
Data & Analytics:
Maintain accurate dashboards and reports on resource availability, utilization, and forecasting.
Use data-driven insights to inform decision-making and identify improvement opportunities.
Skills and attributes for success:
Hands on knowledge on End to End Resource management
Be proficient in MS Project/Word/PowerPoint/Excel - working knowledge of MS office
Knowledge in Data Visualisation tools would be an added advantage
Exceptional communication skills - both written and oral
Demonstrate strong organizational skills and structured thinking abilities
Demonstrate strong interpersonal and analytical skills
Demonstrate an eye for detail
Be flexible and willing to adjust responsibilities to align with developing business needs
Flexibility to adjust to multiple demands, shifting priorities, ambiguity and rapid change
To qualify for the role, you must have:
Graduate / MBA (HR) with 12-14 years of overall experience with 8+ years of relevant experience in E2E resource management, deployment, forecasting and scheduling concepts.
Exposure of short term and long-term resource planning would be an added advantage.
What we look for:
A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
An opportunity to be part of a market-leading, multi-disciplinary team in the only integrated global assurance business worldwide.
Opportunity to work with EY GDS practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries
What we offer you:
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
Our Commitment: As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
Professional Development: From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
People and Culture: In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
Benefits: Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
How to Apply: If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

Description:
Virtual Engagement Solutions (Remote Sales) is focused on expanding customer reach, increasing engagement with existing and prospective accounts, and driving commercial growth through remote customer interactions. VES partners with sales leaders across multiple Medtronic Operating Units to identify opportunities, support market development initiatives, and improve access to Medtronic therapies through a scalable virtual engagement model.
This role leads remote sales activities across the North, East, and West regions of India, supporting a broad portfolio of businesses and customer segments. The position is preferably based in Gurugram, with Mumbai also considered, and operates in a primarily office-based environment where virtual engagement is the primary mode of customer and stakeholder interaction. Travel is expected up to 25% for business reviews, team engagement activities, customer meetings, and key stakeholder interactions.
The Remote Sales Supervisor will lead the expansion and execution of the Virtual Engagement Solutions (VES) model across North, East, and West India. This role combines people leadership, strategic account management, pipeline oversight, business development, and cross-functional collaboration to drive commercial growth through remote sales channels. The position is responsible for building team capability, supporting market expansion, and delivering commercial objectives across multiple Operating Units.

Responsibilities may include the following and other duties may be assigned:
Build, lead, and develop a high-performing team of 6-7 remote sales representatives to deliver annual operating plan objectives across assigned regions.
Manage and grow a portfolio of strategic customer accounts, driving engagement, opportunity development, and commercial outcomes through virtual interactions.
Partner with commercial leaders and stakeholders across multiple Operating Units to identify growth opportunities and execute market development initiatives.
Expand Medtronic's presence within new and underserved accounts through targeted remote engagement strategies and customer outreach programmes.
Monitor sales pipelines, account targeting activities, opportunity progression, forecasting, and reporting to maximise commercial performance.
Coach and develop direct reports through performance management, capability building, and sales effectiveness initiatives.
Analyse sales performance data, market trends, and customer insights to identify opportunities for revenue growth, market share expansion, and process improvement.
Lead planning, coordination, reporting, and implementation of VES projects and operational initiatives across supported businesses.

Required Knowledge and Experience:
Bachelor's degree with a strong academic record and a minimum of 8 years of relevant experience, including 5+ years of team management, product marketing, sales leadership, or commercial management experience.

Preferred:
Experience within the medical device, healthcare, life sciences, pharmaceutical, or related healthcare industry.
Experience managing inside sales, remote sales, contact centre, virtual sales, or customer engagement teams.
3+ years of people management experience leading, coaching, and developing teams of 6-7 or more direct reports.
Experience supporting multiple business units, product portfolios, or matrixed commercial organisations.
Knowledge of account development, market expansion, customer engagement strategies, and data-driven sales performance management across diverse geographic regions.

Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.

Description:
Job description
Key Responsibilities:
As a Learning Design & Development practitioner, you will play a key role in helping clients navigate their transformation challenges by designing and building the learning solutions that carry those transformations, owning the work from curriculum architecture through to release-ready assets. You will provide tailored learning solutions to enhance workforce capabilities, optimize HR functions, and support long-term organizational success. By offering insights into company culture and designing impactful learning programs, you will help clients build a skilled, adaptable workforce that drives performance and growth
As such, the key responsibilities for this position include (but are not limited to):
Engagement Delivery
Delivering learning solutions for technology driven or culture-based client transformation journey, by including (but not limiting to) the below skill sets:
Learning Strategies:
Instructional Design (ID) or Learning Experience Design (LXD) with a strong command of adult learning principles and instructional strategies, and working fluency in recognized frameworks - ADDIE and/or SAM, Blooms taxonomy for objective setting, and Kirkpatrick for evaluation.
Demonstrate a deep understanding of business operations and ERP and HCM solutions like Workday, Oracle, SAP, etc.
Learning Activities:
Collaborate with Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) to deliver Training Needs Analysis, Curriculum design, role-based learning plans and blended training solutions.
Ability to use a variety of collaboration tools available to the client to run workshops and presentations.
Ability to develop engaging scenarios, activities, and assessments for blended learning solutions.
Hands-on proficiency with industry-standard authoring and multimedia tools - Articulate Storyline and Rise 360, Adobe Captivate, Camtasia, Vyond, or equivalent - to build visually engaging learning assets.
Publish and troubleshoot content on an LMS or LXP, including SCORM/xAPI packaging and versioning, and build to accessibility standards (WCAG 2.1 / Section 508).
Work directly with clients to support engagement delivery spanning across phases of analysis, design, development, and implementation of training.
Learning Effectiveness:
Evaluate the effectiveness of learning programs against Kirkpatrick Levels 13 using a range of methods - reaction surveys, knowledge checks, and on-the-job performance measures.
Continuously improve learning programs based on feedback, industry best practices, and emerging trends.
General Requirements:
Excellent storyboarding skills, and able to produce release-ready facilitator guides, participant materials and ILT/vILT decks to a publishable standard.
Communicate complex information effectively through engaging written and verbal formats tailored to the client's needs and audiences.
Ensure regular communication and alignment on project updates with the engagement team
Ability to work through ambiguity, flexibility to adapt to changing priorities and business needs.
Ability to work flexibly across time zones as per project requirements, ensuring seamless coordination and efficient project execution.
Stay up to date with the latest trends and advancements in learning and development.
Contribute learning scope, effort estimates and instructional methodology input to pursuits and proposals as a subject-matter expert.
Provide guidance and support to team members to reinforce learning from engagements.
Believe in the value created by diverse teams and adapt to different working styles.
Continue to develop internal relationships and your PwC brand.

About the Team:-
The team is focused on driving Data & AI based solutions for SaaS and PaaS clients for Accenture. The team collaborates actively with onsite counterparts to help identify opportunities for growth as well as drives client deliveries from offshore.
WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU?
As part of our Data & AI practice, you will join a worldwide network of smart and driven colleagues experienced in leading statistical tools, methods, and applications. From data to analytics and insights to actions, our forward-thinking consultants provide analytically informed, issue-based insights at scale to help our clients improve outcomes and achieve high performance.
Accenture will continually invest in your learning and growth. You'll work with experts in SaaS & PaaS and Accenture will support you in growing your own tech stack and certifications.

What you would do in this role
Development and testing of AI algorithms and techniques, custom-tailored to effectively address and solve specific, complex business problems.
Manage large databases proficiently, conducting exploratory data analytics to derive valuable insights for stakeholders.
Track down and thoroughly investigate previous information related to a problem, asking probing questions to identify root causes.
Employ a systematic approach to problem-solving, exploring known avenues and asking insightful questions to unravel the core issues.
Work collaboratively with both internal teams and external consultants/managers to achieve project objectives.

Demonstrate adaptability and flexibility in responding to changing project requirements.
Proactively seek and embrace continuous learning opportunities to stay updated with the industry trends and advancement.

Experience working for large Software or Platform organizations.

Hands on experience in building and deployment of Statistical Models/Machine Learning including Segmentation & predictive modelling, hypothesis testing, multivariate statistical analysis, time series techniques, and optimization.
Ability to work with large data sets and present findings / insights to key stakeholders; Data management using databases like SQL
Proficiency in statistical packages such as R, Python, Java, SQL, Spark, etc.
Knowledge in training large language models and fine-tuning for specific applications or domains.
Experience with cloud platforms like AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud for deploying and scaling language models.
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with a data-driven mindset.
Proficient in Excel, MS word, PowerPoint, etc.

About The Role

About The Role


Job Title - SC Global Network - AI - Healthcare Analytics - Consultant


Management Level:9-Team Lead/Consultant


Location:Bangalore/Gurgaon


Must-have skills:GenAI, RAG, Agentic AI, Python, SQL, AI/ML, Visualization (Power BI or Tableau)



Good to have skills:R, Spark, data bricks, Ability to leverage design thinking, business process optimization, and stakeholder management skills.


Job

Summary:
This role involves driving strategic initiatives, managing business transformations, and leveraging industry expertise to create value-driven solutions.






Roles Responsibilities:

Deliver strategic advice to clients by providing data-driven recommendations that enhance business outcomes.
Independently manage communications with clients, ensuring clear understanding of project objectives and progress updates.
Design and implement GenAI, RAG, Agentic AI, or traditional AI/ML algorithms tailored to address specific business challenges within the healthcare and life sciences sector.
Demonstrate knowledge of life sciences datasets and maintain strong domain expertise to drive the development of robust analytics solutions.
Support the delivery of consulting projects for global clients, working as part of a small to medium-sized team or as an individual contributor as required.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams, leveraging skills in data engineering, data science, and business intelligence tools such as Power BI or Tableau.
Apply design thinking principles and business process optimization to recommend and implement innovative, value-driven solutions.
Engage in ongoing learning to develop consulting acumen, industry knowledge, and technical capabilities.


WHATS IN IT FOR YOU
An opportunity to work on high-visibility projects with top Pharma clients around the globe.
Potential to Co-create with leaders in strategy, industry experts, enterprise function practitioners, and business intelligence professionals to shape and recommend innovative solutions that leverage emerging technologies.
Ability to embed responsible business into everythingfrom how you service your clients to how you operate as a responsible professional.
Personalized training modules to develop your strategy consulting acumen to grow your skills, industry knowledge, and capabilities.
Opportunity to thrive in a culture that is committed to accelerating equality for all. Engage in boundaryless collaboration across the entire organization.


What you would do in this role
Support delivery of small to medium-sized teams to deliver consulting projects for global clients.
Responsibilities may include strategy, implementation, process design, and change management for specific modules.
Work with the team or as an Individual contributor on the project assigned which includes a variety of skills to be utilized from Data Engineering to Data Science
Provide Subject matter expertise in various sub-segments of the LS industry.
Develop assets and methodologies, point-of-view, research, or white papers for use by the team and the larger community.
Acquire new skills that have utility across industry groups.
Support strategies and operating models focused on some business units and assess likely competitive responses. Also, assess implementation readiness and points of greatest impact.
Co-lead proposals, and business development efforts and coordinate with other colleagues to create consensus-driven deliverables.
Execute a transformational change plan aligned with the clients business strategy and context for change. Engage stakeholders in the change journey and build commitment to change.
Make presentations wherever required to a known audience or client on functional aspects of his or her domain.


Who are we looking for
Bachelors or Masters degree in Statistics, Data Science, Applied Mathematics, Business Analytics, Computer Science, Information Systems, or other Quantitative field.
Extensive GenAI expertise with a track record of creating and deploying GenAI and Agentic AI solutions.
Proven experience (4+ years) in working on Life Sciences/Pharma/Healthcare projects and delivering successful outcomes.
Excellent understanding of Pharma data sets commercial, clinical, RWE (Real World Evidence) EMR (Electronic medical records)
Leverage ones hands on experience of working across one or more of these areas such as real-world evidence data, RD clinical data, digital marketing data.
Hands-on experience with handling Datasets like Komodo, RAVE, IQVIA, Truven, Optum etc.
Hands-on experience in building and deployment of Statistical Models/Machine Learning including Segmentation predictive modeling, hypothesis testing, multivariate statistical analysis, time series techniques, and optimization.
Proficiency in Programming languages such as Python, SQL, Spark, etc.
Ability to work with large data sets and present findings/insights to key stakeholders; Data management using databases like SQL.
Experience with any of the cloud platforms like AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud for deploying and scaling language models.
Experience with any of the Data Visualization tools like Tableau, Power BI, Qlikview, Spotfire is good to have.
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with a data-driven mindset.
Proficient in Excel, MS Word, PowerPoint, etc.
Ability to solve complex business problems and deliver client delight.
Strong writing skills to build points of view on current industry trends.
Good communication, interpersonal, and presentation skills




Professional Technical


Skills:

- Relevant experience in the required domain.
- Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
- Ability to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.






Additional Information:

- Opportunity to work on innovative projects.
- Career growth and leadership exposure.



Qualification
Job
Qualifications


Experience:4-8 Years



Educational Qualification:Bachelors or Masters degree in Statistics, Data Science, Applied Mathematics, Business Analytics, Computer Science, Information Systems, or other Quantitative field.

Must Have Skills
Strong expertise in B2B Sales process transformation, covering end-to-end Sales process steps such as Lead Management, Lead Qualification, Opportunity Management, Pipeline Management, Account Management, Forecasting, CPQ, Deal Management, Contract Management, Order Management, and Sales Operations.
Proven experience in future-state process design, process transformation, process optimization, and operating model design.
Strong ability to lead client discovery and design workshops, stakeholder interviews, design-thinking sessions, and co-creation workshops.
Experience integrating AI, GenAI, automation, and analytics into business and Sales processes.
Strong understanding of Sales platforms and enterprise applications that enable the B2B Sales lifecycle.
Ability to connect business processes, technology, operating models, and organizational change to develop practical transformation solutions.
Strong team management and people leadership skills, including coaching, mentoring, work allocation, quality assurance, and developing junior practitioners.
Strong executive communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to present and defend recommendations to senior client leadership.
Good-to-Have Skills
Experience with process mapping, process modeling, and visualization tools, including Microsoft Visio or equivalent applications.
Exposure to process mining, digital twin, process simulation, or other data-driven approaches for process assessment and validation.
Familiarity with AX Design and designing AI-agent experiences within business processes.
Experience supporting Business Development, sales pursuits, RFP/RFI responses, proposal development, solutioning, and client presentations.
Experience conducting change-impact assessments across people, process, technology, data, skills, and operating models.
Knowledge of Sales platforms such as CRM (Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics), CPQ (Salesforce, Conga, SAP), CLM (Icertis Conga), Sales Planning (Anaplan, Xactly), Forecasting (Clari, Aviso), Incentive Compensation (Varicent, SAP Callidus), Order Management (Salesforce, SAP), and Revenue Management (Salesforce, SAP)
Experience
8 -12 years of experience in management consulting, process transformation, process excellence, Sales Operations, business transformation, or related areas.
Demonstrated experience leading process transformation workstreams and managing client and internal stakeholders.
Experience managing and developing consulting teams
Experience supporting BD, RFP/RFI, proposal, and pursuit activities is preferred.

Bachelor's Degree or equivalent.

Job Summary
As a Manager - B2B Sales Transformation & Process Excellence, you will lead the design and transformation of end-to-end B2B Sales processes for clients across Software & Platforms, High Tech, and Communications & Media.
You will own the process transformation design cycle-from understanding the client's current-state Sales processes and assessing industry, market, technology, and competitive forces, through defining future-state processes and operating models, to developing implementation and adoption approaches. You will bring strong knowledge of key Sales process steps, including Lead-to-Opportunity, Opportunity Management, Pipeline Management, Forecasting, Account Management, CPQ, Deal Management, Contracting, Order Management, and Sales Operations. You will also assess how Sales platforms and applications enable these processes and identify opportunities for platform optimization, digital transformation, automation, and AI/GenAI integration.
The role requires strong consulting leadership, including client workshop facilitation, stakeholder management, executive communication, team management, and delivery ownership. You will lead and coach practitioners, ensure quality of deliverables, and build reusable methodologies and assets. You will also contribute to Business Development and RFP/RFI activities, including opportunity shaping, solution development, proposal responses, process narratives, capability presentations, and client presentations.
As part of AI-led transformation, you will apply AX Design principles to consider the intersection of human, AI agent, and process. Future-state process designs should define where AI agents operate autonomously, where human intervention is required, escalation triggers, controls, and the quality of human-agent handoffs.
Roles & Responsibilities
B2B Sales Process Transformation
Lead end-to-end B2B Sales process transformation initiatives across multiple Sales process steps and functional areas.
Assess current-state processes, identifying pain points, inefficiencies, control gaps, manual activities, duplication, and opportunities for standardization and automation.
Lead the design of future-state Sales processes and operating models aligned to business objectives and industry leading practices.
Drive transformation across key Sales processes including:
Lead Management & Qualification
Lead-to-Opportunity
Opportunity Management
Pipeline Management
Account Management
Sales Forecasting & Planning
CPQ & Deal Management
Contract Management
Order Management
Sales Operations & Revenue Operations
Connect process design with people, technology, data, governance, and operating model changes.
Develop transformation roadmaps, process specifications, business requirements, operating models, and implementation recommendations.
Sales Platforms & Applications
Assess the role of Sales platforms and applications in enabling end-to-end B2B Sales processes.
Support transformation initiatives involving CRM/Sales Cloud, CPQ, CLM, Sales Planning, Forecasting, Deal Management, Incentive Compensation, Order Management, and Revenue Management platforms.
Identify opportunities to improve platform adoption, integration, automation, data quality, user experience, and process effectiveness.
Lead process visualization and documentation using Microsoft Visio and other process mapping/modeling tools.
Work closely with business and technology teams to translate process requirements into platform and solution requirements.
Client Leadership & Workshops
Lead client discovery workshops, stakeholder interviews, design-thinking sessions, and co-creation workshops.
Facilitate discussions with Sales, Operations, Technology, Finance, and Business stakeholders.
Present transformation recommendations and future-state designs to senior client leadership.
Manage day-to-day client relationships, stakeholder expectations, risks, dependencies, and issue resolution.
Build trusted relationships with client stakeholders and establish credibility through strong Sales domain and consulting expertise.
AI, GenAI & AX Design
Embed AI, GenAI, automation, and analytics into future-state Sales process designs and team ways of working.
Identify high-value opportunities where AI can improve Sales productivity, decision-making, forecasting, customer engagement, and operational efficiency.
Use appropriate AI tools to accelerate research, benchmarking, analysis, process documentation, and deliverable creation.
Apply AX Design principles to future-state process specifications by defining:
AI-agent responsibilities
Autonomy levels
Decision-making boundaries
Escalation triggers
Human intervention points
Human-agent handoff protocols
Quality and governance requirements
Evaluate how AI agents and human users should collaborate across individual Sales process steps.
Process Excellence, Benchmarking & Analytics
Lead process maturity, benchmarking, and performance assessments to identify transformation opportunities.
Assess market and industry trends across Software & Platforms, High Tech, and Communications & Media.
Leverage AI-assisted analytics and benchmarking tools to develop data-driven insights.
Use process mining, digital twin, and process simulation approaches where appropriate to validate current-state and future-state process designs.
Develop change-impact assessments covering people, process, technology, data, skills, and organizational structures.
Business Development & RFP
Contribute actively to Business Development, RFP/RFI, proposal, and pursuit activities.
Support opportunity qualification, solution shaping, and development of differentiated value propositions.
Lead or contribute to RFP responses, proposal narratives, solution approaches, process diagrams, operating models, case studies, and capability presentations.
Translate client requirements into practical B2B Sales transformation solutions and roadmaps.
Support client presentations, solution demonstrations, workshops, and pursuit discussions.
Develop reusable Sales transformation assets, accelerators, frameworks, and points of view to support future pursuits.
Team Management & People Leadership
Lead and manage consulting teams across Sales transformation engagements.
Allocate work, establish priorities, monitor delivery quality, and ensure timely completion of deliverables.
Coach and mentor junior consultants and practitioners on B2B Sales processes, process redesign, consulting methodologies, analytics, and AI-enabled transformation.
Provide regular feedback and support team members in developing consulting and domain capabilities.
Foster a collaborative, high-performing team environment across onsite, offshore, and distributed teams.

Deep understanding of B2B Sales processes and end-to-end Sales process steps.

Strong knowledge of Sales Operations and Sales transformation.

Role Overview
The Assistant Cluster Lead will support the Cluster Lead in managing operations across multiple residential & comemrcial communities. The incumbent will be responsible for driving operational excellence, team effectiveness, vendor performance, customer satisfaction, governance compliance, and financial discipline across assigned sites while ensuring adherence to organizational standards and service commitments.

Key Responsibilities
Operational Management

Monitor preventive and corrective maintenance activities across sites.

Team Management

Support governance meetings and ensure closure of action items.
Act as a key escalation point for operational and service-related issues.

Customer Experience

Monitor customer feedback and implement improvement initiatives.
Support resident engagement activities and community-building programs.
Minimize escalations through proactive issue identification and resolution.

Vendor Management

Conduct periodic vendor reviews and service quality audits.
Ensure compliance with safety, statutory, and operational standards.
Support onboarding and governance of service partners.

Monitor documentation, licenses, certifications, and compliance trackers.
Support implementation of risk mitigation and corrective action plans.

Manage release cycles, deployments, and upgrades of Informatica SaaS MDM platforms.
Provide leadership, mentoring, and career development guidance to team members.

Strong experience managing large-scale Informatica MDM implementations (on-premises and/or cloud) preferrably cloud
Deep understanding of MDM principles including data modeling, survivorship rules, matching and linking algorithms, and data governance.
Proven ability to manage multi-disciplinary teams consisting of architects, developers, analysts, and QA professionals.
Solid project and resource management skills, including Agile and waterfall methodologies.
Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with experience working closely with business and IT leadership.
Familiarity with related Informatica tools (CDGC, CDQ, CAI,IICS) and integration technologies.
Strong problem-solving skills with a strategic and tactical mindset.
Experience with regulatory compliance related to data privacy (e.g., GDPR, CCPA).

Description:
Job Title - Service Operating Model & Process Design - Senior Manager - I&P GN
Management Level:06 - Senior Manager
Location:Bangalore/ Gurgaon/ Mumbai/ Pune/ Hyderabad/ Chennai?
Must have skills:Process Excellence, Process Re-engineering, Customer Service Transformation, Lean Six Sigma

Good to have skills:Customer Experience Design, AI-enabled Process Design, Process Mining, CCaaS, CRM, Operating Model Design
Experience:Minimum 12 years(s) of experience is required

Educational Qualification:MBA or equivalent postgraduate degree from a Tier 1 institute?
Job Summary:
As a Service Operating Model & Process Design Senior Manager, you define how process transformation work gets done for your clients, setting the methodology, governing quality, and ensuring every engagement reflects deep domain expertise and the right delivery standards. You are responsible for helping clients reimagine how work gets done across customer-facing and operational processes, bringing together process excellence, customer experience, AI, and service operations to drive lasting business value. You've embedded AI thinking into the team's methodology, proactively identifying where AI can be applied meaningfully within your domain. You coach the team on how to incorporate AI initiatives into future-state processes in the right way, ensuring they enhance operational performance while delivering a better customer experience.

Roles & Responsibilities:
Embed AI into future state design for clients as well as in ways of working for your team using the appropriate AI tools and creating agents strategically to aid in deliverable creation.
Define the process redesign standard for your clients- the method the team uses to assess as-is processes, redesign future-state processes, integrate AI, and design operating model changes - and govern its application across all engagements in your area.
Determine the client facilitation approach:discovery workshop methodology, recommendation presentation standards, and approval governance.
Serve as the executive governance point of contact across programmes by managing risks, escalations, and stakeholder alignment at the most senior client levels, ensuring delivery confidence and programme integrity throughout.
Connect with technology and delivery partners to make sure process design and platform work fit together on joint deliverables.
Provide direction on Service transformation programs by shaping technology strategy within process designs, evaluating platform fit, and ensuring alignment between architecture decisions and business outcomes.
Build and grow senior client relationships by identifying account expansion and follow-on engagement opportunities and generating new pipeline for process excellence work. Expanding the practice's presence across industries and geographies to establish it as a long-term strategic partner in customer service transformation.
Lead and grow the practice by mentoring Senior Managers, Managers, Consultants, and Analysts, shaping capability development across the team, and contributing to hiring and talent strategy.
Lead practice and thought leadership by developing points of view, industry insights, go-to-market offerings, accelerators, frameworks, and reusable assets that strengthen the practice's market positioning and differentiation.

Professional & Technical Skills:
Basic Qualification:
Minimum 12-18 years of experience in process excellence, process redesign, or management consulting
Deep industry (any) or customer service function expertise, with the ability to apply it to process transformation
Demonstrated ability to define and govern team methodology across a portfolio of client engagements
Experience managing and developing team members in a consulting environment
Proven business development experience including RFP ownership, deal shaping, and relationship-led growth interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence and drive change across organizational levels.
Preferred Qualification:
Familiarity with CCaaS, CRM platforms and AI-enabled service technology, sufficient to provide strategic direction on technology decisions
Demonstrated track record of leading large, complex consulting engagements end-to-end, with full accountability for delivery, quality, and client satisfaction
Experience managing and developing multi-level teams in a fast-paced consulting environment
Strong executive communication and facilitation skills
Lean Six Sigma certification - Good to have (Black Belt preferred)

Additional Information:
- The ideal candidate combines process re-engineering?expertise, customer-centric service design, AI-enabled transformation, and senior client leadership.?
- The role requires the ability to design at the intersection of people, AI agents, and?process?while aligning outcomes for the business, customers, and employees.?

Description:
We are looking for a hands-on Senior Machine Learning Engineer to join our team and help bridge the gap between Data Science and Engineering. This role will focus on designing, deploying, and scaling AI/ML solutions, building robust MLOps capabilities, and enabling the successful transition of machine learning models from experimentation to production. The ideal candidate will combine strong engineering skills with cloud, data, and ML deployment expertise.
Key Responsibilities
Partner closely with Data Science, Data Engineering, and Software Engineering teams to operationalize machine learning solutions.
Design, build, deploy, and maintain scalable ML systems and production-grade AI applications.
Serve as the bridge between model development, infrastructure, and deployment.
Develop and implement proof of concepts (POCs) and contribute directly to project execution.
Define solution architecture and recommend appropriate cloud services, tools, and deployment approaches.
Design, build, and optimize MLOps workflows, CI/CD pipelines, and monitoring frameworks.
Support modernization initiatives, including migration of legacy platforms to cloud-native architectures.
Contribute to the development of next-generation AI/ML solutions that deliver analytics, predictions, and explainability.
Collaborate on data processing pipelines and engineering workflows that support machine learning applications.
Required Skills & Experience
Machine Learning Engineering & MLOps
Strong experience with the end-to-end machine learning lifecycle, including:
Model deployment
Monitoring and observability
Model maintenance and retraining
MLOps best practices
Experience deploying and managing ML models in production environments.
Understanding of AI systems, model integration, and AI agent deployment.
Cloud Platforms
Hands-on experience with one or more major cloud platforms such as AWS or GCP.
Experience with cloud-based ML services and containerized deployments.
Familiarity with services related to model training, orchestration, deployment, monitoring, and scaling.
Experience implementing CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation.
Data Engineering
Experience building and supporting data pipelines and data processing frameworks.
Understanding of data integration, transformation, and workflow orchestration.
Familiarity with DBT is preferred but not mandatory.
Architecture & System Design
Ability to design scalable, secure, and maintainable ML solutions.
Experience making infrastructure and architecture decisions for AI/ML workloads.
Strong problem-solving and technical design capabilities.
Preferred Technology Stack
Cloud Platforms: AWS, GCP
Data Platform: Snowflake (including AI capabilities such as Cortex)
Application Layer: Streamlit
Containerization and Deployment Frameworks
CI/CD and MLOps Tooling
Modern Data Engineering and ML Deployment Frameworks
Experience Required
4 to 6 years of relevant experience in Machine Learning Engineering, MLOps, Data Engineering, or related fields.
Demonstrated experience building, deploying, and supporting ML applications in production environments.
Strong balance of technical architecture knowledge and hands-on implementation experience.
Important Note
This is a hands-on engineering role rather than a pure architecture position. The ideal candidate should be comfortable contributing directly to solution development, deployments, experimentation, and execution. Profiles with only high-level architecture experience and limited implementation exposure may not be a fit.
Project Scope
The selected candidate will:
Work on new AI/ML platform development initiatives.
Support modernization and migration of existing systems.
Contribute to building intelligent systems focused on analytics, prediction, automation, and explainability.
Help establish scalable engineering practices for AI and machine learning adoption across the organization.

Description:
Delhivery is Indias leading fulfillment platform for digital commerce. With its nationwide network extending beyond 18,000 pin codes and 2,500 cities, the company provides a full suite of logistics services such as express parcel transportation, LTL and FTL freight, reverse logistics, cross-border services, B2B & B2C warehousing, and technology services.

Delhivery has successfully fulfilled over 550 million transactions since inception and today works with over 10,000 direct customers, which include large and small e-commerce participants, SMEs, and over 350 leading enterprises and brands.

Role Details:
Position: Manager
Location: Gurgaon, Noida and Mumbai
Working Days: 6 Days

About Delhivery: Delhivery is a leading logistics and supply chain services company in India, founded in 2011. Our vision is to become the operating system for commerce in India through a combination of world-class infrastructure, logistics operations of the highest quality, and cutting-edge engineering and technology capabilities. We are disrupting Indias logistics industry through our proprietary network design, infrastructure, partnerships, and engineering and technology capabilities. Delhivery brings unparalleled cost efficiency and pan-India reach to the businesses of over 15,000 customers. Our team has successfully fulfilled over 1 billion orders to more than 420 million households across India. 20 automated sort centers, 71+ fulfillment centers, 65+ hubs, 2200+ direct delivery centers, 5000+ partner centers, and 39,200+ team members make it possible to deliver over 1.5M packages a day.

Job Summary: We are seeking a proactive and strategic Manager to manage partners for our platform and grow loyalty towards Delhivery.

Role Overview: We are seeking a proactive Manager Supply to strengthen relationships with our delivery partners and drive long-term loyalty towards the Delhivery platform.

This role will focus on improving partner onboarding, partner satisfaction, performance, and retention, while ensuring high standards of productivity, compliance, and engagement across the partner ecosystem.


Key Responsibilities:

1. Partner Engagement & Relationship Management Vendor Management & Onboarding – Identify, onboard, and maintain a strong vendor base for fleet requirements. Build and maintain strong relationships with delivery partners (loyal partners). Conduct regular engagement activities, recognition programs, and feedback sessions to enhance partner motivation and loyalty. Resolve partner grievances promptly to ensure high satisfaction and minimal attrition. Act as a bridge between partners and internal teams (operations, HR, product) for smooth communication and issue resolution.

2. Partner Performance & Retention Monitor partner-level performance metrics (attendance, delivery quality, productivity, etc.). Identify top-performing and at-risk partners and design targeted retention initiatives. Develop incentive and recognition programs to reward consistent, high-performing partners. Drive reduction in partner churn and ensure a stable, reliable delivery network.

3. Process & Compliance Ensure all partners adhere to Delhivery’s operational and safety guidelines. Maintain updated documentation and records for all partner interactions and activities. Collaborate with internal teams to ensure timely onboarding, training, and policy awareness among partners.

4. Data Analysis & Reporting Track and analyze partner satisfaction, retention rates, and performance metrics.

Prepare regular dashboards and insights to identify trends and areas for improvement.

Recommend data-driven interventions to improve partner experience and operational outcomes.

Key Requirements:

Bachelor’s degree in Business, Operations, or a related field (MBA preferred).

3–6 years of experience in on-ground partner management, fleet engagement, or delivery operations, preferably in logistics, e-commerce, or mobility sectors.

Strong people management and relationship-building skills. Ability to analyze data and drive actionable insights.

Excellent communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills. Willingness to travel locally and work in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment.

Capco, a Wipro company, is a global technology and management consulting firm. MAKE AN IMPACT

CAREER ADVANCEMENT

DIVERSITY & INCLUSION

Job Description:
Credit Analyst (3-6 Years Experience)
Key Responsibilities
Perform credit underwriting and appraisal for corporate/wholesale banking clients, including detailed credit reports
Prepare end-to-end credit proposals (industry & peer analysis, risk assessment, internal rating, documentation, collateral evaluation)
Conduct financial analysis (cash flow, working capital, leverage, EV, ratio analysis)
Evaluate loan structures, including term loans, working capital facilities, and trade finance exposures
Assess financial & non-financial covenants and monitor compliance
Analyze collateral/security structures (fund-based & non-fund-based limits)
Build and review financial models and projections

Required Skills & Experience
3-6 years of mandatory experience in Corporate Banking / Wholesale Banking credit roles
Strong experience in credit appraisal for large corporates / mid-market clients
Solid understanding of banking products (CC/OD, term loans, BG/LC, etc.)
Expertise in financial statement analysis, credit risk assessment, and rating frameworks
Proficiency in financial modelling and forecasting

Description:
About the Role
Are you a strategic operational leader with a strong track record in managing external service providers and driving operational excellence within a shared services environment? We are seeking a highly capable Regional BPO Manager to take ownership of all contractual and performance aspects of our Business Process Outsourcing (BPO) and Shared Service Centre (SSC) partners.
In this strategic management role, you will act as the vital bridge between our regional business stakeholders and our external BPO service provider across multiple outsourced process streams. While functional Tower Leads manage day-to-day process execution, you will ensure our BPO partners deliver against contractual commitments, achieve financial efficiency targets, maintain high customer satisfaction, and execute seamless process transitions.
Key Responsibilities
Contract & Commercial Management: Manage and coordinate all aspects of the BPO partner contract for the region. Oversee invoicing, timesheets, FTE approvals, volume modifications, service onboarding, and the tracking of contractual cost savings.
Relationship & Governance Ownership: Serve as the primary operational contact between internal regional business leadership and service provider management, driving alignment and acting as the escalation point for issue resolution.
Performance Management: Implement and maintain performance management frameworks using contractual KPIs and SLAs to ensure alignment with organizational benchmarks.
Regional Service Reviews: Lead regular Regional Service Reviews covering performance evaluations, issue mitigation, and future continuous improvement initiatives across all regional markets.
Transition Management: Oversee the onboarding and implementation of newly outsourced process workstreams into standard Business-As-Usual (BAU) operations.
Change Governance: Develop and execute the formal change note approval process for contractual and scope updates.
Customer Satisfaction & Insights: Implement periodic internal customer satisfaction survey processes, translating stakeholder feedback into joint action plans with service providers to address operational gaps.
Financial & Budgetary Control: Manage annual and in-year financial budgets for shared service operations, ensuring partner costs accurately reflect productivity gains, scope shifts, and volume changes.
Risk & Quality Framework: Establish risk and control processes governing vendor activities while championing standard process documentation across provider teams.
Role Deliverables
Outsourced process operations delivered consistently within contractually agreed KPIs and SLAs.
Measurable productivity and efficiency savings achieved through structured process improvements.
Transparent, budget-aligned service provider costs reflecting volume dynamics, expanded scope, and savings targets.
Successful execution of the annual Customer Satisfaction Survey process with clear action plans implemented.
Required Skills and Experience
Outsourcing Expertise: Proven experience in managing complex, large-scale outsourced process operations across multi-location environments.
Performance Management: Track record of developing, monitoring, and driving vendor performance using structured KPI and SLA frameworks.
Process Transformation: Demonstrated ability to deliver process efficiency and continuous improvement initiatives through SSC and BPO models.
Financial & Commercial Acumen: Hands-on experience developing and managing operational budgets, complex commercial contracts, and vendor change notes.
Functional Knowledge: Practical working knowledge of core Finance and HR process flows.
Stakeholder & Negotiation Skills: Excellent negotiation and bridge-building capabilities with the ability to translate complex process problems into clear, actionable, high-impact strategies for internal leadership and external partners.

Description:
Role: Quantitative Developer
Location: Mumbai/ Delhi (4 days working from office)
Shift: UK Shift (Afternoon Shift) (2:00pm to 11:00pm)
The Area: The Research & Investment group is a global team guided by Morningstars investment principles focused on delivering great long-term investment results to help end-investors reach their financial goals. We use our expertise in asset allocation, investment selection and portfolio construction to create world-class investment strategies leveraging the full resources of Morningstar. The group specializes in multi-asset investing, using building blocks in equities, fixed income and alternative investments to construct robust portfolios. Through our investment offerings, we serve financial advisers and institutions, and the investors that they serve.
Role Summary:
The Quantitative Developer will join the Systematic Strategies team in the Research & Investment group. This experienced professional will build scalable research infrastructure used by portfolio managers and quantitative researchers to develop, back test, and deploy multi asset models.
You should understand the nuances of the data and prepare it for ingestion, and your daily work with researchers and portfolio managers will facilitate the research, design, and deployment of investment strategies.
This role is ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of data engineering, cloud architecture, and financial systems.
Key Responsibilities:
The successful candidate will
Design and maintain scalable data pipelines for market, fundamental, and alternative datasets using Python, PySpark, FastAPI and AWS
Build and support investment data platforms, maintain databases and research datasets.
Integrate and automate data retrieval from internal/external providers such as FactSet, Morningstar, Axioma, and other third-party sources
Collaborate with quantitative researchers and portfolio managers to support enhancement of production workflows
Automate operational processes through workflow orchestration, CI/CD, and Infrastructure-as-Code practices
Exposure to streaming data services and event-driven architectures used for real-time data ingestion, processing, and distribution
Evaluate and leverage AI/ML and Generative AI technologies to enhance analytics and operational efficiency
Requirements:
Strong expertise in Python, PySpark, and distributed data processing
Experience with Airflow, EMR, AWS Step Functions, Docker, Git, CI/CD, Terraform, and CloudFormation
Strong SQL skills and experience with Redshit, Athena, DataLake and Parquet
Experience of building AI agents & agentic workflow is desirable and will be considered a strong plus
Experience with handling financial data from vendors such as FactSet, Bloomberg, Morningstar, or Compustat
Exposure to portfolio analytics, risk modelling, performance attribution, and platforms such as Axioma, MSCI Barra, Bloomberg PORT, or similar solutions
Required Technical Skills
Advanced SQL, Python and PySpark
Experience with creating Data Pipelines
Exposure to cloud-based services, AWS (preferred)
Exposure to AI-powered productivity and development tools such as ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, and GitHub Copilot
Preferred Qualifications
Bachelor’s or master’s degree in engineering, Computer Science, Finance, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related quantitative discipline
2+ years of experience in Quantitative Engineering, Data Engineering, or Platform Engineering within investment management or financial services
Morningstar is an equal opportunity employer.
