Description:
Role Overview

CBRE seeks a Project Lead for Real Estate Portfolio Valuations to join the Valuation Excellence (VALEX) Team. This role combines strategic portfolio management, stakeholder coordination, and deep valuation expertise. You will oversee pan-India portfolio valuations for REITs, InvITs, and RE investment funds while driving innovation and automation across the valuation delivery model.

Position Details
Reports To - VALEX Head/Senior Director
Team Leadership - Manages 1 to 3 team members; potential for mentorship and cross-regional coordination
Location- Mumbai or NCR (multi-city flexibility expected)
Experience Required - Minimum 5 years of real estate valuation experience in India
Asset Classes - Core office, retail malls, warehousing, hospitality, residential, etc.
Geography - Pan-India portfolio management; multi-region experience is an advantage

Core Responsibilities

1. As Project Lead, you manage complex, high-stakes valuation assignments for institutional clients across India across REITs, InvITs, funds, and private investors.
2. Serve as the central coordinator between clients (often CFOs and investment committees) and internal regional teams, ensuring seamless communication, delivery and quality. You will be the single point of accountability.
3. Own project timelines and quality standards. Deliver valuations on schedule and in compliance with CBRE's quality frameworks.
4. Build and maintain client relationships to secure repeat business and identify upsell opportunities.
5. Provide asset-specific insights and market knowledge to clients. Translate technical valuations into clear, actionable recommendations.
6. Lead active involvement in valuation discussions and finalization with regional teams across North, South, East, and West India.
7. Review all reports for content quality and compliance with CBRE standards before client delivery.
8. Lead or support VALEX innovation initiatives that drive automation and improve team efficiency.
9. Identify opportunities to standardize processes, reduce manual work, and implement new valuation tools.

Required Qualifications
To succeed in this role, you must bring:

1. A minimum of 5 years of hands-on experience in real estate valuation within India.
2. Proven track record valuing core assets (office, retail, warehousing, hospitality, residential) across multiple Indian cities.
3. Strong financial modeling and analysis skills; comfort with DCF, income approach, and comparable sales analysis.
4. Demonstrated ability to manage multiple stakeholders and complex projects with competing priorities.
5. Clear communication skills; ability to explain valuation methodologies and findings to non-technical clients.
6. Educational background in civil engineering, real estate, architecture, or a related field (B.Tech, M.Tech, or equivalent).

Desired Qualifications

1. MRICS (Royal Institution of Chartered Surveyors) or equivalent professional certification.
2. Experience in REIT and InvIT valuations across key metros.
3. Familiarity with CBRE's valuation processes, tools, or technology platforms.
4. Prior experience managing a small team or mentoring junior valuers.
5. Background in capital markets transactions or investment advisory.
6. Willingness to travel across regions for client meetings and team coordination.

Key Competencies

Success in this role requires a blend of technical expertise and leadership skills:

Valuation Mastery - Core technical expertise in DCF modeling, market research, and comparable analysis for multiple asset classes.
Project Management - Ability to juggle multiple portfolios, meet strict deadlines, and coordinate across distributed teams.
Client Relationship Management - Proven ability to build trust, manage expectations, and convert engagements into long-term partnerships.
Analytical Thinking - Comfort with complex real estate datasets, spotting trends, and translating numbers into strategic insights. Collaboration - Works effectively with regional teams, senior leadership, and external stakeholders; no siloed mentality.
Adaptability - Open to learning new technologies, valuation approaches, and market dynamics; willing to upskill continuously.
Communication - Can articulate complex financial concepts in clear, jargon-free language for diverse audiences.

Your Impact on VALEX

The VALEX team is CBRE's centralized excellence unit for real estate valuations. As a Project Lead, you will:

1. Drive consistency in valuation standards across all 400+ team members and multiple regions.
2. Identify bottlenecks in current delivery workflows and champion automation initiatives.
3. Move beyond regional expertise. Coordinate pan-India complexity. This breadth is rare and globally marketable
4. Mentor junior team members on best practices, portfolio management, and client engagement.
5. Serve as a subject matter expert on specific asset classes and geographies.
6. Contribute to the continuous improvement culture that underpins VALEX's mission.
7. Build a skill set that makes you invaluable: master every Indian asset class, become fluent in REIT/InvIT structuring, develop advanced modeling skills and lead teams.

Learning and Growth

This role offers deep opportunity for professional development. You'll be expected to stay current on:
1. Advanced financial modeling techniques and emerging valuation methodologies.
2. Real estate market dynamics, sector trends, and macroeconomic factors affecting India's asset classes.
3. CBRE's proprietary tools, technology platforms, and analytics dashboards.
4. Team leadership and mentoring skills to support junior professionals.
5. Automation and workflow optimization to reduce manual workload and improve efficiency.

Why Join CBRE VALEX?

1. Work with India's most sophisticated real estate portfolios across REITs, funds, and institutional investors.
2. Be part of a high-performing centralized team focused on innovation, consistency, and excellence.
3. Access to world-class training, CBRE's global knowledge, and leading technology platforms.
4. Clear career path: grow your technical expertise, build team leadership capabilities, and move into senior roles.
5. A culture of continuous learning; CBRE invests in upskilling and professional certifications.
6. Collaborative, multi-regional environment with exposure to diverse asset classes and market geographies.

How to Apply

Interested candidates should submit the following:

1. A detailed resume highlighting your valuation experience across asset classes and geographies.
2. A cover letter explaining your interest in VALEX and how your background aligns with this role.
3. A portfolio example or case study demonstrating your valuation approach and client communication style (if available).
4. References from clients or managers who can speak to your project delivery and relationship management

Job Title: Python Network Automation Engineer (L2/L3, OSPF)
Experience-6-14 Years
Location-Chennai/Bangalore/Gurgaon
Job Summary
We are seeking a skilled Python Network Automation Engineer with strong expertise in L2/L3 networking, OSPF routing, and network test automation using PyTest or PyATS. The ideal candidate will be responsible for network automation, validation testing, troubleshooting routing and switching issues, and developing scalable automation frameworks for enterprise networks.
Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, and maintain Python-based network automation solutions.
Troubleshoot and support complex L2/L3 network environments.
Configure, validate, and troubleshoot OSPF routing protocols.
Develop automated test cases using PyTest and/or PyATS.
Perform network validation, regression testing, and pre/post-deployment verification.
Automate configuration backups, audits, compliance checks, and reporting.
Analyze packet captures and troubleshoot routing convergence issues.
Integrate automation solutions with REST APIs, CI/CD pipelines, and network management tools.
Perform root cause analysis for network incidents and outages.
Collaborate with network operations, engineering, and DevOps teams.

Job Description
Title : Premium Retail Sales Executive
Location : Delhi
Job Type: Permanent
Industry : Sales and Marketing
Summary:
We are seeking a dynamic and motivated individual to join our team as a Premium Retail Sales Executive in Bangalore. As a Premium Retail Sales Executive, you will be responsible for delivering exceptional customer service, meeting sales objectives, and maintaining the overall visual appeal of the store. This is an excellent opportunity for both fresher and experienced individuals who are passionate about sales and customer satisfaction.
Responsibilities :
Ensure the delivery of products and services to customers meets the highest standards.
Create an interactive and engaging store experience to build customer confidence.
Follow the selling process and adhere to standard operating procedures and organizational policies.
Maintain the cleanliness and visual appeal of the store at all times.
Utilize time effectively, including periods without customer interactions, to upgrade communication skills, gain knowledge of SOPs, and manage stock.
Complete operational duties, including paperwork and sales reports, related to store opening and closing.
Handle customer inquiries regarding product offerings, pricing, and billing.
Meet established sales objectives by effectively selling products and services.
Address and resolve customer escalations in a professional manner.
Work a flexible schedule, including evenings, weekends, and holidays.
Stand in an enclosed area for 100% of the shift while assisting customers.
Requirements
0.6 year of working experience in retail sales.
Availability to work during retail hours, weekends, and public holidays.
Well - groomed, highly motivated, and possess a strong passion for sales.
Proficient in spoken English.
Strong interpersonal skills and ability to communicate effectively with individuals at all levels.
Benefits
Open to experienced professionals.
Salary will be between 25-28k per month based on last salary
PF + ESIC
Lucrative Incentives
Other pointers regarding this job:
Location: Plot No. 3B1, Twin District Centre-1, Sector 10, Rohini, Delhi
Age Criteria: 18 35 years
Gender: Male and Female candidates can apply
Eligibility: MBA freshers or Graduate candidates with 6 months or more experience in Retail Sales with a known brand
Location: Candidates must be based in Delhi only.
Qualification: Freshers are eligible; Graduate / Postgraduate (any year pass - out)
Communication Skills: Must have excellent English
Interview Type -  In - person interview

About The Role

Job Title - SC Global Network - AI - Healthcare Analytics - Consultant

Management Level:9-Team Lead/Consultant

Location:Bangalore/Gurgaon

Must-have skills:GenAI, RAG, Agentic AI, Python, SQL, AI/ML, Visualization (Power BI or Tableau)


Good to have skills:R, Spark, data bricks, Ability to leverage design thinking, business process optimization, and stakeholder management skills.

Job Summary:

This role involves driving strategic initiatives, managing business transformations, and leveraging industry expertise to create value-driven solutions.



Roles Responsibilities:
Deliver strategic advice to clients by providing data-driven recommendations that enhance business outcomes.
Independently manage communications with clients, ensuring clear understanding of project objectives and progress updates.
Design and implement GenAI, RAG, Agentic AI, or traditional AI/ML algorithms tailored to address specific business challenges within the healthcare and life sciences sector.
Demonstrate knowledge of life sciences datasets and maintain strong domain expertise to drive the development of robust analytics solutions.
Support the delivery of consulting projects for global clients, working as part of a small to medium-sized team or as an individual contributor as required.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams, leveraging skills in data engineering, data science, and business intelligence tools such as Power BI or Tableau.
Apply design thinking principles and business process optimization to recommend and implement innovative, value-driven solutions.
Engage in ongoing learning to develop consulting acumen, industry knowledge, and technical capabilities.


WHATS IN IT FOR YOU
An opportunity to work on high-visibility projects with top Pharma clients around the globe.
Potential to Co-create with leaders in strategy, industry experts, enterprise function practitioners, and business intelligence professionals to shape and recommend innovative solutions that leverage emerging technologies.
Ability to embed responsible business into everythingfrom how you service your clients to how you operate as a responsible professional.
Personalized training modules to develop your strategy consulting acumen to grow your skills, industry knowledge, and capabilities.
Opportunity to thrive in a culture that is committed to accelerating equality for all. Engage in boundaryless collaboration across the entire organization.


What you would do in this role
Support delivery of small to medium-sized teams to deliver consulting projects for global clients.
Responsibilities may include strategy, implementation, process design, and change management for specific modules.
Work with the team or as an Individual contributor on the project assigned which includes a variety of skills to be utilized from Data Engineering to Data Science
Provide Subject matter expertise in various sub-segments of the LS industry.
Develop assets and methodologies, point-of-view, research, or white papers for use by the team and the larger community.
Acquire new skills that have utility across industry groups.
Support strategies and operating models focused on some business units and assess likely competitive responses. Also, assess implementation readiness and points of greatest impact.
Co-lead proposals, and business development efforts and coordinate with other colleagues to create consensus-driven deliverables.
Execute a transformational change plan aligned with the clients business strategy and context for change. Engage stakeholders in the change journey and build commitment to change.
Make presentations wherever required to a known audience or client on functional aspects of his or her domain.


Who are we looking for
Bachelors or Masters degree in Statistics, Data Science, Applied Mathematics, Business Analytics, Computer Science, Information Systems, or other Quantitative field.
Extensive GenAI expertise with a track record of creating and deploying GenAI and Agentic AI solutions.
Proven experience (4+ years) in working on Life Sciences/Pharma/Healthcare projects and delivering successful outcomes.
Excellent understanding of Pharma data sets commercial, clinical, RWE (Real World Evidence) EMR (Electronic medical records)
Leverage ones hands on experience of working across one or more of these areas such as real-world evidence data, RD clinical data, digital marketing data.
Hands-on experience with handling Datasets like Komodo, RAVE, IQVIA, Truven, Optum etc.
Hands-on experience in building and deployment of Statistical Models/Machine Learning including Segmentation predictive modeling, hypothesis testing, multivariate statistical analysis, time series techniques, and optimization.
Proficiency in Programming languages such as Python, SQL, Spark, etc.
Ability to work with large data sets and present findings/insights to key stakeholders; Data management using databases like SQL.
Experience with any of the cloud platforms like AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud for deploying and scaling language models.
Experience with any of the Data Visualization tools like Tableau, Power BI, Qlikview, Spotfire is good to have.
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with a data-driven mindset.
Proficient in Excel, MS Word, PowerPoint, etc.
Ability to solve complex business problems and deliver client delight.
Strong writing skills to build points of view on current industry trends.
Good communication, interpersonal, and presentation skills


Professional Technical Skills:

- Relevant experience in the required domain.

- Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.

- Ability to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.


Additional Information:

- Opportunity to work on innovative projects.

- Career growth and leadership exposure.

Job

We are seeking a dynamic and experienced AI / GenAI Retail Specialist (Manager level) to lead the development and implementation of artificial intelligence solutions across our retail operations. Focus on the creation of AI models that can help in wide range of use cases across customer lifecycle, personalized customer experiences, optimize pricing, and product assortment.
Translate data insights into actionable strategies for marketing, merchandising, and customer experience teams. For example, identifying cross-selling opportunities or optimizing product assortments.
Work closely with cross-functional teams (e.g., product, marketing, business development) to understand the retail business challenges and translate them into AI-driven solutions.
Communicate the potential of AI solutions to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, ensuring alignment between technical capabilities and business objectives.


 Qualification

Proven experience with supervised and unsupervised learning, deep learning, and generative AI models (e.g., LLMs, transformers).
Expertise in machine learning, natural language processing (NLP), and generative AI models.
Experience with platforms like TensorFlow, PyTorch, and OpenAI technologies.
Knowledge of AI ethics and responsible AI practices.
Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure) and modern MLOps practices.

Global

Why Technology Consulting

The Technology Consulting business within Global Network invents the future for clients by providing them with the right guidance, design thinking and innovative solutions for technological transformation.

As technology rapidly evolves, it's more important than ever to have an innovation advisor who can create a new vision or put one into place to solve the client's toughest business problems.

Specialize in management or technology consulting to transform the world's leading organizations by building innovative business solutions as their trusted advisor by:

Helping Clients :Rethinking IT and Digital ecosystems and innovating to help clients keep pace with fast-changing, customer-driven environments.

Enhancing your Skillset: Building expertise and innovating with leading-edge technologies such as Blockchain, Artificial Intelligence and Cloud.

Transforming Businesses :Developing customized, next-generation products and services that help clients shift to new business models designed for today's connectedlandscape of disruptive technologies

Principal Duties

And Responsibilities:

Working closely with our clients, Consulting professionals design, build and implement ServiceNow and ITSM transformation strategies that enhance service delivery, operational resilience, and enterprise performance. They develop specialized expertiseprocess, platform, industry, and architecturalin a dynamic project environment that offers multiple opportunities for career growth.

The opportunities to make a difference within large-scale service transformation initiatives are limitless in today's digital enterprise landscape. Here are just a few of your day-to-day responsibilities:

Drive ServiceNow implementation workstreams across ITSM and related modules (ITOM, SPM, HRSD, GRC as applicable)
ITSM processes Transformation/Modernization using Agentic AI/Gen AI
.
Conduct current-state process assessments and identify optimization opportunities
Translate business requirements into functional specifications, user stories, and solution designs
Configure and implement ServiceNow modules including workflows, forms, catalog items, and integrations
Support CMDB design, data model alignment, and service mapping initiatives
Participate in solution blueprinting workshops and stakeholder discussions
Contribute to implementation planning, release management, and deployment activities
Identify and resolve complex ITSM process and platform configuration challenges
Support integration activities using APIs, IntegrationHub, and MID Server
Drive UAT support, hyper care stabilization, and post-go-live optimization
Contribute to ITSM best practices alignment and platform governance adherence
Assist in client presentations, demos, and proposal support activities

MBA (preferred but not mandatory)
9+ years of overall experience with 46+ years hands-on ServiceNow implementation experience

Exposure to multiple ServiceNow modules such as ITSM (mandatory) and at least 2 of ITOM/SPM/HRSD/GRC
ServiceNow certifications such as CSA (mandatory) and CIS
ITIL certification (v3/v4) preferred

Cloud Architecture certification (Azure or GCP or AWS)

Experience:
We are seeking experienced professionals who have led large-scale ServiceNow and ITSM transformation engagements across enterprise environments. The ideal candidates will have deep expertise in ITSM strategy, service operating model design, platform architecture, and multi-module ServiceNow implementations (ITSM, ITOM, SPM, HRSD, GRC), with hands-on experience across the full lifecyclefrom assessment and solution design to implementation and optimizationfocused on driving measurable service excellence and digital transformation outcomes
The candidate should have practical industry expertise in one of these areas - Financial Services, Retail, consumer goods, Telecommunications, Life Sciences, Transportation, Hospitality, Automotive/Industrial, Mining and Resources.


Key Competencies and Skills:

The right candidate should have competency and skills aligned to one or more of these archetypes



ITSM Enterprise Service Transformation Experience leading enterprise-wide ITSM transformations, designing target service operating models, process standardization, and automation-first service architectures aligned to ITIL best practices.


ITSM Process Design Optimization Experience analyzing and improving incident, problem, change, request, and knowledge management processes aligned to ITIL practices.
Exposure to Agentic AI/Gen AI for ITSM Processes modernization


ServiceNow Functional Implementation Strong hands-on experience configuring ServiceNow modules including workflows, catalog items, SLAs, UI policies, business rules, and reporting.


ServiceNow Technical Awareness Working knowledge of Flow Designer, Client Scripts, Script Includes, IntegrationHub, REST/SOAP integrations, and CMDB data models.


CMDB ITOM Exposure Basic to intermediate experience in CMDB structure, discovery concepts, and event management integration.


Solution Documentation Design Ability to create BRDs, FSDs, user stories, process maps, and implementation documentation.


Delivery Client Collaboration Ability to independently manage workstreams, support workshops, and collaborate with cross-functional teams.


Secondary Skills (Preferred)


Application Modernization Experience leading and designing the composable architecture leveraging Microservices, EDA on the Cloud Platforms.


Cloud Architecture: Experience with private, public and hybrid cloud architectures, pros/cons, and Hybrid cloud integration architecture


Cloud-native application development , DevOps and data integration within cloud platform


Cloud Migration: Delivering cloud migration roadmaps and managing execution from a project management perspective.


Cloud Deployment across various hyper-scaler platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and models (PaaS, SaaS, IaaS), containers and virtualization platforms (VMWare.)


AIOps Intelligent Operations Exposure to AIOps concepts including event correlation, noise reduction, predictive analytics, and automation-driven incident management within IT operations environments.


IT Infrastructure Architecture Working knowledge of enterprise infrastructure components including networks, servers, virtualization, containers, middleware, and security layers to ensure accurate CMDB modeling and service dependency mapping.


Other desired skills -
Strong desire to work in technology-driven business transformation
Strong knowledge of technology trends across IT and digital and how they can be applied to companies to address real world problems and opportunities.
Comfort conveying both high-level and detailed information, adjusting the way ideas are presented to better address varying social styles and audiences.
Leading proof of concept and/or pilot implementations and defining the plan to scale implementations across multiple technology domains
Flexibility to accommodate client travel requirements
Published Thought leadership Whitepapers, POV's

About The Role


Job Title -

Instructional Design - Associate

- T&O- (S&C GN)

Management Level:12 - Associate

Location:Gurugram, Bangalore, Mumbai, Pune, Hyderabad, Kolkata and Chennai

Must have skills:

Instructional Design OR Storyboarding OR Articulate Storyline


Good to have skills:Whatfix, walk me, ADDIE model

Experience:Minimum 0-3 year(s) of experience is required


Educational Qualification:Any Bachelors Fulltime

Job

Summary:

As a Talent & Organization (T&O) professional in the S&C Global Network, youll help clients across a variety of industries in the areas of Learning Design and Development, Change Management and HR Transformation. Youll use your expertise to develop exciting new learning strategies and solutions. Youll help clients manage organizational change and smooth the transition process. Essentially, youll be part of the team that is creating the workforce of the future!

Roles & Responsibilities:



Although no two days at Accenture are the same, as an Instructional Designer Analyst in our T&O practice, a typical day might include:
Support team/ project through various phases of learning design and development based on the identified business problem, audience profile, and evaluation methodology.
Help develop standards and templates for the proposed learning solution.
Create effective training materials mapping the clients needs using learning modalities such as Instructor-led training, Web-based training, virtual Instructor-led training, simulations, videos, interactive learning nuggets, and performance support materials.
Collaborate with stakeholders such as Subject Matter Experts, team leads, media and technology teams to support iterations to the learning material for improved business outcomes.
Creatively visualize the content and work with the visual design team to convey the course content/key messages impactfully.
Write impactful storyboards by understanding the raw content and repurposing it based on audience, content, modality, and other considerations.
Perform quality checks on the training deliverables to meet the standard quality benchmarks.
Bring your best skills forward to excel in the role:
Proficiency in content development and instructional design, research and information gathering, content analysis, knowledge of latest trends in the learning industry.
Understanding of industry standard design/rapid authoring tools such as Articulate/Captivate/ Lectora/ Camtasia/ SAP Enable Now/WalkMe and be comfortable with client proprietary authoring tools. An ideal candidate should be well-versed with the technical functionalities and limitations of these tools.
Work in a problem-solving global environment with Cross cultural competence.
Possess excellent interpersonal and writing skills with a strong business acumen.


Qualification

Professional & Technical

Skills:

Graduate/Post Graduate in any specialization, preferably Journalism / Mass Communication / English Literature /Advertising / Public Relations
Desired work experience:-0-3 years in instructional design and content development with an understanding of training and design strategy
Adept at gathering and understanding source content to create engaging courses based on the target audience
Experience in applying proven learning methodologies and emerging technologies for adult learning



Additional Information:
A transparent career path designed for rapid career progression
A supportive culture that is serious about training, coaching and continuous learning
A global network where only state-of-the-art tools and technologies will do
A bighearted environment with opportunities to give back to our local communities
An opportunity to work on with key G2000 clients
Potential to with leaders in strategy, industry experts, enterprise function practitioners and, business intelligence professionals to shape and recommend innovative solutions that leverage emerging technologies.
Ability to embed into everythingfrom how you service your clients to how you operate as a responsible professional.
Personalized training modules to develop your to grow your skills, industry knowledge and capabilities
Opportunity to thrive in a that is committed to accelerate equality for all. Engage in boundaryless collaboration across the entire organization.

Skill required: Statutory Reporting & Tax Compliance - Statutory Reporting

Designation: Tax Analyst

Qualifications: Chartered Accountant

Years of Experience: 0 to 1 year

What would you do
The Statutory Accounting team manages statutory audits for Group entities in line with applicable GAAP requirements while supporting various stakeholders across the business. This position provides exposure to end-to-end statutory reporting, coordination with auditors, and cross-functional collaboration with tax, treasury, and corporate teams.



This is the process of generating financial statements in accordance with client policies and statutory requirements.
Activities include IFRS to local GAAP reconciliation, updating notes accounts, XBRL tagging, preparing tax packs etc.

What are we looking for
Primary skill - Statutory Reporting - P1
Secondary skill - Accounting & Financial Reporting Standards - P1

Roles and Responsibilities:
Prepare annual statutory accounts for assigned legal entities in compliance with local GAAP.

Coordinate with external auditors to ensure timely completion and filing of statutory accounts.

Develop audit schedules, reconciliations, and support documentation.

Liaise with Business Units, Legal, Corporate, Treasury, HR, and Payroll teams to provide auditors with necessary information and approvals.

Draft financial statements and disclosures in accordance with statutory requirements.

Prepare and support annual legal entity returns, collaborating with tax and corporate advisors to meet filing deadlines.

Address queries raised by directors during financial statement reviews and obtain required approvals.

Work with the Tax team to finalize tax disclosures and calculations.

Qualification Chartered Accountant

SUMMARY
Job Description
Title : Premium Retail Sales Executive
Location : Lucknow
Job Type: Permanent
Industry : Sales and Marketing
Summary:
We are seeking a dynamic and motivated individual to join our team as a Premium Retail Sales Executive in Bangalore. As a Premium Retail Sales Executive, you will be responsible for delivering exceptional customer service, meeting sales objectives, and maintaining the overall visual appeal of the store. This is an excellent opportunity for both fresher and experienced individuals who are passionate about sales and customer satisfaction.
Responsibilities :
Ensure the delivery of products and services to customers meets the highest standards.
Create an interactive and engaging store experience to build customer confidence.
Follow the selling process and adhere to standard operating procedures and organizational policies.
Maintain the cleanliness and visual appeal of the store at all times.
Utilize time effectively, including periods without customer interactions, to upgrade communication skills, gain knowledge of SOPs, and manage stock.
Complete operational duties, including paperwork and sales reports, related to store opening and closing.
Handle customer inquiries regarding product offerings, pricing, and billing.
Meet established sales objectives by effectively selling products and services.
Address and resolve customer escalations in a professional manner.
Work a flexible schedule, including evenings, weekends, and holidays.
Stand in an enclosed area for 100% of the shift while assisting customers.
Requirements
0.6 year of working experience in retail sales.
Availability to work during retail hours, weekends, and public holidays.
Well - groomed, highly motivated, and possess a strong passion for sales.
Proficient in spoken English.
Strong interpersonal skills and ability to communicate effectively with individuals at all levels.
Benefits
Open to experienced professionals.
Salary will be between 20-25k per month based on last salary
PF + ESIC
Lucrative Incentives
Other pointers regarding this job:
Location: Lucknow (Work from Office only)
Age Criteria: 18 33 years
Gender: Male and Female candidates can apply
Eligibility: MBA freshers or Graduate candidates with 6 months or more experience in Retail Sales with a known brand
Location: Candidates must be based in Lucknow only.
Qualification: Freshers are eligible; Graduate / Postgraduate (any year pass - out)
Work Details: Day shift; employment via third-party payroll (2Coms)
Communication Skills: Must have excellent English
Interview Type -  In - person interview

Associate Inside Sales | Direct Intracity
Experience: 05 Years
Locations: Chandigarh | Bangalore
Function: Inside Sales | Direct Intracity

Role Overview:

We are looking for an energetic and customer-focused Associate – Inside Sales to drive customer retention, revenue growth, and upselling opportunities within our Intracity Logistics business.

Key Responsibilities:

Manage customer relationships and drive retention & engagement.
Handle inbound/outbound calls to generate business opportunities.
Identify customer needs and drive upselling & cross-selling.
Coordinate with internal teams to resolve customer queries and ensure a positive experience.
Maintain sales pipeline and customer information through CRM.
Achieve defined sales, revenue, retention, and engagement targets.

What We’re Looking For:

0–5 years of experience in Inside Sales, Telesales, Customer Success, Account Management, or Relationship Management.
Freshers with strong communication and sales aptitude can also apply.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Strong customer-handling and relationship-building skills.
Target-oriented, proactive, and comfortable with sales calls.
Basic knowledge of MS Office/Google Workspace and CRM tools.
AboutCompany:
Delhivery is India's largest fully integrated logistics services provider. With its nationwide network covering over 18,400 pin codes, the company provides a full suite of logistics services such as express parcel transportation, PTL freight, TL freight, cross-border, supply chain, and technology services.
Delhivery has successfully fullled over 1.7 billion shipments since inception and today works with over 28,000 customers, including large & small e-commerce participants, SMEs, and other enterprises & brands.
For more information about Delhivery, please visit www.delhivery.com.
Vision - Our vision is to become the operating system for commerce in India, through a combination of world-class infrastructure, high-quality logistics operations, cutting-edge engineering, and technology capabilities.

Description:
Skill required: Supply Chain - Supply Chain Execution

Designation: Business Advisory New Associate

Qualifications: Any Graduation

Years of Experience: 0 to 1 years

What would you do
We are looking for a detail-oriented and proactive professional to support Customer Operations Incident management ticketing system
The role requires close collaboration with cross-functional teams, in-depth analysis of requirements, and ensuring Reduction in repeated incidents, Ticket closure turnaround time, Accuracy of issue resolution, Stakeholder satisfaction, reduced rework

You will be a part of Supply Chain Management team where in you will be accountable to manage the Supply Chain and provide insights which will help in increasing efficiency by doing away with waste and facilitating greater profits It also involves management of the flow of goods and services and including all processes that transform raw materials into final products


Drive cost savings and efficiency improvements in collaboration with onshore and offshore teams

Identify opportunities to optimize planning processes and improve service levels

Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives across planning operations

What are we looking for
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

Advanced Excel and PowerPoint skills

Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills

Background in supply chain, asset management, or engineering (preferred)

Strong understanding of SCM processes, especially PO lifecycle management

Ability to work in a fast-paced, operational environment with multiple stakeholders

Strong communication and problem-solving skills

Roles and Responsibilities:
1 Incident Identification , Ticket Creation

Raise incidents promptly based on issues identified by internal teams or stakeholders
Ensure accurate and complete ticket creation description, impact, priority, affected systems
Categorize incidents correctly eg, data issues, Agent defects, inventory discrepancies


2 Ticket Assignment , Coordination

Assign incidents to the appropriate teams Engineering, DC Ops, Inventory, Planning, etc
Coordinate with cross functional teams to ensure clarity on issue ownership
Follow up on ownership gaps and ensure accountability is established


3 Tracking , Monitoring

Track all open tickets end to end until closure
Monitor SLA adherence and escalate delays or aging tickets
Maintain visibility on critical, high priority incidents

4 Communication , Updates

Provide regular status updates to stakeholders LCM, Engineering, Planners, E, O, etc
Highlight blockers, risks, and dependencies impacting resolution
Ensure clear communication of ticket status open, in progress, pending, closed


5 Validation , Closure

Validate resolution provided by the respective teams before closing tickets
Ensure the issue is fully resolved and does not reoccur
Capture resolution details clearly for future reference

Qualification Any Graduation

Description:
Job Description
The Gracenote Sports Content team keeps track of 3,000 leagues across 250 different sports. This data is delivered in multiple languages to media clients, international sports federations and national sports governing bodies. Our live sports data can also be seen on smart TVs and in cars.
We are presently looking for a Content Operations Coordinator I to join our Content team. This role is responsible for our live sports coverage, you will capture several live match events and use Gracenote s Sports-based tooling in the process. You will work as quickly as possible watching, analyzing, and entering data to deliver the required deep sports data to our (media) customers within seconds
- Live scoring of sports, including football, tennis, cricket, road cycling and many more!
- Enter players and schedule information for upcoming competitions and matches.
- Process (historic) results of any of the 250 sports covered by Gracenote
- Expect to spend about 80% of your time on Live scoring of sports, including football, tennis, cricket and many more Qualifications
- Experience of 0-2 years in an operations environment.
- Should be proficient in the English language and possess excellent writing and communication skills
- Ready to work in a 24/7 operation, including evening and weekend shifts.
- The role is hybrid, so you must live near Nielsen s Mumbai office.
Desired Skills:
Avid follower of one or more different sports. Excellent general sports knowledge
Able to deal with stress and time pressure, and able to make quick decisions.
Able to identify reliable, accurate data from sources.
Must possess strong analytical and decision making skills.
Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively in a team environment.
Solid communication and time-management skills required.
Ability to adapt to changing guidelines, procedures, and business rules.
Have excellent computer skills.
Able to work when sports are happening - evening - nights - weekends.
High quality focused individuals with a high level of attention to detail.
Have excellent written and verbal English skills.
High quality focused individuals with a high level of attention to detail

Description:
Join JPMorganChase as a Fund Servicing Associate II and be at the forefront of enhancing our operational services in fund accounting and administration. This role offers a unique opportunity for career growth and skill development, as you collaborate with a dynamic team and contribute to impactful solutions. Experience the benefits of being part of a leading financial institution that values innovation and continuous improvement.

As a Fund Servicing Associate ll within JPMorganChase, you will play a pivotal role in enhancing our fund servicing operations. Leveraging your broad knowledge of fund accounting and administration, you will provide advice and support to ensure progress within established procedures and policies. Your work will have a significant impact on our department, requiring you to apply your advanced analytical and problem-solving skills to develop solutions for varied and complex issues. Your advanced emotional intelligence will be key in building trusting relationships and influencing better outcomes for our team and clients. Your role will also involve planning and organizing your own work, and potentially that of a team, while continuously seeking opportunities for improvement and innovation in our operating platform.

Job responsibilities
Input and maintain OTC derivative trades and associated economic data in strategic systems.
Perform trade and cash reconciliations, investigating and resolving discrepancies.
Support derivative valuations, cash flows and client/fund manager reconciliations.
Maintain accurate derivatives and reference data across operational platforms.
Support new client/fund onboarding and implementation of new products.
Manage daily production activities, ensuring timely and accurate completion of required controls and sign-offs.
Partner with Operations, Risk, Technology, Finance and other stakeholders to resolve operational issues.
Support and oversee multiple operational initiatives/projects as required.
Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills
Experience or working knowledge of OTC Derivatives and derivative products.
Understanding of trade processing, trade maintenance and derivative lifecycle activities.
Knowledge of trade and cash reconciliation processes.
Understanding of client valuation processes and derivative-related cash flows.
Knowledge of financial products/security types including Bonds, Equities, Commodities and Indices.
Strong communication, interpersonal and influencing skills, with the ability to engage stakeholders across different levels.
Ability to quickly understand financial products and their operational/processing requirements.
Strong partnership and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively across Operations, Risk, Technology and Finance.
Ability to work effectively in a dynamic environment and manage multiple activities/projects.
Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills
Hands-on experience in OTC Derivatives Operations.
Experience with derivative trade capture, confirmations, settlements and/or valuations.
Exposure to Middle Office or Fund Services operations.
Experience with client/fund onboarding and implementation of new products.
Experience working with Fund Managers, clients or counterparties on valuation or reconciliation activities.
Developing experience using AI-powered analytics, workflow automation, or intelligent process tools to drive efficiency gains, reduce manual effort, or improve accuracy in operational processes

The Critical Infrastructure Engineer is responsible for monitoring, managing and improving the reliability of critical infrastructure supporting telecom and data centre operations. This aligns with the current CI direction of moving from repeat break-fix to asset-led preventive management.

Title: FP&A Consultant
Location: Bangalore
Shift: General Shift
Education: CA Qualified
Experience: 0 to 1 year of experince in FP&A, Budgeting, Forecasting

Role Overview
We are seeking a highly motivated, analytical, and ambitious Executive Finance Controllership & Business Partnering to join our finance team in Bangalore. This role is specifically designed for a newly qualified Chartered Accountant (CA Fresher) who is eager to transition their rigorous articleship training into a corporate career.
In this role, you will quickly get up to speed with our corporate financial processes. You will collaborate closely with senior finance managers to execute budgeting, forecasting, monthly financial closures, and MIS reporting, while providing analytical support for key business decisions.
Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A)

Support the execution of monthly, quarterly, and annual budgeting and forecasting cycles.
• Perform monthly variance analyses (Actual vs. Budget/Forecast) and prepare initial commentary on deviations for review.
Financial & MIS Reporting

Actively participate in monthly book closures, trial balance reviews, and accrual management.
• Prepare accurate financial statements and compile monthly Management Information System (MIS) reports to track business unit performance.
Pricing & Commercial Support

Assist in building financial models for pricing scenarios and support the evaluation of commercial bids to protect operating margins.
Business Partnering

Coordinate with cross-functional departments to gather financial data, resolve routine queries, and provide cost-benefit analysis support.
Compliance & Governance

Ensure corporate accounting matches Ind-AS, IFRS, and local GAAP standard requirements.
• Support both internal and statutory audit closures by preparing audit schedules and maintaining robust internal controls.
Candidate Profile & Qualifications
Articleship Experience: Must have completed a full 3-year articleship from a reputed mid-sized or Big 4 accounting firm, with solid exposure to Statutory Audits, Corporate Tax, or Financial Advisory.
Technical Accounting: Strong foundational knowledge of Ind-AS, IFRS, and GAAP frameworks.
Technical & Tool Skills
Core Tools: Advanced proficiency in MS Excel (analytical formulas, pivot tables) and MS PowerPoint (ability to build clean, structured presentations).
BI & ERP: Prior exposure to ERPs (Oracle, SAP) during audits is highly valued. Ready to quickly learn corporate BI tools.
Modern Tech (Preferred): Familiarity with generative AI tools (such as ChatGPT or Gemini) to optimize analytical research and writing tasks.
Soft Skills & Competencies
Agility & Learning Curve: Extremely fast learner who can quickly adapt to corporate accounting workflows.
Communication: Clear, concise communication style to interact comfortably with internal business partners.
Problem-Solving: Structured approach to analyzing data anomalies with strong attention to detail.

We are seeking a highly motivated, analytical, and detail-oriented CA Industrial Trainee to join our Finance Controllership team in Bangalore. Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A)

Support the team in consolidating data for budgeting and forecasting cycles.

Financial & MIS Reporting

Compliance & Governance

Assist in ensuring accounting schedules align with Ind-AS, IFRS, and local GAAP standard requirements.
• Help document and test internal financial controls and compliance checklists.

Description:
COMPANY DESCRIPTION:
Allegis Group is the largest privately held talent management firm in the world. We are headquartered in
Hanover, Maryland, USA, and consist of a number of specialist operating companies (OpCos) that serve a
wide range of industries. We work with clients across the world and have more than 15,000 people who work
across 500+ offices with operations in North America, Europe, and Asia.
Allegis Group is founded on a culture that is passionate about transforming the way the world acquires talent
by delivering client-focused solutions that make a difference for businesses worldwide. From refining how
you manage your contingent workforce to strengthening your employer brand to recruit top talent, our
integrated talent solutions drive the business results you need.
JOB TITLE: Recruiter Level 1
LOCATION: Bangalore, Karnataka
JOB DESCRIPTION:
If you have the passion to work with people and are excited by the thought of collaborating with an
international audience, making a difference in peoples lives around the world, and of course growing your
career in the HR Recruitment space, you should interview with us.
JOB SUMMARY:
The key focus for a Recruiter is to execute sourcing strategies and plans with a focus on passive candidates,
with the aim of achieving high quality, cost-effective and timely filling of roles. You will work closely with the
Recruitment Relationship Manager and stakeholders to recommend and develop a sourcing strategy. Based
on your experience, you will recommend enhancements to ensure recruitment strategy effectiveness and
will initiate and drive best-practice sourcing strategies
Your duties may include, but are not limited to:
Responsible for identifying talent that meets specific client requirements.
Build a strong working relationship with Recruitment Relationship Manager and stakeholders.
¢ Understanding & analyzing the requirement of the position based on clients specifications.
¢ Utilize a variety of recruiting strategies to focus on direct sourced (passive) candidates.
¢ Involved in sourcing profiles through job portals, internal databases, and professional networking.
¢ Utilize the internal database to identify potential candidates and post jobs on the portals to increase
the pool of candidates.
¢ Call potential candidates in the US and discuss the job openings.
¢ Provide exceptional candidate care and ensure that candidates are effectively pre-screened before.
¢ Select and qualify candidates based on skill, cultural, and motivational fit, utilizing behavioral-based
Approach and screening criteria.
¢ Maintain timely and accurate information on all candidate interactions.
¢ Proactively pipeline talent and create pre-qualified candidate talent pools in line with the clients.
QUALIFICATION:
¢ Bachelors/Masters degree. (For recent under-graduates: They should have all the semesters
original mark sheets. No active backlogs)



¢ The average of 10th, 12th (PUC), and UG marks percentage should be more than 60%.
¢ Ability to learn and adapt to working on newer skills and requirements demands.
¢ Possess strong written and oral English communication skills.
¢ Ability to recruit with a sense of urgency.
¢ Availability to work before/after typical office hours as work may necessitate.
¢ A strong work ethic and sense of commitment.
¢ Ability to work under pressure and target-driven environment.
WORK SCHEDULE:
Night Shift Should be flexible to work on both shift
CAREER PATHWAY
¢ Shift- 1: 5:30 pm/6.30 pm IST to 2:30 am/3.30 am IST
¢ Shift- 2: 8:30 pm/9.30 pm IST to 5:30 am/6.30 am IST
¢ Saturday & Sunday fixed off
WORK MODE: Hybrid ( Mon-Wed: WFO ; Thurs, Frid: WFH)
SALARY: 3,50,000 LPA (25K after PF)
(Take home: 25K + Incentives + Allowances )
¢ Allowance : 2300/-
¢
¢
Night Shift 1500/-
Food Allowance: 800/-
¢ Incentives : Uncapped Incentives based on each Hire.
PERKS AND BENEFITS:
¢ Both-way Cab (Free Door Pickup and Drop) Within a 14
Km radius of the work location.
¢ 5 days Working
¢ Medical Insurance.
WORK LOCATION:
Allegis Group, Commerce@Mantri, No. 12/1 & 12/2, Shoppers Stop
Building, Level 3, Bannerghatta Main Rd, NS Palya, Bengaluru,
Karnataka 560076.
(Click the maps icon to view the work location) (Note : We are
only considering candidates within a 14km radius of our oce or
those willing to relocate within 14km. We are unable to hire anyone
who lives far from our oce. Check the distance before applying)

Description:
Client Advisor Job Description

About NoBroker

NoBroker is a technology-led real estate platform focused on simplifying the property buying, selling, and renting
experience through technology. We operate in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment where ownership,
customer experience, and business outcomes are highly valued.

About the Role

We are looking for Client Advisors to join our sales team. In this role, you will be responsible for driving sales,understanding customer requirements, guiding customers through NoBrokers products and services, and converting leads into successful customers.The role requires strong communication, relationship-building, follow-up, and negotiation skills, along with a target-oriented mindset.

Key Responsibilities

Drive sales and revenue targets within the assigned territory.
Identify and connect with potential customers to understand their property requirements.
Guide customers on NoBrokers plans, products, and value-added services.
Build and maintain strong customer relationships throughout the sales journey.
Generate leads through calls, referrals, follow-ups, and local market opportunities.
Conduct product/service demonstrations and clearly explain pricing and benefits.
Handle customer queries, objections, and escalations effectively.
Convert leads into customers and consistently achieve individual sales targets.
Follow up with prospective customers to maximize conversions.
Identify upselling and cross-selling opportunities for premium plans and additional services.
Maintain accurate customer information, follow-ups, and sales activities in the CRM.
Track daily sales performance, pipeline status, and achievement against targets.
Coordinate with internal teams to ensure smooth customer onboarding and service delivery.
Stay updated on local market trends, customer preferences, and competitor activities.
Prepare regular sales reports and share performance updates with the reporting manager.

Candidate Requirements

Experience: Freshers can apply.
Education: Any Graduation.
Age: Up to 30 years.
Strong verbal communication and interpersonal skills.
Good customer-handling and relationship-management abilities.
Strong persuasion, negotiation, objection-handling, and closing skills.
Comfortable working in a target-driven environment.• Self-motivated, persistent, and result-oriented.
Willingness to learn and work in a fast-paced sales environment.

Why Join NoBroker?
Opportunity to build a career in a fast-paced PropTech environment.
Performance-driven growth opportunities.
Exposure to sales, customer management, negotiation, and business development.

Description:
Job description
About the Role
We are looking for an enthusiastic and target-oriented Admission Counselor to guide working professionals in choosing the right upGrad programs based on their career goals and professional experience.

Key Responsibilities
Connect with working professionals through calls and other communication channels to understand their career and learning requirements.
Counsel prospective learners about upGrads programs, courses, eligibility, and career benefits.
Follow up with leads and convert prospective learners into enrolled students.
Achieve assigned monthly admission and revenue targets.
Maintain regular follow-ups and build strong relationships with prospective learners.
Handle queries and objections related to programs, fees, eligibility, and career outcomes.
Maintain accurate lead and conversion records in the CRM.
Coordinate with internal teams to ensure a smooth admission and enrollment process.

Requirements
03 years of experience in Inside Sales, EdTech Sales, Admission Counseling, Telesales, or Business Development.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
Strong convincing, negotiation, and objection-handling abilities.
Comfortable working with sales targets and performance metrics.
Ability to understand customer needs and recommend suitable learning programs.
Good follow-up and relationship-management skills.
Candidates from EdTech, Education, BFSI, Telecom, or other sales-driven industries are preferred.
Willingness to work from the Pune office.
AboutCompany:
Started in 2015, upGrad is one of Asia's largest integrated Learning, Skilling, and Workforce Development Majors. It offers a range of online & hybrid skilling, pathway and study abroad courses, Certifications, and Bootcamps under its B2C portfolio. It also facilitates top Indian and global universities to offer their Diploma, Masters and Executive Doctorates. Additionally, select programs are tailored for Enterprise clients under the corporate skilling division, along with other recruitment and staffing services.
Origin: Co-founded by Ronnie Screwvala, Mayank Kumar, and Phalgun Kompall, upGrad was born to bridge the gap between imparting skills and employability, and is committed to providing affordable, accessible and high-quality lifelong learning at scale to millions worldwide. It caters to the end-to-end learning requirements of freshers to seasoned professionals in the age group of 18-60+ years who would use constant learning to enhance their skill sets while also receiving career acceleration.

Impact: To bridge the gap between academia and the industry, upGrad has built an immersive and 360-degree integrated learning solution that rests upon strong pillars like Content, Technology and Deep Personalization, further accelerating stronger career outcomes for learners. It enjoys a wide brands credibility and recall within India Inc. and globally, and continues to command strong course completion rates as high as 80%+ and higher Repeat and Referral rates annually. The skilling major has achieved two consecutive years of remarkable growth, closing FY23 and FY24 with over 55,000 successful career transitions, further establishing the credibility and mettle of the online higher education segment in India and globally.

Description:
Company Name: Manipal Hospitals
Job Title: Technician-Microbiology

Job Description:
The Technician-Microbiology will be responsible for performing a variety of laboratory procedures related to the analysis and testing of microbiological samples. This role involves collecting samples, preparing cultures, conducting tests, and interpreting results in accordance with established protocols. The technician will also maintain laboratory equipment, ensure compliance with safety and quality standards, and assist in research projects as needed. Effective communication and collaboration with other healthcare professionals are essential to ensure accurate diagnosis and treatment plans.

Key Responsibilities:
- Collect and prepare microbiological samples for analysis.
- Conduct microbiological tests on various specimens such as blood, urine, swabs, and other samples.
- Interpret test results and document findings accurately.
- Maintain laboratory equipment and ensure proper calibration and functionality.
- Follow standard operating procedures and adhere to safety regulations in the laboratory environment.
- Collaborate with other healthcare team members to discuss findings and contribute to patient care decisions.
- Assist in maintaining inventory and ordering laboratory supplies.
- Participate in quality control and assurance processes to uphold laboratory standards.
- Provide support in research activities as directed by senior staff.

Skills and Tools Required:
- Strong knowledge of microbiology principles and laboratory practices.
- Proficient in performing various microbiological techniques and assays.
- Familiarity with laboratory safety protocols and quality control measures.
- Ability to operate and maintain laboratory equipment such as incubators, autoclaves, and microscopes.
- Good analytical skills for interpreting test results and diagnosing issues.
- Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.
- Excellent communication skills for effective collaboration with healthcare professionals.
- Basic computer skills, including proficiency in laboratory information management systems (LIMS) and data entry.
- Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and manage time efficiently.

Qualifications:
- Bachelor’s degree in Microbiology, Biotechnology, or a related field.
- Relevant certification as a laboratory technician is preferred.
- Previous experience in a microbiology laboratory setting is an advantage.
- Familiarity with clinical laboratory standards and regulations (e.g., ISO, NABL).

Candidates interested in the Technician-Microbiology position at Manipal Hospitals should demonstrate a commitment to quality laboratory work and patient care.
Roles and Responsibilities
About the Role:
The Technician-Microbiology at Manipal Hospitals will play a crucial role in performing diagnostic tests and procedures related to microbiological analysis. This position involves collecting, processing, and analyzing samples to identify pathogens and support clinical decision-making. The technician will also maintain laboratory equipment and ensure compliance with quality control standards.

About the Team:
You will be part of a dedicated microbiology team that works collaboratively to enhance patient care through accurate diagnostics. The team comprises skilled professionals who are committed to scientific excellence and continuous improvement in laboratory practices. Strong communication and teamwork are key components of this supportive environment.

You are Responsible for:
- Conducting microbiological tests on samples to identify microorganisms and determine susceptibility patterns.
- Accurately documenting test results and maintaining laboratory records in accordance with protocols.
- Ensuring the maintenance and calibration of laboratory equipment and instruments.
- Adhering to safety and quality standards to guarantee the reliability of test results.

To succeed in this role – you should have the following:
- A degree in Microbiology or a related field, along with relevant certifications in laboratory techniques.
- Strong analytical skills and attention to detail to ensure accurate test results.
- Experience in laboratory settings, with a good understanding of microbiological procedures and protocols.
- Effective communication skills to collaborate with healthcare professionals and contribute to patient care decisions.

Description:
About Us
Tata Consulting Engineers Limited (TCE) is the largest Indian private sector engineering and project consultancy and an emerging global leader in integrated engineering solutions. With more than 60 years of engineering excellence, TCE has a presence in over 64 countries and over 12000 completed projects, the company operates in 3 core Industry segments -Infrastructure (Water, Environment, Urban Development, Buildings, Manufacturing Facilities, Ports and Harbours, Transportation), Power (Thermal, Hydro, Nuclear, Renewable, Transmission and Distribution) and Resources - Hydrocarbons and Chemicals (Oil, Gas and Refineries, Chemicals, Petrochemicals, Fertilizers, Speciality Chemicals, Pulp and Paper, Cement, Food, Pharmaceuticals and Beverages, Tyre, Glass) as well as Mining and Metallurgy (Mining, Geology, Beneficiation, Steel, Non-ferrous). TCE serves domestic as well as international markets and is known for several first-of-its-kind projects offering Engineering Studies, Design Engineering Services, Project Management Consultancy Services, OPEX and IIOT across all three verticals. A part of Tata Group - India’s most respected group, TCE is a 100 percent subsidiary of Tata Sons Limited Design your Future with us At TCE, you will experience a supportive environment that empowers you to excel, whether you are based in our offices or at a client site. We embrace diversity, equity, and inclusion, fostering a workplace where every individual can thrive by contributing their unique skills and perspectives to deliver exceptional results for our clients. Our comprehensive compensation and benefits packages are designed to meet the diverse needs of our employees and their families, complemented by a robust global well-being program. As a leading global infrastructure firm, we are committed to your growth and success, offering access to cutting-edge technology and impactful projects that offer flexibility and significant professional opportunities. Join us and become part of a global company that values your potential and supports your career development.
Purpose & Scope of Position
The Construction Engineer is responsible for overseeing and coordinating the project works contractors and maintaining the project performance goals. He coordinates work efforts and ensures activities are sequenced in accordance with the project schedule. A construction engineer must be a competent person in the construction business so that he accurately evaluates the methods and performance in all respects of the particular scope elements of the project for which he is accountable.
Experience
• Minimum 5 – 10 years of onsite experience on major projects under any sector – Infrastructure, Real Estate, Power, Steel or Chemical • Involvement in at least 2 significant major project similar in size and scope as delivered by TCE
Qualification
• Postgraduate or graduate in an engineering discipline • Post graduate degree/diploma in construction management (preferable)
Key Responsibilities
1. Monitors overall job site health, safety and environment performance and verifies that contractors are protecting their workers at the job site. 2. Responsible for construction supervision and contract administration including supervision of contractors and their subcontractors for assigned portions of the project. 3. Assists in the coordination of the design deliverables to support continuous and efficient construction. 4. Job site point of contact for all contractors in his assigned area of the project. 5. Plans and chairs project safety meetings, assists with incident investigations and reporting, and participates in TCE safety programs and initiatives. 6. Communicates the identification, management and resolution of deficiencies and non-conformance to the Construction Manager. 7. Assists with construction estimating, scheduling, reporting, cost control, measurement verification and invoice certification for all work being performed by the contractor in his assigned area of the project. 8. To lead complete Bill Certification process, Measurement of Quantities, resolution of extra scope for assigned construction area or structure or domain or discipline. Enforce Change Management and Request for Information (RFI) management process 9. During absence of the Construction Manager, act as administrative spokesperson. 10. Assist with the development and review of construction related information for the purpose of proposals and other related business improvement activities. 11. Participate in and provide construction input for project constructability plans. 12. To provide inputs for daily, weekly and monthly progress reports, track contractor’s asking rates for major construction activities, to workout catch up plans suit to site conditions 13. Assist the Construction Manager to address site issues and developorimplement a remedy. 14. Assist in coordinating between constructions and commissioning and establishing an effective handover policy. 15. Ensures that Project safety plan and project quality plan is strictly implemented 16. Provides inputs for planning and billing activities

If you are a Finance professional, Emerson has an exciting role for you! We are looking for a Project Analyst to work with our Financial Services Group in Pune.
We value autonomy, self-reliance, fast movers, a passion for robust and ability to maintained quality of financial reporting.

In This Role, Your Responsibilities Will Be:

Managing the monthly reporting process, ensure timely and accurate reporting of financial information to internal and external stakeholders.
Responsible for monthly, quarterly, and annual financial closes, meeting reporting deadlines.
Preparing the Daily/ monthly flash for Orders and Sales at SYSS/ Site level
Determining Correct revenue recognition method for Projects
Revenue & COS Recognition in Oracle system for Projects
Control Account (WIP/UBR/UER) Reconciliations between PA (sub ledger) vs General Ledger
Conducting month-end checks (EAC movements, Loss Accruals, Cost Corrections)
Working of pre close accruals, re-class of timesheets and time sheet analysis
Projects maintenance responsibilities in Oracle, including:
Perform timely closure of projects, including cost and revenue reconciliations and clearance of differences based on internal approvals prior to project closure
Clearance of cost interface errors, PA module closure
Ensure foreign currency exposures are reviewed and validated on monthly basis.
Generate project financial reports, including:
Inception To Date (ITD) Invoice reports by project
Run Project Status Inquiry (Noetix & Oracle) and compile reports for period close
Other invoice and expenditure inquiry reports as specified
Regularly review accuracy and completeness of project costs and revenues
Backlog reconciliation & correct reporting of FX Backlog
WIP and UBR Aging analysis
Perform monthly variance analysis (GP Tracking including Non-Project Orders)
Participate in monthly forecasting (POR) process ensuring correct Backlog phasing
Support segment reporting- Product Group & KOB
Responsible for post month-end reports for Site & BU management
Liaise with Business Unit Financial Analysts during month end close and provide them with financial details/explanations regarding variances
Support on Annual Budgets, mid-year reviews, Ops Reviews
Support on WIP Count & Inventory Analysis
Support on Annual Audit
Participation in Project Review (Monthly and Quarterly)

Who You Are:

You promote high visibility of shared contributions to goals. You quickly and significantly act in constantly evolving, unexpected situations. You actively seek input from pertinent sources to make timely and well-informed decisions. You handle the risk that comes with moving forward when the outcome is not certain.

For This Role, You Will Need:
Finance Professional up to 3 years of work experience in FP&A Domain
Hands on experience in ERP, MS Office, and reporting tools
Self-starter
Balance stakeholder, Situational adaptability, manages complexities & ambiguity.
Ability to think creatively, self-driven, and self-motivated.
High standards of accuracy and highly organized.
Team Player

Preferred Qualifications that Set You Apart:

Qualified Chartered Accountant, CMA up to 3 years of post-qualification experience in finance domain
Basic understanding of Accounting Principles and US GAAP
Excellent written and verbal communication skills
System Knowledge of Oracle, Oracle SmartView
Good Excel knowledge & presentation tools.

Position: Process Executive (MIS)
Job Shift: Day
Experience: 0 - 2 Years
Education: We hire based on individual talent, skill and work ethic. Formal degrees are not a material in our hiring decision.
Job Location: Pan India

Key Responsibilities:
Collect, process, and analyze raw data by pasting it into appropriate spreadsheets for efficient organization and preliminary reporting
Extract and compile comprehensive reports from various data dumps, ensuring completeness and relevance for stakeholder review. Proficiently work on MS Excel to perform data cleaning, pivot tables, formulas, and advanced functions for accurate analysis and reporting
Generate customized MIS (Management Information System) reports aligned with company-specific requirements, highlighting key performance metrics and trends.
Maintain and update records with high accuracy, ensuring data integrity, version control, and compliance with organizational standards.
Handle company mailbox efficiently, including sorting emails, responding to inquiries, prioritizing tasks, and archiving communications.

Candidates who have appeared for our selection process in the last 3 months are not eligible for this opening.
Candidates with notice period of more than 30 days (non-negotiable), are requested not to apply.

Description:
Applying only on Naukri will not be counted. Please complete both steps:
Fill the online form at www.scilal.com > Career > Current Openings > Advt. No. SCILAL 03/2026.
Email your resume and a single combined PDF of documents (under 10 MB) to shorerecruitment@sci.co.in. Subject: Application for Senior Secretarial Officer / Secretarial Officer / Accounts Officer on Contract (Advt. No. SCILAL 03/2026). Mention the specific post you are applying for in the email.
Last date to apply: 21 October 2026, 23:59 hrs
Role & Responsibilities
Vacancies: Senior Secretarial Officer - 1, Secretarial Officer - 1, Accounts Officer - 1 (Mumbai, Contract)
A) Senior Secretarial Officer / Secretarial Officer
Assist in convening Board and Committee Meetings, including preparing notices, agenda papers and minutes in compliance with the Companies Act, 2013 and Secretarial Standards (SS-1 & SS-2)
Support compliance with the Companies Act, 2013, including maintenance of statutory registers and filing of e-forms with the ROC
Ensure compliance with SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015, including quarterly and periodic filings with Stock Exchanges
Assist with compliance under SEBI (Depositories and Participants) Regulations, 2018
Assist with SEBI (Prohibition of Insider Trading) Regulations, 2015, including the Structured Digital Database (SDD), trading window closure and disclosures
Coordinate with Stock Exchanges, Depositories and the RTA; handle investor grievances (SEBI SCORES / Online Dispute Resolution)
Support preparation of the Annual Report, Directors Report and Corporate Governance Report, and the conduct of AGMs and other shareholder meetings
Assist with IEPF and dividend-related compliances, DPE Guidelines and coordination with the Administrative Ministry
Support Secretarial, Internal and Statutory Audit and CAG-related documentation and follow-ups
Assist in reviewing corporate policies, monitoring regulatory amendments and maintaining records
B) Accounts Officer
Record day-to-day accounting transactions: payment, receipt, journal, purchase and sales entries; verify invoices, bills and vouchers
Prepare bank, vendor, customer and ledger reconciliations; assist in monthly, quarterly and annual closing
Assist in GST, TDS, income tax and other statutory compliances; maintain records of returns and challans
Assist the CFO in preparing financial statements, MIS and other reports
Provide schedules and documents to statutory and internal auditors; respond to audit queries
Maintain vendor and customer accounts; monitor receivables and payables
Preferred Candidate Profile
Senior Secretarial Officer
Qualified Company Secretary (ACS / FCS, ICSI)
2 years of post-qualification relevant experience; 1 year in a listed company is desirable
Age: up to 34 years (born on or after 01.09.1992)
Secretarial Officer
Qualified Company Secretary (ACS / FCS, ICSI)
Post-qualification experience is desirable; freshers can also apply
Age: up to 32 years (born on or after 01.09.1994)
Accounts Officer
Qualified CA (ICAI) or CMA (ICMAI), and B.Com / BAF / related graduate degree
Post-qualification experience is desirable; freshers can also apply
Knowledge of Tally preferred; good Excel and reconciliation skills
Age: up to 32 years (born on or after 01.09.1994)
Age and eligibility are calculated as on 01.09.2026.
Skills required for all posts
Accuracy, attention to detail and ability to work within deadlines
High level of integrity and confidentiality
Ability to work independently and support the team
Indian nationals only
Key terms
Contract of 2 years, extendable by two terms of 6 months each; no permanent appointment
Consolidated monthly emoluments (PF included): Senior Secretarial Officer Rs. 80,000; Secretarial Officer Rs. 60,000; Accounts Officer Rs. 60,000
Flexi timing of 7 hrs 45 mins, Monday to Friday; Saturday or holiday work may be required without extra compensation
Location: Mumbai (Shipping House, Nariman Point); deputation to other offices or projects in India is possible
No company medical benefits; covered under the group accident insurance scheme
Candidates must sign an NDA and undergo a pre-recruitment medical check-up
