Job Introduction:
Admin Support
Position Title: Admin Support
Employment Type: Full-Time, Permanent
Minimum Qualification: Graduate (mandatory)
Role Overview:
The Assignment Manager will be responsible for the end-to-end management of physical security operations across high-profile client sites in the South Zone of India. This includes ensuring effective deployment of personnel, compliance with client protocols, documentation accuracy, stakeholder engagement, crisis readiness, and operational audits. The Assignment Manager is expected to maintain high discipline standards, handle large-scale operations seamlessly, and serve as the bridge between the client, site security teams, and the G4S backend.
This role demands strong leadership, a proactive mindset, technical know-how, and non-negotiable communication excellence. Impeccable fluency in spoken English with the right accent, grammar, vocabulary, and pronunciation is strictly mandatory.
Key Responsibilities:
1. Site Operations Oversight:
Plan and deploy daily security personnel as per shift schedules and site-specific SOPs.
Conduct briefing sessions across all shifts and ensure grooming, discipline, and attendance compliance.
Prepare and manage MDR, shift schedules, and site logs.
Carry out efficient patrolling of internal and perimeter areas.
Observe and respond to suspicious man/material movements.
Ensure access control compliance and critical access management (labs, restricted zones).
Maintain visitor/vendor records, key logs, badges, and lost found registers.
Conduct weekly security training and refresher briefings.
Perform surprise night inspections to assess readiness of night staff.
2. Technical Systems Documentation:
Ensure the uptime and functionality of CCTV, access control systems, and FAPA equipment.
Maintain workstations audit, badge audits, and access key audits.
Coordinate with facility teams for system rectification and AMC partner activities.
Take access approvals via eApproval portals.
3. Reporting MIS:
Share daily, weekly, and monthly operations reports with G4S and designated site managers.
Maintain event trackers, alarms reports, RPM data, incident logs, and vendor performance records.
Support site managers in Hyderabad, Mumbai, Delhi, and Gurugram for consolidated reporting.
4. Emergency Incident Management:
Act as the first escalation point for medical emergencies, duress alerts, or system-triggered alarms.
Liaise with EMEIA SOC for remote access control and video retrieval.
Prepare incident reports, investigate breaches, and implement CAPAs.
Conduct mock drills, shutdown protocols, and risk preparedness activities.
5. Client Stakeholder Coordination:
Respond to client queries and share required reports (daily/weekly/monthly) within agreed SLAs.
Attend virtual coordination meetings with client-side managers to sync activities Pan India.
Coordinate closely with facilities and places teams for smooth operations, approvals, and events.
Handle onboarding/offboarding of employees with badge issuance and access revocation.
6. G4S Internal Coordination:
Share weekly duty rosters, attendance, and nominal rolls with G4S backend.
Coordinate on salary concerns, health insurance issues, and uniform issuance.
Maintain leave records and escalate absenteeism trends.
Work with Key Account Managers to resolve operations-related escalations.
Candidate Profile:
Minimum Requirements:
Graduate in any discipline (mandatory)
Minimum 5-10 years of experience in security operations management
Experience handling multi-location operations preferred
Prior exposure to multinational corporate environments in IT sector shall be very advantageous for the candidate.
Essential Competencies:
Communication: Fluent spoken and written English (mandatory); clarity, grammar, and pronunciation will be tested.
Operational Skills: Security deployment, documentation, SOPs, reporting tools.
Technical Proficiency: Familiar with access control, surveillance systems, e-portals, and Microsoft Office.
Leadership Ethics: High integrity, team management skills, crisis-handling experience.
Behavioral Traits: Attention to detail, time-sensitive decision-making, calm under pressure.
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):
100% compliance in daily deployment reporting
95% uptime for security equipment and systems
2 critical incidents per year (with timely CAPA)
SLA adherence for report submissions and audits
Staff discipline, grooming, and performance audit scores 90%

Job Introduction:
Admin Support
Position Title: Admin Support
Employment Type: Full-Time, Permanent
Minimum Qualification: Graduate (mandatory)
Role Overview:
The Assignment Manager will be responsible for the end-to-end management of physical security operations across high-profile client sites in the South Zone of India. This includes ensuring effective deployment of personnel, compliance with client protocols, documentation accuracy, stakeholder engagement, crisis readiness, and operational audits. The Assignment Manager is expected to maintain high discipline standards, handle large-scale operations seamlessly, and serve as the bridge between the client, site security teams, and the G4S backend.
This role demands strong leadership, a proactive mindset, technical know-how, and non-negotiable communication excellence. Impeccable fluency in spoken English with the right accent, grammar, vocabulary, and pronunciation is strictly mandatory.
Key Responsibilities:
1. Site Operations Oversight:
Plan and deploy daily security personnel as per shift schedules and site-specific SOPs.
Conduct briefing sessions across all shifts and ensure grooming, discipline, and attendance compliance.
Prepare and manage MDR, shift schedules, and site logs.
Carry out efficient patrolling of internal and perimeter areas.
Observe and respond to suspicious man/material movements.
Ensure access control compliance and critical access management (labs, restricted zones).
Maintain visitor/vendor records, key logs, badges, and lost found registers.
Conduct weekly security training and refresher briefings.
Perform surprise night inspections to assess readiness of night staff.
2. Technical Systems Documentation:
Ensure the uptime and functionality of CCTV, access control systems, and FAPA equipment.
Maintain workstations audit, badge audits, and access key audits.
Coordinate with facility teams for system rectification and AMC partner activities.
Take access approvals via eApproval portals.
3. Reporting MIS:
Share daily, weekly, and monthly operations reports with G4S and designated site managers.
Maintain event trackers, alarms reports, RPM data, incident logs, and vendor performance records.
Support site managers in Hyderabad, Mumbai, Delhi, and Gurugram for consolidated reporting.
4. Emergency Incident Management:
Act as the first escalation point for medical emergencies, duress alerts, or system-triggered alarms.
Liaise with EMEIA SOC for remote access control and video retrieval.
Prepare incident reports, investigate breaches, and implement CAPAs.
Conduct mock drills, shutdown protocols, and risk preparedness activities.
5. Client Stakeholder Coordination:
Respond to client queries and share required reports (daily/weekly/monthly) within agreed SLAs.
Attend virtual coordination meetings with client-side managers to sync activities Pan India.
Coordinate closely with facilities and places teams for smooth operations, approvals, and events.
Handle onboarding/offboarding of employees with badge issuance and access revocation.
6. G4S Internal Coordination:
Share weekly duty rosters, attendance, and nominal rolls with G4S backend.
Coordinate on salary concerns, health insurance issues, and uniform issuance.
Maintain leave records and escalate absenteeism trends.
Work with Key Account Managers to resolve operations-related escalations.
Candidate Profile:
Minimum Requirements:
Graduate in any discipline (mandatory)
Minimum 5-10 years of experience in security operations management
Experience handling multi-location operations preferred
Prior exposure to multinational corporate environments in IT sector shall be very advantageous for the candidate.
Essential Competencies:
Communication: Fluent spoken and written English (mandatory); clarity, grammar, and pronunciation will be tested.
Operational Skills: Security deployment, documentation, SOPs, reporting tools.
Technical Proficiency: Familiar with access control, surveillance systems, e-portals, and Microsoft Office.
Leadership Ethics: High integrity, team management skills, crisis-handling experience.
Behavioral Traits: Attention to detail, time-sensitive decision-making, calm under pressure.
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):
100% compliance in daily deployment reporting
95% uptime for security equipment and systems
2 critical incidents per year (with timely CAPA)
SLA adherence for report submissions and audits
Staff discipline, grooming, and performance audit scores 90%

Title: Environmental Health and Safety Executive
Skills: Skills highlighted with ‘‘ are preferred keyskills, Work Permit SystemHazard AnalysisSafety Audit, Accident InvestigationEHSIndustrial SafetyEnvironmentRisk Identification, About company, ITC Foods Business Division (FBD) is one of the leading players in India Foods FMCG sector, housing over 40+ iconic brands such as Aashirvaad, Bingo, Yippee, Sunfeast, Candyman, B Natural, Fabelle, ITC Master Chef, and Sunrise. These brands span a diverse range of categoriesStaples, Snacks, Biscuits, Spices, Confectionery, and Frozen Foodsand many are leaders in their segments.
Description:
To ensure implementation of safe work practices and technology, analyse and mitigate risks with respect to health and safety, ensure statutory compliance related to safety and control pollution in the manufacturing unit.
Principal Accountabilities:
Ensure through regular rounds/ proper liaising with workmen & staff for compliance of safe work practices.
Ensure that proper records as per the guidelines of Corporate Safety are maintained.
To plan training of all contractors and own employees for safety and ensure implementation.
To ensure that all incidents are captured and analyzed and actions are planned and taken to prevent recurrence.
To ensure that best safe work practices are identified and implemented.
To ensure formal reports/reviews of action plans of EHS audit and regular follow up on internal audits.
To ensure that regular EHS audits are carried out and also external audits are coordinated and organized.
Plan and ensure that EHS Committee Meetings are held regularly.
Ensure risk assessment / hazard spotting exercises are carried out on regular basis.
To make sure that safety features are in-built at the initial stage of new projects and inspect / recommend rectification of any unsafe guarding / inter-locking of new machines before they are commissioned on the floor.
Recommend and advise the Management the impacts of various environment pollution parameters and suggest ways & means of controlling the same.
Knowledge:
Safe work practices and technology, such as, categories of guarding, etc. of machines.
In depth knowledge of statutory compliance in relation to occupational health, safety and environment, fire and life safety
Understanding of ISO 14001 and OHSAS 18001 standards on EHS
Various acts of Laws, such as, Factories Act, Labor Laws, Employee Compensation Act, etc
AboutCompany:
ITC Foods Business Division (FBD) is one of the leading players in India Foods FMCG sector, housing over 40+ iconic brands such as Aashirvaad, Bingo, Yippee, Sunfeast, Candyman, B Natural, Fabelle, ITC Master Chef, and Sunrise. These brands span a diverse range of categoriesStaples, Snacks, Biscuits, Spices, Confectionery, and Frozen Foodsand many are leaders in their segments.

ITC envisions becoming India’s most trusted and innovative packaged foods company, enriching lives through safe, nutritious, sustainable, and delightful food experiences. With initiatives like ‘Eat Right’, responsible sourcing, and digital integration, ITC aims to build a future-ready, purpose-led enterprise that creates inclusive growth and transforms the Indian food landscape.

Description:
Job Description: Associate / Senior Associate Used Commercial Vehicle
Finance (Ahmedabad, Baroda, Mumbai (all areas), Pune)
Job Summary
We are seeking a dynamic, result-oriented Field Sales Executive to drive growth in our
Used Commercial Vehicle (CV) Finance division. The ideal candidate will have a
minimum of 2 years of direct field experience in used CV financing, a strong local
network of brokers, dealers, and fleet operators, and a proven track record of meeting
monthly disbursement targets.
Key Responsibilities & KRAs
• Achieve Sales Targets: Meet and exceed monthly and quarterly disbursement
targets for Used Commercial Vehicles and any new CV products introduced by
the company.
• Lead Generation & Sourcing: Identify and develop new business opportunities
through direct field visits, cold calling, and local networking.
• Channel Management: Build and maintain strong relationships with used
vehicle dealers, brokers, mechanics, and local transport hubs.
• Customer Assessment: Conduct preliminary credit and financial screenings of
customers, evaluating their profile, repayment capacity, and asset condition.
• End-to-End Logistical Management: Oversee the loan process from document
collection and login to verification, valuation, and final disbursement.
• Portfolio Health & Collections: Assist the credit and collections team in
monitoring early delinquencies and ensuring timely recovery from acquired
portfolios.
Required Qualifications & Skills
• Experience: Minimum 2 to 5 years of core field experience specifically in Used
CV Finance (experience in Light, Medium, or Heavy Commercial Vehicles).
• Education: Graduate or Under-Graduate degree in any stream.
• Market Knowledge: Deep understanding of the local used commercial vehicle
market, asset valuation nuances, and competitor practices.
• Skills: Strong negotiation, interpersonal communication, and relationship-
building skills.
• Mobility: Must possess a valid driving license and a personal two-wheeler for
extensive field travel.

What We Offer
• Competitive fixed salary and a highly lucrative performance-based incentive
structure.
• Travel allowances.
• Fast-tracked career progression opportunities within a growing financial
institution.

Description:
The B2B College Connect Sales role is responsible for driving institutional sales across engineering colleges and universities. The role focuses on acquiring new academic partners, expanding existing accounts, and positioning L&T EduTechs industry-aligned skilling and learning solutions to higher education institutions. The incumbent will manage end-to-end sales cycles, engage academic stakeholders, and ensure sustained business growth within the assigned territory.

Key Responsibilities
Drive B2B institutional sales for College Connect programs across assigned regions.
Identify and engage with engineering colleges, universities, and academic institutions to promote L&T EduTech offerings.
Build strong relationships with Principals, Directors, Deans, HODs and academic leadership.
Understand institutional needs and propose solution-based skilling programs aligned to curriculum enhancement and employability outcomes.
Manage the complete sales lifecycle including lead generation, proposal submission, negotiation, and deal closure.
Achieve assigned revenue, acquisition, and growth targets consistently.
Ensure repeat business and account expansion within existing partner institutions.
Coordinate with internal teams (content, delivery, operations, finance) to ensure smooth program onboarding and execution.
Track and maintain sales pipeline, forecasts, and customer interactions in CRM systems.
Monitor market trends, competitor offerings, and NEP-driven changes to refine sales pitches and proposals.
Participate in academic events, conferences, and institutional meetings to strengthen brand presence.

Reporting: Head College Connect Sales

Educational Qualifications
Bachelors degree in Engineering (Preferred)
MBA / Postgraduate qualification in Marketing or Business Management (Preferred)

Domain & Functional Expertise
Strong experience in B2B institutional sales, preferably in EdTech or higher education solutions. Good understanding of engineering education ecosystem and campus buying processes.

Behavioral & Professional Skills:
Strong communication, presentation, and negotiation skills.
Relationship-driven approach with the ability to manage multiple stakeholders.
Result-oriented mindset with strong ownership and execution focus.
Professional demeanor with high ethical standards.
Willingness to travel extensively within the assigned territory.

Territorial Scope: Regional / Location (as assigned)
AboutCompany: L&T EduTech is an initiative of the Larsen & Toubro Group focused on bridging the gap between academia and industry. It works with universities, colleges, enterprises, and professionals to deliver industry-aligned learning, skilling, assessments, and certification programs. L&T EduTech leverages the Groups extensive industry expertise to develop practical, future-ready skills and improve employability across engineering, technology, and other professional domains.

Description:
Role & responsibilities
Title Store Manager
Reporting to Area Operations Manager
Skip Level City/Zonal Manager
About the Role
A Store Manager at Lenskart acts as an important link between strategy and execution. He/she drives the store towards achieving all assigned metrics of Store Sales, Conversions, Customer satisfaction etc. and is responsible for keeping a high level of morale among the store staff, developing them, controlling attrition, and ensuring smooth operations at the store.
Responsibilities
Area

Activities expected to be performed by a Lenskart Store Manager
Customer focus:
Driving Net
Promoter Score

Greeting customers when they enter store and coaching the team to do the same
Displaying commitment towards providing exceptional Customer Service and ensuring that Lenskart associates also treat Customer Satisfaction as a priority
Dealing with customer service issues such as queries and complaints at store level and ensuring this is consistent with the team
Striving to have long lasting and fruitful relationships with each of our customers
Driving sales vs.
plan

Driving the sales of the store to meet the allotted targets by allocating the targets to the staff
Developing a culture of high sales performance expectations, i.e. Sales Leadership
Motivating and inspiring the field team to drive for results
Assessing field capability and establish performance priorities at group level
People development
(Attrition
Control)

Assisting in recruiting and selecting high potential staff
Providing effective on-the-job training and guidance to team members making use of company training modules
Delivering clear, motivating and constructive feedback in a timely manner to all retail associates
Evaluating the training needs of store associates and working closely with L&D department to execute the developmental plan
Understanding the reasons for attrition and taking measures to control it
Cash & Inventory management

Monitoring cash reconciliation to ensure there is no mismatch of store funds
Ensuring availability of required merchandise and services
Conducting stocktakes regularly
Ensuring the staff at store level has basic understanding of POS System to ensure transactions are properly and effectively processed
Performing the necessary quality checks for the new products
Working very closely with other departments till the product reaches the customer and ensuring the best customer experience to the Lenskart Customer
Supervision

Ensuring that all store employees, including the Optometrist, are taken care of and their issues are resolved
Ensuring that the eye check-ups are conducted as per the SOP and maintain high quality standards
Preferred candidate profile :
Candidate should has to 4 to 10 Years of Experience in store managing

Perks and benefits
ESI and PF
Family insurance policy
Incentive policy : Daily - weekends - monthly - festival incentive program.
Professional Training : 25 Days training in Bangalore post selection in Lenskart Academy .

bout the Role

Description:
Job Opening: Deputy Manager Accounting & Commercial (Cable Division)

Experience: 4 - 5 years
Compensation: 20 LPA 25 LPA
Age Limit: 25–35 years


Key Responsibilities
Financial Accounting & Closure: Manage day-to-day general ledger accounting, plant/project accounting, and ensure timely month-end financial closure for the Cable Division.
Commercial Governance: Oversee vendor contract evaluations, customer credit management, receivables tracking, and commercial terms verification.
Working Capital Optimization: Monitor and optimize key working capital drivers including Accounts Payable (AP), Accounts Receivable (AR), and inventory valuation/provisions.
SAP S/4HANA Operations: Leverage SAP S/4HANA (FI & CO modules) for general ledger management, cost center reporting, and seamless financial postings.
Profitability Insights (COPA): Utilize COPA to generate granular segment-wise, product-wise, and customer-wise revenue and margin insights.
MIS & Business Reporting: Prepare monthly Management Information Systems (MIS) reports, plant performance dashboards, and comprehensive budget vs. actual variance analysis.
Taxation & Compliance: Support compliance for GST returns, TDS submissions, and tax audits in close coordination with corporate tax teams.

Candidate Requirements
Qualification: Qualified Chartered Accountant (CA) (Mandatory).
Experience: 4 to 5 years of post-qualification experience in Accounting, Commercial Finance, Plant Finance, or Business Finance within a manufacturing environment (Cable, Electrical, Capital Goods, or Process Manufacturing preferred).


How to Apply
If you match the criteria and are ready for an exciting career growth opportunity, please share your updated CV to bhargavi_s@trigent.com.

Description:
Field Account Manager BioA

For Sartorius India Pvt. Ltd, we are looking for a Field Account Manager to join our team in Ahmadabad Pune Mumbai. In this role, you will be responsible for supporting the growth of revenue by proactively managing a range of accounts throughout Maharashtra, Gujrat, and Goa by developing and maintaining strong KOL relationships. The goal is to achieve individual and assigned group sales target within the financial year for BioAnalytics product portfolio.
Job Summary
For Sartorius India Pvt. Ltd, we are looking for a Field Account Manager to join our team in Ahmadabad Pune Mumbai. In this role, you will be responsible for supporting the growth of revenue by proactively managing a range of accounts throughout Maharashtra, Gujrat, and Goa by developing and maintaining strong KOL relationships. The goal is to achieve individual and assigned group sales target within the financial year for BioAnalytics product portfolio.
Main Responsibilities Tasks:
Initiate and manage the full sales process within the assigned territory and product range
BioAnalytics group consist of BLI (Octet), SPR (SF3), Live Cell Analysis system (Incucyte), Flow Cytometer (iQue), and Cell Selection and retrieval system (CellCelector).
Maintain the CRM with relevant and up-to-date customer and sales opportunity information in SFDC.
Develop and achieve account targets understanding customer needs and future plans.
Be customer-centric ensuring customer satisfaction without compromising the business.
Expand networks and sellupsell additional products and services.
Provide trainings, technical and commercial support to Sales Reps and customers in relevant products and processes.
Actively contribute to sales growth by identifying new opportunities at customer site.
KOL Management and development.
Identify and implement appropriate action plans to track key accounts consumption patterns.
This is an Individual contributor role.
Qualification Skills:
Master in life sciences (Biotechnology, Microbiology or Biochemistry), With a PhD preferred. Experience in the industry from Bioasay group or Biosimilar groups preferred.
Minimum 5 years of field sales experience in the west region. Candidates with international experience are an addition.
Experience in handling Live Cell imagers, Confocal microscopes, Flow Cytometry, SPR or from the Cell Biology field will be preferred.
Relevant technical knowledge and extensive industry knowledge (eg. Biotech, Pharma, etc.)
Experience in selling capital instrumentation is an addon.
Result-oriented and highly motivated.
Capable of providing outstanding customer service.
Ability to manage complex issues using innovation and processes.
A track record of strong compliance and customer reference is required.
Ability to manage and work in Matrix organization.

Description:
Profile : Wealth Manager

Location : Mumbai

Job Summary :
As a Wealth Manager, you will be responsible for providing personalized financial advice and guidance to high net worth individuals. You will play a crucial role in managing and growing our clients' wealth portfolios, while ensuring excellent customer satisfaction. This is a dynamic role that requires a deep understanding of financial markets, strong analytical skills, and exceptional interpersonal abilities.

Responsibilities:

Understanding the financial need & risk appetite of the client & recommending suitable
products from the array of financial products available with us like - Mutual Funds, PMS,
Bonds,NCD, Structured Products, Equity, AIF,Private Equity, Real Estate, Life
insurance, General Insurance etc (We work as an Open Architecture).

Advising Affluent clients on their Investments across a gamut of wealth products and
managing their overall financial portfolio.
Analyse client portfolios and make necessary suggestions.
Seek to establish a level of trust and confidence with the client so that any financial need
can be addressed and solutions offered.

Achieving financial goals and maintaining organization brand value.

Ensure highest levels of customer service and experience to these customers.

Interact with clients to update them on research calls and advising on asset allocation within their financial portfolio and guide them on their investment.

Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, or a related field
Proven experience as a Wealth Relationship Manager or similar role in the financial services
industry
Strong knowledge of investment products, financial planning strategies, and wealth
management practices

Excellent communication and interpersonal skills

Ability to build and maintain long-term client relationships

Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities
Requirements:

Team Leading Experience of minimum 5-8 years in Wealth Management.

Existing book and client relationship preferable.

In depth knowledge of various products of Wealth Management.

Knowledge of relevant Taxation applicable to the Wealth Management.

Good Oral and written communication Skills.

Description:
Company: G4S

Location: Ahmedabad
Job Type: Full-Time
Experience: Fresher / Experienced
Qualification: Any Graduate / Undergraduate with good communication skills

Job Summary
We are looking for energetic and target-oriented Telecallers / Recruitment Telecallers to support our recruitment and candidate onboarding activities at G4S.
The selected candidate will be responsible for calling prospective candidates from various internal databases, following up with them, motivating them to join, and ensuring successful onboarding.
Freshers with good communication skills and a willingness to work in a target-driven environment are welcome to apply.

Key Responsibilities
Make outbound calls to candidates from various available databases.
Contact and follow up with:
Absconded candidates
Non-deployed candidates
ATS database candidates
Candidates who have previously applied for G4S job opportunities
Other available recruitment databases
Understand candidate requirements and provide relevant information about available job opportunities.
Motivate and convince suitable candidates to attend interviews and complete the joining process.
Regularly follow up with candidates until successful onboarding.
Maintain accurate records of candidate calls, responses, follow-ups, and joining status.
Update candidate details and recruitment status in the required system/database.
Achieve daily, weekly, and monthly calling and onboarding targets.
Coordinate with the recruitment and operations teams for smooth candidate deployment.
Handle candidate queries professionally and provide timely resolutions.
Work efficiently in a target-oriented and high-pressure environment.

Candidate Requirements
Education
Any Graduate / Undergraduate
Freshers are welcome to apply.

Skills Required
Good communication and convincing skills.
Comfortable making a high volume of outbound calls.
Good follow-up and candidate engagement skills.
Basic knowledge of MS Excel and computer applications.
Ability to work in a target-driven environment.
Ability to handle work pressure and meet deadlines.
Good interpersonal and coordination skills.
Positive attitude and willingness to learn.

Preferred Candidate Profile
Male or Female candidates can apply.
Freshers and experienced candidates are welcome.
Experience in Telecalling, Recruitment Calling, Customer Support, Sales Calling, or BPO will be an added advantage.
Candidates who are comfortable working with targets and high call volumes.
Candidates with strong convincing and follow-up skills.
CompanyAddress: 9th Floor, Good Earth Trade Tower, Sector 62, Gurgaon, GURGAON, Haryana, India

About IIFL Finance Ltd
IIFL Finance is one of the most preferred Gold Loan financing company inIndia

Having presence in 25 states and a network of 2700+ branches on a PANIndia level, our mission is to cater to the needs of all those who are lookingfor an easy swift, and low-cost financing option

Our customers can avail gold loansthrough submitting an online application or visiting any of our branches intheir vicinity

We also have an option where the customers can avail gold loansat their doorstep so that they are not deprived of financing options to fulfilltheir needs

Our core values serve as a moral compass in all our activities

Fairness, Integrity, andTransparency - FIT is the driving force behind all that we do at IIFL

Weonly work with people who fit into our professional ethos

We are resolute inthe observance of these values and will let go of any growth opportunities thatdeem unfit

Primary Responsibilities:
Attending to walk-in customers, addressingqueries about the gold loan process and schemes offered

Conducting gold valuations andidentifying gold purity accurately

Properly packing and storing gold andgold packets after loan disbursal

Returning gold ornaments to customers afterloan closure

Managing cash (system physical)during loan disbursals, interest collection, and loan closures

Create new CUID in system modifications in LOS during Disbursal, Part Release / Payments LoanClosure

Maintain branch registers as per theguidelines Key / Cash / Packet Movements, Staff Customer Visits etc
Ensuring proper collection and storageof customer KYC documents

Following up with customers for timelycollection of interest and principal payments

Providing good customer service at everystep ie while pledging, releasing, or making interest payments

Additional Responsibilities: Insummary, the Gold appraiser is responsible for the end-to-end transactionprocess for gold loans - from valuation to disbursal to closure, along withcustomer service

CTC Upto 3 Lacs ( for Non-Metro) / 4

20 Lacs ( for Metro )
Incentives extra - Best in the industry

Description:
Key Responsibilities
1. Quality Strategy & Leadership
Develop and implement manufacturing quality assurance strategies and improvement plans.
Establish manufacturing process quality standards, specifications, and controls.
Utilize data-driven decision-making to enhance quality performance.
Provide quality performance reporting to management and stakeholders.
Mentor and support quality professionals where applicable.
Deliver quality awareness training and coaching to manufacturing personnel.
2. Customer Quality Focus
Support fulfillment of customer-specific quality requirements.
Analyze customer complaints, feedback, and quality concerns.
Participate in cross-functional initiatives aimed at improving customer satisfaction.
Translate customer expectations into manufacturing process improvements.
3. Quality Management System (QMS)
Develop and maintain SOPs, work instructions, and process controls.
Conduct process audits and compliance assessments.
Ensure adherence to quality standards, procedures, and regulatory requirements.
Train manufacturing teams on quality management practices and risk mitigation methods.
4. Manufacturing Quality Assurance
Conduct Process Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (PFMEA).
Identify manufacturing and assembly process risks.
Develop and implement risk mitigation plans.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to eliminate potential quality failures.
Monitor effectiveness of risk controls and preventive actions.
Maintain and update risk assessments throughout the product lifecycle.
Manage change control activities related to:
Product features
Manufacturing processes
Materials
Suppliers
Design modifications

Job Description: Regional Manager Automobile Sales

Company: CARS24
Locations: Ahmedabad, Pune, Rajkot
Contact Person: Kavita Dangwal
Team: People & Culture | CARS24
Phone: 9311243497
Email: kavita.dangwal@cars24.com

About the Role

CARS24 is looking for a dynamic and results-driven Regional Manager to lead automobile sales and retail operations across the assigned region. The ideal candidate will have strong experience in automotive sales, business development, team leadership, and achieving sales targets, preferably in the used-car or new-car dealership industry.

Key Responsibilities
*Regional Sales Management: Drive automobile sales and business growth across multiple locations within the assigned region.
*Business Development: Develop strategies to increase vehicle sales, procurement, revenue, and market share.
*Team Leadership: Lead, coach, and mentor sales managers and frontline sales teams to achieve business objectives.
*Dealer & Partner Management: Build and maintain strong relationships with new-car dealerships, used-car dealers, and other automotive business partners.
*Target Achievement: Monitor sales performance, conversion rates, inventory movement, and key business KPIs to ensure targets are met.
*Market Expansion: Identify new business opportunities, strengthen market presence, and expand the regional dealer network.
*Customer Experience: Ensure a smooth customer journey and maintain high standards of service and customer satisfaction.
*Performance Monitoring: Analyse regional sales data, identify performance gaps, and implement corrective action plans.
*Operational Excellence: Ensure adherence to company processes, sales policies, and operational standards.
*Cross-functional Coordination: Work closely with procurement, operations, and other teams to improve business performance.
Candidate Requirements
*2-8 years of experience in automobile sales, preferably in the used-car, new-car dealership, automotive retail, or automotive e-commerce industry.
*Prior experience in managing sales teams and driving regional or multi-location business performance.
*Strong understanding of automobile sales, dealer relationships, vehicle procurement and retail operations.
*Proven ability to achieve sales targets, improve conversions, and drive revenue growth.
*Excellent leadership, negotiation, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
*Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with a focus on business KPIs.
*A go-getter mindset with the ability to work in a fast-paced, target-driven environment.
What Were Looking For
A strong sales leader with a passion for the automobile industry who can drive regional growth, build high-performing teams, strengthen dealer partnerships, and deliver sustainable business results.

We are looking for process-driven, consultative B2B Sales Managers who can operate inside a structured, CRM-led sales system. Build and manage a high-quality sales pipeline using the Companys defined stages.
Drive structured deal progression from lead qualification to closure.

Strong command of pipeline math and forecasting logic.
Proven CRM discipline (Zoho, HubSpot, Salesforce, etc.).

Excellent communication with owners, ops heads, and IT managers.
A problem-solving, process-driven mindset — thrives under accountability.

Description:
Role & responsibilities
1. Sales Approach and Target Orientation: The desired RMH candidate must have an excellent aptitude for sales and marketing and must be very focused towards generating quality leads with maximum probability for conversion. He/she must have a strong orientation to generate and bring new customers to the branches and add new customers to our fold.
2. Exceptional Planning and Execution Skills: RMH must plan and execute the local flavored activities for the branches of the Region allocated to the RMH to ensure that the branches achieve their monthly and quarterly business targets of New Customer Acquisition for Gold Loan and Other Financial Products. New customer acquisition (new KYC) is the primary metric on which an RMHs effectiveness will be measured and hence RMHs primary focus must be to ensure his/her Region achieves its new KYC target without fail.
3. Monitoring Skills: RMHs must coordinate with the branches and the vendors on a regular basis to ensure the proper execution of the sanctioned regional BTL activities. He/she should have the ability to take branch staff along and ensure the BTL activities are conducted effectively and collectively to create top quality leads. He/she should also have the ability to foresee if there are any possible leakages or misreporting being done at agency level and should be able to check it, plug it and correct it.
4. Competition Tracking & Monitoring: RMH should proactively visit branches of competitors and prepare a counter competition strategy on a monthly / Quarterly basis to highlight what competitors are doing in his Region at BTL level and how does he/she plan to counter it.
5. Branch visits: All branches of in his/her Region must be visited by the RMH at least once in every Quarter to understand the on-ground issues, faade related branding issues, use/misuse of branch collaterals and merchandise, understand the branchs catchment area, competitors active in the respective branchs neighborhood and then finally plan and execute effective marketing initiatives which are specific to the branch, to address identified issues.
6. Branch Branding and Visual Branch Merchandise: RMH must ensuring effective branch branding, ensuring every branch in his Region stands out and is well-equipped with prominent and well-placed lit Glow Sign Boards (GSBs and Vertical GSBs), suitable quantity of branch merchandise, collaterals etc It is also his/ her responsibility to ensure that no branch has abundance of marketing collaterals / marketing material which lies unused or gets wasted later. Thus, his / her role does not end with just supplying this material but also includes their best utilization to drive business impact and ensure nil wastage.
7. Branch Launch: Whenever a new branch is being opened, RMH is entrusted with preparing a detailed report on the available opportunity in the branch’s catchment area and once the branch opening date is finalized, he/she is expected to plan a detailed marketing plan with various new branch opening activities that create awareness in the neighborhood and also drives footfall and business conversion for the new branch.
8. Vendor Management: RMH is expected to bring with him/her a good network of vendors, marketing agencies, partners, and collaborators with whom he can work closely to execute his marketing plans. He/she should also have good negotiation skills to ensure he gets the best out of his partners without compromising quality of execution.
9. Lead Management: RMH must also ensure that branches follow-up on leads generated through BTL activities timely and effectively. He must ensure leads so generated are entered in CRM under correct marketing activity source and converted aggressively to achieve targets.
10. Coordination for ATL Activities: RMH must coordinate with Corporate Office and monitor the execution of the ATL Activities such as Newspaper Ad releases, Outdoor Campaigns, Cable TV activities, TV Ads in Regional Channels etc Effectively and bring to the notice of seniors at CO North Marketing department in case he/she observes any anomalies.
MIS: RMH must prepare a monthly MIS of the response generated by the local BTL Activities along with other monitoring of ATL/BTL Campaigns. Timely execution of BTL activities as per CRM schedule, sharing of periodic reports with 100% execution photographs is also an important part of his / her role.


Preferred candidate profile
1. Graduation / Post Graduation
2. Minimum 2-3 years of relevant work experience in marketing domain, preferably with BFSI / Retail exposure. Professionals with increased work experience will be treated differently.
3. Good communication skills, fairly good in written and spoken English
4. Excellent knowledge of MS Office
5. Extremely honest, committed and must possess highest degree of integrity.

Develop APIs and microservices for AI model integration.

Follow MLOps best practices for model deployment, experimentation, and monitoring.

Job Requirements
This position is a mechanical integrity technical position for fixed equipment in support of petrochemical facility
This position provides technical support to the client with a focus on managing the risk based inspection program, troubleshooting, asset improvement, and technology selection
Provide strong technical leadership in Inspection/Corrosion Management for Oil & Gas upstream/downstream assets
Provide technical solution in upstream/downstream Asset Integrity
Has ability to create innovative solutions /automations/ methodologies to build a differentiation for Quest Global
Integrity assessment/assurance activities like FFS, Corrosion Evaluations and Remaining Life Studies
Drive and manage Integrity Engineers to execute the workflows with Quality at scale 
Provide pre-sales support for new business deals and post-sales support for the new projects assigned
Drive core team members to recruit skilled resources or train internal resources to achieve the targets
Act as a bridge between customer, sales organization and global technical teams
Lead Develop, nurture and manage global customer relationships and drive strategic partnering initiatives to address unique business situations and complex technology needs
Review technical scoping, estimation, fitment and feasibility studies, mapping customer expectations and solution design, prepared by Program Managers and Project Leader
Degradation evaluations related to pressure equipment, heat exchangers, piping circuits, fired equipment, flares, above ground storage tanks, and/or pressure relief devices.
Monitoring and surveillance of integrity parameters to ensure reliable operations.
Troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and integrity recommendation stewardship.
Bad actor identification and analysis to reduce equipment downtime.
Data analytics, digital tools/ technologies and operationalize upgraded work practices through digital transformation.
Overall integrity effectiveness and management which includes, criticality assessments, consequence/ complexity rating of fixed equipment, development of fit-for-purpose risk based strategies, setting optimum task intervals including considerations to local regulations/ statutory requirements, timely review of inspection findings, and ever-greening of strategies.
Work Experience
Engineering degree (Mechanical/Materials or Chemical) 6 to 12 years of oil gas experience in related industry (refining/petrochemical/LNG/oil & gas) 
Should have sound knowledge on Oil & Gas upstream and downstream business in the following areas 
- Risk Based Inspection methodologies
- Fixed equipment inspection tasks/ procedures 
- Inspection Optimization
- Piping Circutization/TML development
- API Damage Mechanisms of Refinery/Chemicals 
- In-service inspection of all types of fixed equipment 
- Knowledge of materials and standards
- Knowledge of corrosion & welding
- Knowledge of NDTs
-Thickness inspection management and analysis
- Corrosion management and analysis
- Inspection plan development/ optimization.
- Knowledge of software (APM Meridium/Pestra/Credo, etc.) 
- Ability to lead teams
- Excellent communication
Should have working knowledge of oil and gas plant operations 
Should have exposure to Operating condition Safety, SHE risks, spill/ safety incident and equipment failure opportunities 
Should have Knowledge of various roles and responsibilities of engineers working in the oil and gas field/site 
Should have knowledge of corrective and preventative maintenance strategy 
Should have knowledge of International standards in design, quality, and procedures for approved equipment
Working knowledge in key sections of ASME Sec Div. 1/2, ASME Sec V, ASME Sec IX, ASME Sec Il, ASME B31.3/ B31.1/ B31.4/ B31.8, ASME PCC-2
Field in-service inspection and repair of pressure equipment, heat exchangers, piping systems, pressure relief devices and above ground storage tanks in operating unit
Good to have skills:
Certification and in-depth working knowledge in API 580, API 510, API 570, API 571 , API 653, NACE Senior Corrosion Technologist, BSI ISO/ ENI AS Standards, AWS/ CSWIP/ ASNT NDT Techniques
Experience with Meridium/Credo/Pestra and SAP

Job Description: Consultant Operations Excellence / Business Process Reengineering (BPR)
1. Role Overview
The Consultant serves as the execution layer of client engagements, responsible for conducting analyses, developing solutions, supporting implementation, and ensuring disciplined execution of project workstreams. The role involves working closely with client functional teams to identify improvement opportunities, redesign processes, and drive operational efficiency through data-driven decision-making and digital enablement.
2. Key Roles and Responsibilities
Conduct diagnostic assessments to identify process gaps, inefficiencies, and opportunities for operational improvement.
Perform data-driven analyses to support problem-solving, root cause analysis (RCA), and business decision-making.
Support Business Process Reengineering (BPR), process redesign, and implementation initiatives.
Develop process maps, value stream maps, and workflow documentation to identify bottlenecks and improvement opportunities.
Support productivity improvement, operational excellence, manufacturing excellence, and supply chain optimisation initiatives.
Assist in digital transformation, process automation, and Generative AI (GenAI) enablement initiatives.
Develop client-ready deliverables, including analytical reports, presentations, dashboards, and recommendations.
Coordinate with client functional teams to drive project execution and implementation activities.
Maintain action trackers, status reports, project documentation, and PMO deliverables.
Apply Lean, Six Sigma, and continuous improvement methodologies to enhance process efficiency.
Leverage advanced Excel, Power BI, and other analytical tools to generate insights and monitor performance.
Support change management activities and develop an understanding of business requirements and operating models.
3. Experience Requirements
Minimum 2 years of relevant professional experience preferred.
Experience in sales is preferred, as specified in the role requirements.
Experience in management consulting, operations excellence, manufacturing excellence, supply chain, industrial engineering, or digital transformation is desirable.
Candidates with exposure to manufacturing environments, shop-floor operations, or business consulting will be preferred.
4. Educational Qualifications
Mandatory: B.Tech/B.E. in a core engineering specialisation, such as Mechanical, Electronics, Production, Metallurgy, Instrumentation, or a related engineering discipline.
Preferred: MBA/PGP in Operations, Supply Chain, Analytics, Manufacturing, or a related discipline.
5. Functional and Technical Skills
Core Functional Skills
Business Process Reengineering (BPR)
Operations Excellence and Manufacturing Excellence
Digital Transformation and AI Enablement
Process Mapping and Value Stream Mapping
Productivity Improvement and Root Cause Analysis
Lean Management and Six Sigma
Process Automation and Digital Operating Models
Change Management and Business Process Improvement
PMO Support, Action Tracking, and Status Reporting
Technical Skills
Advanced Microsoft Excel Mandatory
Power BI – Mandatory
Tableau
Basic SQL
Microsoft PowerPoint
GenAI fundamentals and prompt engineering
Digital productivity tools and process automation solutions
AI and digital transformation certifications will be considered an added advantage.
6. Key Competencies
Structured problem-solving
Strong analytical and critical-thinking abilities
Effective written and verbal communication
Stakeholder coordination and presentation skills
Ownership and accountability
Adaptability and willingness to learn
Understanding of business processes and change management
Ability to manage defined work packages and execute project deliverables within timelines
7. Industry Background
Candidates from the following backgrounds will be preferred:
Management Consulting
Manufacturing and Industrial Engineering
Operations and Supply Chain
Operational and Manufacturing Excellence
Business Process Reengineering and Process Improvement
Digital Transformation and AI Enablement

In alignment with Hitachi Energy High Voltage's learning vision and growth strategy, this role will help architect our inaugural training center of expertise and knowledge community. This will include creating engaging technical content and courses, utilizing micro-, people-centric, role- skill- and level-based learning methodologies.
If you're ready to transform our onboarding and learning journey, then we want to hear from you.
Responsibilities
Working closely with the Global Learning Manager, you will collaborate with cross-cultural and functional leaders, technical subject matter experts, knowledge owners, and learning experts to determine and create content to fulfill critical knowledge needs. This role will help architect our inaugural Global HV Learning Center of Expertise.
You will create skill- and role-based learning objectives, assessments, certifications, stories, scenarios, knowledge checks, case studies, interactive activities, scripts, content, and videos adhering to all branded standards, processes, and style-guides.
You will interpret skill matrixes to determine critical knowledge gaps and develop training content. You will create step-by-step guides, best practice and troubleshooting documents, infographics, animations, videos, interactive elements, learning activities, assessments, gamification, and courses while maintaining the highest standards of safety, quality, compliance, and operational excellence.
Interpret content analytics for success and continuous improvement by implementing a plan of improvement to address poor review comments, low ratings and completions.
Support the acceleration of our employees' learning by creating content that onboards, assesses, and advances skill acquisition and proficiency.
Lead and track projects that align with goals to ensure on-time and quality completion.
Develop, edit, and maintain content and other documentation that enhance the effectiveness of on-the-job training and inquiry-based (hands on) learning.
A bachelor's degree is required, with a master's degree preferred in Technology, Science, Technical Writing, or Instructional Design.


Your Background
Advanced knowledge and in-depth experience in adult micro-learning, skill- and role-based training design, skill mapping, learning levels and learning paths, people-centric, scenario-based, and adaptive learning methodologies.
Experience in development and maintenance of high-stakes internal examinations.
Advanced experience using: Camtasia, Articulate 360 (Storyline, Review, and Rise), Screen Capture, Vyond, Synthesia, Adobe Creative Suite, and a Learning Management System.
A minimum of 10 years of experience in andragogy learning, training, and/or knowledge content management in manufacturing, engineering, higher education, and/or technology industries is required.
Highly organized and detail-oriented, capable of managing multiple projects simultaneously.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, comfortable working with employees across the organization.
Demonstrated flexibility to adjust training approaches to meet evolving employee needs.

Description:
Job Title: Inside Sales Executive
Job Location: Vadodara (Onsite)
Shift Timings: US shift (Night Shift)

About the Role
Collabera is looking for a Account executive - Inside sales who can cultivate opportunities for the development of the business and plans strategies to target potential clients and customers. Inside sales Team is the cornerstone of any successful organization because they ultimately generate new revenue by getting client business referrals, network, and web leads and Provide prospective customers/clients with all services offered, and additional presentations as needed. Therefore, they need to upgrade themselves regularly with current industry trends and maintain good relations with potential business entrepreneurs.

What You'll Do
Responsible for coordinating activities related to sales and customer service on clients' accounts
Identifying, qualifying, and securing business opportunities
Creating a sales pipeline while working on pre-identified accounts
Setting up meetings with US-based clients via calls and Emails
Acknowledge incoming telephone calls, emails, letters, and messages, and pass it to the sales representative or account manager to provide a detailed response
Building business relationships with current and potential clients
Collaborating with clients in the US to secure, retain, and grow accounts
Doing extensive Market Research on all potential clients
Developing customized targeted sales strategies
Coordinating business generation activities
Answering potential client questions and follow-up call questions
Meeting or exceeding annual sales goals.
Collaborating with management on sales goals, planning, and forecasting

What Youll Need
Comfortable making calls and talking to new people all-day
Excellent verbal and written communication skills; the ability to call, connect and interact with clients
Persuasive and goal-oriented
Possesses an energetic, outgoing, and friendly demeanour
Eager to expand the company with new sales, clients, and territories
Self-motivated and self-directed
Able to multitask, prioritize, and manage time efficiently
In-depth understanding of company services and their position in the industry
Able to work accurately under stress and pressure to meet competing deadlines
Excellent analytical and time-management skills
Tenacity to handle rejection and continue with a positive attitude when reaching the next potential client
Ability to work independently or as an active member of a team
Strong computer skills, including Microsoft Office Suite (Word, PowerPoint, Outlook, and Excel)

Must Haves-
Experience with lead generation and prospect management
Cold calling experience; Previous experience as an inside sales representative, or related sales experience
Able to communicate with C-Level Executives professionally

You can apply here or else share your updated resume on nisarg.shah@collabera.com along with a preferred time to get on a call.

Description:
The opportunity:
Hitachi Energy is looking for a Project Manager for the High Voltage Business unit covering Gas Insulated Switchgear, Hybrid Gas Insulated Switchgear and Dead Tank Breaker product portfolio in Savli, Vadodara. The Project Manager is responsible for the successful execution of GIS Projects, HGIS & DTB orders execution throughout the entire project lifecycle. This role ensures that all project activities are executed in compliance with contractual requirements, company policies, quality standards, HSE regulations, financial objectives, and delivery commitments.
How you'll make an impact:
Establish the overall project execution strategy and lead projects from handover through successful completion, customer acceptance, and project closure.
Manage and execute domestic and export customer projects, ensuring full compliance with contractual, commercial, logistics, global trade compliance, export control, customs, documentation, taxation, and customer-specific requirements while delivering project objectives related to schedule, quality, cost, cash flow, and customer satisfaction.
Drive project performance by effectively managing schedules, milestones, resource utilization, quality, and delivery commitments.
Monitor and control project financials, including revenue recognition, invoicing, cash collection, cost management, profitability, and cash flow.
Identify, assess, and proactively manage project risks, opportunities, claims, variations, and change orders throughout the project lifecycle.
Coordinate engineering, procurement, manufacturing, logistics, and site execution activities to ensure seamless project delivery.
Act as the primary customer interface and escalation point for all project-related matters, ensuring timely resolution of issues and effective stakeholder communication.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams and key internal stakeholders to ensure alignment with project objectives and business priorities.
Ensure successful completion of project close-out activities, including contractual closure, final documentation, lessons learned, and customer acceptance.
Build and maintain strong customer relationships to enhance customer satisfaction, repeat business, and long-term growth opportunities.
Coach and support project team members while fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, operational excellence, and continuous improvement.
Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance project execution effectiveness, efficiency, and customer experience.
Responsible for ensuring compliance with applicable external and internal regulations, procedures, and guidelines.
Living Hitachi Energy's core values of safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business
Your background:
Degree in Electrical Engineering.
12 to 16 years of experience in Project Management of Turnkey EPC, GIS or AIS Substation projects.
High Voltage Switchgear industry experience preferred.
Strong knowledge of project management life cycle, PMBOK and PMP practices.
PMP certification or formal PM training preferred
Hands-on experience with SAP S/4HANA, MS Office, MS Project.
Knowledge of substations, Gas Insulated Switchgear and power system projects.
Good understanding of taxation, invoicing processes and export documentation.
Excellent leadership, stakeholder management, communication and negotiation skills.
Strong analytical ability, problem-solving skills and execution focus.
Self-motivated, collaborative and capable of working across multicultural teams.
Fluent in written and spoken English.

Exective
Designation Title: Program Executive - Education, Skilling Engagement
Department: Prgrammes
Business Unit: Arvind Foundation
Group Company: Arvind Limited
Location: Ahmedabad
Work Mode: Onsite
Role Summary
The Program Executive - Education, Skilling Engagement will support the delivery of programmes within Arvind Foundation's Prgrammes function.
This role focuses on coordinating education and skilling activities, supporting participant engagement, and ensuring smooth execution of assigned programme tasks.
The position involves working with internal teams, external agencies, and volunteers to help drive enrolment, track progress, and maintain programme documentation and reporting.
The role is suitable for a candidate with 0-5 years of experience who is proactive, organised, and learner-centric.
Key Responsibilities
Collect required qualitative and quantitative data and support data management activities.
Support the joining of new recruits and coordinate visits of potential FLMs.
Drive enrolment of girls in educational programmes such as Open Schooling, UG, PG, and ITI based on individual development plans.
Drive enrolment of girls in skilling programmes such as computer and English.
Track, monitor, and report on enrolled students' progress and results.
Coordinate and support agencies involved in the delivery of education and skilling programmes.
Work with Aakriti volunteers on different development sessions.
Support planning, coordination, documentation, and follow-up for programme activities as required.
Must-Have Skills
Bachelor's degree with work experience, or Master's degree in Education, Social Work, Psychology, Human Development, Vocational Education, or Rural Development.
0-1 year of experience in education, youth development, vocational training, employability programmes, CSR, or NGO-led skilling initiatives, preferably with adolescent girls and young women.
Experience in planning and delivering educational and skilling programmes, including academic support, life skills, digital literacy, career guidance, vocational training, and learner progress tracking.
Excellent communication, facilitation, mentoring, and relationship-building skills.
Strong understanding of MS Office, especially Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.
Strong planning, coordination, organisational, documentation, and MIS/reporting skills.
Ability to achieve programme targets within timelines.
Empathetic, proactive, learner-centric, and adaptable, with strong problem-solving skills.
Nice-to-Have Skills
Experience working with adolescent girls and young women.
Exposure to community-based education or skilling initiatives.
Familiarity with volunteer engagement and session facilitation.
Experience in maintaining programme dashboards or MIS trackers.
Basic understanding of career guidance and learner outcome tracking.

Description:
JOB SUMMARY
Entry level management position that is responsible for leading and assisting with the successful completion of daily shift requirements. Front office areas include Bell/Door Staff, Switchboard and Guest Services/Front Desk. Strives to ensure guest and employee satisfaction and achieve the operating budget. Assists in completing financial and administrative responsibilities.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- High school diploma or GED; 2 years experience in the guest services, front desk, or related professional area.
OR
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Hotel and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or related major; no work experience required.
CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Supporting Management of Front Desk Team
- Utilizes interpersonal and communication skills to lead, influence, and encourage others; advocates sound financial/business decision making; demonstrates honesty/integrity; leads by example.
- Encourages and building mutual trust, respect, and cooperation among team members.
- Serves as a role model to demonstrate appropriate behaviors.
- Supports all day-to-day operations.
- Understands employee positions well enough to perform duties in employees absence.
- Coaches, counsels and encourages employees.
- Handles employee questions and concerns.
- Supports all areas of the Front Office in the absence of the Front Office or Front Desk Manager.
- Guides daily Front Desk shift operations.
- Communicates performance expectations to employees in accordance with job descriptions for each position.
Monitoring and Supporting Progress Toward Guest Services and Front Desk Goals
- Manages day-to-day operations, ensuring the quality, standards and meeting the expectations of the customers on a daily basis.
- Develops specific goals and plans to prioritize, organize, and accomplish your work.
- Handles complaints, settling disputes, and resolving grievances and conflicts, or otherwise negotiating with others.
- Participates in department meetings and continually communicates a clear and consistent message regarding the Front Desk goals to produce desired results.
- Strives to improve service performance.
- Supervises staffing levels to ensure that guest service, operational needs and financial objectives are met.
- Trains staff on adherence to all credit policies and procedures to reduce bad debts and rebates.
- Supervises same day selling procedures to maximize room revenue and property occupancy.
- Understands the impact of Front Desk operations on the overall property financial goals and objectives.
Ensuring Exceptional Customer Service
- Provides services that are above and beyond for customer satisfaction and retention.
- Improves service by communicating and assisting individuals to understand guest needs, providing guidance, feedback, and individual coaching when needed.
- Sets a positive example for guest relations.
- Empowers employees to provide excellent customer service within guidelines.
- Handles guest problems and complaints seeking assistance from supervisor as necessary.
- Interacts with guests to obtain feedback on product quality and service levels.
Managing Projects and Policies
- Implementing the customer recognition/service program, communicating and ensuring the process.
- Assists in the review of comment cards and guest satisfaction results with employees.
- Ensures employees have the proper supplies and uniforms.
- Assists in the use of a guest information tracking system to ensure that a successful repeat guest recognition program is in use to recognize guest preferences and aid in problem resolution.
Supporting Handling of Human Resource Activities
- Identifying the developmental needs of others and coaching, mentoring, or otherwise helping others to improve their knowledge or skills.
- Providing guidance and direction to subordinates, including setting performance standards and monitoring performance.
- Provides feedback to individuals based on observation of service behaviors.
- Participates in an ongoing employee recognition program.
- Conducts training when appropriate.
- Participates in the employee performance appraisal process.
Additional Responsibilities
- Provides information to supervisors, co-workers, and subordinates by telephone, in written form, e-mail, or in person.
- Analyzes information and evaluating results to choose the best solution and solve problems.
- Informs and/or updating the executives, the peers and the subordinates on relevant information in a timely manner.
- Performs all duties at the Front Desk as necessary.
- Understands the functions of the Bell Staff, Switchboard and Concierge/Guest Services operations.
- Complies with loss prevention policies and procedures.

POSITION SUMMARY
Ensure staff is working together as a team to ensure optimum service and that guest needs are met. Inspect grooming and attire of staff, and rectify any deficiencies. Complete opening and closing duties including setting up necessary supplies and tools, cleaning all equipment and areas, locking doors, etc. Inspect storage areas for organization, use of FIFO, and cleanliness. Complete scheduled inventories and stock and requisition necessary supplies. Monitor dining rooms for seating availability, service, safety, and well being of guests. Complete work orders for maintenance repairs.
Assist management in hiring, training, scheduling, evaluating, counseling, disciplining, and motivating and coaching employees; and serve as a role model and first point of contact of the Guarantee of Fair Treatment/Open Door Policy process. Follow all company and safety and security policies and procedures; report accidents, injuries, and unsafe work conditions to manager; and complete safety training and certifications. Ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional, maintain confidentiality of proprietary information, and protect company assets. Welcome and acknowledge all guests according to company standards, anticipate and address guests service needs, assist individuals with disabilities, and thank guests with genuine appreciation. Speak with others using clear and professional language. Develop and maintain positive working relationships with others, support team to reach common goals, and listen and respond appropriately to the concerns of other employees. Ensure adherence to quality expectations and standards; and identify, recommend, develop, and implement new ways to increase organizational efficiency, productivity, quality, safety, and/or cost-savings. Read and visually verify information in a variety of formats (e.g., small print). Visually inspect tools, equipment, or machines (e.g., to identify defects). Stand, sit, or walk for an extended period of time or for an entire work shift. Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 50 pounds without assistance. Grasp, turn, and manipulate objects of varying size and weight, requiring fine motor skills and hand-eye coordination. Move through narrow, confined, or elevated spaces. Move up and down stairs and/or service ramps. Reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping. Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Education: High school diploma or G.E.D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: At least 2 years of related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: At least 1 year of supervisory experience.
License or Certification: None

Description:
The Opportunity:

Manufacturing Quality Assurance work includes: Defining and specifying activities, processes, and standards to fulfill the quality requirements for a manufactured material, component, or product. Building and maintaining the infrastructure and systems necessary to consistently ensure the timely delivery of quality products. Auditing, monitoring, and determining the quality of manufacturing processes and/or outputs against defined internal and regulatory standards. Reporting and troubleshooting manufacturing process deviations and defects in finished goods An Entry Professional (P1) applies broad theoretical job knowledge typically obtained through advanced education. May require the following proficiency: Work is closely supervised. Problems faced are not typically difficult or complex. Explains facts, policies and practices related to job area.

How you'll make an Impact:

1. Quality Strategy & Leadership
Develop and implement manufacturing quality assurance strategies and improvement plans.
Establish manufacturing process quality standards, specifications, and controls.
Utilize data-driven decision-making to enhance quality performance.
Provide quality performance reporting to management and stakeholders.
Mentor and support quality professionals where applicable.
Deliver quality awareness training and coaching to manufacturing personnel.
2. Customer Quality Focus
Support fulfillment of customer-specific quality requirements.
Analyze customer complaints, feedback, and quality concerns.
Participate in cross-functional initiatives aimed at improving customer satisfaction.
Translate customer expectations into manufacturing process improvements.
3. Quality Management System (QMS)
Develop and maintain SOPs, work instructions, and process controls.
Conduct process audits and compliance assessments.
Ensure adherence to quality standards, procedures, and regulatory requirements.
Train manufacturing teams on quality management practices and risk mitigation methods.
4. Manufacturing Quality Assurance
Conduct Process Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (PFMEA).
Identify manufacturing and assembly process risks.
Develop and implement risk mitigation plans.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to eliminate potential quality failures.
Monitor effectiveness of risk controls and preventive actions.
Maintain and update risk assessments throughout the product lifecycle.
Manage change control activities related to:
Product features
Manufacturing processes
Materials
Suppliers
Design modifications
5. Quality Control
Implement quality control plans and inspection requirements.
Conduct process audits, inspections, and verification activities.
Analyze test results, measurements, and statistical quality data.
Identify trends and improvement opportunities through data analysis.
Recommend and implement corrective actions to improve quality performance.
6. Process Performance Management
Monitor key process performance indicators.
Analyze manufacturing performance data and trends.
Support implementation of Statistical Process Control (SPC) techniques.
Maintain process performance documentation.
Drive corrective and preventive actions to improve process capability and efficiency.
Train operators and manufacturing teams on performance monitoring methods.
7. Non-Conformance Management
Investigate process and product non-conformities.
Lead root cause analyses using structured problem-solving methodologies such as:
8D
5 Why Analysis
Fishbone Diagram
Statistical Analysis Tools
Implement and verify effectiveness of corrective and preventive actions (CAPA).
8. Continuous Improvement
Lead and support continuous improvement initiatives across manufacturing operations.
Identify opportunities to improve:
Process capability
Product quality
Productivity
Cost efficiency
Operational performance
Participate in Lean and Six Sigma projects.
Facilitate waste reduction and process optimization activities.
Prioritize and execute improvement projects based on business impact.
Authority & Accountability
The position is accountable for:
Quality risk identification and mitigation.
PFMEA development and maintenance.
Manufacturing quality assurance activities.
Process audit execution.
Quality performance monitoring.
Continuous improvement project execution.
Supporting customer quality requirements and compliance

Your background:

B.E or B. Tech in Electrical or Mechanical with 5 to 10 years of experience

Business Information
Transformers BU team leverages innovative and diverse technology to transform energy, delivering social, environmental, and economic value and enabling a sustainable energy future for current and future generations. The business's comprehensive portfolio includes power transformers, traction transformers, insulation and components, digital sensors, and transformer services. Description:
JOB SUMMARY
Responsible for the daily shift operations of Housekeeping, Recreation/Health Club and, if applicable, Laundry. Directs and works with employees to verify property guestrooms, public space and employee areas are clean and well maintained. Completes inspections and holds people accountable for corrective action. Position assists in ensuring guest and employee satisfaction while maintaining the operating budget.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- High school diploma or GED; 2 years experience in the housekeeping or related professional area.
OR
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Hotel and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or related major; no work experience required.
CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Managing Housekeeping Operations and Budgets
- Verifies guest room status is communicated to the Front Desk in a timely and efficient manner.
- Inspects guestrooms on a daily basis.
- Obtains list of rooms to be cleaned immediately and list of prospective check-outs or discharges to prepare work assignments.
- Inventories stock to verify adequate supplies.
- Supports and supervises an effective inspection program for all guestrooms and public space.
- Understands the impact of department s operations on the overall property financial goals and objectives and manages to achieve or exceed budgeted goals.
- Verifies all employees have proper supplies, equipment and uniforms.
- Communicates areas that need attention to staff and follows up to verify understanding.
- Supervises daily Housekeeping shift operations and verifies compliance with all housekeeping policies, standards and procedures.
- Participates in departmental meetings and continually communicates a clear and consistent message regarding the departmental goals to produce desired results.
Conducting Human Resources Activities
- Uses all available on the job training tools to train new room attendants and provide follow-up training as necessary.
- Establishes and maintains open, collaborative relationships with employees and verifies employees do the same with them.
- Schedules employees to business demands and for tracks employee time and attendance.
- Verifies employees understand expectations and parameters.
- Verifies property policies are administered fairly and consistently, disciplinary procedures and documentation are completed according to Standard and Local Operating Procedures (SOPs and LSOPs) and support the Peer Review Process, where applicable.
- Supervises staffing levels to verify that guest service, operational needs, and financial objectives are met.
- Observes service behaviors of employees and provides feedback to individuals.
- Verifies employee recognition is taking place on all shifts.
- Participates in an on-going employee recognition program.
- Solicits employee feedback, utilizes an open door policy, and reviews employee satisfaction results to identify and address employee problems or concerns.
- Participates in employee progressive discipline procedures.
- Celebrates successes and publicly recognizes the contributions of team members.
Ensuring Exceptional Customer Service
- Sets a positive example for guest relations.
- Understands the brands service culture.
- Participates in the development and implementation of corrective action plans to improve guest satisfaction.
- Empowers employees to provide excellent customer service.
- Emphasizes guest satisfaction during all departmental meetings and focuses on continuous improvement.
- Responds to and handles guest problems and complaints.
- Strives to improve service performance.
At Marriott International, we are dedicated to being an equal opportunity employer, welcoming all and providing access to opportunity. We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated. Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates. We are committed to non-discrimination on any protected basis, including disability, veteran status, or other basis protected by applicable law.
