Description:
Job Description
Are You Ready to Make It Happen at Mondel z International

Join our Mission to Lead the Future of Snacking. Make It With Pride.

Principal Accountabilities
1.
Site Electricity Management Improvement
- Ensure Smooth Operation Maintenance of 33KV Sub Station which includes, transformers, PCC MCC panels, DG, UPS and their auxiliary equipment.
- Ensure compliance to Electricity Board regulations e.g. annual inspection, Monthly compliance form submission of DG duty etc.
- To drive electrical energy efficiency benchmarking improvement for site.
- Ensure smooth operation maintenance of power backup equipment e.g. UPS, DG.
- Planning and execution of assigned improvement project
- Benchmark electrical design and identify areas of improvement.
- To ensure time-based maintenance compliance drive reduction in downtimes due to electrical failures for site.
- Perform monthly electricity consumption analysis find areas of improvement. drive best in class energy efficiency through energy projects.

2.
Cost Control
- Drive a cost effective program management to reduce reoccurring cost on repair/ replacement of electrical equipments parts.
- Reduction of Working Capital by focusing on inventory reduction
- Manage electrical design and any design changes within budget and schedule.
- Prepare weekly electrical progress and expenditure reports on a project specific basis.

3.
EHS support
- To ensure that all shutdown jobs are carried out through valid permit system
- Drive PS-2 ( Safe electrical systems ) Standard for site.
- To ensure electrical safety as per Mondel z Health Safety Standards
- To ensure any m/c shutdown job is carried out with LOTO
- Maintains safety, health, and environmental policies and procedures.

4.
Quality support
- To ensure compliance of GMPs and Quality Policy
- To maintain hygiene in work place.
- Be accountable for the QFS Performance of the Work Group
- Communicate Coordinate with Quality department to ensure effective participation by the maintenance technicians in the implementation of Food Safety policies and procedures.
Education : BE/B Tech/Diploma - Electrical Engineering
Experience : 3-5 years of experience in electrical engineering, preferably in food industry.
Skills :
Strong knowledge of electrical codes (e.g NEC, IEC)
Excellent problem solving troubleshooting skills
Strong verbal written communication skills
Liaising with government officials
Certifications (must have): License of Electrical Supervisor 33 KV / 11 KV
Within Country Relocation support available and for candidates voluntarily moving internationally some minimal support is offered through our Volunteer International Transfer Policy
Business Unit Summary
Mondelez India Foods Private Limited (formerly Cadbury India Ltd.) has been in India for over 70 years, making sure our mouth-watering and well-loved local and global brands such as Cadbury chocolates, Bournvita and Tang powdered beverages, Oreo and Cadbury Bournvita biscuits, and Halls and Cadbury Choclairs Gold candies get safely into our customers hands-and mouths. Headquartered in Mumbai, the company has more than 3,300 employees proudly working across sales offices in New Delhi, Mumbai, Kolkata and Chennai and in manufacturing facilities at Maharashtra, Madhya Pradesh, Himachal Pradesh and Andhra Pradesh, at our global Research Development Technical Centre and Global Business Hub in Maharashtra and in a vast distribution network across the country. We are also proud to be recognised by Avatar as the Best Companies for Women in India in 2019 - the fourth time we ve received this award.
Mondel z International is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation or preference, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Description:
The Opportunity
Hitachi Energy is currently looking for a Testing Engineer to join their team in Savli, Vadodara, India. This team seeks a skilled and motivated individual. The ideal candidate must enjoy working in a dynamic, fast-paced business environment. He or she must be flexible to accommodate business requirements and experience in working with diverse groups and cultures. The ability to multitask & delivers within timelines is essential.
How you'll make an impact
Should possess adequate knowledge and understanding of relevant national & international standards like IEC.
Must be able to understand different kinds of electrical schematic drawings.
Should be capable of tracing the fault & solving it (both electrical as well as mechanical) by referring the documents.
Must have worked in the testing field and should have the knowhow of the testing equipment.
Should have the experience of high voltage testing, partial discharge testing and routine testing of switchgear product.
Candidate should have the basic knowledge of the switchgear's product.
Candidate should be able to do the electrical wiring independently in Local control cubical and able to verify basic interlocks.
Capable to work independently and handle the day-to-day workload.
Should supervise the team members and ability to deliver the output in targeted timeline.
Should be familiar with practices such as 5S, KAIZEN, etc.
Experience of co-ordination with various cross functions like production, stores, packing and marketing/planning
Should be able to handle the customer inspection independently
Should have the knowledge of the equipment calibration and its certification.
Responsible to ensure compliance with applicable external and internal regulations, procedures, and guidelines.
Living Hitachi Energy's core values of safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business.
Your background
A Diploma / bachelor's degree in electrical engineering with first class (above 60%)
Minimum 4 to 6 years of professional work experience in Procurement.
Sound interpersonal skills. Working knowledge of SAP MM.
Well versed with MS Office. Basic knowledge of engineering drawing.
Skilled in High voltage testing, partial discharge testing, Mechanical endurance test of Switchgear product. Experience in GIS & DTB testing will be an added advantage.
Should have adequate knowledge of functional and interlock verification in low voltage or local control cubicle.
Quick learner with interest in and ability to master new technologies. Knowledge of basic SAP
Proficiency in both spoken & written English language is required

Our client’s reach span across several countries across the globe.

PERFECT PLACER (www.perfectplacer.com), Promoted by a team of dedicated professionals with varied background, having comprehensive and extensive industry and consultancy exposure, is “One of the most preferred and referred consultants” today in Executive Search & Placement.

PERFECT PLACER in less than half a decade has grown to be a force to reckon with, having offices in Mumbai, Chennai, Bangalore, and New Delhi.

Perfect Placer along with its associate services has a long and prestigious list of leading Indian and Multinational Corporates in India and Outside across Managerial levels, functions, and Industries, covering both IT and Non-IT specialized in chief executive, board member and senior-level management search assignments.

General Manager Sales & Marketing (Engineering Polymers / Plastics)
You are responsible for leading the commercial, technical, and strategic growth for high-performance plastics and compounds.
Drive revenue, expand market share, manage P&L (Profit & Loss), and building B2B partnerships and oversee commodity polymer trends (PP, PE, PVC), negotiate high-volume contracts, manage strategic distributor relationships, and direct technical marketing for high-performance thermoplastics (e.g., Nylon, PEEK, Polycarbonates, customized polymer compounds) across target industrial segments.
Key Responsibilities:
Strategic & Financial Leadership
F P&L Management: Own revenue targets, gross contribution margins, pricing strategies, and annual budgeting for engineering polymer lines.
F Go-To-Market (GTM) Strategy: Formulate and execute regional or global business development plans to scale market presence.
F Market & Competitor Analysis: Track raw material pricing volatility (petrochemical trends), freight costs, and competitor benchmarks.
Business Development & Key Accounts
F OEM & Processor Relationships: Build direct relationships with major OEMs, tier-1/tier-2 suppliers, and injection moulders/converters.
F Product Substitution: Drive metal-to-plastic or standard-to-engineering polymer conversion initiatives.
F Channel Management: Establish, evaluate, and manage distributor and channel partner networks.
Commodity Market Analysis
F Monitor petrochemical pricing fluctuations, global supply chain bottlenecks, global commodity trends (PP, PE, PVC, PET), currency fluctuations, and competitor pricing to manage risk and optimize trading margins.
B2B Brand Management
F Build brand equity and trust among suppliers (refineries/producers), logistics providers, and industrial buyers.
Commercial Strategy & Trading
F Develop and execute go-to-market strategies for trading commodity and engineering polymers.
Technical & Cross-Functional Coordination
F Technical Sales Support: Collaborate with R&D, production, and quality assurance teams to define technical specifications (MFI, density, impact, tensile strength, fillers) and manage customer trials.
F Product Development: Guide sample testing, custom grade development, and compliance validation for client applications.
Team Management
F Leadership & Mentoring: Direct, coach, and evaluate regional sales managers, technical application engineers, and account executives.
F Performance Tracking: Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) including sales volume in metric tons, customer acquisition rates, and collection cycles.
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):
Revenue Growth: Target achievement in sales volume and overall market share.
Profitability: Margin optimization against global commodity volatility.
Supplier & Client Acquisition: Diversity of supplier networks and conversion of B2B key accounts.
Risk-adjusted Return on Capital (RAROC): Management of credit cycles, inventory holding, and trade logistics.
Gross profit margins on plastic raw materials and compounding resins.
Sales volume (in Metric Tons) vs. quarterly/annual forecasts.
Customer acquisition rates and retention in key end-use verticals.
Inventory turnover and logistical cost optimization

Preferred candidate profile
1. Bachelor of Engineering in Polymer or Plastics Chemical or related Engineering Field is a must with MBA in Marketing is strongly preferred with 12 to 20+ years of progressive commercial and sales leadership experience specifically within engineering plastics, polymer compounding, or chemical raw materials.
2. Strong grasp of polymer rheology, resin properties, application engineering, and ERP/CRM tools (e.g., SAP, Salesforce).
3. B2B contract negotiation, high-volume account management, cross-functional leadership, and data-driven forecasting
4. Proficiency in data-driven decision-making, supply-demand forecasting, and CRM utilization.
5. Ability to communicate complex market intelligence to C-suite executives and board members.
6. Decisive leadership when navigating volatile commodity markets or supply chain crises.

Remuneration:
An outstanding remuneration package that rewards professionalism and diligence will be on offer for the successful applicant as well as a well-defined career path. An excellent package will be on offer for the right candidate, including an above-mentioned industry base salary for the right person as well as the most complete employee benefit scheme. Don't miss out on this opportunity to join the market leader.

Role & responsibilities
Our clients are leading MNC & Industrial Conglomerates (AUTOMOBILES, FMCG, CONSUMER DURABLES, MANAUFACTURING, RETAIL, EPC, INFRASTRUCTURE (POWER, ENERGY, OIL & GAS, PORTS), INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY, BPO, PHARMA & TELECOM with a Turnover of US $ 1 Bn to US $ 100 Bn with exponential growth potential. Our client’s reach span across several countries across the globe.

PERFECT PLACER (www.perfectplacer.com), Promoted by a team of dedicated professionals with varied background, having comprehensive and extensive industry and consultancy exposure, is “One of the most preferred and referred consultants” today in Executive Search & Placement.

PERFECT PLACER in less than half a decade has grown to be a force to reckon with, having offices in Mumbai, Chennai, Bangalore, and New Delhi.

Perfect Placer along with its associate services has a long and prestigious list of leading Indian and Multinational Corporates in India and Outside across Managerial levels, functions, and Industries, covering both IT and Non-IT specialized in chief executive, board member and senior-level management search assignments.

GM Marketing - Engineering Plastics PAN INDIA
Objective:
You are responsible for leading commercial, technical, and strategic growth for high-performance plastics and compounds. (PBT/ PA/ PP/ PC/ ABS/ ASA /PET / PMMA/Nylon/Poly/ POM Blends)
Drive revenue, expand market share, manage P-L, and build B2B partnerships.
Oversee commodity polymer trends (PP, PE, PVC), negotiate high-volume contracts, manage strategic distributor relationships, and direct technical marketing for high-performance thermoplastics across target industrial segments
Principal Accountabilities / Key Responsibilities
F Develop, obtain approval and implement a strategic sales and marketing plan for domestic and export markets, with focus on PP Compounding and non-auto plastic applications.
F Responsible for creating and executing national sales strategies to drive revenue growth.
F Achieve targeted sales volumes, price premia, market share and segment-wise growth in line with the approved marketing plan.
F Devise pricing strategies within defined guidelines to maximize product premia and shareholder value.
F Drive continuous improvement in profitability through regular assessment of customer, product and application portfolios.
F Lead sales & business development for engineering plastic compounds across PAN India
Business Development
F Lead business development for PP Compounding and Plastic Injection Moulding applications for:
F Non -Automotive Industry
F Support customer engagements related to material selection, application development, trials, validation and commercialization.
F Expand Co’s footprint other than non-auto industry
F Analyzing market trends and identifying new business opportunities,
F Monitor market trends, competitor activities, and consumer demand to refine sales strategies and identify new business opportunities.
F Build and maintain strong relationships with key clients, distributors, and partners.
F Drive Metal-to-Plastic and polymer material replacement projects
F Manage key accounts to achieve sales targets and customer satisfaction
Customer, Key Account Management & Relationships:
F Build and maintain strong relationships with key decision makers and Non-Auto OEM accounts.
F Understand customer needs in terms of products, technologies, processing (injection moulding) and service expectations.
F Act as a senior interface between the Co. and key non-auto customers.
F Managing key client relationships and ensuring consistent sales performance across all regions.
F Coordinate customer requirements, forecasts, dispatches and inventory planning
F Participate in exhibitions, seminars, technical presentations and customer meetings
F Work closely with technical, R&D, production and quality teams
People Management & Leadership
F Build, mentor and develop a high-performing sales & marketing team.
F Setting sales targets, managing and coaching a national sales team,
F Ensure all team members work in alignment with Co’s strategic objectives and HR policies.
F Promote a culture of performance, accountability, knowledge sharing and ethical conduct.

Preferred candidate profile
1. BE with 12 to 20+ years of progressive commercial and sales leadership experience specifically within engineering plastics (PBT/ PA/ PP/ PC/ ABS/ ASA /PET/ PMMA/ Nylon/ Poly/ POM Blends) or chemical raw materials.
2. Proven experience in new project development
3. Strong technical understanding of polymer applications and material selection
4. Strong sales, business development and negotiation skills
5. Strong exposure to Plastic Injection Moulding processes and their linkage with material performance.
6. Hands-on experience handling Non- Auto Industry suppliers and OEM businesses.
7. Proven sales track record and experience in customer support (preferred).
8. Strong communication and negotiation skills.
9. Ability to build rapport quickly and maintain strong client relationships.
10. Effective time management and planning skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
11. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
12. Willingness to travel PAN India

Remuneration:
An outstanding remuneration package that rewards professionalism and diligence will be on offer for the successful applicant as well as a well-defined career path. An excellent package will be on offer for the right candidate, including an above-mentioned industry base salary for the right person as well as the most complete employee benefit scheme. Don't miss out on this opportunity to join the market leader.

Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.
Present in India since 1953, Thales is headquartered in Noida and has other operational offices and sites spread across Delhi, Gurugram, Bengaluru and Mumbai, among others. Over 2200 employees are working with Thales and its joint ventures in India. Since the beginning, Thales has been playing an essential role in India s growth story by sharing its technologies and expertise in Defence, Aerospace and Cyber Digital sectors. Thales has two engineering competence centres in India - one in Noida focused on Cyber Digital business, while the one in Bengaluru focuses on hardware, software and systems engineering capabilities for both the civil and defence sectors, serving global needs. The Group has also established an MRO (Maintenance, Repair Overhaul) facility in Gurugram to provide comprehensive avionics maintenance and repair services to Indian airlines and support the growth of the local aviation industry.
Position Summary
The Cybersecurity Software Lead will join our Software organization to design and implement the cybersecurity features our In Flight Entertainment and Connectivity (IFEC) product suite. The candidate must be a proficient technical leader and have extensive knowledge of cybersecurity of software systems that utilize Android and/or Linux platforms, multi-layered, client-server technologies. Experience in developing complex Java and C/C++ applications on the Android and Linux platform is required. Experience in following cybersecurity features is required: Firewall, Antivirus, Key management, Encryption, SELinux. Candidate must also possess excellent communication skills that will help in the job of leading, and facilitating discussions between stakeholders. The Cybersecurity Software Specialist also has software development responsibilities for prototyping new features. The Cybersecurity Software Specialist will work with SW Architects, SW development teams and system teams.
Essential Functions / Key Areas of Responsibility
The Cybersecurity Software Specialist will provide his technical expertise, guidance, oversight and drive the following:
Drive software architecture Cybersecurity aspects for the IFEC product lines Lead the design of the Cybersecurity features Responsible for Writing the Cybersecurity use cases (user stories), and allocate them to the functional components as necessary Lead the definition of interfaces/APIs between software components Provide the technical expertise and communicate on cybersecurity effectively to other engineers and management via presentations, architecture documents/diagrams, and software requirements Select COTS (Commercial Off the Shelf) and OSS (Open Source Software) for cybersecurity features Assess vulnerabilities of existing COTS and OSS and propose needed updates Analyze existing designs, define and implement security improvements to the existing IFEC designs Must be able to create proof-of-concepts as necessary to demonstrate new ideas/technologies and architectural concepts Participate in detailed design and code reviews for compliance with the defined secured software architecture Ensure the software implementation is in line with the proposed software architecture and recommended design patterns Partner Product and Program Management teams to define and estimate the work scope of new projects and cybersecurity features Responsible for providing technical leadership to junior software engineers in the areas of software design and implementation
Minimum Requirements: Skills, Experience, Education, Technical/Specialized Knowledge, Certifications, Language
Required Education and Experience:
Area of study: Computer Science
Master degree in field with minimum 6 years of experience
6+ years of cybersecurity software development experience
OR
Bachelor degree in field with minimum 8 to 10 years of experience in IFE
6+ years of cybersecurity software development experience
Skills:
Expertise in cybersecurity features like Firewall, certificates/key/authentication management, SELinux, Antivirus
Fluent in Java, C, C++, shell scripting, networking protocols, audio video distribution, and database management
Expertise in Android Framework/Internals
Experience with the Linux operating system and SELinux
Experience in software design and development of Android and/or Linux-based systems following an industrial process
Knowledge of the Scrum development process and Continuous Integration practices and tools (e.g. Jenkins, Sonar, GIT, BitBucket, JIRA)
Very good knowledge of all phases of software development lifecycle: requirements analysis, design, implementation, code review, testing, and release
Self-motivated, critical thinker with strong technical background
Excellent verbal and written communication skills
Experience with IFEC systems is a plus
Preferred Qualifications
Master degree in Computer Science

At Thales, we re committed to fostering a workplace where respect, trust, collaboration, and passion drive everything we do. Description:
Open Locations - Kolkata/Bangalore/Pune/Noida/Kochi
We are looking for a Senior to join our Life Insurance Managed Services Actuarial Practice delivering solutions to the leading clients in Insurance Sector, working closely with other Staff/Assistants, Consultants/Seniors, Managers, Senior Managers or Client partners in EYs global network of insurance sector and consulting professionals.
You can expect to work along with senior managers/directors to support large scale engagements and deliver high-quality client solutions. You will develop and maintain long-term relationships and networks, build and energize a high performing team.
Our growing team of professionals come from a diverse background, all committed to being long term trusted advisors to our clients.
Key Requirements
As a Senior within the Actuarial managed services team your role involves developing and implementing solutions both within the Insurance service line and in collaboration with other services lines.
Good understanding of US product lines and regulatory standards; hands-on implementation experience (desirable)
Experience of handling a small to moderate sized team will be an advantage
Ability to review work done by junior members, ensuring quality of work product during time sensitive deadlines
Ability to maneuver around existing modeling setup to incorporate the asset or liability cashflows
Understanding of AoC concept and AoC steps (unwinding, roll forward, assumption changes, experience variances)
Strong excel skills, capable of running and modifying macros used to transform Actuarial Cashflows
Hands-on experience in actuarial valuation software such as Prophet / Axis / MG Alpha. Advanced level experience in one of these softwares will be valuable
Strong experience on Excel is must and experience on VBA would be good
Good experience of preparing PPT decks
In-depth understanding of insurance products and regulations of one or more geographies
iduals who have a proactive attitude and are seeking the opportunity for personal and professional growth, leveraging and supporting our global network.
Skills and attributes for success
Skills and attributes for a successful career at EY require a learning mindset and passion to add value to GDS, member firms and client organisations. Bright and enthusiastic individuals who give their all to each assignment they work on will find themselves at home within our energetic GDS actuarial team.
To qualify for the role, you must have
3-6 years of experience in valuation / reporting / pricing or modelling function in life actuarial team of an insurance / consulting / outsourcing company
Good analytical skills
Ability to do investigations in models / reporting process and independently solve problems
Willingness to learn and apply learning actively in project work Proficiency in MS-Office Suite, Power BI, VBA, SAS, R Programming, Python, SQL, SPSS, etc., will be a plus
Ideally, youll also have
Good actuarial exam progress
Strong written and verbal communication skills for report writing, industry studies and stakeholder presentations
The ability to build relationships with colleagues across the business, support them and promote a collaborative environment
Overseas exposure (especially Australia/UK/US/Europe market experience)

Title: Gen AI Data Engineer - Azure AI Foundry - Senior Associate
Skills: Skills highlighted with ‘‘ are preferred keyskills, Gen AI Data EngineerAzure AI Foundry, About company
Description:
Design, develop, and maintain data pipelines and ETL processes for GenAI projects.
- Collaborate with data scientists and software engineers to implement machine learning models and algorithms.
- Optimize data infrastructure and storage solutions to ensure efficient and scalable data processing.
- Implement event-driven architectures to enable real-time data processing and analysis.
- Utilize containerization technologies like Kubernetes and Docker for efficient deployment and scalability.
- Develop and maintain data lakes for storing and managing large volumes of structured and unstructured data.
- Implement and integrate LLM frameworks (Langchain, Semantic Kernel) for advanced language processing and analysis.
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to design and implement solution architectures for GenAI projects.
- Utilize cloud computing platforms such as Azure or AWS for data processing, storage, and deployment.
- Monitor and troubleshoot data pipelines and systems to ensure smooth and uninterrupted data flow.
- Stay up-to-date with the latest advancements in GenAI technologies and recommend innovative solutions to enhance data engineering processes.
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
- Document data engineering processes, methodologies, and best practices.
- Maintain solution architecture certificates and stay current with industry best practices.
Requirements:
Python Proficiency: Minimum 3 years of hands-on experience building applications with Python.
Scalable System Design: Solid understanding of designing and architecting scalable Python applications, particularly for Gen AI use cases, with a strong understanding of various components and systems architecture patterns to make cohesive and decoupled, scalable applications.
Web Frameworks: Familiarity with Python web frameworks (Flask, FastAPI) for building web applications around AI models.
Modular Design & Security: Demonstrated ability to design applications with modularity, reusability, and security best practices in mind (session management, vulnerability prevention, etc.,).
Cloud-Native Development: Familiarity with cloud-native development patterns and tools (e.g., REST APIs, microservices, serverless functions).
Cloud Deployments: Experience deploying and managing containerized applications on Azure/AWS (Azure Kubernetes Service, Azure Container Instances, or similar).
Version Control (Git): Strong proficiency in Git for effective code collaboration and management.
CI/CD: Knowledge of continuous integration and deployment (CI/CD) practices on cloud platforms.
3-5 years of relevant technical/technology experience, with a focus on GenAI projects.
Strong programming skills in Python.
Experience with data processing frameworks like Apache Spark or similar.
Proficiency in SQL and database management systems.
Preferred Skills:
Gen AI Frameworks: Experience with LLM frameworks or tools for interacting with LLMs such as LangChain, Semantic Kernel, LlamaIndex
Data Pipelines: Experience in setting up data pipelines for model training and real-time inference.
CompanyAddress: 4th Floor, Bagmane Tech Park, Byrasandra Village, KR Puram Hobli, CV Raman Nagar, Bangalore, KA, BANGALORE, Karnataka, India

Title: Presales/Operations Professional | Online Payments (Payment Gateway)

About Paytm Group:
Paytm is Indias leading digital payments and financial services company, focused on driving consumers and merchants to its platform through a wide range of payment use cases. Paytm offers services such as utility bill payments, money transfers, UPI, Wallet, FASTag, Postpaid, and Payment Gateway solutions. For merchants, Paytm provides comprehensive payment acceptance solutions, including QR, Soundbox, EDC, and Payment Gateway, while enabling business growth through commerce and financial services.

About Paytm Payments Services (PPSL):
Paytm Payments Services Limited (PPSL) is the RBI-regulated Payment Aggregator responsible for Paytm's Online Payment Gateway business. PPSL enables thousands of merchants, startups, and enterprises to offer seamless digital payment experiences through multiple payment modes, including UPI, Cards, Net Banking, Wallets, EMI, and BNPL. Our mission is to help businesses accelerate growth through secure, reliable, and scalable payment solutions.

About the Role:
We are looking for a proactive and detail-oriented professional to support the Payment Gateway Sales team across pre-sales activities, client solutioning and sales operations. The role will work closely with Sales, Product, Technology and Operations teams to ensure smooth coordination, effective client engagement and seamless business execution.

Expectations / Requirements:
Generate and qualify enterprise leads through cold calling, outbound prospecting and market research.
Understand prospect requirements, conduct initial discussions and build a strong pipeline for the Enterprise Sales/KAM team.
Maintain lead pipeline, follow-ups and accurate updates in CRM/internal systems.
Coordinate with Product, Technology, Integration, Risk and Operations teams for smooth merchant onboarding and integration.
Act as a SPOC for merchant queries, issues and grievances, ensuring timely resolution and closure.
Track merchant onboarding, integration and operational issues, identify bottlenecks and drive timely resolution.
Prepare MIS, reports and dashboards covering leads, onboarding, integrations and operational metrics.
Support Sales with operational activities, documentation, approvals and internal coordination.
Leverage AI tools and automation to improve productivity, prospect research, reporting and operational efficiency.
Identify process gaps and drive improvements in TAT, operational efficiency and merchant experience.

Qualifications & Skills:
2+ years of experience in Pre-Sales, Inside Sales, Sales Support, Merchant Operations or similar roles.
Strong experience in B2B/Enterprise lead generation, cold calling and lead qualification.
Prior experience in Fintech, Payments, Banking or Technology preferred.
Exposure to merchant onboarding, payment integration or merchant support is an added advantage.
Strong communication, stakeholder management and interpersonal skills with the ability to engage effectively with prospects, merchants and internal teams.
Strong analytical, problem-solving and execution skills with proficiency in MS Excel, PowerPoint and CRM/reporting tools.
Hands-on experience with AI tools to improve prospecting, research, reporting, productivity and day-to-day execution is mandatory.
Strong ownership, customer focus and ability to work in a fast-paced, target-driven environment.
Superpowers / Skills that will help you succeed:
Proven ability in cold calling, lead generation & lead qualification
Strong B2B/Enterprise sales orientation
Excellent stakeholder management & coordination
Customer-centric approach with strong problem-solving skills
Good analytical and reporting skills
Ability to multitask and work in a fast-paced environment
Strong ownership, follow-through and execution mindset
Proficiency in MS Excel, PowerPoint and CRM tools

Location:
Noida | Mumbai | Bengaluru
Why Join Us:
At Paytm Payments Services, you'll work on one of India's largest digital payment platforms, solving complex business challenges for leading enterprises. You'll collaborate with high-performing teams, gain exposure to cutting-edge payment technologies, and play a key role in enabling India's digital commerce ecosystem.
Compensation:
If you are the right fit, we believe in creating wealth for you. With 500M+ registered users and 21M+ merchants, Paytm offers immense opportunities to build, innovate, and grow while contributing to India's largest digital payments ecosystem
AboutCompany: Paytm is India's leading mobile payments and financial services distribution company. Pioneer of the mobile QR payments revolution in India, Paytm builds technologies that help small businesses with payments and commerce. Paytms mission is to serve half a billion Indians and bring them to the mainstream economy with the help of technology.

Description:
Title: Key Account Manager | Enterprise & Growth Portfolio

About Paytm Group:
Paytm is Indias leading digital payments and financial services company, which is focused on driving consumers and merchants to its platform by offering them a variety of payment use cases. Paytm provides consumers with services like utility payments and money transfers, while empowering them to pay via Paytm Payment Instruments (PPI) like Paytm Wallet, Paytm UPI, Paytm Payments Bank Netbanking, Paytm FASTag and Paytm Postpaid - Buy Now, Pay Later. To merchants, Paytm offers acquiring devices like Soundbox, EDC, QR and Payment Gateway where payment aggregation is done through PPI and also other banks financial instruments. To further enhance merchants business, Paytm offers merchants commerce services through advertising and Paytm Mini app store. Operating on this platform leverage, the company then offers credit services such as merchant loans, personal loans and BNPL, sourced by its financial partners.

About Paytm Payments Services (PPSL):
PPSL enables thousands of online merchants to offer world class frictionless payment experience to their customers. We are present across large enterprises and startups including well known unicorns alike. We strive to take payments beyond an enabler and an instrument to drive revenue and user growth for our merchants. Online Payment Gateway is Paytms B2B Business regulated by RBI as it allows only authorized entities to conduct PA PG (Payment Aggregator Payment Gateway) business. This team is responsible for growing the penetration of Paytms PA PG business in the Indian merchants.

About the role:
We are looking for a highly driven Enterprise Sales professional with a strong hunting mindset to acquire and onboard new enterprise merchants for Paytm Payment Gateway. This is primarily a new business acquisition role focused on identifying, engaging and closing enterprise opportunities. While account nurturing forms part of the role, the primary expectation is consistent new merchant acquisition, revenue generation and market expansion.

Expectations/ Requirements:
Drive new enterprise merchant acquisition by identifying, prospecting and closing strategic accounts.
Own the complete sales lifecycle from lead generation, hunting, solutioning, commercial discussions and merchant onboarding.
Generate new business opportunities through self-sourcing, networking, referrals and market intelligence.
Build and maintain a healthy pipeline of enterprise prospects to consistently achieve acquisition targets.
Engage CXOs and decision makers to understand business needs and position Paytm Payment Gateway solutions.
Manage relationships with newly acquired merchants during onboarding and activation.
Drive upsell and cross-sell of UPI, Cards, Net Banking, Wallets, EMI and other payment solutions.
Partner with Product, Technology, Operations and Integration teams for successful merchant onboarding.
Monitor GMV, transaction trends and revenue growth across acquired merchants.
Negotiate commercials and contracts while ensuring timely closures.
Track competition, market trends and white-space opportunities.
Deliver monthly and quarterly acquisition, activation, GMV and revenue targets.

Qualifications & Skills
Bachelor's degree (MBA preferred).
5+ years of Enterprise Sales, New Business Development, Merchant Acquisition or Strategic Sales experience in Payments, FinTech or BFSI.
Proven track record of enterprise hunting and achieving acquisition targets.
Excellent stakeholder management, consultative selling, negotiation and presentation skills.
Understanding of Payment Gateway, Merchant Acquiring, UPI, Cards and Digital Payments ecosystem.

Superpowers/ Skills that will help you succeed in this role :
Strong hunter mindset with passion for acquiring new enterprise merchants.
Comfortable with outbound prospecting and CXO engagement.
Experience in enterprise payments/fintech preferred.
Candidates seeking predominantly account management/farming roles may not find this role aligned.

Location - Noida, Mumbai or Bangalore

Why join us:
We give immense opportunities to make a difference and have a great time doing that. You are challenged and encouraged here to do meaningful work for yourself and customers/clients. We are successful, and our successes are rooted in our people's collective energy and unwavering focus on the customer, and that's how it will always be.

Compensation:
If you are the right fit, we believe in creating wealth for you. With enviable 500 mn+ registered users, 21 mn+ merchants and depth of data in our ecosystem, we are in a unique position to democratize credit for deserving consumers & merchants and we are committed to it. Indias largest digital lending story is brewing here. Its your opportunity to be a part of the story!

Pioneer of the mobile QR payments revolution in India, Paytm builds technologies that help small businesses with payments and commerce. Paytms mission is to serve half a billion Indians and bring them to the mainstream economy with the help of technology.

Experience-4-12 years
Location- Hyderabad/Bangalore/Delhi

Design and implement scalable, secure, resilient, and cost-effective cloud architectures on AWS.
Lead cloud migration and modernization initiatives, including application re-platforming, re-hosting, and cloud-native transformations.

Troubleshoot and resolve complex cloud infrastructure and application issues.

AWS Cloud Expertise
Strong hands-on experience with AWS core services:
Amazon EC2
Amazon S3
Amazon VPC
AWS IAM
Amazon RDS
AWS WAF
Amazon Bedrock
Solution Architecture
Proven experience designing enterprise-scale cloud architectures and solutions.
Strong understanding of AWS Well-Architected Framework and cloud best practices.

Job Summary
Job Title: Client Service Analyst
Corporate Title: AS
Location: Bangalore, India


Role Description
Ensuring DB Service Standards wrt to Customer Service, Compliance and Corporate Security are adhered too.
Ensure total Compliance of all audit guidelines set by External (RBI, NSDL) and Internal OR Auditors.


Your key responsibilities
Ensure strict adherence to all internal and external guidelines (KYC Money Anti Launderings, Audits)
Ensure proper monitoring of expenses and controlling costs, waiver tracking lead management
Ensure proper display of all Regulatory Circulars in the Area
Accurate processing of all account opening forms MF applications
Voucher Management, Rules of Custodianship , Key Management guidelines, are followed without any deviation
Exception handling / deferral tracking and monitoring
Suspicious transactions, large cash txns, NR Credits are reviewed and the necessary process is followed as per the guidelines laid
Ensure Area has a clean Mystery Shopping Audit report both by Internal as well as External auditors
Ensure proper tracking, responses and closures of all Customer Complaints within the committed TATs.
Ensuring best in class service standards to all the Area customers by synergizing with all the channels in the Area
Ensuring proper controls and access is maintained to the Cash / Locker Area at all times. Any suspicious transaction must immediate! be reported to the supervising officer


Your skills and experience
Knowledge on FEMA/Foreign exchange and trade operations will be preferred
Client service excellence
Experience in overall branch operations for 10 years
Proven ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, optimise workflows to solve business problems, while applying critical judgment to ensure responsible and ethical use of data and AI outputs.

Description:
Job Details
Designation: Educational Sales / Promotion / Marketing Representative
Work Experience: 0-2 years sales/promotion/marketing experience in the Book Trade
Location: New Delhi, Pune, Bangalore, Mumbai, Ahmedabad, Chennai, Chandigarh, Coimbatore, Hyderabad, Jaipur, Kolkata, Noida, Lucknow, Indore
Gender: Open to both. As the job requires travelling within the city, candidates should be able to drive and have their own conveyance.
Job Type: Open
No. of Positions: 25
Job Summary
Educational Sales / Promotion / Marketing Representative. Sales/promotion/marketing experience in the Book Trade. Creating a positive brand image/awareness of Deepshikha Books in junior schools, play schools, gift shops and bookshops. The candidate will visit play schools, junior schools and bookshops, meet junior school heads and principals to inform them about Deepshikhas product range, and also look out for promising teachers who could become good authors and encourage them to write new books to be published by Deepshikha. Candidates will stay alert to competing publishers products and strategies so Deepshikha can devise an appropriate marketing strategy. The candidate will be given a particular area/territory to work in, visiting all schools, play schools and bookshops (small to big), meeting customers, gathering relevant data and sharing it with the immediate senior / as advised by the marketing manager.
Responsibilities
Sales/promotion/marketing experience in the Book Trade. Creating a positive brand image/awareness of Deepshikha Books in junior schools, play schools, gift shops and bookshops.
The candidate will visit play schools, junior schools and bookshops, meet junior school heads and principals to inform them about Deepshikhas product range, and also look out for promising teachers who could become good authors and encourage them to write new books to be published by Deepshikha.
Candidates will stay alert to competing publishers products and strategies so Deepshikha can devise an appropriate marketing strategy.
The candidate will be given a particular area/territory to work in, visiting all schools, play schools and bookshops (small to big), meeting customers, gathering relevant data and sharing it with the immediate senior / as advised by the marketing manager.
Desired Competencies
Knowledge
Basic knowledge of methods involved in presenting, promoting, and selling products or services.
Basic computer knowledge -- preparing sales presentations, sales letters, promotion through email and WhatsApp.
English and the regional language.
A fair idea of local locations/areas.
Skills
Talking to customers to effectively convey information.
Judging customer behaviour and moulding the sales pitch accordingly.
Interacting with customers to ascertain and evaluate their needs and wishes.
Listening to what the customer is saying and asking questions as appropriate.
The ability to speak clearly so as to be understandable to a customer.
Attitude
Sales strategies and tactics, product demonstration and sales techniques.
The ability to communicate information and ideas clearly in speech.
The ability to listen to and understand information and ideas presented through spoken words.
Experience
Product detailing and presentation; front-line sales or cold-calling sales experience would be an added advantage.
Education
Any Graduate / Under Graduate / Post Graduate, preferably with a marketing background.

Description:
The ideal candidate is a strategic thinker with strong analytical capabilities, hands-on experience in AI-enabled analytics, and the ability to translate complex data into actionable business insights. Acting as a performance intelligence hub for Marketing, this role will help leadership make faster, smarter, and more informed decisions.
Experience: 8–12 Years
Location: Bangalore / Noida
Shift: 2:00 PM – 11:00 PM IST
Role- Individual Contributor
The Main Responsibilities
AI & Analytics Transformation
Drive the adoption of AI, automation, and advanced analytics to enhance the speed, scale, and quality of marketing insights.
Design and deploy AI-powered solutions, intelligent agents, and automated workflows to streamline analysis, reporting, and opportunity identification.
Identify and automate recurring analytical processes to improve efficiency and reduce manual effort.
Partner with Marketing Operations and Technology teams to enhance analytical capabilities and optimize workflows.
Establish best practices and governance for AI-assisted analytics and insight generation.
Strategic Business Insights
Analyze end-to-end marketing and revenue performance across campaigns, funnels, pipeline creation, sales, and revenue outcomes.
Conduct in-depth analysis to identify trends, growth opportunities, performance challenges, and key business drivers.
Perform root-cause analysis to explain performance fluctuations and support strategic decision-making.
Develop forecasting models, scenario planning frameworks, and business performance analyses to guide investment and planning decisions.
Deliver data-backed recommendations that improve marketing effectiveness and overall business performance.
Performance Intelligence & Forecasting
Continuously monitor key marketing KPIs, including lead generation, MQL volume, conversion rates, funnel health, pipeline creation, campaign performance, and revenue attainment.
Provide proactive visibility into performance against goals, forecasts, and business targets.
Develop pacing, forecasting, and scenario models to identify potential performance gaps and enable early intervention.
Track week-over-week performance trends and communicate key business insights to stakeholders.
Automated Monitoring & Anomaly Detection
Build and maintain automated monitoring systems and alerting frameworks to identify significant changes in marketing performance metrics.
Detect emerging risks, unusual activity, and performance anomalies across campaigns, channels, website traffic, conversion rates, pipeline creation, and spend effectiveness.
Assess business impact and distinguish between genuine performance issues, growth opportunities, and measurement discrepancies.
Lead diagnostic and root-cause investigations to identify the primary factors influencing performance outcomes.
Optimization & Executive Decision Support
Translate analytical findings into prioritized recommendations that drive measurable business impact.
Identify opportunities to optimize campaign investments, resource allocation, channel strategies, and marketing execution.
Proactively surface risks that may impact target achievement and highlight emerging opportunities for growth.
Provide executive-ready performance insights, risk assessments, and strategic recommendations to support leadership decision-making.
What We Look For in a Candidate
8–12 years of experience in Marketing Analytics, Business Intelligence, Revenue Analytics, Campaign Performance, or related analytical functions.
Strong expertise in data analysis, performance measurement, forecasting, and statistical modeling.
Experience leveraging AI, machine learning, and automation technologies within analytics environments.
Proficiency with BI and visualization tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or similar platforms.
Advanced SQL and data manipulation skills; experience with Python or other analytical programming tools is highly desirable.
Strong business acumen with the ability to translate data into strategic recommendations.
Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and executive presentation skills.
Experience supporting B2B marketing, demand generation, funnel analytics, and revenue performance initiatives is preferred.

Description:
Himalayan Institute of Alternatives, Ladakh (HIAL) is an upcoming Alternative Institute for Mountain Development which follows Contextual Learning and Experiential Pedagogy where students learn by doing and earn while they learn. It aims to develop Ladakh into a benchmark of sustainable living for the mountain world, where all children receive a meaningful education that prepares them for a life of dignity in harmony with nature. It believes in collaborative exercise between learners and facilitators. Instead of solving problems with the conventional 3Rs (Reading, writing, and arithmetic), the learners are encouraged to solve problems using the 3Hs: Bright Head, Kind Heart, and Skilled Hands. The institute is promoted by the renowned leaders in entrepreneurial education in India and attracts talent and grants from leading corporates and Government bodies in India.
For more details about us, please check:
Visit : HIAL Website or watch: About HIAl Job Description:
Looking for an experienced content creator who has proven ability to develop content and experience of writing good quality engaging articles. Has an ability to conduct extensive research on the assigned topic. A team player who has good coordination skills to collate the data at hand from different stake holders. The right candidate will be the one who is able to work from remote ethically and maintain timelines for deliverables and take ownership of the expected output without supervision.
About The Role:
As a content writer / you shall get to create content that shares HIAL's story, vision and brand to the world and make an impact across many different digital / social / media platforms.
Responsibilities:
1.Write, edit, publish content for websites, blogs, vlogs, videos, social media campaign (LinkedIn, Facebook, Twitter, Instagram etc).
2.Creating compelling headlines and body content that will capture the attention of the target audience.
3.Write content for Annual Report, Newsletter and other internal communication initiatives.
4.Design content marketing strategy.
5.Optimise content considering SEO.
6.Should have the ability to work independently and with cross functional teams.
7.Should be able to come up with fresh ideas and take ownership of projects.
8.Ensure that the content adheres to required branding and style guidelines and is relevant for our target audience.
9.Scripting for audio-visual, written and other media content.
10.Plan and Execute Events and Conferences that are integral to HIAL.
11.Monitor HIAL's Social Media and online presence and timely preparing high quality content for promoting HIAL brand value.
12.Prepare HIAL Annual Report (Annually), Newsletters (Quarterly), Monthly Updates (Monthly) collating data as required from all stakeholders.
13.While ensuring that they adhere to standards and goals of the HIAL, write and produce high-quality materials for effectively communicating to the key audience at appropriate platforms.
14.Create creative content for social media platforms including LinkedIn, Facebook and Instagram to maintain an active online presence for HIAL.
15.Content for press releases, media briefings etc for HIAL's media relations across radio, print, digital, and television.
16.Assure uniformity in all content by serving as key brand guardian of HIAL.
17.Maintain the content of HIALs website by making sure it is correct, up to date, and persuasive.
18.Have an eye for detail and make sure all output is of a high quality.
19.Able to work from remote ethically and maintain timelines for deliverables.

KRA:
1.Written content for communication with HIAL's stakeholders.
2.Preparation and circulation of Annual Report (Annually), Newsletters (Quarterly), Monthly Updates (Monthly), brochures/ manuals, etc.
3.Branding and marketing related content.
4.Support in promoting the events organised time to time with valuable content for marketing and branding.
5.Social Media: Preparation of high quality and engaging content for all the social media handles as per tentative schedule mentioned below with SEO.
1. Instagram: Ensure daily effective posts.
2.Any Event: Instant Posting.
3.Facebook: Ensure daily effective posts.
4.Twitter
5.LinkedIn
6.Website
6.Content for the Events:
1.Annual Conferences & Festivals, promotion activities (Sun & Earth, Education, Entrepreneurship, Energy Studies).
2.Workshops.

7.I Live Simply (ILS).
1.Manage content related activities for ILS.


Preferred Educational Background:
1.Graduate or Master's in Mass Communication/ English literature or equivalent.
2.Good command over English.
3.Proven experience working under strict deadlines and the ability to work quickly.
4.Creative skills and usage of photographs, drawings, diagrams, animation, etc
The above is relaxed for the right candidate who can prove excellence in lines with the requirement with proven track record.
Preferred Work Experience:
1.Minimum of 2-5 years in similar roles.
2.Ability to work independently and reliably with minimal supervision.
3.Experience in SEO will be preferred.
4.Creative writing.
Compensation:
As per industry and region standards.

Description:
Job Description:
We are seeking a talented and creative Media Executive to join our team . The ideal candidate will have proven photography and videography skills, with a keen eye for capturing compelling visuals that tell a story. As a Media Executive, you will play a key role in documenting our projects, events, and initiatives through various forms of media, including photography, videography, and multimedia content creation. Responsibilities:
Capture high-quality photographs and videos that showcase the work and impact of HIAL's projects and initiatives.
Edit and enhance photos and videos using Adobe Creative Suite or similar software to ensure a polished and professional final product.
Collaborate with team members to develop creative concepts and visual storytelling strategies for various media projects.
Manage and maintain a library of multimedia assets, including photos, videos, and graphics.
Support social media and marketing efforts by providing engaging visual content for digital platforms.
Assist in the production of promotional materials, including brochures, presentations, and videos.
Travel with project teams to remote locations in Ladakh and other regions as needed to document fieldwork and events.

Qualifications:
Bachelor's degree in photography, videography, media production, or related field preferred.
Proven experience in photography and videography, with a strong portfolio demonstrating technical proficiency and creative vision.
Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite, including Photoshop, Lightroom, Premiere Pro, and/or After Effects.
Strong attention to detail and ability to work efficiently in a fast-paced environment.
Excellent communication and teamwork skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with colleagues from diverse backgrounds.
Willingness to travel and work in challenging environments, including remote Himalayan regions, and be flexible with assignments and schedules.
Benefits:
Opportunity to work with a dynamic team dedicated to making a positive impact in the Himalayan region.
Experience the rich cultural heritage and breathtaking landscapes of Ladakh.
Professional development opportunities and training in media production and storytelling techniques.
If you are passionate about using your media skills to make a difference and are excited about the opportunity to work in the beautiful Himalayan region of Ladakh, we encourage you to apply for the Media Executive position at HIAL. Join us in our mission to create a more sustainable and resilient future for Himalayan communities.

Job Summary:
Job Summary

The Commis I Indian Kitchen is responsible for assisting in the preparation, cooking, and presentation of Indian cuisine while maintaining the highest standards of food quality, hygiene, and kitchen operations. The role requires sound knowledge of Indian cooking techniques, ingredients, and kitchen procedures, along with the ability to work efficiently in a fast-paced environment.

Key Responsibilities

Prepare and cook Indian dishes according to established recipes and standards.
Assist senior chefs in mise en place and daily kitchen operations.
Ensure consistency in taste, presentation, and portion control.
Monitor the quality and freshness of ingredients before use.
Maintain cleanliness and organization of the assigned work station.
Follow all food safety, hygiene, and sanitation standards.
Ensure proper storage, labeling, and rotation of food items (FIFO).
Support in receiving and storing kitchen supplies and ingredients.
Minimize food wastage and contribute to cost-control initiatives.
Assist during buffet service, la carte operations, banquets, and special events.
Report equipment malfunctions, stock shortages, and quality concerns to supervisors.
Work collaboratively with other kitchen team members to ensure smooth operations.

Qualifications & Experience

Diploma or Degree in Hotel Management, Culinary Arts, or a related field preferred.
Minimum 2 4 years of experience in an Indian kitchen, preferably in a luxury hotel or fine-dining restaurant.
Knowledge of North Indian, Mughlai, Tandoor, and regional Indian cuisines is desirable.
Familiarity with food safety and hygiene standards.

Skills & Competencies

Strong understanding of Indian cooking methods, spices, and ingredients.
Ability to work under pressure and meet service timelines.
Attention to detail and commitment to quality.
Good organizational and time-management skills.
Team-oriented attitude with a willingness to learn.
Ability to maintain a clean and disciplined work environment.

What We Offer

Opportunity to work in a luxury hospitality environment.
Professional growth and learning opportunities.

Description:
The Marketing Manager at the Himalayan Institute of Alternatives Ladakh will be responsible for developing and executing marketing strategies to promote responsible tourism-related events, projects and activities, as well as promoting various courses, conferences, and workshops offered by the institute. The role will encompass a range of marketing activities, including digital marketing, content creation, event promotion, and brand management.

Key Responsibilities:

Promote Responsible Tourism Events:
Develop and implement marketing plans to promote responsible tourism-related events and activities curated by HIAL.
Collaborate with local and international partners to create awareness and attract participants.
Utilize digital marketing channels, social media, and content marketing to reach the target audience.
Promote Institute Courses:
Create marketing campaigns to promote the various courses offered by the Himalayan Institute of Alternatives Ladakh.
Develop course-specific marketing materials, including brochures, flyers, and digital content.
Implement strategies to increase course enrollment and participation.
Promote Conferences and Workshops:
Plan and execute marketing initiatives to promote conferences, workshops, and seminars held at the institute.
Coordinate with speakers, sponsors, and participants to ensure successful event promotion.
Manage event registration and attendee communication.
Digital Marketing:
Implement digital marketing strategies, including SEO, SEM, email marketing, and social media campaigns.
Create and curate content that highlights the institute's mission and values.
Monitor website traffic, engagement, and conversion rates to optimize digital marketing efforts.
Resource Management:
Oversee resource allocation and cash flow management to maintain financial stability and ensure that the organization can meet its financial obligations and strategic goals.
Content Creation:
Develop compelling and informative content, including blog posts, videos, and infographics, to engage the target audience.
Ensure that content aligns with the institute's values and promotes sustainable practices.
Collaboration:
Collaborate with the institute's teams, including academic, administrative, and event planning, to align marketing efforts with organizational goals.
Foster relationships with local and regional stakeholders to enhance the institute's presence.
Budget Management:
Create and manage marketing budgets, optimizing resource allocation for maximum impact.
Monitor spending and provide regular reports

Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, or a related field (Master's degree preferred).
Proven experience in marketing, preferably in the field of education, sustainable tourism, or related areas.
Strong knowledge of digital marketing techniques and tools.
Excellent communication and content creation skills.
Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a diverse team.
Passion for sustainable and responsible tourism practices.
Familiarity with Ladakh and the local community is a plus.
This Marketing Manager will play a crucial role in promoting the Himalayan Institute of Alternatives Ladakh's mission to promote responsible tourism and education in the region, while also fostering awareness and participation in its various courses, conferences, and workshops.

Description:
style="margin-bottom: 0px;"> Sous Chef-Indian Cuisine
F&B Production 7-8 Years Full-time Leh, Ladakh
Job Summary:
Job Summary

The Sous Chef - Indian Kitchen is responsible for assisting the Executive Chef in managing the preparation, cooking, and presentation of Indian cuisine while maintaining the highest standards of food quality, hygiene, and kitchen operations. The role requires strong knowledge of Indian cooking techniques, ingredients, menu execution, and kitchen procedures, along with proven leadership skills and the ability to manage a team effectively in a fast-paced hospitality environment.

Key Responsibilities

Assist the Executive Chef in managing the day-to-day operations of the Indian kitchen.
Supervise and coordinate the work of Chefs de Partie, Commis Chefs, and other kitchen team members.
Prepare and oversee the preparation and cooking of Indian dishes according to established recipes and standards.
Ensure consistency in taste, presentation, portion control, and overall food quality.
Conduct regular quality checks and ensure all dishes meet the required standards before service.
Plan and supervise mise en place and ensure adequate preparation for daily operations and service.
Assist in menu planning, development of new dishes, and implementation of seasonal and special menus.
Ensure proper handling, storage, labeling, and rotation of food items in accordance with FIFO practices.
Monitor ingredient quality, freshness, and availability and coordinate with the relevant departments for timely replenishment.
Control food wastage and assist in maintaining food-cost targets through effective production and portion control.
Ensure strict compliance with food safety, hygiene, sanitation, and HACCP standards.
Maintain cleanliness, organization, and discipline across the Indian kitchen and assigned work areas.
Assist in managing buffet service, la carte operations, banquets, special events, and other culinary requirements.
Train, guide, and develop junior kitchen team members in Indian cooking techniques, hygiene, and standard operating procedures.
Allocate daily duties and ensure efficient deployment of kitchen personnel during service.
Monitor kitchen equipment and report maintenance requirements, malfunctions, stock shortages, and quality concerns to the Executive Chef.
Take responsibility for the Indian kitchen in the absence of the Executive Chef, ensuring uninterrupted and efficient operations.
Work closely with other kitchen sections and service teams to ensure smooth coordination and timely food delivery.

Qualifications & Experience

Diploma or Degree in Hotel Management, Culinary Arts, or a related field preferred.
Minimum 7-8 years of experience in a professional Indian kitchen, preferably in a luxury hotel or fine-dining restaurant.
Previous experience in a Sous Chef, Junior Sous Chef, or senior Chef de Partie position is preferred.
Strong knowledge of North Indian, Mughlai, Tandoor, and regional Indian cuisines.
Proven experience in supervising and leading a kitchen team.
Good knowledge of food safety, hygiene, sanitation, and HACCP standards.

Skills & Competencies

Strong understanding of Indian cooking methods, spices, ingredients, and regional cuisines.
Strong leadership and team-management skills.
Ability to maintain consistency and quality during high-volume service.
Ability to work effectively under pressure and meet service timelines.
Excellent organizational and time-management skills.
Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality.
Good understanding of food cost, portion control, and wastage management.
Ability to train, motivate, and develop junior kitchen team members.
Strong communication and coordination skills.
Ability to maintain a clean, disciplined, and professional kitchen environment.

What We Offer

Opportunity to work in a luxury hospitality environment.
Professional growth and learning opportunities.
Competitive compensation and benefits.
A collaborative and supportive workplace culture.

Description:
Job Summary

Delhivery is looking for an experienced operations leader to head Fulfillment Center (FC) Operations, drive operational excellence, improve productivity, optimize costs and ensure seamless end-to-end fulfillment. The role requires strong expertise in large-scale warehouse operations, supply chain management, inventory control, process improvement and team leadership.

Key Responsibilities

Lead and oversee end-to-end fulfillment center operations, including inbound, receiving, put-away, storage, inventory management, picking, packing, dispatch and returns.
Develop and implement operational strategies to improve productivity, throughput, order accuracy, service quality and overall efficiency.
Drive operational excellence through process standardization, automation, technology adoption and continuous improvement initiatives.
Manage operational budgets, cost optimization, resource utilization and productivity targets to achieve business objectives.
Establish and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs), including fulfillment accuracy, inventory accuracy, turnaround time, throughput, SLA adherence and cost per shipment.
Lead large operations teams, build leadership capability and drive a performance-oriented culture across fulfillment centers.
Drive capacity planning, manpower planning, infrastructure utilization and peak-season readiness in line with business volumes.
Collaborate with transportation, linehaul, first-mile, last-mile, technology, planning and customer experience teams to ensure seamless end-to-end operations.
Leverage warehouse management systems (WMS), data analytics and automation to improve operational visibility and decision-making.
Ensure adherence to operational SOPs, safety standards, statutory requirements and audit processes.
Identify operational bottlenecks, conduct root cause analysis and implement corrective and preventive actions.
Lead facility expansion, operational transformation and scalable process implementation to support business growth.


Required Qualifications and Experience

Proven experience managing large-scale fulfillment or warehouse operations, preferably across multiple facilities or locations.
Strong understanding of end-to-end warehouse processes, inventory management, order fulfillment and distribution operations.
Demonstrated success in improving operational KPIs, productivity, service levels and cost efficiency.
Experience in budget management, capacity planning, resource optimization and operational governance.
Proven ability to lead large teams and develop senior operational leaders.
Strong analytical, strategic planning, stakeholder management and problem-solving skills.
Experience with warehouse management systems, operational dashboards and process improvement methodologies.
AboutCompany:
Delhivery is India's largest fully integrated logistics services provider. With its nationwide network covering over 18,400 pin codes, the company provides a full suite of logistics services such as express parcel transportation, PTL freight, TL freight, cross-border, supply chain, and technology services.
Delhivery has successfully fullled over 1.7 billion shipments since inception and today works with over 28,000 customers, including large & small e-commerce participants, SMEs, and other enterprises & brands.
For more information about Delhivery, please visit www.delhivery.com.
Vision - Our vision is to become the operating system for commerce in India, through a combination of world-class infrastructure, high-quality logistics operations, cutting-edge engineering, and technology capabilities.

Description:
Job Summary
The role will be responsible to drive sales and customer acquisition for home loan and mortgage products, and contribute to the organizations revenue growth through direct sourcing and strategic networking. This role involves generating leads, managing customer relationships, conducting field visits, and ensuring end-to-end loan processing with a focus on delivering a seamless customer experience.


Responsibilities
Go on field visits to meet customers and explain loan products
Work to achieve sales targets and help grow the company's business
Build good relationships with customers by meeting them regularly and following up for more business
Meet new customers and ask happy customers to refer others who may need a home loan
Coordinate with credit team for smooth processing and disbursal of loans
Maintain credit quality
Onboard new channel partners
Find and add new housing projects (APFs) and agents to bring in more loan applications


Required Qualifications and Skills
1-5 years of experience in Home Loan or Mortgage Sales within the BFSI/NBFC sector
Prior experience in direct customer acquisition and channel sales preferred; Freshers with strong sales aptitude may also be considered
Strong local market knowledge and established network in the region
Excellent interpersonal skills
Customer handling and relationship-building abilities
Result-oriented and self-motivated
Strong negotiation and influencing skills


Educational Qualifications
Minimum: Graduate in any discipline (Bachelors degree required)
Having a two-wheeler will be an added advantage

Job Title: DataStage Developer

Job Summary
We are seeking a talented IBM DataStage Developer with 23 years of experience in ETL development, data integration, and data warehousing projects. The ideal candidate should possess strong expertise in IBM InfoSphere DataStage, SQL, and database technologies, with the ability to design, develop, and maintain scalable ETL solutions that support business intelligence and analytics initiatives.
Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, test, and deploy ETL jobs using IBM InfoSphere DataStage.
Develop and maintain data integration workflows for loading data from multiple source systems into data warehouses and data marts.
Analyze business requirements and translate them into technical ETL solutions.
Implement data cleansing, validation, and transformation logic.
Optimize DataStage jobs for performance, scalability, and reliability.
Perform unit testing, integration testing, and support UAT activities.
Troubleshoot ETL job failures and resolve production issues.
Work closely with database administrators, business analysts, and data architects.
Maintain technical documentation and adhere to development standards.
Ensure data quality, integrity, and compliance with organizational policies.
Required Skills
2 - 8 years of hands-on experience in IBM InfoSphere DataStage development.
Strong experience in ETL design and development.
Proficiency in SQL and database concepts.
Experience with relational databases such as Oracle, SQL Server, DB2, PostgreSQL, or MySQL.
Knowledge of DataStage components including:
Designer
Director
Administrator
Manager
Parallel Jobs
Sequence Jobs
Understanding of data warehousing concepts and dimensional modeling.
Experience in Unix/Linux commands and shell scripting.
Knowledge of source code management tools such as Git.
Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.

Experience: 2-8 Years
Location: PAN India
Employment Type: Full-Time
Job Summary
We are seeking a talented IBM DataStage Developer with 23 years of experience in ETL development, data integration, and data warehousing projects. The ideal candidate should possess strong expertise in IBM InfoSphere DataStage, SQL, and database technologies, with the ability to design, develop, and maintain scalable ETL solutions that support business intelligence and analytics initiatives.
Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, test, and deploy ETL jobs using IBM InfoSphere DataStage.
Develop and maintain data integration workflows for loading data from multiple source systems into data warehouses and data marts.
Analyze business requirements and translate them into technical ETL solutions.
Implement data cleansing, validation, and transformation logic.
Optimize DataStage jobs for performance, scalability, and reliability.
Perform unit testing, integration testing, and support UAT activities.
Troubleshoot ETL job failures and resolve production issues.
Work closely with database administrators, business analysts, and data architects.
Maintain technical documentation and adhere to development standards.
Ensure data quality, integrity, and compliance with organizational policies.
Required Skills
2 - 8 years of hands-on experience in IBM InfoSphere DataStage development.
Strong experience in ETL design and development.
Proficiency in SQL and database concepts.
Experience with relational databases such as Oracle, SQL Server, DB2, PostgreSQL, or MySQL.
Knowledge of DataStage components including:
Designer
Director
Administrator
Manager
Parallel Jobs
Sequence Jobs
Understanding of data warehousing concepts and dimensional modeling.
Experience in Unix/Linux commands and shell scripting.
Knowledge of source code management tools such as Git.
Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.

Description:
Job Description:
The Client Service at Delhivery will be responsible to provide exceptional service and support to customers, ensuring their satisfaction with Delhivery's products and services. You will handle inquiries, complaints, and requests through various communication channels, including phone, email, and chat. Your role involves understanding customer needs, resolving issues, and delivering accurate and timely information.
Key Responsibilities: 

Providing assistance with shipment tracking and delivery inquiries and drive regular engagement/quick response 
Resolving issues related to shipments (missing or damaged packages, customs delays, or delivery exceptions) 
CS Engagement via Ticketing module, getting timely response; Keep active track of timely closure of tickets 
Assisting with billing inquiries such as explaining charges, resolving disputes and/or claims, or providing information on payment options 
Providing support for shipping services and delivery options available, regulatory compliance, documentation requirements, claim monitoring 
Analyze and support with insights to improve the process and internal operations and service levels 
Handling customer escalations-preparing RCA / CAPA and providing the solution 
Collaborate with internal stakeholders to maintain and increase performance of client accounts 
Designing SOP, mapping and freezing requirements, client NPS management and providing best solutions to the business
AboutCompany: Delhivery Limited is India's largest and fastest-growing fully-integrated logistics services player by revenue as of Fiscal 2021. With its nationwide network covering over 17,000 pin codes, the company provides a full suite of logistics services such as express parcel transportation, PTL, TL freight, cross-border, supply chain, and technology services. Delhivery has successfully fulfilled over 1 billion shipments since inception and today works with over 23,000 customers, including large & small e-commerce participants, SMEs, and other enterprises & brands. For more information about Delhivery, please visit www.delhivery.com
CompanyAddress: PLOT NO. 5 SECTOR 44 GURGAON , GURGAON, Haryana, India
