About the Role

We're looking for a creative and detail-oriented Video Editor to join the Marketing team at upGrad. In this role, you'll create compelling video content that supports brand campaigns, performance marketing, social media, product launches, and learner engagement. You'll collaborate with marketers, designers, content creators, and creative strategists to deliver high-quality videos that drive awareness, engagement, and conversions.

Key Responsibilities

Create engaging short-form and long-form video content, including ads, reels, explainers, testimonials, webinars, and promotional videos.
Add motion graphics, text animations, transitions, sound effects, and color correction to enhance visual storytelling.
Repurpose existing content into multiple formats optimized for different platforms.
Collaborate with marketing, branding, and content teams to understand campaign objectives and creative briefs.
Maintain consistency with upGrad's brand guidelines across all video assets.
Manage multiple projects simultaneously while meeting tight deadlines.
Stay updated with video editing trends, social media formats, and emerging AI-powered editing tools.


Required Qualifications –

Bachelor's degree in Mass Communication, Multimedia, Film, Design, or a related field (preferred).
2–5 years of experience in video editing, preferably in a digital marketing, media, startup, or edtech environment.
Strong portfolio showcasing marketing videos, social media content, and promotional campaigns.


Required Skills –

Proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro and Adobe After Effects.
Working knowledge of Adobe Photoshop and Adobe Illustrator.
Experience with color grading, sound design, and motion graphics.
Understanding of social media video formats and performance marketing creatives.
Familiarity with AI-powered editing tools is a plus.
Strong storytelling, pacing, and visual composition skills.
Excellent time management and ability to work in a fast-paced environment.


Why Join upGrad?

Opportunity to contribute to one of India's leading EdTech organizations.
Exposure to large-scale digital campaigns and brand initiatives.
Collaborative and high-growth work environment.
Learning and development opportunities across diverse business functions.
AboutCompany:
Started in 2015, upGrad is one of Asia's largest integrated Learning, Skilling, and Workforce Development Majors. It offers a range of online & hybrid skilling, pathway and study abroad courses, Certifications, and Bootcamps under its B2C portfolio. It also facilitates top Indian and global universities to offer their Diploma, Masters and Executive Doctorates. It caters to the end-to-end learning requirements of freshers to seasoned professionals in the age group of 18-60+ years who would use constant learning to enhance their skill sets while also receiving career acceleration.

Impact: To bridge the gap between academia and the industry, upGrad has built an immersive and 360-degree integrated learning solution that rests upon strong pillars like Content, Technology and Deep Personalization, further accelerating stronger career outcomes for learners. It enjoys a wide brands credibility and recall within India Inc. and globally, and continues to command strong course completion rates as high as 80%+ and higher Repeat and Referral rates annually. The skilling major has achieved two consecutive years of remarkable growth, closing FY23 and FY24 with over 55,000 successful career transitions, further establishing the credibility and mettle of the online higher education segment in India and globally.

- Solicits employee feedback, utilizes an "open door" policy and reviews employee satisfaction results to identify and address employee problems or concerns.
- Supervises and coordinates activities of cooks and workers engaged in food preparation.
- Demonstrate new cooking techniques and equipment to staff.
Setting and Maintaining Goals for Culinary Function and Activities
- Develops and implements guidelines and control procedures for purchasing and receiving areas.
- Establishes goals including performance goals, budget goals, team goals, etc
- Communicates the importance of safety procedures, detailing procedure codes, ensuring employee understanding of safety codes, monitoring processes and procedures related to safety.
- Manages department controllable expenses including food cost, supplies, uniforms and equipment.
- Participates in the budgeting process for areas of responsibility.
- Knows and implements the brands safety standards.
Ensuring Culinary Standards and Responsibilities are Met
- Provides direction for menu development.
- Monitors the quality of raw and cooked food products to ensure that standards are met.
- Determines how food should be presented, and create decorative food displays.
- Recognizes superior quality products, presentations and flavor.
- Ensures compliance with food handling and sanitation standards.
- Follows proper handling and right temperature of all food products.
- Ensures employees maintain required food handling and sanitation certifications.
- Maintains purchasing, receiving and food storage standards.
- Prepares and cooks foods of all types, either on a regular basis or for special guests or functions.
Ensuring Exceptional Customer Service
- Provides and supports service behaviors that are above and beyond for customer satisfaction and retention.
- Improves service by communicating and assisting individuals to understand guest needs, providing guidance, feedback, and individual coaching when needed.
- Manages day-to-day operations, ensuring the quality, standards and meeting the expectations of the customers on a daily basis.
- Displays leadership in guest hospitality, exemplifies excellent customer service and creates a positive atmosphere for guest relations.
- Interacts with guests to obtain feedback on product quality and service levels.
- Responds to and handles guest problems and complaints.
- Empowers employees to provide excellent customer service.
Establishes guidelines so employees understand expectations and parameters.
Ensures employees receive on-going training to understand guest expectations.
- Reviews comment cards, guest satisfaction results and other data to identify areas of improvement.
Managing and Conducting Human Resource Activities
- Identifies the developmental needs of others and coaching, mentoring, or otherwise helping others to improve their knowledge or skills.
- Ensures employees are treated fairly and equitably.
- Trains kitchen associates on the fundamentals of good cooking and excellent plate presentations.

- Interacts with the Banquet Chef and Catering department on training regarding food knowledge and menu composition.

- Ensures disciplinary procedures and documentation are completed according to Standard and Local Operating Procedures (SOPs and LSOPs) and supports the Peer Review Process.
Additional Responsibilities

Description:
About the Role
We are looking for a sharp, energetic, and customer-focused Associate Inside Sales to join our Intracity Logistics business. The role will involve managing customer relationships, driving retention and growth, and identifying opportunities for upselling and cross-selling through effective inside sales.
The ideal candidate should have strong communication skills, a sales mindset, and the ability to build meaningful customer relationships while working in a fast-paced environment.
What You’ll Do
Manage a portfolio of customers and build strong, long-term relationships.
Drive customer retention and engagement through regular follow-ups and proactive account management.
Handle inbound and outbound sales calls to generate business opportunities.
Identify customer needs and recommend relevant Delhivery solutions.
Drive upselling and cross-selling opportunities within existing accounts.
Work closely with customers to understand their requirements and ensure a positive customer experience.
Support customer success by resolving queries and coordinating with internal teams for timely closure.
Maintain accurate customer and sales information and track opportunities through the sales funnel.
Meet defined sales, retention, revenue, and customer engagement targets.
Continuously identify opportunities to improve customer experience and business growth.
What We’re Looking For
0–3 years of experience in inside sales, account management, customer success, relationship management, telesales, or a similar customer-facing role.
Freshers with excellent communication skills and a strong interest in sales may also be considered.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Confident in handling inbound and outbound calls and engaging with customers.
Strong relationship-building and customer-handling skills.
Good sales orientation with the ability to upsell and cross-sell.
Sharp, proactive, and target-oriented with strong problem-solving abilities.
Comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
Basic proficiency in MS Office/Google Workspace and CRM tools
Prior experience in logistics, e-commerce, D2C, or B2B sales will be an added advantage.
Who Will Do Well in This Role?
Someone who is sharp, articulate, proactive, and comfortable speaking to customers every day—someone who enjoys sales and account management, takes ownership, learns quickly, and can turn customer conversations into meaningful business opportunities.
If you are looking to build a career in Inside Sales, Account Management & Customer Success with one of India’s leading logistics companies, we’d love to hear from you.

Description:
Job Summary
Overview: Join Xerox's Talent Acquisition team and be at the forefront of reinvention and innovation as we continue shaping the future of work.
As a Corporate Recruiter, you will play an integral role in delivering exceptional customer experiences by sourcing, screening, and engaging top talent to support Xerox's growth and strategic priorities. Using tools like Avature, you'll manage a seamless hiring process, create an exceptional candidate experience, and drive recruitment strategies that align with our mission to foster diversity and innovation.
Our recruitment team is essential to Xerox's success, enabling us to grow, evolve, and inspire while delivering on our commitment to inclusivity and excellence. You'll also lead process improvements and streamline efficiencies to build a best-in-class recruitment journey.
Sourcing and Candidate Engagement
Identify qualified candidates through Avature, job boards, social media, networking, and referrals.
Build and maintain talent pipelines to ensure a steady flow of qualified candidates for current and future roles, leveraging various tools.
Develop creative and innovative sourcing strategies to attract diverse talent pools.
Recruitment Process Management
Conduct intake meetings with hiring managers to understand role requirements and align hiring strategies.
Screen and interview candidates to assess qualifications, cultural fit, and alignment with Xerox's values.
Manage the recruitment lifecycle, including scheduling interviews, facilitating feedback, and negotiating offers.
Provide a first-class candidate experience by maintaining clear and timely communication.
Process Improvement and Candidate Experience
Analyze and refine recruitment workflows and processes to improve efficiency and effectiveness through all channels of engagement.
Collaborate with team members to identify and implement strategies for streamlining hiring processes.
Focus on enhancing the overall candidate experience by ensuring timely responses, clear communication, and a seamless journey from application to onboarding.
Leverage data and feedback to identify opportunities for continuous improvement and innovation within the recruitment process.
Collaboration and Strategy
Partner with business leaders & managers, serving as a trusted advisor, providing guidance on hiring best practices and diversity recruitment
Lead and support cross-functional projects aimed at improving recruiting operations, systems, or end-to-end workflow effectiveness.
Provide consistent updates to hiring leaders through scheduled calls, dashboards, and reporting to ensure transparency and alignment.
Support managers in initiating requisitions by guiding them on process, system navigation, and best practices.
Promote and model recruitment best practices, helping leaders optimize hiring strategies aligned with organizational goals.
Required Skills and Qualifications
Proven track record of success as a recruiter in a fast-paced, complex, and global organization.
Experience using Avature or other applicant tracking systems (ATS) and sourcing platforms.
Demonstrated ability to work independently and manage full-cycle recruitment, including sourcing, screening, interviewing, and offer negotiation.
Experience contributing to or leading projects that enhance recruitment operations, workflows, or systems to improve overall process effectiveness.
Exceptional organizational, time-management, and customer service skills.

AboutCompany:
Jaro Education is India’s most trusted online higher education company. The Edtech firm has been the first mover and a pioneer in the executive & online education industry. It was founded in 2009 by Dr Sanjay Salunkhe, has been profit-making since its inception, and is self-funded. The company has been awarded as Leading EdTech Company of the Year by Times Business Award 2024, India’s most trusted online higher education by Outlook Business Icon 2023, the Edtech Leadership award, and the National Best Employer accolade by the World HRD Congress in March 2022.
With its strong domain expertise and insight into executive education, Jaro Education has transformed the careers of over 3 lakh professionals in the last 14+ years through its 23+ learning centers across India, Singapore & USA. The company aims to nurture entrepreneurs & working professionals from entry-level to C-Suite level in every field and industry by offering executive education programs that cater to their requirements. Having been recognized for changing the online education landscape in India, Jaro Education provides more than 150+ management, technology, and techno-functional programs in collaboration with top reputed institutes.
They facilitate the development of leadership and technology-based online programs for many leading Indian and global institutes including Massachusetts Institute of Technology – Institute for Data, Systems, and Society (MIT IDSS), The Wharton Interactive (an initiative of The Wharton Business School, University of Pennsylvania), Rotman School of Management (University of Toronto), IIM Ahmedabad, IIM Kozhikode, IIM Mumbai, IIM Indore, XLRI Jamshedpur, IIM Tiruchirappalli, IIT Madras Pravartak, CEP – IIT Delhi, E&ICT – IIT Guwahati, Symbiosis International University (SSODL), and others.”

Description:
About the role:
We are looking for a detail-oriented and technically strong Car Inspection Engineer to
conduct comprehensive inspections of used cars sourced through dealer partners. The role is
responsible for accurately assessing a vehicle’s mechanical condition, body condition,
structural integrity, and overall quality, while ensuring standardized inspection processes and
transparent reporting.

What You Will Do:
Conduct detailed physical inspections of used cars at dealer locations, customer locations, yards, and designated inspection centers. 
Assess key vehicle systems including engine, transmission, suspension, brakes, tyres, steering, electrical systems, AC, and other mechanical components. 
Inspect the exterior and interior condition of vehicles, including body panels, paint quality, dents, scratches, accidental repairs, and signs of structural damage. 
Identify critical vehicle issues such as flood damage, major accidents, odometer tampering, structural damage, and significant mechanical defects. 
Conduct road tests to evaluate vehicle performance, drivability, handling, braking, and overall condition. 
Verify VIN/chassis number, engine number, registration details, and other relevant vehicle documents. 
Use diagnostic tools, inspection equipment, mobile applications, and digital platforms to conduct standardized vehicle assessments. 
Prepare accurate and detailed inspection reports with photographs, observations, identified defects, and recommendations. 
Identify approximate refurbishment/repair costs and clearly highlight major repairs or quality concerns. 
Complete inspections and reports within defined Turnaround Time (TAT). 
Clearly communicate critical defects, major repairs, and vehicle quality concerns to internal teams and dealer stakeholders 
Follow defined inspection SOPs, checklists, quality standards, and safety protocols. 
Maintain accurate inspection records and ensure data quality on the inspection platform/mobile application. 
Identify recurring vehicle quality issues and provide actionable feedback to improve inspection processes, standards, and quality controls. 
What we are looking for:
ITI, Diploma, or Graduate qualification in Automobile Engineering. 
3–5 years of relevant experience as an Automobile Evaluator, Mechanic, Service Advisor, Assistant Service Advisor, or similar role. 
Experience working with passenger vehicles and strong understanding of automotive systems and components. 
Strong multi-brand vehicle technical knowledge. 
Ability to identify accidental damage, mechanical defects, structural issues, and major repair requirements. 
Hands-on experience with vehicle diagnostic tools and inspection applications will be preferred.
Strong attention to detail with excellent observation and problem-solving skills. 
Ability to prepare clear, accurate, and unbiased inspection reports. 
Comfortable using smartphones, tablets, and digital inspection platforms. 
Willingness to travel extensively for vehicle inspections. 
Valid driving licence and practical driving skills preferred. 
What we will give you:
Opportunity to work with modern digital inspection platforms, diagnostic tools, and technology-enabled processes. 
A fast-paced environment where your technical expertise directly influences vehicle quality and business decisions. 
A role with strong ownership, autonomy, and visibility in a growing automotive business. 
A performance-driven environment with opportunities for learning, growth, and career progression. 
At OLX India, we are committed to creating a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace. We strongly encourage people of all races, ethnicities, disabilities, ages, gender identities or expressions, sexual orientations, religions, backgrounds, and experiences to apply.
We embrace diversity and welcome applicants from all backgrounds. If you are as excited as we are about this position and our company, we hope you join us! To learn more, take a look at our website.
"Our Success is fueled by diverse perspectives and talents."

Description:
About the Role
Sales Associate is responsible for providing the best customer experience in the stores by providing high standards of selling services to Lenskart customers. He/she plays a pivotal role in driving the revenue achieved by the store.
Responsibilities Area Activities expected to be performed by a Lenskart Sales Associate
Customer focus
Sales Associate is expected to greet and welcome all walk-in customers and guide them toward the clinic, promoting the free eye check-up
He/she will be involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day tasks to deliver the best shopping experience to the customers
He/she must possess a basic understanding of the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively
He/she must be dedicated to customer satisfaction and must go beyond his means to resolve any concerns that the customer has
Product recommendation
With the information received from the Optometrist and the customer, he/she will present the customer with an optimal selection of products. This opportunity may be used to strike a conversation and convert it into sales
He/she is expected to understand the unstated needs of the customer, ask relevant questions,
and pick the right time to pitch the recommended solutions
Achieving sales targets & SOP adherence
Sales Associate is expected to achieve the assigned target for sales, eye-test conversion, and returns. He/she must follow all assigned SOPs diligently
Post making the sale, he/she is responsible for coordinating with the customer for product pick up, after receiving due communication from the warehouse. He/she will verify the accuracy of the lenses fitted before handing over the product to the customer. In case of returns, he/she is expected to understand the reason and try to resolve the same to control the return percentage
Store upkeep & maintenance
He/she is expected to maintain Lenskart standards of hygiene in the store with respect to the overall display, frames, instruments, and other store equipment by cleaning them regularly
He/she must ensure the security of all Lenskart equipment and ensure there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store
Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification: 12th pass; Graduates preferred
Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions
Clear articulation and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to changing environment and openness to learn
Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation
Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority

Description:
About the Role

A Store Manager at Lenskart acts as an important link between strategy and execution. He/she drives the store towards achieving all assigned metrics of Store Sales, Conversions, Customer satisfaction etc. and is responsible for keeping a high level of morale among the store staff, developing them, controlling attrition, and ensuring smooth operations at the store.
Responsibilities:

Customer focus: Driving Net Promoter Score ( NPS )

Greeting customers when they enter store and coaching the team to do the same
Displaying commitment towards providing exceptional Customer Service and ensuring that Lenskart associates also treat Customer Satisfaction as a priority
Dealing with customer service issues such as queries and complaints at store level and ensuring this is consistent with the team
Striving to have long lasting and fruitful relationships with each of our customers

Driving sales vs. plan

Driving the sales of the store to meet the allotted targets by allocating the targets to the staff
Developing a culture of high sales performance expectations, i.e. Sales Leadership
Motivating and inspiring the field team to drive for results
Assessing field capability and establish performance priorities at group level

People development (Attrition Control)

Assisting in recruiting and selecting high potential staff
Providing effective on-the-job training and guidance to team members making use of company training modules
Delivering clear, motivating and constructive feedback in a timely manner to all retail associates
Evaluating the training needs of store associates and working closely with L&D department to execute the developmental plan
Understanding the reasons for attrition and taking measures to control it

Cash & Inventory management

Monitoring cash reconciliation to ensure there is no mismatch of store funds
Ensuring availability of required merchandise and services
Conducting stocktakes regularly
Ensuring the staff at store level has basic understanding of POS System to ensure transactions are properly and effectively processed
Performing the necessary quality checks for the new products
Working very closely with other departments till the product reaches the customer and ensuring the best customer experience to the Lenskart Customer

Supervision

Ensuring that all store employees, including the Optometrist, are taken care of and their issues are resolved
Ensuring that the eye check-ups are conducted as per the SOP and maintain high quality standards

SOP adherence & implementation

Ensuring that all SOPs for retail are implemented successfully and adhered to by store employees
Updating colleagues on business performance, new initiatives and other important issues
Scheduling the teams shift timings to meet the stores business needs and demands
Ensuring staffing levels are adequate to effectively operate the store

Store upkeep & maintenance

Maintaining the store as per Lenskart standards, regularly cleaning the frames and other equipment at the store
Ensuring the security of all Lenskart equipment and that there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store

Job Responsibility
1. Sales Planning:
Drives sales in the specified territory for a particular product line ensuring volume sales, market share growth and enhanced customer engagement in assigned territory
Plan and conduct monthly target setting including marketing activations at the dealerships in line with forecast/ estimated TIV and sales volume for the assigned territory

Execute trainings for dealer sales team on pre-sales & sales processes, new product features / modifications etc.

Description:
Profile Summary
Our Area Operations Manager is responsible for developing and expanding the business in the respective area and managing the store operations across the respective area thereby increasing the customer experience.
Key Responsibilities
Driving Sales and Customer Service
a. Driving and ensuring to meet or exceed the sales plan of the respective territory monthly/ quarterly and annually
b. Driving and focusing on providing the customer services thereby increasing the Net Promoter Score (NPS) for the store
c. Drive culture of high sales performance expectations, i.e. SALES Leadership
d. Motivates and inspires field team to drive for results.
e. Review financial performance at regional level to identify improvement opportunities.
f. Serve as critical strategy planning link between Corporate and the field organization.
g. Translate corporate goals including financial returns, sales growth and market share, into business plans.
h. Assess field capability and establish performance priorities at group level.
Manpower Planning & People Development
a. Working with the HR team and the Store Manager in ensuring staffing levels are adequate to effectively operate the store
b. Direct responsibility for professional development of Lenskart Associates
c. Assess and prioritize advanced management skill gaps including those related to design and implementation of business plans, forecasts, financial analysis, associate development and communication.
d. Conduct two-way, formal and informal performance evaluations of Lenskart Associates which review professional development needs and accomplishments as well as overall achievement of management objectives
e. Responsible for establishing a culture that embraces diversity and maximizes the learnings from a diverse team.
f. Overall responsibility for associate development
Managing P&L of the Assigned Stores
a. Responsible for managing and maintaining territory and store budgets to ensure profitability at store as well as territory level
b. Managing the top and bottom line effectively of the assigned territory and stores
c. Responsible for reducing shrinkage
d. Managing the productivity of the staff
e. Using cost effective methods to ensure productivity of the respective territory
Managing and Maintaining High Standards of Retail Operations
a.Regular Store Visits to:
Audit stores
Coaching the Store Managers
Motivate staff through sales discussions
Check VM, stock availability
Check store hygiene, grooming
Assess discipline levels in store opening times, staff attendance, process adherence etc.
b. Analyze data before Store Visits
Monitoring Sales through data.
Assessing the productivity and achievements of the stores
Store Staffing levels.
Product flow, supply, demand and shrinkage.
NPS and MC scores
Reviewing measures to achieve performance targets
a.Bridge communication between Management and floor
Recommending changes to ZM/BH basis visits.
Ensure Timely reporting of Data when needed.
Implementing and enforcing company regulations
Implement process change
Attending conferences, events and meetings at regional as well as corporate level to enhance knowledge and skill sets
Inventory Management
a. Ensures availability of required merchandise and services at each of the assigned stores
b. Ensuring that inventory levels are well balanced and making key decisions about inventory control at each of the assigned stores
c. Ensuring physical verification of inventory on regular intervals is being conducted at each of the assigned stores
d. Ensuring the staff at store level has basic understanding of POS System to ensure transactions are properly and effectively processed
e. Ensuring necessary quality checks for the new products is being conducted in a timely manner
f. Responsible for reducing shrinkage at store level
g. Working very closely with various departments in the organization till the product reaches the customer and ensuring the best customer experience to the Lenskart Customer
Key Personal and Professional Attributes:
a) Collaborative Skills: The role requires the incumbent to work closely and coordinate with the Internal and external teams to create success. S/he should be able to seamlessly navigate these relationship dynamics in a high growth, young, agile business environment.
b) Functional understanding: The role is critical for the business performance and would require the incumbent to create a competitive business advantage. It would be critical to analyze the effectiveness of the processes on a day to day basis and course correct.
c) Data driven/ Analytical: The role is required to drive specific process efficiency metrics and would be accountable to drive data-driven decision making.
d) Results oriented: The role is required to work on deliver on daily numbers, short-term goals and long-term milestones set by business and efficacy. Meeting these milestones would be critical to create success.
e) Extroverted Personality
f) Pleasant & Friendly who can be easily approached
g) Pragmatic Leaders who are self -motivated and resilient
h) Passionate
i) Energetic
j) Positive Attitude
k) Ability to handle stressful situations
l) Problem Solving & Decision Making
m) Assertive
n) Sales Driven & Number Oriented Team player
Candidate Profile:
a) Full Time Post Graduate with 7-9 years of relevant experience into retail industry
b) Post-Graduation is a must
c) Very strong communication skills- both written and verbal and must be a good orator
d) Should have hands on experience working on Microsoft Office- Including Excel, PPT & Word
e) Strong inter-personal skills (friendly, caring & patient)
f) Sales oriented
g) Strong Management/leadership skills.
h) Strong organizational skills.
i) Strong team builder
Required Managerial Competencies
People Management
a) Mentors team members and colleagues; guides them with regard to development and career progression.
b) Clearly communicates work responsibilities and expectations and takes steps to balance the workload among team members.
c) Anticipates the effect of an action on other people and modifies such action accordingly.
d) Resolves conflicts among colleagues in just and fair manner
Proactive Problem Solving Skills
a) Anticipates problems before they develop, and takes steps to avert them.
b) Considers a situation from multiple perspectives before deciding on a course of action.
c) Adept at managing the flow of information in times of crisis.
d) Appeals to reason, facts, and figures and adapts managerial style based on the demands of the situation
Commercial Savviness
a) Protects the commercial interests of the company with the aim of maximizing revenue.
b) Takes appropriate business decisions after performing a cost-benefit analysis and pre-empts problems and resolves them, ensuring minimal business loss.
c) Builds and manages workforce based on organizational goals and budget constraints
Customer Expectation Management
a) Adept at balancing the interests of the company with the needs and expectations of the client/customer
b) Responds deliberately and diplomatically to protect company interests
c) Communicates effectively about sensitive matters and influences the client/customer when required
Planning and Organizing
a) Adept at prioritization and time management to ensure efficient and timely completion of assignments
b) Manages and shifts priorities as required and incorporates new approaches
c) Delegates work effectively among team members
Required Personality Traits
a) Extraversion - The trait is marked by pronounced engagement with the external world. Extraverts enjoy interacting with people, and are often perceived as full of energy. They tend to be enthusiastic, action-oriented individuals. They possess high group visibility, like to talk, and assert themselves
b) Conscientiousness- It is a tendency to display self-discipline, act dutifully, and strive for achievement against measures or outside expectations. It is related to the way in which people control, regulate, and direct their impulses. High scores on conscientiousness indicate a preference for planned rather than spontaneous behavior
c) Openness to Experience- Openness is a general appreciation for art, emotion, adventure, unusual ideas, imagination, curiosity, and variety of experience. People who are open to experience are intellectually curious, open to emotion, sensitive to beauty and willing to try new things. They tend to be, when compared to closed people, more creative and more aware of their feelings
d) Agreeableness- The agreeableness trait reflects individual differences in general concern for social harmony. Agreeable individuals value getting along with others. They are generally considerate, kind, generous, trusting and trustworthy, helpful, and willing to compromise their interests with others.
e) Polychronicity- it is defined as a continuum, and preferences for degrees of engagement. At one extreme is the pattern of focusing on one task at a time, interpreting other potential tasks and events as interruptions and attempting to shield one's chosen task from such interference. The other extreme is actually open-ended, it involves engagement in several tasks simultaneously, sometimes literally simultaneously and sometimes in a frequent back-and-forth engagement pattern
f) Emotional Stability- People high on emotional stability do not tend to have a negative outlook of the future and hence are usually calmer. Persons who score low in emotional stability generally have a fearful and negative disposition, with an ominous foreboding about things.

Job Summary
The role will be responsible to drive sales and customer acquisition for home loan and mortgage products, and contribute to the organizations revenue growth through direct sourcing and strategic networking. Educational Qualifications
Minimum: Graduate in any discipline (Bachelors degree required)
Having a two-wheeler will be an added advantage

Description:
The position assists with the soliciting and handling of sales opportunities.
Ensures business is turned over properly and in a timely fashion for proper service delivery.
Assists in leading all day-to-day activities related to sales with a focus on building long-term, value-based customer relationships that enable achievement of sales objectives.
Achieves personal sales goals.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Business Administration, Marketing, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; 2 years experience in the sales and marketing or related professional area. OR
- 4-year bachelors degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; no work experience required
CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Building Successful Relationships that Generate Sales Opportunities
- Works collaboratively with off-property sales channels to ensure sales efforts are coordinated, complementary and not duplicative.
- Builds and strengthens relationships with existing and new customers to enable future bookings.
Activities include participating on sales calls, entertainment, FAM trips, trade shows, etc
- Develops relationships within community to strengthen and expand customer base for sales opportunities.
- Assists with managing and developing relationships with key internal and external stakeholders.
- Provides accurate, complete and effective turnover to Event Management.
Managing Sales Activities
- Participates in sales calls with members of sales team to acquire new business and/or close on business.
- Supports the operational aspects of business booked (eg, generating proposal, writing contract, customer correspondence).
Using Knowledge of Market Trends and Target Customer Information to Maximize Revenue
- Identifies new business to achieve personal and location revenue goals.
- Understands the overall market - competitors strengths and weaknesses, economic trends, supply and demand etc and knows how to sell against them.
- Assists in closing the best opportunities for the location based on market conditions and location needs.
- Gains understanding of the location s primary target customer and service expectations; serves the customer by understanding their business, business issues and concerns, to offer better business solution.
Providing Exceptional Customer Service
- Supports the company s service and relationship strategy, driving customer loyalty by delivering service excellence throughout each customer experience.
- Services our customers in order to grow share of the account.
- Executes and supports the company s customer service standards.
- Provides excellent customer service consistent with the daily service basics of the company.
- Sets a positive example for guest relations.
- Interacts with guests to obtain feedback on product quality and service levels.
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Description:
About Jaro Education
Jaro Education is a leading higher education company focused on providing executive education and online learning opportunities to working professionals through partnerships with reputed universities and institutions.

Job Overview
We are looking for energetic and target-oriented Inside Sales Executives to join our Admissions & Executive Education Sales team.
The role involves engaging with working professionals, understanding their career goals, counselling them on relevant higher education programs, and managing the complete sales cycle from lead generation to enrolment closure.

Key Responsibilities
Connect with prospective customers through calls and follow-ups.
Handle both warm and cold leads and build a strong sales pipeline.
Understand candidates' career goals, professional background and requirements.
Provide consultative counselling and recommend relevant higher education and executive programs.
Explain program details, curriculum, benefits and career outcomes.
Manage the complete sales cycle including lead nurturing, follow-ups, objection handling, fee negotiation and enrolment closure.
Achieve daily calling, weekly conversion and monthly revenue targets.
Maintain accurate lead and follow-up information in CRM.
Coordinate with internal teams to ensure a smooth onboarding experience.

Candidate Profile
Graduate in any discipline.
0-5 years of experience in Inside Sales, B2C Sales, Telesales, EdTech, Education Sales, Admissions or Business Development.
Strong verbal communication and convincing skills.
Comfortable working in a target-driven environment.
Strong negotiation, objection handling and closing skills.
Ability to build rapport and effectively communicate with working professionals.
Experience with CRM tools will be an added advantage.

Why Join Jaro Education?
Opportunity to work in the growing Higher Education and EdTech industry.
Exposure to executive education and reputed academic institutions.
Performance-driven career growth opportunities.
Structured career progression into Senior CDO, Team Leader, Assistant Manager and Business Manager roles.

Description:
About Smart Working
At Smart Working, we believe your job should not only look right on paper but also feel right every day. This isn t just another remote opportunity - it s about finding where you truly belong, no matter where you are. From day one, you re welcomed into a genuine community that values your growth and well-being.
Our mission is simple: to break down geographic barriers and connect skilled professionals with outstanding global teams and products for full-time, long-term roles. We help you discover meaningful work with teams that invest in your success, where you re empowered to grow personally and professionally.
Join one of the highest-rated workplaces on Glassdoor and experience what it means to thrive in a truly remote-first world.
About the Role
As a Mobile Developer, you will enhance an existing cross-platform mobile application, delivering new features, improving the user interface and implementing API changes. The role involves an equal 50/50 split between front-end and back-end development, contributing to a data-heavy application where attention to detail is essential.
You will work alongside an existing mobile developer, eight software developers, two project managers and other supporting IT staff. The position combines independent working with collaboration across the project team and other mobile developers.
You will have the autonomy to manage your tasks flexibly while following established DevOps processes. The role is primarily delivery-focused, with opportunities to contribute to technical problem-solving discussions. You will work in a fast-paced environment while ensuring all deliverables meet requirements.
Responsibilities
Enhance and maintain an existing cross-platform mobile application.
Develop and implement new features within the application.
Implement API changes to support application functionality.
Develop and improve mobile user interfaces.
Contribute to both front-end and back-end development, with a 50/50 split.
Perform testing to ensure application functionality meets requirements.
Manage assigned development tasks independently and efficiently.
Collaborate with the project team and other mobile developers.
Maintain accuracy and attention to detail when working with data-heavy systems.
Follow established DevOps processes while working flexibly and autonomously.
Execute development tasks and participate in problem-solving discussions when required.
Deliver work at pace while ensuring it meets the specified requirements.
Requirements
Minimum 2 years of experience in .NET MAUI or relevant cross-platform/native mobile development using React Native, Flutter, Swift or Android Studio.
Minimum 2 years of experience in .NET / C#, which is an essential requirement with no substitute.
Minimum 2 years of relevant professional experience in mobile development.
Ability to work independently and collaboratively with project teams and other mobile developers.
Strong attention to detail, particularly when working with data-heavy systems.
Ability to manage tasks autonomously while following established DevOps processes.
Ability to execute assigned development tasks and contribute to technical problem-solving discussions when required.
Ability to work in a fast-paced environment while ensuring deliverables meet requirements.
Nice to Have
At least 1 year of experience with Azure Pipelines or GitHub Actions.
At least 2 years of experience with GitHub or equivalent version control platforms such as GitLab or Bitbucket.
At least 1 year of experience with Jira for project management or alternatives such as Linear or Trello.
At least 1 year of experience with Claude Code or Codex.
We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

About Smart Working
At Smart Working, we believe your job should not only look right on paper but also feel right every day. This isn t just another remote opportunity - it s about finding where you truly belong, no matter where you are. From day one, you re welcomed into a genuine community that values your growth and well-being.
Our mission is simple: to break down geographic barriers and connect skilled professionals with outstanding global teams and products for full-time, long-term roles. We help you discover meaningful work with teams that invest in your success, where you re empowered to grow personally and professionally.
Join one of the highest-rated workplaces on Glassdoor and experience what it means to thrive in a truly remote-first world.
About the Role
As a Senior Python Engineer (Backend / Data), you will join an existing engineering team to strengthen backend development and data engineering capabilities. This is a long-term, ongoing opportunity (subject to confirmation), focused on building and maintaining reliable production systems.
You will work closely with the engineering team and an existing DevOps/SRE engineer on infrastructure, deployments and releases. The role requires independent ownership of assigned work, collaboration across engineering functions and an understanding of how data pipelines support the wider product.
You will contribute to engineering decisions, maintain high standards of data quality, correctness and testing, and propose solutions rather than simply execute assigned tasks. Reliability and thoroughness in production are key priorities.
Responsibilities
Design, build and maintain reliable data pipelines in Python on AWS.
Build and maintain backend services and APIs using Django and FastAPI.
Model, query and optimise data across PostgreSQL and search/NoSQL databases, including OpenSearch, Elasticsearch and DynamoDB.
Deploy and run services on Kubernetes, working alongside the DevOps engineer.
Take end-to-end ownership of assigned work, including design, testing, code reviews, releases and production support.
Work independently on assigned tasks while collaborating closely with the engineering team and DevOps/SRE engineer on infrastructure and releases.
Maintain high standards of data quality, correctness and testing while understanding how data pipelines contribute to the wider product.
Follow established engineering practices, including code reviews and CI/CD, while adapting to changing priorities.
Proactively identify problems, propose solutions and challenge technical decisions when necessary rather than simply executing tickets.
Prioritise thoroughness, reliability and production stability when developing and maintaining data pipelines and data stores.
Requirements
6+ years of experience in software engineering, including 5+ years of commercial Python development.
5+ years of Python backend development experience, with strong hands-on engineering capabilities.
3+ years of experience in data pipelines and data engineering, including ETL/ELT processes and batch processing. Relevant technologies include Airflow, Dagster, Prefect, AWS Glue and Step Functions.
3+ years of AWS experience, with practical experience developing and maintaining cloud-based backend services and data pipelines. Strong GCP or Azure experience may be considered on a case-by-case basis.
3+ years of experience with Python web frameworks, particularly Django or FastAPI. Flask is an acceptable alternative.
3+ years of PostgreSQL experience, including data modelling, querying and optimisation. MySQL or SQL Server experience may be considered where strong SQL expertise is demonstrated elsewhere.
2+ years of experience with non-relational or search databases, such as Elasticsearch, OpenSearch or DynamoDB. Relevant alternatives include MongoDB, Redis and Cassandra.
2+ years of Kubernetes experience, including deploying and running services. Docker combined with ECS or EKS exposure may be considered as an alternative.
Ability to independently own technical tasks from design through implementation, testing, release and production support.
Strong attention to data quality, correctness, testing and production reliability.
Ability to collaborate with engineering and infrastructure teams while independently proposing solutions and challenging decisions where appropriate.
Ability to follow engineering practices and adapt to changing priorities.

Description:
Delhivery is Indias leading fulfillment platform for digital commerce. With its nationwide network extending beyond 18,000 pin codes and 2,500 cities, the company provides a full suite of logistics services such as express parcel transportation, LTL and FTL freight, reverse logistics, cross-border, B2B & B2C warehousing and technology services.

Delhivery has successfully fulfilled over 550 million transactions since inception and today works with over 10,000 direct customers, which includes large & small e-commerce participants, SMEs, and over 350 leading enterprises & brands.

Vision- Since its inception in 2011, Delhivery has become Indias leading supply chain services company. Our vision is to become the operating system for commerce in India, through a combination of world-class infrastructure, high-quality logistics operations, cutting-edge engineering, and technology capabilities.

Team- Delhivery was founded in 2011 by Sahil Barua, Mohit Tandon, Bhavesh Manglani, Suraj Saharan, and Kapil Bharati and is now 40,000+ people strong.

Role Details: Designation : Associate
Mode:Work from Office (6 Days working)
Location - Chandigarh and Gurgaon

Job Description: The Client Service Associate at Delhivery will be responsible to provide exceptional service and support to customers, ensuring their satisfaction with Delhivery's products and services. You will handle inquiries, complaints, and requests through various communication channels, including phone, email, and chat. Your role involves understanding customer needs, resolving issues, and delivering accurate and timely information.

Key Responsibilities:

Providing assistance with shipment tracking and delivery inquiries and drive regular engagement/quick response
Resolving issues related to shipments (missing or damaged packages, customs delays, or delivery exceptions)
CS Engagement via Ticketing module, getting timely response; Keep active track of timely closure of tickets
Assisting with billing inquiries such as explaining charges, resolving disputes and/or claims, or providing information on payment options
Providing support for shipping services and delivery options available, regulatory compliance, documentation requirements, claim monitoring
Analyzeandsupport with insights to improve the process and internal operations and service levels
Handling customer escalations-preparing RCA / CAPA and providing the solution
Collaborate with internal stakeholders to maintain and increase performance of client accounts
Designing SOP, mapping and freezing requirements, client NPS management and providing best solutions to the business Required Skills and competencies
Excellent communication skills: You should possess strong verbal and written communication abilities to effectively interact with customers and convey information clearly and concisely.
Customer-centric approach: A deep understanding of customer needs and the ability to keep focus on their issue is a fast paced and complex environment
Problem-solving skills: You must be adept at analyzing customer issues, identifying root causes, and providing appropriate solutions or escalating matters as needed.
Time management: The ability to prioritize tasks, manage multiple inquiries simultaneously, and meet deadlines is essential for efficient customer service delivery.
Familiarity with customer-relationship management (CRM) software programs
Problem-solving and critical thinking: You will encounter complex customer issues that require effective problem-solving skills and the ability to think critically. You should be able to analyze situations, evaluate available options, and propose viable solutions to ensure customer satisfaction.
Flexible with the working schedule; may be expected to work weekends, holidays and events where there is increased service demand

Delhivery is Indias leading fulfillment platform for digital commerce. With its nationwide network extending beyond 18,000 pin codes and 2,500 cities, the company provides a full suite of logistics services such as express parcel transportation, LTL and FTL freight, reverse logistics, cross-border, B2B & B2C warehousing and technology services.

Position: Associate, (freshers are also welcome)
Location: Chandigarh
Department: Fleet Operations
Working Days - 6
Freshers are also welcome

About the Role: We are looking for detail-oriented and highly attentive candidates to assist in the Dispute Resolution and Usage confirmation by fleet vendors.

This is a critical role that ensures accuracy in vendor payments and helps maintain financial integrity in our fleet operations.
This position offers a unique opportunity to understand the cost control, and compliance in running large-scale logistics operations.

Key Responsibilities:
Verify & validate grievances raised by fleet vendors for accuracy and authenticity.
Cross-check billing claims with supporting documents to identify discrepancies and prevent duplicate payments.
Ensure all required receipts and supporting documents are available before approving payments.
Maintain detailed records of all validated grievances and highlight any missing or incorrect submissions.
Work closely with the Fleet and Finance teams to resolve discrepancies and ensure timely processing of payments.
Follow standard operating procedures (SOPs) to ensure compliance and prevent financial risks.

Who Should Apply?
Have strong attention to detail and can spot errors or inconsistencies in documents.
Are highly responsible and diligent in handling financial records.
Have basic knowledge of finance, accounting, or logistics (preferred but not mandatory).
Are proficient in MS Excel/Google Sheets for data validation and record-keeping.
Are eager to learn about financial compliance in logistics operations.
Can work with minimal supervision and ensure accuracy in high-volume data processing.
Having strong communication skills to deal with fleet vendors and the operation team.


What You Will Learn?

Importance of documentation in logistics billing and vendor payments.
How cost validation impacts fleet operations and financial efficiency.
Hands-on experience in financial audits and compliance in logistics.
Problem-solving and analytical skills in identifying billing discrepancies.

Role & responsibilities
Generate new B2B leads and develop business opportunities for logistics and transportation services.
Identify and approach manufacturers, exporters, SMEs, traders, distributors, and other businesses requiring transportation/logistics solutions.
Conduct regular field visits and client meetings to generate new business.
Build and maintain strong relationships with existing and potential clients.
Prospect new customers through cold calling, field visits, references, networking, market research, and other lead-generation activities.
Understand customer transportation requirements and coordinate with the internal team to provide suitable solutions.
Prepare quotations, negotiate with clients, and follow up until business closure.
Achieve monthly/quarterly sales and lead-generation targets.
Develop a strong pipeline of prospective clients and maintain regular follow-ups.
Identify new market segments and business opportunities within the logistics/transportation sector.
Maintain proper records of leads, client meetings, follow-ups, quotations, and conversions.
Monitor competitor activities and market trends.

2-5 years of experience in Sales / Business Development, preferably in Logistics, Transportation, Freight, Cargo, Supply Chain, or related industries.
Candidates with an existing network among manufacturers, exporters, SMEs, traders, or corporate clients will be preferred.
Strong understanding of B2B sales and lead generation.
Must be comfortable with field sales and regular client visits.
Own vehicle (two-wheeler/car) is mandatory.
Good communication, negotiation, presentation, and relationship-building skills.
Self-motivated, result-oriented, and capable of working independently.
Should have a proactive approach toward finding and converting new business opportunities.
Candidates currently working in the logistics/transportation industry are especially encouraged to apply.

B2B Sales | Business Development | Lead Generation | Logistics Sales | Transportation Sales | Field Sales | Corporate Sales | Client Acquisition | Cold Calling | Customer Relationship Management | Negotiation | Market Development

Performance-Based Incentives – Additional incentives based on business generation and achievement of targets.
Growth Opportunities – Opportunity to build a career in the logistics and transportation industry.
Learning & Exposure – Direct exposure to B2B sales, client acquisition, and business development.

Description:
About the Role
We are looking for an experienced and target-driven Manager – Key Accounts (Inside Sales) to lead a high-performing team of 30 associates and drive revenue growth, customer retention, and own end-to-end account management
The ideal candidate will have strong experience in Inside Sales, Key Account Management, Customer Retention, and Account Management, with a proven track record of achieving challenging business and growth targets. You should have a strong understanding of the sales funnel and complete sales lifecycle, along with the ability to coach and develop large sales teams that become trusted advisors for our client partners.
Key Responsibilities
Lead, manage, and motivate a team of 30 Inside Sales/Key Account associates.
Own and deliver revenue, sales, growth, retention, and productivity targets for the team.
Develop and execute strategies to drive account growth, upselling, cross-selling, and customer retention - own the sales retention funnel to drive SoW gain and increase order frequency 
Drive performance across the entire sales lifecycle and identify opportunities to improve conversion at each stage.
Analyze sales metrics, team productivity, revenue performance, conversion ratios, retention, and other key KPIs. Identify performance gaps and implement structured sales training, coaching, and improvement plans.
Conduct regular performance reviews, coaching sessions, and team huddles to improve individual and team performance.
Work closely with cross-functional teams such as Operations, Customer Success, Marketing, and Product to improve customer experience and business outcomes.
Build forecasting mechanisms and ensure accurate tracking of pipeline, revenue, and growth targets.
Establish a strong performance-oriented culture focused on customer retention, revenue growth, productivity, and conversion.
Have a pulse on the voice of the customer that could help build critical product/experience improvements to build client stickiness on the platform 
What We’re Looking For
5+ years of overall experience, with significant experience in Inside Sales / Account Management / Key Account Management / Customer Retention.
Prior experience managing a large sales team of 30+ members is highly preferred.
Proven experience of managing and delivering revenue and growth targets.
Strong understanding of the inside sales process, sales funnel, and end-to-end sales lifecycle.
Demonstrated experience in customer retention, account growth, upselling, and cross-selling.
Strong analytical and data-driven approach to sales and team management.
Excellent people-management, coaching, and communication skills.
Ability to work in a high-pressure, target-driven environment.
Strong understanding of sales metrics such as conversion rate, revenue per associate, productivity, pipeline, retention, churn, and achievement against target.
Strong stakeholder management and problem-solving abilities

Description:
Title Sales Associate
Reportingto Store Manager
SkipLevel Areas Operations Manager
Aboutthe Role
A Sales Associate is responsible for providing the best customer experience in the stores by providing high standards of selling services to customers. He/she plays a key role in driving the revenue achieved by the store.
Responsibilities
Area
ActivitiesexpectedtobeperformedbyaLenskartSalesAssociate
Customerfocus: Driving Net Promoter Score
Greeting and welcoming all walk-in customers and guiding them toward the clinic to promote the free eye check-up
Being involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day tasks to deliver the best shopping experience to the customers
Understanding the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively
Being dedicated to customer satisfaction and resolving any concerns that the customer has
Product recommendation
Presenting the customer with an optimal selection of products based on customer preferences Understanding the unstated needs of the customer, asking relevant questions, and picking the
right time to pitch the recommended solutions
Achievingsales Vs.Plan&SOP adherence
Achieving the assigned target for sales, eye-test conversion, returns; and following all SOPs
Post making the sale, coordinating with the customer for product pick-up, after receiving due communication from the warehouse. In case of returns, he/she is expected to understand the reason and try to resolve the same to control the return percentage.
Storeupkeep& maintenance
Maintaining the store as per Lenskart standards, cleaning the frames and other equipment regularly, and ensuring there is no deviation as per the SOP
Ensuring the security of all Lenskart equipment and that there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store
Personalattributes&competencies
Minimum qualification: 12th pass; Graduates preferred Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions Clear communication and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to changing environment and openness to learn
Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priorityRole & responsibilities
Note :
Family Insurance Policy and Monthly Incentive policy
Professionalized Training with Lenskart Academy ( Mandatory )

Description:
About us:
Paytm is India's leading mobile payments and financial services distribution company. Pioneer of the mobile QR payments revolution in India, Paytm builds technologies that help small businesses with payments and commerce. Paytms mission is to serve half a billion Indians and bring them to the mainstream economy with the help of technology.

About the team:
EDC Retail is one of Paytm‘s business tools to help merchants grow and manage their business through simplicity and data driven technology.

About the role:
The person should be capable of increasing the sale of QR & Soundbox through proper channels to the merchants across multiple locations.

Expectations/ Requirements :

1. Grow Distribution and Market share in the assigned area of operations.
2. Visibility Accountability through Extensive QR & Sound box deployment and sale of the product.
3. Identify and Recruit the sales team to align and drive business in the market.
4. Skilled in coaching and mentoring, a quick learner who grasps and puts into application new learned ideas and concepts.
5. Plan the market size, span and geographies for FSE.
6. Should be able to devise the best methods for communication of plans/targets to the team so as to minimize the expectations vs delivery gap.
7. Monitor the Quality parameters as suggested by the management.
8. Validate and conduct the audits on the acquisitions and sales done by the team.
9. Ensure the team members are in the market where sales & usage are done regularly 10. Should have good networking capabilities and be willing to travel extensively throughout their specified area.

Superpowers/ Skills that will help you succeed in this role

1. High level of drive, initiative and self-motivation
2. Must Have Experience in Leading Team
3. Must Be a Graduate
4. Growth Mindset

Why join us :
We aim at bringing half a billion Indians into the mainstream economy, and everyone working here is striving to achieve that goal. Our success is rooted in our people’s collective energy and unwavering focus on the customers, and that’s how it will always be. We are the largest merchant acquirer in India.


Qualification:-
Graduate/Post Graduate.

Description:
Role & responsibilities
The Sales Executive shall be responsible for promoting and selling solar power solutions offered by Gibbon Infrastructures Pvt. Ltd., with a primary focus on residential rooftop solar installations under the PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana, along with commercial and industrial solar projects.
The employee shall be responsible for lead generation, customer acquisition, site visit coordination, documentation, sales conversion, order booking, payment follow-up, and coordination with the installation and technical teams to ensure smooth execution of solar projects.

Preferred candidate profile
A minimum Class X pass candidate with good communication skills, a positive attitude, and the ability to generate leads and develop customer relationships in the solar power sector.

Perks and benefits
Annual Bonus: Annual bonus as per company policy and applicable eligibility criteria.
Travel Allowance (TA): Travel expenses for authorised official visits and sales activities, as per company policy.
Daily Allowance (DA): Daily allowance for eligible official travel and field assignments, subject to applicable company rules.
Performance-Based Incentives: Attractive sales incentives based on the achievement of assigned sales targets, successful customer acquisition, and confirmed solar installations, as per the company's incentive structure.



Perks and benefits
Annual bonus, Food allowance
AboutCompany:
GIBBON INFRASTRUCTURES PVT. LTD.
Company Profile
Renewable Energy | Solar Power Solutions | Civil Construction & Infrastructure Development
1. About the Company
Gibbon Infrastructures Pvt. Ltd. is an infrastructure and renewable energy company engaged in the solar power industry since 2021, alongside civil construction and infrastructure development activities. The company is committed to delivering reliable, technically sound, and cost-effective solutions that address the growing demand for sustainable energy and quality infrastructure.
With a focus on professional project execution, customer satisfaction, and responsible business practices, the company undertakes solar power installations and civil construction works for residential, commercial, institutional, and other project requirements.
Through its presence in the renewable energy sector and its involvement in construction activities, Gibbon Infrastructures Pvt. Ltd. aims to contribute to India's clean energy transition and infrastructure development.
2. Solar Power & Renewable Energy Division
Since 2021, the company has been engaged in solar power solutions, supporting the adoption of renewable energy through rooftop solar installations and commercial solar projects. Its activities include project planning, system supply, installation, testing, commissioning, and associated technical services.
The company undertakes solar projects across a range of capacities, from 3 kW residential rooftop systems to large-scale projects of up to 100 MW, subject to project scope and technical requirements.
Key Areas of Expertise
Residential rooftop solar power systems.
Solar installations under the PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana.
Commercial and industrial solar power projects.
On-grid, hybrid, and off-grid solar solutions.
Solar photovoltaic (PV) system design and installation.
Supply, installation, testing, and commissioning of solar systems.
Solar project coordination and technical support.
Assistance with project documentation and relevant utility coordination.
The company works with solar equipment brands including Premier, Pahal, Adani, Vikram Solar, INA, Microtek, and Citizen, subject to project specifications and availability.
3. Civil Construction & Infrastructure Division
In addition to renewable energy, Gibbon Infrastructures Pvt. Ltd. undertakes civil construction and infrastructure-related works. The company recognises the importance of sound engineering practices, proper planning, quality materials, and efficient execution in delivering durable and dependable infrastructure.
Scope of Activities
Civil construction and building works.
Plain Cement Concrete (PCC) and Reinforced Cement Concrete (RCC) works.
Structural and allied construction activities.
Site preparation and development.
Foundation and related civil works.
Construction support for solar power installations.
Other civil and infrastructure works as per project specifications.
The company seeks to execute projects in accordance with applicable technical requirements, contractual obligations, safety practices, and agreed project schedules.
4. Our Vision
To establish Gibbon Infrastructures Pvt. Ltd. as a trusted organisation in renewable energy and infrastructure development by delivering sustainable solutions, maintaining professional standards, and creating long-term value for clients and stakeholders.
5. Our Mission
To promote the adoption of clean and renewable energy.
To deliver reliable and efficient solar power solutions.
To undertake civil construction works with a focus on quality and durability.
To maintain transparency, accountability, and professionalism in business operations.
To develop long-term relationships through customer satisfaction and dependable project delivery.
To contribute to sustainable development through responsible construction and energy solutions.
6. Our Core Values
Quality: Maintaining appropriate standards in materials, workmanship, and project execution.
Integrity: Conducting business with transparency, accountability, and ethical practices.
Reliability: Focusing on dependable solutions and professional service delivery.
Safety: Promoting safe working practices across project sites and operations.
Sustainability: Supporting renewable energy adoption and environmentally responsible development.
Customer Focus: Understanding client requirements and providing solutions aligned with project objectives.
7. Our Approach to Project Execution
Gibbon Infrastructures Pvt. Ltd. follows a project-oriented approach based on understanding client requirements, planning resources, coordinating technical activities, and executing works in accordance with agreed specifications.
For solar projects, the approach may cover site assessment, system design, equipment selection, installation, testing, commissioning, and associated documentation. For civil construction projects, the approach focuses on work planning, material and resource coordination, construction quality, site safety, and timely completion.
8. Commitment to Sustainable Development
The company recognises the growing role of renewable energy and dependable infrastructure in economic and social development. By operating across solar power and civil construction, Gibbon Infrastructures Pvt. Ltd. seeks to support energy efficiency, infrastructure improvement, and sustainable growth.
The company remains committed to strengthening its capabilities, developing professional partnerships, and delivering value-driven solutions for its clients.
9. Conclusion
Gibbon Infrastructures Pvt. Ltd. combines its experience in the solar power industry since 2021 with its involvement in civil construction and infrastructure works. Through a commitment to quality, technical competence, responsible execution, and customer satisfaction, the company aims to build lasting relationships and contribute meaningfully to India's renewable energy and infrastructure sectors.
GIBBON INFRASTRUCTURES PVT. LTD.
Powering a Sustainable Future. Building Infrastructure for Tomorrow.

Title - Sales Associate
Reporting to Store Manager
Skip Level Areas Operations Manager

About Lenskart
With a mission to give India a vision, Lenskart.com is India's fastest growing eyewear company. Lenskart's products include prescription eyewear, branded contact lenses and sunglasses, all equipped with the customers eye powers. Backed by IDG Ventures, Unilazer Ventures and TPG Capital, Lenskart has grown its array of services exponentially.
About the Role
Sales Associate is responsible for providing the best customer experience in the stores by providing high standards of selling services to Lenskart customers. He/she plays a pivotal role in driving the revenue achieved by the store.
Responsibilities Area
Activities expected to be performed by a Lenskart Sales Associate
Sales Associate is expected to greet and welcome all walk-in customers and guide them toward the clinic, promoting the free eye check-up
He/she will be involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day tasks to deliver the best shopping experience to the customers
He/she must possess a basic understanding of the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively
Customer focus
He/she must be dedicated to customer satisfaction and must go beyond his means to resolve any concerns that the customer has
With the information received from the Optometrist and the customer, he/she will present the customer with an optimal selection of products. This opportunity may be used to strike a conversation and convert it into sales
He/she is expected to understand the unstated needs of the customer, ask relevant questions, and pick the right time to pitch the recommended solutions
Product recommendation
Sales Associate is expected to achieve the assigned target for sales, eye-test conversion, and returns. He/she must follow all assigned SOPs diligently
Post making the sale, he/she is responsible for coordinating with the customer for product pick- up, after receiving due communication from the warehouse. He/she will verify the accuracy of the lenses fitted before handing over the product to the customer. In case of returns, he/she is expected to understand the reason and try to resolve the same to control the return percentage
Achieving sales targets & SOP adherence
He/she is expected to maintain Lenskart standards of hygiene in the store with respect to the overall display, frames, instruments, and other store equipment by cleaning them regularly
He/she must ensure the security of all Lenskart equipment and ensure there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store
Store upkeep & maintenance
Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification: 12th pass; Graduates preferred
Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions
Clear articulation and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to changing environment and openness to learn
Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation
Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority
