Ownership & Accountability
Proactive Problem Solving
Teamwork & Coordination
Effective Communication & Follow-up
Result Orientation
Continuous Improvement
AboutCompany:
Jindal Power Limited (JPL) is a leading Indian power company with a diverse energy portfolio encompassing thermal and renewable sources. With an impressive installed capacity of 4300 MW, JPL has been instrumental in meeting the nation's growing power demands. Pioneering the establishment of an Independent Power Plant (IPP) in 2007 with its 4x250 MW thermal power unit in Chhattisgarh's Raigarh district, JPL has continued its expansion in Tamnar with a 2400 MW (4X600 MW) thermal power plant.

JPL energy portfolio includes 3400 MW at Tamnar, Chhattisgarh and 600 MW at Simhapuri Andhra Pradesh & 300 MW at Shirpur, Maharashtra. By leveraging cutting-edge technologies and best practices, JPL has set new standards in India's power sector.
The company's vision is to emerge as a significant player in the industry, contributing to the nation's development. Committed to renewable energy sources, JPL aims to substantially increase the share of power generated through sustainable means. As the 5th largest integrated power producer in India, based on million units of generation, and with three captive mines, JPL stands as a key player in the sector. The company envisions establishing benchmarks in renewable energy, carbon emissions, and environmental protection. Furthermore, JPL is a trailblazer in community development and welfare initiatives.

Description:
POSITION SUMMARY
Kitchen Support Experts play an important role in support of several hotel functions. These associates may work across departments (e.g., kitchen, food and beverage, employee dining room) to support cleaning and basic kitchen preparation needs. Whether preparing fresh clean linen and spotless dining ware for guests to enjoy, operating and maintaining cleaning equipment and tools (e.g., dishwashing machines, hand wash stations), or transporting dishware across the hotel, these associates do whatever it takes to get the job done.
Follow all company and safety and security policies and procedures; report maintenance needs, accidents, injuries, and unsafe work conditions to manager; complete safety training and certifications. Ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional; maintain confidentiality of proprietary information; protect company assets. Welcome and acknowledge all guests according to company standards. Speak with others using clear and professional language. Develop and maintain positive working relationships with others; support team to reach common goals. Ensure adherence to quality expectations and standards. Stand, sit, or walk for an extended period of time. Reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping. Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 25 pounds without assistance. Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Education: No high school diploma or G.E.D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: No related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.
License or Certification: None

Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates. We are committed to non-discrimination on any protected basis, including disability, veteran status, or other basis protected by applicable law.

Description:
Reportingto Store Manager
SkipLevel Areas Operations Manager
About the Role
A Sales Associate is responsible for providing the best customer experience in the stores by providing high standards of selling services to customers. He/she plays a key role in driving the revenue achieved by the store.
Responsibilities
Area
Customer focus: Driving Net Promoter Score
Greeting and welcoming all walk-in customers and guiding them toward the clinic to promote the free eye check-up
Being involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day tasks to deliver the best shopping experience to the customers
Understanding the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively
Being dedicated to customer satisfaction and resolving any concerns that the customer has
Product recommendation
Presenting the customer with an optimal selection of products based on customer preferences Understanding the unstated needs of the customer, asking relevant questions, and picking the right time to pitch the recommended solutions
Achievingsales Vs.Plan & SOP adherence
Achieving the assigned target for sales, eye-test conversion, returns; and following all SOPs
Post making the sale, coordinating with the customer for product pick-up, after receiving due communication from the warehouse. In case of returns, he/she is expected to understand the reason and try to resolve the same to control the return percentage.
Storeupkeep & maintenance
Maintaining the store as per Lenskart standards, cleaning the frames and other equipment regularly, and ensuring there is no deviation as per the SOP
Ensuring the security of all Lenskart equipment and that there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store
Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification: 12th pass; Graduates preferred Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions Clear communication and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to changing environment and openness to learn
Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority.

Description:
Job description
We are looking for a passionate and driven Support Services Executive to join our dynamic team at Manipal Hospitals!

About Us:
As a pioneer in Healthcare, Manipal Hospitals is among the top healthcare providers in India serving over 5 million patients annually. Today we stand as an integrated network with a pan-India footprint of 49 hospitals across 19 cities with 10,500 beds, and a talented pool of over 7,200 doctors and an employee strength of over 20,000.

Location: Raipur, Chhatisgarh

What You'll Do:.
Ensure cleanliness and hygiene across all patient care areas, including Wards, ICUs, OPDs, public areas, and back-of-house, in line with hospital standards.
Supervise housekeeping operations, monitor cleaning schedules, conduct regular rounds, and ensure timely resolution of service requests and complaints.
Manage laundry operations by ensuring uninterrupted linen supply, inventory control, and timely replacement of damaged linen.
Coordinate hospital transport services, ensuring vehicle availability, proper utilization, maintenance, servicing, and statutory compliance.
Oversee hospital security operations to provide a safe and secure environment for patients, visitors, staff, and hospital assets.
Ensure hygienic preparation and timely distribution of food for patients and staff while monitoring food quality and raw material availability.
Coordinate pest control activities and ensure proper maintenance of hospital gardens, landscapes, and green areas.
Maintain departmental records, inventories, vehicle logbooks, service reports, and other operational documentation as per hospital guidelines.
Ensure compliance with hospital policies, SOPs, quality standards, infection control practices, statutory regulations, and accreditation requirements.
Monitor departmental service quality and patient satisfaction indicators, implement corrective actions, and drive continuous service improvement.
Coordinate with internal departments and external vendors for smooth execution of support service activities.
Train, guide, and supervise support staff, conduct regular briefings, and ensure adherence to operational standards.

Description:
Purpose of the Role
The position will be responsible for driving retail sales of Passenger Electric Vehicles to personal customers in assigned regions to achieve business objectives in terms of volumes, market share and customer experience; the incumbent is to provide focus to EV retail efforts, including market activation, tie-ups, customer & pipeline management
Lack of focus for EV retail in a primarily ICE focused dealership structure; limited EV ecosystem development and activation for personal segment EV buyers
Job Responsibility
1. Driving EV Retail Sales volumes & Market Share:
Deliver Retail targets for the city/region through dealership as well as alternate channel sales teams
Direct responsibility of managing sales in Store-in-Store/Experience Centres
Micro-market activation: Identify, optimize and conduct micro market activations within the region to optimize lead generation and conversion
Interface with dealerships through PV TSMs to seek dealer support & ensure dealer focus to achieve retail targets
Optimize test drives and conversion through special initiatives executed through dealers and alternate channels
Develop market intelligence on customer preferences, competitor offerings, key opportunities, etc. and share with Head – EV Retail Sales
Develop and manage region specific tie-ups to increase value proposition of EVs
2. Manage Customer Relationships:
Engage frequently with EV customers & serve as first point of escalation for customers (adhering to SLAs)
Share feedback with Charging Solutions & Customer Experience teams
3. Team Management:
Monitor Sales funnel and direct Product Specialists to Manage pool of TML Sales executives deployed in alternate sales channels to take appropriate follow-up actions to ensure retail customer satisfaction.
Onboard and manage product specialists across relevant sales channels
Stakeholder Profiles & Nature of Interactions
Internal:
Regional Customer Care Manager
Specific service campaigns/ communicate service-related issues being faced by retail customers in the region
Sales Planning
Providing inputs on the sales forecast and tracking delivery
Zonal Retail Marketing
Align on EV specific offers
Charging Solutions/
Customer Experience
Communicating product/service feedback received on-ground to charging/customer experience team
PVBU TSM
Interface with TSMs to seek dealer support and ensure dealer focus to achieve retail targets

External:
Channel Partners
Direct Feedback/ daily assistance to them to sort issues.
Financial Institutions
For financial offerings as required by retail customers (along with RCFI, at times directly)
Desired Candidate Profile
Education: B.E/ B. Tech & MBA - Sales & Marketing
Relevant Experience: 5-6 years of Sales & Marketing experience with a focus in EV/PV sales.
Understanding of Competition Product Portfolio and own competitive advantage.
Ability to communicate with learned and environmentally conscious set of Customers.
Experience in Value Selling concept of Sales.
Ability to lead and manage teams and achieve targets; drive product specialists and dealerships to achieve retail targets
Strong Oral & written communication with good fluency in English language and local language of relevant city/region
Ability to guide teams in prioritizing and managing customer pipeline without losing sales
Strong planning & problem solving skills to create city specific market activation plans, tie-ups and customer schemes
Knowledge of EV/PV sales process and sales resource allocation
Ability to influence colleagues/ other BU manpower without direct reporting relationship
Strong sales team leadership experience/ skills, evidenced through track record or references
Strong experience in Retail customer management, handling escalations and working with multiple internal stakeholders etc.
Knowledge of EV/PV sales process and sales resource allocation
Good technical knowledge of EV/PV products along with product features
Skills & Competencies
Effective Communication and Influencing Skills
Ability to drive teams to meet targets
Result Oriented approach
Accountability & Ownership
Ability to change user behaviour
Data Driven

Description:
About the Role
The role of Cluster Optometrist at Lenskart revolves around a combination of a perfect blend of optometry and optical retail. He/she plays a pivotal role in upskilling the front end retail staff on the professional optometry grounds. They are responsible to deliver the best customer experience by leading the example in driving the key business metrics with their optometric approach. Their key deliverable in business includes maintenance of eye test quality and dispensing standards throughout as per Lenskart norms.
Responsibilities
Store Visit
Must visit assigned stores in Lenskart uniform and manage the complete Technical and Functional part of Lenskart stores

In Store Duty
Act as a Mentor and Coach to Fresher Optometrists. Help them with Sales Pitch, Technical Dispensing Guidance, Troubleshooting, Customer Query Handling etc.
Must also work as a store optometrist during busy hours, high sale days or to cover shifts of those who are on leave. Check eye test, QC drawers, Wooqer entries, CL expiry, merchandise, Instrument calibration, KMT products etc.
To ensure the Store NPS is achieved by training, troubleshooting, tracking detractor and lead by example

Manpower
To welcome new talent from market, conduct interview and on board. Initiation Prepare and conduct meetings with respective AOMs to discuss reviews, performance or proposals

Training
For new staff - Undertake regular reviews, analyse SOPs such as eye test, quality check, dispensing, contact lens, troubleshoot, deliver to measure the impact of training on store performance. Identify and Train the Store staff to help them achieve their goals

Audit
Periodically audit their eye test and dispensing performance

Team Leader
Wear multiple hats of Team leader, Bench, Senior, Consultant Optometrist to support store team

Revenue
Maximise In-Store Revenue through Optometrists through continuous training, periodic reviews, increasing number of eye tests done at store and reducing returns

Team Work
Work as a member of Business Team to accomplish goals and objectives. Participate in regional, departmental, executive, operational meeting as appropriate

Documentation
Maintain documentation and Report daily to PS regional manager on store visit summary
Working Hours
Same as store shift and as per business needs. Must work on weekends and public holidays to support store business

Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification - Diploma in Optometry with minimum 3 years of retail experience and a good track record
Good Knowledge in Optometry, Refraction, Eye Wear Products, Dispensing and Measurements
Must be ready to travel anywhere in India as per Business requirements
Passionate about Sales, Retail, Customer service and Training
Good understanding of market and product analysis
Must have leadership qualities such as - lead by example, coaching, motivating, great communication and never give up attitude
Energy, influence, 10 x think entrepreneur mind-set etc

Description:
Job Responsibility
1. Sales Planning:
Drives sales in the specified territory for a particular product line ensuring volume sales, market share growth and enhanced customer engagement in assigned territory
Plan and conduct monthly target setting including marketing activations at the dealerships in line with forecast/ estimated TIV and sales volume for the assigned territory
Coordinate with various partners and internal teams to drive customer engagement & sales. Plan and execute monthly activations and provide the necessary support to drive effectiveness while measuring outcomes of activities conducted

Support state product manager in the conversion of mid-to-big sized deals when needed
Drive the conversion of C4T customers with assigned dealership into Tata Motors fold
Drive sales and share of business with key accounts customers
Drive value added sales in the assigned territory and seek support from sales teams on need basis
2. Review and Execution:
Conduct sales execution meeting on a monthly basis with dealers sales representatives and sales team to monitor performance and to set future action plan
Execute dealer wise and outlet wise performance to monitor sales pipeline and deploy action plan to different territories based on performance and potential
Review and monitor MIS of the following: Volume, Market Share, Activity Report, Retail tracker, C4T list and pipeline DSE
Ensure the execute of distribution of dealership target DSE wise and Micro Market wise
Provide product wise indent to RSMs as per the agreed schedule
Capture and review market intelligence through multiple sources, including voice of customer on product/services and regulatory requirements. Explore potential white spaces due to emerging customer expectations
Review and monitor dealers inventory and ensure that it stays at optimum level through proper forecasting
Provide inputs on existing product improvements/ development of new products and variants to create differentiation in the market
Work closely with state product managers to share market intelligence about the product on regular basis
3. Financial Management:
Monitor liquidation of stock at assigned dealerships to ensure timely payment by financiers and channelling of funds back into the system
4. People Management:
Drive manpower, infrastructure and processes at dealerships as per TML norms
Execute trainings for dealer sales team on pre-sales & sales processes, new product features / modifications etc.

Description:
SALES EXECUTIVE AJANTA SHOES (INDIA) PVT. LTD.

Industry: Footwear
Location: Vijayawada / Chhattisgarh
Designation: Sales Executive
Department: Sales & Marketing
Experience: 4-5 years in footwear Industry
Languages: Telegu / Hindi / English
Salary: As per Industry norms
Employment Type: Full-time
Reporting To: Area Sales Manager / Regional Sales Manager

Job Summary
We are looking for a dynamic and target-oriented Sales Executive to drive sales and expand the company's footwear business in Hyderabad and Bangalore. The candidate will be responsible for developing new customers, managing existing accounts, achieving sales targets, and strengthening the company's market presence.

Key Responsibilities
Achieve assigned monthly and quarterly sales targets for the designated territory.
Identify and develop new dealers, distributors, retailers, and business opportunities.
Maintain strong relationships with existing dealers, retailers, and channel partners.
Conduct regular market visits to understand customer requirements, competitor activities, pricing, and market trends.
Promote and sell the company's footwear products, including PU, EVA, rubber footwear, sandals, slippers, and other product categories.
Ensure proper product presentation, availability, and visibility at retail outlets.
Generate regular orders from dealers and retailers and follow up on pending orders.
Monitor sales, collections, stock availability, and outstanding payments of assigned customers.
Coordinate with distributors, dealers, retailers, and internal teams for timely order execution and delivery.
Identify opportunities for increasing product distribution and market penetration.
Collect market feedback regarding products, pricing, quality, packaging, and competitor offerings.
Support the implementation of promotional schemes, dealer incentives, and sales campaigns.
Prepare daily/weekly/monthly sales reports, market visit reports, and competitor activity reports.
Ensure timely collection of payments from customers as per company policies.
Handle customer queries and coordinate with relevant departments for resolution of complaints.
Maintain updated records of dealers, retailers, sales orders, collections, and market activities.

Candidate Profile
Graduate / MBA in Sales & Marketing or a related field preferred.
3-5 years of experience in sales, preferably in the Footwear Industry
Experience in dealer/distributor/retail sales will be an advantage.
Good knowledge of the local market in
Must be comfortable with Local Languages of Vijayawada / Chhattisgarh
Strong communication, negotiation, and relationship-management skills.
Willingness to travel extensively within the assigned territory.
Good knowledge of MS Excel and basic reporting.
Self-motivated, target-oriented, and capable of working independently.

Key Skills

Sales & Business Development | Dealer Management | Retail Sales | Distributor Management | Market Development | Lead Generation | Negotiation | Customer Relationship Management | Market Intelligence | Collection Follow-up | Target Achievement | Reporting

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
Achievement of monthly/quarterly sales targets
New dealer and retailer acquisition
Sales volume and revenue growth
Territory-wise market expansion
Customer retention and relationship management
Collection efficiency
Market coverage and outlet visits
Product distribution and availability

Description:
Title - Sales Associate
Reporting to Store Manager
Skip Level Areas Operations Manager

About Lenskart

About the Role
Sales Associate is responsible for providing the best customer experience in the stores by providing high standards of selling services to Lenskart customers. He/she plays a pivotal role in driving the revenue achieved by the store.
Responsibilities Area
Activities expected to be performed by a Lenskart Sales Associate
Sales Associate is expected to greet and welcome all walk-in customers and guide them toward the clinic, promoting the free eye check-up
He/she will be involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day tasks to deliver the best shopping experience to the customers
He/she must possess a basic understanding of the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively
Customer focus
He/she must be dedicated to customer satisfaction and must go beyond his means to resolve any concerns that the customer has
With the information received from the Optometrist and the customer, he/she will present the customer with an optimal selection of products. This opportunity may be used to strike a conversation and convert it into sales
He/she is expected to understand the unstated needs of the customer, ask relevant questions, and pick the right time to pitch the recommended solutions
Product recommendation
Sales Associate is expected to achieve the assigned target for sales, eye-test conversion, and returns. He/she must follow all assigned SOPs diligently
Post making the sale, he/she is responsible for coordinating with the customer for product pick- up, after receiving due communication from the warehouse. He/she will verify the accuracy of the lenses fitted before handing over the product to the customer. In case of returns, he/she is expected to understand the reason and try to resolve the same to control the return percentage
Achieving sales targets & SOP adherence
He/she is expected to maintain Lenskart standards of hygiene in the store with respect to the overall display, frames, instruments, and other store equipment by cleaning them regularly
He/she must ensure the security of all Lenskart equipment and ensure there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store
Store upkeep & maintenance
Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification: 12th pass; Graduates preferred
Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions
Clear articulation and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to changing environment and openness to learn
Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation
Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority

Description:
Title Store Manager

Reporting to Area Operations Manager

About Lenskart

With a mission to give India a vision, Lenskart.com is India's fastest growing eyewear company. Lenskart's products include prescription eyewear, branded contact lenses and sunglasses, all equipped with the customers eye powers.

About the Role

A Store Manager at Lenskart acts as an important link between strategy and execution. He/she drives the store towards achieving all assigned metrics of Store Sales, Conversions, Customer satisfaction etc. and is responsible for keeping a high level of morale among the store staff, developing them, controlling attrition, and ensuring smooth operations at the store.
Responsibilities:

Customer focus: Driving Net Promoter Score ( NPS )

Greeting customers when they enter store and coaching the team to do the same
Displaying commitment towards providing exceptional Customer Service and ensuring that Lenskart associates also treat Customer Satisfaction as a priority
Dealing with customer service issues such as queries and complaints at store level and ensuring this is consistent with the team
Striving to have long lasting and fruitful relationships with each of our customers

Driving sales vs. plan

Driving the sales of the store to meet the allotted targets by allocating the targets to the staff
Developing a culture of high sales performance expectations, i.e. Sales Leadership
Motivating and inspiring the field team to drive for results
Assessing field capability and establish performance priorities at group level

People development (Attrition Control)

Assisting in recruiting and selecting high potential staff
Providing effective on-the-job training and guidance to team members making use of company training modules
Delivering clear, motivating and constructive feedback in a timely manner to all retail associates
Evaluating the training needs of store associates and working closely with L&D department to execute the developmental plan
Understanding the reasons for attrition and taking measures to control it

Cash & Inventory management

Monitoring cash reconciliation to ensure there is no mismatch of store funds
Ensuring availability of required merchandise and services
Conducting stocktakes regularly
Ensuring the staff at store level has basic understanding of POS System to ensure transactions are properly and effectively processed
Performing the necessary quality checks for the new products
Working very closely with other departments till the product reaches the customer and ensuring the best customer experience to the Lenskart Customer

Supervision

Ensuring that all store employees, including the Optometrist, are taken care of and their issues are resolved
Ensuring that the eye check-ups are conducted as per the SOP and maintain high quality standards

SOP adherence & implementation

Ensuring that all SOPs for retail are implemented successfully and adhered to by store employees
Updating colleagues on business performance, new initiatives and other important issues
Scheduling the teams shift timings to meet the stores business needs and demands
Ensuring staffing levels are adequate to effectively operate the store

Store upkeep & maintenance

Maintaining the store as per Lenskart standards, regularly cleaning the frames and other equipment at the store
Ensuring the security of all Lenskart equipment and that there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store

Description:
Reporting to Area Operations Manager

With a mission to give India a vision, Lenskart.com is India's fastest growing eyewear company. Lenskart's products include prescription eyewear, branded contact lenses and sunglasses, all equipped with the customers eye powers.

About the Role

A Store Manager at Lenskart acts as an important link between strategy and execution. He/she drives the store towards achieving all assigned metrics of Store Sales, Conversions, Customer satisfaction etc. and is responsible for keeping a high level of morale among the store staff, developing them, controlling attrition, and ensuring smooth operations at the store.

Responsibilities:

Customer focus: Driving Net Promoter Score ( NPS )

Greeting customers when they enter store and coaching the team to do the same
Displaying commitment towards providing exceptional Customer Service and ensuring that Lenskart associates also treat Customer Satisfaction as a priority
Dealing with customer service issues such as queries and complaints at store level and ensuring this is consistent with the team
Striving to have long lasting and fruitful relationships with each of our customers

Driving sales vs. plan

Driving the sales of the store to meet the allotted targets by allocating the targets to the staff
Developing a culture of high sales performance expectations, i.e. Sales Leadership
Motivating and inspiring the field team to drive for results
Assessing field capability and establish performance priorities at group level

People development (Attrition Control)

Assisting in recruiting and selecting high potential staff
Providing effective on-the-job training and guidance to team members making use of company training modules
Delivering clear, motivating and constructive feedback in a timely manner to all retail associates
Evaluating the training needs of store associates and working closely with L&D department to execute the developmental plan
Understanding the reasons for attrition and taking measures to control it

Cash & Inventory management

Monitoring cash reconciliation to ensure there is no mismatch of store funds
Ensuring availability of required merchandise and services
Conducting stocktakes regularly
Ensuring the staff at store level has basic understanding of POS System to ensure transactions are properly and effectively processed
Performing the necessary quality checks for the new products
Working very closely with other departments till the product reaches the customer and ensuring the best customer experience to the Lenskart Customer

Supervision

Ensuring that all store employees, including the Optometrist, are taken care of and their issues are resolved
Ensuring that the eye check-ups are conducted as per the SOP and maintain high quality standards

SOP adherence & implementation

Ensuring that all SOPs for retail are implemented successfully and adhered to by store employees
Updating colleagues on business performance, new initiatives and other important issues
Scheduling the teams shift timings to meet the stores business needs and demands
Ensuring staffing levels are adequate to effectively operate the store

Store upkeep & maintenance

Maintaining the store as per Lenskart standards, regularly cleaning the frames and other equipment at the store
Ensuring the security of all Lenskart equipment and that there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store

Description:
Direct Reportees: Store Managers
Interactions: Internal and External Stakeholders.

You, as an Area Manager, play a critical role to lead diverse teams at store level who are in turn responsible in providing the best customer experience to Lenskart customers as well as revenue generation. You are the facilitator of growth, responsible to build vision & business strategies to achieve sales, customer experience, and other organisational goals by investing in people through regular coaching.

We are looking for enthusiastic & pragmatic leaders with strong inclination towards customer centricity, sales, digital mind-set, and people leadership. On a typical day, you would be spending your time at the stores in your area, helping the team deliver on the strategy, coaching them and helping remove road-blocks.

Key Responsibilities:

Sales Leadership:

- Developing & driving sales strategy for your area & team with focus on revenue goals.
- Driving the rigor to deliver world-class customer experience at the store, thereby increasing the Net Promoter Score (NPS) for the store and reducing detractors
- Drive high performance culture in your area across the metrics mentioned above
- Assessing business and performance trends regularly & build improvement opportunities.
- Serve as critical strategy planning link between Corporate and the field organization.
- Translate corporate goals including financial returns, sales growth and market share, into
Business plans.
- Assess field capability and establish performance priorities at group level.

People leadership:

- Partnership with Store Managers & HR team to make sure stores are adequately staffed.
- Leading leaders, coaching and developing future talent
- Assess & bridge skill gaps including those related to implementation of business plans, forecasts, financial analysis, associate development and communication
- Formal & Informal performance management for store managers they are responsible for
- Responsible for establishing a culture that embraces diversity and maximizes the learnings from a diverse team.
- Retain talent - Reduce attrition

Organizational leadership:

- Solely responsible for managing and maintaining territory and store budgets to ensure profitability at the area level
- Managing the top and bottom line effectively of the assigned territory and stores
- Responsible for overall operational effectiveness of stores on areas such as shrinkage, capacity, productivity, growth, attrition.
- Build creative & cost effective methods to ensure productivity while managing high standards of retail operations.

Description:
Profile Summary
Our Area Operations Manager is responsible for developing and expanding the business in the respective area and managing the store operations across the respective area thereby increasing the customer experience.
Key Responsibilities
Driving Sales and Customer Service
a. Driving and ensuring to meet or exceed the sales plan of the respective territory monthly/ quarterly and annually
b. Driving and focusing on providing the customer services thereby increasing the Net Promoter Score (NPS) for the store
c. Drive culture of high sales performance expectations, i.e. SALES Leadership
d. Motivates and inspires field team to drive for results.
e. Review financial performance at regional level to identify improvement opportunities.
f. Serve as critical strategy planning link between Corporate and the field organization.
g. Translate corporate goals including financial returns, sales growth and market share, into business plans.
h. Assess field capability and establish performance priorities at group level.
Manpower Planning & People Development
a. Working with the HR team and the Store Manager in ensuring staffing levels are adequate to effectively operate the store
b. Direct responsibility for professional development of Lenskart Associates
c. Assess and prioritize advanced management skill gaps including those related to design and implementation of business plans, forecasts, financial analysis, associate development and communication.
d. Conduct two-way, formal and informal performance evaluations of Lenskart Associates which review professional development needs and accomplishments as well as overall achievement of management objectives
e. Responsible for establishing a culture that embraces diversity and maximizes the learnings from a diverse team.
f. Overall responsibility for associate development
Managing P&L of the Assigned Stores
a. Responsible for managing and maintaining territory and store budgets to ensure profitability at store as well as territory level
b. Managing the top and bottom line effectively of the assigned territory and stores
c. Responsible for reducing shrinkage
d. Managing the productivity of the staff
e. Using cost effective methods to ensure productivity of the respective territory
Managing and Maintaining High Standards of Retail Operations
a.Regular Store Visits to:
Audit stores
Coaching the Store Managers
Motivate staff through sales discussions
Check VM, stock availability
Check store hygiene, grooming
Assess discipline levels in store opening times, staff attendance, process adherence etc.
b. Analyze data before Store Visits
Monitoring Sales through data.
Assessing the productivity and achievements of the stores
Store Staffing levels.

e) Polychronicity- it is defined as a continuum, and preferences for degrees of engagement. At one extreme is the pattern of focusing on one task at a time, interpreting other potential tasks and events as interruptions and attempting to shield one's chosen task from such interference. Description:
About the Role
The role of Cluster Optometrist at Lenskart revolves around a combination of a perfect blend of optometry and optical retail. He/she plays a pivotal role in upskilling the front end retail staff on the professional optometry grounds. They are responsible to deliver the best customer experience by leading the example in driving the key business metrics with their optometric approach. Their key deliverable in business includes maintenance of eye test quality and dispensing standards throughout as per Lenskart norms.
Responsibilities
Store Visit
Must visit assigned stores in Lenskart uniform and manage the complete Technical and Functional part of Lenskart stores

In Store Duty
Act as a Mentor and Coach to Fresher Optometrists. Help them with Sales Pitch, Technical Dispensing Guidance, Troubleshooting, Customer Query Handling etc.
Must also work as a store optometrist during busy hours, high sale days or to cover shifts of those who are on leave. Check eye test, QC drawers, Wooqer entries, CL expiry, merchandise, Instrument calibration, KMT products etc.
To ensure the Store NPS is achieved by training, troubleshooting, tracking detractor and lead by example

Manpower
To welcome new talent from market, conduct interview and on board. Initiation Prepare and conduct meetings with respective AOMs to discuss reviews, performance or proposals

Training
For new staff - Undertake regular reviews, analyse SOPs such as eye test, quality check, dispensing, contact lens, troubleshoot, deliver to measure the impact of training on store performance. Identify and Train the Store staff to help them achieve their goals

Audit
Periodically audit their eye test and dispensing performance

Team Leader
Wear multiple hats of Team leader, Bench, Senior, Consultant Optometrist to support store team

Revenue
Maximise In-Store Revenue through Optometrists through continuous training, periodic reviews, increasing number of eye tests done at store and reducing returns

Team Work
Work as a member of Business Team to accomplish goals and objectives. Participate in regional, departmental, executive, operational meeting as appropriate

Documentation
Maintain documentation and Report daily to PS regional manager on store visit summary
Working Hours
Same as store shift and as per business needs. Must work on weekends and public holidays to support store business

Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification - Diploma in Optometry with minimum 3 years of retail experience and a good track record
Good Knowledge in Optometry, Refraction, Eye Wear Products, Dispensing and Measurements
Must be ready to travel anywhere in India as per Business requirements
Passionate about Sales, Retail, Customer service and Training
Good understanding of market and product analysis
Must have leadership qualities such as - lead by example, coaching, motivating, great communication and never give up attitude
Energy, influence, 10 x think entrepreneur mind-set etc .

Job Summary
We are looking for an experienced and result-oriented Unit Head to drive overall business growth, revenue generation, market expansion, and team performance. The ideal candidate should possess strong business development and sales capabilities, proven leadership experience, and the ability to independently manage revenue targets while leading a team.

Candidates with experience in media sales, advertising, channel management, and developing innovative revenue streams will be preferred.

Key Responsibilities
Drive overall business growth, revenue generation, and market development for the Korba unit.
Develop and execute business strategies to achieve revenue targets, sales objectives, and market expansion goals.

Independently manage key accounts, client relationships, negotiations, business closures, and revenue targets.
Lead, motivate, and develop the team to achieve business objectives and improve overall performance.
Develop and strengthen channel partner networks to expand market reach and generate incremental revenue.
Drive print innovations, customized advertising solutions, and innovative business concepts to create new revenue opportunities.
Plan and execute events, intellectual properties (IPs), brand activations, and client engagement initiatives.
Monitor market trends, competitor activities, and customer requirements to identify opportunities for business growth.
Collaborate with internal stakeholders to ensure effective execution of business plans and client commitments.
Undertake extensive market visits to strengthen client relationships, develop new accounts, and improve market penetration.

Candidate Profile
7–10 years of relevant experience in Sales, Business Development, Media Sales, or Advertising.
Proven track record of revenue generation, sales target achievement, and market development.
Prior experience in team management and leadership, along with strong individual sales capabilities.
Hands-on experience in channel management, channel partnering, and key account management.
Strong business acumen, negotiation skills, client relationship management, and business development capabilities.
Ability to develop innovative revenue-generating ideas, advertising solutions, events, and market initiatives.
Strong understanding of the local market, with established business networks and client relationships.
Excellent communication, interpersonal, planning, and execution skills.
Willingness to travel extensively across Korba and emerging markets.
AboutCompany:
DB Corp is the largest print media company of India. It publishes newspapers in 3 Indian languages across 12 Indian States with 65 print Editions with 6.6 cr total readerships. Description:
WE ARE HIRING | CEO MAHADEVA MAHINDRA
Location: Raipur, Chhattisgarh
Industry: Automobile / Automotive Dealership
Position: Chief Executive Officer (CEO)
About the Role:
Mahadeva Mahindra is looking for an experienced and result-oriented CEO to lead overall dealership operations, drive business growth, and ensure operational excellence across departments.
Key Responsibilities:
Lead overall dealership operations, including Sales, Service, Spare Parts, CRM, and Administration.
Develop and implement business strategies to achieve revenue, profitability, and growth targets.
Drive vehicle sales, after-sales service, customer satisfaction, and customer retention.
Monitor KPIs, business performance, profitability, and operational efficiency.
Lead, motivate, and develop department heads and their teams.
Ensure compliance with OEM policies, company standards, and operational procedures.
Build strong customer relationships and maintain high service quality.
Coordinate with the OEM and senior management to achieve business objectives.
Candidate Requirements:
8–10 years of experience in the automobile industry, preferably in dealership management.
Proven experience in a senior leadership role such as CEO, Dealer Principal, or General Manager.
Strong understanding of automobile dealership operations, sales, service, and profitability.
Excellent leadership, strategic planning, decision-making, and team management skills.
Strong business acumen with a track record of achieving business targets.
Salary: Negotiable — no bar for the right candidate.

Email: hr@mahadevamahindra.com
Contact: 6269000507
If you know a suitable candidate, please share this opportunity with them.

We are seeking a detail-oriented and proactive Manufacturing Engineer to optimize production processes, improve manufacturing efficiency, and ensure high-quality product output. The ideal candidate will work closely with production, quality, maintenance, and design teams to implement process improvements, reduce costs, and support continuous improvement initiatives.

Develop, implement, and optimize manufacturing processes to improve productivity and quality.

Strong understanding of manufacturing processes, production planning, and quality systems.
Knowledge of Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, 5S, and root cause analysis.
Proficiency in CAD software (AutoCAD, SolidWorks, or similar) is preferred.
Experience with ERP/MRP systems is an advantage.
Good analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
Ability to work effectively in a cross-functional team environment.

The company's vision is to emerge as a significant player in the industry, contributing to the nation's development. Committed to renewable energy sources, JPL aims to substantially increase the share of power generated through sustainable means. As the 5th largest integrated power producer in India, based on million units of generation, and with three captive mines, JPL stands as a key player in the sector. The company envisions establishing benchmarks in renewable energy, carbon emissions, and environmental protection. Furthermore, JPL is a trailblazer in community development and welfare initiatives.

Purpose/Objective


The Team Member - Trucking Logistics is responsible for managing all road transportation logistics, ensuring efficient and timely delivery of goods.
This role involves coordinating with transporters, managing Delivery Orders, optimizing performance, and ensuring compliance with safety and logistics standards.
Key Responsibilities of Role


Road Transportation Management: - Oversee all road transportation activities, ensuring efficient and timely movement of goods.
- Manage relationships with transporters and their supervisors to facilitate smooth operations.
Delivery Order Management and Execution: - Arrange and manage Delivery Orders (D/O) to ensure trucks arrive at the plant for loading as scheduled.
- Ensure timely loading and dispatch of trucks from the plant.
Performance Monitoring: - Monitor transporter performance to ensure timely and efficient deliveries.
- Implement improvement strategies to enhance road logistics operations.
Cost Management: - Monitor transportation costs and implement cost-saving measures.
- Optimize truck routing and scheduling for cost efficiency.
Safety and Compliance: - Ensure adherence to safety regulations and compliance with logistics standards.
- Implement safety measures to minimize risks during transportation.
Ethical Standards - Use ethical reasoning to guide decisions, considering the broader impact on the organization and stakeholders.
- Ensure all communications, both verbal and written, reflect the organization’s commitment to integrity and ethics.
Policy Adherence and Development - Implement and enforce organizational policies to maintain consistency and alignment with corporate objectives.
- Contribute to policy development by providing feedback and insights from departmental operations.
Organizational Skills - Prioritize tasks effectively to ensure timely completion of departmental objectives and projects.
- Implement best practices in workflow management to reduce bottlenecks and improve output quality.
- Manage multiple projects simultaneously, adapting to changing priorities and demands with agility.
Transparency in Operations - Foster a culture of openness by sharing information transparently with team members and stakeholders.
- Establish clear accountability mechanisms to track performance and decision-making within the department.
- Document and communicate decision-making processes and rationales to ensure clarity and understanding.
Key Stakeholders - Internal: - Head Plant Logistics - Lead Primary Logistics Key Stakeholders - External: - Transporters and their Supervisors - Regulatory Authorities
Technical Competencies


Fleet Management-Cements,Fleet Safety and Risk Management-Cements,Inventory Management-Cements,Logistics and Supply Chain Management-Cements,Operational Excellence & Innovation-Cements,Operational Planning-Cements,Transportation Route Optimization-Cements
Qualifications and Experience


Education Qualification - Master's degree in Business Administration or Operations.
Work Experience (Range of years) - 7+ years of experience in truck logistics, fleet management, and route optimization Industry Knowledge - Demonstrate proficiency in vehicle maintenance, fleet utilization, and cost-effective transportation solutions.

Description:
Purpose/Objective


To oversee and execute mechanical construction activities for large-scale industrial/power projects, ensuring adherence to project schedules, quality standards, safety requirements, and cost targets.
The role involves coordinating with contractors, consultants, procurement teams, and stakeholders for successful project execution.
Key Responsibilities of Role


Project Execution - Lead mechanical construction and erection activities for project sites.
- Ensure installation of mechanical equipment as per approved drawings, specifications, and project standards.
- Monitor project progress and ensure timely completion of milestones.
- Coordinate with engineering, planning, procurement, and commissioning teams.
Construction Management - Supervise erection and installation of static and rotary equipment.
- Review construction methodologies and optimize resource utilization.
- Manage contractor performance and ensure compliance with contractual obligations.
- Track material availability and resolve site execution issues.
Quality Management - Ensure compliance with project quality plans and applicable standards.
- Conduct inspections and monitor equipment installation quality.
- Coordinate with QA/QC teams for stage-wise inspections and clearances.
- Review punch points and ensure closure before commissioning.
Safety & Compliance - Implement and enforce site safety procedures.
- Ensure compliance with statutory regulations and EHS guidelines.
- Participate in safety audits and risk assessments.
- Promote a zero-harm safety culture across project teams.
Coordination & Reporting - Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly construction progress reports.
- Coordinate with planning teams for schedule monitoring.
- Escalate critical issues affecting project timelines.
- Participate in review meetings with management and stakeholders.
Technical Competencies


Mechanical erection and construction management,Equipment installation and alignment,Project scheduling and execution monitoring,Contractor and vendor management,Reading and interpretation of engineering drawings,QA/QC procedures for mechanical systems,Site safety management,Construction planning and resource optimization
Qualifications and Experience


8-16 Years - B.
E.
/B.
Tech in Mechanical Engineering (Full-Time) - MBA/PGDM in Project Management will be preferred

Responsible for secondary sales of JSWs branded products - TMT and coated sheets. Key Result Areas (Key Performance Indicators)
Secondary Sales from distributors to dealers
Dealer onboarding
Management of distributors sales representatives (DSRs) and following all listed processes
Execution of Channel and Marketing Activities
ECP Implementation
Influencer Engagements
Competition Intelligence
Agency and Vendor Management
MIS for Channel Activities & Distributor Policy Adherence

M.B.A (Marketing) Must with B.E./ B. Tech (preferred)
1-3 years of work experience
Additional Certification MS Office, Data Analytics (Power BI, Tableau etc.), SAP will be preferred

Competencies
Flair for sales, experience of marketing execution at district level, market understanding, ownership and drive for results, cross functional working skills, communication skills, team handling capability ,understanding of product and aptitude for technical sales

Key Success Factors Challenges
Secondary sales targets through direct reach-outs and a team of about 4 - 10 distributors sales representatives
Market visits to convince high potential dealers
System and Process implementation for DSR management
Distributor and dealer Management
Continuous training and development of people in core Marketing and retail sales
Competency development and appropriate fitness of people in the role.

AboutCompany:
Jindal Power Limited (JPL) is a leading Indian power company with a diverse energy portfolio encompassing thermal and renewable sources. With an impressive installed capacity of 4300 MW, JPL has been instrumental in meeting the nation's growing power demands. Pioneering the establishment of an Independent Power Plant (IPP) in 2007 with its 4x250 MW thermal power unit in Chhattisgarh's Raigarh district, JPL has continued its expansion in Tamnar with a 2400 MW (4X600 MW) thermal power plant.
JPL energy portfolio includes 3400 MW at Tamnar, Chhattisgarh and 600 MW at Simhapuri Andhra Pradesh & 300 MW at Shirpur, Maharashtra. By leveraging cutting-edge technologies and best practices, JPL has set new standards in India's power sector.
The company's vision is to emerge as a significant player in the industry, contributing to the nation's development. Committed to renewable energy sources, JPL aims to substantially increase the share of power generated through sustainable means. As the 5th largest integrated power producer in India, based on million units of generation, and with three captive mines, JPL stands as a key player in the sector. The company envisions establishing benchmarks in renewable energy, carbon emissions, and environmental protection. Furthermore, JPL is a trailblazer in community development and welfare initiatives.

Description:
Purpose/Objective


To manage the end-to-end procurement process for assigned categories/materials by ensuring timely sourcing, vendor management, purchase order execution, cost optimization, and adherence to procurement policies.
The role is responsible for maintaining uninterrupted supply while achieving quality, cost, and delivery objectives.
Key Responsibilities of Role


Procurement & Sourcing - Execute procurement activities for materials, equipment, consumables, and services as per organizational requirements.
- Float RFQs/RFPs, obtain quotations, and conduct comparative analysis.
- Negotiate prices, payment terms, delivery schedules, and commercial conditions with vendors.
- Prepare and release Purchase Orders (POs) in accordance with approved procurement procedures.
- Ensure timely procurement to avoid operational disruptions.
Vendor Management - Identify, evaluate, and onboard new suppliers.
- Maintain strong relationships with existing vendors to ensure quality and timely deliveries.
- Monitor vendor performance based on cost, quality, and delivery metrics.
- Coordinate with suppliers for order acknowledgments, dispatch schedules, and issue resolution.
Commercial Evaluation - Conduct techno-commercial evaluation of bids along with user departments.
- Analyze market trends, pricing movements, and supply risks.
- Support cost-saving and value-engineering initiatives.
Coordination & Follow-up - Liaise with internal stakeholders including operations, maintenance, stores, finance, and projects teams.
- Track purchase orders and expedite deliveries as required.
- Resolve procurement-related issues, shortages, and delivery delays.
- Liaise with GCC for timely floating RFQ, Conducting RA, vendor onboarding Compliance & Documentation - Ensure procurement activities comply with company policies and audit requirements.
- Maintain procurement records, contracts, vendor documentation, and reports.
- Support internal and external audits related to procurement activities.
Inventory Support - Coordinate with stores and planning teams to optimize inventory levels.
- Monitor consumption trends and support replenishment planning.
- Minimize stock-outs and excess inventory.
Technical Competencies


Procurement & Sourcing,Coordination & Follow-up,Negotiation,SAP, ARIBA
Qualifications and Experience


Qualification and Experience: 5 to 8 years of experience in procurement, purchasing, sourcing, or supply chain management.
Experience in Procurement of Materials and Services related to Power Plant Equipment / Spares (Mech, Elec, C&I) / AMCs / Civil / Commodities / IT / HR/FMS and should be ready to take up assignments of any category.
Experience in Power, Manufacturing, EPC, Infrastructure, Steel, Cement, or Industrial sectors will be preferred.
AboutCompany: Adani Group is a diversified organisation in India comprising 10 publicly traded companies. Over the years, Adani Group has positioned itself to be the market leader in its transport logistics and energy utility portfolio businesses focusing on large scale infrastructure development in India with O & M practices benchmarked to global standards. With four IG rated businesses, it is the only Infrastructure Investment Grade issuer in India./n/nAdani owes its success and leadership position to its core philosophy of 'Nation Building' driven by 'Growth with Goodness' - a guiding principle for sustainable growth. Description:
Purpose/Objective


The Graduate Trainee Engineer (Mechanical) will support the planning, execution, monitoring, and commissioning of mechanical systems associated with ongoing projects.
The role offers hands-on exposure to project engineering, installation, quality assurance, safety compliance, vendor coordination, and project management practices while working closely with experienced project professionals.
Key Responsibilities of Role


Key Responsibilities Project Execution - Assist in execution of mechanical project activities as per approved project schedules.
- Support installation, erection, testing, and commissioning of mechanical equipment and systems.
- Monitor day-to-day site activities and track project progress against milestones.
- Coordinate with contractors, vendors, consultants, and internal stakeholders for timely completion of work.
Engineering & Technical Support - Review engineering drawings, technical specifications, and BOQs.
- Support preparation of technical documents, reports, and project records.
- Participate in equipment inspections, testing activities, and quality checks.
- Assist in troubleshooting technical issues during execution and commissioning phases.
Quality & Safety Compliance - Ensure compliance with project quality standards and engineering specifications.
- Adhere to all safety guidelines, statutory requirements, and organizational HSE policies.
- Participate in safety audits, toolbox talks, and risk assessment activities.
- Report unsafe conditions and support implementation of corrective actions.
Project Monitoring & Reporting - Maintain progress reports, project trackers, and documentation.
- Assist in preparation of daily, weekly, and monthly project status reports.
- Monitor material availability and coordinate with procurement and stores teams.
- Support cost control and resource optimization initiatives.
Continuous Learning - Develop technical knowledge of mechanical equipment and project management processes.
- Participate in training programs and cross-functional assignments.
- Gain understanding of industry standards, operating procedures, and best practices.
Technical Competencies


• Basic knowledge of mechanical engineering principles.
,• Understanding of pumps, compressors, piping systems, rotating equipment, HVAC, and utility systems.
,• Ability to read engineering drawings and technical documents.
,• Familiarity with AutoCAD, MS Excel, and MS Office applications.
,• Basic understanding of project management concepts
Qualifications and Experience


Educational Qualification - Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering (B.
E.
/B.
Tech).
- Fresh graduates from recognized universities/institutes.
- Consistent academic record preferred.
Experience - 0 to 1 year of experience.
- Internship or project exposure in industrial, power, infrastructure, manufacturing, EPC, or construction projects will be an added advantage.

Description:
Overview:
We are seeking an experienced and highly skilled Logistics Sr. Executive/ Executive to join our team. The ideal candidate will have 7+ years of experience in logistics operations, with a strong background in transport management systems/ fleet management / control tower operations. The successful candidate will be responsible for overseeing and optimizing our logistics operations, ensuring effective vehicle utilization, and utilizing advanced Excel skills for data analysis and reporting.
Key Responsibilities:
Oversee the daily logistics operations, ensuring smooth and efficient transportation, and vehicle uptime.
Manage and optimize the Transport Management System (TMS) for route planning, scheduling, and tracking of shipments.
Lead and supervise fleet management activities, ensuring proper maintenance, compliance, and efficiency of vehicles.
Coordinate and manage control tower operations to provide real-time visibility and proactive management of logistics and transportation activities.
Develop and implement logistics strategies to improve milage efficiency, trip turns, reduce vehicle downtimes, and enhance productivity levels.
Analyze data using advanced Excel skills, including creating dashboards, reports, and metrics to track performance and identify areas for improvement.
Collaborate with internal teams, vendors, and third-party logistics providers to ensure smooth and time-effective transportation solutions.
Ensure compliance with industry regulations, safety standards, and company policies.
Troubleshoot operational issues, identify root causes, and implement corrective actions to maintain operational excellence.
Continuously monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) and propose enhancements to improve efficiency and productivity in the logistics function.
Qualifications:
7+ years of experience in logistics operations or Transport operations.
Strong understanding and experience with Transport Management Systems (TMS), fleet management, and control tower operations.
Advanced Excel skills (pivot tables, vlookups, macros, etc.) for data analysis, reporting, and performance tracking.
Proven experience in managing logistics operations and optimizing transportation processes.
Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.
Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
Knowledge of industry regulations, safety standards, and best practices in logistics.
Bachelor's degree in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Business, or related field preferred.
Preferred Skills:
Experience with enterprise resource planning (ERP) systems. Like TMS or FMS (Preferably Fleetx,or Pando)
Familiarity with Power BI or Excellent with Excel dashboard creation.

Description:
Our jobs aren t just about giving guests a smooth check-in and check-out.
Instead, we want to build and experience that is memorable and unique.
Our Guest Experience Experts take the initiative to deliver a wide range of services that guide guests through their entire stay.
They are empowered to move about their space and do what needs to be done.
Whether processing operational needs, addressing guest requests, completing reports, or sharing the highlights of the local area, the Guest Experience Expert makes transactions feel like part of the experience.
No matter what position you are in, there are a few things that are critical to success - creating a safe work place, following company policies and procedures, maintaining confidentiality, protecting company assets, upholding quality standards, and ensuring your uniform, personal appearance, and communications are professional.
Guest Experience Experts will be on their feet and moving around (stand, sit, or walk for an extended time) and taking a hands-on approach to work (move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 10 pounds without assistance).
Doing all these things well (and other reasonable job duties as requested) is critical for Guest Experience Experts - to get it right for our guests and our business each and every time.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Education: High school diploma or G. E. D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: No related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.
License or Certification: None
At Marriott International, we are dedicated to being an equal opportunity employer, welcoming all and providing access to opportunity.
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Description:
Job Description:
The Client Service at Delhivery will be responsible to provide exceptional service and support to customers, ensuring their satisfaction with Delhivery's products and services. You will handle inquiries, complaints, and requests through various communication channels, including phone, email, and chat. Your role involves understanding customer needs, resolving issues, and delivering accurate and timely information. 
Key Responsibilities: 
Providing assistance with shipment tracking and delivery inquiries and drive regular engagement/quick response 
Resolving issues related to shipments (missing or damaged packages, customs delays, or delivery exceptions) 
CS Engagement via Ticketing module, getting timely response; Keep active track of timely closure of tickets 
Assisting with billing inquiries such as explaining charges, resolving disputes and/or claims, or providing information on payment options 
Providing support for shipping services and delivery options available, regulatory compliance, documentation requirements, claim monitoring 
Analyze and support with insights to improve the process and internal operations and service levels 
Handling customer escalations-preparing RCA / CAPA and providing the solution 
Collaborate with internal stakeholders to maintain and increase performance of client accounts 
Designing SOP, mapping and freezing requirements, client NPS management and providing best solutions to the business

Description:
About the Role

We are looking for a results-driven Performance Marketing Manager to lead customer acquisition and performance marketing initiatives across digital channels. The role will involve owning the paid acquisition funnel end-to-end, from campaign strategy and execution to optimization and conversion, with a strong focus on scaling efficiently while improving CAC, ROAS and overall marketing performance.
The ideal candidate should have strong hands-on experience across Google Ads, Meta Ads, Apple Search Ads, SEO, ASO, analytics and experimentation, along with the ability to translate business objectives into measurable performance marketing strategies.
Key Responsibilities
Own and drive the overall performance marketing strategy across paid digital channels.
Manage significant monthly marketing budgets across Google Ads, Meta Ads, Apple Search Ads, affiliates and other performance channels.
Drive customer acquisition while optimizing CAC, CPA, ROAS, conversion rates and overall marketing efficiency.
Develop, launch and scale campaigns across the acquisition funnel, including app installs, leads, first transactions/orders and other business conversion goals.
Lead Google Ads, Meta Ads, Apple Search Ads and app acquisition campaigns, including campaign structure, targeting, bidding, budget allocation and optimization.
Identify opportunities to scale campaigns while maintaining target acquisition costs and business outcomes.
Analyze campaign, audience and funnel performance to identify growth opportunities and improve unit economics.
Design and execute A/B tests and performance marketing experiments across campaigns, audiences, creatives, landing pages and conversion flows.
Work closely with product, engineering and analytics teams to improve tracking, attribution and conversion measurement.
Define and implement conversion events and signals through GA4, GTM, Adjust and other analytics platforms.
Develop dashboards and recurring performance reports covering spend, CAC, conversions, ROAS, customer quality and channel performance.
Work closely with creative teams to develop, test and scale performance-oriented ad creatives, messaging and landing pages.
Own and drive SEO and ASO initiatives to improve organic acquisition, app discoverability and overall digital performance.
Conduct regular competitor, audience and channel analysis to identify new acquisition opportunities.
Manage external agencies and vendors, including performance reviews, budgets, deliverables and transition of capabilities in-house.
Collaborate with product, business, analytics and creative teams to translate business objectives into actionable performance marketing plans.
Stay updated on changes across advertising platforms, attribution, automation, AI-driven campaign optimization and emerging performance marketing channels.
Required Skills
68 years of experience in Performance Marketing / Growth Marketing / Digital Marketing.
Strong hands-on experience with Google Ads and Meta Ads.
Experience managing large-scale performance marketing budgets.
Strong understanding of app and web acquisition funnels.
Experience with SEO and ASO.
Strong analytical and data-driven approach to performance marketing.
Experience with GA4, GTM, Adjust, Google Ads, Meta Ads, Apple Search Ads and Google Search Console.
Strong understanding of attribution, conversion tracking, campaign measurement and marketing analytics.
Experience working with product, technology, analytics and creative teams.
Strong Excel/Google Sheets skills with the ability to build and interpret performance dashboards.
Excellent communication, stakeholder-management and problem-solving skills.
Experience managing agencies and bringing performance marketing capabilities in-house




Job location- North Goa,
5 Days working

Description:
Plays a significant role in maximizing ficial performance and attracting hotel and non-hotel guests by understanding the local market and partnering with the culinary leadership to effectively position the outlet.
Supervises daily restaurant operations and assists with menu planning, maintains sanitation standards and assists servers and hosts on the floor during peak meal periods.
Strives to continually improve guest and employee satisfaction.
Determines training needed to accomplish goals, then implements plan.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- H High school diploma or GED; 4 years experience in the food and beverage, culinary, or related professional area. OR
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Food Service Management, Hotel and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or related major; 2 years experience in the food and beverage, culinary, or related professional area. CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Taking an Entrepreneurial Approach to Driving the Restaurant Business
- Understands ficial opportunities by surveying restaurant demand.
- Partners with key individuals in the local community to assess opportunities.
- Identifies and analyzes competitors.
- Controls purchases and inventory by negotiating prices and contracts, developing preferred supplier lists, reviewing and evaluating usage reports, and taking corrective action.
- Applies sound revenue management strategies to secure the right level of business at the most optimal time to yield maximum revenues.
Leading Significant Marketing/Public Relations/Media Activities
- Oversees the restaurant marketing plan in partnership with the either the Hotel General Manager/ Manager or Director of Operations and Hotel/Brand Marketing teams including Destination Restaurant Chef, if applicable.
- Supports on-site/off-site public relations opportunities to promote the restaurant.
- Creates and executes against the restaurant-related social media posts and public event communications, monitors social media activity, responds to comments, analyzes posts/trends, and corrects deficiencies.
- Serves as the primary point of contact for restaurant events.
- Participates in local networking activities, which are often off-property, in support of the restaurant.
Managing Day-to-Day Restaurant Operations
- Supervises and manages employees.
- Understands employee positions well enough to perform duties in employees absence.
- Maintains service and sanitation standards in restaurant, bar/lounge and room service areas.
- Conducts daily "taste panels" to educate, drive sales and create sales goals.
- Monitors appropriateness of ambiance/atmosphere (eg, lighting, music, table-top, etc) restaurant concept, positioning, time of day, etc
- Monitors compliance with all applicable laws and regulations.
- Monitors adherence to liquor control policies and procedures.
- Maintains and monitors all collateral, menus and guest touch points such that all are pristine and free of tears, stains and noticeable wear and tear.
- Monitors alcohol beverage service for compliance with local laws.
- Monitors compliance with all food & beverage policies, standards and procedures, including food handling and sanitation standards.
- Assists servers and hosts on the floor during meal periods and high demand times.
- Advocates sound ficial/business decision making.
- Manages day-to-day operations so that customer expectations of quality and standards are meet on a daily basis.
- Recognizes good quality products and presentations.
- Supervises daily shift operations in absence of Assistant Restaurant Manager.
- Oversees the ficial aspects of the department including purchasing and payment of invoices.
Fostering an Environment that Creates Exciting and Memorable Guest Experiences
- Provides services that are above and beyond for customer satisfaction and retention.
- Improves service by communicating and assisting individuals to understand guest needs, providing guidance, feedback, and individual coaching when needed.
- Displays leadership in guest hospitality by exemplifying excellent customer service and creating a positive atmosphere for guest relations.
- Empowers employees to provide excellent customer service.
- Acts as the guest service role model for the restaurants.
.
- Addresses guest problems and complaints.
- Meets with guests on an informal basis during meals or upon departure to obtain feedback on quality of food and beverage, service levels and overall satisfaction.
- Verifies corrective action is taken to continuously improve service results.
- Manages service delivery in outlets to ensure excellent service from point of entry to departure (eg, greeting from hostess, speed of order taking and food and beverage delivery, fulfillment of special requests, collection of payment & invitation to return).
- Incorporates guest satisfaction as a component of departmental meetings with a focus on continuous improvement.
Managing and Conducting Human Resource and Talent Management Activities
- Actively participates in the hiring process to identify the right talent to support the outlets concept.
- Provides guidance and direction to subordinates, including setting performance standards and monitoring performance.
- Identifies the educational needs of others, develops formal educational or training programs or classes, and teaches or instructs others.
- Facilitates the fair and equal treatment of employees.
- Strives to improve employee retention.
- Monitors employee attendance of on-going training to understand guest expectations.
- Solicits employee feedback, utilizes an "open door" policy and reviews employee satisfaction results to identify and address employee problems or concerns.
- Strives to improve service performance.
- Encourages recognition of employees across areas of responsibility.
- Establishes and maintains open, collaborative relationships with employees and encourages employees do the same within the team.
- Establishes guidelines so employees understand expectations and the work.
- Utilizes interpersonal and communication skills to lead, influence, and encourage others.
- Demonstrates honesty/integrity and models appropriate behaviors by leading by example and serving as a role model.
- Encourages and builds mutual trust, respect, and cooperation among team members.
- Identifies the developmental needs of others and coaches, mentors, or otherwise helps others to improve their knowledge or skills.
- Develops specific goals and plans to prioritize, organize, and accomplish own work.
- Monitors and maintains the productivity level of employees.
- Provides the leadership, vision and direction to bring together and prioritize the departmental goals in a way that will be efficient and effective.
- Manages staffing levels to meet guest service standards, operational needs, guest service, and ficial objectives.
- Provides work-related training, supervising, follow-up and hands-on management.
Additional Responsibilities
- Maintains professional and technical knowledge by tracking emerging trends in the restaurant industry, attending educational workshops, reviewing professional publications, establishing personal networks, and/or benchmarking state-of-the-art practices.
- Provides information to supervisors, co-workers, and subordinates by telephone, in written form, e-mail, or in person.
- Analyzes information and evaluates results to choose the best solution and solve problems.

Description:
Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You
Picture yourself brightening someone s day. When you join our hotels team, that s exactly what you ll do every time you come to work! You are the Master of your culinary station, creating delicious dishes guests love. As a Chef de Partie (South Indian), you re not just overseeing kitchen operations - you re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.
What It Takes to Make the Stay
At Hilton, our core values define what it takes to succeed here and guide the qualities we look for in every team member:
A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality. Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership. A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now, bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.
In addition, this role requires the following minimum qualifications:
High school graduate with at least 3 years of experience in a 5-star hotel or high-end restaurant.
At least 1 year as a Demi Chef de Partie or equivalent in an international brand hotel. Technical culinary education preferred.
Proficient in Western or Chinese cuisine, with expertise in various cooking techniques
Knowledge of seafood/meat processing, cooked food processing, storing, and receiving standards.
Here s what you ll do during a typical day:
Prepare great tasting dishes: Season, cook, and test dishes according to standard recipes, ensuring consistency in taste and presentation
Supervise the kitchen team: Oversee line cooks to ensure and provide support as needed in the absence of senior chefs to ensure smooth and efficient operations
Maintain kitchen cleanliness: Keep all work areas clean, tidy, and free of cross-contamination
Ensure food quality and storage compliance: Monitor ingredient quality, ensuring proper storage and stock rotation
Assist with cost management: Contribute to controlling food costs, improving gross profit margins, and meeting departmental financial targets
Inspire and develop the team: Supervise and support team members, monitor performance, provide coaching, and foster a positive and productive work environment
Uphold regulatory standards: Maintain compliance with health, safety, sanitation, and alcohol awareness regulations, ensuring the highest standards of guest and team member well-being
