Description:
Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You
Picture yourself brightening someone s day. When you join our Hotels team, that s exactly what you ll do every time you come to work! You will manage the daily operations of the front office and guest services teams, ensuring that all guests receive outstanding service. You will manage check-in and check-out processes, resolve guest concerns, and lead a team of front desk agents and guest service representatives to meet the hotel s service standards. As a Front Office / Guest Service - Supervisor / Team Leader, you re not just managing daily front office operations - you re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.
What It Takes to Make the Stay
At Hilton, our core values define what it takes to succeed here and guide the qualities we look for in every team member:
A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality. Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership. A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now, bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.
In addition, this role requires the following minimum qualifications:
Proven experience in a front office or guest service management role within the hospitality industry.
Strong leadership and team management skills, with the ability to inspire and motivate staff.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with a guest-centric approach.
Strong problem-solving abilities and attention to detail, with the ability to handle high-pressure situations.
Proficiency in hotel property management systems (PMS) and front office operations.
Proficiency in English; additional languages are a plus.
Ability to work flexible hours, including nights, weekends, and holidays.
Here s what you ll do during a typical day:
Oversee daily front office operations: Overseeing Front Office activities, including guest service, registration, room inventory, and adherence to policies and standards
Monitor and elevate service: Assist in tracking guest satisfaction, addressing service issues, and guiding the team to implement improvements that enhance the guest experience
Support revenue initiatives: Assist in promoting hotel services and executing up-selling tactics to drive room occupancy and revenue growth
Facilitate team knowledge: Provide regular updates and training to ensure the team is well-informed of hotel offerings, services, and local attractions
Delight our guests: Welcome guests, respond to inquiries, and resolve concerns promptly to uphold service standards
Oversee VIP guest experience: Review VIP reservations and ensure an elevated and seamless check-in and check-out experience
Inspire and develop the team: Supervise and support front office team members, monitor performance, provide coaching, and foster a positive and productive work environment

Description:
The Front Office Associate is responsible for delivering exceptional guest service by ensuring smooth check-in and check-out processes, handling guest requests efficiently, maintaining accurate records, and creating a welcoming experience in line with hotel brand standards.
Key Responsibilities
Welcome guests warmly and provide a professional first impression.
Perform check-in and check-out procedures accurately and efficiently.
Handle room reservations, modifications, and cancellations.
Respond promptly to guest inquiries, requests, and complaints, ensuring timely resolution.
Process payments, maintain guest accounts, and prepare accurate billing.
Coordinate with Housekeeping, Engineering, and other departments to ensure guest satisfaction.
Promote hotel facilities, services, loyalty programmes, and special offers.
Maintain the confidentiality of guest information and adhere to data security policies.
Ensure the front desk, lobby, and reception area remain clean and presentable.
Follow hotel SOPs, brand standards, and safety, security, and emergency procedures.
Prepare daily reports and complete shift handovers accurately.
Qualification Skills
Diploma or bachelors degree in Hotel Management or Hospitality.
0 2 years of experience in Front Office operations (freshers may also apply).
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
Strong customer service orientation with a professional appearance.
Basic computer knowledge and familiarity with PMS (Opera/Fidelio or similar) is preferred.
Ability to work in shifts, including weekends and public holidays.
Good problem-solving, multitasking, and teamwork skills.
This role is responsible for ensuring every guest receives a warm welcome, personalized service, and a memorable stay while maintaining the highest standards of hospitality and operational excellence.

Description:
Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You
Picture yourself brightening someone s day. When you join our hotels team, that s exactly what you ll do every time you come to work! You will oversee the maintenance of precise records of all receivables from guests, tenants, concessionaires, credit card companies, online transactions, and employees. As a Finance Executive (Income Auditor), you re not just driving financial accuracy and operational efficiency - you re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.
At Hilton, our core values define what it takes to succeed here and guide the qualities we look for in every team member:
A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality. Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership. A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now, bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.
In addition, this role requires the following minimum qualifications:
University degree with 3-4 years of relevant experience.
Attention to detail, good communication, and interpersonal skills.
Proficient in Microsoft Office with system skills in Check SCM, SUN.
A professional accounting qualification would be advantageous.
Here s what you ll do during a typical day:
Secure Accurate Documentation: Safeguard signed cheques in the Financial Controller s safe and maintain a detailed log; verify invoice backups for accuracy before distribution.
Efficient Time Management: Maintain an organized, up-to-date filing system and respond to all inquiries promptly and professionally.
Problem-Solving Support: Perform ad hoc tasks to ensure smooth hotel operations and maintain accurate records of all receivables.
Financial Accuracy: Ensure all charges and account statements are correct and submitted on time, covering guests, groups, banquets, employees, and credit card companies.

Responsibilities: We're Hiring | HR Executive / Assistant Manager Talent Acquisition Muthoot Finance Ltd

We're expanding our HR Talent Acquisition Team (FTC)& Alternate channel ! If you're passionate about recruitment and want to be part of one of India's leading BFSI organizations, we'd love to hear from you.

Open Positions

HR Executive – Talent Acquisition Assistant Manager – Talent Acquisition

Work Locations

Bengaluru, Chennai, Hyderabad, Warangal, Mysore, Mangalore, Hubballi, Davanagere, Kalaburagi, Tirupati, Nellore, Kurnool, Vijayawada, Visakhapatnam, Kochi, Coimbatore, Salem, Madurai, Tirunelveli, Tiruchirappalli, Kanyakumari, Delhi, Ahmedabad, Pune, Chandigarh, Jaipur, Lucknow, Kolkata, Mumbai, and many more locations across India.

Eligibility

• Graduate/Postgraduate (Male candidates)• 2 to 5+ years of experience in Talent Acquisition/Recruitment• Sales & BFSI hiring experience preferred

Key Responsibilities

1. Talent Acquisition:
o Source candidates through diverse sourcing channels, including campus recruitment, job drives,
employee exchanges, and lateral hiring.
o Screen candidate profiles for role fitment and coordinate interviews with hiring managers.
o Negotiate salary packages and ensure maximum offer-to-joining conversions.
o Map and contact competitor talent for strategic recruitment.
2. Employee Retention & Performance:
o Maintain attrition levels below 5% in the assigned region.
o Conduct exit interviews and analyze data to improve retention strategies.
o Track and ensure the completion of performance scorecards for all employees.
3. HR Operations & Compliance:
o Oversee daily HR operations at the regional level.
o Address and resolve employee grievances effectively.
o Ensure timely attendance management and the seamless movement of promoted employees to
their respective branches.
4. Employee Engagement:
o Organize and implement employee engagement activities to foster a positive work culture in the
region.
o Conduct regular feedback sessions to understand employee needs and align them with
organizational goals.
5. Strategic HR Activities:
o Maintain and update competitor data for strategic mapping.
o Support the implementation of corporate HR initiatives at the regional level.
Requirements:
• Education: Any Graduate or PG Qualifications in Human Resources or a relevant field are desirable.
• Experience: 2–6 years of experience in HR, with a strong understanding of HR processes.
• Expertise: Practical experience in employee relations, performance & reward, and learning & talent
acquisition.
• Proficiency in MS Excel and PowerPoint.
• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills

Compensation

Competitive salary with a hike on your last CTC.• HR Executive: Budget up to 5 LPA• Assistant Manager TA: Budget up to 10 LPA (based on experience and role fit)

Description:
Here is a comprehensive Job Description (JD) tailored specifically for a Store Manager / Sales Executive role in the luxury furniture sector.
Job Description: Store Manager / Sales Executive
Job Overview
Position: Store Manager / Sales Executive (Luxury Furniture)
Industry: Luxury Retail / High-End Furniture / Interior Design Solutions
Employment Type: Full-Time
Department: Retail Operations & Sales
We are looking for a high-performing, customer-centric Store Manager / Sales Executive to lead our luxury showroom and drive exceptional retail sales. In this role, you will act as the brand ambassador for our high-end furniture collections, blending hands-on luxury sales consultation with store leadership to deliver an elevated client experience.
Key Responsibilities
Luxury Client Consultation: Welcome high-net-worth clients, interior designers, and architects, offering expert consultations tailored to high-end residential and commercial spaces.
Store Operations & Team Leadership: Manage daily showroom operations, oversee visual merchandising standards, and guide sales staff to achieve store performance goals.
Sales & Revenue Generation: Drive individual and store sales targets by proactively converting walk-ins, closing high-value deals, and nurturing long-term client relationships.
Product & Design Expertise: Showcase premium furniture craftsmanship, rare materials, and bespoke custom design options with deep product knowledge.
Order & Inventory Management: Oversee order tracking, delivery schedules, quality checks, stock inventory, and after-sales support to ensure absolute client satisfaction.
Key Requirements & Qualifications
Experience: 2 to 6 years of proven experience in luxury retail sales, premium furniture showrooms, or high-end lifestyle brand management (Store management experience required for managerial applicants).
Skills & Competencies:
Impeccable communication, negotiation, and interpersonal relationship-building skills.
Strong aesthetic sense with an understanding of luxury interior design trends and spatial layout.
Professional demeanor, well-groomed presence, and high emotional intelligence.
Proficiency in basic retail management software, CRM tools, and inventory systems.
Education: Bachelors degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Interior Design, or a related field.Role & responsibilities

Picture yourself brightening someone s day. When you join our Hotels team, that s exactly what you ll do every time you come to work! Description:
Hi,
Greetings!
We are looking for Technology Transfer Engineer (Pilot plant) at Goa Location.
Experience 7- 12 Years.
Qualification - Must have BE/B.Tech or ME/M.Tech in Chemical Engineering.
Role purpose
To assist the technology transfer of processes into pilot plant for both internally (Goa T&E) and externally ( other locations plants) developed processes
To Works cross functionally with process development, analytical , raw material procurement and facilities departments to effectively transfer and maintain processes in the facility
Involve in compilation of process data , report preparation
Evaluates existing processes and identifies process and/or equipment improvement to improve efficiency, consistency, and competitiveness within the timelines.
Responsible for the process performance monitoring / optimization / development during pilot trials
Support operation team in preparation of the technical documents including batch production records, specifications, project reports, and engineering specifications
Accountabilities:
For operating the plant as per the HSEQEn management system
For any scenarios that can place oneself as well as others to injuries /illness and Environment pollution
Develops BFD , costing , engineering package for any new product introduction in pilot
Responsibilities:
Should undertake equipment mapping , process risk assessment , management of change prior to pilot trials
Basic knowledge in chemistry and process hazard
Process hazard data interpretation and translating to pilot trials
Exploits a deep knowledge of chemical technology, chemical processes & processing to deliver right first time product
Takes detailed account of the end-to-end solutions while devolving the process during pilot trial
Develops specific calculation methodologies and process models to support design, scale-up and sizing
Extensive knowledge of Basis of Safety across the whole process, including hazard identification, risk assessment of all performance aspects, and incident investigation.
Generates, investigates and owns innovative technical solutions across functional boundaries.
Understands and utilises advanced calculation, modelling and simulation tools in support of design, and performs complex scale-up and sizing calculations
Provides critical justification of the end-to-end process based on detailed economic, safety and operability assessment
Works independently in supporting the implementation of new chemical processes using novel technologies
Lead comprehensive training on topics including safe operations of process units (including MOCs, HAZOPs and P&IDs), Key process safety indicators, BOS (Basis of safety), and API, Global standards and procedures.
Critical knowledge
Must have BE/B.Tech or ME/M.Tech in Chemical Engineering
Atleast Min 7 - 12 years experience in technology transfer, process engineering or Scale -up Good understanding of HSEQEn systems in chemical industry
Appreciation of high process safety standards basic theoretical and practical experience.
Awareness of ISO 50001:2018 requirements for this role.

Description:
Responsible verifying that operations are in compliance with hygiene and food safety standards.
Advises on proper food handling practices and provides food hygiene training for all new hires and trainees.
Identifies key areas of risk in various food operations and takes preemptive remedial action.
Provides technical advice on product labeling issues for fulfilling government requriements.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- High school diploma or GED; 2 years experience in the food and beverage, culinary, or related professional area. OR
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Hotel and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or related major.
Preferred:
Environmental Health Degree or Culinary Degree
CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Managing Hygience and Food Safety Operations
- Verifies compliance with Brand Standard Audit (BSA) requriements of Marriott International throughout the operations.
- Advises and monitors food handlers on the proper good handling practices and verifies their observance.
- Identifies key areas of risk in various food operations and takes preemptive remedial action.

- Provides in-house food hygiene training for all good handlers, (eg new hires and trainees).

- Conducts and records daily kitchen inspections on the personal, environmental and food hygiene condictions and provides corrective action plans as necessary.
- Conducts regular vendor inspections in partnership with purchasing and culinary leadership.
- Conducts regular internal BSA inspections with culinary leadership and kitchen cleaning staff.

- Coordinates cleaning program in all F&B areas (eg, General clean), identifying trends and making recommendation for improvements.
- Establishes and maintains open, collaborative relationships with employees.
- Liases with pest control company for any pest issues and monitors pest control performance.
- Maintains and makes improvements to hygiene standards.
- Regularly reviews and refreshes the food safety standards of all food handlers withing the property.
- Maintains documentation on all hygiene and food safety stadards throughout the operation.

Description:
Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You
Picture yourself brightening someone s day. When you join our Hotels team, that s exactly what you ll do every time you come to work! Long Description: You will be the first point of contact for guests, responsible for ensuring smooth check-ins, check-outs, and addressing guest inquiries throughout their stay. You play a key role in making guests feel welcome, ensuring that all their needs are met and that any issues are resolved promptly. As a Front Office Associate , you re not just ensuring a seamless check-in and check-out process - you re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.
What It Takes to Make the Stay
At Hilton, our core values define what it takes to succeed here and guide the qualities we look for in every team member:
A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality . Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership . A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now , bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.
In addition, this role requires the following minimum qualifications:
Previous experience in a guest service or front office role within the hospitality industry.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to handle guest inquiries and complaints professionally.
Proficiency in hotel property management systems (PMS) and general front office procedures.
Excellent multitasking skills and the ability to remain calm and professional in a fast-paced environment.
Proficiency in English; additional languages are a plus.
Ability to work flexible hours, including nights, weekends, and holidays.
A positive attitude and a genuine passion for providing exceptional guest service.
Here s what you ll do during a typical day:
Deliver a warm welcome: Greet guests upon arrival and complete the check-in process, including verifying details, assigning rooms, issuing keys, and providing welcome materials or bell service assistance
Support efficient check-out: Process guest departures by verifying charges, handling payments, issuing receipts, and using the point-of-sale system accurately
Provide hotel and local knowledge: Demonstrate comprehensive knowledge of hotel offerings, room types, rates, promotions, and local area information to assist with guest inquiries
Promote hotel services: Use up-selling techniques to recommend hotel amenities and maximize room and service revenue
Delight our guests: Respond to guest requests, resolve concerns with care and urgency, and effectively manage messages and communications

Description:
Our jobs aren t just about putting food on the table that our guests will enjoy until they ask for their bill.
Instead, we want to build an experience that is memorable and unique - with food and drinks on the side.
Our Guest Service Experts take the initiative and deliver a wide range of services to make sure that guests enjoy their meal.
Whether setting tables, communicating with the kitchen, interacting and serving guests, or cleaning work areas and supplies, the Guest Service Expert makes transactions feel like part of the experience.
No matter what position you are in, there are a few things that are critical to success - creating a safe workplace, following company policies and procedures, upholding quality standards, and ensuring your uniform, personal appearance, and communications are professional.
Guest Service Experts will be on their feet and moving around (stand, sit, or walk for an extended time; moving over sloping, uneven, or slippery surfaces), managing the menu (read and visually verify information), and taking a hands-on approach to work (move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 25 pounds without assistance and 50 pounds with assistance; reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping).
Doing all these things well (and other reasonable job duties as requested) is critical for Guest Service Experts - to get it right for our guests and our business each and every time.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Education: High school diploma or G. E. D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: Less than 1 year related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.
License or Certification: None

Description:
POSITION SUMMARY
Respond and attend to guest repair requests. Communicate with guests/customers to resolve maintenance issues. Perform preventive maintenance on tools and kitchen and mechanical room equipment, including cleaning and lubrication. Visually inspect tools, equipment, or machines. Carry equipment (e.g., tools, radio). Identify, locate, and operate all shut-off valves for equipment and all utility shut-offs for buildings. Maintain maintenance inventory and requisition parts and supplies as needed. Communicate each day s activities and problems that occur to the other shifts using approved communication programs and standards. Display basic knowledge or ability to acquire knowledge in the following categories: air conditioning and refrigeration, electrical, mechanical, plumbing, pneumatic/electronic systems and controls, carpentry and finish skills, kitchen equipment, vehicles, energy conservation, and/or general building. Perform all surface preparation, painting, minor drywall and wood trim repair, light bulb and A/C filter replacement and the complete and thorough cleanup of the painting or repair area. Test, troubleshoot and perform basic repair on all types of equipment, plumbing (e.g., plunge toilets and unclog drains), electrical components including lamps, cosmetic items, extension cords, vacuum cleaners, internet devices, replace electrical switches and outlets, and other guestroom items. Program TVs and perform general housekeeping and engineering-related inventory duties. Use the Lockout/Tagout system before performing any maintenance work. Perform repairs on interior and exterior landscaping as well as external landscaping sprinklers. Display basic computer skills including inputting air handler schedules and making temperature changes.
Follow all company and safety and security policies and procedures; report any maintenance problems, safety hazards, accidents, or injuries; complete safety training and certifications; and properly store flammable materials. Ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional, maintain confidentiality of proprietary information, and protect company assets. Welcome and acknowledge all guests according to company standards, anticipate and address guests service needs, assist individuals with disabilities, and thank guests with genuine appreciation. Adhere to quality expectations and standards. Develop and maintain positive working relationships with others, support team to reach common goals, and listen and respond appropriately to the concerns of other employees. Speak with others using clear and professional language. Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 50 pounds without assistance and heavier lifting or movement tasks with assistance. Move up and down stairs, service ramps, and/or ladders. Reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping. Enter and locate work-related information using computers. Perform other reasonable job duties as requested.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Education: High school diploma or G.E.D equivalent.
Related Work Experience: Some experience in general maintenance, exterior and interior surface preparation and painting.
Experience in hotel engineering or maintenance a plus.
Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.
REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS
License or Certification: Driver s License
At Marriott International, we are dedicated to being an equal opportunity employer, welcoming all and providing access to opportunity. We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated. Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates. We are committed to non-discrimination on any protected basis, including disability, veteran status, or other basis protected by applicable law.

About Lenskart
With a mission to give India a vision, Lenskart.com is India's fastest growing eyewear company. Lenskart's products include prescription eyewear, branded contact lenses and sunglasses, all equipped with the customers eye powers.
About the Role
A Sales Associate is responsible for providing the best customer experience in the stores by providing high standards of selling services to customers. He/she plays a key role in driving the revenue achieved by the store.
Responsibilities Area
Activities expected to be performed by a Lenskart Sales Associate
Customer focus: Driving Net Promoter Score
Greeting and welcoming all walk-in customers and guiding them toward the clinic to promote the free eye check-up
Being involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day tasks to deliver the best shopping experience to the customers
Understanding the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively
Being dedicated to customer satisfaction and resolving any concerns that the customer has
Product recommendation
Presenting the customer with an optimal selection of products based on customer preferences Understanding the unstated needs of the customer, asking relevant questions, and picking the right time to pitch the recommended solutions
Achieving sales Vs. Plan & SOP adherence
Achieving the assigned target for sales, eye-test conversion, returns; and following all SOPs
Post making the sale, coordinating with the customer for product pick-up, after receiving due communication from the warehouse. In case of returns, he/she is expected to understand the reason and try to resolve the same to control the return percentage.
Store upkeep & maintenance
Maintaining the store as per Lenskart standards, cleaning the frames and other equipment regularly, and ensuring there is no deviation as per the SOP
Ensuring the security of all Lenskart equipment and that there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store
Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification: 12th pass; Graduates preferred Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions Clear communication and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to changing environment and openness to learn
Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority

About the Role
Sales Associate is responsible for providing the best customer experience in the stores by providing high standards of selling services to Lenskart customers. He/she plays a pivotal role in driving the revenue achieved by the store.
Responsibilities Area Activities expected to be performed by a Lenskart Sales Associate Customer focus
Sales Associate is expected to greet and welcome all walk-in customers and guide them toward the clinic, promoting the free eye check-up
He/she will be involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day tasks to deliver the best shopping experience to the customers
He/she must possess a basic understanding of the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively
He/she must be dedicated to customer satisfaction and must go beyond his means to resolve any concerns that the customer has
Product recommendation

Store upkeep & maintenance
He/she is expected to maintain Lenskart standards of hygiene in the store with respect to the overall display, frames, instruments, and other store equipment by cleaning them regularly

Description:
About the Role

A Store Manager at Lenskart acts as an important link between strategy and execution. He/she drives the store towards achieving all assigned metrics of Store Sales, Conversions, Customer satisfaction etc. and is responsible for keeping a high level of morale among the store staff, developing them, controlling attrition, and ensuring smooth operations at the store.

Responsibilities:

Customer focus: Driving Net Promoter Score ( NPS )

Greeting customers when they enter store and coaching the team to do the same
Displaying commitment towards providing exceptional Customer Service and ensuring that Lenskart associates also treat Customer Satisfaction as a priority
Dealing with customer service issues such as queries and complaints at store level and ensuring this is consistent with the team
Striving to have long lasting and fruitful relationships with each of our customers

Driving sales vs. plan

Driving the sales of the store to meet the allotted targets by allocating the targets to the staff
Developing a culture of high sales performance expectations, i.e. Sales Leadership
Motivating and inspiring the field team to drive for results
Assessing field capability and establish performance priorities at group level

People development (Attrition Control)

Assisting in recruiting and selecting high potential staff
Providing effective on-the-job training and guidance to team members making use of company training modules
Delivering clear, motivating and constructive feedback in a timely manner to all retail associates
Evaluating the training needs of store associates and working closely with L&D department to execute the developmental plan
Understanding the reasons for attrition and taking measures to control it

Cash & Inventory management

Monitoring cash reconciliation to ensure there is no mismatch of store funds
Ensuring availability of required merchandise and services
Conducting stocktakes regularly
Ensuring the staff at store level has basic understanding of POS System to ensure transactions are properly and effectively processed
Performing the necessary quality checks for the new products
Working very closely with other departments till the product reaches the customer and ensuring the best customer experience to the Lenskart Customer

Supervision

Ensuring that all store employees, including the Optometrist, are taken care of and their issues are resolved
Ensuring that the eye check-ups are conducted as per the SOP and maintain high quality standards

SOP adherence & implementation

Ensuring that all SOPs for retail are implemented successfully and adhered to by store employees
Updating colleagues on business performance, new initiatives and other important issues
Scheduling the teams shift timings to meet the stores business needs and demands
Ensuring staffing levels are adequate to effectively operate the store

Store upkeep & maintenance

Maintaining the store as per Lenskart standards, regularly cleaning the frames and other equipment at the store
Ensuring the security of all Lenskart equipment and that there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store

Description:
About the Role
The role of Cluster Optometrist at Lenskart revolves around a combination of a perfect blend of optometry and optical retail. He/she plays a pivotal role in upskilling the front end retail staff on the professional optometry grounds. They are responsible to deliver the best customer experience by leading the example in driving the key business metrics with their optometric approach. Their key deliverable in business includes maintenance of eye test quality and dispensing standards throughout as per Lenskart norms.
Responsibilities
Store Visit
Must visit assigned stores in Lenskart uniform and manage the complete Technical and Functional part of Lenskart stores

In Store Duty
Act as a Mentor and Coach to Fresher Optometrists. Help them with Sales Pitch, Technical Dispensing Guidance, Troubleshooting, Customer Query Handling etc.
Must also work as a store optometrist during busy hours, high sale days or to cover shifts of those who are on leave. Check eye test, QC drawers, Wooqer entries, CL expiry, merchandise, Instrument calibration, KMT products etc.
To ensure the Store NPS is achieved by training, troubleshooting, tracking detractor and lead by example

Manpower
To welcome new talent from market, conduct interview and on board. Initiation Prepare and conduct meetings with respective AOMs to discuss reviews, performance or proposals

Training
For new staff - Undertake regular reviews, analyse SOPs such as eye test, quality check, dispensing, contact lens, troubleshoot, deliver to measure the impact of training on store performance. Identify and Train the Store staff to help them achieve their goals

Audit
Periodically audit their eye test and dispensing performance

Team Leader
Wear multiple hats of Team leader, Bench, Senior, Consultant Optometrist to support store team

Revenue
Maximise In-Store Revenue through Optometrists through continuous training, periodic reviews, increasing number of eye tests done at store and reducing returns

Team Work
Work as a member of Business Team to accomplish goals and objectives. Participate in regional, departmental, executive, operational meeting as appropriate

Documentation
Maintain documentation and Report daily to PS regional manager on store visit summary
Working Hours
Same as store shift and as per business needs. Must work on weekends and public holidays to support store business

Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification - Diploma in Optometry with minimum 3 years of retail experience and a good track record
Good Knowledge in Optometry, Refraction, Eye Wear Products, Dispensing and Measurements
Must be ready to travel anywhere in India as per Business requirements
Passionate about Sales, Retail, Customer service and Training
Good understanding of market and product analysis
Must have leadership qualities such as - lead by example, coaching, motivating, great communication and never give up attitude
Energy, influence, 10 x think entrepreneur mind-set etc

Description:
You, as an Area Manager, play a critical role to lead diverse teams at store level who are in turn responsible in providing the best customer experience to Lenskart customers as well as revenue generation. You are the facilitator of growth, responsible to build vision & business strategies to achieve sales, customer experience, and other organisational goals by investing in people through regular coaching.

We are looking for enthusiastic & pragmatic leaders with strong inclination towards customer centricity, sales, digital mind-set, and people leadership. On a typical day, you would be spending your time at the stores in your area, helping the team deliver on the strategy, coaching them and helping remove road-blocks.

Key Responsibilities:

Sales Leadership:

- Developing & driving sales strategy for your area & team with focus on revenue goals.
- Driving the rigor to deliver world-class customer experience at the store, thereby increasing the Net Promoter Score (NPS) for the store and reducing detractors
- Drive high performance culture in your area across the metrics mentioned above
- Assessing business and performance trends regularly & build improvement opportunities.
- Serve as critical strategy planning link between Corporate and the field organization.
- Translate corporate goals including financial returns, sales growth and market share, into
Business plans.
- Assess field capability and establish performance priorities at group level.

People leadership:

- Partnership with Store Managers & HR team to make sure stores are adequately staffed.
- Leading leaders, coaching and developing future talent
- Assess & bridge skill gaps including those related to implementation of business plans, forecasts, financial analysis, associate development and communication
- Formal & Informal performance management for store managers they are responsible for
- Responsible for establishing a culture that embraces diversity and maximizes the learnings from a diverse team.
- Retain talent -> Reduce attrition

Organisational leadership:

- Solely responsible for managing and maintaining territory and store budgets to ensure profitability at the area level
- Managing the top and bottom line effectively of the assigned territory and stores

Description:
Responsible for availability of Raw Material & Components as per agreed delivery dates aligned to Production Schedule by effective vendor management and internal escalations.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES AND ACCOUNTABILITIES
Vendor Management & Expediting
Drive proactive vendor engagement with a go-getter attitude to ensure timely deliveries.
Prepare and monitor scheduling lines post-PO release; align supplier schedules with plant requirements.
Track delivery performance, escalate critical delays, and ensure adherence to monthly supply plans.
Utilize Vendor Portal for streamlined communication and grievance resolution.
Collaborate with planning and plant teams to maintain safety stock and optimize storage utilization.
Develop and maintain procurement dashboards for performance tracking and reporting.

Operational Procurement & P2P Cycle

Ensure the Long Lead Time parts are well planned based on Season requirement
Supplier RM wise (ABS) monitoring and ensure uninterpreted supplies.

Inventory & Material Management
Manage raw material inventory and refine lead times based on plant requirements.
Measure and report RM/component availability against production plans.
FSN Analysis & Aging Inventory Analysis
Indirect Purchase (Opex/Capex) Experience.

Governance & Compliance
Ensure adherence to government norms related to taxation, safety, and environmental regulations.
Apply 5S, QC tools, and process control charts to enhance procurement operations.
Support corporate SCM initiatives across logistics, planning, strategic sourcing, and supplier development.
Desired Skills & Experience
Strong analytical and communication skills.
Exposure to vendor negotiations, import/export regulations, and compliance frameworks.
SAP End user skill level important
Must have experience in relevant Consumer durable /Appliance industry, handled Metals/Plastics/Packaging/Fabrication item.
Indirect purchase experience

Description:
QC Analyst
Roles & Responsibilities:
Perform analysis of raw materials, packing materials, in-process samples, finished products, and stability samples as per approved specifications and test methods.
Operate and maintain analytical instruments such as HPLC, GC, UV-Visible Spectrophotometer, FTIR, Dissolution Apparatus, and other laboratory equipment.
Prepare, standardize, and maintain laboratory reagents, volumetric solutions, and reference standards.
Review analytical data, maintain laboratory records, and ensure compliance with GDP, GLP, and data integrity requirements.
Investigate OOS, OOT, laboratory incidents, and deviations as per approved procedures.
Participate in method verification, method transfer, and analytical method validation activities.
Ensure timely completion of sample analysis and reporting.
Support regulatory audits, customer audits, and internal audits.
Follow cGMP, safety, and quality systems requirements.

Microbiologist -
Roles & Responsibilities:
Perform microbiological testing of raw materials, finished products, purified water, and environmental monitoring samples.
Conduct environmental monitoring of manufacturing areas, including viable and non-viable monitoring.
Perform microbial limit tests, sterility testing, endotoxin testing, and growth promotion tests.
Prepare and manage microbiological culture media and microbial cultures.
Carry out water system monitoring and trend analysis.
Maintain microbiology laboratory records in compliance with GDP, GLP, cGMP, and data integrity requirements.
Investigate OOS, OOT, deviations, and microbiological excursions.
Participate in method validation, method suitability studies, and qualification activities.
Ensure laboratory housekeeping, equipment calibration, and compliance with safety requirements.
Support internal, regulatory, and customer audits.

Qualification
B.Sc./M.Sc. (Chemistry/Analytical Chemistry/Microbiology/Biotechnology) or equivalent qualification.
Experience
2-4 Years of relevant experience in a pharmaceutical formulation/API manufacturing company.
Skills Required
  Knowledge of cGMP, GLP, GDP, and Data Integrity.
Hands-on experience with analytical instruments (for QC Analyst) and microbiological testing techniques (for Microbiologist).
Good documentation and investigation skills.
Exposure to regulatory requirements of USFDA, MHRA, EU GMP, WHO GMP, etc.

Description:
Responsible for providing short-term, specialized patient care, diagnostic monitoring, and minor surgical procedures that do not require overnight hospitalization.

Clinical & Patient Care
Outpatient Consultations (OPD): Conduct primary medical examinations, take comprehensive patient histories, and assess acute or chronic illnesses.
Daycare Management: Supervise and manage short-stay patients undergoing procedures like IV fluid therapies, chemotherapy sessions, dialysis, blood transfusions, or prolonged diagnostic monitoring.
Minor Procedures: Perform or assist in minor surgical or medical procedures such as wound suturing, dressings, incision and drainage (I&D), foreign body removal, and catheterization.
Diagnostic Interpretation: Order and evaluate basic clinical investigations (e.g., blood tests, X-rays, ECGs) to formulate quick and accurate treatment plans.
Emergency & Stabilization
Acute Care & Triage: Identify critical shifts in a patient's vital signs or general condition during their short stay.
Emergency Management: Administer first-line emergency medical care and stabilize patients experiencing sudden medical crises before coordinating transfers to higher care centers.
Operations & Administration
Multidisciplinary Liaison: Coordinate closely with nursing staff, specialist consultants, and administrators to ensure seamless patient care and timely discharges.
Medical Documentation: Maintain highly precise Electronic Medical Records (EMR), including admission notes, procedure records, drug charts, and discharge summaries.
Referrals & Follow-ups: Structure comprehensive discharge guidelines and schedule routine outpatient follow-up care.

Qualifications & Licensing
Degree: Bachelor of Medicine, Bachelor of Surgery (MBBS) from a recognized medical council.
Licensure: Valid and active registration with the relevant State Medical Council or National Medical Commission (NMC)

Description:
Program Associate - District Coordination

Position Overview
The Program Associate will provide strategic and operational support to the District Administration, ensuring effective coordination and convergence among relevant departments across the assigned district and blocks.

Roles and Responsibilities
Conduct situational assessments and district-level gap analyses to identify challenges in child protection.
Undertake vulnerability mapping and facilitate the linkage of vulnerable children and families with appropriate central and state government welfare schemes.
Strengthen the functioning of child protection systems and institutions.
Support the protection and rehabilitation of children affected by child marriage, child trafficking, child labour, and other forms of exploitation.
Assist the District Administration in inspecting child protection institutions and schools to ensure compliance with applicable laws, standards, and safeguarding protocols.
Organize capacity-building workshops for government officials, frontline workers, and relevant stakeholders.
Conduct awareness and sensitization workshops at district and block levels on child protection issues, including child marriage, child labour, child trafficking, and child sexual abuse.
Facilitate interdepartmental coordination and convergence among stakeholders working on child protection.
Track progress on key indicators related to education, health, nutrition, and child protection to support timely corrective action.
Support data-driven planning, monitoring, and decision-making processes.
Document key learnings, insights, and best practices to improve programme implementation and outcomes.

Education and Experience
Graduate with 1 to 2 years of relevant work experience; or
Postgraduate/Masters degree with up to 1 year of relevant work experience.

Required Skills
Strong commitment to child protection and welfare initiatives.
Good communication and coordination skills, with the ability to build effective working relationships with stakeholders.
Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple responsibilities.
Analytical thinking and practical problem-solving abilities.
Fluency in the local language(s) spoken in the assigned community will be preferred.

Job Description
A Sales Advisor is responsible for delivering the best customer experience that contributes to the store s sales and profit. As a Sales Advisor, you ll always put customers first, offer assistance, and share your product and fashion knowledge. Previous experience within retail, merchandising and/or customer service.

Working at the heart of a fast-paced fashion business, a Visual Merchandiser will create an environment that inspires customers to explore their personal style. Be responsible for driving new product development from designsstage to high volume production

Deep understanding of statistical data analysis along withdata analysis tools such as Excel VBA / Spotfire / O+ / JMP / Galaxy.

Strong analytical skills, ability to problem solve and debugsystems, circuits, and devices.
Experienced in product coordination, yield improvement test time reduction.
Working knowledge of semiconductor quality and automotivestandard process control
Hands-on experience with production Characterizationdata collection at Wafer as well as Package level
Experience in working in production test floors, benchinstruments ATE is a plus.
Experience with Probers and Handlers is a plus

Description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Job Title Senior Resident

Department Forensic Medicine & Toxicology (FMT)

Reporting To Professor / Head of the Department

Location Northeast India

Institution Type Premier 500-bed NABH-Accredited Multi-Super Speciality Teaching Hospital.

Employment Type Full-Time | Resident Medical Officer (Teaching Hospital)

Regulatory Framework National Medical Commission (NMC) Compliant

POSITION SUMMARY
The Senior Resident in the Department of Forensic Medicine & Toxicology (FMT) at SMIMS & Central Referral Hospital, Gangtok, Sikkim, is a pivotal training and operational role for postgraduate-qualified doctors seeking structured hands-on experience in forensic medical practice within a university teaching hospital. The incumbent will contribute to undergraduate MBBS teaching, forensic laboratory operations, mortuary supervision, and medico-legal documentation under the guidance of senior faculty. This role serves as a critical stepping stone toward an academic career as Assistant Professor, fulfilling the NMC-mandated Senior Resident experience requirement in a recognized medical institution.

CRITICAL ACCOUNTABILITIES

A. Academic & Teaching Responsibilities
Deliver undergraduate (MBBS) theory lectures and tutorial classes in Forensic Medicine & Toxicology as assigned by the Head of Department.
Conduct undergraduate clinical classes, practical demonstrations, and case-based learning sessions for MBBS students and interns.
Assist senior faculty in postgraduate teaching activities including seminars, journal clubs, and case presentations.
Cover duties of other Senior Residents when required to ensure uninterrupted academic programme delivery.

B. Clinical & Forensic Responsibilities
Collect, record, and maintain accurate patient and case information in accordance with institutional and medico-legal documentation standards.
Assist in forensic laboratory activities including collection of forensic samples such as viscera, blood, and tissues for toxicological analysis.
Ensure proper preservation and timely dispatch of forensic samples for toxicology analysis, adhering to institutional and legal protocols.
Maintain strict chain of custody for all forensic evidence ensuring proper labelling, packaging, documentation, and secure transfer at every stage.
Supervise mortuary operations and enforce safety protocols including infection control, documentation standards, and dignified handling procedures.
Assist in medico-legal autopsy procedures under the supervision of faculty, including documentation of findings.
Support preparation of medico-legal certificates, injury reports, and other forensic documentation as required.
Cover duties of other Senior Residents when required, ensuring continuity of clinical and forensic operations.

C. Administrative & Other Responsibilities
Maintain meticulous records of all forensic cases, samples, and medico-legal proceedings handled by the department.
Participate in departmental quality improvement initiatives and NABH compliance activities.
Engage in Continuing Medical Education (CME) programmes, workshops, and departmental academic activities.
Complete the NMC-mandated Basic Course in Biomedical Research within the stipulated timeframe.
Undertake any additional responsibilities assigned by the Head of Department or senior faculty.

MANDATORY QUALIFICATIONS & ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA

Educational Qualifications
MBBS from a recognized medical institution.
Postgraduate degree: MD / MS / DNB in Forensic Medicine & Toxicology (or equivalent recognized qualification) from a permitted/recognized medical college or institution, as per NMC guidelines.
Regulatory & Compliance Requirements
Valid registration with the State Medical Council or National Medical Commission is mandatory.
Appointment must comply with current NMC guidelines for Senior Resident positions in recognized medical institutions.
Must complete or be willing to complete the Basic Course in Biomedical Research (NMC-mandated) during the tenure.
Preference for candidates seeking to fulfill NMC-recognized SR experience for future Assistant Professor eligibility.

SKILLS, KNOWLEDGE & COMPETENCIES

Forensic & Clinical Skills
Forensic sample collection & handling
Toxicology sample preservation & dispatch
Chain of custody maintenance
Mortuary supervision & safety
Post-mortem assistance & documentation
Medico-legal record keeping

Academic & Technical
UG MBBS lecture & clinical teaching
Practical demonstration skills
NMC regulatory awareness
Medical documentation & reporting
Forensic laboratory procedures
Biomedical research basics

Interpersonal & Soft Skills
Excellent interpersonal skills
Strong verbal & written communication
Detail-oriented & organized
Ethical & professional conduct
Team collaboration skills

underlying business case and building a generalized solution

Converting the cleaned data into actionable insights and sharing the same with relevant
Audience

Ensure new business requirements are thoroughly vetted and signed off
Knowledge sharing within the team and outside if required

Description:
IMMEDIATE JOINERS || 4-7 years || Pune / Bengaluru

Roles & Responsibilities:
As a member of the CLE ADB Productization the associate will be responsible for development and maintenance of Live Procedures handled by SAF team.
The Procedure Expert needs the skill set required to support a range of SAP systems including ABAP, Java stack, Non-NetWeaver systems. The associate would be responsible to Plan / Validate / Maintain the Procedures according to the ECS standard and sometimes non-standard procedures as requested by the stakeholder.
Associate will be majorly responsible for
Monitor the Procedure execution and identify the task errors and reason
Get feedback from Delivery Team, SEO and Service Owners and identify scope of Procedure enhancement.
Prepare and maintain the Task failure analysis report and track ‘First time Success Rate’.
Propose solution and suggest modification in Procedure by discussing with PO’s.
Drive the procedure enhancement by coordinate with developers / SEO / PO / Developer.
Coordinate with developers and support them with required inputs.
Perform Validation and report the issues encountered while running the procedures in VLAB environment with the concerned procedure owner to ensure the issue doesn’t reoccur in PROD Environment.
Sharing the feedback of the Task documentation if unclear or needs to be modified
First level of issue analysis encountered in the procedure by troubleshooting the underlying procedure along with the PO by understanding the basic ECS architecture, newly released features of the tools involved etc
Support Delivery colleagues in case of Procedure failure and propose immediate work around
Proactive follow-up on the tickets created for the issues encountered
Knowledge sharing within the team and with larger audience of the technical and process aspects
Maintaining documentation of the above deliverables
Expectations and Tasks:
Understand the SAF Basis Team functioning and process model.
Knowledge ECS support tools - LVM, SPC, JIRA, CRT , Customer Launch Pad ,Service Now, TIC and Etc.
Develop a deep understanding of the Enterprise Cloud solution architecture and productization model along with the tools within 6-8 months of onboarding.
Associate should be capable of delivering the targets in Scope of work however is not limited to it solely
Know the point of contact in each team for issue resolution
Capable to independently troubleshoot, reproduce, determine the root cause for repetitive issues
Other General OPO support activities include
Handling of Run procedure automation failure with PO/SEO/SMEs
Good understanding of the service lifecycle and deep idea on the automation cycles
Basic understanding of Landscape Virtualization Manager is needed
Work Experience:
Strong Basis knowledge (ABAP, JAVA, non-NetWeaver etc) with experience in Installations and migrations.
Knowledge of HANA and Linux is a must
Knowledge of High-Availability scenarios especially Pacemaker (SLES and RHEL)
Knowledge of various OS/DB combinations and related troubleshooting is desirable
Associate must have a very strong desire to keep up to date with technical developments in basis, DB and Server management area within ECS Delivery and SAP
Commitment to detailed planning, documentation and quality assurance processes, especially change control, which will support the timely implementation of enhancements to the server environment whilst maintaining the highest levels of operational service
High levels of self-motivation and focus to work with the minimum of supervision and deliver against agreed targets
Strong customer service awareness to keep the customers’ requirements constantly in mind and ensure that activities align closely with these requirements
Hands-on or know-how of Migration and different types of Migration ( OS/DB).
Skills and Competencies:

Full SAP life-cycle experience using HANA, DB2 database (Desirable) technologies
Strong hold on SAP NetWeaver 7 or higher
Good experience on Basis, OS and DB flavors
Minimum 2 years specialist technical skill in one or more SAP areas (5+ Years recommend)
Minimum 2 years’ experience with Pacemaker based SAP Solutions
Proven SAP experience running on HANA (must), DB2 (desirable) platforms
Migration Experiece
Strong Communication skills, project management skills
I od team playerI

About the Role
Were building and growing our hyperlocal (on-demand) logistics business within Delhivery, and are for someone who can take ownership from day zero acquiring customers, shaping the GTM motion, and building a repeatable revenue engine.
You will operate as a full-stack sales owner — from identifying opportunities within SMEs and enterprises to closing deals and ensuring long-term account success. The role requires a mix of hunting (acquisition) and farming (growth & retention), with a strong bias toward building from scratch.

What You’ll Do
Own the end-to-end sales cycle: prospecting pitching closing account growth for leads with monthly wallet potential of 5L to 10L
Acquire and onboard SMEs and enterprise customers onto Delhivery’s hyperlocal logistics platform
Build a strong pipeline through outbound efforts, partnerships, and market mapping
Work closely with operations to ensure a seamless fulfillment experience for customers while providing top-notch customer assistance
Drive account expansion and retention, identifying upsell/cross-sell opportunities
Develop a deep understanding of customer supply chains and last-mile needs
Contribute to GTM strategy, pricing inputs, and product feedback as an early member of the business
Lay the foundation for scaling this business line and becoming a trusted + reliable logistics partner for our customers
Who We’re Looking For
2–5 years of experience in B2B sales, with a strong focus on acquisition-led roles
Prior experience in logistics, on-demand delivery, or supply chain platforms
Strong exposure to both SME and enterprise sales
Hands-on experience with solution selling (not just transactional sales)
High ownership mindset — comfortable operating in 0-1 environments
Strong understanding of last-mile logistics, fulfillment challenges, and operational nuances

What Makes This Role Different
You’re not inheriting a book of business — you’re building it
Direct impact on shaping a new vertical within Delhivery
Opportunity to scale into a larger role as the business grows

At Xoriant, we are looking for a skilled IntelliMatch / SQL Developer to support reconciliation technology and operations within the financial services domain. SUMMARY
Job Title: International Recruiter
Location: Bangalore
Industry: Recruitment/Staffing
Job Description
Global Talent Square (GTS), a venture of 2COMS Consulting Pvt. Ltd., is hiring enthusiastic and motivated candidates to join its Australia Recruitment Team in Bengaluru. We welcome both freshers who want to start their careers in recruitment and experienced professionals with recruitment, talent sourcing, candidate management, or sales experience. The ideal candidate should have strong communication skills, a proactive attitude, and an interest in international recruitment and talent acquisition.
Key Responsibilities
Source candidates through job portals, LinkedIn, databases, and other channels.
Screen resumes and assess candidates based on job requirements.
Contact candidates, explain job opportunities, and evaluate their suitability.
Coordinate interviews with clients and internal teams.
Follow up with candidates throughout the recruitment process.
Maintain candidate databases, recruitment trackers, and hiring reports.
Work towards recruitment targets and hiring deadlines.
Understand international job requirements and communicate them clearly to candidates.
Build positive relationships with candidates and recruitment partners.
Explain job opportunities and recruitment processes professionally.

Requirements
Freshers are welcome to apply. For experienced candidates, a minimum of 1 year of experience in international recruitment is required.
Strong verbal and written communication skills.
Good interpersonal skills and confidence in speaking with candidates.
Interest in recruitment, talent acquisition, or international hiring.
Good coordination, follow-up, and organisational skills.
Proactive attitude and willingness to learn.
Target-oriented mindset and ability to manage multiple tasks.
Sales aptitude and ability to explain opportunities convincingly.
AboutCompany: 2COMS Consulting Pvt. Ltd. is a Recruitment and staffing solutions company established in 1999 in Kolkata with branches in Pune, Hyderabad & Bhubaneshwar. 2COMS focuses on verticals like KPO, BPO, IT, Insurance, Banking.

Associate will be responsible for ensuring completion of delivery of day-to-day transactions and activities within the Record-to-Report (R2R) function/process, (for e.g., GL Accounting, Period End Close, Reporting, etc.)

Performance and day-to-day delivery of R2R processes, sub-processes, activities, and transactions enteries

GL Accounting

Cost Allocation

Period End Close, Reporting

Management and tracking of the close checklist
Perform reconciliations, including BS reconciliations

Preparing financial statements
Participate in month-end close
Internal Controls
SOX Reporting
SOX & risk compliance activities
Prepare IFRS internal and group regulatory reporting
Manage activities across fixed assets, inter-company, bank reconciliations
Experience in preparation of SOPs and managing SLAs
Provide necessary documentation and reports for financial reporting.
Ensure compliance with company policies, accounting principles, and relevant regulations.
Stay informed about changes in accounting standards and best practices in R2R function
Support Team Lead (as required) in areas such as:
Operational Excellence
Process Improvements
Reporting
Client Management / Escalations

Own project timelines and quality standards. Deliver valuations on schedule and in compliance with CBRE's quality frameworks.
Build and maintain client relationships to secure repeat business and identify upsell opportunities.
Provide asset-specific insights and market knowledge to clients. Translate technical valuations into clear, actionable recommendations.
Lead active involvement in valuation discussions and finalization with regional teams across North, South, East, and West India.
Review all reports for content quality and compliance with CBRE standards before client delivery.
Lead or support VALEX innovation initiatives that drive automation and improve team efficiency.
Identify opportunities to standardize processes, reduce manual work, and implement new valuation tools.


Required Qualifications
To succeed in this role, you must bring:

A minimum of 5 years of hands-on experience in real estate valuation within India.
Proven track record valuing core assets (office, retail, warehousing, hospitality, residential) across multiple Indian cities.
Strong financial modeling and analysis skills; comfort with DCF, income approach, and comparable sales analysis.
Demonstrated ability to manage multiple stakeholders and complex projects with competing priorities.
Clear communication skills; ability to explain valuation methodologies and findings to non-technical clients.
Educational background in civil engineering, real estate, architecture, or a related field (B.Tech, M.Tech, or equivalent).


Desired Qualifications

MRICS (Royal Institution of Chartered Surveyors) or equivalent professional certification.
Experience in REIT and InvIT valuations across key metros.
Familiarity with CBRE's valuation processes, tools, or technology platforms.
Prior experience managing a small team or mentoring junior valuers.
Background in capital markets transactions or investment advisory.
Willingness to travel across regions for client meetings and team coordination.

Key Competencies

Success in this role requires a blend of technical expertise and leadership skills:

Valuation Mastery : Core technical expertise in DCF modeling, market research, and comparable analysis for multiple asset classes.

Project Management: Ability to juggle multiple portfolios, meet strict deadlines, and coordinate across distributed teams.

Client Relationship Management : Proven ability to build trust, manage expectations, and convert engagements into long-term partnerships.

Analytical Thinking : Comfort with complex real estate datasets, spotting trends, and translating numbers into strategic insights.

Collaboration: Works effectively with regional teams, senior leadership, and external stakeholders; no siloed mentality.

Adaptability : Open to learning new technologies, valuation approaches, and market dynamics; willing to upskill continuously.

Communication: Can articulate complex financial concepts in clear, jargon-free language for diverse audiences


Your Impact on VALEX

The VALEX team is CBRE's centralized excellence unit for real estate valuations. As a Project Lead, you will:
Drive consistency in valuation standards across all 400+ team members and multiple regions.
Identify bottlenecks in current delivery workflows and champion automation initiatives.
Move beyond regional expertise. Coordinate pan-India complexity. This breadth is rare and globally marketable
Mentor junior team members on best practices, portfolio management, and client engagement.
Serve as a subject matter expert on specific asset classes and geographies.
Contribute to the continuous improvement culture that underpins VALEX's mission.
Build a skill set that makes you invaluable: master every Indian asset class, become fluent in REIT/InvIT structuring, develop advanced modeling skills and lead teams.

Learning and Growth

This role offers deep opportunity for professional development. You'll be expected to stay current on:

Advanced financial modeling techniques and emerging valuation methodologies.
Real estate market dynamics, sector trends, and macroeconomic factors affecting India's asset classes.
CBRE's proprietary tools, technology platforms, and analytics dashboards.
Team leadership and mentoring skills to support junior professionals.
Automation and workflow optimization to reduce manual workload and improve efficiency.

Why Join CBRE VALEX?

Work with India's most sophisticated real estate portfolios across REITs, funds, and institutional investors.
Be part of a high-performing centralized team focused on innovation, consistency, and excellence.
Access to world-class training, CBRE's global knowledge, and leading technology platforms.
Clear career path: grow your technical expertise, build team leadership capabilities, and move into senior roles.
A culture of continuous learning; CBRE invests in upskilling and professional certifications.
Collaborative, multi-regional environment with exposure to diverse asset classes and market geographies.

Description:
Role & responsibilities
Title Store Manager
Reporting to Area Operations Manager
Skip Level City/Zonal Manager
About the Role
A Store Manager at Lenskart acts as an important link between strategy and execution. He/she drives the store towards achieving all assigned metrics of Store Sales, Conversions, Customer satisfaction etc. and is responsible for keeping a high level of morale among the store staff, developing them, controlling attrition, and ensuring smooth operations at the store.
Responsibilities
Area

Activities expected to be performed by a Lenskart Store Manager
Customer focus:
Driving Net
Promoter Score

Greeting customers when they enter store and coaching the team to do the same
Displaying commitment towards providing exceptional Customer Service and ensuring that Lenskart associates also treat Customer Satisfaction as a priority
Dealing with customer service issues such as queries and complaints at store level and ensuring this is consistent with the team
Striving to have long lasting and fruitful relationships with each of our customers
Driving sales vs.
plan

Driving the sales of the store to meet the allotted targets by allocating the targets to the staff
Developing a culture of high sales performance expectations, i.e. Sales Leadership
Motivating and inspiring the field team to drive for results
Assessing field capability and establish performance priorities at group level
People development
(Attrition
Control)

Assisting in recruiting and selecting high potential staff
Providing effective on-the-job training and guidance to team members making use of company training modules
Delivering clear, motivating and constructive feedback in a timely manner to all retail associates
Evaluating the training needs of store associates and working closely with L&D department to execute the developmental plan
Understanding the reasons for attrition and taking measures to control it
Cash & Inventory management

Monitoring cash reconciliation to ensure there is no mismatch of store funds
Ensuring availability of required merchandise and services
Conducting stocktakes regularly
Ensuring the staff at store level has basic understanding of POS System to ensure transactions are properly and effectively processed
Performing the necessary quality checks for the new products
Working very closely with other departments till the product reaches the customer and ensuring the best customer experience to the Lenskart Customer
Supervision

Ensuring that all store employees, including the Optometrist, are taken care of and their issues are resolved
Ensuring that the eye check-ups are conducted as per the SOP and maintain high quality standards
Preferred candidate profile :
Candidate should has to 4 to 10 Years of Experience in store managing

Perks and benefits
ESI and PF
Family insurance policy
Incentive policy : Daily - weekends - monthly - festival incentive program.
Professional Training : 25 Days training in Bangalore post selection in Lenskart Academy .

Description:
Job Summary:
Under minimal supervision and in accordance with Cummins Delegation of Authority Policy, determines the quantity and order date for materials needed to meet the master production schedule or independent customer demand. Expedites purchase or production orders as appropriate.
Key Responsibilities:
Health, Safety & Environmental (HSE) Reports any work-related injury, illness, incident or hazard. Complies with HSE standards, policies, procedures & regulations. Engages in HSE training. Quality Follows applicable standard work, process documentation, and quality procedures. Performs quality checks on material planning master data (lead time, order quantities, etc. ) taking action to support Plan for Every Part (PFEP). Works with Quality to disposition non-conforming material in a timely manner. Delivery Initiates purchase and work orders to support the demand plan. Participates on allocation calls with Sourcing Manager, supplier, and other Cummins entities to understand nature and impact of constraints. Works with suppliers to reduce lead time and order quantities balancing supply with demand. Collaborates with Supply Chain Planners across the organization to reposition excess inventory to locations with supporting demand. Provides accurate, timely updates specific to inventory availability and back order recovery plans. Manages part change requests and ramp up / ramp down activities to meet demand while minimizing excess and obsolete inventory. Reconciles order boards for critical suppliers, critical parts, and past due orders on a routine basis. Supports the Deliver Supplier Improvement Process initiative to improve performance metrics. Documents, communicates, and follows-up on action items impacting the ability to execute the plan. Takes ownership and accountability for delivery of supplier schedules that supports end Customer needs. Demonstrates the target level of proficiency in core competencies. Remains flexible and performs other miscellaneous duties, as required, to meet business goals. Teamwork Communicates effectively within the assigned team and with all support teams. Completes training and personal development in line with business requirements and career goals. Participates in improvement (quality, safety, process, material flow, etc. ) projects.
Drive end-to-end supply chain performance by ensuring superior customer service, achieving Customer On-Time Delivery (OTD) targets, managing order fulfillment processes, optimizing trading supply chain operations, and implementing functional excellence through system-driven planning and continuous improvement initiatives.
Key Responsibilities

1. Customer OTD & Customer Service
Ensure achievement of Customer OTD targets for internal and external customers.
Monitor customer demand, order fulfillment status, and service level performance.
Coordinate with Production, Procurement, Warehousing, and Logistics teams to ensure timely deliveries.
Analyze delivery performance and implement corrective actions to improve customer satisfaction.
Proactively manage supply risks to minimize customer service disruptions.

2. Order Management
Manage the complete order-to-delivery process.
Review customer orders, prioritize requirements, and ensure accurate order execution.
Monitor backlog orders and expedite critical customer requirements.
Ensure timely order confirmation, scheduling, invoicing, and dispatch coordination.
Resolve order-related issues through cross-functional collaboration.

3. Trading Supply Chain Management
Plan and manage trading product procurement and replenishment.
Coordinate with suppliers and distribution teams to maintain optimum inventory levels.
Monitor stock availability and prevent shortages or excess inventory.
Drive supplier performance improvement initiatives to ensure uninterrupted supply.
Manage inventory health, working capital, and product availability.

4. Functional Excellence
Lead continuous improvement initiatives across SCM processes.
Develop and implement standard operating procedures (SOPs).
Drive Lean, process optimization, and cost reduction projects.
Monitor key KPIs and implement actions for sustained performance improvement.
Support digital transformation and best-practice deployment across the organization.

5. System-Driven Planning
Utilize ERP, ASCP, and planning systems to drive data-based decision-making.
Maintain planning master data and planning parameters.
Improve forecast accuracy, material planning, and inventory optimization through system-generated recommendations.
Develop dashboards and reports to support planning reviews and business decisions.
Ensure effective adoption of digital tools, automation, and planning processes.
Key Competencies
Supply Chain Planning & Execution
Customer Focus
Order Management
ERP / ASCP Knowledge
Data Analytics & Reporting
Inventory Optimization
Cross-Functional Collaboration
Problem Solving & Decision Making
Continuous Improvement Mindset
Agility, Accountability, and Ownership
Competencies:
Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.

Customer focus - Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions.

Drives results - Consistently achieving results, even under tough circumstances.

Manages complexity - Making sense of complex, high quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to effectively solve problems.

Optimizes work processes - Knowing the most effective and efficient processes to get things done, with a focus on continuous improvement.

Materials Planning System Utilization - Uses the materials planning system to manage supply and demand plans taking long-term corrective action on exception messages and other alerts based on root cause analysis; occasionally refers to adhoc tools such as Excel, Access, TOAD, OMS, etc. in performing problem solving, while leveraging the materials planning system as the primary tool in day-to-day operations.

Part Change Control Management - Evaluates and implements engineering change request (obsolescence, supersessions, new part release, etc. ) to meet customer delivery requirements while minimizing excess and obsolete inventory.

Plan for Every Part (PFEP) - Uses PFEP in planning, designing, and management of systems and processes within a facility to ensure delivery of right part at the right time in the right quantity to the right place, which in turn guarantees smooth operations; applies PFEP principles on the end to end supply chain with particular attention to the relationships between master data management, materials planning parameters, engineered material flows, transport management, and warehouse management.

Master Supply Scheduling - Establishes and maintains a valid Master Production Schedule for a family of products, which meets customer s expectations and requirements while maximizing operational efficiency; validates procurement scheduling, production scheduling, and replenishment planning are aligned to manufacturing and assembly assets for conversion.

Materials KPI Management - Operates in relation to recent or historical outputs as compared to expectations of the organization to determine next steps to drive improvement; assesses gaps to the supply chain performance against the expectation of achieving target deliverables; interprets KPIs to understand end-customer impact; strategically balances trade-offs to influence one KPI while minimizing the impact to others.

Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.

Education, Licenses, Certifications:
High school diploma or certificate of completion of secondary education or equivalent experience to the extent such experience meets applicable regulations.

College, University or equivalent degree in Business, Engineering, or related field preferred.
This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.

Experience:
Requires significant relevant work experience or specialized skills obtained through education, training, or on-the-job experience in an equivalent field such as materials planning, production scheduling, manufacturing, or inventory control.
