Description:
Profile Summary
Our Area Operations Manager is responsible for developing and expanding the business in the respective area and managing the store operations across the respective area thereby increasing the customer experience.
Key Responsibilities
Driving Sales and Customer Service
a. Driving and ensuring to meet or exceed the sales plan of the respective territory monthly/ quarterly and annually
b. Driving and focusing on providing the customer services thereby increasing the Net Promoter Score (NPS) for the store
c. Drive culture of high sales performance expectations, i.e. SALES Leadership
d. Motivates and inspires field team to drive for results.
e. Review financial performance at regional level to identify improvement opportunities.
f. Serve as critical strategy planning link between Corporate and the field organization.
g. Translate corporate goals including financial returns, sales growth and market share, into business plans.
h. Assess field capability and establish performance priorities at group level.
Manpower Planning & People Development
a. Working with the HR team and the Store Manager in ensuring staffing levels are adequate to effectively operate the store
b. Direct responsibility for professional development of Lenskart Associates
c. Assess and prioritize advanced management skill gaps including those related to design and implementation of business plans, forecasts, financial analysis, associate development and communication.
d. Conduct two-way, formal and informal performance evaluations of Lenskart Associates which review professional development needs and accomplishments as well as overall achievement of management objectives
e. Responsible for establishing a culture that embraces diversity and maximizes the learnings from a diverse team.
f. Overall responsibility for associate development
Managing P&L of the Assigned Stores
a. Responsible for managing and maintaining territory and store budgets to ensure profitability at store as well as territory level
b. Managing the top and bottom line effectively of the assigned territory and stores
c. Responsible for reducing shrinkage
d. Managing the productivity of the staff
e. Using cost effective methods to ensure productivity of the respective territory
Managing and Maintaining High Standards of Retail Operations
a.Regular Store Visits to:
Audit stores
Coaching the Store Managers
Motivate staff through sales discussions
Check VM, stock availability
Check store hygiene, grooming
Assess discipline levels in store opening times, staff attendance, process adherence etc.
b. Analyze data before Store Visits
Monitoring Sales through data.
Assessing the productivity and achievements of the stores
Store Staffing levels.
Product flow, supply, demand and shrinkage.
NPS and MC scores
Reviewing measures to achieve performance targets
a.Bridge communication between Management and floor
Recommending changes to ZM/BH basis visits.
Ensure Timely reporting of Data when needed.
Implementing and enforcing company regulations
Implement process change
Attending conferences, events and meetings at regional as well as corporate level to enhance knowledge and skill sets
Inventory Management
a. Ensures availability of required merchandise and services at each of the assigned stores
b. Ensuring that inventory levels are well balanced and making key decisions about inventory control at each of the assigned stores
c. Ensuring physical verification of inventory on regular intervals is being conducted at each of the assigned stores
d. Ensuring the staff at store level has basic understanding of POS System to ensure transactions are properly and effectively processed
e. Ensuring necessary quality checks for the new products is being conducted in a timely manner
f. Responsible for reducing shrinkage at store level
g. Working very closely with various departments in the organization till the product reaches the customer and ensuring the best customer experience to the Lenskart Customer
Key Personal and Professional Attributes:
a) Collaborative Skills: The role requires the incumbent to work closely and coordinate with the Internal and external teams to create success. S/he should be able to seamlessly navigate these relationship dynamics in a high growth, young, agile business environment.
b) Functional understanding: The role is critical for the business performance and would require the incumbent to create a competitive business advantage. It would be critical to analyze the effectiveness of the processes on a day to day basis and course correct.
c) Data driven/ Analytical: The role is required to drive specific process efficiency metrics and would be accountable to drive data-driven decision making.
d) Results oriented: The role is required to work on deliver on daily numbers, short-term goals and long-term milestones set by business and efficacy. Meeting these milestones would be critical to create success.
e) Extroverted Personality
f) Pleasant & Friendly who can be easily approached
g) Pragmatic Leaders who are self -motivated and resilient
h) Passionate
i) Energetic
j) Positive Attitude
k) Ability to handle stressful situations
l) Problem Solving & Decision Making
m) Assertive
n) Sales Driven & Number Oriented Team player
Candidate Profile:
a) Full Time Post Graduate with 7-9 years of relevant experience into retail industry
b) Post-Graduation is a must
c) Very strong communication skills- both written and verbal and must be a good orator
d) Should have hands on experience working on Microsoft Office- Including Excel, PPT & Word
e) Strong inter-personal skills (friendly, caring & patient)
f) Sales oriented
g) Strong Management/leadership skills.
h) Strong organizational skills.
i) Strong team builder
Required Managerial Competencies
People Management
a) Mentors team members and colleagues; guides them with regard to development and career progression.
b) Clearly communicates work responsibilities and expectations and takes steps to balance the workload among team members.
c) Anticipates the effect of an action on other people and modifies such action accordingly.
d) Resolves conflicts among colleagues in just and fair manner
Proactive Problem Solving Skills
a) Anticipates problems before they develop, and takes steps to avert them.
b) Considers a situation from multiple perspectives before deciding on a course of action.
c) Adept at managing the flow of information in times of crisis.
d) Appeals to reason, facts, and figures and adapts managerial style based on the demands of the situation
Commercial Savviness
a) Protects the commercial interests of the company with the aim of maximizing revenue.
b) Takes appropriate business decisions after performing a cost-benefit analysis and pre-empts problems and resolves them, ensuring minimal business loss.
c) Builds and manages workforce based on organizational goals and budget constraints
Customer Expectation Management
a) Adept at balancing the interests of the company with the needs and expectations of the client/customer
b) Responds deliberately and diplomatically to protect company interests
c) Communicates effectively about sensitive matters and influences the client/customer when required
Planning and Organizing
a) Adept at prioritization and time management to ensure efficient and timely completion of assignments
b) Manages and shifts priorities as required and incorporates new approaches
c) Delegates work effectively among team members
Required Personality Traits
a) Extraversion - The trait is marked by pronounced engagement with the external world. Extraverts enjoy interacting with people, and are often perceived as full of energy. They tend to be enthusiastic, action-oriented individuals. They possess high group visibility, like to talk, and assert themselves
b) Conscientiousness- It is a tendency to display self-discipline, act dutifully, and strive for achievement against measures or outside expectations. It is related to the way in which people control, regulate, and direct their impulses. High scores on conscientiousness indicate a preference for planned rather than spontaneous behavior
c) Openness to Experience- Openness is a general appreciation for art, emotion, adventure, unusual ideas, imagination, curiosity, and variety of experience. People who are open to experience are intellectually curious, open to emotion, sensitive to beauty and willing to try new things. They tend to be, when compared to closed people, more creative and more aware of their feelings
d) Agreeableness- The agreeableness trait reflects individual differences in general concern for social harmony. Agreeable individuals value getting along with others. They are generally considerate, kind, generous, trusting and trustworthy, helpful, and willing to compromise their interests with others.
e) Polychronicity- it is defined as a continuum, and preferences for degrees of engagement. At one extreme is the pattern of focusing on one task at a time, interpreting other potential tasks and events as interruptions and attempting to shield one's chosen task from such interference. The other extreme is actually open-ended, it involves engagement in several tasks simultaneously, sometimes literally simultaneously and sometimes in a frequent back-and-forth engagement pattern
f) Emotional Stability- People high on emotional stability do not tend to have a negative outlook of the future and hence are usually calmer. Persons who score low in emotional stability generally have a fearful and negative disposition, with an ominous foreboding about things.

Description:
You, as an Area Manager, play a critical role to lead diverse teams at store level who are in turn responsible in providing the best customer experience to Lenskart customers as well as revenue generation. You are the facilitator of growth, responsible to build vision & business strategies to achieve sales, customer experience, and other organisational goals by investing in people through regular coaching.
We are looking for enthusiastic & pragmatic leaders with strong inclination towards customer centricity, sales, digital mind-set, and people leadership. On a typical day, you would be spending your time at the stores in your area, helping the team deliver on the strategy, coaching them and helping remove road-blocks.
Key Responsibilities:
Sales Leadership:
- Developing & driving sales strategy for your area & team with focus on revenue goals.
- Driving the rigor to deliver world-class customer experience at the store, thereby increasing the Net Promoter Score (NPS) for the store and reducing detractors
- Drive high performance culture in your area across the metrics mentioned above
- Assessing business and performance trends regularly & build improvement opportunities.
- Serve as critical strategy planning link between Corporate and the field organization.
- Translate corporate goals including financial returns, sales growth and market share, into
Business plans.
- Assess field capability and establish performance priorities at group level.
People leadership:
- Partnership with Store Managers & HR team to make sure stores are adequately staffed.
- Leading leaders, coaching and developing future talent
- Assess & bridge skill gaps including those related to implementation of business plans, forecasts, financial analysis, associate development and communication
- Formal & Informal performance management for store managers they are responsible for
- Responsible for establishing a culture that embraces diversity and maximizes the learnings from
a diverse team.
- Retain talent -> Reduce attrition
Organizational leadership:
- Solely responsible for managing and maintaining territory and store budgets to ensure profitability at the area level
- Managing the top and bottom line effectively of the assigned territory and stores
- Responsible for overall operational effectiveness of stores on areas such as shrinkage, capacity, productivity, growth, attrition.
- Build creative & cost effective methods to ensure productivity while managing high standards of retail operations.

Description:
About the Role
The role of Cluster Optometrist at Lenskart revolves around a combination of a perfect blend of optometry and optical retail. He/she plays a pivotal role in upskilling the front end retail staff on the professional optometry grounds. They are responsible to deliver the best customer experience by leading the example in driving the key business metrics with their optometric approach. Their key deliverable in business includes maintenance of eye test quality and dispensing standards throughout as per Lenskart norms.
Responsibilities
Store Visit
Must visit assigned stores in Lenskart uniform and manage the complete Technical and Functional part of Lenskart stores

In Store Duty
Act as a Mentor and Coach to Fresher Optometrists. Help them with Sales Pitch, Technical Dispensing Guidance, Troubleshooting, Customer Query Handling etc.
Must also work as a store optometrist during busy hours, high sale days or to cover shifts of those who are on leave. Check eye test, QC drawers, Wooqer entries, CL expiry, merchandise, Instrument calibration, KMT products etc.
To ensure the Store NPS is achieved by training, troubleshooting, tracking detractor and lead by example
Manpower
To welcome new talent from market, conduct interview and on board. Initiation Prepare and conduct meetings with respective AOMs to discuss reviews, performance or proposals
Training
For new staff - Undertake regular reviews, analyse SOPs such as eye test, quality check, dispensing, contact lens, troubleshoot, deliver to measure the impact of training on store performance. Identify and Train the Store staff to help them achieve their goals
Audit
Periodically audit their eye test and dispensing performance
Team Leader
Wear multiple hats of Team leader, Bench, Senior, Consultant Optometrist to support store team
Revenue
Maximise In-Store Revenue through Optometrists through continuous training, periodic reviews, increasing number of eye tests done at store and reducing returns
Team Work
Work as a member of Business Team to accomplish goals and objectives. Participate in regional, departmental, executive, operational meeting as appropriate
Documentation
Maintain documentation and Report daily to PS regional manager on store visit summary
Working Hours
Same as store shift and as per business needs. Must work on weekends and public holidays to support store business
Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification - Diploma in Optometry with minimum 3 years of retail experience and a good track record
Good Knowledge in Optometry, Refraction, Eye Wear Products, Dispensing and Measurements
Must be ready to travel anywhere in India as per Business requirements
Passionate about Sales, Retail, Customer service and Training
Good understanding of market and product analysis
Must have leadership qualities such as - lead by example, coaching, motivating, great communication and never give up attitude
Energy, influence, 10 x think entrepreneur mind-set etc

Job Summary
The role will be responsible to drive sales and customer acquisition for home loan and mortgage products, and contribute to the organizations revenue growth through direct sourcing and strategic networking. Position description: The Business Manager is responsible for driving business growth and managing relationships within the assigned area, while also servicing existing clients
Primary Responsibilities:
1. Ensure 100% achievement of assigned business targets (volume and value).2. Identify new business prospects and areas through market initiatives such as leafleting, canopy activities, and direct sourcing.3. Ensure timely and accurate preparation and submission of MIS reports related to sourcing, disbursement, audits, and operational pendency.12. Follow proper procedures for handling and movement of property documents and customer files in coordination with the central operations team.

Area Activities expected to be performed by a Lenskart Optometrist
Greeting and welcoming all walk-in customers and guiding them toward the clinic to promote the

Driving Net
Promoter Score free eye check-up

Eye check-up & Sharing the prescription clearly and educating the customer about single vision and progressive

maintenance Ensuring the security of all Lenskart equipment and that there is no shortage of stock units or
damage in the storePersonal attributes & competencies

Description:
Bill Processing & Liability Statement
Daily Bills Receiving from Stores, Planning & QS Dept for Sub-Cons, Hire Bills from P&M, Admin Bills from HR& Admin etc and preparing the CAS Trackers along with Scanning the Bills etc. Forward the same to CAS Dept on Weekly Basis
Liability Statement Preparation, First Level Verifications at Site and discussions with Project Head on Listing the Priorities for payments, obtain the Sign-off from the Project head etc on Monthly basis and keep updating the same as and when required to match the funds inflows/outflows and coordination with CCO for Liabilities and payments
All Bills & Payments are bifurcated as below
Subcontractor Bills
Hire Machinery Bills
Purchase Bills
Overhead related Bills (incl. Pay Roll Related)
Compliances ( PF, ESI, PT, IT TDS & GST etc)
EMIs for Vehicles , P&M etc.
Payments for LC / BG related commitments

Fund Management:
Fund Proposal preparation and submitting to HO
Monitoring Omini card Payments
Preparation of Monthly Liability Statement and submission to HO
Preparation and submission of Fund utility statement
Business development related expenses monitoring

Bank Related : Bank Book Maintenance for Project Specific Loans

Inventory Monitoring:
Monitoring of Major Materials
3-Way Match of Material bills
Participation in for Physical Stock Verification

Other Responsibilities
Not limited but suggested

GST ITC reconciliation with the Accounts ITC receivable
Monthly Closing of Books of Accounts for the Projects
Payment updates
Branch Reco updates & completion of Accounting Entries
Supporting the Statutory Audits, JV ABS Functions as and when required
Tracking Monthly Overheads
Coordinate with cross-functional teams to ensure timely completion of assigned tasks
MIS Report Preparation

Description:
Job Summary
State Operation - Manager
Full Time/ Arunachal Pradesh, Jharkhand and Andra Pradesh /Immediate
State Operations Manager will be responsible for leading, coordinating, and monitoring the implementation of the program in partnership with the State Rural Livelihood Mission (SRLM) at the state level. This role will ensure effective collaboration with state, district, and block-level teams, build the capacities of stakeholders, and drive alignment with program objectives. The position will serve as the key link between the organization, SRLM, and other stakeholders, ensuring timely execution, quality outcomes, and comprehensive documentation for reporting and knowledge management.
Roles & Responsibilities
Foster and maintain strong partnerships with the State Rural Livelihood Mission (SRLM) and other key stakeholders.
Lead and oversee program implementation across the state, ensuring timely execution, quality delivery, and effective monitoring of activities.
Provide capacity-building support to SRLM teams at state, district, and block levels.
Facilitate collaboration with government departments, community institutions, and other stakeholders to achieve program objectives.
Drive effective internal and external communication to ensure alignment and transparency.
Develop, review, and maintain comprehensive program documentation, progress reports, and IEC materials.
Skills and Competencies
Proven experience in program implementation, monitoring, and reporting
Ability to coordinate with government stakeholders, community institutions
Strong understanding of rural development and livelihood promotion
Strong leadership and team management abilities
Effective stakeholder engagement and partnership-building skills
Ability to work independently while driving collaboration across multiple levels.
High adaptability and resilience in field-driven environments
We encourage women candidates to apply.

Description:
Role & responsibilities
To provide day-to-day IT support and ensure the smooth functioning of computer systems, network infrastructure, internet connectivity, communication systems, software applications, and IT assets at the project site.
1. IT Support and Troubleshooting
Provide first-level technical support to project employees for hardware, software, and IT-related issues.
Troubleshoot computer, laptop, printer, scanner, and other peripheral-related problems.
Resolve IT issues promptly to minimize disruption to project operations.
2. Hardware and Software Management
Install, configure, and maintain desktops, laptops, printers, scanners, and other IT equipment.
Install and update authorized operating systems, software, and applications.
Maintain records of software licenses, warranties, repairs, and IT equipment.
3. Network and Internet Management
Maintain LAN, Wi-Fi, internet connectivity, and network devices at the project site.
Coordinate with internet service providers and network vendors for connectivity-related issues.
Monitor network performance and ensure reliable connectivity across site offices, project camps, and other designated locations.
4. IT Asset Management
Maintain an updated inventory of IT assets, including computers, laptops, printers, switches, routers, and accessories.
Issue IT assets to employees against proper acknowledgement and maintain asset handover records.
Coordinate the collection of IT assets from employees upon transfer, resignation, or separation.
Track asset repairs, replacements, and movement between locations.
5. Email and User Account Management
Coordinate the creation, configuration, and deactivation of official email IDs and user accounts.
Assist employees with email configuration, password resets, and access-related issues as per company policy.
Ensure timely IT arrangements for new joiners and coordinate asset recovery during employee separation.
6. IT Security and Data Backup
Ensure antivirus installation, security updates, and compliance with company IT policies.
Support data backup activities and assist in data recovery when required.
Protect confidential company information and prevent unauthorized access to systems and data.
Report suspected cyber incidents, malware infections, and security breaches to the IT department.
7. CCTV and Communication Systems
Provide basic technical support for CCTV systems, video conferencing equipment, and IP phones, wherever applicable.
Coordinate with vendors for installation, maintenance, and repair of communication and surveillance systems.
8. Coordination with Head Office
Coordinate with the Corporate / Head Office IT team for system approvals, technical support, software requirements, and infrastructure upgrades.
Follow up on IT-related service requests, purchase approvals, and vendor support.
Ensure implementation of company IT policies and procedures at the project site.
9. Vendor and AMC Coordination
Coordinate with IT vendors for equipment servicing, repairs, and annual maintenance contracts (AMC).
Maintain records of service reports, repair bills, warranties, and vendor visits.
Verify the completion of assigned IT services before forwarding bills for processing.
10. Documentation and Reporting
Maintain IT asset registers, user allocation records, complaint registers, and maintenance logs.
Prepare periodic IT status reports covering asset utilization, pending complaints, network issues, and repair requirements.
Submit IT requirements and expenditure details to the reporting manager for review and approval.
11. Project Site IT Infrastructure
Support IT infrastructure setup for project offices, site offices, construction camps, and temporary office facilities.
Assist in installation of network points, internet connections, printers, and other IT equipment for new workstations.
Ensure IT readiness for new employees, project meetings, and official activities.

Description:
Summary
The Area Sales Manager is a key strategic leader within the solar energy industry, responsible for driving revenue growth and expanding market presence across a defined geographic region. This role focuses on building and managing a high-performing B2B sales team, cultivating relationships with commercial and industrial clients, and executing targeted sales strategies to achieve aggressive quarterly and annual targets. The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in B2B sales within the renewable energy sector, with a proven ability to navigate complex procurement processes, negotiate long-term contracts, and deliver scalable solar solutions. As a critical link between the organization and its enterprise clients, the Area Sales Manager plays a pivotal role in advancing sustainable energy adoption, contributing to corporate sustainability goals, and strengthening the companys position as a leader in the solar industry.

Responsibilities
Develop and execute regional sales strategies aligned with company growth objectives and market opportunities in the solar energy sector.
Lead, mentor, and manage a team of B2B sales representatives, ensuring performance excellence through coaching, goal setting, and regular feedback.
Identify, qualify, and pursue new commercial and industrial B2B prospects, focusing on solar PV system installations for businesses, manufacturing facilities, and institutional clients.
Build and maintain strategic relationships with key decision-makers at enterprise accounts, including facility managers, sustainability officers, and procurement teams.
Collaborate with technical and project development teams to deliver customized solar solutions that meet client energy needs and financial objectives.
Analyze market trends, competitor activity, and customer behavior to refine sales approaches and improve win rates.
Prepare and present detailed proposals, financial models, and ROI analyses to support client decision-making.
Track and report on sales pipeline, forecast accuracy, and KPIs using CRM platforms to ensure transparency and data-driven planning.
Ensure compliance with industry regulations, safety standards, and company policies throughout the sales and project handoff process.

Requirements
Requirements:
Bachelors degree in Business, Engineering, Renewable Energy, or a related field; advanced degree preferred.
Proven experience (5+ years) in B2B sales, with a strong track record of exceeding sales targets in the renewable energy, clean tech, or construction industry.
In-depth knowledge of solar energy systems, including photovoltaic (PV) technology, financing models (PPA, lease, cash purchase), and incentive programs (e.g., ITC, state rebates).
Demonstrated ability to manage complex sales cycles involving multi-stakeholder decision-making and long-term contracts.
Proficiency in CRM software (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot) and Microsoft Office Suite for reporting, forecasting, and client presentations.
Strong negotiation, presentation, and interpersonal skills with the ability to influence at the executive level.
Valid drivers license and willingness to travel extensively within the assigned region.
Experience in team leadership and performance management, including hiring, training, and performance evaluation.
Familiarity with sustainability metrics and ESG reporting is a plus.
Compensation Benefits
Competitive base salary: ${salary}
Performance-based commission and bonus structure
Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance
401(k) plan with company match
Paid time off, holidays, and professional development opportunities
Company-sponsored training in solar technology and sales strategy

Description:
To plan, supervise, and control all mining, quarrying, excavation, drilling, blasting, crushing, and aggregate production activities required for construction of the RCC dam and hydroelectric project, ensuring compliance with approved designs, safety standards, quality requirements, environmental conditions, and statutory regulations.
A. Quarry & Mining Operations
Plan and supervise quarry development and mining operations for construction materials.
Identify and assess suitable sources of rock, aggregates, sand, and other construction materials.
Prepare quarry development plans, extraction plans, and production schedules.
Monitor excavation, bench formation, slope stability, muck handling, and material recovery.
Ensure optimum utilization of available mineral resources and minimize wastage.
B. Drilling & Blasting
Plan and supervise drilling and controlled blasting activities for quarry and excavation works.
Prepare/coordinate blast designs based on geological conditions and project requirements.
Determine drilling patterns, burden, spacing, stemming, charge quantities, and initiation sequence as per approved procedures.
Monitor blasting vibrations, fly-rock, fragmentation, and overbreak.
Coordinate with the safety team and concerned authorities for safe execution of blasting operations.
Maintain records of drilling, explosives consumption, blasting, and production.
C. Dam & Hydro Excavation
Supervise rock excavation and controlled excavation for dam foundation, diversion structures, powerhouse, intake, tunnels, shafts, adits, roads, and other project components.
Coordinate excavation activities with Civil, Geology, Planning, Survey, and QA/QC teams.
Ensure excavation is carried out as per approved drawings, specifications, and geological conditions.
Monitor controlled blasting near critical structures to avoid damage to foundation rock and existing structures.
D. Crushing & Aggregate Production
Coordinate with crushing and screening plant teams for production of aggregates of required sizes and quality.
Monitor production capacity, material feed, crusher performance, screening efficiency, and stockpile management.
Ensure proper segregation and storage of different aggregate sizes.
Coordinate with QA/QC laboratory for testing and approval of aggregates.
E. Geological & Technical Coordination
Work closely with the Geology team to understand rock formations, geological structures, joints, faults, and groundwater conditions.
Assess geological conditions during excavation and recommend suitable excavation/blasting methods.
Assist in identifying unstable zones and implementing appropriate slope stabilization measures.
Review geological observations and incorporate them into mining and excavation plans.
F. Production & Equipment Management
Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly mining/excavation production plans.
Monitor deployment and productivity of drilling rigs, excavators, dumpers, compressors, loaders, and other equipment.
Track excavation quantities, drilling meters, blasting quantities, muck generation, and aggregate production.
Improve equipment utilization and overall productivity.
G. Safety & Statutory Compliance
Ensure mining and blasting activities comply with applicable statutory requirements, approved mining plans, permits, and project safety procedures.
Ensure safe handling, storage, transportation, and accounting of explosives through authorized personnel.
Conduct toolbox meetings and risk assessments for mining and blasting activities.
Monitor quarry slopes, benches, access roads, and working areas for safety risks.
Coordinate with the HSE team for implementation of project safety standards.
H. Documentation & Reporting
Maintain records of drilling, blasting, excavation, quarry production, explosive consumption, and aggregate production.
Prepare daily progress reports and monthly production reports.
Maintain quarry plans, blast records, production statements, and material reconciliation.
Provide technical inputs for project MIS, planning, billing, and cost-control activities.
Experience
6 -10 years of relevant experience in mining/quarrying operations.
Experience in Hydroelectric Projects, RCC/Concrete Dams, tunnelling, major infrastructure projects, quarry development, drilling & blasting, and aggregate production will be preferred.
Experience in large-scale rock excavation and controlled blasting is desirable.

Description:
To lead and manage all environmental activities of the RCC Dam and Hydro Electric Project, ensuring compliance with applicable environmental laws, statutory approvals, project-specific environmental conditions, and contractual requirements. The position will be responsible for environmental planning, monitoring, reporting, mitigation measures, regulatory coordination, and implementation of the project's Environmental Management Plan (EMP).
Key Responsibilities
1. Environmental Compliance & Regulatory Management
Ensure compliance with applicable environmental laws, rules, regulations, permits and statutory requirements.
Monitor compliance with Environmental Clearance (EC) and other applicable environmental permissions and conditions.
Maintain records of statutory approvals, consents, permits and environmental compliance.
Coordinate with regulatory authorities and government departments on environmental matters.
Ensure timely submission of environmental compliance reports and statutory returns.
2. Environmental Management Plan
Develop, implement and periodically review the Environmental Management Plan (EMP) for the project.
Establish environmental procedures and control measures for construction activities.
Ensure implementation of mitigation measures related to air, water, noise, soil, waste, ecology and biodiversity.
Identify environmental risks associated with dam, tunnel, powerhouse, roads, quarry, muck disposal and other project activities.
3. Environmental Monitoring
Establish and monitor environmental parameters including:
Ambient air quality
Water quality
Noise levels
Soil quality
Surface and groundwater
Waste generation and disposal
Dust and emissions
Review environmental monitoring reports and initiate corrective actions wherever required.
Coordinate with NABL/accredited laboratories and environmental consultants, wherever applicable.
4. Construction Environmental Management
Monitor environmental impacts arising from excavation, blasting, concreting, crushing, batching plants, tunnelling, road construction and material transportation.
Ensure proper management of construction debris, muck, hazardous waste and other wastes.
Monitor muck disposal areas and ensure compliance with approved disposal plans.
Ensure proper dust suppression and control of construction-related emissions.
Monitor drainage, erosion and sedimentation control measures.
5. Water & Wastewater Management
Monitor water abstraction, consumption and discharge.
Ensure proper operation and monitoring of sewage treatment and wastewater treatment facilities.
Implement measures for prevention of contamination of rivers, streams and groundwater.
Monitor water conservation and recycling initiatives at project facilities.
6. Biodiversity & Ecological Management
Monitor environmental impacts on forests, wildlife, aquatic ecology and biodiversity, where applicable.
Ensure implementation of approved biodiversity and ecological management measures.
Coordinate with forestry and wildlife authorities wherever required.
Monitor compliance related to compensatory afforestation, catchment-area treatment and other environmental management programmes, where applicable.
7. Quarry, Crusher & Muck Management
Monitor environmental compliance at quarry, crusher, screening and batching plant areas.
Ensure proper control of dust, noise, wastewater and material spillage.
Monitor slope stabilization, drainage and rehabilitation of quarry and disposal areas.
Ensure implementation of approved muck disposal and reclamation measures.
8. Environmental Audits & Inspections
Conduct regular environmental inspections and audits across the project site.
Identify non-compliances and prepare corrective and preventive action plans.
Track closure of environmental observations and maintain compliance registers.
Participate in internal, client, consultant and regulatory environmental audits.
9. Documentation & Reporting
Prepare daily, weekly, monthly and periodic environmental reports.
Maintain environmental registers, monitoring records and compliance documentation.
Prepare presentations and reports for Project Head, Corporate Office, client and statutory authorities.
Maintain records of environmental incidents, corrective actions and regulatory correspondence.
10. Contractor & Subcontractor Management
Ensure contractors and subcontractors comply with project environmental requirements.
Review environmental plans and method statements submitted by contractors.
Conduct contractor environmental inspections and toolbox/training sessions.
Monitor environmental performance of construction agencies and service providers.
11. Environmental Awareness & Training
Conduct environmental awareness programmes for employees, workmen and contractors.
Develop training programmes covering waste management, pollution prevention, water conservation and environmental protection.
Promote good environmental practices across project operations.
12. Incident & Emergency Management
Investigate environmental incidents such as oil/chemical spills, wastewater discharge, pollution and other environmental emergencies.
Develop and implement environmental emergency response procedures.
Ensure immediate containment, reporting, investigation and corrective action.
13. Coordination
Coordinate with Project Head, Construction, Civil, Mechanical, Electrical, QA/QC, EHS, Contracts and other departments.
Liaise with client representatives, consultants, statutory authorities and environmental agencies.
Coordinate with Corporate Environment/EHS team for project-level compliance and reporting.
Key Deliverables
100% compliance with applicable environmental approvals and statutory requirements.
Effective implementation of the Environmental Management Plan.
Timely environmental monitoring and reporting.
Proper management of muck, waste, wastewater and hazardous materials.
Closure of environmental audit observations within agreed timelines.
Prevention and control of environmental pollution.
Timely renewal/maintenance of applicable environmental permissions and consents.
Effective environmental performance of contractors and subcontractors.
Qualification
Bachelor's/Master's Degree in Environmental Engineering, Environmental Science, .
Experience
1215 years of relevant experience, preferably in large infrastructure, Hydro Electric, Dam, Tunnelling, RCC Dam, Power or major construction projects.
Experience in environmental compliance, EC conditions, environmental monitoring and regulatory coordination is preferred.

Description:

Work closely with school complexes in order to support them with their improvement plans and respective resource/additional training support.
Co-lead the training of a cadre of assessors from the government including HMs, CRPs, BRPs and other relevant district officials in the area assigned.
Support the monitoring and evaluation process and communications for the assigned area along with respective districts reporting processes.
Experience and Qualifications
3-4 years of experience working in the field of education
A bachelors/masters degree in education is preferred
Prior classroom teaching experience
Excellent facilitation, collaboration, and communication skills
Genuine passion for transforming education through peer learning and systemic change
Proficiency in using Google Workspace (Sheets, Document, etc.) and creating presentations, reports, etc.

Description:
Geologist Position: Geologist Project: HEO 240 MW Hydro Electric Project Location: Project Site, Arunachal Pradesh Employment Type: Full-time, Site-based Experience Required: 7 to 10 years (Targeting ~7 years) Qualification
M.Sc. in Geology (Mandatory requirement).
Strong theoretical and practical foundation in structural geology, lithostratigraphy, and field mapping techniques.
Experience Overview
Minimum 7 years of post-qualification field experience in geological mapping, surface and subsurface data collection, and geotechnical/rock mass assessments, preferably within large-scale infrastructure, mining, or hydropower projects in complex mountainous regions (such as the Himalayas).
Key Responsibilities
Field Mapping & Face Logging: Conduct rigorous surface and underground geological mapping (rock outcrops, quarry sites, tunnel faces, and dam foundations) and maintain accurate lithological and structural logs.
Structural & Rock Mass Analysis: Measure and analyze structural data (joints, faults, shear zones, dip/strike) and evaluate rock mass quality using standard empirical rating systems to understand ground behavior.
Core Drilling & Logging: Oversee exploratory core drilling programs, perform detailed physical core logging, and systematically collect representative rock and soil samples for laboratory testing.
Geological Hazard Identification: Spot and evaluate potential geological risks early-such as weak zones, active fault lines, unpredicted seepage, or unstable slopes-and provide critical inputs to the project management team.
Data Correlation & Mapping: Correlate surface mapping data with subsurface drilling logs to update geological cross-sections and structural models.
Documentation & Reporting: Maintain comprehensive daily geological records, photographic logs, and technical reports for audits and client reviews.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with civil engineering and site execution teams, serving as the primary authority on ground conditions to help bridge science with construction realities.

Description:
Title Sales Associate
Reporting to Store Manager
Skip Level Areas Operations Manager
About the Role
Sales Associate is responsible for providing the best customer experience in the stores by providing high standards of selling services to Lenskart customers. He/she plays a pivotal role in driving the revenue achieved by the store.
Responsibilities Area Activities expected to be performed by a Lenskart Sales Associate
Customer focus
Sales Associate is expected to greet and welcome all walk-in customers and guide them toward the clinic, promoting the free eye check-up
He/she will be involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day tasks to deliver the best shopping experience to the customers
He/she must possess a basic understanding of the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively
He/she must be dedicated to customer satisfaction and must go beyond his means to resolve any concerns that the customer has
Product recommendation
With the information received from the Optometrist and the customer, he/she will present the customer with an optimal selection of products. This opportunity may be used to strike a conversation and convert it into sales
He/she is expected to understand the unstated needs of the customer, ask relevant questions, and pick the right time to pitch the recommended solutions
Achieving sales targets & SOP adherence
Sales Associate is expected to achieve the assigned target for sales, eye-test conversion, and returns. He/she must follow all assigned SOPs diligently
Post making the sale, he/she is responsible for coordinating with the customer for product pick[1] up, after receiving due communication from the warehouse. He/she will verify the accuracy of the lenses fitted before handing over the product to the customer. In case of returns, he/she is expected to understand the reason and try to resolve the same to control the return percentage
Store upkeep & maintenance
He/she is expected to maintain Lenskart standards of hygiene in the store with respect to the overall display, frames, instruments, and other store equipment by cleaning them regularly
He/she must ensure the security of all Lenskart equipment and ensure there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store
Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification: 12th pass; Graduates preferred
Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions
Clear articulation and active listening skills

Description:
About the Role
The role of an Optometrist at Lenskart is different from competing brands and is not limited to only eye check-ups but also includes sales as a critical deliverable. He/she plays a key role in delivering technical expertise through eye-checks, dispensing, and diagnosis as well as selling products, executing stocktakes and SOPs to deliver an exceptional customer experience.

Responsibilities
Greeting and welcoming all walk-in customers and guiding them toward the clinic to promote the free eye check-up
Being involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day tasks to deliver the best shopping experience to the customers
Understanding the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively Being dedicated to customer satisfaction and resolving any concerns that the customer has
Following the 12-step Optometry process at Lenskart, during the eye check-up
Sharing the prescription clearly and educating the customer about single vision and progressive lens while recommending the appropriate lens and/or frames
Performing a quality check of the lenses fitted before handing over the product to the customer
Presenting the customer with an optimal selection of products based on customer preferences
Understanding the unstated needs of the customer, asking relevant questions, and picking the right time to pitch the recommended solutions
Achieving the assigned target for sales, eye-test conversion, returns; and following all SOPs Post making the sale, coordinating with the customer for product pick-up, after receiving due communication from the warehouse. In case of returns, he/she is expected to understand the reason and try to resolve the same to control the return percentage.
Maintaining the store as per Lenskart standards, cleaning the frames and other equipment regularly, and ensuring there is no deviation as per the SOP
Ensuring the security of all Lenskart equipment and that there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store
Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification: Diploma/ Bachelors in Optometry
Freshers are eligible to apply- no minimum work experience required
Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions
Clear communication and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to changing environment and openness to learn
Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation
Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority .

What will you drive?
As a Retail Associate, your primary responsibility will be to build strong relationships with New Car Dealerships (NCDs)and generate high-quality leads for customers looking to sell or exchange their cars.
Your day will revolve around visiting 3-5 NCD outlets daily, engaging with dealer partners, and identifying customers interested in selling their old vehicles or opting for exchange deals. You will act as the face of CARS24 on the ground ensuring that every potential lead is captured, nurtured, and converted through our platform.
This role is not just about visits its about consistent follow-ups, relationship management, and closing deals. Strong coordination with dealers and timely follow-ups on leads will be critical to your success.
You will work towards monthly targets, where your performance will be measured based on lead generation, conversions, and dealer engagement quality. Your persuasion and negotiation skills will play a key role in turning opportunities into successful transactions.
To set you up for success, you will go through 715 days of structured training(classroom + on-field), equipping you with the right product knowledge, sales techniques, and tools.
Expect a high-performance environment with attractive incentives tied to your achievements because at CARS24, we celebrate results and reward top performers.

Visit4-6 Dealerships daily to generate leads
Identify customers interested in selling or exchanging their cars
Build and maintain strong relationships with dealer partners
Ensure consistent follow-ups with NCDs for lead flow
Convert leads into successful transactions via CARS24
Maintain accurate records of visits, leads, and conversions
Achieve monthly sales and conversion targets

Working Days
6 days a week
Week off during weekdays

Who are we looking for?
Strong field sales mindset with willingness to travel daily
Excellent communication and relationship-building skills
Ability to follow up persistently and close deals
Self-driven, target-oriented, and highly energetic

Description:
STORE MANAGER
Title - Store Manager
Reporting to - Area Operations Manager
Skip Level - City/Zonal Manager

About the Role
A Store Manager at Lenskart acts as an important link between strategy and execution. He/she drives the store towards achieving all assigned metrics of Store Sales, Conversions, Customer satisfaction etc and is responsible for keeping a high level of morale among the store staff, developing them, controlling attrition, and ensuring smooth operations at the store.
Responsibilities Area Activities expected to be performed by a Lenskart Store Manager
Greeting customers when they enter store and coaching the team to do the same
Displaying commitment towards providing exceptional Customer Service and ensuring that
Lenskart associates also treat Customer Satisfaction as a priority
Dealing with customer service issues such as queries and complaints at store level and ensuring
this is consistent with the team
Customer focus: Driving Net Promoter Score
Striving to have long lasting and fruitful relationships with each of our customers
Driving the sales of the store to meet the allotted targets by allocating the targets to the staff
Developing a culture of high sales performance expectations, i.e. Sales Leadership Motivating and inspiring the field team to drive for results
Driving sales vs. plan
Assessing field capability and establish performance priorities at group level Assisting in recruiting and selecting high potential staff
People development
Providing effective on-the-job training and guidance to team members making use of company
training modules Delivering clear, motivating and constructive feedback in a timely manner to all retail associates ,Evaluating the training needs of store associates and working closely with L&D department to execute the developmental plan
(Attrition Control)
Understanding the reasons for attrition and taking measures to control it ,Monitoring cash reconciliation to ensure there is no mismatch of store funds ,Ensuring availability of required merchandise and services
Conducting stocktakes regularly Cash & Inventory management
Ensuring the staff at store level has basic understanding of POS System to ensure transactions
are properly and effectively processed
Performing the necessary quality checks for the new products
Working very closely with other departments till the product reaches the customer and ensuring
the best customer experience to the Lenskart Customer
Ensuring that all store employees, including the Optometrist, are taken care of and their issues
are resolved Supervision
Ensuring that the eye check-ups are conducted as per the SOP and maintain high quality standards
Ensuring that all SOPs for retail are implemented successfully and adhered to by store employees
Updating colleagues on business performance, new initiatives and other important issues
Scheduling the team shift timings to meet the store and business needs and demands
Ensuring staffing levels are adequate to effectively operate the store
SOP adherence & implementation
Maintaining the store as per Lenskart standards, regularly cleaning the frames and other
equipment at the store
Ensuring the security of all Lenskart equipment and that there is no shortage of stock units or
damage in the store
Store upkeep & maintenance
Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification: Graduate
Ability to act as a link between strategy and execution
Ability to develop and inspire people to achieve their best
Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
Ability to understand stated and unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions
Clear communication and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to a changing environment and openness to learn
Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation
Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority

Description:
*Role: Business Development / Expansion Role – OYO (Field Profile)*
*What is this role about?*
This role is about **expanding OYO’s hotel network in new and upcoming markets*
You will identify hotels, meet property owners, explain OYO’s vision, and help them partner with OYO. From the first discussion to the hotel going live, you will manage the full journey.
This is a *field-based role* and requires regular travel.
*What will you do in this role?*
• Find hotels and properties that can partner with OYO
• Generate leads through market visits, brokers, and referrals
• Visit properties and meet hotel owners face to face
• Explain how partnering with OYO can grow their business
• Negotiate commercials and close property signings
• Build a joint business plan with property owners for long-term profitability
• Coordinate with internal teams to launch the property on OYO
• Review agreements and service levels with property owners
• Resolve issues between property owners and internal OYO teams
*How is your performance measured?*
• Number of sellable rooms signed every month
• Number of rooms made live and available for booking
• Gross margin generated from signed properties
*Education:*
• Graduation mandatory
• MBA preferred
**Experience & Skills:**
• 1–5 years of relevant experience
• Strong negotiation and deal-closing skills
• Comfortable reading and understanding legal agreements
• Analytical and data-driven mindset
• Comfortable working in a fast-paced startup environment
• Basic working knowledge of ERP or mobile apps
• Good Excel skills and professional email writing
*Stakeholders you will work with:*
*Internal:*
• Business Development Head
• Hub Head
• Central Team
• Operations Team
• Transformation Team
• Legal Team
*External:*
• Property Owners
• Real Estate Brokers
*In simple words:*
Your role is to *find hotels, sign them, launch them on OYO, and ensure the partnership is profitable*.

Description:
Role: Area Operations Manager

Direct Reportees: Store Managers

Interactions: Internal and External Stakeholders.

Description: 

You, as an Area Manager, play a critical role to lead diverse teams at store level who are in turn responsible in providing the best customer experience to Lenskart customers as well as revenue generation. You are the facilitator of growth, responsible to build vision & business strategies to achieve sales, customer experience, and other organisational goals by investing in people through regular coaching.

We are looking for enthusiastic & pragmatic leaders with strong inclination towards customer centricity, sales, digital mind-set, and people leadership. On a typical day, you would be spending your time at the stores in your area, helping the team deliver on the strategy, coaching them and helping remove road-blocks.

Key Responsibilities:

Sales Leadership:

- Developing & driving sales strategy for your area & team with focus on revenue goals.

- Driving the rigor to deliver world-class customer experience at the store, thereby increasing the Net Promoter Score (NPS) for the store and reducing detractors

- Drive high performance culture in your area across the metrics mentioned above

- Assessing business and performance trends regularly & build improvement opportunities.

- Serve as critical strategy planning link between Corporate and the field organization.

- Translate corporate goals including financial returns, sales growth and market share, into

Business plans.

- Assess field capability and establish performance priorities at group level.

People leadership:

- Partnership with Store Managers & HR team to make sure stores are adequately staffed.

- Leading leaders, coaching and developing future talent

- Assess & bridge skill gaps including those related to implementation of business plans, forecasts, financial analysis, associate development and communication

- Formal & Informal performance management for store managers they are responsible for

- Responsible for establishing a culture that embraces diversity and maximizes the learnings from

a diverse team.

- Retain talent -> Reduce attrition

Organisational leadership:

- Solely responsible for managing and maintaining territory and store budgets to ensure profitability at the area level

- Managing the top and bottom line effectively of the assigned territory and stores

- Responsible for overall operational effectiveness of stores on areas such as shrinkage, capacity, productivity, growth, attrition.

- Build creative & cost effective methods to ensure productivity while managing high standards of retail operations.

Description:
About the Role
The role of Cluster Optometrist at Lenskart revolves around a combination of a perfect blend of optometry and optical retail. He/she plays a pivotal role in upskilling the front end retail staff on the professional optometry grounds. They are responsible to deliver the best customer experience by leading the example in driving the key business metrics with their optometric approach. Their key deliverable in business includes maintenance of eye test quality and dispensing standards throughout as per Lenskart norms.
Responsibilities
Store Visit
Must visit assigned stores in Lenskart uniform and manage the complete Technical and Functional part of Lenskart stores

In Store Duty
Act as a Mentor and Coach to Fresher Optometrists. Help them with Sales Pitch, Technical Dispensing Guidance, Troubleshooting, Customer Query Handling etc.
Must also work as a store optometrist during busy hours, high sale days or to cover shifts of those who are on leave. Check eye test, QC drawers, Wooqer entries, CL expiry, merchandise, Instrument calibration, KMT products etc.
To ensure the Store NPS is achieved by training, troubleshooting, tracking detractor and lead by example

Manpower
To welcome new talent from market, conduct interview and on board. Initiation Prepare and conduct meetings with respective AOMs to discuss reviews, performance or proposals

Training
For new staff - Undertake regular reviews, analyse SOPs such as eye test, quality check, dispensing, contact lens, troubleshoot, deliver to measure the impact of training on store performance. Identify and Train the Store staff to help them achieve their goals

Audit
Periodically audit their eye test and dispensing performance

Team Leader
Wear multiple hats of Team leader, Bench, Senior, Consultant Optometrist to support store team

Revenue
Maximise In-Store Revenue through Optometrists through continuous training, periodic reviews, increasing number of eye tests done at store and reducing returns

Team Work
Work as a member of Business Team to accomplish goals and objectives. Participate in regional, departmental, executive, operational meeting as appropriate

Documentation
Maintain documentation and Report daily to PS regional manager on store visit summary
Working Hours
Same as store shift and as per business needs. Must work on weekends and public holidays to support store business

Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification - Diploma in Optometry with minimum 3 years of retail experience and a good track record
Good Knowledge in Optometry, Refraction, Eye Wear Products, Dispensing and Measurements
Must be ready to travel anywhere in India as per Business requirements
Passionate about Sales, Retail, Customer service and Training
Good understanding of market and product analysis
Must have leadership qualities such as - lead by example, coaching, motivating, great communication and never give up attitude
Energy, influence, 10 x think entrepreneur mind-set etc

1) Job Purpose
To supervise excavation and delivery of the specified quantity and quality of bauxite from the assigned area of the Gurdari mines in the Netarhat cluster to the alumina refinery at Renukoot.
To execute the mine plan, MIS reporting, Budgeting, sustainable Mining Operation & implementation of digitization /Automation in mining activities.


2) Dimensions:Business/SBU/Unit Revenue Business Workforce Number284Unit Workforce Number284Function Workforce Number202Department Workforce NumberLMS 4, Workmen 5, Contractual - 193Other Quantitative and Important Parameters for the Job: Budgets/Volumes/No. of Products/Geography/Markets/ Customers or any other parameterVolume-1.50 lakh Mt. Bauxite and 1 million MT of Overburden.
Customer- Renukoot Refinery
Lease Area 190.95 Ha.


3) Job Context & Major Challenges:Job Context:
Hindalco Industries Limited operates 5 bauxite mines across the Netarhat cluster in Jharkhand, about 95-100 km from Lohardaga Railway siding with an extraction capacity of 1,50,000 tons per year. The Amtipani mines caters to alumina refineries at Muri. Bauxite is transported through tippers by road and shipped through train from the railway siding at Tori. Once mining plan is finalized in collaboration with the Geological department and approved by the Indian Bureau of Mines (IBM), mining operation is undertaken at the mines primarily through contractual manpower & departmental manpower both. Laterite is removed, bauxite is drilled, excavated through excavators, and dumped through dumpers and unloaded in crusher hover or in bauxite stock room. At the end of the mining lifecycle, the waste is removed and used in back filling of closed mine pits and making them ready for plantation.

This role is responsible for supervising the excavation at the assigned area of the Gurdari mines to assist in delivering planned quantity and quality of bauxite in accordance with the approved Mining Plan and dispatch the same after a stringent quality assurance process that involves proper segregation after QA verification to the alumina refineries at Muri.
Criticality is achievement of quantity and quality of bauxite through maximum productivity in area under jurisdiction.

This role is expected to contribute to controlling costs through optimum deployment and utilization of resources including manpower, consumables, and spares in assigned area of the mine. This role must facilitate upkeep of equipment and infrastructure as well as good housekeeping under jurisdiction so that continuous production can be maintained.

A key element of the role is to implement safety protocols with respect to both man and materials in area under jurisdiction. It involves participating in safety propaganda and continuously checking PPE usage. It also involves supervising the blasting process with due permissions from explosive department in compliance of PESO norms.

Partnering sustainability through Mine Restoration as mandated by law for management of eco system of mining areas. It involves supervision of back filling of exhausted mines Harmonious relations with the local community and government officials is an important aspect of the role.
The new aspect of this role is to implement the new initiatives related to digitization, automation, and sustainability in various mining operations.

Job Challenges:
Unions of own workmen and transport union Local truck owners posing problem in mining and dispatch
Insurgency affecting operations and movement of materials
Issues of raiyat
Issues of Loader involved for truck loading, specially related to safety





4) Key Result Areas/Accountabilities:Key Result Areas/AccountabilitiesSupporting Actions1) Business Excellence
Achieving monthly, quarterly, and annual targets for excavation of bauxite in assigned area of the Gurdari mines
Maintaining qualitative parameters of each consignment of bauxite as per requirement of the alumina refinery at Muri
Implementing SOPs in all aspects of mining operation under jurisdiction
Facilitating preventive and predictive maintenance as well as breakdown maintenance of all equipment under jurisdiction to have continuous uptime of the equipment and non-stop production
2) Cost
Controlling cost of production and achieving cost saving without compromising delivery by driving continuous process improvement across area of operation
3) Cash
Improving profitability by optimizing working capital through inventory management and spare consumption patterns without compromising on safety and environment aspects
4) Customer
Minimizing response time in providing information and sharing data proactively with all internal and external customers with respect to the Amtipani Mines
5) Sustainability
Handling blasting activities in area of jurisdiction in compliance of PESO guidelines for explosive
Implementing integrated Management system and Energy Management System guidelines
Implementing good housekeeping practices in area of jurisdiction
Implementing sustainability initiative in assigned mine area through Mine Restoration as mandated by law through backfilling of exhausted mines
6) Safety
Implementing Safety standards and developing safety mechanism to achieve zero harm
Embedding safety culture through training and awareness sessions to eliminate unsafe behavior with focus on implementation of safety standards such as LOTOTO, HIRA, 5S, use of PPE and safety related training
Implementing emergency handling readiness through continuous recording of special events, benchmarking, efficiency evaluation
7) People development and engagement
Implementing training initiatives to enhance technical and behavioral competencies
Supervising intake and deployment of physically fit and appropriately trained contractual workforce and overseeing their continuous training and wellbeing as per company guidelines in area under jurisdiction

5) Role Specific Competencies Technical competencies
B Tech in Mining Engineering with 3 years of experience
2nd class Mine Manager certificate from DGMS

ABG Leadership Competencies

Description:
Group Company: Marks and Spencer Reliance India Private Limited

Designation: Store Manager

Office Location:

Position description: As a Store Manager, you will lead the operations of your business unit while ensuring a seamless shopping experience for customers. Your key responsibilities will include:

Primary Responsibilities:
1. Operational Leadership:

? Day-to-Day Management: Oversee the smooth running of the store, maintaining high standards across all operations, and ensuring legal compliance, particularly regarding pricing and product display.

? Procedure Adherence: Execute operational procedures efficiently, ensuring consistency and excellence in areas such as housekeeping, fitting rooms, and checkout processes.

? Quality Control: Monitor product quality, address any issues swiftly, and communicate feedback to the merchandising team to uphold superior product standards.

2. Sales Performance Management:

? Target Achievement: Drive and monitor the achievement of sales goals for your department. You?ll also play a key role in setting realistic yet ambitious targets, with the flexibility to adapt based on performance trends.

? Sales Analysis: Track sales performance continuously, taking timely corrective actions when necessary to meet or exceed sales objectives.

? Team Communication: Regularly share updates on department, store, and regional performance with your team, ensuring transparency and motivating everyone towards common goals.

3. Customer Experience:

? Customer Service Excellence: Lead by example in delivering exceptional customer service, creating a welcoming atmosphere for every visitor.

? Building Relationships: Understand customer needs, cultivate rapport, and establish loyal relationships with key clientele.

? Handling Feedback: Take ownership of customer complaints and queries, ensuring timely and satisfactory resolutions that turn challenges into positive outcomes.

4. Visual Merchandising Store Presentation:

? Merchandising Standards: Ensure that all visual merchandising guidelines are followed to create an attractive and engaging shopping environment.

? Continuous Improvement: Provide constructive feedback to visual merchandisers to enhance the store's visual appeal and product presentation.

5. Shrinkage Inventory Control:

? Loss Prevention: Implement best practices to minimize shrinkage by training staff on merchandise handling and stock protection, safeguarding store assets.

6. Team Development Leadership:

? Training Development: Facilitate on-the-job training, product knowledge sessions, and visual merchandising workshops to equip your team with the skills needed for success.

? Role Clarity Task Delegation: Clearly define roles and responsibilities for each team member, ensuring accountability and efficient task management.

? Constructive Feedback: Regularly provide feedback that helps your team identify strengths and areas for improvement, fostering continuous personal and professional growth.

? Motivation Engagement: Inspire your team to not only meet sales targets but also to follow operational procedures with enthusiasm and dedication.

7. Cashier Support Training:

? Support Supervision: Assist in the training of cashiers and provide ongoing support to ensure smooth operations at checkout, contributing to a positive customer experience.

Description:
Title Store Manager
Reporting to Area Operations Manager

About Lenskart
With a mission to give India a vision, Lenskart.com is India's fastest growing eyewear company. Lenskart's products include prescription eyewear, branded contact lenses and sunglasses, all equipped with the customers eye powers.

About the Role
A Store Manager at Lenskart acts as an important link between strategy and execution. He/she drives the store towards achieving all assigned metrics of Store Sales, Conversions, Customer satisfaction etc. and is responsible for keeping a high level of morale among the store staff, developing them, controlling attrition, and ensuring smooth operations at the store.

Responsibilities:
Customer focus: Driving Net Promoter Score ( NPS )
Greeting customers when they enter store and coaching the team to do the same
Displaying commitment towards providing exceptional Customer Service and ensuring that Lenskart associates also treat Customer Satisfaction as a priority
Dealing with customer service issues such as queries and complaints at store level and ensuring this is consistent with the team
Striving to have long lasting and fruitful relationships with each of our customers

Driving sales vs. plan

Driving the sales of the store to meet the allotted targets by allocating the targets to the staff
Developing a culture of high sales performance expectations, i.e. Sales Leadership
Motivating and inspiring the field team to drive for results
Assessing field capability and establish performance priorities at group level

People development (Attrition Control)
Assisting in recruiting and selecting high potential staff
Providing effective on-the-job training and guidance to team members making use of company training modules
Delivering clear, motivating and constructive feedback in a timely manner to all retail associates
Evaluating the training needs of store associates and working closely with L&D department to execute the developmental plan
Understanding the reasons for attrition and taking measures to control it

Cash & Inventory management
Monitoring cash reconciliation to ensure there is no mismatch of store funds
Ensuring availability of required merchandise and services
Conducting stocktakes regularly
Ensuring the staff at store level has basic understanding of POS System to ensure transactions are properly and effectively processed
Performing the necessary quality checks for the new products
Working very closely with other departments till the product reaches the customer and ensuring the best customer experience to the Lenskart Customer

Supervision
Ensuring that all store employees, including the Optometrist, are taken care of and their issues are resolved
Ensuring that the eye check-ups are conducted as per the SOP and maintain high quality standards

SOP adherence & implementation
Ensuring that all SOPs for retail are implemented successfully and adhered to by store employees
Updating colleagues on business performance, new initiatives and other important issues
Scheduling the teams shift timings to meet the stores business needs and demands
Ensuring staffing levels are adequate to effectively operate the store

Store upkeep & maintenance
Maintaining the store as per Lenskart standards, regularly cleaning the frames and other equipment at the store
Ensuring the security of all Lenskart equipment and that there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store

Description:
Job Description for Sales Associate at Manipal Hospitals:

As a Sales Associate at Manipal Hospitals, you will play a key role in promoting and selling our healthcare services to potential patients and clients. Your primary responsibilities will include identifying sales opportunities, maintaining relationships with existing clients, and providing exceptional customer service. You will work closely with the healthcare team to understand our offerings and effectively communicate the benefits of our services to customers.

Key Responsibilities:
- Engage with potential patients and provide them with detailed information about healthcare services offered by Manipal Hospitals.
- Conduct market research to identify prospective clients and generate leads.
- Develop and maintain relationships with referral sources, such as physicians and community organizations.
- Collaborate with the marketing team to create promotional materials and campaigns that highlight our services.
- Meet and exceed sales targets and objectives.
- Maintain accurate records of sales activities and client interactions in the CRM system.
- Attend industry events and health fairs to represent Manipal Hospitals and connect with potential clients.
- Provide feedback to the management team on market trends and customer needs.

Skills and Tools Required:
- Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
- Excellent negotiation and persuasive abilities.
- Customer-focused attitude with a commitment to providing exceptional service.
- Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
- Proficiency in using CRM software and Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
- Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
- Previous experience in sales, preferably in healthcare or a related field, is a plus.
- Knowledge of healthcare services and an understanding of the sales process.

Roles and Responsibilities
About the Role:
The Sales Associate at Manipal Hospitals will focus on building and maintaining strong relationships with clients and stakeholders. This role is critical in promoting our healthcare services and driving patient engagement. The Sales Associate will collaborate closely with various teams to enhance service delivery and ensure customer satisfaction.

About the Team:
You will be part of a dynamic sales team dedicated to expanding Manipal Hospitals' reach in the healthcare market. The team comprises skilled professionals who are passionate about providing exceptional service and support to patients. Collaboration and a customer-centric approach are key values within the team.

You are Responsible for:
Identifying and pursuing new sales opportunities within the healthcare sector.
Achieving sales targets and contributing to the overall growth of Manipal Hospitals.
Building and maintaining relationships with healthcare professionals, patients, and other stakeholders.
Conducting market research to understand customer needs and competitive landscape.
Participating in promotional events and activities to raise awareness about the services offered.

To succeed in this role – you should have the following:
A strong background in sales, preferably in the healthcare industry.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to effectively engage with clients.
Strong analytical skills to assess market trends and customer needs.
Proven ability to meet sales targets and work in a fast-paced environment.
A proactive and positive attitude, along with a passion for healthcare service.
AboutCompany: Manipal Health Enterprises, commonly known as Manipal Hospitals, is an Indian for-profit private hospital network headquartered in Bangalore, Karnataka. The hospitals trace their origins to the Kasturba Medical College, founded by T. M. A. Pai in 1953.
