Description:
Purpose/Objective


The Store Incharge oversees the efficient receipt, storage, and issuance of materials, ensuring adherence to standard operating procedures (SOP) and maintaining material quality.
This role coordinates with site store in-charges on material requisitions and vendor deliveries, manages inventory through regular monitoring and timely disposal of non-moving items, and handles financial and documentation management to ensure accurate records.
Key Responsibilities of Role


Store In-charge - Mining Stakeholder Liasioning: Liasion with site store in-charge to cordinate with material requisitions and vendor deliveries Obtain vendor reports from all sites on monthly basis and consolidate the same for providing inputs to Vendor Development Lead and senior management.
Material Handling and Procurement: Ensure efficient receipt, storage, and issuance of various materials in accordance with standard operating procedures (SOP).
Coordinate material collection from the vendors for material procured or services sourced.
Implement appropriate storage methods tailored to different categories of materials to maintain their quality and integrity.
Oversee PR and verify stock availability before approving PRs to facilitate timely procurement.
Ensure the closure of open goods receipt/invoice receipt (GR/IR) issues to maintain accurate inventory records.
Employ effective handling methods to prevent material damage.
Inventory Management: Authorize RGP/NRGP material gate passes and define ROL and ROQ for fast-moving items in collaboration with user and commercial departments to optimize inventory management Ensure timely monitoring and disposal of non-moving items nearing expiration, following established procedures.
Oversee regular physical verification of inventory in accordance with SOP.
Financial and Documentation Management: Maintain records encompassing store registers and material requisition slips (MRS).
Enter invoices into the system to enable Contract Admin / ABEX for doing MIRO and subsequent release of payment.
Operational Management and Reporting: Facilitate daily review meetings with store team members to promptly address and resolve any outstanding issues.
Respond to internal and external audit queries, provide necessary data, and implement corrective actions for audit observations.
Ensure compliance with IMS standards in all store processes and data management activities.
Oversee GRN, quality, DCC, and MRS posting in SAP.
Compile monthly MIS reports on inventory aging, non-moving items (NMI), and project inventory, and distribute them to relevant stakeholders.
Technology Utilization: Leverage digital tools to streamline store operations, including order processing, stock management, and supplier coordination.
Develop and maintain digital records for store transactions and inventory, enhancing accuracy and transparency in store operations.
Key Stakeholders - Internal Site Store In-charges Finance Team Operations Team Quality Assurance Team Key Stakeholders - External Vendors Suppliers Regulatory Authorities
Technical Competencies


Category Management-NR,Contract Management-PRJ,Contractor Management-NR,Data Analysis and Reporting-NR,Digitization & Automation-NR,Inventory Management-PRJ,Market Intelligence Understanding-NR,Mining Business Know-how-NR,NR Business Know How-NR,Sourcing Strategy and Execution-NR
Qualifications and Experience


Educational Qualification: Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Business Administration, or a related field.
Work Experience (Range of years): 3-5 years of work experience

Title: Business Development Executive \ Field sales apprentice role
Location: Ranchi (Retail Store Based)
Job Type: Full\-Time apprentice role for 12 months
Industry: Beauty & Cosmetics \/ Retail \/ FMCG

Summary:
We are seeking a motivated Business Development Executive to drive growth for a leading online cosmetic and beauty products retailer across Uttar Pradesh. This role is centred on expanding our retail footprint by building strong relationships with distributors, retailers, and vendors within the assigned territory. The ideal candidate will be proactive in lead generation, product promotion, and sales execution, ensuring consistent visibility and performance of our offerings in key retail locations. The position is retail store\-based with regular field visits, offering a dynamic opportunity to contribute directly to business expansion in a fast\-paced FMCG environment.

Responsibilities:
\- Identify and develop new leads through systematic market visits, provided data, and personal referrals
\- Engage with distributors, retailers, and vendors to present product portfolios and drive sales
\- Conduct in\-store product sampling and promotional activities to enhance customer engagement
\- Execute targeted product launch initiatives and ensure timely deal closures
\- Support retail partners with business development strategies and on\-ground execution
\- Monitor, analyse, and report monthly sales performance, campaign outcomes, and key market insights

Requirements
\- Graduate in any discipline (from 2021 to 2025 pass\-out)
\- Freshers are encouraged to apply
\- Up to 11 months of sales or field experience is acceptable
\- Must be a local resident of the assigned location (within 10 km of the retail store)
\- Personal two\-wheeler (bike preferred) is mandatory with valid driving license
\- Prior knowledge or experience in the beauty\/cosmetics or FMCG sector is preferred
\- Male candidates are preferred for this role

Work Details:
\- Work Schedule: 6 days a week
\- Weekly Off: Sunday
\- Work Type: Retail store\-based with regular local market visits

Benefits
\- Fixed salary: \\u20b911,500 from Nykaa + 4500 from Govt (16000 in hand)
\- Daily TA\/DA: \\u20b9200
\- Attractive performance\-based incentives

AboutCompany:
Jana Small Finance Bank, erstwhile Janalakshmi Financial Services, is headquartered in Bengaluru. It is one of the 10 financial institutions which had received in-principle approval from RBI, in 2015, to set up a Small Finance Bank.
Established in Bengaluru in 2008, it went on to become the largest Micro Finance Institution (MFI) in India, and was recognised globally as one of the world€™s innovative financial institutions working on the problem of financial inclusion.
Jana Bank received the final banking license in April 2017 and started banking operations on March 28, 2018. Under the leadership of its MD & CEO, Ajay Kanwal, Jana Small Finance Bank€™s vision is to become the leading inclusive digitised bank serving all customer segments and communities of an aspirational India.
Currently, post the transition phase, the bank is enabling its existing 45 lakh customers across 19 states in India to access banking services. It has Capital Adequacy Ratio (CAR) of about 35 percent and a loan book of INR 76 billion as on March 31, 2018. By 2020, the bank aspires to add four million customers.
The bank has deep domain expertise in banking and financial services, with the senior management team having 25+ years of average experience in banking sector. Its current employee strength is of 15,000. By end of 2019, Jana Bank€™s 500 branches will be operational across 19 states, post conversion of majority of its micro finance storefronts into bank branches.
Bengaluru-headquartered Jana Small Finance Bank is regulated by the Reserve Bank of India (RBI).

Description:
Role & responsibilities:
People Operations & Employee Relations:

Provide day-to-day support to employees on People Operations-related queries and coordinate with the appropriate team members for timely resolution.
Support employee relations activities by listening to employee concerns, documenting queries, and escalating matters appropriately when required.
Maintain professional and confidential communication while handling employee information and concerns.
Coordinate with employees and internal stakeholders to ensure smooth implementation of People Operations processes.
Support employee engagement and other People Operations initiatives as required.
Develop a working knowledge of Room to Read Indias People Operations policies, procedures, and processes and ensure assigned activities are carried out in accordance with organizational guidelines.
Ensure confidentiality and appropriate handling of employee information and maintain adherence to organizational standards relating to employee conduct and child protection.

Talent Acquisition & Recruitment Support:

Be well versed with RtR HR Recruitment Policies, and provide weekly, monthly and quarterly Recruitment metrics as required.
Support the end-to-end recruitment process, candidate sourcing, screening, interview coordination, reference checks, and offer-related documentation.
Coordinate with hiring managers to schedule interviews and ensure timely follow-up on recruitment requirements.
Maintain candidate trackers, recruitment databases, and other relevant records.
Ensure recruitment-related documentation and processes are completed accurately and in accordance with organizational policies and timelines.

Employee Documentation & Records Management:

Maintain accurate and up-to-date employee files, both physical and digital, in accordance with organizational policies.
Ensure timely collection, verification, filing, and submission of employee-related documents.
Support joining, transfer, confirmation, separation, and other employee lifecycle documentation.
Maintain People Operations trackers and databases and ensure information is updated accurately and within timelines.
Ensure confidentiality and appropriate handling of employee records and personal information.
Support timely submission and maintenance of statutory and other People Operations-related documentation, as required.

Administration & Coordination:

Coordinate closely with the Administration team for employee-related administrative requirements.
Support employee induction by coordinating with relevant internal teams to ensure that new employees receive the required information, documentation, facilities, and administrative support for a smooth onboarding experience.
Support office administration activities related to employee onboarding, transfers, travel, meetings, events, and other operational requirements.
Coordinate with internal teams and external vendors/service providers as required for People Operations and administrative activities.
Follow up with relevant stakeholders to ensure timely completion of assigned tasks and requirements.
Ensure administrative activities are carried out in accordance with organizational policies, procedures, and guidelines.

Bills, Expenses & Documentation:

Support the processing and tracking of People Operations and Administration-related bills and invoices.
Ensure bills, supporting documents, approvals, and other required paperwork are complete and submitted within the prescribed timelines.
Maintain proper records of bills, expenses, and supporting documentation.
Coordinate with Finance and relevant internal stakeholders for timely processing and resolution of billing-related queries.
Ensure bills, expenses, approvals, and supporting documentation are processed in accordance with organizational policies and established procedures.
Maintain appropriate records and documentation for audit and internal review purposes.
Ensure timely submission of required documentation and follow up on pending approvals or discrepancies.


Preferred candidate profile
Required:

Bachelors degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Management, or a related field.
24 years of relevant professional experience in People Operations, Human Resources, Talent Acquisition, HR Administration, or a related function.
Working knowledge of recruitment and employee lifecycle processes.
General understanding of personnel administration and HR practices.
Good coordination, follow-up, and documentation skills.
Ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines.
Good written and verbal communication skills in English.
Ability to interact effectively with employees and stakeholders at different levels.
Good working knowledge of MS Office, particularly Excel and Word.
Ability to maintain confidentiality while handling employee information and records.

Preferred:

Prior experience in the development/non-profit sector or a multi-location organization.
Experience in handling HR documentation, employee queries, recruitment coordination, bills, and administrative processes.
Familiarity with HRIS or other employee management systems.


Please share your resume at Ranjan.Singh@roomtoread.org.

1) Job Purpose
To take responsibility for measuring excavation area and submit surface plan, geological plan, water danger plan to DGMS on a quarterly basis with respect to the Bagru mines
To estimates over burden, top soil, laterite over bauxite area and arrange for their removal through contractor and ensure payment
2) Dimensions:Business/SBU/Unit Revenue Business Workforce Number Unit Workforce Number Function Workforce Number Department Workforce Number Other Quantitative and Important Parameters for the Job: Budgets/Volumes/No. of Products/Geography/Markets/ Customers or any other parameter
3) Job Context & Major Challenges:Job Context:
Hindalco Industries Limited operates 4 bauxite mines across the Lohardaga cluster in Chhattisgarh. Bagru plateau in the Lohardaga cluster, with composite deposit of bauxite, has 2 operating mines (4 leases) about 20 km from Lohardaga. The Bagru mines cater to alumina refineries at Muri and Renukoot. Besides transporting bauxite through tippers by road, bauxite is shipped through train from the railway siding at Lohardaga which gets bauxite through an aerial ropeway from the Bagru mines. Once mining plan is finalised in collaboration with the Geological department and approved by the Indian Bureau of Mines (IBM), mining operation is undertaken at the mines primarily through contractual manpower. Laterite is removed, bauxite is drilled, excavated through excavators and dumped through dumpers and unloaded in crusher hover or in bauxite stock room. At the end of the mining lifecycle, the waste is removed and used in back filling of closed mine pits and making them ready for plantation through horticulture contract.

This is a statutory position. The role is responsible for measuring excavation area and submitting surface plan, geological plan, water danger plan to DGMS on a quarterly basis showing progress of excavation. It is critical to ensure measurement of length, breadth, width of excavated area and conduct proper risk analysis to ensure complete accuracy.

Another important element of the role is to estimate over burden, top soil, laterite over bauxite area and arrange for their removal through contractor. Close coordination with the contractor to check whether all resources in terms of manpower and equipment are being deployed and work is progressing as per plan. Criticality is to keep track of progress of work on the ground to ensure completion of tasks within deadline to make the mine ready for bauxite excavation and ensure payment as per actual work done. In view of the large contingents of contractual workers deployed for this process, contract labour management is a critical element of the role.

This role is required to undertake creation of green belt particularly for rehabilitation of mines. Water management through rain water harvesting is also an important element of the role. It involves dealing with the local community sometimes.

Job Challenges:
Harmonious community management


4) Key Result Areas/Accountabilities:Key Result Areas/AccountabilitiesSupporting Actions1) Business Excellence
Measuring excavation area, over burden, top soil, laterite accurately with respect to the Bagru mines
Overseeing removal of over burden, top soil, laterite as per mining plan.
Overseeing implementations of SOPs in all aspects of operation under jurisdiction
2) Cost
Implementing budgets and achieving cost saving without compromising delivery by driving continuous process improvement across area of operation
Certifying work accurately to optimise cos
3) Cash
Improving profitability by optimum deployment of contractors
4) Customer
Collaborating with operations team and contractors to make mines free of top soil, over burden and laterite and ready for excavation of bauxite as per mining plan
Minimizing response time in providing information and solutions to all internal and external customers
5) Sustainability
Implementing all statutory compliance within timelines by submitting the following to the Director General of Mine Safety (DGMS) on a quarterly basis:
surface plan
geological plan
water danger plan

Implementing compliance of Integrated Management system and Energy Management System
Overseeing good Housekeeping practices in area under jurisdiction
Partnering in green initiatives
6) Safety
Implementing Safety standards to achieve zero harm through implementation of safety standards such as LOTOTO, HIRA, 5S
Monitoring implementation of safety related training
7) People development and engagement
Monitoring intake and deployment of physically fit and appropriately trained contractual workforce and ensuring their continuous training and wellbeing as per company guidelines.
Monitoring implementation of contract management.

Description:
Role & responsibilities:
Procurement & Vendor Management:

Support the end-to-end procurement process in accordance with organizational procurement policies and procedures.
Identify vendors, obtain quotations, prepare comparative statements, coordinate reviews, obtain approvals, and maintain procurement documentation.
Maintain the vendor database and procurement documentation.
Monitor contract expiry dates and coordinate timely renewal or execution of new contracts.
Coordinate with vendors to ensure timely delivery of goods and services.
Verify vendor invoices, submit them to Finance on time, and follow up until payment is completed.
Maintain procurement records, agreements, purchase orders, and supporting documents for audit and compliance purposes.

Office Administration & Facilities Management

Responsible for the overall upkeep and day-to-day administration of the office.
Ensure timely payment of field office rent, electricity, water, internet, and other utility bills, and maintain proper records of the same.
Oversee the general upkeep and maintenance of the office premises, furniture, fixtures, and equipment, and coordinate timely repairs and servicing as required.
Coordinate with the landlord, service providers, and utility vendors for uninterrupted office services and address any related issues promptly.
Maintain adequate stock of office stationery, pantry items, housekeeping materials, and other office supplies.
Raise procurement requests for routine office requirements.
Ensure office safety, cleanliness, security, and compliance with organizational administrative standards.
Manage and monitor Annual Maintenance Contracts (AMCs) for office facilities and equipment, ensuring timely renewals, preventive maintenance, and uninterrupted service delivery.

Logistics, Events & Travel

Coordinate logistics arrangements for trainings, workshops, meetings, and program events.
Arrange venue bookings, accommodation, transportation, catering, and event materials as required.
Coordinate staff travel, including travel bookings and local transportation.
Support logistical planning for program implementation activities at district and field levels.
Inventory & Material Distribution:

Coordinate procurement, storage, packaging, dispatch, and distribution of program materials.
Maintain inventory registers and stock records for program materials at the field office.
Maintain fixed asset and non-fixed asset registers in accordance with organizational policies.
Support periodic physical verification of inventory and assets.
Coordinate with program teams to obtain material distribution acknowledgements and supporting documentation as applicable.
Ensure proper storage, movement, and record-keeping of program materials.

Program Implementation & Documentation Support:

Provide administrative and operational support for program implementation activities.
Support data collection, data entry, verification, and database updates in organizational systems (including GSD or other designated platforms).
Assist in data validation and periodic data cleaning to maintain accuracy.
Extend support Program Field Coordinators and Program Assistants during district, block, school, and community-level events, including documentation, photography, and other logistical assistance as required.
Render support to the Program Field Coordinators/Program Assistants in rolling out community-level events and district/block/school-level workshops/meetings/events by documenting the meeting, clicking photographs, and any other support as required.
Prepare, type, format, and maintain program documents in English and Hindi, including managing electronic records, SharePoint folders, and file conversions as required.
Prepare meeting minutes, maintain documentation, and follow up on agreed action points.
Perform other administrative and documentation tasks assigned by the reporting manager.

Stakeholder Coordination & Relationships:

Coordinate closely with concerned Program, Finance, Procurement, and Administration teams to ensure timely support for program activities.
Ensure effective liaison w Liaise with vendors, service providers, landlords, government offices, and other external stakeholders as required.
Respond promptly to administrative requests from field teams while ensuring compliance with organizational policies.
Maintain professional relationships with internal and external stakeholders to support efficient program delivery.

Compliance & Reporting:

Ensure all procurement and administrative activities comply with organizational policies, donor requirements, and statutory regulations.
Maintain complete documentation for procurement, inventory, payments, and office administration.
Support internal and external audits by providing required records and documentation.
Prepare periodic administrative and procurement reports as required.

Preferred candidate profile

Required:

Graduate in any discipline.
23 years of relevant experience in administration, procurement, logistics, or office management, preferably in the NGO, development, or social sector.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook)
Willingness to travel frequently within the states.
Ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines.
Self-motivated, flexible, and able to work without close supervision.
Attention to detail.
High standards of integrity, honesty, and professionalism.
Strong negotiation skills.

Preferred:

Flexible attitude towards changing priorities and ability to multi-task with an eye for detail.
Strong initiative, proactive, and solution oriented.
Team player.
Excellent interpersonal and relationship-building skills.

Please share your resume at Ranjan.Singh@roomtoread.org.

Description:
Job Summary
Important: All applicants must be legally eligible to work in the country where the position is located. Room to Read is not able to provide sponsorship.
The Associate, Numeracy Field will support the Program Officer in strengthening foundational numeracy implementation in Ramgarh, Jharkhand through district and block-level planning, technical support, government system strengthening, supervision of Project Field Coordinators, data use, monitoring, and documentation. The Associate will work closely with district and block education officials, including BEEOs, BPOs, BPMs, BRPs, CRPs, Head Teachers and DIET, to strengthen government-led academic support systems under the NIPUN Bharat Mission. The position will also support academic platforms such as Cluster Academic Meetings, Block Academic Reviews and Gurugosthi, ensuring that these platforms use implementation and foundational numeracy data to identify priorities, develop action plans and follow up on agreed actions.
The Associate will report to the Program Officer and will supervise and provide technical and mentoring support to Project Field Coordinators in assigned blocks.


Responsibilities

Programme Planning, Management & Implementation
Develop a strong understanding of Room to Reads Foundational Numeracy program design and the NIPUN Bharat guidelines, NCF-FS, NCF-SE and SCF-Jharkhand.
Support the district lead in planning, coordinating, and implementing district foundational numeracy priorities within the DPMU structure, ensuring alignment with program goals and budgets.
Develop and maintain district, block, cluster, BRP, CRP, and school profiles to identify numeracy implementation priorities and prepare district heat maps for targeted academic support.
Flag key implementation issues, coordinate timely resolution with programme teams and DEO/BEO and BRP/CRP, and support the delivery of planned activities.
Plan and monitor implementation strategies based on priority areas, ensuring effective allocation of Project Field Coordinators (PFCs), training, mentoring, and follow-up support.
Supervise PFCs by reviewing monthly work plans, monitoring field performance, ensuring data quality, and strengthening their technical and mentoring capacities.
Support and facilitate numeracy training programmes, academic review meetings, and professional learning platforms for BRPs, CRPs, Head Teachers, and teachers, in coordination with the district lead and relevant government stakeholders.
Represent the numeracy programme at relevant district- and block-level forums, as assigned, and maintain effective coordination and professional relationships with government stakeholders.


Technical & Academic Support for Foundational Numeracy
Provide technical support on foundational numeracy pedagogy, classroom practices, assessment and academic mentoring to BRPs, CRPs, Head Teachers and Teachers.
Support government stakeholders to implement foundational numeracy practices consistently during school visits, mentoring visits, and academic review discussions at district and block levels.
Support DEO and BEO in coordination with District lead to analyze and use foundational numeracy assessment data to identify block-wise learning gaps, prioritize areas for academic support, and informed evidence-based planning and decision-making.
Conduct and support foundational numeracy-focused classroom observations and provide constructive, actionable feedback to PFCs and academic support personnel.
Support PFCs in using foundational numeracy assessment data to identify childrens learning needs and plan appropriate academic support to teachers.
Support the development, adaptation and use of numeracy observation tools, training resources and guidance materials in collaboration with DIET and district education officials.
Strengthen the technical capacity of PFCs to provide effective support on foundational numeracy pedagogy, classroom observation, academic mentoring, and data use.
Strengthen government-led academic support systems under the NIPUN Bharat Mission through coordinated engagement with district, block, cluster, school, and DIET stakeholders.
Track action points from Cluster Academic Meetings, Block Academic Reviews, and Gurugosthi, and support officials to close agreed actions within defined timelines.
Stay updated on relevant national and state education policies and initiatives, including NEP 2020, NIPUN Bharat, NCF and SCF-Jharkhand, and support the Program Officer in translating relevant priorities into district and block-level implementation.


Supervision & Field Support
Conduct regular joint visits with district and block education officials and Project Field Coordinators as per defined touchpoints to provide supportive supervision, technical guidance, and implementation monitoring.
Support DEO and BEO in reviewing the district and block-wise progress towards the overall goals and learning outcomes of the NIPUN Bharat Mission, identifying key bottlenecks, and strengthening academic support strategies to improve foundational numeracy learning outcomes.
Review field observations, implementation progress, and data submitted by Project Field Coordinators (PFCs) to ensure timely reporting, data quality, and adherence to programme standards.
Analyse monitoring, assessment, and implementation data to identify trends, implementation gaps, and priority areas, and provide actionable insights to support programme planning, implementation, and decision-making.
Prepare and submit timely weekly, monthly, and other programme reports, documenting key achievements, challenges, lessons learned, action points and recommendations for continuous programme improvement.


Monitoring, Evaluation & Learning
Collaborate with the Data and Evaluation team to implement and maintain programme monitoring and evaluation activities.
Support the district lead in the synthesis of monitoring and evaluation findings and preparation of concise programme summaries.
Use evidence from classroom observations, assessments, and implementation data to identify programme quality issues & gaps and prioritize block-wise priorities and support continuous improvement.


Qualifications
Required:
Bachelor's degree in education / mathematics / social sciences or equivalent
Master's degree in education / mathematics / social sciences or equivalent preferred
Minimum 3 years of relevant experience in the education sector, particularly in foundational learning, teacher support, academic mentoring, school improvement, education programmes or related areas.
In-depth knowledge of foundational numeracy, its pedagogies, and classroom implementation strategies.
Strong written and oral communication skills.
Critical thinking and analytical skills
Good interpersonal skills and a team player
Proven track record of achieving results.
Proven ability to work effectively with schools and communities.
Room to Read is a child-safe organization. All personnel must adhere to Room to Read's Child Protection Policy, Child Protection Code of Conduct and Prevention.

Description:
Job Details
Position Title: Distict Project Coordinator
Number of Position: 1
Reporting: State Program Manager
Location: Garhwa, Jharkhand
Type: Project Based
Qualifications
Qualification Required: Master s degree in social work, Child Rights, or related field.
Experience
Minimum 3 to 5 years of experience in child protection, social protection or Community development.
Prior experience of working at the district level
Experience of handling responsibilities of coordination with Government departments
Experience in working with government stakeholders, child and social protection mechanisms,
Skills & Attributes
Proactive and solution-oriented person.
Possess communication and facilitation skills.
In-depth understanding of child protection schemes and architecture in Jharkhand.
Knowledge and experience of working with Panchayati Raj Institutions preferably in Jharkhand, is desirable.
Excellent oral and written communication skills in Hindi and English language.
Digital literacy including word processing database systems and PowerPoint.
Strong command of excel and budget management is a plus
About the Project
Project Concern International (PCI) India, with support from UNICEF, will implement the initiative in Jharkhand titled Convergent approach towards adolescent empowerment, reduction of child marriage and violence against women and children, prevention of family separation and strengthening social protection, focusing on equity. The project aims to prevent child marriage and violence against women and children, reduce family separation, and strengthen social protection systems with a strong focus on equity. The key focus of this project is to strengthen preventive work around ending child marriage, violence against children and promote prevention from family separation and social protection linkages through existing government platforms, programs and schemes. This project is to provide technical support to district administration in strengthening institutional mechanisms including child protection systems and convergence between government and non-governmental organizations for updating, implementing and reviewing district specific implementation plans and other interventions and targeted actions to accelerate reduction in child marriage in districts with high or increasing prevalence with focus on equity. It also includes supporting district to develop and implement social behaviour change strategies to address harmful social norms of child marriage and violence, capacity building of stakeholders, and facilitate identification and support to vulnerable children and their families. This comprehensive initiative operates at both systemic and community levels to create sustainable, equity-focused change in 12 high-prevalence districts and 9 tribal blocks. A dedicated project team will drive the initiatives forward by facilitating convergence among departments (WCD, Rural Development, JSLPS, PRI and others), enhancing CSO capacity, institutionalizing community based monitoring systems, and document best practices to inform state policy. This partnership seeks to catalyze systemic change, strengthen government-CSO coordination, and accelerate Jharkhand s progress toward becoming child marriage-free while ensuring protection and empowerment for all adolescents.
Key Responsibilities
Facilitate in district-level implementation of the project, under the guidance of state team and leadership of district administration, achieving restits within the stipdated time frame.
Facilitate development/update, implernentation, and review of District Action/lmplementation Plans to end child marriage and violence against children and adolescent empowerment with integration of Mental Health Psycho-SociaI Support and Family Based Care components.
Strengthen coordination among District Child Protection Unit (DCPU), Child Wdfare Committees, Police, Education, Jharkhand State Livelihood Promotion Society, Panchayati Raj Institution, District Legal Services Authority, and Civil Society Organizations for integrated case management and reducing vulnerabilities through linkages with various schemes of the government including sponsorship, foster care, Savitri bai Phule Scheme, etc.
Co-ordinate with Panchayati Raj Department for strengthening Standing Committee on Women and Child Development (Child Welfare Protection Committee), DLCC and operationalising Gram panchayat Help Desks as social protection clinics and activating Child Welfare Protection Committees in selected blocks.
Support in organizing and facilitate quarterly review meetings to track implementation of child protection plans and convergence mechanisms at Nie district level.
Support improved case management practices, including timely referral and follow-up for child victims of sexual abuse by developing/strengthening coordination mechanism
Assist the department to organize capacity-building sessions for local NGOs, JSLPS teams,
frontline workers, teachers, PRI members, and community leaders using UNICEF s toolkits.
Develop and maintain district-level local support groups/master trainers for regular refresher training.
Leverage existing platforms for community mobilization and awareness campaigns on child rights, prevention of child marriage, trafficking, and violence.
Facilitate access to Mental Health Psycho-SociaI Support services for children, adolescents, parents, and caregivers.
Maintain district-level data, MOVs (Means of Verification) and submit regular reports to the state team, facilitate case/change stories documentation and participate and contribute in review meetings.

Description:
World Change Starts with Educated Children
IMPORTANT: All applicants must be legally eligible to work in the country where the position is located. Room to Read is not able to provide sponsorship.
The Associate, Numeracy Field will support the Program Officer in strengthening foundational numeracy implementation in Ramgarh, Jharkhand through district and block-level planning, technical support, government system strengthening, supervision of Project Field Coordinators, data use, monitoring, and documentation. The Associate will work closely with district and block education officials, including BEEOs, BPOs, BPMs, BRPs, CRPs, Head Teachers and DIET, to strengthen government-led academic support systems under the NIPUN Bharat Mission. The position will also support academic platforms such as Cluster Academic Meetings, Block Academic Reviews and Gurugosthi, ensuring that these platforms use implementation and foundational numeracy data to identify priorities, develop action plans and follow up on agreed actions.
The Associate will report to the Program Officer and will supervise and provide technical and mentoring support to Project Field Coordinators in assigned blocks.
Responsibilities
Programme Planning, Management & Implementation
Develop a strong understanding of Room to Reads Foundational Numeracy program design and the NIPUN Bharat guidelines, NCF-FS, NCF-SE and SCF-Jharkhand.
Support the district lead in planning, coordinating, and implementing district foundational numeracy priorities within the DPMU structure, ensuring alignment with program goals and budgets.
Develop and maintain district, block, cluster, BRP, CRP, and school profiles to identify numeracy implementation priorities and prepare district heat maps for targeted academic support.
Flag key implementation issues, coordinate timely resolution with programme teams and DEO/BEO and BRP/CRP, and support the delivery of planned activities.
Plan and monitor implementation strategies based on priority areas, ensuring effective allocation of Project Field Coordinators (PFCs), training, mentoring, and follow-up support.
Supervise PFCs by reviewing monthly work plans, monitoring field performance, ensuring data quality, and strengthening their technical and mentoring capacities.
Support and facilitate numeracy training programmes, academic review meetings, and professional learning platforms for BRPs, CRPs, Head Teachers, and teachers, in coordination with the district lead and relevant government stakeholders.
Represent the numeracy programme at relevant district- and block-level forums, as assigned, and maintain effective coordination and professional relationships with government stakeholders.
Technical & Academic Support for Foundational Numeracy
Provide technical support on foundational numeracy pedagogy, classroom practices, assessment and academic mentoring to BRPs, CRPs, Head Teachers and Teachers.
Support government stakeholders to implement foundational numeracy practices consistently during school visits, mentoring visits, and academic review discussions at district and block levels.
Support DEO and BEO in coordination with District lead to analyze and use foundational numeracy assessment data to identify block-wise learning gaps, prioritize areas for academic support, and informed evidence-based planning and decision-making.
Conduct and support foundational numeracy-focused classroom observations and provide constructive, actionable feedback to PFCs and academic support personnel.
Support PFCs in using foundational numeracy assessment data to identify childrens learning needs and plan appropriate academic support to teachers.
Support the development, adaptation and use of numeracy observation tools, training resources and guidance materials in collaboration with DIET and district education officials.
Strengthen the technical capacity of PFCs to provide effective support on foundational numeracy pedagogy, classroom observation, academic mentoring, and data use.
Strengthen government-led academic support systems under the NIPUN Bharat Mission through coordinated engagement with district, block, cluster, school, and DIET stakeholders.
Track action points from Cluster Academic Meetings, Block Academic Reviews, and Gurugosthi, and support officials to close agreed actions within defined timelines.
Stay updated on relevant national and state education policies and initiatives, including NEP, NIPUN Bharat, NCF and SCF-Jharkhand, and support the Program Officer in translating relevant priorities into district and block-level implementation.
Supervision & Field Support
Conduct regular joint visits with district and block education officials and Project Field Coordinators as per defined touchpoints to provide supportive supervision, technical guidance, and implementation monitoring.
Support DEO and BEO in reviewing the district and block-wise progress towards the overall goals and learning outcomes of the NIPUN Bharat Mission, identifying key bottlenecks, and strengthening academic support strategies to improve foundational numeracy learning outcomes.
Review field observations, implementation progress, and data submitted by Project Field Coordinators (PFCs) to ensure timely reporting, data quality, and adherence to programme standards.
Analyse monitoring, assessment, and implementation data to identify trends, implementation gaps, and priority areas, and provide actionable insights to support programme planning, implementation, and decision-making.
Prepare and submit timely weekly, monthly, and other programme reports, documenting key achievements, challenges, lessons learned, action points and recommendations for continuous programme improvement.
Monitoring, Evaluation & Learning
Collaborate with the Data and Evaluation team to implement and maintain programme monitoring and evaluation activities.
Support the district lead in the synthesis of monitoring and evaluation findings and preparation of concise programme summaries.
Use evidence from classroom observations, assessments, and implementation data to identify programme quality issues & gaps and prioritize block-wise priorities and support continuous improvement.
Qualifications
Required
Bachelor's degree in education / mathematics / social sciences or equivalent
Master's degree in education / mathematics / social sciences or equivalent preferred
Minimum 3 years of relevant experience in the education sector, particularly in foundational learning, teacher support, academic mentoring, school improvement, education programmes or related areas.
In-depth knowledge of foundational numeracy, its pedagogies, and classroom implementation strategies.
Strong written and oral communication skills.
Critical thinking and analytical skills
Good interpersonal skills and a team player
Proven track record of achieving results.
Proven ability to work effectively with schools and communities.

Take necessary preventive actions and measures of counselling wherever necessary
Take necessary disciplinary actions wherever required to ensure harmonious and productive environment on the shop floor.
Lead Quality Circle, SDT, improvement projects.
Ensure Statutory Compliance of the factory he/she is responsible for : Monitoring Statutory compliances such as ESI,PF, Minimum wages, maternity benefit, Bonus Act & Submission of returns
3. Liaise with employees, Union Leaders, line managers, divisional heads & factory heads:
Work closely with line managers for improvement in production, interacts with shop supervisors, managers, function heads.
Implement long term settlements, wage negotiations clauses, Bonus settlements, union elections and other critical items as and when they are due & manage industrial relations.
Provide inputs to the ER head for preparing management demands.
Provide cross-functional support to administration, communication and productivity services, safety team.
Resolve ER issues at the plant level striving for no/minimum loss to business/ corporate image.
Maintain cordial relations with all stake holders in order to ensure smooth functioning on the shop floor.
Implement location level ER priorities in consultation with Factory Head, Shop heads & ER Head.
Identify risks and opportunities in the respective factory location and put in place plans to mitigate the same.
4. Drive initiatives to motivate bargainable employees:
Identify and implement welfare activities including sports for blue collar workers in line with organizational guidelines
Organize regular Reward & Recognition functions like the long service awards
Plan and organize various family events or departmental picnics.
Be responsible for a set of employees in shop/area for engagement, growth, recognition,
Self –Directed teams , SQDCME (Safety / Quality/ Delivery/ Cost/ Morale and Environment)
Stakeholder Profiles & Nature of Interactions
Internal
Employees: Regular Liaising & proactive IR
Block Union Representatives / Line Managers/Divisional Heads/Factory Heads : Regular Interaction and communication for smooth functioning.
Shared services, Construction, Safety, Administration, Medical: To assist workmen in resolving their grievances
ER Team: Regular Interaction between factories for good flow of management ideas.
External
Labour Department & Government Agencies: For Statutory Requirements
Industry Associations: Participation in industry associations and forums related to Industrial Relations to stay informed about trends, regulations, and emerging practices.
Desired Candidate Profile
Education : Post Graduate in Human Resources.
Relevant Experience : 5+ years of experience in HR / ER with exposure to handling blue collared workers extensively.

Description:
Job Description (JD) Diploma Apprentice Trainee
Position: Diploma Apprentice Trainee - Production/Quality
Department: Production / Manufacturing
Location: Plant Operations
Reporting To: Production Line Manager / Shift In-Charge
Job Purpose
To assist the Production Line Manager in day-to-day manufacturing operations, ensure smooth production flow, support achievement of daily production targets, and develop practical knowledge of manufacturing processes, quality standards, safety practices, and productivity improvement initiatives.
Key Responsibilities
Assist the Line Manager in monitoring and executing daily production activities as per the production plan.
Support achievement of daily, shift-wise, and monthly production targets.
Ensure availability of materials, tools, and components at the production line.
Monitor production processes and report abnormalities, breakdowns, or quality issues to the supervisor.
Maintain production records, reports, and process-related documentation.
Support implementation of 5S, Kaizen, Lean Manufacturing, and continuous improvement initiatives.
Ensure adherence to quality standards and company manufacturing procedures.
Follow all safety guidelines and promote a safe working environment.
Coordinate with Quality, Maintenance, Stores, and Production Planning teams for smooth operations.
Assist in reducing line stoppages, rework, rejection, and wastage.

About the role
We are seeking a dynamic and results-driven professional to lead the development of a world-class franchise model. The ideal candidate will be responsible for generating leads, managing the sales funnel, onboarding new franchisees, and ensuring both the growth and retention of franchise stores. In this role, you will play a critical part in expanding our franchise network by onboarding 50 new stores per month and driving sustainable revenue growth across the franchise portfolio.

Key Responsibilities

Franchise Acquisition & Expansion

• Strategic Acquisition Planning: Design and execute a comprehensive franchise acquisition strategy aligned with organizational growth targets.
• Pipeline Leadership: Oversee and optimize the full acquisition funnel, ensuring consistent inflow of high-quality prospects and timely conversions.
• Market Penetration: Identify high-potential markets and expansion zones, developing region-specific growth plans.
• Channel Diversification: Leverage digital, on-ground, partnerships, and referral ecosystems to expand franchise reach and strengthen lead quality.

Franchise Onboarding & Set-Up
• End-to-End Launch Ownership: Lead the onboarding and operational go-live of new franchise stores, ensuring all SOPs, processes, and compliance standards are met.
• Scale Management: Ensure successful onboarding of 50+ franchise stores per month, maintaining quality and standardization at scale.
• Capability Building: Establish robust training, enablement, and support frameworks to set new franchise partners up for long-term success.

Franchise Performance, Retention & Revenue Growth
• Portfolio Management: Oversee performance of the entire franchise portfolio, using data-driven insights to enhance store productivity and profitability.
• Retention & Engagement: Develop franchise retention programs, strengthen partner relationships, and proactively resolve operational challenges.
• Business Growth Initiatives: Drive revenue optimization initiatives, implement performance-improvement plans, and roll out business interventions to support consistent growth.
• Operational Excellence: Ensure adherence to brand standards, operational guidelines, and customer experience expectations across all franchise stores.

Qualifications
• Experience: Minimum 5+ years in Business Development, Franchise Management, or Multi-Unit Operations within FMCG, retail, food, logistics, or telecom
• Skills: Strong leadership, stakeholder management, strategic planning, communication, negotiation, and analytical capabilities.

Description:
About IIFL Finance Ltd
IIFL Finance is one of the most preferred Gold Loan financing company inIndia

Having presence in 25 states and a network of 2700+ branches on a PANIndia level, our mission is to cater to the needs of all those who are lookingfor an easy swift, and low-cost financing option

Our customers can avail gold loansthrough submitting an online application or visiting any of our branches intheir vicinity

We also have an option where the customers can avail gold loansat their doorstep so that they are not deprived of financing options to fulfilltheir needs

Our core values serve as a moral compass in all our activities

Fairness, Integrity, andTransparency - FIT is the driving force behind all that we do at IIFL

Weonly work with people who fit into our professional ethos

We are resolute inthe observance of these values and will let go of any growth opportunities thatdeem unfit

Group Company: IIFL Finance Ltd
Primary Responsibilities:
Attending to walk-in customers, addressingqueries about the gold loan process and schemes offered

Conducting gold valuations andidentifying gold purity accurately

Properly packing and storing gold andgold packets after loan disbursal

Returning gold ornaments to customers afterloan closure

Managing cash (system physical)during loan disbursals, interest collection, and loan closures

Create new CUID in system modifications in LOS during Disbursal, Part Release / Payments LoanClosure

Maintain branch registers as per theguidelines Key / Cash / Packet Movements, Staff Customer Visits etc
Ensuring proper collection and storageof customer KYC documents

Following up with customers for timelycollection of interest and principal payments

Providing good customer service at everystep ie while pledging, releasing, or making interest payments

Additional Responsibilities: Insummary, the Gold appraiser is responsible for the end-to-end transactionprocess for gold loans - from valuation to disbursal to closure, along withcustomer service

Incentives extra - Best in the industry

Description:
About IIFL Finance Ltd
IIFL Finance is one of the most preferred Gold Loan financing company inIndia

Having presence in 25 states and a network of 2700+ branches on a PANIndia level, our mission is to cater to the needs of all those who are lookingfor an easy swift, and low-cost financing option

Our customers can avail gold loansthrough submitting an online application or visiting any of our branches intheir vicinity

We also have an option where the customers can avail gold loansat their doorstep so that they are not deprived of financing options to fulfilltheir needs

Our core values serve as a moral compass in all our activities

Fairness, Integrity, andTransparency - FIT is the driving force behind all that we do at IIFL

Weonly work with people who fit into our professional ethos

We are resolute inthe observance of these values and will let go of any growth opportunities thatdeem unfit

Group Company: IIFL Finance Ltd
Primary Responsibilities:
Attending to walk-in customers, addressingqueries about the gold loan process and schemes offered

Conducting gold valuations andidentifying gold purity accurately

Properly packing and storing gold andgold packets after loan disbursal

Returning gold ornaments to customers afterloan closure

Managing cash (system physical)during loan disbursals, interest collection, and loan closures

Create new CUID in system modifications in LOS during Disbursal, Part Release / Payments LoanClosure

Maintain branch registers as per theguidelines Key / Cash / Packet Movements, Staff Customer Visits etc
Ensuring proper collection and storageof customer KYC documents

Following up with customers for timelycollection of interest and principal payments

Providing good customer service at everystep ie while pledging, releasing, or making interest payments

Additional Responsibilities: Insummary, the Gold appraiser is responsible for the end-to-end transactionprocess for gold loans - from valuation to disbursal to closure, along withcustomer service

CTC Upto 3 Lacs ( for Non-Metro) / 4

20 Lacs ( for Metro )
Incentives extra - Best in the industry

Description:
About IIFL Finance
IIFL Finance is one of the most preferred Gold Loan financing company inIndia

Having presence in 25 states and a network of 2700+ branches on a PANIndia level, our mission is to cater to the needs of all those who are lookingfor an easy swift, and low-cost financing option

Our customers can avail gold loansthrough submitting an online application or visiting any of our branches intheir vicinity

We also have an option where the customers can avail gold loansat their doorstep so that they are not deprived of financing options to fulfilltheir needs

Our core values serve as a moral compass in all our activities

Fairness, Integrity, andTransparency - FIT is the driving force behind all that we do at IIFL

Weonly work with people who fit into our professional ethos

We are resolute inthe observance of these values and will let go of any growth opportunities thatdeem unfit

Job Title Customer Care Executive (Gold Loans)
Job Description -
Responsible toacquire New Customers for generating Gold Loan business and for other cross sell products

Participate in field- marketing activities toimprove the brand visibility of IIFL Finance Limited branch in the catchment areas and generate leads of prospective customers

Drive ensure continuous customer engagement through various channels

Maintaining quality portfolio by trackingcontrolling ROI

Provide after salesservice to existing customers and obtain references from them to increase thecustomer base

Strong follow up on interest collectionsto keep NPAs (non-performing assets) under control

Desired Candidate Profile (CCE) -
Candidateswith 6 months of sales experience in Banking Financial Services can applyfor the role

Fresherswith flair in Sales can also apply

In summary,the role focuses heavily on sales - acquiring new customers, engaging withexisting ones, ensuring portfolio quality, and collecting payments to minimizedefaults

Brand building through field marketing is also a key component

CTC Upto 2

37 Lacs ( for Non Metro) / 2

8Lacs ( for Metro )
Incentives extra - Best in the industry

The firm provides retail and institutional clients with access to products such as home loans, business loans, mutual funds, and securities trading. With a strong presence across India, IIFL emphasizes trust, transparency, and customer-centric financial planning. Its career opportunities highlight roles in advisory, sales, technology, and operations, reflecting its commitment to growth and innovation in the financial sector.

Description:
Job Summary
Job Title: Operations Analyst
Corporate Title: Analyst
Location: Jaipur
Responsibilities
The person will be responsible for day-to-day review of voice logs between Client Relationship Managers (RC) and clients where trade details are discussed and agreed. They need to ensure that all key trade-related details are clearly discussed, accurately captured, and documented in the applicable product-specific template. The role requires strong attention to detail, adherence to defined review standards, timely completion of assigned production duties, and appropriate escalation of exceptions, missing information, or first-level queries within the pre-specified timelines. The candidate should also act as a backup for peers when required and share best practices with the team to support consistent quality delivery.
Review voice logs between RCs and clients to validate that trade details have been discussed and agreed as per the required standards.
Listen to and understand client discussions conducted in English and Chinese language (Mandarin and Cantonese) and accurately document the agreed details in English or the prescribed business template, as applicable.
Complete the relevant product-specific voice log review template with accurate details, observations, and outcome of the review.
Identify and highlight missing, incomplete, inconsistent, or unclear trade details and escalate exceptions to the relevant stakeholders within agreed timelines.
Ensure accurate and timely completion of daily production activities in line with defined SLAs, cut-off times, and quality expectations.
Perform quality checks on completed reviews to support consistency, audit readiness, and control effectiveness.
Assist in preparing and reviewing daily control / production reports, including tracking of open items, exceptions, and follow-ups.
Support follow-up with RC / business teams for clarification or resolution of deficiencies noted during voice log review.
Maintain proper documentation and evidence of review outcomes to support internal control, audit, and management reporting requirements.
Coordinate with team members and stakeholders on complex cases, escalations, reporting requirements, and process improvements.
Act as backup for peers during absence and support knowledge sharing, cross-training, and continuous improvement within the team.
Perform other administration, reporting, and control-related tasks as assigned.
Your skills and experience
Minimum educational qualification: University graduate with a Bachelor s Degree.
Chinese Language Proficiency (Mandarin and/or Cantonese): Candidate must be able to understand spoken client conversations, interpret financial and investment terminology, and accurately document agreed trade details in English using prescribed Voice Log Review templates.
Good command of business English for accurate documentation, exception reporting, and stakeholder communication.
Understanding of trade lifecycle, banking / wealth management products, or control review processes will be an added advantage.
Strong listening, comprehension, documentation, and analytical skills with high attention to detail.
Ability to identify gaps, inconsistencies, missing information, and potential control issues from recorded conversations.
Candidates are required to be proficient in Microsoft Office applications, especially Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.
Highly motivated, quality-focused, and able to work independently as well as collaboratively within a team environment.
Ability to multi-task and work under pressure to meet production timelines, cut-off times, and quality standards.
Good communication skills and ability to manage routine queries / first-level escalations professionally.
Proven ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, optimise workflows to solve business problems, while applying critical judgment to ensure responsible and ethical use of data and AI outputs.

Job description
Job Title: Business Development Manager/Senior Manager
Employment Type: Full-Time

About the Role
We are seeking a dynamic and execution-focused Business Development Manager to lead market expansion and partnership initiatives in Kolkata/Bangalore/Rajasthan. The role will be responsible for identifying growth opportunities, driving site acquisitions (if retail/F&B), building strategic alliances, and delivering revenue targets in line with the companys regional expansion strategy.
This is a high-ownership role requiring strong commercial acumen, negotiation skills, and on-ground market intelligence.

Key Responsibilities
1 Market Expansion & Strategy
Develop and execute growth strategy aligned with regional objectives.
Identify high-potential micro-markets within Kolkata/Hyderabad/Haryana and secondary cities.
Conduct feasibility analysis including catchment, competition mapping, and revenue projections.
Build pipeline of priority opportunities.
2 Site Identification & Acquisition (Retail / F&B focused)
Source and evaluate high-street and mall locations.
Negotiate commercial terms.
Liaise with landlords, developers, brokers, and mall management.
Coordinate with legal and finance teams for deal closure.
3 Partnerships & Alliances
Develop relationships with local partners, developers, and institutional stakeholders.
Identify potential JV or franchise opportunities (if applicable).
Represent company in networking forums and industry events.
4 Financial & Commercial Analysis
Build unit-level P&L projections.
Evaluate commercial viability including payback for proposed sites/partnerships.
Monitor performance of newly launched units vs projections.
5 Cross-functional Coordination
Work closely with operations, marketing, finance, and legal teams.
Ensure seamless transition from site acquisition to store launch.
Drive project timelines from sourcing to opening.
Key Requirements
Bachelors degree in Business, Finance, Real Estate, or related field.
510 years of experience in Business Development / Real Estate Expansion / Retail Leasing / F&B Expansion.
Strong network within the state and key cities.
Proven experience negotiating leases and commercial agreements.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to operate independently in a fast-paced environment.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience expanding brands.
Exposure to mall / Highstreet leasing.
Familiarity with local licensing and regulatory processes.
Experience in multi-unit expansion environment.
What We Offer
Competitive compensation (Base + Performance Bonus).
Leadership exposure in a high-growth market.
Opportunity to build and scale operations.
Regional career progression

Description:
Job Summary
Job Title: Operations Expert, AVP
Location: Bangalore, India
Deutsche Bank is committed to being the best financial services provider in the world, balancing passion with precision to deliver superior solutions for our clients. This is made possible by our people: agile minds, able to see beyond the obvious and act effectively in an ever-changing global business landscape. As you'll discover, our culture supports diverse perspectives, driven by a shared sense of purpose.
Margin Operations is responsible for minimizing Deutsche Bank's counterparty credit risk on its collateralized derivatives portfolio. We aggregate the Bank's exposure across trading activity globally, administer the margin terms dictated in bilateral ISDA and CSA (Credit Support Annex) Agreements and facilitate exchange of permissible collateral (cash or securities) with our clients or central clearing counterparties. The team also manages Margin Disputes, regulatory Portfolio Reconciliation and Data Control flowing into the margining systems for APAC, EMEA and US regions.
Your key responsibilities
Be a central point of contact for external clients on valuations and responding / resolving their queries / disputes in a timely and professional manner and having to build strong working relationships with various front and back offices departments globally
Coordinate with such areas as Trading, Sales, Product control and Middle Office to resolve escalated customer inquiries and disputes
Close interaction with regional and global teams to ensure consistency in procedures and policy and to stay aware of organizational objectives
Keep Management informed of the exceptional occurrences, to enable appropriate action
Manage risks relating to specific processes and identify any deviations from established policies and guidelines
Re-engineering the current process to meet the changing needs of the business. Leading/contributing to various projects which are kicked off in the department to increase efficiency in the process.
Manage operational risk by checking strength of existing controls and recommend/implement new or improved controls
Expected to monitor KPIs and KRIs of the process.
Lead and contribute to Global initiatives that could be strategic and tactical in nature
Knowledge of TriResolve, Acadiasoft is must
Knowledge of Tableau, Alteryx and other self-service analytical and data interpretation tools will be an advantage
Your skills and experience
Strong organisational skills; ability to identify and prioritise multiple tasks based on criticality, impact and franchise importance.
Exceptional communication skills - verbal, written and presentation.
Independent problem solver who demonstrates accountability as well as execution capability.
Ability to independently coordinate and manage work requirements across multiple business areas and functions.
Ability to work in a fast-paced, highly regulated environment.
Ability to connect with people as well as desire to learn process flows. Dedication to servicing a demanding internal and external client base.
Ability to mentor and coach the new joiners. Professional skills
Degree educated in Finance, Commerce or related field, or have a minimum of 6 years of work experience in a Banking/Finance environment.
Experience working in a global, cross matrix reporting organization
Should have detailed understating of Derivatives, Trade Life Cycle, UnCleared Margin Rules, reconciliations and settlements processes
Microsoft Excel skills to a good standard.
Proven ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, optimise workflows to solve business problems, while applying critical judgment to ensure responsible and ethical use of data and AI outputs.

About IIFL Finance Ltd
IIFL Finance is one of the most preferred Gold Loan financing company inIndia

Having presence in 25 states and a network of 2700+ branches on a PANIndia level, our mission is to cater to the needs of all those who are lookingfor an easy swift, and low-cost financing option

Our customers can avail gold loansthrough submitting an online application or visiting any of our branches intheir vicinity

We also have an option where the customers can avail gold loansat their doorstep so that they are not deprived of financing options to fulfilltheir needs

Our core values serve as a moral compass in all our activities

Fairness, Integrity, andTransparency - FIT is the driving force behind all that we do at IIFL

Weonly work with people who fit into our professional ethos

We are resolute inthe observance of these values and will let go of any growth opportunities thatdeem unfit

Group Company: IIFL Finance Ltd
Primary Responsibilities:
Attending to walk-in customers, addressingqueries about the gold loan process and schemes offered

Conducting gold valuations andidentifying gold purity accurately

Properly packing and storing gold andgold packets after loan disbursal

Returning gold ornaments to customers afterloan closure

Managing cash (system physical)during loan disbursals, interest collection, and loan closures

Create new CUID in system modifications in LOS during Disbursal, Part Release / Payments LoanClosure

Maintain branch registers as per theguidelines Key / Cash / Packet Movements, Staff Customer Visits etc
Ensuring proper collection and storageof customer KYC documents

Following up with customers for timelycollection of interest and principal payments

Providing good customer service at everystep ie while pledging, releasing, or making interest payments

Additional Responsibilities: Insummary, the Gold appraiser is responsible for the end-to-end transactionprocess for gold loans - from valuation to disbursal to closure, along withcustomer service

CTC Upto 3 Lacs ( for Non-Metro) / 4

20 Lacs ( for Metro )
Incentives extra - Best in the industry

Description:
POSITION SUMMARY
Check figures, postings, and documents for accuracy. Organize, secure, and maintain all files, records, cash and cash equivalents in accordance with policies and procedures. Record, store, access, and/or analyze computerized financial information. Classify, code, and summarize numerical and financial data to compile and keep financial records, using journals, ledgers, and/or computers. Prepare, maintain, audit, and distribute statistical, financial, accounting, auditing, or payroll reports and tables. Complete period-end closing procedures and reports as specified. Prepare, review, reconcile, and issue bills, invoices, and account statements according to company procedures. Follow-up and resolve past due accounts and vendor invoices until payment in full is received or resolved.
Coordinate tasks and work with other departments; serve as a departmental role model or mentor; assign and ensure work tasks are completed on time and that they meet appropriate quality standards. Report work related accidents, or other injuries immediately upon occurrence to manager/supervisor. Follow all company policies and procedures; ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional; maintain confidentiality of proprietary information; protect company assets. Speak with others using clear and professional language; prepare and review written documents accurately and completely; answer telephones using appropriate etiquette. Develop and maintain positive working relationships with others; support team to reach common goals; listen and respond appropriately to the concerns of other employees. Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 10 pounds without assistance. Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Education: High school diploma or G.E.D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: At least 1 year of related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.
License or Certification: None

Description:
CustomerCare Executive IIFL Gold Loan (Detailed JD)

RoleOverview
A CustomerCare Executive (CCE) at IIFLFinance (Gold Loan division) is responsible for handlingcustomers at the branch, supporting loan processing, and ensuringsmooth service experience .
Insimple terms:
Youare the first point of contact for customers and the support systemfor the branch team.




CoreResponsibilities

1. Customer Handling Service
Welcome and assist walk-in customers
Understand customer requirements (loan, renewal, closure)
Explain:
Gold loan process
Interest rates
Repayment options
Ensure excellent customer experience and quick service




2. Documentation KYC Processing
Collect and verify:
Aadhaar / PAN
Address proof
Photographs
Ensure proper KYC compliance as per RBI norms
Fill and process loan application forms
Maintain accurate customer records




3. Loan Processing Support
Coordinate with:
Gold Appraiser
Branch Manager
Assist in:
Loan entry in system
Documentation completion
Ensure fast turnaround time (TAT) for disbursement




4. Customer Follow-ups Telecalling
Call customers for:
Loan renewals
Interest payments
Overdue reminders
Handle inbound customer queries
Maintain relationship with existing customers




5. Data Entry MIS Management
Enter customer and loan details into company systems
Maintain:
Daily transaction records
Customer database
Generate basic reports for branch operations




6. Cash Handling Support (in some branches)
Assist in:
Cash collection (interest/repayment)
Receipt generation
Ensure proper cash reconciliation at end of day




7. Branch Coordination
Support smooth coordination between:
Customers
Appraisers
Sales staff
Help manage:
Customer queue
Branch workflow




8. Compliance Process Adherence
Follow:
Company policies
RBI guidelines
Ensure error-free documentation
Support audits and verification processes




KeySkills Required

FunctionalSkills
Basic knowledge of:
Banking/NBFC processes
Documentation KYC
Computer skills (MS Excel, data entry systems)


BehavioralSkills
Good communication (Hindi/English + local language)
Customer handling patience
Attention to detail
Multitasking ability




EligibilityCriteria
Graduate (preferred) or 12th pass
03 years of experience in:
Customer service
Banking/NBFC
Retail or telecalling
Freshers are often hired




KPIs(Performance Metrics)
Customer satisfaction levels
Accuracy of documentation
Turnaround time (TAT)
Number of customer interactions handled
Follow-up conversion (renewals, payments)




RealisticNature of the Role
Entry-level role in NBFC structure
Repetitive but fast-paced work
High interaction with customers
Moderate pressure during peak business hours
Important support role but not core decision-making




Day-to-DayWork
Typicalday includes:
Handling walk-in customers
Completing KYC and documentation
Coordinating loan processing
Calling customers for follow-ups
Updating system records




CareerPath
Growthopportunities in **IIFL Finance Gold Loan:
Customer Care Executive
Senior CCE / Operations Executive
Assistant Branch Manager
Branch Manager
Territory Manager

Job Title - Branch Manager (Gold Loans)


Job Summary
In summary, the Branch Manager oversees end-to-end branch operations, business growth, compliance, portfolio quality and team performance. Key responsibilities include operational management, business acquisition and collections, compliance and infrastructure upkeep, team leadership and motivation.


Responsibilities
Responsible for business growth, new customer acquisition, customer service, overall branch operations compliance.
Drives field marketing and continuous customer acquisition engagement in catchment area to meet branch targets for gold loans and other financial products.
Maintains portfolio quality by tracking gold quality and ROI.
Ensures valuation, process compliance, timely system approvals for loans.
Coordinates with audit teams; maintains registers and displays.
Follows up for interest collections to control NPAs; handles auctions.
Monitors team's activities across gold loans, cash, documents, leads generated and new customer acquisition.
Coaches, mentors, and trains team; provides timely feedback and motivation.
Maintains branch infrastructure and hygiene standards.


Desired Candidate Profile
Candidate with minimum 5 Years of experience in Banking Financial services can be looked at for the role.
Prior Gold Loan Team Handling experience will be preferred.

Achieves personal and team related revenue goals. Verifies business is turned over properly and in a timely fashion for proper service delivery. Responsible for driving customer/guest loyalty by delivering service excellence throughout each customer/guest experience. Provides service to customers in order to grow the account on behalf of the company.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- High school diploma or GED; 2 years experience in the sales and marketing, guest services, front desk, or related professional area.
OR
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Business Administration, Marketing, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; no work experience required.
CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Understanding Market Opportunities Driving Revenue
- Targets group/catering accounts, markets, or segments with heavy emphasis on proactive solicitation and account saturation.
- Partners with group/catering counterpart to effectively manage the business opportunity.
- Responds to incoming group/catering opportunities for the property that are outside parameters of the .
- Handles all opportunities if property does not participate in an EBC.
- Identifies, qualifies and solicits new group/catering business to achieve personal and each property s revenue goals.
- Focuses efforts on group/catering accounts with significant potential sales revenue.
- Develops effective group/catering sales plans and actions.
- Designs, develops and sells creative catered events.
- Maximizes revenue by upselling packages and creative food and beverage.
- Understands the overall market - competitors strengths and weaknesses, economic trends, supply and demand etc. and knows how to sell against them.
- Closes the best opportunities for each property based on market conditions and individual property needs.
- Uses negotiating skills and creative selling abilities to close on business and negotiate contracts.
Providing Exceptional Customer Service
- Handles complex business with significant revenue potential as well as significant customer expectations.
- Builds and strengthens relationships with existing and new customers to enable future bookings. Activities include sales calls, entertainment, FAM trips, trade shows, etc.
- Develops relationships within community to strengthen and expand customer base for group/catering sales opportunities.
- Supports brand s Service and Relationship Strategy, driving customer loyalty by delivering service excellence throughout each customer experience.
- Provides excellent customer service in order to grow share of the account.
- Executes brand s Customer Service Standards and property s Brand Standards.
- Executes and supports the business Customer Service Standards and property s Brand Standards.
- Participates in and practices daily service basics of the brand.
- Executes exemplary customer service to drive customer satisfaction and loyalty by assisting the customer and ensuring their satisfaction before and during their program/event.
- Serves the customer by understanding their needs and recommending the appropriate features and services that best meet their needs and exceed their expectations, while building a relationship and loyalty to the property and brand.
- Gains understanding of the property s primary target customer and service expectations; serves the customer by understanding their business, business issues and concerns, to offer better business solution both prior to, and during the program/event.
Building Successful Relationships
- Works collaboratively with off-property sales channels (e.g., , Market Sales, Strategic Accounts) to ensure sales efforts are coordinated, complementary and not duplicative.
- Manages and develops relationships with key internal and external stakeholders.
- Uses sales resources and administrative/support staff.

- Conducts site inspections.
