Description:
Skill required: Procure to Pay - Accounts Payable Process

Designation: Procure to Pay Operations Senior Manager

Qualifications:CA Inter/ICWA(Inter)

Years of Experience:16 to 25 years
About Accenture
Accenture is a global professional services company with leading capabilities in digital, cloud and security.Combining unmatched experience and specialized skills across more than 40 industries, we offer Strategy and Consulting, Technology and Operations services, and Accenture Song- all powered by the world's largest network of Advanced Technology and Intelligent Operations centers. Our 784,000 people deliver on the promise of technology and human ingenuity every day, serving clients in more than 120 countries. We embrace the power of change to create value and shared success for our clients, people, shareholders, partners and communities.Visit us at www.accenture.com

What would you do?
You will be aligned with our Finance Operations vertical and will be helping us in determining financial outcomes by collecting operational data or reports, whilst conducting analysis and reconciling transactions. You will be working on audit claims in accordance with client policies and procedures.You will work on save or post invoice in ERP, Tax components and discrepancy resolution.
You will be working as a part of Procure to Pay Processing team which is responsible for accounting of goods and services through requisitioning, purchasing and receiving which denotes order sequence of procurement and financial process end to end.
In Invoice Processing Operations you will ensure efficient and accurate processing of expense invoices or claims in adherence with client policy and procedures.
You will also be required to post the invoices for payment and work on PO Process, Non PO, credit note, 2 way Match & 3 Way Match, Email management and ERP Knowledge , managing purchase and non-purchase orders and two-way and three-way matching of invoices.

What are we looking for?
Primary skill - Accounts Payable Process - P4
Written and verbal communication
SAP, COUPA Payables
Boosting vendor compliance, cutting savings erosion, improving discount capture using preferred suppliers, and in confirming pricing and terms prior to payment. Responsible for accounting of goods and services, through requisitioning, purchasing and receiving. Also look after order sequence of procurement and financial process end to end. The Accounts Payable Processing team focuses on designing, implementing, managing and supporting accounts payable activities by applying the relevant processes, policies and applications. The team is responsible for timely and accurate billing and processing


Roles and Responsibilities:
To ensure availability of resources within the team and effective management of the team
To monitor & evaluate the performance of the team in all areas
To ensure that results are in accordance with agreed metrics and the operating plan
Define the standards and reusable approaches within a broad operational framework
Initiate and design business process excellence improvements
To participate in development, implementation and maintenance of policies, objectives, short-and long-range planning, develop and implements projects and programs to assist in accomplishment of established goals
Accountable for ongoing maintenance of effective client service relationship in the area of business and PTP tower as well, by acting as first point of contact for client representatives

Qualification
CA Inter,ICWA(Inter)

Description:
Human Resources Coordinator
Create and maintain filing systems.
Create and type office correspondence using a computer.
Distribute and route mail.
Order and track Human Resources office supplies and forms.
Answer phone calls and record messages.
Create new employee personnel file.
Assist walk-in candidates with application procedures.
Maintain space designated for completing applications and ensure it is clean, well maintained, and accessible to individuals with disabilities.
Respond to questions, requests, and concerns from employees and management regarding company and Human Resources programs, policies and guidelines.
Inform Human Resources management of issues related to employee relations within the division or property.
Maintain confidentiality and security of employee and property records, files, and information.
Ensure accurate maintece of all employee records and files (eg, interview documents, I-9s).
Follow all company policies and procedures; ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional; maintain confidentiality of proprietary information; protect company assets.
Report accidents, injuries, and unsafe work conditions to manager.
Welcome and acknowledge all guests according to company standards.
Speak with others using clear and professional language; prepare and review written documents accurately and completely; answer telephones using appropriate etiquette.
Develop and maintain positive working relationships with others; support team to reach common goals; listen and respond appropriately to the concerns of other employees.
Ensure adherence to quality expectations and standards.
Enter and locate work-related information using computers and/or point of sale systems.
Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 10 pounds without assistance.
Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Education: High school diploma or G. E. D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: At least 1 year of related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.
License or Certification: None
At Marriott International, we are dedicated to being an equal opportunity employer, welcoming all and providing access to opportunity.
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Adaptable and flexible

Good Written Communication
MS Office
Team working

Description:
Job Title: Workplace Facility Management Associate Manager
Management Level: CL 8 (Associate Manager)
Work Location:Jaipur
Must have Skills: Experience in Integrated Facility Management and Administration

Educational Qualification: Graduate/Postgraduate in any discipline. An engineering degree in Electrical/Mechanical or a full time MBA or both would be an added advantage.
Department: Accenture Workplace Solutions, Corporate Functions
Job Summary
Workplace Operations is responsible for overseeing the day-to-day management of integrated facilities across assigned locations, ensuring seamless delivery of services aligned with business needs, compliance requirements, and corporate standards. The role involves managing vendor performance, engineering services, statutory compliance, real estate coordination, audits, and stakeholder engagement. The candidate will also lead workplace experience initiatives, support sustainability and EHS goals, drive team development, and ensure smooth operations during business continuity or crisis situations. A strong focus on service quality, operational efficiency, and client satisfaction is essential. The role is instrumental in creating a productive, safe, and engaging workplace environment that enhances employee experience and supports business continuity.
Role and Responsibilities
Integrated Facility management
Plan, manage, and oversee day-to-day workplace operations for assigned locations.
Conduct daily/weekly/monthly/quarterly service reviews with service partner teams. Ensure delivery of daily onsite facility management services including asset management, engineering, building maintenance, cleaning, office services, mail delivery, logistics and storage services.
Ensure workplace operations meet or exceed service delivery and corporate standards in line with global/local policies.
Drive the Service Partner to execute the deliverables as per the agreed scope of works and review the performance as per schedule.
Manage operating and capital budgets in coordination with site operations and commercial teams for geography or location.
Govern Service delivery partner and vendor performance using SLAs, KPIs, OLAs, and other tracking mechanisms.
Maintain high service quality by identifying weak areas and implementing corrective actions.
Monitor and document MIS/reporting processes, including weekly/fortnightly/monthly /quarterly calendars.
Deploy global changes to policies, operating models, and best practices.
Maintain a healthy working environment, and foster employee productivity by ensuring a functional, safe, and engaging workplace.
Engineering and Technical Services
Oversee engineering infrastructure and keep a track of service partners performance by reviewing the uptime of all engineering assets and performance as per agreed OLAs.
Collaborate on RM planning, and drive OPEX/CAPEX initiatives aligned with sustainability and safety.
Track and manage M E Opex and Capex budgets for engineering services efficiently.
Support implementation of sustainability and energy efficiency initiatives.
Statutory Compliance and Risks
Ensure compliance with all statutory norms and third-party vendor (TPV) legal requirements.
Liaise with all stakeholders/teams who are part of the process: Legal, HR, TPV, AEE, Contract Management, and Commercial teams to fulfil obligations.
Track license renewals (e.g. lifts, fire NOCs, building safety, water quality, etc.).
Maintain documentation for health, safety, and environment-related regulations.
Lead responses to all auditsinternal, external, client, statutory, and process audits covering the workplace operations.
Corporate Real Estate (CRE)
Engage with landlords on all operational issues and lease terms on a monthly basis.
Ensure all contractual obligations are being fulfilled by both parties.
Escalate RE MSA or CAM related issues or violations to CRE leads.
Support site selection and site disposition and extend all necessary support to Workplace leads, CRE POC, Controllership and Procurement, including risk-free handovers and formal process closure.
Coordinate with CRE, procurement, and finance during acquisition/disposition.
Workplace Governance and Client Relationship Management
Conduct structured CRM connects with key business stakeholders (DU Leads, MDs, SDLs, etc.).
Present KPI delivery metrics and track escalation resolution within a reasonable time frame (SNOW, M E, Events, Travel, etc.).
Monitor and drive monthly client engagement activities (townhalls, bay walks, FGDs).
Maintain strong client satisfaction by acting on feedback and enabling resolution of workplace issues.
Security, EHS, and Business Continuity
Oversee physical and electronic security controls, including CCTV, access controls, and fire safety.
Lead response efforts during BCP or crisis events and participate in LMT calls.
Ensure site compliance with EHS protocols and wellness standards.
Supervise wellness facilities such as gyms, wellness rooms, ambulance support, etc.
Good knowledge of ISO standards like ISO45K, ISO27001, ISO14K, ISO22301.
Cafeteria Management
Oversee aggregator managed cafeteria operations and ensure compliance to the SLAs. Oversee vendor selection, hygiene and sanitation standards, and quality of food and ensure adherence to EHS and GAP standards, and other statutory compliance.
Lead Food Committee Reviews and ensure feedback is acted upon by the vendor.
Oversee licenses and documentation for food services.
Team Management
Right-size direct and extended vendor teams; ensure role clarity and workload balance.
Ensure timely completion of mandatory training programs for all personnel, both direct and TPV service partner teams.
Deliver feedback and performance reviews to the team members and drive team engagement activities.
Promote a culture of innovation and employee well-being.
Stakeholder Engagement Special Events
Extend support for high-profile visits, including global leaders and clients.
Participate in showcasing workplace capabilities during such events.
Liaise with SMT, P+ teams, and central/managed services (Events, CPSM, Travel) to ensure operational harmony.
Projects and Transitions
Oversee seamless handover of newly completed WP projects into operations.
Actively contribute during transition stages to ensure business readiness.
Professional Technical Skills:
Strong leadership and team management skills with a track record of driving operational excellence.
Strong organisational and planning skills with attention to detail.
Proven experience in managing multi-disciplinary teams and external stakeholders.
Effective communication (English, Hindi, and preferably Marathi) and interpersonal skills.
Excellent problem-solving, decision-making, and negotiation skills.
Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
Strong analytical and reporting abilities (MIS, KPIs, OLAs).
Crisis management and business continuity planning (BCP) experience.
Change management and adaptability to global process changes.
Strong presentation and documentation skills.
Proficient in MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint, word, working knowledge of Power BI and Power Apps preferred.
Additional Information:
The ideal candidate should be a person of high integrity and moral values with strong leadership skills.
This position is based out of Jaipur offices.



Qualification
Good to have Skills: Microsoft office, Power BI
Experience: Min 12 - 15 years of experience in Facility management and administration with IT/ITES Sectors.

Strong problem-solving skills and adaptability

What would you do?
You will be aligned with our Finance Operations vertical and will be helping us in determining financial outcomes by collecting operational data/reports, whilst conducting analysis and reconciling transactions. Posting journal entries, preparing balance sheet reconciliations, reviewing entries and reconciliations, preparing cash forecasting statement, supporting month end closing, preparing reports and supports in audits. The Account Reconciliation team focuses on general ledger accounting which contains a summary of sub-ledger accounts. The role requires a good understanding of P&L accounts, bookkeeping, journal entries, voucher entry, trial balance, and month-end reporting. Ways of Working - Mandate 3 : Employees to be located in their place of posting / respective office base location.
About Swiggy: 
Swiggy is Indias leading on-demand delivery platform with a tech-first approach to logistics and a solution-first approach to consumer demands. With a presence in 500+ cities across India, partnerships with hundreds of thousands of restaurants, an employee base of over 5000, a 2 lakh+ strong independent fleet of Delivery Executives, we deliver unparalleled convenience driven by continuous innovation. Built on the back of robust ML technology and fuelled by terabytes of data processed every day, Swiggy offers a fast, seamless and reliable delivery experience for millions of customers across India. From starting out as a hyperlocal food delivery service in 2014, to becoming India’s leading on-demand convenience platform today, our capabilities result not only in lightning-fast delivery for customers, but also in a productive and fulfilling experience for our employees.
Overview
A Sales Manager owns the acquisition and engagement of single-outlet independent restaurants across an assigned city.
You are the primary touchpoint for these restaurants - learning their business, understanding their challenges, and building a partnership where you help the restaurant partner directly drive their growth in orders, visibility, and customer engagement.
This role is Consultative & On-Field and requires you to be resourceful, adaptable, and genuinely invested in your partners' success.
You'll develop consultative sales skills, learn restaurant operations intimately, and build the foundation for scaling your career.
Key Responsibilities
-Own a defined geographic territory: build strong and successful relationships with the assigned restaurant partners
-Field-intensive engagement: Conduct in-person visits, walking restaurants through product demos, ROI analysis, and present how working with Swiggy is a mutually beneficial relationship
-Consultative selling: Diagnose restaurant needs through questions about their current channels, delivery logistics, marketing spend, and business goals. Position Swiggy’s products as solutions, not features
-Relationship management: Manage the full lifecycle each month, pitching, negotiation, activation, and ongoing support to the restaurant partner
-Data-driven problem solving: Track adoption metrics, identify why restaurants aren't growing, troubleshoot issues, and course-correct
-Revenue responsibility: Own targets within your territory; track your own pipeline and conversion rates
-Excel mastery: all the data related to your day-to-day work will be on the city and central trackers, so you must have advanced knowledge of Excel/Googlesheet/WSP
-Market research: Stay updated on restaurant trends, competitive landscape, and local market dynamics. Feedback from the field informs product direction
-80 to 90 In-person meetings with restaurant partners a month
What We're Looking For
Experience & Background:
-0-2 years in B2B sales, field sales, or business development (preferably in fmcg, food/beverage, or hotel industry)
-Track record of meeting or exceeding targets and managing your own pipeline
-Restaurant Business is a round-the-clock business; the role holder has to take ownership of the growth of the assigned portfolio of restaurant partner
-Comfort with data, especially Excel—you should be able to build pivot tables, use VLOOKUP, and create dashboards without help
-Post - Graduated preferably in marketing or sales

Description:
Job Title: Assistant Manager - B - CAT
Company Name: Axis Max Life Insurance

The Assistant Manager - B - CAT will play a pivotal role in supporting the strategic initiatives of the organization. The individual will be responsible for analyzing business trends, identifying areas for improvement, and implementing best practices to enhance operational efficiency. This role requires close collaboration with cross-functional teams to drive performance and ensure alignment with organizational goals. Key responsibilities include managing project timelines, conducting data analysis, generating reports, and presenting insights to senior management. The individual will also oversee team activities, mentor junior staff, and contribute to a positive team culture.

Responsibilities:
- Conduct thorough business analysis and identify opportunities for process improvements.
- Collaborate with various departments to align business strategies and optimize operations.
- Develop and maintain performance metrics and dashboards to track progress against goals.
- Prepare reports and presentations for senior leadership to facilitate data-driven decision-making.
- Mentor and guide team members, providing support and fostering professional development.
- Ensure compliance with industry regulations and internal policies.
- Participate in the development and execution of project plans, ensuring timely delivery of outcomes.

Skills Required:
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
- Excellent communication and interpersonal abilities.
- Leadership skills with a focus on team collaboration and mentoring.
- Proficient in data analysis and reporting tools.
- Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously under tight deadlines.
- Detail-oriented with a results-driven mindset.

Tools Required:
- Proficiency in Microsoft Excel for data analysis.
- Experience with data visualization tools such as Tableau or Power BI.
- Familiarity with project management software (e.g., JIRA, Asana, Trello).
- Strong understanding of CRM systems and experience in insurance industry software.
- Knowledge of statistical analysis tools would be a plus.

The ideal candidate will demonstrate a strong commitment to driving results, have a proactive approach to challenges, and possess a deep understanding of the insurance industry dynamics.

Description:
Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You
Picture yourself brightening someone s day. When you join our Hotels team, that s exactly what you ll do every time you come to work! You are responsible for developing and executing purchasing strategies, including supplier selection, negotiation, and contract management, to ensure supply chain stability and cost-effectiveness. As a Purchasing Manager , you re not just overseeing the purchasing process - you re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.
At Hilton, our core values define what it takes to succeed here and guide the qualities we look for in every team member:
A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality . Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership . A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now , bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.
In addition, this role requires the following minimum qualifications:
Diploma or degree in Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, Hospitality, or related field
Minimum 5 years of purchasing or procurement experience, preferably in a hotel or hospitality environment
Proven ability to source, negotiate, and manage supplier relationships to ensure quality and cost-efficiency
Strong understanding of inventory management, stock control, and procurement systems
Experience in budgeting, cost analysis, and tracking purchasing performance
Familiarity with local procurement regulations, health and safety standards, and sustainability practices
Highly organized with strong analytical and problem-solving abilities
Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and adapt to changing operational needs
Ensure that purchasing activities comply with relevant laws, regulations and company policies and uphold the hotels ethical standards.
Here s what you ll do during a typical day:
Oversee procurement operations: Manage purchasing and inventory of general merchandise to ensure adequate stock levels
Align with internal stakeholders: Collaborate with the Chef and hotel management to align purchases with hotel needs and specifications
Manage supplier relationships: Secure competitive pricing, place orders, and ensure timely delivery of goods
Ensure quality control: Review shipments to confirm products meet order specifications, grade, and quality standards
Inspire and develop the team: Supervise and support team members, monitor performance, provide coaching, and foster a positive and productive work environment
Risk Management: To identify and manage supply chain risks, including supply disruptions, price volatility, and compliance issues.
Market Analysis: A comprehensive grasp of market trends and the capacity to anticipate price shifts and supply dynamics to inform prudent purchasing decisions.

Description:
Job Summary
Job Title- Operations Analyst, NCT
Location- Jaipur, India
We are seeking a highly motivated and detail-oriented Operations Analyst to join our Private Banking team. This role involves supporting multiple critical processes within our operations. The Candidate will be responsible for completion of day-to-day activity as per standards and ensure accurate and timely delivery of assigned production duties.


Responsibilities
The position also requires regular collaboration with onshore colleagues and clients, with proficiency in German being essential.
Candidate/Applicant needs to ensure adherence to all TAT/cut-off times and quality of processing as maintained in SLAs.
Candidate/Applicant should ensure that all queries/first level escalations related to routine activities are responded to within the time frames pre-specified.
Should take responsibility and act as backup for the Peers in Candidate/Applicant absence and share best practices with the team.
Account Freeze/Unfreeze: Manage the end-to-end process of account freezing and unfreezing for private banking clients and liaise with onshore colleagues and relationship managers to ensure accurate execution of requests.
Performance research in order to find debitors and creditors and process as per the guidelines.
Perform multiple level calculation in order to determine final amount and make payments, should have basic understanding of SEPA payment system.
Signature Validation and Updation: Verify client signatures for various banking documents and transactions. Ensure proper documentation and system updates are made in accordance with bank policies.
Collaboration with Onshore Teams and Clients: Act as a key point of contact with onshore colleagues and clients in Germany, communicating effectively in German for smooth coordination of tasks and resolving operational issues.
Collaborate with internal teams to resolve discrepancies and ensure smooth operations across all processes.
Proactively identify and escalate potential risks or fraudulent activities associated with account transactions.
Ensure timely and accurate completion of tasks while adhering to internal Service Level Agreements (SLAs).
Ensure compliance with all regulatory and internal policies.
Handle any other Adhoc projects/tasks/activities assigned by the supervisor.
Ensure all your key deliverables are completed on a timely manner without any escalations.


Qualifications
German Language certification ranging between B1 to C2 is mandatory (preferably from Goethe/Max Mueller Bhavan).
At least 2 - 4 years experience in German language process.
Good communication skills and can interact independently with various stakeholders.
Willing to work in Multiple/ rotational Shifts.


Skills and Competencies
Proven ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, optimise workflows to solve business problems, while applying critical judgment to ensure responsible and ethical use of data and AI outputs.

About Lenskart
With a mission to give India a vision, Lenskart.com is India's fastest growing eyewear company. Lenskart's products include prescription eyewear, branded contact lenses and sunglasses, all equipped with the customers eye powers.
About the Role
A Sales Associate is responsible for providing the best customer experience in the stores by providing high standards of selling services to customers. He/she plays a key role in driving the revenue achieved by the store.
Responsibilities Area
Activities expected to be performed by a Lenskart Sales Associate
Customer focus: Driving Net Promoter Score
Greeting and welcoming all walk-in customers and guiding them toward the clinic to promote the free eye check-up
Being involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day tasks to deliver the best shopping experience to the customers
Understanding the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively
Being dedicated to customer satisfaction and resolving any concerns that the customer has
Product recommendation

Post making the sale, coordinating with the customer for product pick-up, after receiving due communication from the warehouse. In case of returns, he/she is expected to understand the reason and try to resolve the same to control the return percentage.
Store upkeep & maintenance
Maintaining the store as per Lenskart standards, cleaning the frames and other equipment regularly, and ensuring there is no deviation as per the SOP
Ensuring the security of all Lenskart equipment and that there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store
Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification: 12th pass; Graduates preferred Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions Clear communication and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to changing environment and openness to learn
Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority

About Lenskart
With a mission to give India a vision, Lenskart.com is India's fastest growing eyewear company. Lenskart's products include prescription eyewear, branded contact lenses and sunglasses, all equipped with the customers eye powers.
About the Role
A Sales Associate is responsible for providing the best customer experience in the stores by providing high standards of selling services to customers. He/she plays a key role in driving the revenue achieved by the store.
Responsibilities Area
Activities expected to be performed by a Lenskart Sales Associate
Customer focus: Driving Net Promoter Score
Greeting and welcoming all walk-in customers and guiding them toward the clinic to promote the free eye check-up
Being involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day tasks to deliver the best shopping experience to the customers
Understanding the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively
Being dedicated to customer satisfaction and resolving any concerns that the customer has
Product recommendation
Presenting the customer with an optimal selection of products based on customer preferences Understanding the unstated needs of the customer, asking relevant questions, and picking the right time to pitch the recommended solutions
Achieving sales Vs. Plan & SOP adherence
Achieving the assigned target for sales, eye-test conversion, returns; and following all SOPs
Post making the sale, coordinating with the customer for product pick-up, after receiving due communication from the warehouse. In case of returns, he/she is expected to understand the reason and try to resolve the same to control the return percentage.
Store upkeep & maintenance
Maintaining the store as per Lenskart standards, cleaning the frames and other equipment regularly, and ensuring there is no deviation as per the SOP
Ensuring the security of all Lenskart equipment and that there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store
Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification: 12th pass; Graduates preferred Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions Clear communication and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to changing environment and openness to learn
Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority

Description:
JOB DISCRIPTION
Experience:2+years
Location: Bangalore
Helpdesk Officer / Contact centre agent v Full-Time Contractual Role v Friendly High Energy team v Work from Office, DTP Whitefield, Bangalore
Your role: You will be responding to enquiries from existing Australia/New Zealand Banking customers as the first point of contact and you will provide high-quality service that the bank Customers have come to expect from one of Australias leading providers of financial services.
You will assist customers via multiple channels, providing consistent and accurate support in line with existing legislation.
You will be available to work on a rotating roster between the hours of 1:00am - 1:00pm Monday to Friday, and occasional Saturdays with comp off
Responsibilities:
Respond to Inbound enquiries.
Make Outbound Phone Calls
Email Correspondence with customers.
Adhering to high compliance and quality standards
Case management
Preferred Skills:
Excellent verbal written communication skills.
Computer Literacy
Working knowledge on MS Office Suite
High attention to detail.
Ability to work in a fast paced and changing environment.

Required Experience: 1-3 years

experience in International Call centre. To be successful in this role you will be motivated and punctual with a strong work ethic and the ability to self-manage.
We are looking for team players with plenty of initiative and can fully commit to their new career.
If you believe this describes you then please apply. Career growth and options in an exciting industry available to those that work towards it.
Note: Preferably candidates who can work from Bangalore as their location.

Tekskills is a leading IT company which offers cost effective and quality software solutions and consultancy services. Tekskills headquarters in New Jersey along with the state of the art off-shore development center in Hyderabad, India. Role: SAP FICO / SAP Finance & Controlling / S/4HANA FICO Consultant
Experience: 4-5 Years | 5-9 Years | 9-18 Years
Locations: Bangalore, Hyderabad, Pune, Chennai, Mangalore, Chandigarh, Trivandrum, Bhubaneswar, Nagpur, Jaipur, Indore, Coimbatore, Noida, Vizag, Kolkata, Mysore, Hubli

Roles and Responsibilities
Provide expertise on SAP FICO modules such as General Ledger (GL), Cost Center Accounting, Asset Accounting, and Internal Orders.
Assist in implementing and configuring SAP FI/CO projects from initiation to go-live phase.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure seamless integration of financial processes within the organization.
Conduct training sessions for end-users on SAP FICO modules and provide post-implementation support.
Analyze business requirements and develop solutions using SAP CO/Controlling/Profitability Analysis tools.
Desired Candidate Profile
4-9 years of experience in SAP FICO consulting or similar role.
Bachelor's degree in Any Specialization (B.Tech / B.E., CS).
Strong understanding of accountancy principles, accounts payable/receivable, general ledger, cost center accounting, asset accounting concepts.

Description:
Dear Aspirant,

Greetings from Heritage Foods Limited!!

*About Us:*
Heritage Foods Ltd. is known for being a premier provider of pure and fresh milk and value-added dairy products. The company has always been committed to its philosophy and Delighting Every Home with Fresh and Healthy Products and Empowering the Farmer.

We have opening for Area Sales Manager - Ice Creams @ Vijayawada at Heritage Foods Limited

Sales Executives - Graduate / Post Graduate with 8 - 12 yrs of Ice Cream / FMCG Sales

Work Location : Vijayawada
Responsibilities:
Develop and implement sales strategies to achieve targeted revenue goals as outlined in the business plan.
Conduct market analysis to identify growth opportunities and expand the distribution network effectively.
Lead the planning, execution, and scaling of push cart business operations to increase brand visibility and sales.
Ensure timely collection of payments and manage outstanding receivables to maintain healthy cash flow.
Optimize the use of resources, funds, and operational costs to support sustainable profitability.
Maintain robust asset management and control systems to safeguard company assets.
Coordinate logistics to ensure on-time delivery of ice cream and frozen dessert products across all channels.
Design and manage customer contract programs, while proactively addressing and resolving customer complaints.
Requirements:
Proven 8+ years experience in sales management, preferably within FMCG, ice cream, or frozen food industries.
Strong track record of achieving and exceeding sales targets in dynamic markets.
Excellent analytical and strategic planning skills with a focus on market intelligence and expansion.
Demonstrated ability in team leadership, resource allocation, and cost control.
Proficiency in logistics coordination and supply chain management.
Skilled in customer relationship management and handling contract programs.
High level of integrity, accountability, and financial stewardship.
Ability to work independently and adapt to fast-paced, results-oriented environments.
Excellent negotiation, leadership, and team management abilities.
Proficiency in CRM tools, ERP systems, and MS Office (especially Excel for data analysis).
AboutCompany:
Heritage Group, founded in 1992 by Mr. Nara Chandrababu Naidu, is a prominent and fast-growing public listed company in India. It operates through various divisions, including Dairy, Renewable Energy, and VetCa, all under its flagship company, Heritage Foods Limited (formerly known as Heritage Foods Limited). Heritage Foods limited is known for being a premier provider of pure and fresh milk and value-added dairy products. The company has always been committed to its philosophy and vision of delivering fresh & healthy products to every home.

As of the financial year 2022-23, Heritage Foods has achieved an impressive annual turnover of over Rs. 3,200 crores. The company's products, particularly its milk and milk-based items, have established a strong market presence in several regions across India. These areas include Andhra Pradesh, Telangana, Karnataka, Kerala, Tamil Nadu, Maharashtra, Odisha, and the National Capital Region (NCR) of Delhi. Heritage Foods' success can be attributed to its dedication to providing high-quality dairy products and its expansion into various regions of the country.

Description:
SUMMARY
Job Title: Process Mechanic - Coating Concept
Job Location:  Germany
Industry:  Automotive/ Industrial Coating
Employment Type:  Full - Time
Working Hours: 40 hours/week
Starting Salary: 2,400 Euros/Approx. 2.63 lakh INR Gross per Month

Job Description:
We are looking for skilled Painters / Spray Painters from India with an NTC/ITI qualification in Painter (General) for employment with an automotive supplier in Germany. The selected candidates will work in the industrial coating of high-value plastic and composite (CFRP/carbon) components used in the automotive industry. Candidates with practical experience in spray painting, surface preparation, masking, polishing, and finishing of components are encouraged to apply.

Key Responsibilities:
Prepare plastic and composite/carbon components for painting.
Carry out manual sanding and surface preparation.
Perform masking of components before painting.
Prepare, set up, and clean components using appropriate chemical solutions.
Carry out manual spray painting using a spray gun.
Paint plastic and composite/CFRP components according to required quality standards.
Perform polishing and finishing of painted components.
Follow workplace safety, quality, and production procedures.
Perform other general support duties as assigned by the shift supervisor.


Requirements
A minimum of 3 years of practical spray painting/spray gun experience is desirable.
Experience in industrial painting, automotive painting, plastic component painting, or composite/CFRP painting will be an advantage.
Candidates with strong hands-on painting skills and relevant ITI/NTC training may also be considered.
Qualification:
NTC / ITI Painter (General) qualification.
Qualification should preferably be issued under NCVT / DGT.
Candidates with relevant vocational training in industrial painting/coating technology may also be considered.


Benefits
    Family-like working atmosphere, flat hierarchies, young international team
       Safe, modern workplace in a growing company
       Personal and professional development opportunities
       Voluntary additional benefits, special and bonus payments, employer contribution to retirement provision
       Predictable vacation planning through company shutdown periods, additional vacation days
       Free work clothing and safety equipment
       Free cold beverages, discounted hot beverages, free parking

Description:
Role & responsibilities

Job Title: Dispatch Operations Supervisor / Manager

Location: Martur, Andhra Pradesh, India

Industry: Logistics & Supply Chain / Oil & Gas Logistics

Site/Client Focus: Bharat Petroleum Corporation Limited (BPCL) Lubricants Depot Operations

Position Overview
The Dispatch Operations Supervisor/Manager is responsible for managing daily dispatch, warehousing, inventory control, and secondary distribution at the BPCL Lubricants Depot in Martur. This role involves overseeing primary and secondary vehicle movements, maintaining strict adherence to BPCL Health, Safety, and Environment (HSE) norms, ensuring accurate inventory records in ERP systems (SAP/WMS), and leading a team of dispatch coordinators, warehouse staff, and transport partners.

Key Responsibilities
1. Dispatch & Fleet Management
Plan, schedule, and execute daily dispatch orders for MAK Lubricants (barrels, pails, cartons, small packs) across assigned distribution routes.
Manage vehicle placement, loading dock allocation, gate entry/exit tracking, and turnaround time (TAT) reduction for local and regional fleets.
Ensure accurate documentation, including e-Way bills, LRs (Lorry Receipts), delivery challans, invoice verification, and gate passes.
Coordinate closely with third-party logistics (3PL) transporters, fleet owners, and drivers for timely vehicle placement and route adherence.

2. Warehouse & Inventory Control
Oversee stock inwarding, putaway, picking, packing, and dispatch execution.
Conduct regular physical stock audits, daily cyclic counts, and reconcile physical inventory with SAP/WMS system records.
Prevent leakage, package damage, or contamination during material handling and loading operations.
Manage stock layout optimization within the depot to maximize space utilization and loading efficiency.

3. Safety, Quality & Compliance (BPCL Standards)
Enforce 100% compliance with BPCL Oil & Gas Safety Regulatory Standards, fire safety protocols, and standard operating procedures (SOPs).
Monitor vehicle fitness standards (VCF check), spark arrestors, driver PPE compliance, and safe material handling procedures prior to dispatch.
Conduct toolbox talks, safety drills, and driver induction sessions on road and operational safety.
Maintain complete compliance with statutory transport, labor, and state/central motor vehicle regulations.

4. Vendor & Stakeholder Management
Serve as the primary operational liaison between the 3PL logistics company, BPCL Depot officers, and external distribution network partners.
Address distribution bottlenecks, customer order delays, and transit queries promptly.
Track and manage transporter performance (KPIs: On-Time Delivery, In-Full Delivery, Vehicle Placement Accuracy).

5. Team Leadership & Administrative Oversight
Supervise warehouse workers, loading labor, billing clerks, and transport coordinators.
Monitor operational costs, labor allocation, and equipment maintenance (forklifts, hand pallet trucks, conveyors).
Generate daily, weekly, and monthly dispatch summary reports, TAT reports, and operational dashboards for management review.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
On-Time In-Full (OTIF) Dispatch & Delivery Accuracy
Vehicle Turnaround Time (TAT) within the depot premises
Inventory Accuracy (% variance between physical and SAP stock)
Zero Loss Time Injuries (LTI) / Compliance with HSE Audits
Transit damage/leakage percentage minimizing operational loss

Preferred candidate profile / Candidate Profile & Qualifications
Professional Experience
Supervisor Role: 3 to 5 years of experience in warehouse dispatch operations, transport logistics, or stock control.
Manager Role: 6 to 10+ years of experience managing depot/warehouse dispatch, contract logistics, or 3PL operations.
Preferred Industry Background: Lubricants, Petroleum/Oil & Gas, Paints, FMCG, Chemicals, or Heavy Industrial Goods. Prior experience working at a BPCL, IOCL, or HPCL depot/installation is a strong advantage.
Educational Background
Graduate in any discipline (B.Sc, B.Com, B.Tech) or Diploma in Logistics & Supply Chain Management / Materials Management.
Post-Graduate degree/MBA in Operations or Supply Chain (preferred for Managerial level).
Technical & Soft Skills
ERP & Software Proficiency: Hands-on experience with SAP (SD/MM modules), WMS (Warehouse Management Systems), and advanced MS Excel.
Regulatory Knowledge: Knowledge of e-Way bill portals, transport laws, and petroleum product handling guidelines.
Language Skills: Proficiency in Telugu (local communication) and Working English / Hindi.
Leadership & Problem Solving: Strong capability to manage ground-level labor, handle transporter negotiations, and resolve operational escalations calmly under shift pressure.

Description:
F&B and Event Service Expert
Our jobs aren t just about putting food on the table or serving guests during a banquet or event.
Instead, we want to build an experience that is memorable and unique - with food and drinks on the side.
Our F&B Service Experts is skilled in a wide range of event functions and able to take the initiative and deliver a wide range of services to make sure that guests experience is well taken care of from start to finish.

Reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping.

Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors.

License or Certification: None

We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Description:
Job Title: Area Sales Manager - Construction Chemicals
Reports To: State/Divisional Head

Job Overview:
We are seeking a dynamic and results-oriented Area Sales Manager to drive sales performance and growth for our construction chemicals product line for AP. The ideal candidate will be responsible for managing and achieving sales targets, expanding distribution networks. This role requires a strong leadership presence, industry knowledge, and a proactive approach to market trends.

Key Responsibilities:
Sales Leadership & Target Achievement:
Lead and motivate a team of frontline sales personnel to meet or exceed sales volume, value, and growth targets for the depot.
Develop and implement effective sales strategies to achieve both short- and long-term goals.
Market & Competitor Analysis:
Monitor and analyze competitor activities, market trends, and customer feedback to identify opportunities for growth and adjust sales strategies accordingly.
Distribution Network Expansion:
Expand and manage a robust retail distribution network within the territory to increase market reach and product availability.
Implement and oversee network management programs to optimize distribution performance.
Customer Relationship Management:
Cultivate and maintain strong relationships with key customers, distributors, and partners.
Address customer inquiries and concerns promptly to ensure high satisfaction levels and repeat business.

Education & Experience Requirements:
Education:
Bachelors degree (Graduation) or an MBA (specialization in Marketing preferred).
Experience:
10 to 12 years of proven sales experience in the construction chemicals industry, with a focus on channel sales and distribution.
Demonstrated ability to manage a sales team and deliver measurable results in a competitive market.

Key Skills & Personal Traits:
Communication:
Proficiency in the local language and excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Leadership & Management:
Strong leadership skills with the ability to inspire, motivate, and manage a team of sales professionals.
Results-driven, achievement-oriented with excellent managerial capabilities.
Customer-Centric:
Demonstrated ability to build and maintain positive customer relationships.
Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to interact effectively with a variety of stakeholders.
Analytical & Problem-Solving Skills:
Solid analytical abilities to assess sales data, market conditions, and performance metrics.
Proactive in identifying challenges and implementing solutions.
Team Player:
A collaborative mindset with the ability to work effectively as part of a team, both within the depot and with other departments.
Additional Information:
This role requires travel within the assigned territory, and flexibility to work extended hours when required.
Competitive salary package with performance-based incentives.

Description:
Job Description
Are You Ready to Make It Happen at Mondel z International

Join our Mission to Lead the Future of Snacking. Make It With Pride.

This is a leadership role where you will own the technology, maintenance, process and setting for the equipment for the line. You will possess deep expertise and will be viewed as the technology expert of the line/s.

How you will contribute

You will:
Partner & enable the line leader(s) to deliver the SQCDSM targets-Safety, Quality, Cost, Delivery, Sustainability & Morale for the lines, to ensure Process stability; Participate in the DMS- Daily Management systems meetings at the shift and line level
Own the technology and process and centerline settings for the equipment and process and has deep technical mastery of the process and equipment; own the Progressive maintenance systems and work processes and the Progressive Maintenance Key Performance Indicators for the line/s along with Centerline Management systems; owns the Repairs & Maintenance budget of the line
Develop, own and execute the line/s preventive and time-based maintenance systems and plans and builds capability of the team to execute themselves; Build (spends at least 50% of time) technical and maintenance skills of the technicians working in the shifts, so that they are able to operate and maintain their equipment themselves; be part of the PM Pillar, own all PM systems and work process at the line level and lead some of them at the department level
Partner with the Asset and Reliability team for system improvement and execution of special maintenance tasks; be responsible for Change Management on the line/s, localization of spares and proper break-down analysis and R&M cost reduction for the line/s; represent the department/line/s as the site technology owner in the regional and global technology forums
Assist in VSU for the new initiatives and enables the VSU team; help the line leader in internal and external benchmarking and reapplication; be the subject matter expert on one of the component categories and will be a trainer of PM related subjects for the plant


What you will bring

A desire to drive your future and accelerate your career. You will bring experience and knowledge in:
Advanced knowledge (including AM-Autonomous Maintenance Step 4 systems & Progressive Maintenance Step 3) & skill to maintain the dedicated equipment(s)at basic conditions independently, including the execution of AM & PM (BD-Breakdown maintenance, planned maintenance) standards on dedicated equipment(s) and TPM - Phase 3 & 4 tools problem solving tools.
The capability to lead a Role for the Line. Qualify and coach the next level SWP owners and drive the common opportunity areas across the line in PDCA-Plan Do Check Adjust approach
The capability to work as the Line Leader, developing and aligning goal/master plan for the line, deploying and managing IDP for the members, coaching team members on their performance management and career development
Within Country Relocation support available and for candidates voluntarily moving internationally some minimal support is offered through our Volunteer International Transfer Policy
Business Unit Summary
Mondelez India Foods Private Limited (formerly Cadbury India Ltd.) has been in India for over 70 years, making sure our mouth-watering and well-loved local and global brands such as Cadbury chocolates, Bournvita and Tang powdered beverages, Oreo and Cadbury Bournvita biscuits, and Halls and Cadbury Choclairs Gold candies get safely into our customers hands-and mouths. Headquartered in Mumbai, the company has more than 3,300 employees proudly working across sales offices in New Delhi, Mumbai, Kolkata and Chennai and in manufacturing facilities at Maharashtra, Madhya Pradesh, Himachal Pradesh and Andhra Pradesh, at our global Research & Development Technical Centre and Global Business Hub in Maharashtra and in a vast distribution network across the country. We are also proud to be recognised by Avatar as the Best Companies for Women in India in 2019 - the fourth time we ve received this award.

Regular
Manufacturing core
Manufacturing

Function SummaryThe agency channel refers to a distribution method where insurance products are sold through agents. Hold periodical customer meet to understand customer pulse need

Measures of Success
Achievement of business plan GPA

Number MTD Active
Persistency as per grid
Number of EC/MDRT agent

Sales Background
Minimum 2 Years Experience
At least 6 Months in last Job

Should be employed in BFSI/Structured Company
Not more than 2 Job Changes in one year

Description:
About the Role The role of an Optometrist at Lenskart is different from competing brands and is not limited to only eye check-ups but also includes sales as a critical deliverable. He/she plays a key role in delivering technical expertise through eye-checks, dispensing, and diagnosis as well as selling products, executing stocktakes and SOPs to deliver an exceptional customer experience.
Responsibilities
Greeting and welcoming all walk-in customers and guiding them toward the clinic to promote the free eye check-up
Being involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day tasks to deliver the best shopping experience to the customers
Understanding the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively Being dedicated to customer satisfaction and resolving any concerns that the customer has
Following the 12-step Optometry process at Lenskart, during the eye check-up
Sharing the prescription clearly and educating the customer about single vision and progressive lens while recommending the appropriate lens and/or frames
Performing a quality check of the lenses fitted before handing over the product to the customer
Presenting the customer with an optimal selection of products based on customer preferences
Understanding the unstated needs of the customer, asking relevant questions, and picking the right time to pitch the recommended solutions
Achieving the assigned target for sales, eye-test conversion, returns; and following all SOPs Post making the sale, coordinating with the customer for product pick-up, after receiving due communication from the warehouse. In case of returns, he/she is expected to understand the reason and try to resolve the same to control the return percentage.
Maintaining the store as per Lenskart standards, cleaning the frames and other equipment regularly, and ensuring there is no deviation as per the SOP
Ensuring the security of all Lenskart equipment and that there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store
Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification: Diploma/ Bachelors in Optometry
Freshers are eligible to apply- no minimum work experience required
Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions
Clear communication and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to changing environment and openness to learn
Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation
Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority .

Description:
About the Role
Sales Associate is responsible for providing the best customer experience in the stores by providing high standards of selling services to Lenskart customers. He/she plays a pivotal role in driving the revenue achieved by the store.
Responsibilities Area Activities expected to be performed by a Lenskart Sales Associate Customer focus
Sales Associate is expected to greet and welcome all walk-in customers and guide them toward the clinic, promoting the free eye check-up
He/she will be involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day tasks to deliver the best shopping experience to the customers
He/she must possess a basic understanding of the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively
He/she must be dedicated to customer satisfaction and must go beyond his means to resolve any concerns that the customer has
Product recommendation
With the information received from the Optometrist and the customer, he/she will present the customer with an optimal selection of products. This opportunity may be used to strike a conversation and convert it into sales
He/she is expected to understand the unstated needs of the customer, ask relevant questions, and pick the right time to pitch the recommended solutions
Achieving sales targets & SOP adherence
Sales Associate is expected to achieve the assigned target for sales, eye-test conversion, and returns. He/she must follow all assigned SOPs diligently
Post making the sale, he/she is responsible for coordinating with the customer for product pickup, after receiving due communication from the warehouse. He/she will verify the accuracy of the lenses fitted before handing over the product to the customer. In case of returns, he/she is expected to understand the reason and try to resolve the same to control the return percentage
Store upkeep & maintenance
He/she is expected to maintain Lenskart standards of hygiene in the store with respect to the overall display, frames, instruments, and other store equipment by cleaning them regularly
He/she must ensure the security of all Lenskart equipment and ensure there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store
Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification: 12th pass; Graduates preferred
Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions
Clear articulation and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to changing environment and openness to learn
Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation
Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority

Description:
Job Title: Field Sales Executive Lenskart@Home


We're looking for energetic and customer-focused Sales Executives to visit customers' homes, conduct eye tests, and sell Lenskart spectacles. As a Sales Executive, you'll:
Visit customers' homes based on scheduled appointments
Conduct eye tests using specialized equipment
Sell Lenskart spectacles and provide exceptional customer service
Carry a 20-25 kg bag with eye check equipment and eyewears
Meet sales targets and earn attractive commissions

Compensation Package:
Fixed CTC: Salary
Variable compensation based on sales performance
Travel allowances

Training:
30-days comprehensive training in Ahmedabad on eye checkups and sales techniques
Candidates must be willing to stay/travel to the training location for 30 days
Support and product training

Requirements:
Graduate or Diploma holder
Fresher/Experienced
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
Ability to lift and carry equipment (20-25 kg)
Willingness to travel and work flexible hours
Must possess a valid driving license
Must own a bike (two-wheeler)

What We Offer:
Opportunity to work with India's leading eyewear brand
Competitive compensation and incentives
Comprehensive training and support
Chance to make a difference in customers' lives through vision care

Description:
Our jobs aren t just about putting food on the table that our guests will enjoy until they ask for their bill.
Instead, we want to build an experience that is memorable and unique - with food and drinks on the side.
Our Guest Service Experts take the initiative and deliver a wide range of services to make sure that guests enjoy their meal.
Whether setting tables, communicating with the kitchen, interacting and serving guests, or cleaning work areas and supplies, the Guest Service Expert makes transactions feel like part of the experience.
No matter what position you are in, there are a few things that are critical to success - creating a safe workplace, following company policies and procedures, upholding quality standards, and ensuring your uniform, personal appearance, and communications are professional.
Guest Service Experts will be on their feet and moving around (stand, sit, or walk for an extended time; moving over sloping, uneven, or slippery surfaces), managing the menu (read and visually verify information), and taking a hands-on approach to work (move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 25 pounds without assistance and 50 pounds with assistance; reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping).
Doing all these things well (and other reasonable job duties as requested) is critical for Guest Service Experts - to get it right for our guests and our business each and every time.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Education: High school diploma or G. E. D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: Less than 1 year related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.
License or Certification: None
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Description:
Job description:
INTERN TRAINEE-New Customer Acquisition
Job Description Sales Intern (NATS Certified Program)Company: Muthoot Finance Ltd. Indias Most Trusted Financial Services Brand
Program: Govt. Certified Training Program (NATS)
Department: Alternate Channel – New Customer Acquisition
Locations : Available BRANCH
VIJ_VIJAYAWADA-BHAVANI PURAM CLUSTER VIJ_MYLAVARAM-(AP) CLUSTER VIJ_VIJAYAWADA-RAMAVARAPPADU CLUSTER VIJ_VIJAYAWADA-BHAVANI PURAM CLUSTER VIJ_VIJAYAWADA-BHAVANI PURAM CLUSTER VIJ_VIJAYAWADA-BHAVANI PURAM CLUSTER VIJ_VIJAYAWADA-RAMAVARAPPADU CLUSTER VIJ_MYLAVARAM-(AP) CLUSTER VIJ_PATAMATA CLUSTER VIJ_MYLAVARAM-(AP) CLUSTER

Cluster-based (covering 8–10 branches under a Cluster Sales Manager)
Role Overview:We are looking for highly motivated Sales Interns under the Government-certified NATS training program to join our Sales & Operations Team.
This internship provides hands-on training in sales, customer acquisition, and operations management under the guidance of an experienced Sales Manager.
Successful candidates will follow a structured career growth path leading to a Sales Manager role within 1.8 years.
Key Responsibilities:Work on open market activities to generate leads for Gold Loans & other financial products.
Conduct customer acquisition drives and build long-term relationships.
Support branch teams in KYC verification, customer onboarding, and operational processes.
Assist the Sales Manager in achieving sales targets for the cluster (8–10 branches).
Learn & apply skills in financial product pitching, field sales, and customer engagement.
Regularly report performance updates and market insights to Sales Manager.
Career Growth Path & Compensation:Internship (0–6 months):
Stipend: 14000 per month
AboutCompany:
The Muthoot Group is a leading business conglomerate that has successfully expanded, in each and every town, across the nation. The Group has 20 diversified business divisions and 5443+ branches with a global presence across USA, UK, UAE, Costa Rica, Sri Lanka and Nepal.
The Group serves over 2.5 lakh customers every single day through its network of branches. Till date, the Group has served over 70 crore customers, including repeat customers. The Muthoot Groups story from humble beginnings to its ever growing stature is built on the firm foundation of 7 fundamental principles of Ethics, Values Reliability, Dependability, Trustworthiness, Integrity and Goodwill. The Group practices an equal opportunity policy wherein people from all sections of the society have equal opportunities to join and be part of the 40,000+ strong Muthoot Family.
Muthoot Finance, the flagship company of The Muthoot Group has been rated India’s No. 1 Most Trusted Financial Services Brand for five consecutive years, from 2016 to 2020 by TRA’s Brand Trust Report. It has been certified as ‘Great Place To Work, 2021-22’ and has been recognised and featured as one of the Top 30 Best Places to Work at in India by Skill Tree Global Knowledge Consortium in the Workplace Excellence Show on CNBC TV-18 in 2016.
The Company offer 30+ Staff Welfare Measures ranging from Fast Track Promotions, Career Development Programs, National Pension Scheme, Foreign Trips, five types of Annual Incentives/Bonuses, Cash Rewards, Contests with prizes, Maternity Benefits, Medical benefits, Employee Insurance etc. to name a few.
Muthoot Finance believes in promoting local hiring from the region. Every 5th employee is a woman and roughly 24% of the workforce comprises of women.
Shri. Amitabh Bachchan Ji is the Brand Ambassador of The Muthoot Group.
The Group takes humble pride in its 800 years of family business legacy and unblemished track record. Over these years, millions of underserved Indians have been served through a bouquet of products and services and have been helped in a big way to move ahead in life.

Description:
Note: Only shortlisted candidates will be invited to attend the hiring drive in Hyderabad on October 30, October 31, and November 1

Primary Purpose of Job:
Contribute to the ongoing growth of Stantec ResourceNet Private India Ltd by providing technical expertise in specialist areas of wastewater network modelling. To be involved in the implementation and delivery of leading edge programmes and projects.
Support project managers/team leader by providing technical expertise to ensure that project outcomes in terms of profit, schedule, technical and quality standards, meet both the client and Stantec expectations.

Key Accountabilities:
Hydraulic modelling
Model build and verification
Optioneering & Outline Design of hydraulic solutions
Development Impact Assessment
Pressure Optimisation
Preparation of technical reports / drawings,
Working with GIS databases,
Handling and managing large data sets for analysis
Carry out other duties as may be assigned from time to time by supervisor/management,
Need to work off-hours for client co-ordination: Occasionally
Need to travel off-shore for training/on-site work: Occasionally

Person Specifications:
Masters degree in civil/ Environmental Engineering
Expert in hydraulic modelling, Hydraulic design, solution modelling, DMA, Pressure Management, Network Analysis
Expert in hydraulic modelling software, InfoWorks WS Pro, InfoWater, Synergy, Bentley WaterGems and DHI MIKE Urban+ preferred
Optimisation tools
Scripting: Python, SQL, Visual Basic, advanced Excel
Have excellent data manipulation abilities (FME/POWERBI/MS Access database type packages)
Good skills in GIS packages: MapInfo, ArcGIS preferred and Drawing Support
Expert in Technical report writing skills
Good level of client service management, i.e. able to interface with clients and to build and maintain lasting, positive relationships with our Clients
Capable to analyse, assess, evaluate the issues, complexity pertaining to projects / work packages and support the team lead in mitigating them in advance
Rigorous attention to detail, able to understand and adopt workflows and commitment to personal professional development
Competent level of baseline skills, i.e. professional and confident with the essential, basic business and communication skills that are required for career growth in all positions
Flexible attitude to accepting different work assignments and pro-active attitude to execution / delivery
AboutCompany:
About Company: Visit us at www.stantec.com, or find us on social media.
We always design with community in mind. The Stantec community, unites approximately 34,000 employees working in over 450 locations across six continents. We collaborate across disciplines and industries to bring water and infrastructure projects to life. Our work as architects, engineers, and consultants from initial project concept and planning through design, construction, and commissioning begins at the intersection of community, creativity, and client relationships. This work is built on a nearly 200-year history. With a heritage in water, our worlds most precious resource, we safeguard and sustain lives, communities, and businesses worldwide. Our local knowledge and relationships, coupled with our global expertise, qualify us to go anywhere to solve our clients' challenges in more creative and personalized ways. With a long-term commitment to the people and places we serve, we have the unique ability to connect to projects on a personal level and advance the quality of life in communities around the globe. Stantec trades on the TSX and the NYSE under the symbol STN.

Description:
Graduate Marketing Executive | Sports-Minded Professionals | Hyderabad 35,000 55,000 per month + Performance Incentives Full Paid Training Provided | Immediate Start | Leadership Progression

Your Sporting Mindset Has a Place Here
The qualities that make a great athlete — consistency, resilience, the ability to perform under pressure, and an instinct to push beyond the average — are the same qualities that build exceptional marketing professionals. Here, we've have built our graduate programme around exactly that thinking.

We are currently expanding our Hyderabad team and are looking for driven graduates who bring that competitive edge and are ready to channel it into a high-performance professional environment.

Why Graduates With a Sporting Background Thrive with Us:
Team Mentality — Our campaigns are built on collective effort. You will work within a close-knit team where collaboration and shared accountability are central to how we operate, much like any high-performing squad
Discipline & Consistency — The ability to show up, follow a structure, and remain focused when results take time is something sports teaches better than any training programme. We recognise and reward that quality
Performance-Driven Culture — Targets, benchmarks, and measurable outcomes are part of daily life at Meridian. If you are motivated by improvement and results, you will feel at home here
Leadership Development — Our strongest performers move quickly into mentoring and team leadership responsibilities, giving you the opportunity to develop the same influence off the field that you carried on it

About the Role
As a Graduate Marketing Executive, you will be at the frontline of our client campaigns — engaging directly with consumers, representing brands in high-footfall environments, and contributing to measurable business outcomes from day one. This is a field-based, people-focused role that rewards energy, communication, and a results-oriented approach.

Full training is provided from the outset, so prior experience in marketing or sales is not a requirement. What we are looking for is the right attitude and the drive to develop quickly.

What You Will Be Doing
Representing client campaigns through direct marketing and face-to-face consumer engagement
Promoting products, services, and events in targeted, high-traffic locations across Bangalore
Identifying and developing new business leads, converting opportunities into tangible results
Collaborating with your team to achieve weekly and monthly campaign targets
Progressing into training and mentoring responsibilities as your confidence and skill set grows

Who We Are Looking For
Graduates from any discipline with a sporting, athletic, or team-based background
Strong communicators who are comfortable engaging with new people daily
Ambitious individuals with a clear goal-oriented mindset
Resilient, self-motivated, and comfortable in a fast-paced field environment
Available to start immediately or at short notice

Compensation & Benefits
Starting salary of 35,000 per month
Progression to 55,000 per month by Month 3, performance dependent
Weekly performance-based incentive structure
Fully paid professional training and ongoing mentorship
Structured and transparent pathway into leadership and business development roles
AboutCompany: Sales Partners is a leading global agency specializing in live and experiential campaigns for the worlds largest companies. We design and execute immersive brand experiences that engage audiences, drive brand awareness, and deliver measurable results. From interactive events to product activations, we bring brands to life through creative, high-impact campaigns that leave a lasting impression. With a global reach and a focus on innovation, Sales Partners helps clients connect with customers in meaningful and unforgettable ways.

Description:
Job Summary
Job Purpose
To independently manage and execute day-to-day finished goods dispatch operations, ensuring 100% dispatch accuracy, timely vehicle placement, proper documentation, inventory accuracy, and adherence to safety and statutory requirements. The role will coordinate with PPC, Production, Sales, Warehouse, Transporters, Finance, and customers to achieve the dispatch plan.
Key Responsibilities
Dispatch Planning Execution Execute the daily and monthly dispatch plan in line with customer and business requirements. Coordinate with PPC and Finished Goods Store for product availability and dispatch readiness. Prioritize customer-critical, ageing, and urgent dispatches. Monitor planned vs. actual dispatch on a daily basis. Identify bottlenecks and take corrective action to achieve dispatch targets. Ensure timely dispatch closure in SAP/ERP.
Vehicle Transporter Management Coordinate with logistics/transporters for timely vehicle placement. Prepare and monitor the day-wise vehicle requirement and loading plan. Ensure appropriate vehicle type and capacity for the planned load. Monitor vehicle reporting, loading, documentation, and departure. Minimize vehicle detention and improve vehicle turnaround time. Escalate vehicle shortages and delays to the concerned stakeholders.
SAP / ERP Documentation Process dispatch transactions accurately in SAP/ERP. Generate and verify OBD, picking documents, invoices, delivery challans, e-way bills, and other applicable documents. Ensure physical material, SAP stock, invoice, and dispatch quantity are matched before vehicle release. Maintain proper system and document traceability. Resolve SAP-related dispatch issues in coordination with PPC/IT/Finance.
Finished Goods Inventory Control Ensure correct model, quantity, customer, destination, and packaging before loading. Maintain accurate FG inventory and dispatch records. Reconcile physical stock with SAP stock. Identify and report stock discrepancies immediately. Support month-end, quarter-end, and year-end physical inventory verification. Ensure FIFO/FEFO practices wherever applicable. Control ageing and slow-moving finished goods through proper dispatch prioritization.
Loading Material Handling Supervise loading to ensure safe and damage-free handling of finished goods. Ensure proper product identification and loading sequence. Verify loading quantity against invoice/OBD. Ensure proper vehicle loading, stacking, lashing, and protection. Coordinate with MHE operators and loading manpower. Ensure compliance with plant EHS and material-handling procedures.
Team Shift Coordination Guide and monitor dispatch executives, operators, loaders, and contract manpower. Allocate manpower based on daily dispatch requirements. Ensure effective utilization of loading docks, MHE, and dispatch area. Monitor shift-wise dispatch performance. Train team members on SOPs, SAP transactions, safety, and documentation.
Coordination with Internal External Stakeholders Coordinate closely with: PPC Production Finished Goods Store Sales Customer Service Logistics / Transporters Finance Commercial Quality Security Warehouse / Distribution Centres Resolve dispatch-related issues on priority. Provide regular status updates to management.
MIS Performance Reporting Prepare and maintain daily/weekly/monthly reports covering: Dispatch plan vs. actual Customer/warehouse-wise dispatch Vehicle placement status Pending dispatch Vehicle turnaround time FG stock Ageing stock Loading productivity Dispatch shortages/delays Dispatch-related complaints Key KPIs / KRAs KPI Key Measure Dispatch Plan Achievement = 100% of approved plan On-Time Dispatch % dispatch within committed timeline Dispatch Accuracy Model/quantity/customer/document accuracy Vehicle Placement % vehicles placed as per plan Vehicle TAT Reduction in loading detention time Inventory Accuracy Physical vs. SAP accuracy

Description:
SUMMARY
Title: Business Development Executive  Field sales apprentice role
Location: Guntur / Chirala / Bapatla / Nellore / Visakhapatnam / Peddapuram
Job Type: Full - Time
Industry: Beauty & Cosmetics / Retail / FMCG

Summary:
We are seeking a motivated Business Development Executive to drive growth for a leading online cosmetic and beauty products store across key retail markets in Visakhapatnam, Tirupati, and Vijayawada. This role is critical in expanding our retail footprint by building strong relationships with distributors, retailers, and vendors. The ideal candidate will be responsible for executing on-ground sales strategies, promoting product visibility, and ensuring consistent performance through market engagement and data-driven follow-ups. The position offers a dynamic environment for growth, with opportunities to contribute directly to business expansion in high-potential retail zones.

Responsibilities:
Conduct regular market visits to identify and develop new sales leads using provided data and personal referrals
Engage with distributors, retailers, and vendors to present product portfolios and drive adoption
Execute product sampling and promotional activities at retail outlets to enhance brand visibility
Implement focus product campaigns and ensure timely deal closures within the assigned territory
Support retailers and distributors with on-ground business development initiatives and operational guidance
Monitor, analyze, and report monthly sales performance, campaign outcomes, and key market insights

Requirements

Graduate degree in any discipline(from 2021 to 2025 pass - out)
Freshers are encouraged to apply
Up to 11 months of prior sales or retail experience is acceptable
Must be a local resident within 10 km of the assigned store
Personal two-wheeler (bike preferred) is mandatory with valid driving license
Prior exposure to the beauty, cosmetics, or FMCG retail sector is preferred
Male candidates are preferred for this role

Work Details:
Work Schedule: 6 days per week
Weekly Off: Sunday
Work Type: Retail store-based operations with regular local market visits

Benefits
Fixed salary:  11,500 from Nykaa + 4500 from Govt (16000 inhand)
Daily TA/DA: 200
Attractive performance-based incentives
