Job Summary
Lead Retail Sales in Bangalore. Responsible for building and expanding our retail network, driving seller acquisitions, training Retailers/sellers to maximize their sales potential and developing strategies to increase market share and achieve sales targets, additionally creating and sharing dashboards to monitor performance and inform decision-making.
Another important activity is to ensure high visibility at all retail points through merchandising by merchandisers.
Responsibilities
What you be doing: Responsible for building and expanding our retail network, driving seller acquisitions, training Retailers/sellers to maximize their sales potential and developing strategies to increase market share and achieve sales targets, additionally creating and sharing dashboards to monitor performance and inform decision-making.
Key Skillset
Proven experience as a Retail Sales Manager or similar role, with a track record of building retail networks and driving sales growth
Proficient in data analysis and dashboard creation, with experience in CRM and sales management software
Strong leadership skills and experience managing a team.
Excellent communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.
Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and adapt to changing market dynamics.
Strategic thinker with a strong business acumen and problem-solving skills
What you bring to the team
Retail Network Development: Identify, recruit, and onboard new retailers to join our retail network. Develop strategies to expand retail presence and increase market penetration.
Retailers Training: Design and implement training programs for retailers to enhance their sales skills, product knowledge, and customer service capabilities. Monitor progress and provide ongoing support and coaching to ensure continuous improvement.
Sales Funnel Optimization: Continuously analyze and optimize the sales funnel to improve conversion rates at each stage. Identify bottlenecks and implement solutions to streamline the retail sales process.
Digital Media Utilization: Leverage digital media platforms effectively to maximize lead generation and conversion rates in the retail sector. Stay updated with the latest trends and best practices in digital marketing for retail sales.
Field Team Collaboration: Work closely with the retail field teams to ensure they have the necessary tools and knowledge to convert leads into sales. Provide training and support to retail field teams on lead conversion techniques.
Data Analysis: Utilize data analytics to monitor performance and identify areas for improvement within the retail sales funnel. Generate regular reports and insights to inform strategic decisions for retail sales.
Cross-Functional Coordination: Collaborate with marketing, sales, and product development teams to ensure a cohesive approach to customer acquisition and retention in the retail sector. Align lead generation strategies with overall business goals and objectives for retail sales.
Acquisition Strategy: Develop and execute innovative acquisition strategies to attract new retailers and customers. Collaborate with marketing and product teams to align acquisition efforts with overall business goals.
Dashboard and Reporting: Build and maintain dashboards to track sales performance, sales activity, retailer performance, and market trends. Share insights and recommendations with senior management to inform strategic decisions.
Market Analysis: Conduct market research to identify trends, opportunities, and challenges in the retail landscape. Use insights to adjust strategies and optimize performance.

Description:
Job Description

MES SME / Business Analyst / Product Owner (B2)
Locations: Mumbai, Pune, Bangalore, Hyderabad
Choosing Capgemini means choosing a place where you''ll be empowered to shape your career, supported by a collaborative global community, and inspired to reimagine what''s possible. Join us in helping manufacturing organizations transform their operations through innovative MES and digital manufacturing solutions.
Role Overview
We are seeking an experienced MES Subject Matter Expert (SME) / Business Analyst / Product Owner with strong manufacturing domain expertise. The ideal candidate will act as a bridge between business stakeholders and technical teams, ensuring successful delivery, implementation, and support of MES solutions.
Interview Process: 2 Rounds
Key Responsibilities
Act as the MES Subject Matter Expert (SME) for business and IT teams.
Collaborate closely with Development, Support, Deployment, and End Users for smooth project delivery and issue resolution.
Gather, analyze, and document business requirements and user stories.
Drive documentation activities including User Stories, Functional Design Documents (FDDs), PRE-ROM, Analyst Testing, UAT, and Release Planning.
Work with stakeholders to define functional requirements and translate them into technical specifications.
Support testing, validation, and deployment activities.
Ensure alignment between manufacturing processes and MES solutions.
Participate in Agile ceremonies and collaborate with cross-functional teams.
Required Skills
Strong MES functional experience with Business Analysis exposure.
Good understanding of manufacturing processes and workflows.
Knowledge of .NET application testing and debugging.
Experience with Web and Mobile Applications (Android).
Hands-on experience with Web Services, SOAP UI, and Postman.
Strong database knowledge with MySQL and Oracle SQL.
Good to Have
Knowledge of PLC, SCADA, and HMI integrations.
Understanding of ISA-95 standards.
Basic experience with Power BI or Tableau.
Knowledge of Automated Guided Vehicles (AGV).
Exposure to IIoT and Digital Manufacturing solutions.
Ideal Candidate Profile
Experience working as an MES SME, Business Analyst, or Product Owner.
Strong manufacturing domain expertise.
Ability to work with both business stakeholders and technical teams.
Strong analytical, documentation, and problem-solving skills.
Experience in requirement gathering, UAT, and release planning activities.
What You''ll Love About Working Here
Opportunity to work on enterprise-scale manufacturing transformation programs.
Exposure to cutting-edge MES, IIoT, and digital manufacturing technologies.
About Us
Capgemini is a global business and technology transformation partner, helping organizations accelerate their digital transformation journey through innovation, engineering excellence, and deep industry expertise. We empower businesses to unlock value through technology while fostering an inclusive and sustainable future.
